( cangazo —nga tshe / rdo — — 4 ོ mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/ ོ dzo'aca nga ba/ca glegs b.rangayo/ bar do thosasgol be go ngatshob so 4 gnyis ba/ khrid yig ma 4 thoma'in / zla— rdoX dbal na ba/ nga nga ru thegs babams/ la ba sgom bsgyud rṣar/ 7 glesag bam bzhi ba/ ri sgro khrid yig thar lamags sgron/ zhuo—— rje ga' bamab/ ra —4 —༷ gle༅ bam lnga pa/ dwags po rin po ma thar rgyan/ ༄ snyo— — thegs bam drug ba/ cagarnathed ri chos/ 7 ri razhe nabu/ tsho ༄ glegs bam bdun ga ra bsdu dang bathe bsdumu/ juzo nga ba 4 sdu — klegs bam brgyadab/ la rim khridayig 4— 4 gyi : ཿngas/dzwadzwa glegs bam dgu pa/ rgyal gras 'ag len/dzārje 'tsho byed ga—— — glegs bam bcu pa/ rtsa chu'i mdo dang zin tig ma bu bcas/— nga 7 4 — 4— :1 zhu ༵ — zo— — — — tsha ྈ tho — — — nga zordzo rdzu ——tswaze cho —— sbyo she— — ོ dzo pa ༷shā— —7 ོ4 ) hūṃ ༷ 〉me 7 nghru ོ — —ca 4waṃ44—4 —— 13 rṣo 4 — rtsi—ོzodngha— 4 — zozo rje 4 rto ༅waṃ ja4nga ༄ 7rwasna rja— rā— — ༅ zo dzo ༅ ryā 4— —zang — ba——— — —za—mo —

mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/chags med ri chos/blo 'dri sa/'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas/ gter chen mchog gyur gling ba/mkhas dbang khro ru tshe rnam/ a dkon rin po che/ 'bal tsha dul mo chos rje/mkhas dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhas dbang padma dam chos/ lā mo yongs 'dzin/ shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ bla rgan sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ lho drung rin po che/ skyed tshal rin po che/spyi khyab rtsom sgrig pa/a lags rta mgrin/gtso sgrig pa/mkhan po rdo rje/rtsom sgrig u yon/kurma gu ru/ sngags chang gu ru/ dge legs nyi ma/ mkhan dam chos zla ba/mkhan skal ldan tshe ring / mkhan mchi med tshe dbang / 'jigs med theg mchog lhun grub rdo rje/ bsod nams rdo rje/ sangs rgyas don grub/ hūṃ chen / phun tshogs legs grub/

mtsho na nang bstan dpe tshogs/glegs bam drug pa/ri sa la masamakhan po rdo rjes bsgrigs/mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/— ———rto — kṣ-inyasho/lto/1 /7/༵༵༵ ༈nya༈1snya/snyisnyi/oṃ// 7/7 / /1 — //1/ ///kṣi/hi/ 7 7//smyokhyi/// / /1///////ṭwāṃ////1 shā// snyiḍi7ṭwāṃlhohaṃ///rnyi//////////hūṃ////snyi/ // 1//7/ / /snyo/snyi4/8(༈/༈/7//ska / 1shā/ 1‘/shka//1(/1snyi/nya//(1/1//lko//1/(/77717117/slo/hūṃsgo1(1/༈14snyi.oṃ/ // 7sgo/7/snyi//snyi/////shā////7 7ṭwāṃ//1slo/snyi/ 7(7༈ṭwāṃ/1khye 1/kyā4(774/7// 77 ( 7 zhang kyang then mā dpe skrun kung zi/
mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/glegs bam drug pa/chags med ri chos zhal gdams/mkhan po rdo rjes bsgrigs/mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs zhang kung then mā dpe skrun kung zi/

par skrun gsal bshad/ rang cag kha ba ri bo'i ljongs la bstan pa yang dar gyi nyi ga'on slar yang shar nas/ go la zlum po'i khyon na rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par bstan pa'i nying khu bod brgyad nang bstan du grags pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogarlo kun tu khyab pa'i go mtshams 'dir/ btsan gyis bcir zhing zur nas bshus pa'i rang 'dod rnams re zhig bzhag ste/ mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab rin thang bral ba ngom rin chog pa rnams par skrun 'grem spel byed rgyu do gal shin tu che ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub la/ khyad par dam pa gong ma rnams kyis gdul bya'i khams dbad dang mthun par grub mtha'i srol gtod pa rnams dgos dbang tsam dang bstan pa la byi dor mdzad pa las don la tha dad til 'bru tsam yang med kyang / da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus skabs su rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams kyis/ rig pa rno mdog gi rtsod gleng byas na/ chags sdang rang rgyud par shor nas bstan pa rin po che dkrugs nyen che bas kun gyis de la dogs zon mdzad nas bka' dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs don thams cad rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs zhi ba'i gnyen po thar pa thob pa'i man ngag nyag cig tu rtogs shing 'khor lo gsum kyi bya ba gang brtsam yang rgyal bstan rnam dag zhig tu 'gro gi yod pa mkhyen dgos la/ de ltar shes dgos na grub mtha' dang gzhung phyogs re tsam la sbyangs pas gnad de mkhyen par dka' bas sa dge bka' rnying bzhi'i dam pa gong ma'i gsung tshad mar gyar pa rdon 'dus la go bde ba/ bar do ngos 'dzin thos grol chen mo/ dal rlobyor don yod dpal dge'i khrid yig bshes gnyen bsten thabs lam 'bras bla brgyud/ ma nor lam ston sa skya'i sngon khrid/ nges 'byung gnad skul

dwags po'i thar rgyan/ rnal 'byor nyams len chag med ri chos/ shes bya mthar byed rwa bsdus bse bsdus/ blo sbyong nyams len lam rim khrid yigakun gyi spyi chings rgyal sras lag len/ dal rten 'tsho byed zin tig ma bu sogs dpe tshogs su bsgrig na/ sbyang brtson pa rnams la blta 'tshol bde zhing /'ga' zhig gis grub mtha' thams cad rta mog mog gi spu ltar 'gal 'dur mthong ba dang / the tshom gyi grwa4 bar tshud pa rnams lhag med du zhi nas gnad kyi babs so dgongs don gcig tu rtogs pa'i thabs khyad 'phags tu 'gyur ba dang / zhib 'jug pa rnams la'ang rgyal bstan ris med gcig tu zlum par ston pa sogs dgos gal che bar mthong la/ 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i dam pa du ma'i bka' lung legs so'i me tog bcas la brten/ mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs 'di bsgrigs bskrun zhus pa yin/ bsgrigs bskrun gyi cha la nor 'khrule srid kyang gong zhus gyis gnad der smin nas rgyal bstan ril po gcig tu bskyang na/ 'dzam bu'i gling na rang cag gi bstan pa 'di dar brtan yun gnas kyi stobs shugs la nus pa gang che zhig 'don thub cing /rang gzhan gyi rgyud la thar pa thob pa'i lam yang thag je nyer phyin yod/mdor ril gyis dril na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rjes 'jug yongs rdzogs kyi phan tshun 'gal 'du'i bsam blo yongs su spang nas theg pa gong 'og dang sa dge bka' rnying sogs grub mtha' smra ba'i mthar thug dgongs don thams cad 'gal med gcig tu rtogs te/ dgongs pa mnyam gzhigs dang mdzad phrin mnyam skyong mdzad nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling na nang bstan ril po gcig tu dar brtan yun gnas 'ong ba bya rgyu de ma bskos dbu la babs pa'i las 'gan zhig yin pa kun gyi thugs dbyings nas mi bor bar zhu zhu/zhes nang bstan rtsom sgrig khang gi mkhan ming rdo rjes bod yul mdo khams zi ling mkhar nang bstan chos kyi lding khang nas/2

dkar chagamachod par brjod cing brtsams pa'i dgos pa bshad pa / (/1(/ ) them yig rin chen phreng ba/ (2)() gling gzhi mthong ba 'dzum shor/ (/ )(snyo nges 'byung skye thabs sha mong sul 'byed/ (23)(// shi theg pa che chung nyams len gsal byed/ (28)(// ) sdom gsum srung tshul nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ (38) (6) skyabs 'gro'i zhal gdams 'jigs pa kun skyob/ (47)tsho/ sa sems bskyed gdams pa byang chub gzhung lam/ (51)(( thugs dam skyabs 'jug thugs rje'i bsil grib/ (56)(/ )/ thun skabs dmigs thun bar chad kun sel/ (59)khodabye sib sprong 'al gangams bangang rtsi'i cha rgyam/ (62)7216 —pa batshe / / ) )skye / rarab sku /(rgespyi maṇḍal gdams pa bsod nams ri bo (70) (snyo bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char rgyun/ (73)lta/ sa nyams rtogs skye tshul mgron po'i lam glu/ (91)

ma// bar chad skyob byed byams pa'i go cha/ ( / ()6)༅ sa dpyad ‘nyung ngu rin chen kun 'dus/ ( / / / ) (glo mtshams gyi zhal gdams thar lam dkar po/ ( 120) tshe'i/ lus sbyin bdag 'dzin bcod pa'i sta re/ (140)sa/ che'i tshe dpal bskyed byed tshe g.yang kha sprod/ (1 46)sherdo) bya spyod nyams len tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs/ ( /54)/() rnal 'byor rgyud sgrub ngan song sgo bcod/ (166)(// snyo/ lho sgo'i dmigs rim thar pa'i lam ston/ ( / 76)/sheX) bar do ngo sprod thos grol bsdus pa/ (/87)lta// 'eX mya ngan med pa'i shing gi bsil grib / ( /90)() gson byang bzhu thab sa 'brel tshad don ldan/ ( 194)4sabheX tshe 'das gnas 'dren thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ (199)/rtezloX/ yi dam phyi sgrub sngags kyi 'brug sgra/ (205)(|| yi dam nang sgrub dpa' bo'i rngam skad/ (2/4)(7 yi dam gsang sgrub mkha' 'gro'i gdung glu/ (221 )2

/() sbyin sreg nor bu sna tshogs mdog can/ (224)o yang gsang sgrub pa bde chen rab 'bar (229)(spyo de bzhin nyid sgrub dag pa rab 'byams (238) (rgo spros med dril sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/ (242)(snyo 'khrul 'khor rtsa tshig dzo bu'i chu gser/ (244)ltas 'grub rtags tshod 'dzin 'phrul gyi me long/ (246)sheX'i gol sa gcod pa ma nor lam ston/ (258)(tshe gegs sel gdams pa ba dud rtsi'i char rgyun/ (266)()/ bog 'don gdams pa yid bzhin nor bu/ (28/ )(/ nyiX rgyab chos dug 'jom rma bya chen mo/ (29/ )(rjeX spyod pa'i gdams pa rgyal sras lag len/ (5rte07/) (rmyenyi/ 'gro don gdams pa phrin las rgya mtsho/ (3/6) (/ snyo 'chi lugs gdams pa dpag bsam shing 'bras/ (346)(// snyo zhing khams gdams pa dad dpon nor len/ (3du9) ltas| dag pa'i zhing bgrod rta mchog ba la ha/ (372)3

( rgo/ thugs dam gsal 'debs rgyal po'i bka' 'phrin/ (387) (4/ chos skyong spyi sgrub phrin las rlabs phreng/ (395)sgo 'i/ bu yig mde'u thung phrin las kun 'grub/ (405)(rsā rgab 'dre mnan thabs ha la'i ri rab (408)lta:spyi bla rdo bca' thabs sha rul sbrang 'khor/ (411)(nyu gtor ma'i yig sna lha yi nor bu/ (417)(7/ pakshi'i khyad chos ma mgon zhal sbyor/ (424)/(snyo ras chen khyad chos mgon po'i nor sgrub/ (431)( snyu snyan rgyud lho brag mgon po'i gdams ngag (434)() bsngo ba'i zhal gdams nor bu rin chen/ (441)(6) chig brgyud u pa chos gyi grangs ldan/ (logs su bzhugs pas der gzigs pa zhu/)zhabs brtan zhal shes gdams pas 'jug bsdu ba/ (446)4

༄༅ / /ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams bzhugs pa'i dbu'o/ /mchod par brjod cing brtsams pa'i dgos pa bshad pa/na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ /chos dbyings mkha' la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer 'gro ba'i mun sel ba/ /drin can rnyarma shwa ra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo khams byang phyogs ngom du rung ba'i yul/ /chu bo gser ldan 'bab pa'i 'gram rol ngogs/ /gnam sa gru gsum phag mo'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /rgyal po gdan la bzhugs 'dra ri bo'i ngos/ /sgrub gnas dpal ri rtse yi mtshams khang du/ /shing sbrul bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lo mjug nas/ /cang shes rā ga'i mdog mtshungs lo sked kyi/ /zla ba 'ga' zung bar la dus rgyun du/ /phug sgo chos bshad byas nas thun re la/ /chos thun dmigs thun re re bshad pa rnams/ /dad brtson shes rab ldan pa'i brtson 'grus pas/ /yi ger bris la ri chos glegs bam byung / e ma ho/ /dus mtha'i dge slong kurma chags med bdag /gzhung lugs rgya chen 'ga' la ma byang zhing / /rtsom gzhi dpe mang bsdus nas ma bltas pas//mkhas rnams dgyes pa'i rgyud gzhung lung 'dren med//sgra dang snyan ngag tshig rgyan mi mkhas shing / legs par bsam blo btang nas ma bris pas /mkhas rnams mgu ba'i sa bcad sdeb sbyor med/ /rlung rnams dbu mar tshud par 1

ma gyur zhing / /ngag gi bden tshig grub pa ma yin phyir/ /gzhan phan byin rlabs 'byung bar re mi che/ /'on kyang bla ma yi dam dbyer med la/ /yun ring gsol ba btab cing bsgrubs pa'i mthus/ /mdo rgyud gsar rnying gnad kyi man ngag rnams//me long gzugs bzhin yid la gsal snyam byed//bslab cing bzung ba'i tshig kun brjed lags kyang / /don rnams phal cher yid la myong bas gsal//kha nag yig nag sprad pa'ang ma yin zhing / /chos bshad blo 'dzin bshar sbyangs ma byas kyang //bshad na zad med chu bo 'dra snyam byed//mkhas pas ma legs gsung nas bkag srid kyang / /rang 'dra'i rmongs ba gzhan la phan yang srid//them yig rin chen phreng ba/(sgotshogatachol bar 'gro dogs them yig rtsis su mnan/ /de la them yig rin chen phreng ba yod//tshorgo skye bo tha mal chos sgor 'jug pa'i phyir/ /ri chos gleng gzhi mthong ba 'dzum shor yod//7khri nges 'byung bsam pa brtan po skye ba'i phyir//'khor ba'i lam spang sha mong sul 'byed yod//(gyi gang zag theg pa che chung so so yi//nyams len gsal byed 'phags pa'i gaṇḍi yod//1misnyi sdom gsum rim gyis zhus nas srung bde'i phyir/ /sdom gsum bsrung tshul nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yod//tshomi 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa kun las skyobs pa'i phyir//skyabs 2

'gro'i zhal gdams 'jigs pa kun skyobs yod//nus ci byed byang chub lam du 'gro ba'i phyir//sems bskyed gdams pa byang chub gzhung lam yod//tshomi rang gzhan dkon mchog thugs rjes skyobs pa'i phyir/ /thugs dam skyabs 'jug thugs rje'i bsil grib yod//6) nyams chung nad pa sogs la phan pa'i phyir//thun skabs dmigs thun bar chad kun sel yod//(mi tshe rabs las kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i phyir/ /sgrib sbyong zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun yod// kṣ-isadaka' tshegs med par bsod nams tshogs rdzogs phyir/ /maṇḍal gdams pa bsod nams ri bo yod//6) byin rlabs 'jug cing nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i phyir//bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char rgyun yod//(mi dang po nyams rtogs skye tshul shes pa'i phyir//myong ba shul ring mgron po'i lam glu yod//6mi sangs rgyas bden pas bar chad skyobs pa'i phyir/ /byams pa'i go cha snying rje'i ya lad yod/ /ltasalji ri khrod sa cha gar legs shes dgos phyir//sa dpyad nyung ngu rin chen kun 'dus yod//6mi blo chung rmongs pas nyams len bde ba'i phyir//mtshams kyi zhal gdams thar lam dkar po yod//tshomi tshogs rdzogs nad gdon lam du slong ba'i phyir/ /lus sbyin bdag 'dzin gcod pa'i sta re yod//kṣ-i'i bla ma mched grogs sbyin bdag tshe bsring phyir//tshe dpal bskyed pa tshe g.yang kha sprod yod//tshobye〉 na so gzhon zhing dka' thub 'dod pa la//bya pyad nyams len tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs yod//tsho'i cho ga 'grigs chags phyag rgya mkhas pa 3

la//rnal 'byor rgyud bsgrub ngan song sgo gcod yod//tsho'i tshe 'das gshin po'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyir//lho sgo'i dmigs rim thar pa'i lam ston yod/ / tsho'ibar do rang ngo 'phrod nas grol ba'i phyir//bar do'i ngo sprod thos grol bsdus pa yod//6mi ri khrod chom rkun 'tshe ba med pa'i phyir//mya ngan med pa'i shing gi bsil grib yod//(zhi dad ldan 'byor ldan sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyir//gson byang bzhu thabs 'brel tshad don ldan yod//tshomi'abrel tshad tshe 'das dag pa'i zhing thob phyir//tshe 'das gnas 'dren thugs rje'i lcags kyu yod//tsho'i bskyed rim gtsor ston ma hā yo ga'i lugs/ /yi dam spyi sgrub sngags kyi 'brug sgra yod//lgoho mchod gtor sgrub rdzas la sogs 'dzom pa la/ /nang ltar bsgrub pa dpa' bo'i rngam skad yod//9mi bskyed rim dmigs pa shin tu gsal ba la//gsang sgrub ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gdung glu yod//(mi 'byor pa chung zhing bsgrub la brtson pa la//sbyin sreg nor bu sna tshogs mdog can yod//7mi a nu yo ga'i rgyud gzhung nyams len thabs/ /yang gsang sgrub pa bde chen rab 'bar yod//(snyo a ti yo ga'i rgyud kyi nyams len thabs//de bzhin nyid bsgrub dag pa rab 'byams yod//lta'iting 'dzin rtsal rdzogs spros par mi dga' na/ /dril sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel yod//(khri rten 'brel lus la bsgrig par bya ba'i phyir//'khrul 'khor rtsa tshig 'dzam bu chu gser yod//tshogis gsum lha tshogs 'grub dang ma 'grub pa'i/ /tshod 'dzin rtags yig 'phrul gyi me long yod//glo'i4

byang chub skyon med lam la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /gol sa gcod pa ma nor lam ston yod//tsho'i phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs skyon bsal ba'i phyir/ /gegs sel gdams pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun yod/ /tshukṣi nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i phyir/ /bogs 'don gdams pa yid bzhin nor bu yod/ / smyos nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib pa spang ba'i phyir/ /rgyab chos dug 'joms rma bya chen mo yod//lgo'ispyod pa rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /spyod pa'i gdams pa rgyal sras lag len yod/ / 7slo bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'gro don gdams pa phrin las rgya mtsho yod//6snyochos pa rab 'bring tha ma yang tha rnams//'chi lugs dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu yod/ /tshuspyorang nyid gar 'gro gtad so yod pa'i phyir/ /zhing khams 'dam pa ded dpon nor len yod/ / slos sgom long ma byung 'chi ba byung ba la/ /zhing bgrod rta mchog ba la ha zhes yod/ / 9slo'achi dus gzhi yi 'od gsal ngo 'phrod phyir/ /thugs dam gsal 'debs rgyal po 'i bka' phrin yod/ /(glosangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /chos skyong spyi sgrub phrin las rlabs phreng yod/ / lgo'i chos skyong phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /bu yig mde'u thung phrin las kun 'grub yod/ / 1spyilji sgrub pa kun la bar chad med pa'i phyir/ /rgab 'dre mnan thabs ha la'i ri rab yod//6michos skyong rang bzhin shugs la 'khor ba'i phyir//bla rdo brten rdzas sha rul sbrang 'khor yod/ /tsho3ljibar chad kun sel ci bsam 'grub pa'i phyir//gtor ma'i yig sna lha 5

yi nor bu yod/ / tshoske gzhung dang man ngag gnyis po gab 'phrod phyir/ /pakṣu'i khyad chos ma mgon zhal sbyor yod/ / (snyo dpal 'byor mnga' thang shugs la 'phel ba'i phyir/ /ras chen khyad chos mgon po'i nor sgrub yod/ / tsho'i rtsa rlung sgo nas phrin las kun 'grub phyir/ /snyan brgyud lho brag mgon po'i gdams ngag yod/ / tsho'i dge rtsa 'dzad med gter du sba ba'i phyir/ /bsngo ba'i zhal gdams nor bu rin chen yod/ /glezhi gsang sngags mi 'chal byin rlabs bcud ldan phyir/ /gcig brgyud u pa chos kyi grangs ldan yon/ /de ltar ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams la/ /bden nam rdzun gyi the tshom skyes pa na/ /gsar rnying bka' gter rgya cher gzigs dang mngon/ /zab dang mi zab yid gnyis za ba na/ /lo gsum mtshams sdams rtse gcig sgrubs dang gsal/ /brgyud pa gang yin the tshom za ba na/ /tshig gi brgyud pa rgya che grangs mang yang / /don gyi brgyud pa zung 'jug brgyud rim yin/ /bla ma gang yin the tshom za ba na/ /'brel thob slob dpon sum cu so bgrang yang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byang phyogs paṇḍi ta/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma chos kyi snang ba can/ /'jam dbyangs gsar du bzhad pa zhes bya ba/ /kun mkhyen dharma shwa ra nyid yin no/ /kye ma mkhas pa 'ga' la gtugs na yang / /gzhung gi bshad pa sa rgya ri nas bskor/ /gnad kyi man ngag rkun nor bzhin du sba/ /don rtsa nyams su len bya gtor nyen mchi/ /btsun tshugs dad pa 'dren la gtugs na yang / /stong nyid bsgom pa'i dus ni da lta min/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong kho nar 'bad dgos gsungs/ /nyams len chos kyi skal ba chad nyen mchi/ /grub thob bzang po 'ga' la gtugs na yang / /bka' bkyon dang bcas gdams ngag 6

brda' tsam gsungs/ /tha mal rmongs pas brda' yi don mi go /blun sgom gol sa'i lam du 'gro nyen che/ /rig gnas mkhas pa 'ga' la gtugs na yang / /sgra tshad sgrog gling tha snyad tshig la 'byams/ /mtha' rgya mi chod nam mkha' 'dom 'jal 'dra/ /'chi dus sems la gtad so med nyen mchi/ /dbang lung thob rgya can la gtugs na yang / /grub mtha' mang po'i lung yig po tir langs/ /phyag len zhib par mi gsungs sbom yor lus//lag tu lon nges gcig kyang med nyen mchi/ /gsar rnying dpe rgyud rgya cher bltas na yang / /de legs de legs bsam pa'i ngang la lus/ /de don snying po rtogs par mi 'gyur bas//klog mkhan rgan po 'dra zhig 'ong nyen mchi/ /gdams ngag zab dgu'i dpe bum mang yod kyang / /'di zab 'di zab snyam nas mi la bskung / /lag khrid med phyir gcig kyang lag mi lon/ /phan med khres po lci ba'i rgyu ru mchis/ /de bas phyi rabs sgom phrug gsar pa rnams/ /gzhung gi dbang lung khrid sogs thob phyi nas/ /man ngag kun 'dus ri chos 'di nyid zhus/ /dang po'i las can chos sgor zhugs pa nas/ /tshe gcig sgrub pa'i gnad 'gag 'di na 'dus/ /nyams su mi lon dpe tshogs ci zhig bya/ /glegs bam 'di nyid sngas su bzhag pa na/ /slob dpon khro med yin no skal ldan rnams/ /e ma ho/ ri rab rtse yi mkha' lding ga ru ṭa/ /lus po mi 'dra 'dab gshog bya dang 'dra/ /bya dang mi min rlabs chen khyung chen yin/ /bar snang khams kyi g.yu 'brug sngon mo kho/ /lus po sbrul 'dra 'phur rkyen bya dang 'dra/ /bya min sbrul min ngar chen g.yu 'brug yin//gangs dkar rtse yi seng lcam dkar mo kho/ /lus ni gcan gzan 'dug gnas ri dwags 'dra/ /gnyis ka ma yin rtsal chen seng ge yin/ /ri chos mtshams kyi zhalari gdams glegs bam 'di/ /bka' 7

ma'i chos 'dra gter ma'i chos kyang 'dra/ /so so ma yin gcig bsdus zhal khrid yin//'khor ba'i rgyun gcod 'khor lo rin chen yin//dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin chen yin/ /bde stong nyams ster btsun mo rin chen yin/ /phan bde'i blo ston blon po rin chen yin/ /sgrub rgyud khur thegs glang po rin chen yin/ /dag pa'i zhing bgrod rta mchog rin chen yin/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin chen yin/ /sgom phrug sgrub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin 'dod la/ /med thabs med pa'i pha nor rin chen bdun/ /pha rgan rkarma chags med bdag gis bzhag /nga dang 'phrad kyang 'di las smra rgyu med/ /yun ring 'grogs kyang zab gnad ston rgyu med//shi yang kha chems 'di las bzhag rgyu med//gsar rnying bka' gter man ngag bye ba phrag /gcig bsdus pod chung bye ba ring bsrel yin//hūṃ//chos kyi srung ma ma hā kā la ya//ma rgyud skor bzhi'i rgyud srung gri thod can//sgrub brgyud sgos kyi srung ma rdo rje ber//sgrub rgyud snying po'i don bcud ri chos 'di/ /'chad nyan sgom sgrub byed pa'i gang zag rnams/ /srung zhing skyong ba'i gnyer kha khyod la gtad//srungs shig skyob cig badzra rakṣa hūṃ//bhyoḥ /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo rang byung ma//sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru//sde snod gsum po 'chad nyan sgom sgrub pa//de la srung skyobs bran dang pho nya byed/ /gal te ma byas lus srog me 'bar nas/ /mnar med dmyal bar skye ba'i dmod bor ba'i/ /dam bca' dam tshig gnyen po'i dus la babs//sde snod gsum gyi bcud bsdus ri chos 'di//'chad nyan thos sgom nyams su len rnams la//srung skyobs sdong grogs mel tshe ma g.yelachag/oṃ//lha sman bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma//ma mo rbod gtong dkyil 'khor lhar ba zhugs pa/ /dkar mo chen mo nyi zla thod phreng 8

can/ /ming po rgyal bo'i bka' bsgyur dbang mo che//ri chos 'di nyid nyams len gang zag la//rgyal 'gong dam sri'i bar chad khyod kyis bzlog/slob dpon padmas dam btags dam tshig can/ /tshogs bdag yum ste rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /ri chos 'chad dang nyan dang nyams len la//bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i 'tshe ba bzlog/bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsang yum tshe ring ma//sgrub rgyud bstan pa spel ba'i g.yar dam can/ /sgrub rgyud snying po'i bcud bsdus ri chos 'di/ /gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin yun ring 'phel rgyas mdzod/ /tri/ /skyes mchog badzrahā cu sa mā ya/ /sngags kyi srung ma rdo rje legs pa skyongs/ /sde brgyad kun gyi sna 'dren rno myur can//ri chos them med skor gyi bka' 'di srungs//snod min lag tu ma 'chal bya ra mdzod/ /gcig brgyud gdams pas skal ldan smin grol ba'i/ /byin rlabs brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba bzhin/ /bstan pa ji srid bar gnas mi 'chad mdzod/ /rdurduhūṃ//ma mgon skyes bu lha sman tshe ring ma//snyan gyis gson la mngon shes thugs gyis dgongs//rdo rje 'chang dbang rta mchog gsang ba'i bdag/padma 'byung gnas pakṣi rang byung rje/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la sogs spyan snga ru/ /gsang sngags chos kyi bka' srung byed pa dang / /sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag thams cad la//bu sdug bzhin du skyong bar dam bcas pa'i//thug4dam tha tshig gnyen po rjes dgongs la/ /dam chos kun gyi bcud bsdus ri chos dang / /'di nyid 'chad dang nyan dang nyams len pa//kun la bu bzhin skyongs shig sa mā ya//de ltar brtsams mkhan garma a rā ga/bdag ni so skye'i dbang gyur mi shes pas//don log don 'gal sba 'os gsal bkod sogs//'di brtsams las gyur nyes pa gang mchis rnams//mkhas grub chos kyi spyan ldan thams cad dang //rtsa gsum 9

chos bdag srung ma rnams la bshags/ /tshe 'di'i bar chad rkyen du mi 'gyur zhing //yun gyis sgrib par yang ni ma gyur cig /rtsom pa'i slob dpon kurma chags med dang //zhu zhing 'bri ba'i ngal ba dang len pa//slob bu ru pa brtson bgrus rgya mtsho dang / /de dag gnyis la 'brel thog 'gro ba dang / /chos 'di mthong thos 'brel thogs 'gro ba rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med nyams rtogs 'phel/ /nam zhig 'phos tshe skye ba gzhan dag gis/ /bar ma mchod par bde chen zhing khams su/ /rdzus te skyes nas rig bdag zhal mthong zhing / /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob par/ /dpon slob mched grogs thams cad mi 'bral bar /byang chub spyod pa rlabs chen spyod par shog /mdor na bdag dang slob ma brgyud par bcas/ /ri chos 'di la 'brel pa thogs tshad kun/ /skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /sku tshe rdzu 'phrul pad 'byung lta bur shog /spyan ras gzigs dang 'gro don mnyam par shog /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mkhyen rab mnyam par shog /gsang ba'i bdag dang mthu stobs mnyam par shog /ri chos 'di la 'brel ba thogs tshad rnams/ /rang sems chos sku mngon sum rtogs pa yi/ /bka' brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis 'byung bar shog /rang lus dkyil 'khor mngon sum gsal ba yi/ /yi dam lha yis bkra shis 'byung bar shog /btsun tshugs nye bar 'khor dang mnyam pa yi//gnas brtan bcu drug bkra shis 'byung bar shog /phrin las lhun grub bstan pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /ma mgon lcam dral bkra shis 'byung bar shog /chos rgyud chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ring ba yi/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i bkra shi4'byung bar shog /myur mgyogs phrin las glog ltar 'khyu ga pa yi/ /skyes bu chen po'i bkra shis 'byung bar shog /maṅga lam̐ si rnyi dzā ya a la la 10

ho/ /ces bya ba 'di ni ngom du rung ba'i yul stod gnas chen rdo rje'i skyed tshal dpal ri rtse yi sgrub khang du/ snyigs dus kyi dge slong sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa kurma a rā ga zhes bya ba tshe mtshams kyi dam bca' la gnas pa'i skabs su/ bla ma ru pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho zhes bya ba phug sgor yang yang slebs shing zhus len gyi tshul du/ zhu ba po nyid kyis yi ge pa byas te/ dpal chen rta mgrin dmar po mtshon pa'i me pho rta'i lo khrums zla'i nyer gnyis nas 'phro mthud de/ yum chen phag mo dmar mo mtshon pa'i me mo phag gi zla ba/ lha lnga mtshon pa'i yar tshes lnga'i snga dro ri chos kyi glegs bam yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'o/ /them yig le'u dang po'o//maṅga lam̐// gling gzhi mthong ba 'a4 shor/lgozhiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ gleng gzhi mthong ba 'dzum shor zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo ratna gu ru ye//ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams kyi//gling gzhi rgyu rkyen brtsams pa'i don/ /nyung bsdus tshigs su bcad de bkod/ /mkhas 'dod che ba'i rtsom pa mkhan/ /bzang 'dod che ba'i tshul 'chos mkhan/ /rtag 'dzin che ba'i khang las mkhan/ /nye rtsis che ba'i 'khor sdud mkhan/ /nor 'dod che ba'i 'gro don mkhan/ /'chi dogs che ba'i mtshams sgrub mkhan/ /rā ga a su ming can des/ /mkhas grub bla ma rnam bzhi'i drung / /rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i dam bca' phul//mi chen yon bdag mang po la/ /tshe mtshams byed pa'i kha phud byas//11

rta phyugs grangs de ri na bzhag/grong ltag khang chung khra mo'i nang //na dogs 'chi dogs 'don 'bug gzab//so gsod lkog nyal byed pa na//zla ngo bcu gnyis ngo mthong dus/ /rigs bzang blo gsal shes rab can/ /dad gus brtson par ldan pa yi/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho de/ /mtshams khang phug sgo'i rtsa ru slebs/ /bdag ni da lo de'u shi byas/ /zug gzer drag pos mnar ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rtogs pas non ma thub/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal de 'dra na/ /'chi bdag gshin rje byung tsam na/ /nyams rtogs pang la yar gyi dogs//dkon mchog thugs rjes ma shi bas/ /sgyu lus 'di la bang gcod nas//mi 'chi'i thabs ni mi gda' ('dug)ste/ /shi yang 'gyod pa med pa yi/ /mtshams dang sgrub pa e thon bsam/ /sgrub gnas ri khrod gcig yod de//sa dpyad kyang ni mi shes pas//'dug rung mi rung thag ma chod//dbang lung gdams ngag mang thob cing //bskyed rdzogs go ba che na yang / /sgrub pa ma thon nyams myong med/ /ri khrod kho na 'grim bsam ste/ /ri chos gdams pa thob ma myong / /bka' brgyud gong mas mdzad pa yi/ /ri chos dpe cha 'ga' yod de/ /lung rgyun tsam yang ma thob cing / /nyams su len pa'ang dka' bar gda'//khyed kyi brtsams chos mang na yang //de sngon ri chos ma mdzad pas//ri chos shig ni rtsoms par zhu/ /khyed kyi phyag kyang bsnyung zer bas/ /phyag bris 'o brgyal che lags pas//zhal nas gsung dang nged kyis 'bri/ /de ltar brtsam pa'i maṇḍal du/ /'od mtshan cod pan 'chang ba yi/ /zhabs rjes gser thang byin rlabs can/ /nyid kyis mdzad chos glegs bam bcas/ /phul nas phyag kyang dgu phrug 'tshal/ /maṇḍal kyang ni brgya rtsa phul/ /de tshe rā ga a su yi/ /he nye brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba//bka' brgyud gong mas gsungs pa yi//ri chos rnams kyi don 12

rtsa ni/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /pha yul spang ba'i gnas ri ru/ /mi rtag 'chi bas sems bsngangs te/ /lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /chu 'thung rdo mur ro gos gyon/ /rang sems ngo bo skyong ba las/ /bya rgyu ci yang med par byas /bla ma'i gsol 'debs tshig gsum las/ /'don rgyu bsgrub rgyu med par byas/ /'chi bdag nam 'ong sgug pa las//bsam rgyu ci yang med par byas//dad 'dun yon bdag byung srid na//ri dwags rmas mas mi mthong bzhin//lung stong mi skad med sar 'bros/ /bka' brgyud dgongs pa'i ri chos yin/ /nad med rlung khyer chos pa lags//de 'dra bdag gis ma nus pas//skyes pa'i yul 'dir sdod yun ring //sa ming mi la thogs nas yod/ /nye du dpon rigs grwa par bskor//gcig pur zhag gcig 'dug ma myong / /lo brgyad lon nas bkor la bros/ /deng sang rta phyugs brang nga yod/ /'chi ba snying la ma gzer bas/ /ri khrod gnas chen khang ba tsam/ /de phyir ri chos rtsom thabs med/ /bka' brgyud gsung la dpe byas nas/ /bris na rgyus yod kun gyis khrel/ /kha yi gtam pa snas khrel dpe/ /rang gi nyams su ma blangs pa'i//chos bshad byas kyang su yid ches//de phyir ri chos rtsom thabs med//ces smras brtson 'grus rgya mtsho des//zhag gcig bsam mno btang byas nas//slar yang zhu ba phul ba ni//bla ma rā ga a su khyed//chung nas rab byung tshul khrims ldan/ /bla ma che phra mang du bsten/ /gsar rnying dbang lung gdams pas phyug /gzhon tshe grong chog mdzad tshe yang / /bar skabs bsnyen sgrub dpag med mdzad/ /de rjes lo grangs bcu gsum bar//sgrub pa'i dam bca' mtha' ru phyin//sa gter gnam chos mang po nas//skal ldan chos bdag lung bstan thob//lo bdun phyogs mtshams 'gro don rgyas/ /che dgu mang pos btud cing bkur/4/13

da ni tshe mtshams dam bca' mdzad//de sngon nyid kyis nyams myong dang //bstun pa'i ri chos gnang bar zhu//de bas lhag pa'i bya btang sogs//bshad kyang nga yi nyams mi lon/ /nyams su mi lon dam chos de/ /dpe cha'i khres po lci ba'i rgyu/ /nyams su lon nges gdams pa zhu/ /zer bas rā ga a su des/ /nyi thung thugs dam byed rgyu mang //ri chos la sogs rtsom gzhi yi/ /dpe cha gcig kyang ma bltas shing / /sku rim srung bzlog dmigs rim mang / /bsam mno btang long ma byung yang //dgong mo'i thun mtshams re re la//'phral du gang dran smras pa rnams//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho bas//zab chos yin pa'i dad 'dun gyis//gos srab lo gsar lhags pa la//bzod pa'i go cha chen po bsgos//sor mo rlung gi rta la zhon//smras rim bzhin du bri tshar byas/ /rim pa bzhin du bris pa'o/ /mdo rgyud lung 'dren med pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gzigs nyan med/ /'on kyang mdo rgyud bstan bcos ni/ /tshad ldan gang dang 'ang mi 'gal snyam//stong skad mthon po ma mchis pas/ /rtogs pa mthon pos gzigs nyan med/ /'on kyang gol sa shor sa la/ /lhung ba'i skyon ni med snyam bgyi/ /sdeb sbyor snyan dngags ma mchis pas/ /rtsom pa'i yan lag ma tshang yang / /sems la phan pa yod snyam bgyi/ /'di nyid tshul bzhin nyams blangs na//grub thob zer ba ma byung yang //byang chub lam la 'gro snyam bgyid//de phyir snag shog smyu gu la/ /ser sna ma byas bris pa lags/ /ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las//gleng gzhi'i skor te dang po'o//na mo gu ru/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho khyed/ /nges par ri khrod 'grim dgongs na/ /lus la snying po len dgongs na/ /mi lus don ldan byed dgongs na/ /'chi kha 'gyod med byed dgongs na/ /'chi la mi 'tsher byed dgongs na/ / 14

bar do med par byed dgongs na/ /phyi ma'i bde skyid bsgrub dgongs na/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro dgongs na/ /gtan bde'i 'dun ma bsgrub dgongs na/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /nga yi snying gtam yid la zhog /bskal pa bye ba brgya stong la/ /mi lus thob pa lan re lags/ /da res lo brgya theng gcig yin/ /mi lus don dang ldan par mdzod/ /bskal pa brgya stong du ma la/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi sgra yang med/ /da res bskal pa bzang por skyes//sangs rgyas stong rtsa 'byon na yang / /bar skabs bstan pa nub yun ring / /da res shā kya'i bstan dang mjal/ /'dzam gling yul gru mang po na/ /bod min gzhan la dam chos nub/ /da res kha ba can du skyes/ /'on long dbang po mi gsal na/ /mi lus tsam pos chos mi go/ /da res shes rab rig pa gsal/ /da res chos cig ma byas na/ /phyis nas 'di 'dra'i lus mi rnyed//de phyir mi lus don ldan mdzod//mi lus don ldan gang zhe na/ /sdom gsum rim gyis zhus pa rnams/ /rtsa ba ma nyams srog ltar bsrung / /phra zhib nyams na gso skyong mdzod/ /lus la g.yog gi 'du shes kyis/ /dal bar yud tsam nyal ma bcug /lus la bed chod phyag bskor mdzod/ /yang na rlung dang 'khrul 'khor sbyongs/ /ngag la bed chod bsnyen sgrub mdzod/ /yang na gsol 'debs chos spyod 'bungs/ /sems la bed chod bskyed rdzogs sgoms/ /yang na snying rje'i gtong len gces/ /g.yog la gla dang tshas ma ltar/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i gla brngan du/ /lto gos ci 'byor tsam re gyis/ /ma 'dzom dka' thub bcud len mdzod/ /sha thud ja sogs zas bzang yang / /zhag gcig song nas mi gtsang rdzas/ /de la snying po med par soms/ /ltogs dang skom pa'i yi mug skyur/ /rlung bcud dmigs pas lus stobs bskyed/ /'dzom na dka' thub dgos rgyu 15

med//lus lha yi dam rnams la mchod//rang gzhan bsod nams tshogs su bsngo//ma shi'i bar du der 'bad na/ /mi lus don dang ldan pa dang / /shi yang 'gyod med 'grub pa yin//lus la snying po len pa'i glu//ri chos kun gyi thog ma yin/ /na mo shu ru//gson dang kurma brtson 'grus pa//nges par ri khrod 'grim pa na//sngon 'gro'i chos su gsungs na yang //dus rnams kun du gal che ba//mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa gces//'chi ba snying nas ma dran na/ /chos sgor zhugs pa don ma mchis//lto phyir rab tu byung ba dang //gral phyir bsnyen par rdzogs na yang //chos med ser mo'i gzugs brnyan tsam/ /rig gnas yon tan kun bslabs kyang / /zang zing longs spyod bsdu phyir tsam//mtshams sgrub ri khrod 'grim na yang //ngag nus nad gdon zhi phyir tsam//sdom pa dam tshig srung na yang //ngo tshas mi kha srung phyir tsam/ /gang bya sa tshe 'di kho na'i don/ /de kun 'chi ba ma dran skyon/ /'dus byas mtshan nyid mi rtag pa//stong gsum 'jig rten sra mkhregs can//'di yang me chu rlung gis 'jig/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sku/ /de yang 'das pa'i tshul ston na/ /bsod nams chung ngu'i 'bras bu yi/ /mi lus nyams chung lta ci smos//tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur//stobs chen de rnams 'chi dgos na/ /srog chags gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /'dzam gling tshe la nges pa med/ /khyad par deng sang snyigs ma'i skabs//tshe tshad bzhi bcu kha ral dus//de yang mi thub 'chi ba mang //mkhas dang btsun dang bzang ba dang //rgyal po man nas sprang po yan//mi 'chi 'dug sa gcig kyang med//kye ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba//'chi ba kun gyis shes mod kyang / /da rung (da dung /)mi dogs bsam pa 'dis/ /thams cad 'di yis bslus nas gda'/ /de yang 'di yis bslu bslu 'dra/ /khyed kyang 16

'di yis bslu dogs mdzod//phu shi mda' shi zer ba'i dus//cha ngag yin par go bar mdzod/ /na mnyam gzhon pa shi ba'i dus/ /tshe la nges med dran par mdzod / ro dang rus pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /lus kyi chos nyid dran par mdzod/ /sman gyis ma phan shi thos tshe//sman gyi phan med dran par mdzod//rim gros ma phan shi thos tshe//bzlog thabs med pa dran par mdzod//nangs par thegs pa'i 'gron po bzhin//myur du 'gro dgos dran par mdzod/ /longs spyod rgya mtsho yod na yang / /zhag rgyags khyer dbang e gda' ('dug)na/ /'khor g.yog brgya stongayod na yang / /gcig tsam khrid dbang e gda' ('dug)na/ /khrab chen brgya stong dpung yod kyang / /'chi bdag bkag sa e gda' ('dugatan/ /zas nor 'dzam gling bkang yod kyang / /'then sa gtong sa e gda' ('dug)na/ /nam 'ong cha med 'chi bdag de/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas thog rgod bzhin/ /nam tsam 'ong na a tsa ma/ /'chi kha nad gcod sdug bsngal de/ /gnyen 'dun mang pos mtha' bskor yang //bgo nas khur thabs e gda' ('dug)na//'byung bzhi'i gtang lan thim rim la/ /log pa'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs de/ /shes rig bkra yang e phan na//bar do'i 'jigs skrag sna tshogs pas/ /nyes chen btson du bzung ba bzhin/ /sngangs skrag 'jigs gsum a tsa ma/ /cha med yul du rgyus med mi/ /grogs med gcig pur 'khyam pa'i dus/ /gar 'gro'i gtad so yod lags sam/ /rgyags phye grabs su tshud lags sam/ /la sa kyi gshin rje'i khrims ra na/ /rdzun gyi phan pa med do skad/ /me long yig chung gsal lo skad/ /de dus ngo gnong med pa zhig /brtson 'grus rgya mtsho da res rem/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i glu/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i cha rkyen yin/ / 17

na mo gu ru/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa/ /dgra bcom rnams kyis mi dgongs na/ /rang cag rnams kyis ga la shes/ /bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /gtso bor rgyu 'bras ston pa lags/ /ro gcig rtogs pa'iskyes bu yis/ /rgyu 'bras don la 'phrigs tshud pas/ /rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char bar gsungs/ /de 'dra bdag gi spyod yul min/ /'on kyang thub pa'i dbang po yi/ /gsung la dpang po byas nas kyang / /cung zad smra nus bla ma'i drin/ /phyirolaldod kyi 'jig rten yang / /sems can spyi mthun las kyis grub/ 4 /nang bcud 'gro ba'i skyid sdug rnams/ /thams cad las kyi rgyu las byung / /dge ba'i las kyis ba de 'gro gsum/ /mi dge'i las kyis ngan 'gro gsum/ /mi g.yo ba yi las zhes pa/ /bsamakhagatan ro la chags pa yis/ /gzugs dang gzugs med lha yi gnas/ /kun bslangs bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /zhe sda nga bsam pa'i kun slong gis/ /mi dge gang byas dmyal ba ste/ /ser sna 'dod chags kyis spyad pa'i/ /mi dge'i las kyis yid btags so/ /gti mug kun bslangs mi dge ba/ /gangatso sa dud 'gro rnams su skye/ /ser sna dge ba 'dres ma yi/ /brel 'phang mi yi gnas su skye/ /phrag dog dge ba 'dres ma yi//'thab —rtsod lha min gnas su skye/ /nga rgyal dge ba 'dres ma yi/ /pham ltung lha yi gnas su skye/ /sdig pa chen pos dmyal ba ste/ /'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngus dud 'gro rnams su'o/ /dge ba chen pos lha ru skye/ /'bring gis mi ru skye ba ste/ /chung ngus lha ma yin skye gsungs/ /srog gcod rnam smin dmyal ba ste/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /tshe ni thung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyu mthun 'bras —bu srog gcod dga'/ /ma byin blangs pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /yi dwags gnas su skyo'agyur 18

ste/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /dbul zhing 'phangs par 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rku 'phrog dga'/ /mi gtsang spyod kyi rnam smin gyis/ /yi dwags gnas su skye 'gyur te/ /dbang gi 'bras bus tshad rong gi /srog chags spu med rigs su skye/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu mir skyes kyang / /gzhan gyi bud med g.yem la dga' / /rdzun gyi rnam smin dud 'gro ste/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /kha na dri ngan bro ba yin/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rdzun la dga'/ /phra ma'i rnam smin lha ma yin/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /gnyen bshes kun dang bye bral mang / /rgyu mthun 'bras bu dbyen la dga'/ /tshig rtsub rnam smin dmyal ba ste/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /nyes med gshe skur mang ba yin/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu tshig rtsub 'tsher/ /ngag 'chal rnam smin dud 'gro ste/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /bden par smras kyang rdzun yin zer/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu ngag mi btsun/ /brnab sems la yang gnyis yin te/ /rang rtsis che ba bdag la brnab/ /gzhan la brnab pa zhes bya ni/ /gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /rang gi yin na ang snyam pa/ /rnam smin ngan song gang rung ste/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /ci bsam mi 'grub log par 'gro/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu brnab sems 'dod/ /gnod sems rnam smin dmyal bar skye/ /dbang gi 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /dgra dang mi 'bral 'jigs skrag dang / /rgyu mthun 'bras bu gnod sems 'dod/ /log lta'i rnam smin dud 'gro ste/ /dbang gis 'bras bus mir skyes kyang / /lta log mu stegs rigs su skye/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu log lta che/ /mi dge bcu po spang ba ni/ /dge ba bcu po zhes bya ste/ /skyon ni sum cu de dag las/ /ldog pa'i yon tan sum cu thob/ /spyir ni las la rnam pa bzhi/ /tshe sngon nam 19

zhig bsags pa'i las/ /tshe 'dir nges par smin dgos pas/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu bde skyid tshogs//bdud kyi bar du gcod mi nus//sdig pa'i las 'bras sdug bsngal tshogs/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyobs mi nus/ /las kyi rnam smin ma gtogs so//gsungs pa'i las ni de yin te//mthong thos myong 'gyur zhes bya'o//tshe 'di las 'bras dge dang sdig/'bring tsam phyi ma mi smin te//skye ba gcig gis bar chod nas/ /de yi rgyab ma smin pa ni/ /skye gnas myong gyur las zhes bya/ /dge ba sdig pa chung ngu rnams/ /nam smin nges pa med pa la/ /nam zhig nges par smin dgos pa/ /lan grangs gzhan du myong 'gyur zer/ /pha ma slob dpon dgra bcom bsad/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub par shom pa rnams/ /skye ba gzhan gyis bar mi chod/ /bar do yang ni mi bgrod par/ /mnar med gnas su ltung 'gyur phyir/ /mtshams med mar gyi zang thal yin/ /'chi dus thugs dam yun ring zin/ /'pho ba skar khung mda' 'phangs ltar/ /bar do mi bgrod zhing khams skye/ /yar gyi zang thal zhes bya'o/ /dge ba shin tu stob4che na/ /'di yis phyi ma nyid la smin/ /dge ba mtshams med zhes bya'o/ /pha ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / /sa bcu'i sems dpa' sangs rgyas la/ /dge dang sdig pa gang bsags pa/ /tshe 'dir smin pa'ang srid ces gsungs//tshe stod sdig pa byas gyur kyang //tshe smad dge la 'bad pa na//sngon la dge ba smin gyur te//'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs na yang //rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa zer/ /tshe stod chos la 'bad gyur kyang / /tshe smad mi dge spyod gyur na/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs na yang / /rdzogs byed sdig pas rdzogs pa'o/ /bsngo ba'i rgya yis ma thebs pa'i/ /dge ba ngom dang 'gyod na 'dzad/ /sdig pa bshags na 'dzad pa yin/ /de lta min pa'i dge dang sdig /bskal pa brgyar yang 20

chud mi za//rang byas rang la smin pa yin//ma byas las dang 'phrad mi srid//byas ba nam yang chud mi za/ /nyi zla thang la ltung ba'am/ /rlung ni zhags pas zin pa dang //me ni grang bar 'gyur srid kyi//las 'bras bslu ba mi srid pa//sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' yin te/ /'di la mi bden sus zer ba/ /tshe 'dir lce yi dbang po brtul/ /skye ba lnga brgyar lkugs par skye/ /de phyir ri khrod 'grims 'dod na/ /las 'bras phra zhib yang yang bsam/ /spang blang lag len theb par mdzod/ /las 'bras don rtsa'i glu chung 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i tshes gcig gi/ /dgong thun mtshams la smras pa'o/ /na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ /gson dang brtson 'gru sa rgya mtsho ba/ /bsam mno legs par thongs mdzod dang //blo bde nyal ba'i skabs ma yin//gnyid kyang bya yal glo snying 'dar/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dir/ /rang cag sems can thams cad ltung / /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs/ /ngan song chu srin spir gyis gang //sdug bsngal rlabs phreng bar skabs med//'di la da res ma thar na//ngan 'gro log pa'i nya mid dang / /de min chu srin spir gyis 'dzin/ /'di las sgrol ba'i ded dpon ni//mtshan ldan bla ma kho na lags//de phyir de la gus pa bskyed//rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru gzings ni/ /sdom pa dam tshig kho na lags/ /de phyir de la gces spras bya/ /rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i skya ba ni/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag gcig pu lags//de phyir de nyid yid la 'chang / /rgya mtsho myur du sgrol ba'i thabs//nyams len brtson 'grus kho na lags/ /de phyir de la 'bad par bya/ /me stag phog pa'i byabs lugs la/ /mi yi me las bdun 'gyur gyis//dmyal ba'i me ni tsha gsungs na//lo grangs stong phrag du ma ru/ /btso zhing bsregs pa su yis bzod//dgun kha 21

gos srab 'dar lugs la//lus ni gas shing chu bur rdol//lo grangs bye ba dpag med du//'khyags na su zhig bsran par nus//nyin gcig zas med ltogs yus (ltog drag)la/ /lo grangs stong phrag re rer yang / /zas skom mig gis ma mthong na/ /de 'dra'i ltogs sdug su yis khyags/ /khyi rgan zer ba'i ko long la/ /khyi yi skye ba lnga brgya tsam/ /bsdud mar blangs na ci 'dra 'kham/ /'ur zhog lang ba'i skrag snang la/ /lha min skyes na gang du 'bros/ /kha rgyal pham pa'i sems sdug la/ /lha yi pham ltung ci ltar bzod//ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'di//rna bas thos kyang ya nga na//thog tu babs na ci ltar byed//bde 'gro gsum gyi bde skyid 'di//zas bzang dug dang 'dres pa bzhin/ /'phral du skyid de phugs su 'phung / /rdzi bo za mar res pa bzhin//'gro ba drug tu res mos 'khor//sdug bsngal grangs mang rgya mtsho 'dra/ /skye rga na 'chi bar med myong / /de ltar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de/ /mu stegs pa yi zer ba bzhin//phya dang dbang phyug gis ma byas//btsan po gzhan gyi chad pa min/ /rang gi byas pa'i las 'bras lags/ /de phyir rang la snyingarje lta/ /sngar byas sdig la bshags sdom dang //phyin chad mi byed dam bca' bzung //nub re bzhin du rang rgyud la//brtag la dge sdig gang mang blta//nyes ltung gang byung 'phral du bshags/ /dge ba gang 'grub byang chub bsngo//lus ngag mi dge ma byas kyang //sems la mi dge 'gyus pa rnams//rang gi rang la zhe khrel bzla/khador na chos phung brgyad khri'i don//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ba stsal ba//sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /ces gsungs sho lo ka de la/ /mdo phyogs chos rnams 'dus pa yin/ /de phyir tshig de yid la chongs/ /'khor ba'i 22

sdug bsngal dran pa'i glu/ /dge slong rā ga a su yi/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i yar tshes gsum/ /dgongs mo'i thun la smras pa ste/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos brjed thor bris//'gro ba mang por phan thogs shog /le'u gnyis pa maṅga lam̐//nges 'byung skye thabs sha mong sul 'byed/mustiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i lam spang ba'i tshul sho mang gi sul 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru shākya mu ne ye//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho gson mdzod dang / /ri khrod 'grim zhing nyams len skyong ba la/ /bla med byang chub lam la 'jug dgos te/ /lam gyi rnam grangs phyogs tsam ma shes na/ /rang nyid gar 'gro lam ngo mi shes pas/ /zhib par brjod na grangs kyis ma langs kyang / /phyogs 'go tsam zhig cis kyang shes dgos gda'/ /de la lam ma rnyed dang lam log dang / /lam gol dman pa'i lam rnams spang bya yin/ /'dzam gling rnga yab gling gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /gling chen gling phran gzhan la chos mi dar/ /'dzam gling yul chen dgu bcu go dgu las/ /yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhir chos dar ste//de min mtha' 'khob brgya dang rtsa brgyad dang / /yang 'khob stong rtsa rnams su dam chos med/ /yul chen gzhan la'ang ding sang dam chos nub/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i phrin las kyi/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bod du dam chos rgyas/ /rang re bod du skyes 'di bsod nams bsags/ /spyir gyi grub mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /spyan ras gzigs sogs sangs rgyas byang 23

sems kyi/ /gdul bya'i blo tshod 'tsham par gsungs pa ste/ /de phyir mu stegs la sogs smad mi rung / /sangs rgyas srid phyir bdud kyang srid pa dang / /dag pa'i zhing khams srid phyir dmyal ba'ang srid/ /bde 'gro srid phyir ngan 'gro srid pa dang / /nyin mo srid phyir mtshan mo srid pa dang / /chos lugs rnam dag srid phyir chos log srid/ /gter ston srid phyir gter rdzun gter log srid/ /lta ba rnam dag srid phyir lta log srid/ /sdom ldan dam gtsang srid phyir dam nyams srid/ /'di dag rten 'brel ltos gzhag chos nyid de/ /ngan pa med na bzang po mi 'byung phyir/ /grub mtha' log pa rnams la'ang gshe mi rung / /shes par bya la de ru 'jug mi bya/ /de phyir rgya gar paṇḍi ta rnams kyis/ /mu stegs gzhung rnams bslabs nas mkhas par sbyangs/ /log pa'i lam de phyogs 'gro ma shes na/ /mun nag nang du ma mthong g.yang sa bzhin/ /rang nyid de ru ltung nyan che ba yin/ /rgya gar yul du phyi pa nang pa zer//rgya nag yul du ha shang ho shang zer//bod kyi yul du ban dang bon du grags/ /de dag rnams rkyang ltos gzhag rten 'brel lags/ /sdang sems mi 'dzin rten 'brel mtshar por blta/ /slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis la ni bka' bsgos pas/ /mu stegs dngos ni bod 'dir 'ong sa med//'on kyang sngon gyi las sgrib che ba des//mtha' 'khob min kyang mtha' 'khob 'dra ba dang / /mu stegs min kyang mu stegs 'dra nyan gda'/ /bon po min kyang bon dang 'dra nyan gda'/ /ha shang min kyang ha shang 'dra nyan gda'/ /kye ma da res mi lus thob pa 'di//tshe sngon gang nas 'ong kyang mi shes la/ /da res 'dug long ci tsam yod mi shes/ /phyi ma gar 'gro'i gtad so med bzhin du//'chi ba mi dran dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang //zas nor 24

bsags 'dod kho na'i don gyi phyir/ /mi dge mi rung mtshams med sna tshogs byed/ /de nimatha' 'khob mi dang khyad par ci//mtha' 'khob la yang de bas thu ba med//la chen byed spyod de dang 'dra ba las//phyi ma mi dran da lta'i rkyen bzlog la/ /ban bon mo ma gto pa gang rnyed brten/ /ban bzang bon bzang khyad par med do zer/ /gangs can bod du skyes pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yi ge drug pa kha thon byed na yang //dbang med lung med bsgom bya'i dmigs pa med//sngags sgra 'bru med rta yi yig drug 'dra//de dag 'jig rten skye bo phal ba ste//lam ma rnyed dang lam ma zhugs pa zer/ /lam log mu stegs pa la'ang rigs mang ste/ /zhib par lta log sum brgya drug cu gsungs//bsdu na mu bzhi'am ni rtag chad gnyis//mu stegs nag po chad par lta ba ste//sngon dus mu stegs paṇa chen mkhas pa zhig/sring mo mdzes ma spyod 'dod ma nyan pas/ /de mgo bskor phyir log pa'i bstan bcos brtsams//de yi rjes 'jug mu stegs chad lta ste//mdzes ma ma shi'i bar du ci dgar spyod/ /shi nas de yi spyod yul min/ /lus ni thal ba ltar song bas /sems ni nam mkha'i bag la zha//slar skye ba dag ga la yod//kye ma mang thos gang smras pa//g.yon can spyang ki'i rjes dang mtshungs//ces bshad mi shi yu med yin par 'dod//sangs rgyas mi bden rgyu 'bras mi bden zer//tshe 'di'i skyid sdug dbang phyug chen pos byed//de phyir dbang phyug snying khrag dron mos mchod//dzas ngan dug sbyor mang pos dgra rnams brlag /sems la dug lnga byol nyogs ci dgar spyod/ /de ni mu stegs nag po'i chos lugs yin/ /de dang cha mthun ding sang 'di na yang / /steng ni nam mkha' stong ba yin pa dang / /'og ni sa tshong rdo tshong yin 'dug pas//dmyal ba gar yod 'khrul snang tsam yin zer//sdig pa'i 25

nyes dmigs ngan song sdug bsngal kun/ /ji ltar bshad kyang bden par mi 'dzin par/ /de tsho shes tshod bshad tshod tsam yin zer/ /gzungs sogs dge pa'i phan yon ci thos kyang //de ltar phan na mang po ci dgos zer//sangs rgyas byang sems bka' brgyud bla ma yi//rnam thar yon tan ngo mtshar ci thos kyang //de tsam mi bden stong pa tsam yin zer//de tsho mu stegs chad lta cha mthun ste//tshe sngon sgrib pa che ba'i las ngan gyis/ /lta ba log par 'dzin par 'gyur ba yin/ /de bzhin mu stegs rtag lta'i rigs rnams kyi/ /phyi ma skye ba len rgyu yod lags te//dge sdig dbang gis mtho dman ma yin te//srid pa'i bdag po dbang phyug chen po ni/ /mnyes na mtho ris ma dga' ngan song skyur/ /lha chen dbang phyug 'grub par gyur na ni/ /'jig rten 'di yi steng phyogs nam mkha' la/ /gdugs ni dkar po gyen bkan 'dra ba yi/ /thar pa'i zhing khams de na skyel ba'i phyir/ /dbang phyug bsgrub cing mchod pa bya dgos te/ /de yang snying dang snying khrag dron mor mnyes//de phyir mi dang ma he ra lug sogs//lnga brgya'am ni stong phrag bsad nas mchod//de dang cha mthun bod yul 'di na yang //srog bcad 'bras bus tshe thung dmyal bar ltung //gsungs pa'i rgyu 'bras don la blo mi gtod//gson po'i rim gro gshin po'i dge rtsa la/ /bsngos sha mang po byed pa'ang mu stegs 'dra/ /mu stegs la las sngar byas sdig pa rnams/ /mi yi zas gos spangs na dag par 'dod//mi zas gcod nas chu dang ba rnyi za//gos spang thal ba byugasanas gcer bu byed//de bzhin longs spyod yod kyang dka' thub dang //dka' thub chu 'thung de yi phyogs la nye/ /mu stegs tshangs pa'i rjes 'brangs bram ze'i rigs//dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mi 'dzin par//lha chen tshangs pa gdong gzhi skyabs su 26

'dzin/ /mi dge bcu spangs tshangs pa mchod cing sgrub/ /legs par sbyar ba tshangs pa lha yi skad/ /phan yon che zer sgra dang snyan dngags slob/ /gzugs khams tshangs pa'i gnas skye'i smon lam 'debs/ /de dang cha mthun bod yul 'di na yang / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mi 'dzin par/ /gtsang gi gzhi bdag lha rgod thog pa dang / /mnga' ris gzhi bdag nag mo stag ri rong / /lha yi 'dre lnga gshin lha 'od dkar sogs/ /'jig rten lha 'dre mthu chen skyabs su 'dzin/ /mi dge bcu spangs dge ba bcu spyod cing / /gser gyi nyi ma dung gi zla ba shar/ /chos nub dbus nub bon dar mtha' nas dar/ /'ol mo lung ring skye ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /mu stegs bram ze'i rigs dang cha mthun yin/ /de ltar min par bai ro tsa na yi/ /rgyal po dga' phyir dam pa'i chos bsgyur te/ /blon po'i ngo bsrung bon yang bsgyur dgos byung / /de dus chos la bon ming btags pa yi/ /mang po gter du sbas nas thon pa rnams/ /rnying ma'i chos dang khyad med legs pa'ang yod/ /de la bon gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa zer/ /de sogs ban ma bon yang mang du bshad/ /rgya nag ha shang chos phugs ngan pa'ang min/ /nyan thos 'od srung chen po'i chos rgyud lags/ /'on kyang zhi gnas gtso che lhag mthong med/ /dge bas mtho ris sdig pas ngan song ltung / /mtho ris ngan song gnyis ka 'khod ba yin/ /de phyir dge ba sdig pa gnyis ka spangs//sems la rnam rtog 'gyu ba 'khrul ba yin/ /yid la dran pa med na sgom du 'dod/ /de dang cha mthun ding sang khrid grwar yang / /tshogs brgyad 'gags pa'i zhi gnas 'thob por song / /langs rgyu mi rnyed bos kyang mi go ba/ /sgom ni skye ba'i snga ltas yin mod kyi/ /de nyid sgom du bzung na ha shang lugs/ /de bzhin ding sang sgom chen la la zhig /'gyu ba mang po 27

'phro la yid mi dga'/ /dran med sa le gnas la 'dod pa che/ /de yang ha shang lugs la nye ba yin//tha mal skye bo bon dang mu stegs rnams//srog bcad spangs dang ma byin len spangs dang / /mi gtsang spyod spangs rdzun smra spang ba dang / /de bzhin sbyin pa rgya chen btang pa sogs/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen ci byas kyang / /byang chub thob pa'i rgyur ni smos ci dgos//thar pa thob pa'i rgyur yang mi 'gyur ste/ /'jig rten lha dang mi yi bde skyid la/ /skye ba brgya stong mang po spyod 'gyur te/ /dge rtsa zad nas slar yang ngan song ltung / /de phyir dkon mchog gsum la skyabs ma zhus//nges 'byung bsam pa brtan pos ma zin pa'i//dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen ci spyad kyang //thar pa cha mthun dge ba zhes bya'am//bar ma'i dge ba zhes kyang bya ba ste/ /'khor ba 'di nas thar par mi 'gyur bas/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'di la gnad chen yod/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas blo gtad dang / /sems bskyed brtan po mdzod cig brtson 'grus pa//de skad dge slong rā ga a su yi//rta lo rgyal zla'i tshes dgu'i dgongs thun la//ban rgan gcos gtam mgur gyi tshul du smras/ /lam ma zhugs dang lam log dman pa'i lam/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i lam kun spangs mdzod la/ /byang chub skyon med lam der gshegs par rigs//yi ge pa'ang birya sā ga ra//le'u gsum pa maṅga lam̐//theg pa che chung nyams len gsal byed/'a ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams kyi gzhung dang po theg pa che chung gi nyams 28

len 'phagasapa'i gaṇḍi zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru ārya me rmi ye//mi pham mgon po'irnam 'phrul bla ma rje/ /drin can rnyarme shwa ra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kurma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho gsan mdzod dang / /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong mdor bsdus na/ /theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus par gsungs//theg pa dman la nyan thos rang rgyal gnyis//de la nyan thos theg pa'i nyams len ni//dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong sogs zhus te/ /tshe 'di yun thung mang po'i longs med pas/ /'dod pa chung zhing gang byung chog shes bsten/ /ngan song gsum dang skye rga na 'chir skrag /'khor ba 'di nas thar thabs snying la 'chang / /'di phyir lha mi'i bde skyid 'dod yon kun/ /srog bcad gshed mas mgo bskor ston mo bzhin/ /ci ltar mthong yang 'dod pa gtan nas med//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob la ha thag ring //grangs med gsum du dka' spyad ga la nus//dper na rgyal bo btsan po'i khrims bzhin du//sdig ltung spyad na ngan song chad pa 'a bebs//de phyir ston pas gang gsungs khrims rnams la//cung zad tsam yang 'da' bar mi phod de//khrims kyi rtsa ba gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spang / /sdom pa'i rtsa ba rnams ni srog ltar bsrung //phra zhib nyes byas rnams la gso sbyong 'bad//gso sbyong la yang rnam pa mang mod kyi//zla ba phyed phyed dus kyi gso sbyong la //mar ngo sngon 'gro yin kyang go bde ba//dbo yi zla ba sa ga zla ba dang //chu stod zla ba khrums stod zla ba dang //smin drug zla ba rgyal gyi zla ba drug /de drug nyer dgu chad nas gnam gang brtsi/ /de la gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa zhes bya/ /de min yar ngo'i nya ni bcu gnyis dang / /mar ngo'i drug dang grangs ka bco brgyad ni/ /gso sbyong bco lnga pa zhes bya ba yin/ /de dus nyi ma rtse shar tsam gyi dus/ /dge 'dun sde rnams kun gyis gso 29

sbyong mdzad/ /dge 'dun sde med ri khrod pa rnams kyi/ /de dus gso sbyong byin rlabs bya ba ste/ /gnas bcu 'am ni thub dbang sku bshams te/ sa gzhi byin rlabs ltar du spyan 'dren dang / /phyag 'tshal maṇḍal thub pa'i bstod pa 'don/ /shes na rgyun chags gsum pa'i mdo dang ni/ /sangs rgyas rab bdun gso sbyong tshigs bcad ni/ /gzhi gsum cho ga'i nang nas 'byung ltar 'don/ /mi shes na yang ma tshang skyon med de/ / phyag 'tshal pus btsugs tsog pur thal mo sbyar/ /lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag shākya'i dge slong che ge zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bcu bzhi ba'am/ bco lnga pa lags te bdag shākya'i dge slong che ge zhes bgyi ba'i bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag go zhes bdag smras bdag yongs su dag par lha rnams kyis bzung du gsol/deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlabs te/gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan gcig tu gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing / so so thar ba'i mdo 'don pa gdon par bgyis so/ lan gsum brjod/ lha rnams kyis gsung bar bsam la thabs yin no/ /rang gis legs so brjod/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /zhes sogs brjod pa gso sbyong byin brlabs te/ /ltung ba mi 'phel byin gyis brlab 'gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug gsung rgyun bslad med yin/ /de ni gong ltar dus tshod des nges dgos//dus la nges med zhi gnas gso sbyong ni//nyes ltung phra zhib dran nas 'gyod pa'i blos/ /khyim gtsang thub dbang sku dang mchod pa bshams/ /gong ltar spyan 'dren maṇḍal bstod pa bya/ /rgyun chags gsum sogs bzlas na rab yin te/ /min kyang nyes ltung bshags pa'i bsams pa yi/ /lus bsrang dran 30

pa mngon du gzhag byas te/ /'dus byas chos rnams thams cad mi rtag pa/ /zag bcas 'khor ba'i chos rnams sdug bsngal ba/ /chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med par / /myang 'das thob na sdug bsngal thams cad zhi/ /bde ba dam pa yin tshul yid la bsam/ /de nas ma yengs sems ngo'i ngang la gzhag /de nas khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /zhes sogs brjod pa zhi gnas gso sbyong ste/ /yongs 'dzin smra ba'i seng ge'i zhal nas gsungs/ /de yi nyes byas phra zhib thams cad dag /dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos dang ltung ba rnams/ /rtsad nas ma dag na yang skyeg mi 'gro/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags sems la shar ba'i tshe/ /rang gzhan ngo bzhin mdzes la chags pa ste/ /de yi nang na keng rus yod tshul bsam//lus la srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong gnas/ /dper na sha rul 'bu yis gzing ba bzhin/ /khrag rnag gcin rtug mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang / /gi gtsang rkyal pa gos kyi btums pa nyid/ /de la chags pa skye ba shin tu 'khrul/ /rang gzhan lus la mi gtsang 'du shes bsgom/ /dper na rma dang shu ba ma rungs pa/ /reg na mi bzod zug gzer ldang pa dang / /lus 'di 'khyags ltogs la sogs rkyen mi khyag /lus la rma dang nad kyi 'du shes bsgom / /zas dang gos la sman gyi 'du shes bya/ /zhe sdang khong khro'i rtog pa skyes pa'i tshe/ /dgra 'dis ngan song gnas su skyur mi byed/ /zhe sdang khong khro 'di yis ngan song skyur/ /de phyir rang gi rang la snying rje lta/ /khros pa'i lan du khro bar mi byed cing / /gshe ba'i lan du gshe bar mi byed cing / /mtshang 'bru ba yi lan du mtshang mi 'bru/ /rdung btag byas pa'i lan du lag mi brdzog /de ni dge sbyong chos bzhi bya ba ste/ /ngan song 'jigs par skrag phyir mi phod bsran/ /gti mug gnyid 'di dge ba'i chom rkun te/ /rbargyad cu thub kyang 31

bzhi bcur ro ltar nyal/ /srod dang tho rangs mi nyal yar langs nas/ /khyim du phan tshun 'chags shing chos spyod 'don/ /'gro mi nus na rna bar chu bum ba tags//mchod rten sku gzugs bzhengs dang phyag bskor bya//rgyal ba'i bka' rnams bzhengs dang klog par bya/ /ser mo rnams la ci 'byor bkur bsti 'bad//'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ste//lus kyi phyi nang bar du bdag mi gnas/ /sems ni stong par 'dug pas bdag ma grub//nga bdag med la nga zhes ci phyir 'dzin/ /nga bdag med pa'i sems la ce re blta/ /de ni gang zag bdag med bsgom pa zer//dge ba thar pa 'thob pa'i phyir du bsngo//'bras bu ma 'ongs byams pa 'byon pa'i dus//mi lus thob nas byams pa zhal mjal te/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs mchod rten 'brel che na//'dus pa dang po'i skabs su dgra bcom thob/ /gsung rab bri klog chos la 'brel che na/ /'dus ba gnyis pa'i skabs su dgra bcom thob/ /dge 'dun bkur sti la sogs 'brel che na/ /'dus pa gsum pa'i skabs su dgra bcom thob//snga ma snga ma'i sangs rgyas bstan pa la//dkon mchog gsum la 'brel ba gang bzhag rnams//phyi ma phyi ma'i sangs rgyas bstan la grol/ /de don byams pa'i lung bstan mdo las gsungs/ /khyad par byams pa'i sprul pa zhwa dmar pa//yang sprul sku mdun si tu yin par bshad//drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul garma pa/ /'di dag rnams kyi ming gnang skra phud dang //dge tshul dge slong pa sogs zhus pa rnams//byams pa'am ni drug pa seng ge yi/ /zhal mthong dgra bcom nges par thob par bshad/ /so so thar pa'i nyan thos nyams len tshul//rā ga asus mgur gyi tshul du smras/ /na mo gu ru seng hā nā da ye//gson dang bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho lags//32

'khor bar skrag nas tshul khrims gtsang mar srungs/ /mi dge bcu spangs dge ba bcu la spyod//nyams su len tshul go nga dang 'dra ba la//'khor bar 'khor ba'isto ba ma rig pa//de la 'du byed de la rnam shes byung / /de la ming gzugs de la skye mched drug /de la reg pa de la tshor ba byung / /de la sred pa de la len pa byung / /de la sred pa de la skye ba byung / /de la rga shi mya ngan sdug bsngal kun/ /de ni rten 'brel srid pa'i 'khor lo zer/ /ma rig 'gag na de kun rim gyis 'gag/de ni thar pa'i 'khor lo 'phags pa'i lam/ /kun gyi rtsa ba ma rig pa de ni/ /rang sems rang gis ma rig pa yi skyon/ /rang sems rang gis bltas pas dngos po med/ /de ni gang zag bdag med gong dang 'dra/ /phyi yi snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs rnams/ /nang gi sems kyis so sor 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /sems ni gdod nas ngo bo stong pa yin/ /stong nyid de yi ngang la mnyam gzhag pas/ /gang zag bdag med rtogs pa'i steng de nas/ /chos kyi bdag med phyed tsam rtogs pa yin/ /'khor ba 'di na da ni lus mi len/ /bla ma slob dpon gzhan la mi re bar/ /rang mgo thon nas rang nyid sangs rgya ba'i//bsngo ba smon lam de ltar byas pa yis/ /bskal pa nyi shus rang rgyal 'grub pa ste/ /bse ru lta bu bskal pa brgya yis 'grub/ /sangs rgyas snga ma'i bstan pa nub nas kyang / /sangs rgyas phyi ma'i bstan pa ma byung skabs/ /chos sgra med pa'i yul du mi ru skye/ /rang gi rang nyid rab tu byung byas te//dben pa bsten pas rang nyid sangs rgyas te//chos ni tshig gcig tsam yang gsung mi 'gyur/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyis gung tshigs drangs pa'i tshe/ /nam mkhar 'phur sogs rdzu 'phrul re re ston//de tshe sbyin bdag de yis phyag 'tshal nas/ /nga yang khyed dang 'dra bar shog ces brjod/ /de tsam zhig las 33

'gro don gzhan med de/ /de 'dra lnga brgya stong phrag la sogs pa/ /dus gcig 'byung zhing phyogs gcig bzhugs pa la/ /tshogs na spyod pa'i rang rgyal zhes bya ba/ /gcig las med cing gcig pur bzhugs pa la/ /bse ru lta bu rang sangs rgyas zhes bya/ /thub bstan nub nas byams pa ma byung bar/ /rang rgyal brgyad khri 'byon par gsungs pa yin//rang sangs rgyas kyi nyams len glu chung 'di//rā ga a sus 'phral du smras pa'o//na mo gu ru buddha ya/ gson dang bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /theg pa che chung khyad par yid la zungs//theg pa chung ngu nyan thos rang rgyal gnyis//snying rje chung bas gzhan phan bsams pa med/ /shes rab chung bas stong nyid phyed ma rtogs//de phyir theg pa chung ngu zhes bya'o//theg pa zhes bya khyag pa'i don yin la//byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba gzhan don du/ /lus srog brgya stong gtong ba'i sdug bsngal khyag /nyan rang gnyis kyis de ltar ga la khyag/khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal zhes bya ba/ /sha khrag lus 'di yod nas sdug bsngal ni/ /cung zad yod pa de yang mi khyag ste/ /'khor bar yun ring mi bzhugs mya ngan 'da'/ /nyan rang dgra bcom zer ba gang zhe na//dgra ni nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum ste//gtan nas bcom pas sems la skye mi srid/ /blta ba 'i 'dun pa btang na mngon shes kyi/ /bskal pa brgya stong snga phyi'i don rnams shes//ma bltas bsgrubs mi yod kyang mi rig go /rdzu 'phrul yid la gang bsam thogs pa med/ /'das kha sku lus nam mkha'i dbyings su 'gags/ /'brug sgrog glog 'byin sa yang rnam par g.yo/ /sku —stod me 'bar sku smad chu rgyun 'bebs/ /sku smad me 'bar sku stod chu rgyun 'bebs/ /nyid kyi thugs las ye shes me 'bar ste/ /sku lus bsregs nas ring 34

bsrel char ba phab/ /dad rten chos gos lhung bzed sa la 'brul/ /de phyis 'khor ba 'di na lus mi len/ /dag pa'i zhing du'ang skye ba mi bzhes te/ /stong nyid zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs pa ste/ /de ni bde ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal 'bral/ /theg pa dman pa'i lugs la de phyi nas/ /bud shing zad pa'i me bzhinarnyed/ /de nas sangs rgyas sku bstan gsung dbyangs kyis//khyod kyi nam du yang //lus ni mi len stong nyid zhi bar bzhugs/ /theg chen lugs la bskal pa brgyad khri bar/ /de ltar bzhugs shing bskal ba brgyad khri nas/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer phog pas dran pa rnyed/ /de nas sangs rgyas sku bstan gsung dbyangs kyis/ /khyod kyi 'di ni mthar thug 'bras bu min/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam du zhugs shig gsungs/ /de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /slar yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub dgos te/ /de ltar bskal pa brgyad khrir 'gro don 'gag/de phyir theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i lugs/ /re zhig dmyal ba'i yul du skyes pa bas/ /nyan rang lam der gol na lod par bzhad//theg dman gol sa bstan pa'i dbyangs chung 'di//rā ga a sus 'phral du smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ye/ rkarma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho legs par gson/ /rgyu yi theg pa mtshan nyid lugs zhes pa/ /theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i nyams len ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhus byas te/ /rab kyi 'gro kun sangs rgyas sar bkod bsams/ /'bring gi rang gzhan mnyam du sangs rgyas 'dod/ /tha mas rang nyid sangs rgyas thob byas nas/ /'khor4 ba jisrid 'gro don byed par 'dod/ /'gro ba kun la pan par ma byas na//rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i thabs med pas/ /gzhan phan bsgrub pa rang don mchog tu go /bskal 35

pa bye stong bsam gyi mi khyab par/ /lus ni bsam 'das brjod mi langs blangs tshe/ /rang don bsgrubs pas ma 'grub 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da nas bzung ste bskal ba grangs med gsum/ /gzhan don bsgrub na sangs rgyas thob par gsungs/ /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i don bsams na/ /de yang yun ring ma yin yun thung yin/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa la sogs kyang / /shig dang lji ba sogs la'ang skyes gsungs na/ /bdag gis da res dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub na cis mi 'grub/ /snyam du blo stobs chen po bskyed par bya/ /nyes ltung phra zhib thams cad dag pa dang / /sdom pa 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir//byang sdom rang gi yang yang len par bya//dper na gser dngul snod ni zhom pa ltar/ /bcos par sla ste nyams kyang 'phral du skye/ /nyams len gtso bo sa gzhi byin brlabs ltar/ /thub dbang spyan drangs mchod bstod maṇḍal phul/ /thugs dam gtso bo yan lag bdun pas byed/ /zhe sdang skyes na byams pas 'dul ba ste//sems can thams cad skye ba mang po'i ma//khong tshos ma shes de la dgra byed kyang //bdag gis shes bzhin lan byed ga la rung //ma rgan spyo rgod bu yis mi bzod ltar/ /de la snying rje bskyed la ci phan sgrubs/ /'dod chags skyes na mi sdug bsgoms pas 'dul//ro rul 'bu yis gzings dang keng rus rnams/ /mdun du bsgoms pas 'dod chags ngang gi rul zhi/ /gti mug 'thibs pa rten 'brel bsgoms pas yal/ /gong ltar ma rig dbang gis 'du byed sogs/ /rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog yid la bgrangs/ /khyad par thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis po/ /ngag tu 'don zhing de don yid kyis bsams/ /de nas zhi gnas lhag mthong don bsgom pa/ /mdun du thub pa'i 36

dbang po gsal bar bsgoms/ /de yi mtshan dang dpe byad re re nas/ /sems gtad rig pa ji ltar gnas gnas bya/ /bying zhing rmug na dpral ba'i mdzod spu dang / /'phro rgod che na skyil krung bsnol mtshams dang / /bying rgod med na thugs kyi dpal be'u la//gar gtad sems gnas yun ring mi 'phro na//de ni thun mong zhi gnas 'grub pa ste//de yi phan yon dpag tu med pa ni/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs mdo dang / /ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las rgya cher gsungs//mdor na rang gi rig pa gang gtad sar//yun ring mi 'phro ci 'dod bar gnas pa/ /rnam rtog zhi nas gnas pa zhi gnas te/ /thun mong zag bcas mngon shes grub rtags sogs//de las 'byung tshul stong phrag brgya par gsungs//de nas thun mong lhag mthong bsgom bya ba//thun mong lhag mthong rtog dpyod shes rab yin//bdag gi lus 'di'i sha rus lpags pa dang //don snod gang la dpyad kyang bdag ma grub/ /sems la dngos po med phyir bdag ma grub/ /ma grub stong pa'i ngang la sa le bzhag /de ni gang zag bdag med sgom tshul yin/ /phyi yi dngos po dper na ka ba gcig/rig pas so sor bsam nas dpyad tsam na//ka ba'i mgo dang mjug dang sked pa dang //phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil dang dgu po rnams/ /so sor dpyad pas gang yang ka ba min/ /ka ba bden par ma grub ming btags tsam/ /de bzhin phyi snod nang bcud dngos po kun//gang yang bden par ma grub stong pa nyid/ /de ni chos kyi bdag med sgom lugs te/ /de dag paṇḍi ta yi dpyad bsgom zer/ /de la go ba'i nges shes skye mod kyi/ /stong nyid dngos ni rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ /bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas//stong nyid rtogs dang dang po'i sa thob mnyam//grangs med gnyis 37

kyi ma dag sa bdun bgrod//grangs med gsum gyi sa bcu mthar phyin te//de nas bskal pa bzhi bcur mtshan dpe bsgrubs/ /de nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshul gyis ni/ /bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi bas thob nas/ /shākya thub bzhin du mngon par sangs rgyas te//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'gro don mdzad//de ltar nyan thos byang chub dgra bcom dang //rang rgyal byang chub bse ru'am tshogs na spyod//rdzogs pa'i bla med byang chub thob pa'i tshul/ /bdag 'dra rmongs pas smra bar mi spobs kyang / /shes bya kun mkhyen rnyame shwa ra yi/ /zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i zer gyis tshim pa'i phyir/ /zur tsam smras la 'gal ba mchis srid na/ /gzhung lugs smra ba rnams kyi drung du bshags//ban rgan gcos pas gang dran smras pa'i tshig/brtson 'grus rgya mtshos chos su bsgoms nas bris//rta lo rgyal zla'i tshes bcu'i dgongs thun nub/ /rā ga a su bi rya sā ga ra/ /zhus len mgur du byas pa maṅga lam̐/ /sdeb sbyor ma legs tshig tshogs ma mdzes shing //mdo lugs chos kun don 'dus yin no ang / /gzhung lugs rgya chen thos bsam ma byas rnams/ /'di mthong mdo lugs khog kun grol bar shog /le'u bzhi pa'o mang ga lam/ / //sdom gsum srung tshul nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/'a ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ sdom pa gsum gyi srung tshul mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru shākya mu ne ye//kun mkhyen thub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa brtson 'grus 38

kyi/ /sdom gsum dam tshig srung mtshams gang yin zer//'di ni rgya che grangs mang brjod mi langs/ /dbus gtsang mkhas pa kun gyi rtsod gzhi lags/ /'gran med rgyud rgyal kye yi rdo rje las/ /so thar byang sdom sngags sdom rim par zhu/ /de nas sngags kyi spyod pa bya bar bshad/ /gsang sngags rnying mar theg pa rim dgu'i dbang //des kyang sdom pa gsum ka rim gyis thob//'di dag nyams su len pa'i phyag len la/ /rgya gar du'ang chos lugs gsum du yod/ /sdom gsum gnas 'gyur sa skya pa yis bzhed/ /gtong gnas tha dad bka' brgyud pa yis bzhed/ /gcig la gcig brten tsong kha pa yis bzhed/—/khyim pa rdor 'dzin dge slong rdor 'dzin gnyis/ /'di dag grub mtha' dag dang ma dag pa/ /rgya gar paṇa chen shā:ka ra ste/ /ti pu gsang sngags sdong po'i yab yin te/ /mchog ni ma yin thun mong grub pa thob/ /grub rtags rdo rje dril bu nam mkhar bzhag /de nyid bod du lan gsum phebs pa yi/ /dang po'i mtshan la shra rnya ka ra zer/ /lo chen rin chen bzang pos bla mar bsten/ /kun rig la sogs rnal 'byor rgyud rnams bsgyur/ /bar res bod du phebs tshe khong gi mtshan/ /a tsar dmar po'i zhabs zhes bya bar grags/ /de dus chags lam ngan sngags kho na spel/ /mthu gla blangs pas gser srang sum brgya rnyed//de dus jo bo rje dang dus mnyam pas//khong gi chags lam spel la ma mnyes nas/ /jo bos khong la bka' bkyon 'bar sha che/ /de don bka' gdams glegs bam nang du gsal/ /khong gi chos lugs dang po skyabs sdom nas/ /dge slong bar du rim par zhus byas te/ /re re gzhung bzhin lo shas zla shas bsrung / /de nas byang chub sems bskyed zhus pa yis/ /so thar sdom pa byang sems sdom par 'gyur/ /de nas 'dul khrims gcig kyang srungami dgos/ / 39

byang sems bslab bya gtong len lo shas bsgom/ /de nas gsang sngags dbang bzhi zhus pa yis//byang sdom de'ang sngags kyi sdom par 'gyur//de nas byang sdom bslab pa bsrung mi dgos/ /sngags 'chang yin phyir chung ma len yang chog /blang yang sdom pa shor ba'i nyes pa med/ /khong gi rjes 'brang mang po dar pa'i phyir/ /mnga' ris dbus gtsang kun du ser khyim dar//'di la a tsar dmar po'i chos log zhes/ /mkhas grub kun gyi gshe zhing bkag pa mdzad/ /sdom gsum gnas 'gyur ngo bo gcig zhes pa/ /sdom pa gsum ka rim gyis zhus pa'i tshe/ /gnas 'gyur sngags sdom nyid du 'gyur na yang / /ngo bo gcig phyir gsum ka srung dgos pa//deng sang lugs rnams kyi bzhed pa ste//rgyab res shra rnya ka ra bod du phebs/ /'brog mi lo tsās bla mar bsten pa'i dus/ /lam 'bras la sogs zab chos mang po dang / /bde mchog ra li nyer bzhi'i rgyud rnams gsungs/ /de dus mtshan la ga ya rnya rar grags/ /gong 'og gnyis ka sdom gsum gnas 'gyur lugs//sdom gsum rim gyis zhus shing so sor srung //rtsa rlung las su rung ba de yi tshe//chags lam la sogs bsten par byas na yang //so so thar pa'i sdom pa mi 'chor zhing / /drag sngags ngan mthu'i zhing bcu bsgral ba na/ /dge slong sdom pa 'chor bar mi 'gyur ba//'di yang sdom gsum gnas 'gyur ngo bo gcig/dper na o rgyan rje 'bangs nyer lnga bzhin/ /sbyor sgrol mdzad kyang chos gos mnab pa'o/ /de ni rnying ma dag pa'i lugs yin te/ /ma dag snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos lugs la/ /mdo dbang la sogs theg dgu'i dbang thob nas//sdom pa gsum ka thob par rlom nas kyang / /'dul khrims sdom pa gzhan ni mi zhu bar/ /chos gos snam sbyar gyon nas srung sdom gzabs//de ni o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan las// 40

sdom pa dbang gi thob par rtsi ba yin/ /'dul ba'i bstan pa nyams pa'i rtags su gsungs/ /'di la nyes 'gal chen po ma mchis te/ /'dul khrims ma zhus 'dul khrims srung ba des//phan yon chen po mi 'byung skyon cig gda'//'di ni mdo khams shar phyogs mtha' nas dar//jo bo rje dang paṇa chen shākya shrī//yongs su dag pa'i mkhas grub thams cad kyis/ /sdom pa gsum po rim gyis zhus nas kyang / /so so'i bsrung bya thams cad srung dgos gsungs/ /kun gyi rtsa ba so thar sdom pa ste/ /de ni chu snod chag gas med pa 'dra//de nang chu yis bkang 'dra byang sems sdom//de la zla gzugs shar 'dra sngags sdom ste//snod chag chu 'bo zla ba'i gzugs brnyan yal/ /de bzhin so thar sdom pa shor ba'i tshe/ /byang sdom sngags sdom gnyis ka med par 'gyur/ /de phyir so thar sdom pa gzab dgos par/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos gtsong kha pa yis bzhed/ /de phyir dge lugs 'dul khrims btsun po byung //paṇa chen shāka shrī slob ma paṇa chung ni//bi bhu ti tsant+ra zhes bya ba yi//mdzad pa'i sdom gsum 'od 'phro rgya gzhung don/ /so thar skar ma byang sdom zla ba dang / /sngags sdom nyi ma dag dang mtshungs pa ste/ /gang zag gcig gi rgyud la so sor yod/ /gcig de shor yang gzhan kun mi shor ste/ /shor ba'i nyes ltung so sor yod na yang / /'og ma shor bas ngan 'gror ltung mi nus/ /dper na zla ba skar ma nub na yang / /nyi ma yod na mun pas gnod mi nus/ /de phyir thub na thams cad srung dgos kyi/ /ma lcogs sngags sdom gong ma gtso bor 'dzin/ /bka' brgyud pa rnams 'di yi lugs mdzad pas/ /bka' brgyud pa rnams 'dul khrims cung zhig lhod//'on kyang skyobs pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis//sdom gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro/ /gsungs phyir sngags sdom mi sla shin 41

tu dka'//de don rgyal ba 'brom gyi zhal nas kyang //so so skye bos srung kyang sla ba yi//'dul khrims sdom pa gtsang mar mi srung bar//'phags pa min pas nyams su mi lon pa'i//gsang sngags nyams len dam tshig srung zer pa//de dag rdzun du che gsungs bzhad gad mdzad/ /khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya ba/ /skyabs sdom dang ni bsnyen gnas sdom pa dang / /sna 'ga' srung ba'i dge bsnyen zhes bya ba//mi gtsang spyod pa ma gtogs gsum po srung//de min byang sdom sngags sdom gzhung bzhin srung / /sras dang btsun mo la sogs yod na yang / /dbang bskur chos bshad bla ma'i sar bzhugs pa/ /sa 'brug gter ston rnams kyi gdung rgyud bzhin//de ni khyim pa rdor 'dzin rnam par dag/de min 'dul khrims sdom pa zhu phyi nas/ /rtsa rlung las su rung ba med bzhin du/ /gdung rgyud yin zhes bu rgyud spel ba na/ /a tsar dmar po'i chos log ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /de bzhin so thar sdom pa nyid la yeng / /mdo sde pa dang bye brag smra ba zhes/ /rgya gar na yang chos lugs gnyis yod de/ /bye brag smra ba rnams kyi chos lugs la/ /'dul khrims rtsa ba bzhi po gcig shor na//sdom pa thams cad 'chor zhing mi gnas te//dper na khang pa sgo bzhi yod pa'i nang / /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gcig yod na/ /rkun ma sgo bzhi gang nas 'ong kyang 'dra//nor bu shor nas nor bu med dang 'dra//nyan thos mdo sde pa yi lugs la ni/ /re re shor bas thams cad mi 'chor ste/ /dper na dge slong mi gtsang spyod na yang / /gsum po ma shor yod pas srung na ni/ /phan yon yod ces nyams pa'i dge slong zer//'di nyid bka' brgyud pa yi bzhed pa ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rdo rje'i gsung / /sna gcig bsrungs kyang myang 'das rgyur 'gyur gsungs/ /de don slob ma dge slong gcig log ste/ /bu 42

rgyud gso phyir bya phag gsod na yang //da rung (da dung /)chab ril btags shing chab blangs pas/ /mched grogs grwa slob kun gyis de la 'bar/ /'jig rten mgon pos de la ma 'bar zhig/sna gcig bsrungs kyang myang 'das rgyur 'gyur gsungs / /dge slong sdom pa thams cad shor tshar yang / /da dung de nyid nyams pa'i dge slong ste/ /mi gtsang la sogs lan re nam spyad kyang //sdom pa gsar du shor 'dra'i nyes ltung 'byung / /de phyir sdom ro phul na nyes ltung 'chad/ /de phyir sdom ro phul bar ma byas tshe//btsun log rnams kyang btsun pa'i grangs su 'gro//de phyir dge bsnyen lcags kyi rkang pa can/ /po ṭa la ru lan gsum byon pa yi/ /bar res dge slong chos gos rul pa can/ /bu dang chung ma zhing gi mu na bzhag /lhung bzed shing gi yal ga la bkal nas//zhing rmo phru ni slog cing 'dug pa la//thang so khrag gis dmar dang ca cang pa'i/ /'bu srin sems can mang po 'chi 'dug pas/ /khyed ni ban log phru 'dul dgos na yang / /lhung bzed chos gos ma bzung bstan la gnod//smras pas byin pa khyer yong gtsang sar sbas//de nas po ṭa la ru song ba na/ /sngar bzhin lha tshogs gcig kyang ma mthong bas/ /phyag dang bskor ba dpag med byas pa'i rjes//sgrol ma khro gnyer can sogs ma mthong ste/ /rtse ru song bas smug pas rab tu btums/ /gzhal yas sgo phye ma thub yun ring 'gor/ /phyag bskor mang byas nang du thar ba'i tshe/ /sngar dang mi 'dra ci lags zhus pa'i lan/ /lam du tshul khrims 'chal ba'i mi de la/ /btsun pa'i cha lugs phral ba de yis bsgribs/ /mi de cha lugs de dang ma bral na/ /da rung (da dung /)btsun pa'i bag tsam sems la yod//da ni dge ba'i bag med dmyal bar 'gro/ /de yi sdig pas khyod la sgrib bo gsungs/ /de nas tshur lam chos gos lhung 43

bzed gtad/ /de don pad ma dkar po'i mdo sde las/ /thub dbang bstan la rab tu byung tshad rnams/ /tshe 'dir mi dge mtshams med ci spyad kyang / /skye ba brgya stong 'bum phrag du ma'i bar//ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal mya ngan yang //sangs rgyas stong gi rjes la mos pa yis/ /bstan pa'i mjug la mi yi lus thob nas/ /theg dman rigs yin dgra bcom 'bras bu 'thob/ /theg chen yin na rab dga'i sa thob ste//'khor ba'i gnas na gcig kyang mi lus pa//'di ni thub pa'i smon lam mthu yin gsungs/ /de phyir yab sras la sogs mkhas grub rnams/ /ci 'ong cir 'gyur dgongs pas gsal na yang / /sdom pa thub dang mi thub mi dpyad par//kun la bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba de yi don//sdom pa zhus nas chos mgo ma thon pa//ngan song dmyal tshabs che yang mtha' la thar//de la 'khor ba mtha' can zhes bya yin/ /sdom pa ma zhus mi dge spyod pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas nam yang thar dus med//de la 'khor ba mtha' med zhes bya yin //de don dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa las//nyams las ma thob nyes pa che zhes gsungs/ /me tog tsam pa ka ni rnying na yang / /me tog phal ba rnams kyi do zla min//nga yi nyan thos ji ltar ngan na yang //tha mal skye bo rnams kyi smad bya min//de skad bcom ldan thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa'i tshe/ /dmar dang ser po'i tshos can gos thams cad//lha rnams kyis bsdus dad pa'i rten du khyer/ /ri rab rtse ru mchod rten brtsegs nas mchod/ /bstan pa nub nas gos kyis tshos mi za/ /de don rtogs brjod la sogs mdo 'gar gsal/ /de don dge 'dun rnams la skyabs zhus nas/ /ser gos gyon tshad rnams la gus dgos gsungs //'jam dbyangs sprul ba rngog lo chen po yi// 44

phyag dar byas pa'i nyal nyil gseb dag nas/ /lwa ba ser po'i ras mo byung ba rnams//na bza' 'di 'dra mnab pa'i rgyud dag la//yon tan sna re med pa med gsungs nas//gos dum dbu zha'i gseb tu bcug par mdzad//bdag gi 'dren mchog chos kyi dbang phyug gis/ /tshogs pa'i tshogs gdan dril nas dbu la bzhag /tshogs gdan rdul sprugs ljags kyi steng du bzhag /rgyun du nam 'byon tshogs par phyag 'bul mdzad/ /'byon dus sku rgyab mi ston phyi 'gros mdzad//de dag don la legs par dpyad byas na/ /phyogs ris med pa'i ser mo gyon tshad la//gzhan skyon mi bya log lta gshe skur spangs//kun kyang skyabs yul dge 'dun yin par bzung //de yi rang nyid bsod nams dpag med 'thob//rab tu byung bas chog par brtsi ba yi//bsam pa de 'dra rang gis 'chang mi bya//rang re bde nas bde bar 'gro 'dod pa/ /'khor ba mtha' yod tsam gyis ga la chog /lta ba rnam par dag pa yod na yang //spyod pa 'dul khrims phra zhib nyams pa de//gso sbyong bshags sdom legs par ma byas na/ /klu ru skye ba rgya mtsho'i zhus mdor gsal/ /klu ru skyes na gzhan la gnod pa dang / /mdze dang bye tshan char dang nyi tshan dang / /rgyal po'i chad pa khyung gi 'jigs pa sogs/ /sdug bsngal de dag bzod par ji ltar nus/ /da lta kun gyis dad cing chos par rtsi/ /shi dus klu bdud 'khor du skye shor na/ /de las rtsog dang de las sdug pa ci/ /de bzhin gsang sngags dam tshig nyams na ni/ /rdo rje dmyal pa'i gnas nas thar dus med//gsang sngags spyod cing bla mar dgrar bltas pas/ /bdud dang rgyal 'gong dam sri'i rigs su skye/ /phal cher chos pa dam tshig nyams pa kun/ /pe kur rgyal po'i 'khor du skye pa'i tshul/ /gur drag lo rgyus rnams su gsal ba yin//kye ma kyi 45
