hud rang la snying rje ltos/ /skyabs sdom gsum dang dge bsnyen sdom pa lnga/ /rab byung dge tshul sdom pa bcu po dang / /dge slong khrims ni nyis brgya lnga bcu gsum/ /byang sdom dkar nag chos bzhi blang dor dang //ltung ba lnga lnga brgya dang nyi shu pa/ /sngags sdom rtsa ltung bcu bzhi sbom po brgyad//rnying ma'i rtsa ba sku gsung thugs dang ni//yan lag dam tshig nyi shu rtsa lnga ste//rgyas par sa ya 'bum sde yod par gsungs/ /de dag rtsa ba bsdus shing dril ba na//gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spangs la so thar 'dus/ /gzhan phan gzhir bcas bsgrub la byang sdom 'dus//bla mar rtse gcig gus la sngags sdom 'dus//rgyas pa rgyas drags bsdus pa bsdus drags nas//nyams su blangs bya rang de gang zhe na//rtsa ba bzhi bo srog ltar srung ba dang //chang dang bsngos sha dgongs sogs spang ba des//deng sang dus kyi sdom pa gtsang mar brtsi/ /byang sdoms sngags sdom gnyis la'ang de gal che/ /dge tshogs bya ba gang dang gang bsgrub pa/ /'gro ba kun la phan pa'i sems bskyed dang / /dge rtsa 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo smon gdab//de yi byang sems sdom pa'i bslab bya 'dus//de don thub pas rgyal bor rgya cher gdams/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin de/ /sems can yin nam sangs rgyas yin kyang rung / /spyi gtsug rigs bdag nyid dang dbyer med mos//de ni bla ma'i sku yi dam tshig yin//lus kyi lha bsgom ngag gi bsnyen pa'am//rlung bzung 'am ni rdor bzlas gang rung bya/ /de ni yi dam gsung gi dam tshig yin//sems ni stong nyid phyag rgya chen por blta//tshes bcu la sogs dus mchod tshogs gtor gzab/ /log lta can la gsang sngags gnad mi bshad/ /de ni mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig yin/ /rgyun du gtor bsngos dgu gtor bskang 46

gsol 'bad/ /lo dus rnams su bskang gsol tshogs mchod gzab/ /yon tan nor lha phrin las chos skyong gi /dam tshig rnams ni de la 'dus pa yin/ /dus rnams kun tu rang sems ngo bo blta//rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba'i dam tshig yin/ /skabs su snying rje'i gtong len dmigs pa sbyangs//dbang lung khrid sogs gdul bya'i re ba skongs/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin pa'i dam tshig yin/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel pa thogs tshad kun/ /bde chen zhing du skye ba'i bsngo smon bya/ /'khor ba dong sprugs theg chen dam tshig yin/ /de ltar dam tshig rnam dbye mdor bsdus pa/ /dbye ba gsal zhing lag tu blangs bde ba/ /rta lo khrums zla'i dmar po'i tshes dgu'i nyin/ /gung gi thun la rā ga a sus smras/ /zhu mkhan brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bris/ /nongs pa mchis na mkhas pa rnams la 'chags//dge bas 'gro kun sdom gsum mthar phyin shog//le'u lnga ba maṅga lam̐//skyabs 'gro'i zhal gdams 'jigs pa kun skyob/0ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ skyabs 'gro 'jigs pa kun skyob bzhugs so/ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho khyed/ /ma yengs bdag la snyan gson dang / /skyabs 'gro byed pa mang lags kyang / /skyabs 'gro'i rnam dbye shes pa dkon/ /byis pa rgyug thub phan chad rnams/ /skyabs gnas pha dang ma la zhu/ /tha mal skye bo phal cher rnams/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la skyabs//phyi ba mu stegs pa rnams kyis/ /dbang phyug khyab 'jug sogs la skyabs// 47

de dang cha mthun bon lugs rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum po skyabs mi 'dzin/ /de dag rnams kyis gnas skabs kyi/ /sdug bsngal cung zad skyabs nus kyi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyabs mi nus/ /skyabs yul de dag rnams kyis kyang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma spangs pas/ /gzhan dag skyob par ga la nus/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum yin te/ /gsum ka gtan gyi skyabs ma yin/ /chos ni lam dang 'dra ba ste/ /pha rol phyin tshar dgos pa med//dge 'dun lam grogs lta bu ste/ /khong rang 'jigs dang ma bral lo/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas kho na yin/ /ci phyir skyon ni thams cad sangs/ /yon tan thams cad shin tu rgyas/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad bcom//mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan//'khor ba'i mya ngan pha rol 'das/ /brtse bas ma gcig bu bzhin du/ /nyin mtshan dus drug 'gro la gzigs/ /stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /skyabs 'os skyabs mchog dam pa yin/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum po la/ /grub mtha' so so'i ngos 'dzin mang / /so so thar ba'i lugs la ni/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku shāka thub yin/ /chos ni bden bzhi'i chos 'khor yin/ /dge 'dun nyan thos rang rgyal gnyis/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong / /dgra bcom rnams ni yin par gsungs/ /de rnams dkon mchog gsum dngos yin/ /kun rdzob dkon mchog gsum gyi rten/ /mchod rten sangs rgyas sku gzugs dang / /yi ge ser mo gyon rnams yin/ /deng nas ma shi'i bar du skyabs/ /ci phyir 'khor ba'i 'jigs la skrag /rang nyid kho na skyabs zhu ba//theg pa dman pa'i skyabs 'gro'o//sangs rgyas chos sku gzugs sku gnyis/ /chos ni theg chen sde snod gsum/ /dge 'dun dang po'i sa thob yin/ /de ni theg chen dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas byang chub ma 48

thob par/ /bdag gzhan 'gro kun skyabs zhu ba/ /theg chen mdo lugs skyabs 'gro lags//bya spyod lugs kyi dkon mchog gsum//sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid can//chos ni bya spyod rgyud sde rnams//dge 'dun rigs sngags grub rnams so/ /dus dang bsam pa mdo dang mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba rigs lnga ste/ /chos ni rnal 'byor rgyud sde rnams/ /dge 'dun sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs//dus dang bsam pa gong dang 'dra//bla med rgyud kyi dkon mchog gsum//sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can//chos ni gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams/ /dge 'dun jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs//bla med yang rtse gdams ngag lugs//dkon mchog gsum po bla ma ste//thugs ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus//gsung ni dam chos kun 'byung gnas/ /sku ni dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun/ /phrin las mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /thams cad bla ma'i rol pa lags//de phyir de la skyabs su 'gro /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos//de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /gsungs pa'i don yang de la dgongs/ /bdag dang 'gro kun skyabs 'gro ste//tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la//rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma yi//go 'phang 'thob phyir skyabs su 'gro//yang gsang a ti yo ga'i lugs/ /sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang / /chos ni 'bum phrag drug cu'i rgyud/ /dge 'dun rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i tshogs/ /bdag dang 'gro kun skad cig la/ /thos grol nyid du sangs rgyas phyir/ /skyabs su 'gro ba rdzogs chen lugs/ /skyabs yul bsgom pa'i khyad par yang so so thar pa'i lugs la ni//skyabs yul bsgom pa'i gsal kha med//ci phyir sangs rgyas thams 49

cad ni/ /mngon shes drug ldan dus rtag tu/ /nyin mtshan dus drug 'gro la gzigs//rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan mnga' bas//'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi//ci bsams gang smras thams cad ni//ma 'dres so sor dgongs shing gsan//de phyir skyabs yul bsgom mi dgos/ /bsam zhing ngag gi smras pas chog /theg chen mdo yi skyabs yul ni//gong dang 'dra bas ma bsgom kyang / /'gal ba yod pa ma yin kyang //skyabs sems sdom pa len 'dod na//shāka thub gtso bor spyan drangs te/ /dper na sa gzhi byin brlabs bzhin/ /de yi mdun du skyabs 'gro bya/ /skyab sa yul gshegs sam mi dmigs bsam//bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la//yi dam gang yin de nyid la//sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyis ba skor//gang zhus rtsa ba 'i bla ma de/ /rigs bdag tshul du dbu gtsug bzhugs/ /de yi mdun du skyabs 'gro bya/ /skyabs yul gshegs sam mi dmigs bya//rang la bstim par ma bshad do/ /bla med lugs kyi skyabs 'gro ni/ /nam mkhar yi dam de nyid bsgoms//steng du bla ma rigs bdag tshul//sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha//sprin tshogs bzhin du gtibs par bsgoms//de yi mdun du skyabs 'gro bya//phyag rgya chen po'i lugs la ni//mdun du mtsho dbus dpag bsam gyi//ljon shing yal ga lnga ldan pa/ /dbus su bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma kun gyis bskor/ /g.yas su shāka thub sangs rgyas tshogs/ /g.yon du byams pa dge 'dun tshogs/ /rgyab tu dam chos glegs bam tshogs/ /mdun du yi dam rgyud sde'i lha/ /bar mtshams mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /de rnams sgom lugs dbyibs 'dra ste//tshe khrid thugs rje chen po'i khrid//byed tshe blas 'od dpag med//ye shes spyan 'dren mi dgos te/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa/ /de yi mdun du thub pa 50

bzhugs/ /de ltar shes pas skyabs su 'gro/ /ljon shing ma gto gas sgom lugs rnams/ /khrid rim phal cher 'dra ba la/ /khyad par rdzogs chen khrid sogs la//bla ma kun tu bzang por sgom/ /de 'dra'i skyabs 'gro tshar ba'i rjes/ /skyabs yu la rang gi snying gar bstims//rang gi sems la hrig ger bltas//ngo bo stong pa chos skur mthong / /rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs 'gag med sprul pa'i sku//de gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid//sku bzhi'i ba dag nyid sangs rgya sa te/ /rang gi sems la rnyed pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs 'gro yin/ /smra bsam brjod med rgyal ba'i yum//rang gi sems la rnyed pa ni//chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /sangs rgyas chos gnyis sems la rnyed/ /rang nyid dge 'dun gral du tshud/ /dge 'dun la ni skyabs song yin/ /de la dgongs nas rgyud rnams nas/ /rang sems skyabs kyi mchog tu gsungs/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje la/ /skyabs su mchi'o gsungs pa'i don//don dam mchog gi skyabs 'gro yin//skyabs su 'gro ba'i glu chung 'di/ /dge slong rā ga a su yi/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i tshes gsum nub/ /nyams la shar nas smras pa ste/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos brjed thor bris/ /le'u drug ste maṅga lam̐//sems bskyed gdams pa byang chub gzhung lam/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /sems bskyed byang chub gzhung lam bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru burnya ngo rnyis twa ye/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya ma tsho khyed/ /51

nges par dam chos bsgrub dgongs na//sngon byon sangs rgyas gshegs pa'i tshul//ma 'ongs rgyal pa sras bcas kun//thams cad 'byon pa'i gzhung lam ni//theg chen sems bskyed kho na lags//de la klu sgrub thogs med gnyis//shing rta'i srol lam gnyis su grags/ /rgya chen spyod rgyud thogs med lugs/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal spyan 'dren pa'i/ /khyim bzang gtsang zhing gdan khri dgos/ /de min rgyal po 'byon gnas med/ /de bzhin theg chen sems bskyed kyang /su yin rgyud la mi skye ste/ /so thar sdom pa legs bsrungs shing / /theg chen sde snod shes pa dgos/ /sems bskyed cho ga'ang rgyas par yod/ /zab mo lta rgyud klu sgrub lugs/ /gar btab skye ba'i sa bon bzhin//zhu 'dod rjes zlos shes pa na/ /kun gyi rgyud la skye bar bshad/ /gnyis ka bla mar zhu ba'am/ /ma rnyed rang gis len shes na/ /rten gsum drung ngam ma 'dzoms kyang / /skyabs yul spyan drangs de drung blangs/ /lan gcig thob nas mi skyur bar/ /sdom pa rgyas shing 'phel ba'i phyir/ /rgyun du rang gis blang bar bya//nyes ltung phra zhib gang byung rnams//de yis 'phral du sor chud de/ /sgra mi snyan pa'i longs spyod bzhin/ /da lta nyams kyang da lta skye/ /dper na gser 'gyur rtsi yi rdzas//lcags la byugs na gser du 'gyur//de bzhin tha mal so skye yang / /theg chen sems bskyed blangs ma thag /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skye/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras gyur pas/ /nyan thos dgra bcom rang rgyal tshogs/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa ste/ /dper na rgyal po chen po'i sras/ /skyes ma thag tu shed med kyang / /blon po tshogs kun zil gnon 'dra/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis/ /bkur sti byas kyang dkor 'ju ste//'gro ba sems can ma lus pa//sangs rgyas sa 52

la bkod snyam pa'i/ /sems bskyed bsam pa bzang phyir ro/ /sems bskyed don de gang zhe na/ /sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod//de skad rgyal ba byams pas gsungs//de la rnam pa gnyis yin te//smon pa dang ni 'jug pa gnyis//smon pa sangs rgyas thob 'dod blo//yid smon lta bu'i sems bskyed yin/ /'jug pa sangs rgyas bsgrub pa ste/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa yin//len tshul chos spyod rab gsal nas//byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa klu sgrub lugs/ /de nyid kho nar 'dus pa yin/ /bslab pa srung tshul grangs mang yang //bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyal po la//gdams pa'i mdo yi don bsdus na//'phags pa rnams dang so skye yi//dge ba kun la yi rang bsgom/ /de yis bsod nams mnyam du 'thob/ /rang gi dge rtsa ci 'grub bcas//gcig tu bsdus te sems can kun//sangs rgyas sa la bkod pa'i phyir//rang nyid myur du sangs rgyas par/ /smon lam dus kun rgyun du 'debs/ /de yi 'thus par thub pas gsungs/ /'jug pa sems bskyed bslab bya ni/ /phar phyin drug la ci nus 'bad//de dag kun rdzob sems bskyed lags//don dam sem sa bskyed cho ga yi/ /skye dang mi skye bzhed pa mang / /'on kyang stong nyid lta ba de/ /rtogs na don dam sems bskyed lags/ /nyams len gtso bo gtong len te/ /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gnyis//yang dag brje bar ma byas na//sang sa rgyas thob pa'i thabs med cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /de skad spyod 'jug gzhung las gsungs/ /bdag gzhan dngos su brje ba ni/ /sa thob min pas mi rung ste//brjes na gegs dang bar chad rgyu//rang re so so'i skye bo rnams//bsam pas bdag gzhan brjes dmigs na//chos rnams bsam pa gtso che bas / 53

dngos su brjes 'dra'i phan yon thob//de phyir rlung ni phyir 'bud dus//rang gi bde skyid bsod nams tshogs/ /thams cad 'gro ba kun la bstims/ /bde ba'i rgyu ni dge ba dang / /bde ba 'i 'bras bu bde skyid la/ /'gro ba thams cad spyod par bsgom//de ni byams pa tshad med yin//rgyun du byams pa de bsgom na//me chu dug mtshon mi tshugs shing / /lha 'dre mi gsum 'du zhing byams/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob pa dang / /gnas skabs tshangs pa'i rgyal por skye//byams pa'i go cha bla na med//bdud kyi dpung gis mi tshugs shing //bsrung pa kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur//rlung zhig nang du rngub ba'i tshe//'gro drug kun gyi sdig sgrib dang //sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la bstims/ /sdug bsngal rgyu yi sdig sgrib dang / /sdug bsngal 'bras bu 'khor ba yi//'gro kun sdug bsngal bral bar bsgom//de ni snying rje tshad med de/ /dang por sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu/ /sa bon lta bu yin par gsungs//bar du sangs rgyas 'a thob pa'i rkyen//so nam chu lud 'dra bar bshad//tha mar sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe/ /phrin las 'gro don kun gyi sgo/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa ltar/ /snying rje de las 'byung bar gsungs/ /nyan thos rang rgyal dgra bcom sogs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung las skyes/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i bcom ldan kun/ /byang chub sems dpa 'a rnams las 'khrungs/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang //snying rje nyid las 'khrungs pa'i phyir /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje lags//de skad dbu ma 'jug par bshad//dper na 'khor lo rin po che//gang gi lag tu yod pa der//rgyal srid dpal 'byor thams cad 'byung //de bzhin snying rje chen po de//su la yod pa'i mi de la//sangs rgyas chos kun thams cad 'du//de skad mdo sde rnams nas gsungs//dper na lcags kyi ril bu zhig/ 54

chu ru 'phangs na zhabs su 'gro/ /de bzhin sems bskyed mi ldan pa/ /sdig pa chung ngu'i ngan 'gror ltung / /lcags snod chen po khung med pa/ /chu ru skyur na steng du lding / /de bzhin sems bskyed thabs mkhas na/ /sdig pa che yang ltung mi nus/ /ci phyir sems bskyed thabs mkhas pas/ /sdig pa phal cher dge bar 'gyur/ /gsang sngags rgyud gzhung thams cad nas/ /sbyor sgrol mthu gtad rdzas ngan sems/ /bsam mi rung ba mang gsungs pa'ang / /sems bskyed kho nas kha bsgyur nas/ /byang chub lam du 'gro phyir gsungs/ /gsang sngags kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /sems bskyed 'di la thug ni gda'/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i thugs la chongs/ /'di na gnad chen 'dug go ang / /sems bskyed rtsi yis ma zin na/ /gsar ma'i bde dgyes gsang gsum dang / /rnying ma'i bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs/ /gsang sngags nyams su blangs lags kyang / /sngags nag mu stegs cha mthun yin/ /phyi rabs sngags pa kun gyis kyang / /gnad 'di go bar ma gyur na/ /mi tsher bsnyen sgrub byas gyur kyang / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ /byang chub lam du'ang 'gro bar dka'/ /de bzhin dka' thub snying rus dang / /sdom pa dam tshig gtsang na yang / /byang chub lam du mi 'gro ste/ /'bras bu nyan thos rang rgyal tsam/ /sems bskyed 'di dang ma ldan na/ /zag bcas mngon shes lnga thob kyang / /sangs rgyas 'thob la mi phan te/ /phyi rol pa yi drang srong 'dra/ /'khor slob gdul bya che na yang / /byang chub 'thob la mi phan te/ /dge slong lha chen po dang 'dra/ /thun mong grub chen brgyad thob kyang / /byang chub 'thob la mi phan te/ /bon dang phyi ba'i grub thob 'dra/ /de la dgongs nas gling ras kyis/ /thun mong grub chen brgyad thob kyang / /ngo mtshar che tsam ma gtogs pa/ /byang chub 'thob la dgos rgyu chung / / 55

gsungs pa'i don yang de ltar ro//sems bskyed de dang ma ldan na//dka' thub chu 'thung rdo 'cha' yang / /byang chub 'thob la mi phan te/ /drang srong sgog po'i lus skam 'dra//byang chub sems bskyed de bzang na//ji ltar byas kyang byang chub lam/ /bza' dang btung dang nyal ba dang / /bag med spyod dang bsod nams tshogs/ /rgyun mi chad par du ma zhig /dbyar gyi chu bzhin 'phel bar gsungs/ /gsang sngags bla med rgyud rnams nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob gsungs pa'i/ /rgyu ni sems bskyed 'di nyid la/ /rkyen ni gsang sngags thabs zab pas /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par gsungs/ /sems bskyed rtsi yis ma zin na/ /dug lnga yid la mi 'gyu zhing /stong nyid lta ba dngos rtogs kyang //dgra bcom tsam zhig ma gtogs pa//sangs rgyas thob pa'i re sgo med//de phyir chos rnams kun gyi bcud/ /cho ga kun gyi sngon 'gro ba/ /sgom sgrub kun gyi dngos gzhi'i don/ /'gro don phrin las 'byung 'i rgyu//byams dang snying rje sems bskyed yin//de las zab pa'i chos gzhan zhig /mdo rgyud kun na ma mchis pas/ /'di la g.yel chung ma mdzad par//brtson 'grus rgya mtshos nyams su longs//de skad rta lo rgyal gyi zla/ /yar tshes bzhi yi dgongs thun skabs//rā ga a sus gang dran smras//kurma bi byas yi ger bris//le'u bdun pa maṅga lam̐////thugs dam skyabs 'jugs thugs rje'i bsil grib/liri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ thugs dam skyabs 'jug thugs 56

rje'i bsil grib ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ /yon tan phun tshogs rin chen tog 'bar ba/ /thugs rje smon lam lha rdzas 'khor yug can/ /mos gus gser gyi yu bas rab btegs nas/ /'khor ba'i tsha gdung sel ba'i bsil byed yin//shi gson gang la'ang thugs dam skyabs 'jug thabs//sangs rgyas spyan gyis dus drug 'gro la gzigs/ /sems can kun la ma gcig bu ltar brtse//stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' bdud kyirapung rnams 'joms//de la skyabs zhus skyobs nges skyabs kyi mchog /phyag chen sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor sgom pa'i zhor/ /dmigs pa gzhan rnams gzhung ltar yin pa la/ /zur 'debs thugs dam skyabs 'jug dmigs pa ni/ /skyabs 'gro'i skabs su bdag dang bsrung bya yi/ /gtsor byas 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi/ /gus te thal sbyar skyabs 'gro byed pa bsam//gzhung gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshar ba'i rjes//bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi//zhes pa de la brgya rtsa brgyad tsam brjod//skyabs yul 'od zhu bdag dang bsrung bya la//thim pas dkon mchog byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ /bdag dang bsrung bya skyabs yul dbyer med pa/ /stong nyid nyams len ngang la yud tsam bzhag/de yi kun rdzob don dam skyabs 'gro tshang //dkon mchog skyabs 'og nges par tshud pa yin/ /bdag gzhan skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan//sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu niḥsdig sgrib yin//rgyu de med na 'bras bu rang 'gag 'gro//rdor sems sgom bzlas gzhung ltar sgom pa'i tshe//rang gi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' las//rang 'dra'i rdo rje sems dpa' mang po 'phros//shi gson bsrung bya kun gyis spyi bor bzhag/ /gzhung gi yig brgya bshags tshig tshar ba'i rjes/ /rdor sems kun gyi sku las bdud rtsi babs//bdag gzhan kun gyis sdig 57

sgrib dag par bsgoms/ /oṃ padzra sa twa hūṃ/ /rdor sems 'bru drug de la brgya rtsa bzlas/ /rdor sems 'ong zhu bdag gzhan so sor bstim/ /bshags bya bshags byed bshagasapa mi dmigs pa/ /nyams len stong nyid ngang la thun gcig bzhag /de yis kun rdzob don dam bshags pa tshang / /sngon gyi las ngan yod kyang bsrab par nus/ /tshe 'di dang ni tshe rabs gzhan du yang / /bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu ni bsod nams tshogs/ /dka' tshegs med par bsags thabs maṇḍal zab/ /gzhung ltar sachod yul dkon mchog nam mkhar dmigs/ /bdag dang bsrungabya'i lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa gcig tu bsdug /gling bzhi ri rab bye ba phrag brgyar sprul/ /lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod yon byur bur gtams/ /gzhung ltar maṇḍal 'bul tshig rdzogs pa'i rjes/ /gu ru de ba ḍā ki niradha maṇḍal bra tī tstsha swā hā/4 /maṇḍal 'bul sngags de la brgya rtsa brjod/ /nam mkha'i lha tshogs bdag dang bsrung byar bstims/ /nyams len stong nyid ngang la' thun gcig bzhag /sngon ma bsod nams rjes ni ye shes tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis 'phel bas bsod nams skye bar 'gyur/ /rang gzhan lus ngag yid gsum byin rlabs thabs/ /mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab pa 'i phyir/ /rang gi spyi bor rtsa brgyud bla ma bsgom/ /gzhung ltar gsol 'debs mang nyung gang byed mjug /bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshig gcig de la brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /bsrung bya kun gyi tshangs pa'i lam na sa zhugs/ /sdig sgrib nag nyil 'og sgo rkang mthil thon/ /lus ni dri med shel sgong lta bur gyur/ /'od zer de yang khong rang rnams la thim/ /bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs zhugs par dmigs/ ca /rtsa brgyud bla ma rang la bstim pa ngu8

las/ /gzhan la bstim pa'i gsal kha ma mthong ngo / /sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor thugs dam skyabs 'jug ni/ /gsar rnying khrid rim 'ga' yi zur nas 'byung / /drin can bla ma'i gsung las dngos su thos/ /de phyir rig bzo yin par mi dgongs 'tshal/ /dkon mchog thugs rje e 'ong e 'ong zhes/ /smra ba mang ste thugs rje bskul shes dgos/ /rnga lcag med na rnga skad mi 'byung / /de phyir brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bskul byas nas/ /rā ga a gye zhes pa'i ri khrod pas/ /shing sbrul smin drug zla ba'i nyer bdun nub/ /smras pa'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po/ /'di yis gzhan phan rgya mtsho 'byung bar shog /le'u brgyad pa maṅga lo/ /thun skabs dmigs thun bar chad kun sel/liri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ dmigs thun bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ye/ /ri bo gru 'dzin rtse ru legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /dpag bsam gor shi ṣa yi ljon pa de/ /man ngag zab mo'i bser bu 'dis bskyod pas/ /phan bde'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar khyab byed yin/ /deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo bas/ /nad gdon byad kha 'jigs su rung rnams kyis/ /mi rnams blo bur ye 'grogs bar chad mang / /de tshe ci 'byor dngos po skur byed cing / /dmigs thun zhu'o zer ba'i srol 'di 'jag /dmigs pa ma byas nor blangs yon bdag bslus/ /gcod dmigs byas na tshar slong 'grig pa dka'/ /tshar slong ma 'grig rang gzhan gnyis kur gnod/ /sbyin bdag phal cher 59

bsta na dgra lha 'gras che//srung bzlog dmigasaya bsgom na chos skyong khro//byad kha che na rang gi srog la gzan/ /de phyir rang la mi gnod gzhan phan che/ /rgyud sde chen po nas gsungs phugs che zhing / /man ngag zab mos brgyan pa'i rno nus can/ /nyams myong ldan pa'i man ngag 'di ltar ro/ /rang nyid yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'am/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs ni gang rung bsgom/ /nad pa de yi spyi gtsug zla ba'i steng / /spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar po zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon pad ma dkar/ /skyil krung dar dang rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs//thugs gar zla steng trīḥ la sngags g.yas bskor//de las 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs bstems//'jigs pa 'jigs pa med pa sbyin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de la phyag 'tshal lo//phyag 'tshal lo//nad pa che ge 'di nad dang gdon gyi 'jigs pa 'di las thar bar mdzad du gsol/ /gsol ba btab pas sku las bdud rtsi babs/ /nad gdon kun dang bde bas lus khengs bsgom/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/che ge'i nad sarba sharto ku ru ye swā hā//sngags grangs mang nyung skabs dang bstun nas bzlas/ /spyi bo'i lha nyid 'od zhu nang par bstims/ /mdo sde pad dkar rdo rje gur gyi rgyud//gnam chos thugs gter gsum gyi don bsdus yin// dus 'khor yum mchog sgrol ma sna tshogs yum/ /gtso rkyang sku ru rang nyid bsgom pa'am//yang na gnyis med rgyud mchog yinatshogasungs phyir//rang nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho bsgom yang rung //rang gi thugs ga'i 'od zer rtse mo la//sna tshogs yum ni dkar mo phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pas bum pa g.yon pas pad dkar 'dzin/ /glang chen dkar po'i steng na bzhugs pa zhig/'od zeraci la bskyon te drung der 60

btang / /phyag gis bum pas nad phar khrus byas pas/ /nad gdon dag nas shel sgong lta bur gyur/ /sprul pa'i lha mo mang pos glu dbyangs bcas/ /me tog char 'bebs shis pa brjod par bsam//o phrim bi shwa ma ta swā tā/che ge'i nad gdon sarba shitt+waṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ /mang nyung gal dang bstun te brjod par bya/ /lha mo nad par bstems sam rang la bsdu/ /'di yi dbang ni sgrub thabs rgya mtshor yod/ /dmigs pa dus 'khor rgyud 'grel rnams nas gsungs/ /'jigs pa bcu drug la sogs skyob pa'i tshul/ /'grel chen dri med 'od las rgya cher bshad/ /sbyin bdag gcig gi bad kun mig sgrib nas//zla gcig tsam zhig bdag gis thun re bsgoms/ /nad pa'i rmi lam bud med ras dkar can/ /gcig gis khrus byas rmis pa'i phyir nang nas/ /mig gsal lam mthong de nas je gsal song //de phyir bdag kyang nges shes thob pa yin/ /yang na rang nyid sgrol dkar bsgom pa'am/ /yang na thugs rje chen po bsgom yang rung / /rang gi thugs las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /po ṭa la nas sgrol dkar spyan drangs te//nad pa'i thad kyi nam mkhar bzhugs par dmigs/ /yid kyis 'jigs pa zhi bar gsol ba btab/ /sku las bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun bzhin babs/ /nad pa la thimand gdon dag par bsam/ /'khor ba las sgrol la— sogs bstod pa'am/ /oṃ tā re tu tta re tu re che ge'i nad gdon sarba shirnye ku ru ye swā hā/ /mthar ni sgrol ma nas de ru bstims/ /thun gcig bsgoms pas nad las grol ba ni/ /bka' gdams dge bshes mang pos myong grub gsungs/ /de bzhin chu dang g.yang sa dgra rkun jag /nad rims 'khrugs pa lam dgra la sogs pa/ /nyam nga'i phyogs su rang gzhan 'gro ba na/ /gong ltar sgrol dkar skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can/ /de thad nam mkhar spyan drangs 61

bzhugs par dmigs / /sngags la 'jigs paṃ gang yin bsgyur kha bya/ /de yis gnod pa thams cad skyob pa ni/ /gdan bzhi'i rgyud dang sgrol ma'i bstod 'bum dang / /sgrol dkar las tshogs bla ma'i gsung rgyun rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus shing rang gi nyams myong yin//man ngag de gsum rang la mi gnod cing / /yon4 bdag la yang 'di phyi kun la phan/ /'di ni 'khyag sgur nus pa'i snying rus can/ /gdams ngag bri bar nus pa'i brtson 'grus can/ /brtson 'grus —rgya mtshos bskul zhing bris pa rgyas/ /shing sbrul smin drug zla ba'i nyer brgyad nub/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dus mchod tshar ba'i skabs/ /dge slong rā ga a sus smras pa 'dis/ /phyi rabs 'gro ba mang por phan thog shog /le'u dgu ba ste maṅga lam̐/ / sgribs sbyong zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/6miri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ sgrib sbyong bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs so/ /na mo badzra sa twa ye/ /gson dang bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /rang re mi rnams dgra la zhe sdang che/ /dma' bar thub kyang mi tshim gsod snying 'dod/ /dgra de rtsad nas brlag ste med par 'dod/ /legs par dpyad na dgra rkun gnyen gyi mchog /tshe rabs mang po'i pha ma drin can lags/ /dgra rnams pha4 cher gnyen du gyur pa mngaka /gal te dgra yis shin tu gnod na yang / /lan gcig gsod kyi yang yang gsod pa min/ /skye ba 'di dang tsherabs thams cad du/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba—'i dgra ni sdig pa yin/ khemyal ba'i gan4 su lan grangs 62

grangs med du/ /yang yang sos kyang yang yang gsod par byed/ /sdig sgrib 'di ni dgra bom rungs pa/ /'di nyid med thabs brlag thabs byed nus na/ /pho rgod yin no brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /bshags pa ma theng sdig ni chung na yang / /zhag re song zhing skyeg ni re re 'gro/ /blun po'i sdig pa chung yang ljid ces bshad/ /bshags pa thengs na rtsad nas ma dag kyang / /skyeg mi 'phel bas nyes pa chung ba ste/ /mkhas pa'i sdig sgrib che yang yang zhes bshad/ /bshags pa ma theng sdig ltung chung ngu yang / /bskal ba bye ba brgyar yang chud mi za/ /gzhan la mi smin sa rdo la mi smin/ /rang gi phung khams skye mched nyid la smin/ /bshags pa shes na sdig ltung mi dag med/ /ma skyes dgra yis pha bsad bstan pa bshigs/ /rgyal ba'i sku la ngan sems khrag kyang phyungs/ /sor mo'i phreng gis mi ni dgu brgya dang / /go dgu bsad pa'ang bshags pa re res dag /dper na me stag gcig gis rtswa phung ni/ /chen po bsreg ltar bshags pa re res kyang / /sdig ltung chen po 'dag par thub pas gsungs/ /de ltar 'dag la bshags pa'i gdams ngag dgos/ /gdams ngag stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa yin/ /rten gyi stobs ni rten gsum byin rlabs can/ /dkyil 'khor gnyen po'am ni bla ma'i drung / /med na sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs drung / /rnam par sun 'byin stobs ni sdig ltung rnams/ /btsan dug khong du shor bzhin 'gyod sems bskyed/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs shes pa/ /phyag bskor la sogs dge ba mtha' dag ste/ /mchog tu gyur pa rdor sems sgom bzlas yin/ /tshur lon stobs ni phyin chad sdig ltung las/ /mi bya'i dam bca' drag po bzung ba'o//de yi gnad la sngar byas sdig ltung rnams/ /nga yis de thub snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang / /gzhan la ngoms shing ngo tsha med pa na//de 63

yis bshags kyang 'dag par mi 'gyur ro//sdig ltung byas kyang skyon med bshag chog bsam/ /phyin chad gcod cing sdom par ma byas na/ /de yis bshags kyang 'dag par mi 'gyur gsungs/ /bshags pa'i gsang sngags yi ge 'bru brgya pa/ /thun mtshams rnams su nyer gcig re brjod pas/ /nyes ltung gang byas 'phel bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /rgya bod ma khas grub thams cad dgongs pa mthun/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod par byas na yang / /nyes ltung thams cad 'dag par 'gyur ro zhes//rta mchog rol ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin//grangs kyi tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig yin te/ /snyigs ma'i dus su bzhi 'gyur dgos gsungs pas/ /gzhan dang ngag ma 'dres par 'bum phrag bzhi/ /bzlas na rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa yang //sor chud 'gyur pa gsar rnying dgongs pa mthun//gal te yig brgya dag par klog dka' na/ /rtsa ba'i snying bo yi ge 'bru drug pa/ /'bum phrag bcu drug bzlas kyang 'dra ba ste/ /tshe 'dir rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa rnams/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i 'og gi byang shar phyogs/ /mdo nas dmyal ba sham bha la zhes bshad/ /sngags nas rdo rje dmyal ba zhes gsungs te/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad las kyang bdun 'gyur gyi/ /sdug bsngal che zhing bar mtshams med pa ste//de yi sdug bsngal dang ni tshe yi tshad//bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs par mi phod de//gsungs na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can//thams cad kha nas khrag skyugs 'chi bar bshad/ /de ru skye ba'i chags nyams sdig sgrib kyang / /rdor sems sgom bzlas bskyed rim gsal ba dang //snying bo 'bru drug bzlas pa'i grangs them na/ /dmyal khams de ru skye bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi rgyud las gsungs//sdig ltung drag po4 non pa'i mi rnams la//gdams 64

pa 'di ni /yid —bzhin rin po che/ /brgya stong bas kyang rin thang mi che re/ /de phyir bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho khyod/ /gdams pa 'di yis 'gro don dpag med mdzod/ /khrid rim kun gyi thog mar 'di nyid shod/ /lwa ba bkrus na tshos mdog legs pa ltar/ /sdig sgrib dag na nyams rtog4skye bar sla/ /thabs lam bsgom na bde drod skye ba'i thabs/ /'di nyid zab ces stag lung thang pas bzhed/ /ma mgon la sogs chos skyong sgrub rna yang / /nyams chags 'dag phyir 'khu ldog 'ong ba min/ /nad gdon 'byung ba'i ‘rgyu ni sdig sgrib ste/ /sdig sgrib med na nad gdon ga la 'byung / /rkyen ngan bzlog la 'di bas zab pa med/ /sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan mi gsal sgrib pas bsgribs/ /dag snang gsal thabs 'di las zab pa med/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo mi mthong ba/ lhan cig skyes pa ma rig sgrib pas bsgribs/ /sgrib pa de bsal ngo bo cis mi mthong / /rtogs pa skye thabs 'di las zab pa med/ /mdor na mang po brjod pas ci zhig bya/ /de nyid kho nas sangs rgyas 'thob par gsungs/ /de phyir brtson 'grus rgya mtshos nyams len mdzod/ /na mo gu ru badzra sa twa ye/ /gson dang bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /rdor sems sgom bzlas phyi nang gsang ba dang / /yang gsang bzhi yi dmigs rim gal che zhing / /rang nyid tha mal spyi bor pad dkar dang / /zla steng hūṃ yig dkar po'i 'phro 'du las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog shel gyi mdog /dar dang rin chen du mas sku la brgyan/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kur bstod de 'dzin/ /g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten zhabs phyed skyil/ /de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems thams cad spyan drangs dbyer med bstems/ /sngags phreng bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sku lus gab / /zhabs rgayas mthe bong rtse nas bdud rtsi 65

rdol/ /thugs kur zla steng hūṃ la yig brgyas bskor/ /tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang sdig sgrib kun//'og sgo dang ni rkang pa'i mthil gnyis nas//dud khu sol khu lta bur sa 'og song / /de ltar bsgom zhing yig brgya'am 'bru drug bzlas/ /rang lus shel sgong ltar gyur bdud rtsis gang / /dper na shel bum 'o mas gang ba bzhin/ /rdor sems zhalanas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi/ /sdig sgrib dag go gsungs nas 'od du zhu/ /bdag la dbyer med thim sgom sang bo lta/ /de ni phyi yi rdor sems bsgom bzlas te//gsar rnying khrid rim phal cher dgongs pa mthun//yang na rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug rol na/ /padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus dang 'dab ma bzhir/ /nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga yi steng / /oṃ ཿswā āḥ hā yi yi ge lnga/ /yongs su gyur las rigs lnga'i rdor sems ni//dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i sku mdog can/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /rin chen padma rgya gram thugs mar 'dzin//g.yon rnams des mtshan dril bu dku la brten/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan/ /kun kyang rgyal bo rol ba'i 'dug stangs can/ /so so'i thugs mar so so'i sa bon mthar/ /so so'i yi ge brgya bas bskor ba las/ /'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas//rigs lnga'i rigs su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems thams cad spyan drangs dbyer med bsnyims/ /rigs lnga'i sku las bdud rtsi kha dog lnga/ /babs pa tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang bas/ /dug lnga'i sgo nalobasags pa'i sdig sgrib dag /'gro ba lam rgyud lnga yi skye sgo bcad/ /ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsis bdag lus gang //rdor sems rigs lngas yig brgya rigs lnga yi//sngags sgra sgrogs pas 'gro kun sgrib pa sbyang / /oṃ buddha sa twa sa ma ya/ /zhes sogaso7de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya 66

dang / /bsdu na oṃ burta sa twa hūṃ//hūṃ ོbadzras twa sa ma ya/ /zhes sogs rdo rje rigs kyi yig brgya dang / /bsdu na oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ//swā ratna sa twa sa ma ya/ /zhes sogs rin chen rigs kyi yig brgya dang / /bsdu na oṃ ratna sa twa hūṃ/ /āḥ padma sa twa sa ma ya/ /zhes sogs padma rigs kyi yig brgya dang / /bsngun oṃ padma sa twa hūṃ/ /hā kurma sa twa sa ma ya/ /zhes sogs rkarma rigs kyi yig brgya dang / /bsngu na oṃ kurmas twa hūṃ/ /ces pa rnams ni ci nus brjod bya zhing / /rgyas par spro na rū ṭa'i smre bshags 'don/ /'bring la bshags rgyud le'u rgyab ma 'don/ /bsdu na lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ /zhes sogs brjod pas rigs lnga 'od du zhu/ /rang la thim bsam mi dmigs ngang la bzhag /de ni na rag dong sprug rgyud chen gyis/ /dgongs pa yin te na rag dong sbrugs don/ /de ni nang gi rdor sems sgom bzlas yin/ /rang gi spyi bor padma nyi ma'i steng / /hūṃ las bla ma rdor sems ༄he ru ka /sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ /khro 'dzum dbu skra gyen badzes thod skam brgyan/ /rdo rje phyar zhing bharbha thugs mar 'dzin/ /rus rgyan stag sham glang chen ko rlon gsol / /yum ni rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dmar/ /gcer bu rus rgyan yab dang gnyis med sbyor/ /rol stabs sam ni g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar/ /rang 'od me dpung 'khrugs pa'i klongan bzhugs/ /thugs skar zla steng hūṃ la sngag4kyis bskor/ /bla ma yi dam ḍā ki thams cad ni/ /spyan drangs bstims pas yab yu ma bdeb rgyas/ /sbyor mtshams byang sems rgyun babs tshangs bug zhugs//lus gang sdig sgrib dag cing bde drod 'bar/ /oṃ shrī he ru mas twa sa ma ya/ /zhes sogs he ru ka yi yig brgya'am/ /oṃ āḥ gu ru badzra sa twa hūṃ/ /de gnyis gang rung ci nus bzlas pa'i rjeg /mgon po bdaka ni mi shes rmong sa pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 67

'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig / gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bla ma rdor sems 'od zhu bdag la thim/ /de ni gsang ba'i rdor sems sgom bzlas lags/ /gsar rnying bka' gter rgyud kyi dgongs pa'o/ /mi dmigs ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhi 'dzum zhal gcig pa/ /rigs lnga'i dbu brgyan rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /rdo rje stod cing dril bu dku la brten/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs smad dkris rol stabs kyi/ /pad zla glang chen brgyad kyi khri la bzhugs/ /thugs skar nya rgyas zla steng hūṃ yig mthar/ /yi ge brgya ba skar ma'i phreng ba bzhin/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems rkun/ /spyan drangs sngags phreng la bstim g.yas su 'khor/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag luyo ltems se gang / /sdig sgrib nad gdon ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /nag dang nyil nyil phyir thon bdag nyid ni/ /shel sgong bzhin drim dag par bsgoms/ /yig brgya'am ni snying po ci nus bzlas/ /rje sa su a sogs brjod bdag bskyed mchod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo— rje dang po kun tu bzang / /rdorje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /ye shes mi gshegs mi dmigs ngang la bzhag /bdun brgya nyi shu'i lha 'dus rigs brgya ste/ /rigs brgya bsdus na rigs ni nyi shu lnga/ /nyer lnga bsdus pa rgyal ba rigs lnga ste/ /rigs lnga gcig bsdus rigs gcig rdo rje sems/ /'di 'grub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub pa yin/ /bka' brgyad zhi khro kun gyi don 'dus te/ —/yang gsang rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas so/ /chos kun rten 'brel bslu ba med pa yi/ /sdig pa sbyangs thabs mchog tu zab pa 'o/1 4/sdig dang bshags pa gnyis ka 68

kun rdzob ste/ /nges pa'i don la sdig dang bshags pa med/ /sdig dang nyes ltung gdod nas ma grub ste/ /gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi dbyings de la/ /dge bas ma phan sdig pas gnod ma bskyal/ /dmyal bar bsreg kyang ngan du ma song la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang bzang du ma song ba/ /nam mkha' bzhin du cis kyang ma gos pa/ /bshags bya bshags byed bshags pa'i spros dang bral/ /de don rtogs na don gyi bshags pa ste/ /dri med bshags rgyud le'u dang po'i don/ /de don nyams su len par 'dod pa na/ /sems kyis sems la bltas te klong der bzhag /de don te lo pa yi zhal nas kyang / /bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i mun pa yang / /sgron me gcig gis bsal ba de bzhin du/ /rang rig 'od gsal rtogs pa'i skad cig la/ /bskal bar bsags pa'i ma rig sdig sgrib bsreg /bstan pa'i sgron me zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'ang de la dgongs pa ste/ /rang gi sems nyid gzhom gzhig bral ba na/ /legs par rtogs pa don gyi rdo rje yin/ /de nyid sems kyis legs par bsgom pa ni/ /don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' yin pa ste/ /gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang sems ngo bo skyong / /de kho na yi rdor sems sgom zlas yin/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang / /de bzhin nyid kyi rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ /nyams su blangs na sdig ltung rtsad nas gcod/ /mi lus don ldan bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /de rtags dngos su khams bde rig pa dngas/ /nges 'byung dad pa nyams rtogs shugs kyis skye/ /rmi lam khrus byas gos dkar gsar ba gyon/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma 'thung dang nam mkhar 'phur/ /de sogs dag snang dpag med 'char bar 'gyur/ /sgrib sbyang glu chung tshigs bcad zung cig 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i yar tshes lnga yi nub/ /rā ga a sus byung rgyal smras pa 69

ste/ /sī rya stso ga ra yis yi ger bris/ /'brel tshad sgrib gnyis sbyong ba'i bdud rtsir shog /le'u bcu ste maṅga lam̐/ / maṇḍal gdams pa bsod rnams ri bo/0 ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ maṇḍal bsod nams ri bo zhes byab bzhugs so/ /na mo ratna gu ru ye/ /gson dang padma thabs mkhas pa/ /skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun/ /bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu gcig pu/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsag dgos te/ /mthar thugs sangs rgyas thob dus kyang / /mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa'i sku/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'byung ba yin/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsags pa'i thabs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab grangs mang yang / /maṇḍal las ni zab pa med/ /'dus byas dge ba gzhan rnams ni/ /yar la mchod dang mar la sbyin/ /'bul ba 'gyed dang mang ja sogs/ /de bzhin lha bri rten bzhengs sogs//rgyu yi dngos po btang dgos rnams/ /dri ma gsum dang ldan par bshad//dang po sgrub tshe sdig dang 'dres/ /dngos gzhi'i skabs su dka' tshegs sdig /rjes nas ser sna'i dri ma 'dres/ /maṇḍal dri ma de rnams med//lag pa brkyang nas bsod nams tshogs/ /bsgrub la maṇḍal las zab pa/ /med par gling rje ras pas gsungs/ /mdo sngags gsar rnying dgongs pa mthun/ /de phyir maṇḍal lag tu longs/ /de la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ /phyi ltar mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bsgoms/ /maṇḍal dngos su yod na phul/ /med na 70

maṇḍal phyag rgya bya/ /de nyid gling bzhi ri rab bcas//lha mi'i longs spyod kun gyis bkang / /bye ba phrag brgyar sprul te 'bul/ /gzhan yang stong gsum 'jug rten dang / /sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad na/ /mchod pa'i rnam pa ci yod kun/ /thams cad blo yis blangs te 'bul/ /bsod nams dngos su phul dang mnyam/ /gong gi dri ma de gsum med/ /mchod yul rang la mi bstim ste/ /rang bzhin gshegs sam mi dmigs bya/ /de ni phyi yi maṇḍal yin//mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang / /yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bsgom/ /bem rig phral yang mi dgos te/ /—rang lus maṇḍal dmigs la phul/ /yan lag bzhi ni gling bzhir dmigs/ /rgal tshigs ri bo mchog rab ste/ /lpags pa dbang chen gser gyi gzhi/ /dbu ma dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /snying ni yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /sha khrag rus pa don snod rmams/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon dpag med sprul/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug dang / /zag med bde ba skyed pa yi/ /mchod rdzas dpag med sprul te 'bul/ /mchod yul lha rnams rang la bstim/ /de ni nang gi maṇḍal yin/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang / /yi dam lha tshogs sprin bzhin bsams/ /rang sems yid bzhin nor bur bsgom/ /de las yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams kun/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis dgyes par dgongs/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs la/ /rgyun chad med par mchod par dmigs/ /de ni gsang ba'i maṇḍal yin/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /maṇḍal gsum po rgyun du 'bul/ /maṇḍal kho na rtse gcig tu/ /bdun gcig bdun gnyis bdun gsum tsam/ /dam par mtshams bsdam phul ba na//dngos su sems dga' rig pa dngas/ /zas mazos kyang bkres pa med//rmi lam nyi zla shar ba dang / /dar 71

phyar dung 'bud khri la 'dug /dmar bo min pa'i me tog tshal/ /lo legs rin chen gter kha rnyed//de dag bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rtags//rtags tsam byung bas mi chog ste//byang chub ma thob bar du ni//bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par bya/ /rgyun du'ang maṇḍal rgyas pa re/ /bsdus pa sho lo ka re tsam/ /shin tu bsdus na maṇḍal sngags/ /brgya rtsa re tsam brjod par bya//dmigs pa'ang de bzhin brgya rtsa bya//khyad par phyag rgya chen po'i lugs//sgrub pa'i maṇḍal bzang po la//tshom bu lnga ni bkod bya'o/ /rin chen gzhal yas khang du dmigs/ /de dbus rin chen khri lnga'i steng / /dbus mar bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma kun gyis bskor/ /g.yas su shāka thub sangs rgyas tshogs/ /g.yon du nye sras dge 'dun tshogs/ /rgyab tu dam chos glegs bam tshogs//mdun du yi dam rgyud sde'i lha//khri lnga'i bar mtshams chos skyong tshogs//spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol rgyas pa'am//bsdun yid kyis bsgom pas 'thus/ /de yi mdun du maṇḍal 'bul/ /tshogs zhing lha tshogs bdag la bstim/ /de dag kun rdzob maṇḍal yin/ /de nas sems kyis sem4la blta/ /ma yengs lhug par mnyam par bzhag /de ni ye shes tshogs bsags thabs//de gnyis zung 'jug byung na rab//ma byung res mos bya ba ste//te lo pa yi zhal nas kyang //tshogs gnyis shing rta 'khor lo la//bu 'phrul bar ma byed nā ro pa/ /gsungs pa'i don yang de 'drar dgongs//tshogs gnyis bre kha khengs pa na//rtogs pa shugs kyis skye ba yin//shes rab shugs kyis 'phel ba yin//chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa yin//gsung rabs don kun go ba yin//sa lam ri4gyis bgrod pa yin/ /mthar thug byang chub 'thob par gsungs/ /bsod namag bsags thabs glu chung 'di//dge slong rā ga a su yi//rta lo rgyal zla'i yar tshe4 72

gsum/ /dgongs thun nyams la shar nas smras/ /thabs mkhas zhes byas brjed thor bris/ /'brel tshad bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shog /le'u bcu gcig maṅga lam̐//bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char rgyun/yiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin brlabs char rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo ma hā mu dra ye//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho tshur gson dang / /mos gus sgom gyi 'go bo yin pa'i phyir/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom gal che na yang / /gsol ba 'debs yul bla ma ngos 'dzin dgos/ /de la bla ma'i rnam dbye shes dgos gda'/ /dge bsnyen skra phud zhu sa'i bla ma ni/ /yul der dge slong gzhan dag med na ni/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul gyis kyang rung bar gsungs/ /rab byung dge slong zhu sa'i mkhan po ni/ /lnga phrag nyer gcig gang rung ldan pa dgos/ /mi ldan na yang sdom pa skye mod kyi/ /gnang mkhan nyid la nyes byas 'byung pa yin/ /zhu mkhan la yang bar chad med pa dgos/ /bar chad can gyis zhus kyang skye mod kyi/ /de yang skye la nyes byas zhes bya'o/ /bsam pa 'khor ba 'di las thar 'dod pa'i/ /nges 'byung bsam pa legs po med na ni/ /so thar sdom pa tshad ldan skye ba min/ /so thar zhu sa'i bla ma bzang na yang / /dge 'dun dkon mchog tsam zhig yin pa las/ /sangs rgyas yin pa'i bshad pa ma mchis so/ /theg chen sems bskyed zhu sa'i bla ma ni/ /byang chub sems kyi sdom pa ldan pa 73

na//khyim pa yin kyang zhu ru rung ba ste//mdo phyogs bla ma ji ltar bzang na yang //dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'am ni sems dpa' tsam//so thar mkhan por pha yi 'du shes dang / /mdo phyogs bla mar sman pa'i 'du shes dang //rang la nad pa'i 'du shes tsam zhig bzhag /gsang sngags zhus sa'i ba ma de la ni/ /gang yin yi dam lha de dngos su mos//de don rgya gzhung dbang chog mang po nas/ /bla ma dang ni yi dam lha//tha dad du ni ma lta zhig/nges par dngos grub dam pa 'di//bdag gis khyod la sbyin par bya//zhes sogs gsungs phyir bla ma yi dam gnyis//tha dad rtog na dngos grub 'byung bar dka'//rang gi gsang sngags zhu sa'i bla ma de//sangs rgyas sems can su yin khyad par med/ /rang gi yi dam dngos su mos byas na/ /yi dam de yi dngos grub myur du 'byung / /de ni mos blo'i yar gzhal dad gus te//de byas bla mar phan rgyu med na yang //rang gi lha de 'grub pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /de don rnal 'byor mi la ras chen la/ /khyed nyid su yi sprul ba yin zhus pas/ /nga ni su yi sprul pa yin pa ni/ /nga rang la yang cha ni ma mchis pas ngan song gsum gyi sprul pa yin kyang rung / /rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms nas gsol thob dang / /rdo rje 'chang gi byin rlabs 'byung ba yin/ /de skad gsungs pa'i don de go bar bya/ /de dag dbang bskur zhus pa'i bla ma lags/ /phyag rgya chen po zhus pa'i bla ma ni/ /gang rung zhig gis chog par ma gsungs te/ /skol phor med na sātstsha mi dod pas/ /bla ma rtogs par ldan pa gal che gsungs/ /rtogs par ldan pa'i bla ma ma rnyed na//khrid lung tsam zhig thob par gyur phyi nas//dwa gas/ po dus mkhyen rgod tshang pa la sogs//bka' brgyud gong ma gang la mos pa zhig/rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung nas gsol btab na//phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skye ba ni//bka' 74

brgyud gong ma rnams kyi zhal bzhes yod/ /'di ni rjes 'jug rnams la thugs rje che/ /rang gi gang mos bka' brgyud bla ma zhig /rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung nas gsol 'debs tshe/ /sku de dngos su bsgom kyang legs pa yin/ /de min skyon yon gnyis ldan bla ma ni/ /dngos su bsgom na skyon yon gnyis ka 'jug /yon tan 'jug cing skyon de mi 'jug thabs/ /ngo bo bla ma rnam pa lha skur bsgoms/ /rtogs pa ma skyes pa rnams skye ba'i thabs/ /skyes pa 'phel zhing mtha' ru phyin pa'i thabs/ /gegs dang gol sa thams cad sel ba'i thabs/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i thabs/ /ci bsam 'grub cing bar chad med pa'i thabs/ /brgyud pa'i chos skyong bka' srung 'go ba'i thabs/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na mchog yin te/ /de la phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bzhi/ /phyi ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor la yang ni/ /tho brtsegs khrom 'tshogs kun 'dus gsum yin no/ /rang nyid yi dam lha'am tha mal lus/ /rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms/ /de yi gtsug tu brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /mu tig star la brgyus bzhin tho brtsegs bsgom/ /de la ye shes spyan 'dren mi dgos te/ /chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs der snang ba/ /ye nas yi dam dbyer med bsgom pas 'thus/ /de nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad kyang / /rgyas par brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sam/ /bsdu na gsar rnying kun nas gsungs pa ltar/ /ma nam bzhi skora'adi nyid 'thus che ste/ /de don cung zhig go dka' bkrol ba ni/ /rang gi don du ga sol 'debs ma yin pas/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po rtogs phyir gsol 'debs ོyin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chos sku gcig yin pas/ /yin rtags kun tu bzang dang 75

sdo rje 'chang / /yum chen mo dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gzhon nu bum sku dang po'i sangs rgyas te/ /bla ma'i thugs kyang de las gzhan min pas/ /de la bla ma chos kyi sku zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas thams / /thams cad blo yis blangs te 'bul/ /bsod nams dngos su cad longs sku lnga yin te//rigs lnga ma gtogs longs sku yod ma yin//de la bla ma longs spyod rdzogs zhes bya/ /sprul ba'i sku ni grangs med brjod las 'das//bsdu na mdo yi lugs la rnam pa gsum//mchog gi sprul sku skye ba sprul sku dang / /bzo yi sprul sku rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams na/ /sangs rgyas stong rtsa bye ba phrag brgya dang / /spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma padma 'byung //phyag rdor 'jam dbyangs bye ba phrag brgya ste//de las gzhan pa'i 'jig rten khams dag na/ /gang gā'i klung ni drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /bye ma snyed kyi grangs mnyam 'jig rten khams/ /de yang sangs rgyas stong dang pad 'byung sogs//de snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang //spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin par gsungs/ /spyan ras gzigs dang pad 'byung kurma pa//ngo bo gcig par lung bstan rnams nas gsal//de dag thams cad bla ma sprul ba'i sku//rgyal ba yab sras rnams dang ngo bo gcig/de la dgongs nas mi bskyod zhabs kyis kyang / /rab 'byams zhing gi bdag po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhing khams sprul pas khyab pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bsam brjod re ba las 'das pa la gsol ba 'debs so//gsungs pa'i don yang de la dgongs pa yin/ /de dag mchog gi sprul ba'i sku ru rtogs/ /sangs rgyas skyes rabs rnams las gsungs pa ltar//sangs rgyas sprul ba nya dang ri bong sogs//de 'dra thams cad skye ba sprul sku zer/ /gangs can bod yul bye ba phrag brgya na/ /jo shāka rnam 76

gnyis bye ba phrag brgya ste/ /de 'dra'i rten rnams bzo yi sprul sku zer/ /de bzhin ngo bo sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /gang 'dul rgyal po blon po bla ma sogs/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa thams cad dang / /yang sprul nyid sprul sum sprul bdun sprul sogs/ /sems can gcig la phan gcig thogs pa na/ /skye ba gcig len 'chi la mi 'chor bar/ /dper na mi bskyod rdo rje kho na yi/ /sprul pa gangs can bod yul 'di nyid na/ /'bum phrag lnga tsam yod par gsungs dang mtshungs/ /de kun thams cad bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /de dag kun la gsol ba 'debs pa yan/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che zhes pa/ /rang gi bla ma de nyid yin pa ste/ /gsang sngags bla med lugs kyi bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsungs/ /bla ma'i thugs ni sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin/ /bla ma'i gsung ni dam chos kun 'dus yin/ /bla ma'i sku ni dge 'dun kun 'dus yin /bla ma'i yon tan nor lha kun gyi dang / /bla ma'i phrin las mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/ /de la gsol btab kun la gsol btab 'gyur/ /de ltar ma nam bzhi skor don shes pas/ /ma nam bzhi skor gsol 'debs gtso bor bya/ /yang na rgyal ba yab sras gang rung gi/ /gsol 'debs sam ni mtshan sngags bzlas kyang rung / /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi babs//rang gi spyi bo tshangs ba'i bug nas zhugs//spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs gang //lus kyi sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang bskur thob//sku yi rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa gnas gang bas ngag sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob gsung gi rdo rje 'grub//snying gi rtsa 'dabs gang bas yid sgrib dag /sher ye'i dbang thob thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub/ /lte ba rkang mthil yan chad rtsa 77

gnas gang / /sgo gsum cha mnyam bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob cing / /dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi rdo rje 'grub/ /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad ni//'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma de rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med bsgom//byin rlabs stobs kyi 'phral la nyams rtogs ni//gang skyes de la slad med bsgom pas 'thus/ /de ni bla ma tho brtsegs bsgom pa dang / /byin rlabs chu rgyun gcig ma'i dbang len tshul//gsar rnying khrid rim phal cher mthun pa'o//na mo gu ru/ /yang cig gson dang gza brtson 'grus pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma khrom 'tshogs bsgom gsungs pa//brgyud pa'i bla ma'i rnam dbye shes dgos pas//de la gsar rnying lugs gnyis so sor gda'/ /rnying ma'i bla ma brgyud pa drug ldan zer/ /kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /sngon byon bskal mgon sa/sa rgyas drug cu lnga//zhing 'dir byon pa'i ston pa bcu gnyis sogs//gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og ma la//dgongs pa gtad tsam chos kun thugs su chud//de la rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa zer/ /dga' rab shrī seng rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad/ /pad 'byung manda ra ba la sogs pa/ /brda' bstan tsam gyis chos kun thugs su chud//de la rigs 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa zer//de bzhin ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro mas/ /shog ser 'am ni glegs bam gtad tsam gyis/ /de yi don rtogs chos kyi bdag por gyur/ /de la mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa zer//pad 'byung drung du dbang lung thob pa'i mi/ /skye rgyud dam ni sprul pas gter la dbang / /pad 'byung sprul pas dbang lung bag chags gso/ /de ni gter chos 78

smon lam brgyud pa zer/ /chos de'i bdag por pad 'byung lung bstan bzhin //rten 'brel ma 'chugs nyams su blangs pa yi/ /chos de'i bka' babs rang gzhan don grub pa/ /de ni dka' babs don gyi brgyud pa'am/ /thugs rje byin rlabs brgyud pa don gcig go /gang zag gcig gis gcig la dbang lung rdzogs//de ni gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa ste//dbang lung phyag dpe'i ngos nas mdzad pa yi/ /shog ser tshig brgyud bla ma tshang ba'i phyir/ /byin rlabs che bar bzhed pa rnying ma'i lugs/ /brgyud pa de drug ldan na mchog tu bshad/ /gsar ma'i brgyud pa nye brgyud ring brgyud dang / /dag snang brgyud pa rtogs pa don rgyud bzhi/ /de yang mdo sngags gtso bo'i brgyud pa gnyis/ /'jam dbyangs klu sgrub ārya dī wa las/ /brgyud pa zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa zer/ /byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen sogs brgyud pa/ /de ni rgya chen spyod pa'i rgyud yin no/ /'jams dbyangs zhi ba lha dang ge sar gling pa/ /jo 'brom sogs las brgyud pa nye rgyud de/ /'di dag mdo yi nyams len brgyud pa yin/ /sngags kyi ring brgyud bka' bzhi brgyud pa ste/ /nye brgyud rdor 'chang te lo nā ro ste/ /dag snang brgyud pa bka' brgyud gong ma rnam sa//so sos yi dam lha la gsan pa dang //sngon byon grub thob rnams la'ang gsan pa mang //de dag dngos su gsan pa yin mod kyi//rmi lam yul du dbang lung thob pa rnams/ /rang gi nyams blangs byin rlabs 'byung mod kyi/ /sa thob min na gzhan la spel mi rung / /de skad dge bshes mtshan nyid pa 'gas gsungs//rang byung ba dang de bzhin gshegs pas ni//sa thob ma thob dbye ba mi mdzad par//nges shes gyis dang dngos su thob pa las/ /de nyid rtag ces slob ma 'ga' la gsungs/ /de bzhin ngag dbang bkra shis 79

dpal grub pas//mngon sum dang ni rmi lam gnyis ka yang //don la bden par ma grub rmi lam 'dra/ /de phyir rmi lam thob pas go chod gsungs/ /de dag dag snang brgyud pa zhes bya 'o//rang gi spyi bo'i nam mkhar pad zla'i steng //rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku//de la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang //'brel thogs re zhing ltos pa'i bla ma kun/ /dang po so so'i cha lugs nyid du bsgom/ /dam ye dbyer med dran rdzogs bsgoms pas mthus/ /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sam/ /rgya gar skad du kurma zhes bya ste/ /bod skad sgra yis 'gyur la las zhes bya/ /don 'gyur sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las pa/ /de phyir brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang //sangs rgyas phrin las sgrub mkhan kho na'i phyir//kurma pa mkhyen brjod kyang chog pa yin//de nas 'khor rnams thams cad gtso bor thim//gtso bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gyi//dpral ba'i gnas nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros /rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus sgrib dag /sku yi dbang dang byin rlabs thob par bsgom//mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'od zar dmar po 'phros//mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi dbang dang byin rlabs thob par bsgom/ /thugs kyi gnas nas 'od zer mthing ka 'phros//snying gar thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs thob par bsgom/ /lte ba'i gnas nas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ /lte bar thim pas cha mnyam sgrib pa dag /yon tan dbang dang byin rlabs thob par bsam/ /gsang ba'i gnas nas 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/ /gsang bar thim pas shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /phrin las dbang dang byin rlabs thob par bsam/ /de nas bla ma dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu/ /rang la bstim nas ngo bo skyong ba ste//rtsa brgyud bla ma khrom 'tshogs sgom pa'i lugs//grub 80

mtha' spyi yi lugs dang mthun pa yin//'di skabs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mtha' skor du//grub chen brgyad cu rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs//rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad bsgom par rung / /'od zer spro bsdu bya rgyud lugs dang mtshungs/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor khrom 'tshogs sgom pa'i lugs/ /rā ga a sus 'a phral du byung rgyal smras// na mo gu ru/ /bla ma rkarma bī rya gsan mdzod dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus su//sgom tshul rtsa ba'i bla ma ngos 'dzin dgos//ding sang ser mo 'dzin pa phal cher gyis/ /chos sgor bcug mkhan skra phud len mkhan dang / /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu sa'i mkhan po de//rtsa ba'i bla ma yin par brtsi lags te//de 'dra mdo rgyud gang nas bshad pa med//grub mtha' spyi lugs sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /so thar dge bsnyen dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs gsum/ /gsum ga'am ni gang rung zhus dang gcig /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhus dang gnyis/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus dang gsum//sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yin par bzhed pa ste/ /sngags lugs rang gi yi dam gang yin gyi//dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa dang //de yi rgyud kyi lung dang bshad pa thob/ /de yi sgrub thabs man ngag zab mo thob/ /de dag sngags kyi sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /yin phyir rtsa ba'i bla ma mang po 'byung / /bka' brgyud lugs kyi rtogs pa don brgyud ni/ /sdom pa zhus dang dbang lung rgya mtsho thob/ /rig gnas yon tan dpag med bslab na yang //drin thob yin gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma min/ /de bzhin khrid rim mang po thob pa dang //gnas 'gyu bde gsal mi rtog ngo 'phrod kyang / /drin can yin gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma min/ /zhal mthong gsung thos 81

phyag dbang thob pa'am/ /chos 'brel dbang 'brel mang nyung gang yang rung / /ma mjal bka' shog gnang ba yan chad kyi/ /rang sems ngo bo rjen par rtogs gyur na/ /de nyid rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa ste//dwags pos bka' gdams bla ma rnams bsten pas/ /zhag bdun tsam la mi 'phro'i zhi gnas thob/ /phag grus sa skya grags rgyal bsten pa yis/ /bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin mthar phyin te/ /'on kyang ngo bo phyis nas mthong ba'i phyir/ /mi la dwags po'i rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung / /o rgyan pa yi thun mong dngos grub dang / /grub rtags thogs pa med pa yod na yang / /pakṣanas ka stor zhi gnas kyis bkang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sba lcag gis dkrug nas/ /dbu gtsug bzhag na sa byin rlabs bka' bsgo mdzad/ /de ma thag tu rtogs pa mchog gyur skyes/ /zhwa nag sku gsum ngo sprod phyag dpe yang /gtad nas nga yi brgyud pa zungs shig gsungs/ /dbon slob zhag bo gnyis las ma mjal kyang / /don brgyud zung 'jug brgyud par khong bzhugs te/ /rang byung rgyal bas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ /bkri nas brgyud dbang lung tshig brgyud rnams/ /gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum las gsan pa lags/ /de bzhin mthong ba don ldan slob ma ni/ /'jam dpal bzang po dpal 'byor donagrub gnyis/ོ/mched grogs yin pas dbang lung mnyam thob kyang / /mthong ba don ldan la brten dbang lung gis/ /dpal 'byor don grub rtogs pa mchog ma skyes/ /phyis su 'jam dpal baṭwāṃng bor thu līg byas/ /de nas dpal 'byor don grub rtogs pa thob/ /de phyir 'jam dpal bzang po btsud dgos byung / /'di yi lugs la dbang lung brgyud pa rnams/ /so sor zhib kyis 'ded pa ma yin te//don brgyud nyid la thams cad 'dus par bzhed/ /ci phyir rtogs pa skyes pa de yi tshe/ /dbang rnams kun gyi 82

dbang don ye shes yin/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi rnams kyi/ /don gyi rtsa ba rtogs pa mchog de yin/ /don brgyud byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang zhes bya/ /rnying ma'i lugs la rigs pa'i rtsal dbang zer/ /'di thob dbang lung kun gyi don rtsa thob/ /de phyir rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa yin/ /de nyid rang gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng / /yab sras lta bu sangs rgyas yin nges rnams/ /sku dngos bsgom yang dag snang 'phel bas legs/ /skyon yon gnyis ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi skur bsgom man ngag yin/ /de yi dpral mgrin snying ga lte ba ru/ /oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing ho ser bsgom //'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /thams cad spyan drangs bla ma nyid la bstim/ /dkonamachog kun 'dus ngo bor mos gus bskyed/ /bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs gang mos gsol ba btab par bya/ /bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las oṃ dkar 'phros//rang gi dpral bar thim pas sku dbang thob//bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥ las āḥ dmar 'phros//rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsung dbang thob/ /bla ma'i thugs ku'i hūṃ lasahūṃ mthing 'phros/ /rang gi snying gar thim pas thugs dbang thob//bla ma'i lte ba'i hoḥ las hoḥ ser 'phros//rang gi lte bar thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs//bla ma 'od zhu rang la dbyer med bstim/ /bzo bcos med par rang sems ngo bo skyong / /rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su//bsgom pa'i man ngag khrid rim kun gyi bcud//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i thugs la zhog/de yan phyi yi bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin//na mo gu ru/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni//rang lus yi dam lha yi sku//phyi ni gur phub lta bu la//nang ni phru ma phus 83

btab bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na//seng khri pad ma nyi zla'i steng //drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de//sprul sku shāka thub sku ru bsgom/ /sa gnon mnyam gzhag chos gos can/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs kur hūṃ//de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros//bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa sogs//sprul sku thams cad spyan drangs bstim//ma nam bzhi skor sprul sku yi/ /gsol 'debs gcig po ci mang bzlas/ /thub pa 'od zhu rang༄ bstim/ /tshul khrims gtsang bar 'gyur ba dang / /bstan pa phan nus rten 'brel 'grig/ /sprul sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /snying gar seng khri pad zla'i steng / /bla ma longs sku rnam snange mdzad/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis klubs/ /'od 'phros rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs/ /longs sku thams cad spyan drangs bstim/ /ma nam bzhi skor longs sku yi/ /gsol 'debs gcig po ci nus brjod/ /rnam snang 'od zhu rang la bstim/ /mi dmigs ngang la klod de bzhag /sdod tshugs sa non bde stong skye/ /longs sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /snying gar seng khri bad zla'i steng / /bla ma chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /rgyan rdzogs nam mkha' dngas pa'i mdog /rdor dril phyag rgya thugs kur bsnol/ /'od 'phros chos sku'i sangs rgyas kun/ /spyan drangs rdo rje 'chang la bstim/ /nga yi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di/ /chos sku rjen pa kho na las/ /gzugs sku tsam༄nga ma yin pa'i/ /nges shes gdung shugs drag po bya//ma nam bzhi skor chos sku yi//gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod tshul du bya/ /'od zhu rang sems dbyer med bsres/ /'phral du nyams la gang shar de/ /bzo bcos med par lhod de bzhag /rig pa dngas snyigs phyed pa dang //gsal stong rjen pa'i nyams rtogs skye/ /chos sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /sku gsum bla 84

ma'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /phyag chen lnga ldan gzhung las gsungs/ /nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /nyams dang rtogs pa skye 'dod na/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos nyams len mdzod/ /na mo gu ru/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho lags/ /mchog gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /yi dam bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /snyan brgyud rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ /yid kyis bsgom bzlas ma gtogs pa/ /ngag tu brjod kyang mi rungs na/ /smod cing bri ba ga la rung / /de min bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /rang nyid yi dam spyi bo'i gtsug/ /padma zla ba nyi ma'i steng / /bla ma o rgyan dbyer med pa/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ /phyag na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /mtsho rgyal dmar mo gri thod 'khyud/ /thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams/ /spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstems/ /yid kyis mchod cing bstod pa dang / /dbang bzhi bskur bar gsol ba gdab/ /bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug gis/ /sgra ni si si kun cu ru//badzra rnyig sogs sgra bsgrags pas//sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha/ /thams cad rang dbang med par byon/ /yab rnams yab kyi zhal du zhugs//yum rnams yum gyi zhal du zhugs//byang sems dkar dmar ngo bor zhu//yab yum sbyor mtshams nas babs te/ /rang gi tshangs pa'i bug nas zhugs/ /spyi bo gang bas bum dbang thob/ /mgrin pa gang bas gsang dbang thob/ /snying ga gang bas sher dbang thob/ /rkang mthil yan chad gang ba yi/ /sgrib pa kun dag dbang bzhi rdzogs/ /rang lus gangs la nyi shar 'dra/ /gsal dngas gzi brjid 'od du 'bar/ /dbang rtags rang gi gnas gsum du/ /oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing mtshan/ /bla ma'i sku yi bum pa ni/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur rdzogs pa yin/ / 85

byang sems chu lhag spyi bor 'gyur/ /yab yum bkrag mdangs 'od du 'bar/ /rdo rjes padma drag dkrug pas/ /byang sems chu bo'i rgyun bzhin babs/ /mgrin pa nas zhugs rtsa gnas gang / /de ni bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang / /bla ma'i yum las yum gcig 'phros/ /rang nyid yi dam yum la thim/ /rang nyid yab yum snyoms 'jug pas/ /spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems babs/ /gnas bzhi gang bas dga' bzhi myong / lhan skyes ye shes mngon du byas/ /yab yum dgongs pa bdag la gtad/ /rang sems chos sku rjen par mthong / /phyag mtshan rdor dril gar stabs bsgyur/ /rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /rang gi spyi bo snying gar bstan/ /dril bu gsung gi dam tshig ni/ /rang gi mgrin pa'i gnas su bstan/ /phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig ni/ /phyag gnyis bsnol ba'i tshul gyis bstan/ /yab yum 'od du ltems se zhu/ /rang la dbyer med sib sib thim/ /ma bcos ngang la mnyam par bzhag /rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med dang / /chos drug bdud rtsi'i snying khu dang / /thugs sgrub dbang gi bdag 'jug gi /don bsdus shin tu zab pa yin/ /rang nyid yi dam spyi bo'i gtsug /padma nyi ma zla ba'i steng / /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar/ /yab yum zhal sbyor longs spyod rdzogs/ /yab kyi rdo rje dril bu dang / /yum gyi gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /yab kyi sku lus da ngas gsal nang / /snying gar kun bzang yab yum dang / /rigs lnga yab yum zhal sbyor dang / /sems dpa' bcu drug yab yun sbyor/ /de bzhin sgo srung yab yum sbyor/ /mgrin par rig 'dzin yab yum bcu/ /spyi bor khrag 'thung yab yum ni/ /gtso bo yab yum bcu gnyis sbyor/ /gzhan rnams bag chags rang grol ltar/ /sku la dam pa rigs brgya rdzo gas / /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim/ /lha tshogs sbyor ba'i byang sems kyis/ / sku 86

lus gang bas bde ba rgyas/ /sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /sngon ltar rtsa gnas bzhi bo gang / /sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi rdzogs/ /sku bzhi 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur/ /bla ma rdor sems yab yum de/ /'od zhu rang thim mi dmigs bsam/ /rdzogs chen spyi dang zhi khro'i lugs/ /rdzogs chen bsgom na gal chen yin/ /rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug rol na/ /bla ma yi dam dbyer med bsgom/ /gsar rnying yi dam gang yin de'i/ /lus dkyil gzhung bzhin bsgom pa ste/ /dper na bka' brgyad lta bu la/ /bla ma che mchog he ru ka/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad/ /gnam zhal yum dang gnyis med 'khril/ /bla ma'i sku lus dwangs gsal nang / /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan bsgom/ /— spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo na/ /'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bsgom/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ /padma gsung gi lha tshogs bsgom/ /thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo na/ /yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs bsgom/ /lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo na/ /bdud 'dul phur ba'i lha tshogs bsgom/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo na/ /gzi brjid ma mo'i lha tshogs bsgom/ /brla yi pus mo'i rtsa 'khor na/ /dregs pa kun 'dulalha tshogs bsgom/ /pus mo g.yon gyi rtsa 'khor na/ /stobs ldan nag po'i lha tshogs bsgom/ /gtsug tor tshangs pa'i 'khor lo na/ /rig 'dzin thod pa'i lha tshogs bsgom/ /rang rang lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim/ /yid kyis mchod cing gsol ba btabs/ /'di dag skabs su gsol 'debs ni/ /sbon bya cho ga mi spro na/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo ste/ /badzra gu ru bzlas pas chog /lha rnams sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi babs/ /bla ma che mchog sku lus gang / /sbyor mtshams nas babs tshangs bu ga zhugs/ /rang gi lus dang rtsa kun gang / /sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag /87

bde gshegs bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi/ /byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob//bla med lugs kyi yi dam ni//kun la de yi rigs 'gres bya/ /de ltar sgom lugs gsum po de/ /gsang ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /snod ldan ma gtogs gsang bar bya/khartson 'grus rgya mtshos thugs dam mdzod//na mo gu ru/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gang bsgom kyang / /mthar ni bla ma rang la bstim//bla ma rang sems dbyer med bsres//byin rlabs stobs kyi nyams rtogs ni/ /gang skyes de la gegs skyon med//gzugs dang kha dog dngos po med//stong nyid bla ma chos kyi sku/ /ci yang med pa'i stong pa min/ /rang rig rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs 'gag med sprul ba'i sku//de gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid//rgya gar chu dang bod kyi chu//lung pa'i dbang gi so so yang //chu yi ngo bor gcig pa ltar/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /sku lus dbang gis so sor yang / /stong nyid spros bral ngo bo gcig /bla ma rang sems gcig tu 'dres/ /gsol ba 'debs yul ma rnyed do/ /bka' brgyud gsungs pa'i don de yin//gu ru padma'i gsungs pas kyang / /rang rig snang ba mtha' yas sku/ /ma 'gag rang gsal thugs rje che//dran rtog rang grol padma 'byung //zhes sogs gsungs pa de la dgongs/ /de don nges par rtogs pa na/ /bla ma chos sku'i mos gus dang / /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa dang //bla ma 'du 'bral med pa ni//de kho na nyid rnal 'byor yin//bla ma mjal bar nam 'dod tshe//sems nyid bla ma'i rang zhal ltos//de mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mjal//bka' brgyud rnams kyi lugs la ni/ /yi dam lha yi zhal mthong pas/ /ngo bo mthong ba lhag par rtsi/ /de phyir brtson 'grus rgya mtsho khyod/ /chos sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /rgyun gyi thugs dam mdzad 88

par zhu//na mo gu ru/ /dad gus gtso bor byed pa yi/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtsho tshur gson dang / /dper na nor bu sna tshogs mdog /gdan ni gang bzhag kha dog bsgyur/ /de bzhin dpal ldan bla ma yang / /gang mos lha yi skur bsgoms pas/ /gang bsgom de yi byin rlabs 'jug /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /de la rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /rgyal mtshan rtser btags gsol btab na/ /zas gos rin chen char pa 'bebs//de bzhin bla ma rin po che//mos gus rgyal mtshan rtser phyar nas/ /mos gus drag pos gsol btab na/ /mchog thun dngos grub char du 'bebs/ /sdig sbyang bla ma rdo rje sems/ /sgrib sbyang bla ma mi 'khrugs pa/ /nad zhi 'dod na sman gyi bla/ /gdon zhi 'dod na gsang ba'i bdag/rdzu 'phrul che 'dod padma 'byung / /longs spyod che 'dod dzam bha la/ /tshe 'phel 'dod na tshe dpag med/ /'gro don che 'dod spyan ras gzigs/ /shes rab che 'dod 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bstan pa tshugs 'dod bstan pa'i bdag /'jigs pa zhi 'dod sgrol ma ste/ /ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rnam pa lha sku gang 'dod skur/ /bsgom pas phrin las 'grub pa na/ /de'ang zhwa dmar pas mdzad pa'i/ /mos gus gter mdzod nang na gsal/ /de yi lung rgyun bdag gis thob//gsol ba 'debs dus spyi bo'i gtsug /mchod pa 'bul dus mdun gyi mkha'/ /rgyun du bla ma snying gi dkyil/ /na na gzer sa'i dmig de ru//skrag na 'jigs pa'i phyogs de ru//bsgom pas nad gdon 'jigs pa zhi/ /tha na so tsam na na yang / /so dkyil bla ma sman blar bsgom/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor las tshogs 'di/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i thugs la zungs/ /de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /kha tsam min par nyams blangs na/ / 89

bzod med gdung shugs khong nas 'bar/ /bla ma min pa bsam rgyu med/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /bla ma'i sprul ba yin par go/ /mkhas btsun bzang po gzhan rnams kyi/ /rnam thar legs po mthong thos na/ /rang gi bla ma'i sprul par go//mkha' 'gro chos skyong la sogs pa'i//mthu stobs nus pa thos pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i phrin las sprul bar go/ /sangs rgyas kun las bla ma lhag /bla ma la ni dkon mchog kun/ /'dus par snying nas thag chod de/ /bla ma mchod phyir rang lus kyi/ /sha khrag gtor yang snying mi tshim/ /bla ma dran cing gsol 'debs tshe/ /dbang med mchi ma char ltar 'bebs/ /sha rus zhig nas 'gro snyam byed/ /de tshe nyams dang rtogs pa ni//bkag kyang mi khog shugs kyis skye//nyams dang rmi lam phal cher la/ /bla ma zhal mjal dbang lung dang / /lung ston gegs sel bogs 'don mdzad//brda 'am zhal 'dzum dkar nag gis/ /legs nyes lung du ston pa 'byung / /a ti bkod pa'i rgyud sogs nas/ /drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil/ /yan lag mthil du gang bsgom pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan kyang / /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig dga'/ /de sogs phan yon mtha' yas gsungs/ /de phyir bka' brgyud chos lugs kun/ /chos spyod gtso bo gsol 'debs yin/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i tshul/ /glu chung tshan pa 'ga' zung 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i yar tshes kyi/ /drug bdun brgyad kyi dgongs thun skabs/ /bya bral ra ga a su yi/ /gcos gtam mgur gyi tshul du byas/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod//phyi rabs mos gus ldan pa yi//bya bral nyam chung mang po la//byin rlabs char rgyun phab nas kyang //nyams dang rtogs pa'i lo tog 90

ni//phun sum tshogs pa 'khrungs par shog/'gro ba kun la 'phel bar shog/'gro don rgyun chad med par shog/le'u bcu gnyis maṅga lam̐// nyams rtogs skye tshul mgron po'i lam glu/'ari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /rtogs pa'i 'char tshul shul ring mgron po'i lam glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo ma hā mu dā ye//gson dang bla ma bīrya sā ga ra//phyag chen rdzogs chen zung 'jug nyams khrid dam/ /gang rung khrid thob bla mar rtogs 'bul byas/ /bla mas de yin ma skyur gsungs phyi nas/ /sgom skyes bdag po med par mi skyur bar/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su song la bsgoms/ /gcig pur rab yin gal te grogs yod kyang / /ngo mi gtugs par rang nyid gcig pur sdams/ /de nas spros pa gcog pa gal che ste/ /'jig rten spros pa dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang //zas nor bsog dang khe skyeg sems 'phreng na/ /sngar yang 'di ltar byas pas 'khor bar 'khyams//tshe 'dir de snga phan chad de 'bad kyang //'dod pa tsam zhig 'grub par ma gyur mod//da ni nyams rtogs legs po ma skyes par//mu ges shi yang lto gos nor gyi phyir/ /bsam blo btang re nā ra kun zhes bsam//rig gnas shes bya'i phyogs la blo 'phreng na//de tsho thams cad tshe 'di'i che thabs yin/ /'bras bu zas nor gdul bya 'byung phyir nyid/ /ngas ni phyi ma'i bde skyid don du gnyer//'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod pa yin//rig gnas mkhas pas sangs rgyas 'thob na ni//mu stegs paṇḍi ta tshos 91

cis mi rgya//ngas ni nyams rtogs bzang po don du gnyer//bshad pa mkhas pas nyams rtogs skye na ni/ /dbus gtsang yongs la grags pa'i rab 'byams pa /mang pos slar yang bla ma rtogs ldan bsten/ /gnas 'gyu gsar du ngo sprod ci la dgos/ /de phyir yon tan che 'dod bsam pa spang / /dpe bltas la sogs byed 'dod byung ba'i tshe//glegs bam klog pas nyams rtogs skye na ni//a mchod 'di tsho sngar nas grub thob 'os//gal te yi ge la sogs bri 'dod na//yi ge bris pas rtogs pa skye na ni/ /bris chen pa tsho sngar nas grol 'os gda'/ /chos spyod bton pas nyams rtogs skye na ni/ /grwa sa'i ban shar thams cad grol 'os gda'/ /de phyir bla mas rang la ngo sprad pa'i//rang sems ngo bo skyong ba ma gtogs pa//bya rgyu ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ /rnam snang chos bdun lus gnad khrig ger bcas/ /rang sems ma bcos klod der bzhag pa'i tshe/ /dngos po ci yang ma mthong stong pa nyid//rang rig rang la gsal bas 'od gsal lo//ma yengs rtse gcig gnas pas rtse gcig go//mtshan mo rlung med mar me gsal ba bzhin//sgom 'dod brod ka chen po nang nas rnyed//'di nyid sgom yin snyam pa'i nges shes can//ku co chu sgra khyi skad la sogs kyi//gnod cing mi gnas de ru 'phro ba'i tshe//gnas 'di mi dben 'di las dben pa yi/ /lung stong zhig tu phyin na dga' snyam byed/ /rang sems rang gis bkol tu ma btub na/ /klu rgyal e la'i 'dab ma'i lo rgyus bzhin/ /ting 'dzin phrog pa'i rkyen de med sa med/ /de phyir khyi rkad chu sgra la sogs pa/ /rna bar gzan cing rnam rtog 'phro ba'i tshe/ /rnam rtog de nyid dang po gang nas byung //bar du gang gnas tha ma gang du 'gro//sems la gnod tshe ngo bo ci 'dra 'dug /legs par brtags pas gzhi med stong par yal/ /de ni mi 92

dben gnod pa'i rnam rtog kun/ /de nyid dmigs rten byas la nan gyis sgoms/ /de nas mi gnod rkyen kun grogs su shar/ /de nas rim gyis gnas nyams che ru 'gro//me re 'khyil le mtsho chen 'khyil ba bzhin//gnas nas yod do snyam pa'i 'dzin pa yod/ /'dzin pa de la bcangs bzung mi bya bar/ /gnas mkhan ngo bo de la hrig ger blta/ /gnas pa'i ngo bo stong bar lhag gis mthong / /gnas pa zhi gnas stong ba lhag mthong ste/ /de gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa zung du 'jug /de nyid bskyangs pas lus bde sems kyang bde/ /nga las skyid pa med snyam sems rtsa dga'//'dug snying 'dod cing langs 'dug mang mi 'dod//zas dang gos kyi sred pa shugs kyis chung / /lus sems bde bas khyab pa'i nus pa des / /nyin mo phal cher yengs med 'khor yug 'byams//mtshan mo rmi lam yul du res 'ga' zin/ /'di skabs bya rgyu bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /thun skabs gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod kho na zab/ /dpe sogs mi lta bltas kyang mi phan gnod/ /de nas gnas pa rgya mtsho 'dra ba de//cung zhig yal nas gsal stong rjen par bud//dper na sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /dngas rjen lhang nge nges shes snying nas skye//'di las lhag pa'i rtogs pa med snyam bgyi//gsal stong rjen no snyam pa'i 'dzin pa yod/ /gsal lo stong ngo snyam pa rnam rtog yin/ /de yi ngo bo bltas pas stong bar yal//gsal dang mi gsal stong dang mi stong med//de nas gsal ba'i dar de cung zad yal/ /thams cad stong pa kho na yin par sems/ /sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing khang khyim yang / /nam mkha' bzhin du stong bar 'dug go snyam/ /rang gi lus kyang med dam snyam pa 'byung / /stong ba red do snyam pa'i 'dzin pa yod/ /'dzin pa de yi ngo bor hrig ger bltas/ /stong dang mi stong 93

gnyis ka brjod las 'das/ /de ltar bde gsal mi rtog nyams gsum mo/ /lo shas zla shas zhag shas la sogs pa/ /go rim ma nges ring thung ci yang 'byung / /sdug bsngal kha smras la sogs rkyen gcig gis/ /bde gsal mi rtogs nyams bzang 'ja' ltar yal/ /'phro rgod dang po dus ltar mang pa la/ /zhe sdang khong khro ko long rnam rtog dang //'dod chags ser sna zas gos sred pa sogs//sngar las che zhing tshig sna thung ba 'byung //de ni rtsub nyams sgrib pa dag pa'i slong //de dus ngos bzung lus sems bag kyis klod/ /ngo bo bltas pas bogs skyed chen po 'byung //'di skabs chos kun rtsa ba sems su go//sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid du rtogs//sems kyi ngo bor lta ba nyams len ste/ /lta mi lta rgyu so sor yod 'dra ba/ /rang yid ches pa'i nges shes 'dzin pa yod//bde gsal mi rtog nyams dang rtsub nyams bzhi/ /res mos 'char ba dpyid ku'i nyi ma bzhin/ /res 'ga' bying rmug mikhanasal 'thibs se ba/ /bltas kyang ngo bo gsal stong ma mthong bas/ /zhe blo mi tshim sems la yi mug can//de dus lus stangs gyis bsgrims byas la//mig gi lta stongs drag gzir cer cer lta/ /de bzhin sems kyis sems la bltas pa'i tshe//rnyog ma'i chu la dri ma ldang ba bzhin//rnam rtog 'di yin ngos bzung med pa ru/ /sems la ban bun lang long 'ga' zhig 'char/ /de ni sems kyi rnyog ma zhes kyang bya/ /'gyu ba phra ba'i phra ba zhes bya ste/ /g.yas g.yon mdun sogs gang yang rung ba ru/ /mig gis lta stangs drag tu gzir byas te/ /ngo bo blta zhing lta yun thung du 'jug /de ltar yang nas yang du byas pa yi/ /rig pa ngar thon sems kyi rnyog ma dngas/ /'di ni dam pa'i zhi byed gdams pa mchog /de ltar bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyi tshe/ /'jig rten bya ba blo yis thong ba dang / /nyon mongs dug 94

lnga'imago bo non pa dang / /'jig rten chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms 'dra yang / /rtag mi thub ste 'gyur ldog chen po 'byung / /dper na seṅge dkar mos 'gros byedatshe/ /rgyang tsam mchongs nas tshur la blta ba ltar/ /de bzhin sems kyis sems la tshur lta bas/ /ser ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting 'dzin zer/ /sgom de nang du bsgom pa 'dra zhig yong / /bde gsal mi rtog zung du 'jug pa la/ /sems ni rtse gcig gnas pas rtse gcig zer//che chung 'bring gsum goms pa che chung dang / /brtan dang mi brtan sogs kyi khyad par lags/ /zhi lhag gnyis las zhi gnas gtso che'o/ /sgom chen gsar bu'i nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /dper na 'dam seng sngon mo'i ngar sgra de/ /seng ge dkar mo'i rigs ni ma thob ste/ /seng rigs yin pas sder chags zil gyis gnon/ /ya mtshan dpa' rtags ral ba dmar pos brgyan/ /de bzhin rtse gcig skabs kyi glu dbyangs 'di/ /phyag rdzogs rtogs pa dngos ni ma thob kyang / /tha snyad rtog ger 'byams rnams zil gyis gnon/ /ya mtshan dpa' rtags bla ma'i mos gus 'bar/ /sgom chen gsar bu rnams kyi nyams len tshul/ /'dam skyes seng ge sngon mo'i nga ro 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i nyer bzhi'i dgongs thun la//rā ga a sus nyams la shar nas smras//birya sā ga ra yis yi ger bkod/ /na mo ma hā mu dra ye/ /ri khrod 'grims shing rgyun du nyams blangs na/ /nyams kyi 'char tshul dbyar kha'i spang dang 'dra/ /ri brag rtsig pa phyi yi snang ba kun/ /ngo bo ma grub thams cad stong pa nyid//rgyug mchongs song yang thogs pa med snyam bgyid//lag pas reg na sra mkhregs de gar snang //skyil krung bcas bzhin nam mkhar 'phur na yang / /bdag lus gdos bcas ma grub thogs med snyam/ /e chog tshad na mtho gang 'phags mi nus/ /sems dang nam 95
