mkha' dbyer med gcig tu 'dres/ /nam mkhas gar khyab rig pas khyab pa dang / /rig pas gar khyab chos skus khyab pa yi//bsre ba dngos de 'di nyid yin snyam bgyi/ /'dres so khyab bo snyam pa'i 'dzin pa yod/ /'dzin pa de la hrig ger bltas pa na//khyab dang ma khyab 'dres dang ma 'dres kyi//'dzin pa rang zhi brjod med nyams shig 'char/ /gong du bde nyams dang ni gsal nyams la/ /chags shing zhen pas 'dod khams gzugs khams gol/ /'di skabs sems dang namamakha' 'dres pa dang / /nam mkha' mtha' yas bzhin du sems mtha' yas/ /sems ni yod med gnyis ka ma yin dang //sems las ma gtogs chos ni rdul tsam med/ /sems la dngos po ci yang yod ma yin/ /snyam pa de dag re re'i 'dzin pa zhugs/ /nges shes sems la 'chang ba'i nyes skyon gyis/ /gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol ba yin/ /de yan nyams rtogs ji ltar bzang ba dang / /rtogs pa ci ltar mtho mtho 'dra na yang //nyams kyi 'gyur ldog yin gyis rtogs pa min/ /e ma ho/ /bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes dang / /'dod khams lha rigs drug gi gol sa gnyis/ /'dra 'dra 'dra la khyad par spu tsam zhig /bde'o snyam pa'i 'dzin pa gol sa yin//bde ba'i ngo bo bltas pas 'dzin pa zhig/bde stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po dngos/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gol sa dang //gsal stong phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes gnyis//khyad par med de khyad par spu tsam zhig/gsal stong rjen ne ye re nges shes can//'di bas lhag pa med bsam nga rgyal can/ /de yang nga rgyal che chung khyad par gyis/ /tshangs ris tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don la sogs//bsam gtan bzhi yi lha gnas rnams su gol//gol zhes bya ba de ru skye ba'i ming //skabs rer de 'drar skyes kyang mi gol 96

te/ /de la mchog 'dzin de dang shi na yin/ /gsal nyams mngon shes yod 'dra shar kyang ni/ /nga rgyal 'khri ba rang rtsis mi bya bar/ /gsal ba'i ngo bo bltas pas stong bar 'char/ /gsal stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po dngos/ /'di skabs gnyid dang ma gnyid so mtshams na//shel sgong zla thig mar me'i 'od 'dra ba'i//'od zhig mig gi thad du byung ba yis/ /rkyen byas sems ngo'i steng du gnas pa'i ngang //sa rdo ri brag sogs kyis mi sgrib par//thag ring gnas pa'i mi yi ci byed mthong //ci smra thos sogs mngon shes lta bur thig/de 'dra rgyun du mi 'byung res 'ga' 'byung / /mngon shes yin par rloms shing nga rgyal na/ /bar chad yin te rtogs pa'i 'phel 'phro chad/ /de ni nyams kyi 'od gsal zhes bya yin/ /de bzhin rang nyid nyal nas 'dug pa'i tshe/ /gnyid la shes shing gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin/ /mun khung yin kyang rang khyim nyin bzhin gsal/ /gzhan dag rnams kyi yid la ci bsam pa//kho rang smras nas byung snyam gsal bor thig/de tsho nyams kyi 'od gsal zhesatso ste//mngon shes yod snyam smras shing thig pa'i tshe//nga rgyal skyes na bdud kyi bar chad zhugs//rnal 'byor nyams la ci yang 'char ba'i dpe//nga rgyal mi bya g.yel chung rang gar skyur/ /de yis bar chad mi 'byung lam du 'gro/ /chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus//dper na lan tsha chu la thim pa bzhin//sems nyid gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi sku//yin kyang de ltar yin snyam 'dzin pa de/ /sems tsam lta ba yin gyi phyag chen min/ /sems ni nam mkha' lta bur mtha' bral zhes/ /bsam pa'i 'dzin pa phra'u des bcings nas/ /rnam shes mtha' yas gzugs med khams su skyes/ /nam mkha'i gar khyab sems kyis khyab pa dang / /nam mkha'i khams ni dpag med bsam las 'das/ /bsam pa'i 97

'dzin pa phra'u des bcings pas/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas gzugs med khams su skye/ /chos kun gdod nas ma grub stong pa nyid/ /ci yang dmigs su med pa yin mod kyi/ /de ltar yin no bsam pa'i 'dzin pa des/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched gol sa yin/ /phyi nang snod bcud rang gi sems dang bcas/ /don dam ci yang med de stong ba nyid/ /kun rdzob ci yang 'char ste ci yang srid/ /de phyir yod med gnyis ka min bsam pa'i //'dzin pa phra'us yod min med min skye//de ltar stong nyams rnam pa bzhi yod de/ /mu stegs pa yi rtogs pa mchog yin te/ /de la mchog 'dzin de dang tshe 'phos na/ /gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir skye bar gsungs/ /bskal pa brgyad khrir lus ni mi len te/ /bde dang sdug pa'i tshor ba gcig kyang med/ /'dzin pa ma zhugs stong ba'i rang ngo lta/ /stong dang mi stong smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /de ni stong nyid phyag rgya chen po dngos//nyams rtogs de dag yun gyi ring thung dang //tshabs kyi che chung rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung / /gang ltar ma yengs sa le rjen ne ba/ /mar me rlung gis ma bskyod lta bu de/ /rtse gcig gnas pas rtse gcig ming du btags/ /de la res 'ga' ba dang phal che ba/ /gnyid dus ma gtogs 'bral ba med pa gsum/ /rtse gcig chung 'bring che gsum ming du btags/ /de man ci ltar bzang bzang 'dra na yang / /rtogs pa'i ngo bo ma mthong nyams kyis g.yos/ /de yang gang zag dbang po'i khyad par gyis/ /nyams rtogs skyed dka' rim gyis skye ba ni/ /rim skyes pa yi rigs te gang skyes brtan//dang po nyams rtogs skye sla myur du skye//skyes pa mi brtan 'gyur ldog mtho dman che/ /de ni thod rgal ba yi rigs yin no/ /dang po nyid nas rtogs pa mthon po skye/ /sgom yun thung ngus de yi rtsal rdzogs pa/ /gcig char pa yi rigs 98

tedakon pa yin/ /rtogs pa skye dka' rim gyis skye ba la/ /de yang 'gyur ldog mthodaman mang ba ni/ /rim gyis pa yi thod rgal pa yin te/ /dper na rā ga a sus bdag lta bu/ /rtogs pa cung zhig skye ba bul ba la//sngon 'gro la sogs khrid rim ci bzhin du//nyams su blangs rim de dang mthun pa yi//rtogs pa bzang po skyesapar gyur pa ni/ /rim gyis pa yi gcig char pa yin no/ /de ni thod rgal ba dang gcig char ba/ /re re la yang gsum gsum dbye ba'i tshul/ /gong gi rigs pas dpag pas shes par sla/ /de nas rtogs pa ci ltar 'char ba'i tshul/ /mos gus gsol 'debs 'bad pa'i byin rlabs sam/ /yi dam 'grub pa'i mchog gi dngos grub bam//bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i nus mthu 'am//tshe sngon las 'phro yod pa'i las sad pas/ /sngar gyi nyams rtogs shun pa lta bur bud/ /bsgom bya sgom byed 'dzin pa dbyings su gtor/ /'di sgom de sgom gtad so gcig kyang med/ /'di yin de yin nges shes 'dzin pa zhig /nang du bkug nas lta ba 'dra de med/ /phyi ru bltas pas gsal ba 'dra de med/ /lta mi lta rgyu so sor yod 'dra ba//de nyid zhig nas 'di lta de lta med//lta mi lta rgyu gnyis po gcig tu 'dres//'di yin de yin 'di bsam de bsam med//rang ga kha rog sdod pa 'dra zhig 'byung //de tshe yid gnyis the tshom du ma ldang / /sngar dang gtan nas mi 'dra ci yin ang / /hwa shang lta ba am de i yin (yin min)ang //stong lta had po am de i yin(yin min) ang //sngar gyi sgom de bor ba i yin (yin min)ang //'di bsgom de bsgom ci yang mi 'dug pas/ /sgom med am de rtogs pa i yin(yin min) ang / /nyams chen dri sa yod na dga' ba la//bsam pa'i blo mang rtsab rtsub ci yang dran/ /thos pa chung na nga yi sgom bor snyam/ /sngar gyi bde gsal mi rtogs 99

nyams bzang po/ /de 'dra i 'ong (yong ngam)bsam zhing bsgom na yang / /sngar bzhin mi 'ong yi mug sems sdug che/ /ham pa che na sgom med rtogs yod snyam/ /'gro don ran bsam g.yeng pas 'khyer yang srid/ /de nas bde gshegs bka' yi bla ma brten/ /bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung dang rgyud sde sogs/ /dpe ltas byas pas sems kyis the tshom chod//rang sems ngo bo mthong ba dngos de yin//tha mal shes pa rjen pa zhes kyang bya/ /spros bral chung ngu'i ngo mthong zhes kyang bya/ /dper na tshes pa gsum gyi zla ba de//chung yang zla ba yin par thag chod ltar//da dung nyams rtogs rtsal ni ma rgyas kyang / /phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa shar ba yin/ /'di nas rtogs ldan ming yang thob par bshad/ /de nas ngo bo 'gyur ba med na yang / /gsal dang 'grib pa cung zad yod pa yin/ /nyams ni shas chung rtogs pa shas che yi//nyams ni gtan nas dag pa ma yin te//da rung (da dung /)nyams kyi gsal 'grib mang du 'byung //ma yengs rtse gcig nyams len skyong ba'i tshe/ /phyi nang med par mnyam dngas yid de ba/ /ma yengs dran rdzi tsam zhig ma gtogs pa//'di bsgom gtad so med pa'i bya le ba//mig gis yul du gzugs ni ci mthong yang / /byis pa lha khang nang du phyin pa bzhin/ /mig gi mthong yang 'di yin 'dzin pa med//snang stong phyag rgya chen po dngos su 'char//rna ba'i yul du snyan dang mi snyan sgra/ /dga' dang mi dga' med de brag cha ltar/ /grag stong phyag rgya chen po dngos su 'char/ /dri ro reg bya rnams kyang de yis 'dres/ /ma yengs nyams len skyong tshe de ltar ste/ /yengs skabs tha mal 'khrul pa'i dug lnga ldang / /'di skabs 'jig rten bya ba ci nus spang / /spros bcas mi bya chos spyod nyung ngur bsdu//nyams len rtse gcig skyong na bogs rtsal che//spros bcas mang na 100

nyams de yal dogs che//nyams de res 'ga' ba dang phal cher ram//gnyid tshe ma gtogs 'khor yug 'gro ba dang //gnyid dang rmi lam res zin res mi zin//spros bcas chung 'bring che gsum yin par nges/ /phyi rol gzugs sgra dri ro ci shar yang / /seng ge gangs la zin pa ci bzhin du//'jigs skrag ya nga'i rtog pa mi 'jug ste/ /de phyir dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin zer/ /don la gang zag bdag med rtogs par 'dod//ci phyir sems dang bdag ces don gcig pas//sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum bral bar rtogs/ /bdag dang sems zhes bya ba'i dngos po zhig /med par thag chod yid ches gdeng rnyed cing //sems nyid las gzhan chos sku med par rtogs//de phyir don la gang zag bdag med yin//gang zag bdag med stong nyid byed pa ste/ /nang gi sems nyid gtan la phabs na yang / /phyi yi snang ba gtan lam phebs pas/ /stong dang mi stong 'dzin pa ma zhugs so/ /de nas snang ba gtan la 'bebs pa ni//sa rdo ri brag skyes pa thams cad dang / /sbra khang skyes pa bud med dud 'gro sogs/ /mig gis gang mthong de la rig pa gtad//ngo bo bltas pas dbyer med gcig tu 'dres//phyi yi gzugs dang nang gi sems nyid gnyis / /so sor phye rgyu med pa'i nyams shig 'char/ /de la goms na gtan nas bsgom mi dgos//gang mthong shugs 'byung de yi ngang la 'gro/ /de nas gling bzhi stong gsum 'jig rten khams/ /yid la bkod nas bsgom pas dbyer med 'dres//de bzhin sems dang nam mkha' bsres bsgoms pas/ /'di phan nam mkha' 'di tshun sems nyid ces/ /so sor phye rgyu med par dbyer med 'dres/ /de bzhin nam mkhas gar khyab sems dang bsres/ /ngo bo bltas pas dbyer med gcig tu 'dres/ /'di tshun nam mkha' sems kyis khyab 101

pa la/ /'di phan ma khyab snyam pa'i sa mtshams med/ /de nas bsre shing bsgom sogs mi dgos par//snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun//rnam pa gsal yang ngo bo stong ba nyid/ /rnam pa gsal ba stong bas ma bsgribs shing / /dngos po'i gzugs de stong pas ma bsgribs par/ /'ja' tshon chu zla me long gzugs brnyan bzhin//nyams len nam skyed dus su de ltar 'char//yengs pa'i skabs su tha mal 'khrul ba nyid/ /yengs skabs ring thung brtson 'grus che chung lags/—/rnam g.yeng che'am sdug bsngal skrag sngangs dus//yengs skabs mi 'byung phal cher tshur la 'char/ /bde skyid sdug bsngal med dus yengs skabs mang /'di skabs yang yang dran rdzi'i gsal 'debs las/ /gzhan pa'i bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /cho ga chos spyod dus mchod la sogs dang / /rim par bsre shing gnyis ka ma shol bya//bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems nyid gnyis//dbyer med gcig tu bsres nas ngo bo lta/ /dbyer med 'dres pa'i rtogs pa nang nas 'char/ /dper na rgya gar chu dang bod kyi chu/ /lung pa'i dbang gis tha dad so so yang / /ngo bo chu ru gcig la tha dad med/ /de bzhin bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal ba dang / /rnam pa 'gag med 'char la khyad par med/ /'di man rang sems 'di yan bla ma'i thugs/ /so sor dbye rgyu med par gcig tu 'dres/ /de yang go ba skam po ma yin par/ /rtogs pa gdeng nas 'char bar gyur pa la//thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa de la zer//de bzhin phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs dang rang sems bsres la ngo bo blta/ /gang bzhin dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngo bo 'char/ /de bzhin dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro sogs/ /'gro drug sems can kun gyi sems rgyud dang / /rang 102

sems bsres nas bltas yang khyad par med/ /don dam chos sku nyag gcig rjen par rtogs/ /sems nyid las gzhan 'khor ba med par rtogs/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'ang de la zer/ /rang gi ngos nas 'khor ba dong sprugs yin/ /ma rtogs 'khrul ngor 'khor ba mtha' med yin/ /rang gi nyams len steng du bzhag pa'i tshe/ /'khor ba myang 'das dbyer med stong pa nyid/ /mtho dman bzang ngan khyad par med par rtogs//'di ni lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med yin//lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor bar/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhib 'dzem pa gnad du che / /rtogs pa mtho dus de ltar rtogs pa dang / /yengs skabs nyon mongs hrag cing tha mal pa/ /de ni nyams kyi ro gcig chung ngu ste/ /'di skabs khro gtum che dang nyon mongs hrag /'dod pa che sogs sgom 'khreb song ba 'dra/ /sgom chen rnying pas lham krad mthong sdud dpe/ /ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yeng zhes pa/ /spyod pa rtsing na ngan 'gror lhung dogs gsungs/ /de dus rgyu 'bras blang dor gzab pa gces/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs bsgrigs na shugs kyis 'grigs//de nas rtsub slong nyon mongs phal cher zhi/ /gtam sogs ko long phrag dog rnams kyang med/ /bkur bsti bstod bsngags byung kyang dga' ba chung / /nyams len steng du nam gzhag de yi tshe/ /snod bcud gsal stong chu zla lta bu las/ /bsre sogs bcas bcos mi dgos shugs kyis 'char/ /rmi lam 'od gsal zin grangs nyung du song / /nyams dang rmi lam dag snang dpag med 'char//bsgrubs dang ma bsgrub yi dam zhal mang mthong / /sngon byon de ltar bzhugs pa'i grub chen tshogs/ /ma nges du ma mjal zhing brda' chos ston/ /de 'dra byung kyang ha cang mchog 'dzin med/ /'on kyang yengs skabs brjed skabs mang ba'i phyir/ /yengs skabs byung 103

bar 'gyod pas blo mi tshim/ /'di ni ro gcig 'bring tsam yin nam snyam/ /blo mi tshim pa mnyam rjes ma 'dres rtags//de nas bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'am//yi dam bsnyen sgrub tshogs kyis rkyen byas te/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu bzhi yi phyag chen gyi/ /go ba skom po de yang ma yin la/ /rigs pas brtag cing dpyad pa'ang ma yin pa//mdo rgyud tshig la'ang go ba brgyab pa min//gzhan gyis gsungs pa'i rjes zlos ma yin par//yengs skabs brjed skabs gnyid skabs yod na yang //yengs dang ma yengs khyad par med par rtogs/ /brjed dang ma brjed khyad par med par rtogs/ /gnyid dang ma gnyid khyad par med par rtogs/ /rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i shes rab kyis//ye nas chos sku rjen pa yin par rtogs//don dam gnyug ma rgyun chad med par rtogs/ /de ltar rtogs kyang da rung (da dung /)dran pa yis/ /yang yang gsal 'debs byed pa zab par go /'khor ba rang bzhin med par rtogs na yang / /dag pa'i zhing du smon lam 'debs pa zab /don la dge sdig med pa'i don rtogs kyang //dge ba bsgrub cing sdig pa spangs pa zab/ /nyes ltung dri ma gdod nas ma dmigs kyang /nyes ltung sbyangs shing bsod nams bsags pa zab/ /de ltar gong du bshad pa'i rtogs pa de/ /res 'ga' shar zhing rtag tu mi brtan na/ /nyams kyi ro gcig ces bya'i ming du btags//'pho 'gyur med cing rtogs pa brtan pa na//da rung (da dung /)rtogs pa'i rtsal ni ma rdzogs shing / /rtogs pa'i yon tan dngos su ma shar kyang / /ro gcig zhes bya'i ming ni thog go snyam/ /snang srid thams cad sgyu mar mthong ba'i phyir/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ /de dag rang gi nyams dang bstun byas te/ /gzhan la phan phyir brtson 'grus khyod la bshad/ /'di ni bshad pa'i 104

chos ni ma yin te//nyams len bsgrub pa'i dmigs rim yin pa'i phyir//rang gi nyams myong med pa'i mang po 'ga'/ /bris kyang shog bu 'dzad las dgos pa chung / /'on kyang chos kyi mgo rkang tshang ba'i phyir//bka' brgyud gsung la dbang bzhag zur tsam smra//dran rdzi bsten dgos bar du sgom yod de//dran rdzi bsten mi dgos par dus rgyun du/ /ngo bo 'gyur med ngang du song ba ni/ /sgom med yin zhes rlung sems gnyis med kyi//shog dril mi las dwags por gnang pa yi/ /yig rnying khungs btsun nang du gsal bar snang //de la'ang chung 'bring chen po gsum du bshad/ /spang bya'i dri ma thams cad des bcom zhing / /sems la gegs skyon gang gis mi tshugs pas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin yin par bshad/ /sgom med chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa/ /yin par khrid yig thams cad dgongs pa mthun/ /de don bla med rgyud sde thams cad nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par gsungs pa de/ /dbu la gtsug tor zhabs la 'khor lo sogs//shāka thub 'dra ba 'ong ba ma lags te//skal ldan tshe gcig sgrub pa byas pa na//sgom med chen po tshe 'dir rtogs 'gyur bas/ /de ni tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin la dgongs/ /de ltar nyams len skyong tshul de dag ni//rdzogs chen pa yis khreg chod nyams len zer//rdzogs chen sems sde'i nyams len mthar thug yin/ /rdzogs chen klong sde man ngag sde rnams nas/ /de la bkag pa mdzad pa'ang mang yod de/ /tshig gi bshad phyogs rtsing zhib khyad tsam las//don la mi 'gal khyad par spu tsam med//de don grub chen kurma pakṣu yis/ /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs pa chen po gnyis/ /tshig la khyad yod don la khyad med gsungs/ /phyag rdzogs zung 'jug nyams len skyong ba'i tshul/ /seng ge dkar mo'i ngar skad 'di bsgrags pas//skal med log lta the tshom 105

gyis skrag kyang //skal ldan seng phrug dga' bas nyams su len//rang gi nyams la gang shar smras pa la/ /yin rung min rung rdzun gyi tshig mi 'dres/ /rnal 'byor nyams la ci yang 'char pa'i phyir/ /mkhas grub rnams kyis gzigs kyang thugs ma khrel/ /zhes pa rta lo rgyal zla'i nyer bzhi la/ /bri mtshams lus nas zla ba 'ga' 'das te//khrums zla'i nyer gnyis nyin par 'phro mthud byas//dgongs mo'i thun pa rdzogs par smras pa de/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos gus btud nas/ /phyag 'tshal maṇḍal phul nas mgyogs par bris/ /dge bas sgom chen 'ga' la phan thog shog/le'u bcu gsum pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /bar chad skyobs byed byams pa'i go cha/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ sangs rgyas kyi smon lam bden tshig gi sgo nas bsrung bzlog byed tshul zab mo 'jigs pa kun skyob byams pa'i go cha snying rje'i ya lad ces bya ba bzhugs so//na mo ārya lo ki shwa ra ya/mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsgrub la brtson pa'i brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis/ /rtsa gsum lha yi sgrub pa gang byed kyang / /rgyun du srung dang bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni//lha tshogs gang la brten na zab ces zhus//'phral rkyen ngan pa'i bar chad bzlog pa la/ /ye shes 'jig rten lha tshogs thams cad zab/ /las kyi rnam smin ma gtogs bzlog par gsungs//las kyi rnam smin de la rigs gsum ste/ /da res tshe 'dir nges par smin dgos pa/ /mthong chos myong 'gyur de la 106

bzlog thabs med/ /skye ba phyi mar smin dgos las de ni/ /skye gnas myong 'gyur lasazhes bya ba dang / /nam smin nges med nam zhig smin dgos pa/ /lan grangs gzhan du myong 'gyur las yin te/ /de gnyis bar chad rkyen gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ /tshe 'dir lus 'di'i steng du smin gyur pa/ /de ni 'jig rten lha yis mi bzlog te//ye shes lha yis phyir la bzlog pa'am//yang na bsrabs shing byang bar nus pa'i don/ /las la dbang ba'i stobs ni mnga' phyir yin/ /chos rgyal gyis kyang las la bcos med de/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis las la bcos yod tshul/ /mo'u gal mdo rgyas pa'i nang na gsal//khyad par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa thob kyang / /sems can phan pa'i smon lam re re'i don/ /bskal ba bye ba brgya stong dka' ba spyad/ /bden tshig 'grub pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams kyi/ /bden tshig mthu yi srung bzlog 'gran zla med//bdag gis rgyun gyi srung bzlog 'di ga yin//bu khyod blo gtad srung bzlog 'di la mdzod/ /rang nyid yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'am gang rung du bskyed chogaskur gsal thugs ka yi//sa bon 'od zer shar gyi phyogs su 'phros/ /shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i thugs yir phog/sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam rjes su dran//sku las 'od zer mthing ka dpag med 'phros/ /bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la thim pa yis/ /'jigs skrag gnod pa thams cad zhi bar bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis dam bcas pa dang / /tshig brjod pa gang yin pa'i dam bcas pa dang / tshig brjod pa de dag gis pha rol tu son pa'i bden 107

pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des/ bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya dmigs yul rnams la 'jigs pa dang / skrag pa dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa 'di dag nub par gyur cig /oṃ a khyo bhya bi snanta krita hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad sharnyo ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa gcig gsum bdun sogs gal dang bstun/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs pa'i/ gnod pa thams cad de ma thag tu ni/ /thams cad nub cing med par 'gyur ba ni/ /mi 'khrugs pa yi mdo las rgya cher gsungs/ /sngags dang dmigs pa gzhan nas kha bskang byas/ /de bzhin rang gzhan nad kyis 'tshe ba la/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros/ /shar phyogs baiḍūrya snang zhing khams su/ /bcom ldan sman bla bzhugs pa'i thugs kur phog /sngon gyi dam bca' thugs bskyed smon lam dran/'od zer baiḍūrya yi mdog /yi dam gang rung bskyed pa 'am/ 'dra 'phros/ /bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus la thim/ /nad kun ba mor nyi zer phog 'drar bsgoms//sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal bos sngon smon lam chen po bcu gnyis btab pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des/ bdag dang srung bya'i nad thams cad da lta nyid du zhi bar gyur cig tabyathā/ oṃ hai ṣa dzu bhe ṣa byo ma hā bhe ṣa dzu rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ nad sarba sharnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ gcig gam gsum mam bdun sogs skabs dang bstun/ /rnam smin ma gtogs nad kun zhi ba'i tshul/ /sman mdo rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgya cher bshad/ /sngags dang dmigs pa'i man ngan gzhan nas bsnan/ /spri/ /me chu dug mtshon rgyal po chom rkun dang / /mdor na 108

'jigs skrag gnod pa gang byung kyang / /rang gi thugs ma'i 'od zer lho phyogs 'phros/ /ri bo po ṭa la yi rtse mo ru/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs kur phog /tshad med thugs rjes dgongs nas skyabs sbyin mdzad//'od zer dkar po nyi ma shar bzhin 'phros/ /bdag dang bsrung bya kun la phog ma thag /ba mor nyi zer phog bzhin gnod pa bsal/ /'jigs pa 'jigs pa med pa sbyin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal lo//'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad las skyab tu gsol/ o pad ma tshinta spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo'i snying po yin/ ma ṇi dzwa la hūṃ/ 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad sharnyi ku ru swā hā/ gcig bdun gsum sogs gal dang bstun la brjod/ /the tshom med na 'jigs pa kun skyobs par/ /parda ma dkar po'i mdo las brgya cher gsungs/ /sngags ni yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rgyud dang ni/ /sga lo nas brgyud rgya gzhung man ngag yin//gong 'og man ngag rim pa 'di gsum gyi//phan yon rgyas par so so'i mdo ltar gsal/ /byin rlabs bden stobs srung ba i thi rgya/ /'jig rten gsum po 'di na dbang che bas//'jig rten dbang phyug ces byar yong grags pa//de yi thugs rje'i stobs kyis bzlog pa ni/ /rang la gnod pa gar yod phyogs de'am/ /'gron po song phyogs 'jigs pa yod phyogs der/ /kha gyus rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su//phyag stong spyan stong sku ru lam gyis bsgom//rkang pa gshibs nas langs te lag pa gnyis/ /'phred du brkyang la thal mo gnam du bzed/ /de nas tshur bskum snying gar thal mo gnyis/ /rgyab sprod g.yas pa'i thog tu g.yon pa 109

bcang //rang gi sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros//'jigs pa dang ni gnod pa gang yin de/ /sprin nag rlung gis gtor bzhin bzlog par bsgom/ /na mo ārya awa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ /tarya thā/ sa rba du shu o ha ya me swā hā/ /de byas dgra dang bdud dang bgegs kyi rigs/ /thams cad bzlog cing thul bar 'gyur ba ni/ /phyag stong spyan stong rgyud gzhung 'ga' na gsal/ /thugs rje'i stobs kyis bzlog pa bla na med//khyad par ngan sngags bzlog pa'i sham bu ni//oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/log pa log pa/ log pa log thum thum shag shag tshal tshal gnod byed byad ma zungs shig /cung zad bzlas pas ngan sngags phar la bzlog /bka' gdams glegs bam nas gsungs gdams ngag yin/ /nge ltar thugs rje byin rlabs bden stobs kyis/ /bsrung dang bzlog pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di/ /bka' yi don rnams gdams ngag nyid du shar/ /rang gi nyams su blangs pa'i rtogs chos yin/ /gsung rab rgya chen go ba'i skyes bu yis/ /dpyad na 'di las zab pa'i gdams ngag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na btsal yang rnyed mi srid/ /de skad rta lo khrums zla'i nyer brgyad nyin/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dus mchod tshogs 'khor skabs/ /rā ga asus ji ltar smras pa rnams//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod/ /nongs pa med pas bshags bya cang ma mchis/ /dge bas 'gro kun 'jigs pa kun skyob shog/le'u bzhi pa'o//maṅga lam̐//110

sa dpyad nyung ngu rin chen kun 'dus/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /sa dpyad rin chen kun 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ārya mañdzu shri ye/ /kun rdzob sa yi bden 'bras ni/ /spyir ni phyi nang snod bcud kun/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin yin/ /khyad par sa 'di dbang che ste/ /gling bzhi dang ni 'dzam bu'i gling / /rgya gar rgya nag hor dang bod/ /sa yi chags tshul la brten nas/ /skyid sdug dar gud phyug dbul sogs/ /so sor byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ /phur pa'i sa dpyad gzhung du gsal/ /de phyir khang ba la sogs pa/ /gson po'i sa 'di gal che'o/ /srog dang bla dang rnam shes gsum/ /srog ni gshed ma 'dre yis bcad/ /rnam shes las kyi rjes su 'brangs/ /bla de tshe 'das gzugs bzung nas//dur sa de la gnas pa yin//dur sa legs na bla de dar/ /gson po rnams la mgon skyabs nus//pha myes bla yis bsrung zhes bya//dur sa ngan na bla de gud//gson po rnams la skyabs 'tshol bas//mi khyag na tsha god kha 'byung / /de phyir dur sa gal che ste/ /sa dpyad ngan par ro bskyal na/ /dud 'gro yin kyang rdul du brlag /de skad 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi/ /rgya nag gtsug lag rgyud nas gsungs/ /sa yi bden 'bras bshad pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /'phags pa 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga dang / /kong rtse la sogs rgyal4 po bzhi kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgal po/ ye shas 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ ji rtse 'phrus gyi rgyal po/ ji nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ /mkhas pa mi bzhi drang song nor bu rin chen/ bram ze mu tig rgya g.yu bzhes 111

stag chang la sogs kyis/ /mdzad pa'i sa gzhung bsam mi khyab/ /mdo sde spom mgo zhes bya dang / /khra bo ri rtsis zhes bya dang / /gal po la byang zhes bya dang / /bya rgod la dang zhes bya dang / /byang ba gser gzhung zhes bya dang / /nag po stag shams zhes bya dang //mon mo mdzub tshugs zhes bya dang / /bye ma lag khrid ces bya dang //chung dur don bdun ma la sogs/ /rgya nag lugs kyi sa dpyad yin/ /rgya gar lugs kyi sa dpyad la/ /mdo rgyud rnams nas gsungs pa yi/ /sgrub gnas sa dpyad mang du yod/ /slob dpon pad mas mdzad pa yi/ /sa dpyad gser gyi lde mig sogs/ /de dag phan bya'i sa dpyad yin/ /nam mkha'i snying pos mdzad pa yi/ /nag po 'bum nag zhes bya dang / /gdug pa'i lce mdung dgu bskor sogs/ /gnod bya'i sa dpyad mang du yod/ /lab kyi sgron mas mdzad pa yi/ /gnyan mig khrag mig sa dpyad mang //sgrub pa byed pa'i sa dpyad la/ /ri chos sa dpyad mang du yod/ sa dpyad kyi lung khungs bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ / lung 'dren byas na mang drag pas/ /lag tu blang bya'i ngag khrid la/ /byang gi stod smad nub byang dang / /nus kyi stod smad rgyab bstan pa/ /shar smad shar lho lho yi stod/ /de la mdun gyi ston sa bya/ /rgyab ri mtho zhing mdun ri rgu/ /g.yas g.yon chu gnyis mdun du 'dus/ /mdun du chu shing na ba rgyas/ /de 'dra'i phyogs der sa tshol bya/ /sa yi ka ba rnam bzhi ni/ /shar phyes lho spungs nub 'dan pa/ /byang ni yol ba bres 'dra bzang / /shar lam lho lam grogs dang g.yang / /nub lam byang lam bdud dang dgra/ /g.yas g.yon shing gcig ngan pa yin/ /'og gi shing gcig rten phur yin/ /steng gi shing gcig ltag pa'i 'dzer/ /gnam ni blum zhing 'khyil na bzang / /gnam zur sdom la 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /phra na bud med 112

'chiba'i sa//brag zur rnon— po gnam du zug/lo mal gang yin mi de 'chi//shar lho'inam mkha' mda' stong 'dra/ /yon tan 'grim sgo che ba'i sa/ /'byung ba'i sgronachen bzhi bo ni/ /gnam sgron gshin rje'i mche ba dang / /brag sgron phug pa skar khung dang / /sa sgron gad pa mdung rtse dang / /chu sgron nyi ma'i srab mda' dang / /shing sgron re ba'i g.yab mo dang / /rlung sgron gang bu mda' stong dang / /de rnams spyi la ngan pa'i sgron/ /mdun du chu shing na ba rdza/ /phun sum tshogs na dngos grub 'byung / /mdun ri g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum/ /che rgyud chung rgyud 'bring rgyud sa//rtse dang bar dang smad dang gsum//pha khu dar ma bu chung sa//rgyab ri rtse 'dzin sa mkhan rang / /yang ri dpon dang mi rgyud sa/ /shar lho bu mo mag pa'i sa//lo skor bcu gnyis lo malas gyi//sa ni dgra dang grogs gang yod//rang rang lo snying can gyi thob/ /rang rang lo mal phyogs nas/ /lo skor so so'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /byung na so so'i lo bar bzang / /shar gyi lam ni stag skya bo/ /gad pas chod na sa mda' phog /lho chu g.yu 'brug sngon mo ste/ /chu chad byung na dong du lhung / /nub kyi sa dmar brag dmar ni/ /nub srung bya ni dmar mo ste/ /lam kyi dkyil gtubs snyi yis zin//byang gi rdza shur pha wang brag/byang srung rus sbal rgya bo ste/ /chu 'go long ro tshwa chus 'grangs/ /skyon med srung bzhi tshang ba ni/ /mtha' brten mi ni drag po tshar/ /skyon bzhis zin na mi ngan skye/ /sa yi srung bzhi ma tshang na/ /yul 'khyar 'khyams pa sprang po mang / /'og ni ha cang gzar ba na/ /cung zhig chags ni dka' bar bshad/ /'og tu tsha khang ma ṇi dang / /skye shing btsugs na phan pa yin/ /sa la sa dgra med na yang / /rang gi sa dgra bzos pa ni//shar du mchod rten tsha khang dang //ma ṇi chen po brtsegs pa na//grong pa de ni 113

gud par 'gyur/ /lho na ma ṇi tsha khang dang /mchod rten la sogs brtsegs pa na//kha yi grogs de lce yi phud/ nub dang byang du tsha khang dang / /maṇi brtsegs na shin tu phan/ /grong dang khang ba'i gnya' ltag tu/ /brtsigs na gnya' gnon 'ong bas ngan/ /de rnams spyi yi sa dpyad yin/ /spyi yi sa dpyad kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o//de nas dur gyi sa dpyad ni/ /rus chen yon tan che ba dang / /spra rgan yang tsha mthong ba rnams/ /gdan khri bang rim mang po dang / /mtho ba'i sa la bzhag par bya/ /lo yi mang nyung rus che chung / /de dang mthun pa'i mthon man bya/ /rgan dur dma' bar gyur pa dang / /gzhon dur mtho bar gyur pa rnams/ /shi res gzhon la 'babs pa yin/ /gzhon dur gnya' non che chung ni/ /shi grangs mang nyung de dang bstun/ /ri yi sna dang brag gi zur/ /sna ru mi rung cung zhig gzur/ /gri dur lung ba'i yangs dogs ni/ /mda' 'ben tsam las yangs mi btsal deyang pha ri tshu ri gnyis//brag zur thang thang rgyu gri yin//de la shin tu 'dzem par bya/ /rgyab ri nga rgyal che ba dang / /mdun ri 'jam na bzang ba yin/ /lo skor bcu gnyis sa dpyad la/ /shar phyogs nags tshal shing gcig ni/ /khyi 'brug glang lug lo ba'i bdud/ /stag yos lo pa'i srog la phan/ /lho phyogs brag dmar sa dmar ni/ /rta sbrul lo pa'i tshe bsring ste/ /bya sprel lo pa'i srog gcod byed/ /nub phyogs brag dkar rdza dkar ni/ /bya sprel lo pa'i srog srung ste/ /stag yos lo pa'i srog bdud byed/ /byang gi chu bo rgyun 'babs ni/ /byi phag lo pa'i tshe sring ste/ /rta sbrul lo pa'i srog gcod byed/ /mtshams bzhi gang yang rung ba ni//lha khang mchod rten tsha khang dang //gyang ral thang chung gru bzhi ni//mtshams bzhi lo pa'i srog la phan//byi phag lo pa'i tshe la gnod/ /de dag dgra dang 'phrad gyur na/ /lo gsum mi 114

'gyang rtags ston no//gal te khang ba la sogs ni//sa dgra de dag la sogs pa//mtshams bzhi sa yi dgra byung na/ /de phyogs khang zur skye shing btsug /lho phyogs brag dmar sa dmar rtsar//chu sna dgu blugs bum pa sbas//shar phyogs shing gi sgra byungan//shing la gri lcags gzer bu gyeb//byang phyogs chu yi dgra byung na//ri chen gsum gyi sa blangs blugs/ /nub phyogs brag dkar dgra byung na/ /dar lcogs dmar po btsugs pa'am//rdo dmar rnam bcu dbang ldan bzhag/de ni khang pa'i sa bcos te/ /dur sa bcos pas thub pa min/ /de nas chung ngur man ngag ni/ /gnya' non che na pha 'chi la/ /chung na 'chi rgab mi chod pas/ /che chung shi ba'i grangs dang sbyar/ /steng du lam gyis chod pa na/ /gzhan la ltag pa'i gnya' shing ste/ /chung ngur la ni gnya' non yin/ /gzhan la g.yas kyi shing gcig ngan/ /chung ngur la ni srung mda' bzang / /mdun du thang chung ma pang yin//med na byis kha mi sos pas/ /ha cang che na ma 'chi 'o/ /mdun gyi thad nas tshur la ni/ /chu bran drag tu 'bab pa dang / /gzhung chu g.yu 'brug ma bu 'dres/ /de la gtad pas srid 'byung ste/ /rba klong skya 'tshubs chu sgra che/ /de la nges par bu 'byung ste/ /chu sgra rba klong med pa na/ /de la bu mo 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnya' non ma pad srung mnga' dang / /chu yis mgyogs so de tsam las/ /sa dpyad spyi rnams dpyad mi dgos/ /de nas god gcod sa dpyad la/ /ri brag dmar bo nag po ni/ /btsan bdud gnas pas sha la dga'/ /de 'drar man nan god 'byung ngo / /brag chen min pa'i brag dkar dang / /pha bong dkar po gtan brugs sogs/ /srog chags 'dra ba'i zhabs su mnan/ /mdun gyi thad der dpal kha ni/ /chu dang na ba gal che zhing / /dud 'gro gang dang gang yin pa'i//so so'i bla shing nags tshal bzang /115

shug pa 'om bu rta yi shing / /thang shing nor yin sur dkar lug /spen ma ba glang smug ra/ /shing ni glang ma mang ba na/ /dud 'gro mo phyugs 'phel ba yin/ /stag dzimang na pho rigs 'phel//gnya' non dpal kha 'dzom pa na//kha yi gyu phyogs nor kyang rung //gnya' non cung zad che dgos kyi//ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yi//sa dpyad kyang ni de dang 'dra/ /dur sa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas khang sa'i khyad par ni/ /byang phyogs sho dang nub phyogs yangs/ /dgra dang na tsha rgod pa yin/ /snophyogs brgya mkhar tsha khang brtsegs/ /shar phyogs ngogs na tshe thung ste/ /lung mda' sho na gya zhud 'byung / /phyag rgya bsnol ba 'dra na bzang / /khyad par dgon pa'i sa cha la/ /'bru yi phung bo spungs 'dra bzang / /gnya' nas 'bo ba 'dra ba dang / /'og nas skyo rang 'dra na bzang / /'og tu chu mig yod pa ni/ /bum pa'i zhabs rdol yin pas ngan/ /g.yas g.yon chu mig yod pa ni/ /phyag dkar gser skyems yin pas bzang / /steng gi rgyab ri'i chu 'go ni/ /sdug gi mchi ma yin paso ngan/ /shar lho'i brag dmar sa dmar ni/ /btsan gyi rgyug srang rta la ngan/ /de phyogs mchod rten gzugs bzhengs bzhag /nub tu shing gcig kher skyes ni/ /lha 'dre'i mdun spung yin pas ngan/ /de la gri lcags gzer bu rgyab/ /nub byang/mtshams kyi phug pa ni//ma mo'i nyal sa yin pa'i phyir//grong der nad rims rgyun mi chad//de nang rnam snang sku bri bzhag /byang du mtsho chung yod pas na//grong pachag la rkyen ngan mang / /ri chen gsum gyi sa blangs blugs/ /nyi zla chu yis khyer ba dang / /nyi zla'i skya lam brtod pa ni/ /ngan te bcos thabs med pa yin/ /ri bo chen po'i rtse dang ni/ /thang chen yangs pa'i dkyil dang ni/ /ri thang gnyis kyi mtshams rnams ni/ /sa zad yin pas bkra mi shis/ /khyad par sgrub gnas yo 116

dpyadani/ /sa mdog dkar zhing sur dkar skye/ /nam mkha' blum zhing sa gzhi 'jam/ /de ru zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub/ /nags tshal me tog gling chen rgyas//ri bragardza rnams nor bu'i dbyibs/ /de ru rgyas pa'i las rnams 'grub/ /brag mdog sa mdog dmar shas che/ /shug pa 'om bu se ba skye/ /phug pa thang chung zla gam dbyibs/ /nub kyi phyogs nas chu chen 'babs//de ru dbang gi las rnams 'grub/ /lung gsum mdo dang chu gsum 'dus//sa gzhi gru gsum tsher ma skyes/ /brag nag brag dmar khros pa'i gzugs//de ru drag po'i phrin las 'grub/ /khang ba dur sa sgrub gnas sogs/ /nye lo chu mig gnyen po dang / /lha 'dre gdug pa can gnas na/ /sa dpyad bzang yang ngan dgu 'byung / /drag sngags la sogs bsgrub pa na/ /sa gzhi shin tu gnyen pa dang / /gnas bdag gdug pa che na 'grub//de gnyis bye brag shes par gyis//khyad par ri khrod sa cha ni//rgyab ri sgom chen 'dra ba dang / /skyil krung bcas 'dra'i pang du bzang / /gsas mkhar lha tho brtsegs pa'i sa/ /ri yi rtse la brtseg mi brtseg/ /gzhi bdag len dang mi len yod/ /de phyir rtse ru brtseg mi bya/ /ri yi rtse lkog dkyil tsam gyis/ /sa dgra med cing sa dpal bzang / /de ru brtseg la nyes 'gal med/ /maṇḍal mchod 'bul tshul du 'ong //de rnams phyi yi sa dpyad yin//de nas nang gi sa dpyad ni//sgo ni shar du btsugs pa yi//sgo them shar gyi stag skya bo//chu ra lho ru bzhag pa yi//lho yi g.yu 'brug sngon mo yin/ /thab kha nub bcas bya dmar mo/ /rang thag byang btsugs rus sbal yin/ /dkyil ka dbus kyi gser sprel te/ /khyim gyi srung bzhi tshang ba yin/ /khang brtseg gnyis byed pa na/ /gdung ma sbrul nag lto sbyor spang / /khang ba chung du 'geb na yang / /ka gcig rlung gi 'khor lo spang / /rtsig pa'i sna 117

dang gdung ma'i sna/ /gdung ma'i 'od tu nyal sa spang / /gzar kha phyir la bstan mi bya//khyim phug gsal na nor mi chags//khyim phug khung du mun nag bya//sgo them rgyab kyi sa mtho zhing / /nang du 'bo ba 'dra na bzang / /sgo them nang du yin them ni/ /thur du che na tshe la gnod/ /sgo yi g.yas g.yon steng la sogs/ /khrol mang bkal nas bzhag pa ni/ /'dre ngan phal cher khog par bshad/ /bya khri legs po bzos nas kyang //gzhu rnams steng du bkram bzhag na//dgra lha gnyen po 'khor ba yin//de rnams 'jig rten skye bo'i khyim//de nas ri khrod sgrub khang sa//sgo thod steng du mchig mi btsug/shar lho me lhar thab kha bca'//lho nub srin por mgon khang bya//nub phyogs klu ni gnas pa'i sar//rta phyugs dud 'gro btags sa bya//nub byang rlung lha gnas pa'i sar/ /rlung 'khor bskor dang gos gdang bre//byang phyogs gnod sbyin gnas pa'i sar/ /mdzod bya ja mar nas sogs bzhag /byang shar dbang ldan gnas pa'i sar/ /gzims mal gra khri bca' bar bya lung mda'i phyogs su sngas mi bya/ /de phyogs bla ma bzhugs pa'am/ /mdun du rten gsum gnas na rung / /lham dang gzhong par sngas mi bya/ /mal sked gdung mas bcad mi bya/ /spyir ni ri khrod khang pa'i tshang / /gru bzhi 'dom skor zhes bya ste/ /logs su bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho//bcu gnyis yin te khru brgyad do//logs gnyis bdun re bya ba ste/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni mtho re la/ /tshad ma'i mi yi khru phyed do/ /spong ba'i khang ba zhes bya'o/ /khang ba de yi gang skyid du/ /dang po mchod bshams byas nas kyang //thub pa'i sku bshams rten 'brel bya//khang pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o//de nas gcod kyi sa dpyad la/ /brag dkar rdza ri dkar po la/ /gtsang ma'i 118

lha rigs dkar phyogs gnas/ /brag ri sku gzugs mchod rten dbyibs/ /dbang phyug ling ga'i gzugs 'dug na/ /de ru gnas ri yod pa'i rtags/ /ye shes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnas/ /gnyan thog gcod par mi rung ngo / /nags ri sa sul mang po 'brel/ /yang na ri skam chu med pa/ /gnyan thog bcad kyang mi chod pa/ /ri sna chu sna lung ba'i sna/ /mang po 'dus pa'i sa mdo ru/ /gnyan thog bcad kyang chod dka' ste/ /gnas bdag sna 'dus mang ba'i phyir/ /re re chod kyang kun mi chor/ /brag dmar btsan la brag nag bdud/ /g.ya' ri na mtsho chu mig klu/ /spang ri phal cher gnyan gyi rigs/ /brag ri rgya bo the'u rang yin/ /brag dang ri rnams mtshungs pa ste/ /dgyes pa rgyab la rgur pa mdun/ /pho ri rtse sbom mo ri phra/ /ri ni lus la mtsho ni snying / /chu mig srog rtsa shing ni skra/ /glang bo'i spyi gtsug mi yi snying / /rta dang dud 'gro'i sgal ba'i thog /phar la non zhing sa dpal bzang /de ru gcod pa'i 'dug sa bya/ /de la gnyan mig zhes bya'o/ /phag 'dra'i sna dang sbrul 'dra'i lce/ /gcan gzan 'dra ba'i mche sder dang / /rwa can 'dra ba'i rwa yi rtse/ /glang chen 'dra ba'i sna ljags rtse/ /ri yi sna dang brag gi zur/ /de la khram mig zhes bya ste//nad pa gdon chen mtha' gtad sa/ /nad med bsdad na nad 'byung sa/ /sgar dang ru ba la sogs pa/ /sa dgra med cing sa dpal bzang / /de 'drar bsdad na 'phral du bde//sbra gur cog bu'i sgo phyogs kyang //chu dpal lam dpal bzang por gtad/ /gal te sa dgra 'dug pa na/ /de phyogs dpe cha rten gsum bzhag /gcod kyi sa dpyad le'u ste drug pa'o/ /sa dpyad le'u drug pa 'di/ /rgya gar lugs dang rgya nag lugs//gzhung mang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ /bcud bsdus mar gyi snying bo yin/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho pas/ /bskul phyir rā ga a su 119

yis/ /shing sbrul smin drug zla ba yi/ /dgong mo thun mtshams re re la/ /gang dran 'phral du smos pa rnams/ /rkarma bīrya nyid kyis bris/ /bco lnga'i nub par rdzogs pa ste//'di la 'gal 'khrul cha mchis na/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rnams la bshags//'di bris dge ba gang mchis des/ /'di la 'brel ba gang thob pa'i/ /yon tan mkhan rnams zhal gro zhing //sbyin bdag bkra shis bde legs shog /le'u bco lnga pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /mtshams gyi zhal gdams thar lam dkar po/0ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /mtshams kyi zhal gdams thar lam dkar po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru ma hā mu dra ye//bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' brgyud rnam thar ri khrod 'grim lugs ni/ /yid la shar kyang nyams su ma lon phyir/ /ci bzhin smra bar shes kyang smra mi spobs/ /rang gi lag blangs nyams su lon tshod tsam/ /rang 'dra'i skal dman gzhan la phan srid pas/ /'phral du yid la gang shar bkod pa ni/ /zhen log sgom gyi rkang ba yin pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad ni/ /bram ze'i mdun du bshang ba bzhag pa bzhin/ /zhen pa gting nas log pa gal che gsungs/ /'phral du zas gos gnas mal gal che yang / /zhag gcig sdod pa'i 'gron po'i bsam pa bzhin/ /yun ring mi thogs 'chi ba yid la bcang / /shi nas lha dang mi ru skyes na yang / /bde skyid mi rtag 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsams/ /bla med byang chub 120

'bras bu ma gtogs pa/ /'khor ba'i bde skyid gang la'ang yid mi smon/ /de ni 'khor bar zhen pa ldog lugs yin/ /dper na sngon gyi bka' gdams pa kun gyis/ /do dgong 'chi bar dogs nas me mi gso/ /de don chos la brtson 'grus bskul phyir yin/ /nam yang mi rtag myur du 'chi na yang / /lo 'ga' byang chub sgrub long yod phyir dang / /phyi ma bde chen zhing khams bgrod phyir du/ /tshe sgrub byas pas bya btang min mi 'gyur//dper na dwags pos sgrol dkar bsgrubs pa bzhin//de nas pha yul zhen pa'i 'khor shing ste//gnyen la gdung sems dgra la sdang sems 'phel/ /de phyir phag gru ras chen la sogs pa/ /pha yul spangs nas phyogs der ma phebs skad//'on kyang pha yul spangs pa'i mi yul du//chags sdang 'phel na pha yul de rang yin/ /pha yul yin yang chags sdang cher med na/ /ma spangs na yang bya btang min mi 'gyur/ /dper na mar dwags sa skya 'bri stag rnams//sa ming bla ma'i mtshan la thogs dang 'dra//pha yul mi yul gang na 'dug kyang 'dra/ /su la'ang mdza' ches mkhon ches spang bar bya/ /gnyen dang nye du 'khor ba'i bshal thag ste//ci yodagyin kyang mi mgu re 'khang mang //legs par dpyad na 'gro drug pha ma yin/ /de phyir nye dur ha cang gdung sems spang / /nye dur 'khon pa'ang bya btang ma yin te//chos la tshud na nye du thabs kyis bskor//des ni bstan dang nye du gnyis kur phan//dper na 'bri stag skya'i gdung rigs bzhin//rang drin yong tshe bu tsha drin du chug/su la su dgos mi shes bod 'bangs rnams//de skad gu ru padmas zhal chems gsungs//nor rdzas dgra bo'i g.yab mo sdug bsngal rgyu//med na thabs chag yod na dgra 'dre'i g.yab//ci tsam yod kyang mi skyol da rung (da dung /)'dod//de phyir zasanor sems kyi chags zhen spang / /121

dbul zhing phongs yang sdig pas nor mi sgrub/ /bkres nas shi yang ma byin len pa spang / /dper na mi las zwa la dka' thub bzhin/ /chu dang rde'u sa sogs bcud len bya/ /de ni 'dod pa'i mtha' ni spang ba ste/ /zas kyi phyir du mi dge spang ba yin/ /shugs kyis byung na spang yang mi dgos te/ /zas kyi rnal 'byor ldan pas gang byung spyod/ /chang dang bsngos sha gnyis ni dug ltar spang / /dge slong dge tshul zhus nas dgongs bcad bya/ /rgyun du gdan gcig thub na mchog yin no/ /zas zhim 'dod phyir sdig pas bsgrub pa dang / /ci 'dod yod kyang mi za dka' thub gnyis/ /gnyis ka gol sa yin par thub pas gsungs/ /de yang ha cang 'grang ches stogs ches spangs//'grang ltogs ran par bya bar mi las gsungs/ /zas kyi mchan nas nyer mkho gos yin te/ /gos kyi phyir du mi dge mi bsag cing / /ngan ngon lhag skyobs tsam gyis chog par 'dzin/ /de phyir ston pa rab tu byung ba'i dus/ /gser srang brgya phrag ri ba'i gos spangs nas/ /phyag dar khrod pa'i gos ni bsnams pa yin/ /shugs kyis rnyed na ched du mi spang te/ /gser srang brgya phrag ri ba'i gos rnyed kyang / /dge slong rnams la gyon par gnang ba yin/ /de yang dmar dang ser dang ngur smug las/ /rgya kha sngo ljang dkar po la sogs spang / /ci ltar snying nas bya btang yin gyur kyang / /chos gos rnam gsum lhung bzed spang mi rung / /chos gos snam sbyar chags tshad mi ldan spang / /'khar gsil chu tshags gding ba rnyed kyang bcang / /de rnams rnyed kyang yibacang rgeb be sogs/ /'dul khrims 'gal ba'i cha lugs byed pa ni/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs mdo dang / /yul 'khor skyong gi mdo las lung bstan bzhin/ /dkon mchog 'bangs sogs yab sras rnams kyis bkag /zas gos 122

'dzoms nas spang dka' gtam yin te//bstod pa thos na nga rgyal sems 'phang mtho/ /nga rgyal de ni thar pa'i bar chad yin/ /bstod 'os med par bstod na bsod nams 'dzad//shi ba'i tshe na snyan grags rjes mi 'brang //de phyir bstod ra byung kyang dga' ba spang / /ngan smras byed pa thos na khong khro skye/ /de dus ngo bo bltas na bogs su thon/ /ma nyes ngan smras byung na sgrib pa 'dzad/ /de phyir ngan smra byung kyang dga' ba bsgom/ /dag 'don mi bya lta ba'i klong du bskyur/ /gal te bstan pa'am rang gi chos rgyud la/ /gnod pa'i skur 'debs yin na dag bya gsungs/ /de nas ri khrod 'grims pa'i gnas bshad pa/ /dang po dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin brlabs shing / /bar du o rgyan chen pos zhabs kyis bcags/ /rim par grub chen rnams kyis ngos bzung ba'i/ /rtsa ri'i gnas lag gnas phran du gtogs pa'i/—/gnas chen brgya rtsa gnas phran stong rtsa gnyis//de dag rnams su zhag gcig bsgrub pa de//gzhan du lo gcig bsgrubs las lhag pa ni/ /lung bstan bka' rgya ma las gsungs pa'i phyir//de 'drar sgrub gnas byas na mchog tu bsngags//de lta min kyang bka' rgyud gong ma yis//sgrub gnas sam ni zhabs kyi bcags pa'i gnas/ /de 'dir bsgrub dgos sgrub thabs kun nas gsungs/ /de yang gnas nyams gnas 'khreb spangs bya ste/ /dang po gnas de byin rlabs ldan gyur kyang / /dam nyams sdom nyams mang bos spyod ngan gyis/ /gnas la grib phog nyams len 'phel skyed med//rtogs pa mchog thob nus par ldan yin na/ /tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg rab gnas byas pa yis/ /gnas nyams sor chud nyams rtogs 'phel mod kyi//gsar bu nyams rtogs dma' ba 'dug mi bya/ /gnas 'khreb la yang rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /gnas sgo ma phyed phye dus 123

rten 'brel 'chug/gnas bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shin tu rtsub//ting 'dzin drod nyul cho 'phrul ci yang ston/ /rtogs pa ma thon bogs thon dngos grub 'thob//dper na mi la ling pa'i brag bzhugs bzhin//rtogs pa dma' na bar chad srog dang 'bral/ /dper na spu bo'i rma yi rkyang lung bzhin/ /gnas dang dgon sde ri khrod la sogs pa/ /dang po bkra shis byin rlabs ldan gyur kyang / /bar skabs spyod pa ngan pas dam sri zhugs/ /su bsdad bkra mi shis shing bar chad rgod//nus pa ldan pas sri mnan byin 'bebs bya//de min gsar bu bsdad na bar chad 'khyer/ /de ltar gnas rnying rnyed par ma gyur na/ /pha yul mi yul skabs su gang babs kyi/ /yul gyi dpon dang gzhi bdag chos ladaga'/ /khyad par sa de'i bdag pos bka' gnang dgos/ /de min dge slong yin na ltungab che/ /mthun rkyen 'dzoms shing sa dpal bzang ba'i sa/ /khang pa rnying pa'am ni gsar du brtsigs//gnas ri bzang po'i sa sna gang rnyed btab//de yis sa gzhi rab gnas byas dang 'dra/ /yab sras la sogs bla ma'i zhabs rjes bshams/ /des ni sa de zhabs kyis bcags pa dang / /khyad par med pa mgon po'i rgyud nas gsungs/ /thog mar khyim mam gnas de'i gar skyid sar/ /thub dbang sku dang glegs bam mchod pa bshams//spyan 'dren la sogs sa gzhi byin brlabs ltar/ /bka' gdams lugs kyi sa gzhi byin brlabs yin/ /de nas sa gzhi gser gyi rdo rje ni//rgya gram sra shing brtan pa'i lte ba na//me tog pad ma'i sdong po chen po skyes//pad ma'i 'dab mas sa phyogs de kun khyab//de steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du hriḥ //de las rang nyid thugs rje chen bo ni//'gro 'dul dkar po phyag bzhi gzhung ltar bsgom/ /sa phyogs de yi lha 'dre mi gsum la/ /byams dang 124

snyingarje thun gcig bsgom byas pas/ /thams cad 'dus nas dad cing gus pa yis//yig drug 'don cing phyag dang bskor ba byed//yul phyogs 'di yi rtswa shing chu dang sa/ /ci dgar spyod ces lha 'dres phul bar bsam/ /de ltar min na ma byin len du 'gyur/ /de ni ri chos lugs kyi byin rlabs yin/ /de nas khang pa gsar brtsigs yin na ni//sa bslang lto 'phye dkyil 'khor dus bzhin bya//khang rnying yin na dkar bgegs gtor ma bshams/ /dkar gtor gnas bdag gnyug mar gnas la bsngo/ /gnas 'di bdag la g.yor dang byang chub bsgrub/ /bdag gis dge rtsa'i cha shas khyod la sbyin/ /nged rang gnyis ku'i don du chos spyod pas/ /'di la phrag dog ma byed sdongagrogs mdzod/ /ces brjod gtor ma rgyab ri'i phyogs su 'bul/ /de nas bgegs gtor bgegs rigs spyi dang ni/ /khyad par yul 'dre gnas 'dre rnams la bsngo/ /bdag gis 'di ru byang chub bsgrub pa la/ / khyed rnams sdang sems bar chad ma byed dang / /nam zhig bdag gis byang chub thob pa'i tshe/ /khyed cag rnams kyi sdug bsngal sel ba dang / /bde skyid thams cad bdag gis bsgrub par bya//ces brjod bgegs kyi gtor ma phyi la dor/ /de nas bum par sme brtsegs rnam 'jom sa sogag /gzungs sgrub byas pa'i chu yis me long ngos//khang bde la phyi nas khrus gsol bya//nang du gzungs chu gtor zhing spos kyis bdug/khang pa stong par lus tshe gdon zhugs sam//ro grib la sogs yod kyang de yis sangs/ /de nas khang pa swā bhā'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las seng khri pad zla'i steng / /hūṃ las byung ba'i rna ma par snang mdzad ni/ /dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /bskyed nas spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ /mchod bstod byas te 'od zhu khang bar 125

gyur/ /de ni gnas dang khang ba byin brlabs yin/ /bde mchog rgyud las sgrub pa'i grogs la ni//bud med ḍā ki'i mtshan ldan dgos gsungs pa//grub chen tsa rlung rang dbang thob rnams yin//pad 'byung dril bu pa dang mar pa bzhin//so so'i skye bo rab tu byung rnams kyis/ /bud med phyogs su nye bar mi bya ste/ /kha0 par yud tsam bsdad kyang ltung ba yin/ /de phyir ri khrod them pa'i nang nyid du/ ka'aja' lus ḍā ki'i lha mo ma gtogs pa/ /mi yi bud med byung na bka' chad thong //ces brjod chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo bya//sgo rtsar tho brtsegs de don kun la bsgrags/ /'di ni gal che shin tu gnad che'o/ /gsang ba spyi yi rgyud la4 sgrub pa'i g.yog /rgya cher gsungs kyang de yi don bsdu na/ /bla ma gzhan la datshwa tshig chags pa dang / /sdom pa shor dang dme pho mdze can dang / /rang gi cho sa lugs bla mar log lta can//smyo nad can dang sdig can sgrub g.yog spangs//dad ldan chos dang yon tan don du gnyer/ /gcong nad zha grum sogs med g.yo sgyu chung / /gang smras nyan pa'i sgrub g.yog bsten par bya/ /sgrub g.yog ngan pa nam yang mi bsten te/ /nye gnas mchog gyur shes rab brtson 'grus yin/ /gcig pur rang tsho thub na chos pa rab/ /de nas sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sta gon ni/ /gnyen 'dun sogs la re ba mi bca' bar//thub pas gnang ba'i bsod snyom4 sgrub rgyags yin//ba sod snyoms bzang po byung bar chags pa spang //ngan nam po byung na yang khong khro spang / /rnyed dang ma rnyed sems kyis ro snyoms shing / /sbyin 'bras byang chub 'thob pa'i bsngo smon bya//bung ba lta bu grong du rgyu gsungs pas//dper na bung bas me tog bzang ngan la/ /chags dngasdang ba'i bsam pa mi byed cing //me tog kha dog dri la mi gnod par//sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'jib tshang du 126

'grob ltar//gang rnyed khyer te sgrub pa'i gnas su 'gro//rang nyid nges par chos dngamathun gyur na/ /bsod snyoms chos rgyags phongs par mi 'gyur te/ /shāka thub mngon par sangs rgyas thob snga bas/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal lnga brgyar skye dgos pas/ /bsod nams ma mkho nyan thos 'tsho bar bsngos//de phyir 'bru dang mu tig mnyam brjed kyi/ /mu ge byung yang 'tsho bas mi phongs gsungs/ /de nyid sems 'chang sgrub rgyags sems khral spang //'on te sngon gyi sbyin 'bras khyad par gyis/ /spyi dang mi mtshungs rang nyid bkres gyur na//sgab 'dre med cing sgrub rdzas mi dka' ba'i/ /ye shes pa yi nor lha cung zad bsnyen/— /de ni rung bar gnyam med dwags pos gsungs/ /gdams ngag nges shes med par sgrub brtson pa/ /gegs dang gol sa 'byung ba'i rgyu yin spang //dbang lung ma thob sgrub pa byed pa ni/ /chu bshigs mar 'dod 'dra ste 'bras bu med/ /byin rlabs cung zad byung yang ngan song rgyu/ /de phyir dbang khrid man ngag rdzogs pa gces/ /de nas sgrub pa'i sta gon bya ba ni/ /'byor ba che zhing shes rab ldan pa na/ /sgrub chen cha lag thams cad tshang bar bsags/ /'bring la sgrub phran tha ma spros med lugs//rang gi 'byor pa shes rab dag dang dpag /gnas derabyin nas zla shas tsam gyi bar/ /chu shing la sogs mthun rkyen sgrub —pa'i tshe//thag ring mi 'gro ldog mtshams tshul du bya/ /de nas rang gis rang la khrid btsugs te/ /dpe cha yod na khrid dpe bla ma'i tshul/ /khrid dpe med na yid kyis gsal 'debs shing //dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa bzhi/ /re re la yang zhag po gsum mam bdun/ /nges shes skye zhing snang ba 'gyur nges bsgom/ /de bzhin skyabs sems rdor sems maṇḍalarang / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor 127

khyad par sngon 'gro bzhi/ /re re la yang zhag po bdun re tsam/ /re re la yang rtse gcig phur tshugs bsgom/ /de nas sgrub pa'i sna sel bya ba ni/ /bsangs dang tsogator phyag dang bskor ba dang / /sā tstsha zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' bklagasogs/ khe re'ang nyin re tsam re gang thon 'bad/ /de nas sgo rtsar tho ni dkar /po brtsegs/ /gzhi bdag dkar gtor phul la bka' bsgo ni/ /bdag gis mtshams sgrub mtha' ru ma thon par/ /phyi yi bar chad nang du ma btang la/ /na4 gi dngos grub phyi ru ma btang bar/ /gnas mgron gnyis kyi dam tshig srungs zhes brjod/ /bgegs gtor rgyas par btang zhing bgegs bskrad de/ /rdzas rgod dam ni gu gul dud pas bdug /'di skabs mtshams rdel 'jog dgos yod na ni/ / shog gur ming bris rde'u gtums nas ni/ /rang mdun bzhag la mi de yin par bsgom/ /mtshams g.yog gtug dgos yod na mdun der bzhag /de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal bar bsgom//rang nyid khrus byas male gos spos kyis bdug / gdan 'og g.yung drung dkar po g.yas 'khyil bri/ /mal sa spo dang gdan sprugs mi rung phyir/ /legs par gegs sel bdud rtsi thig pa las 'byung ltar srung 'khor drug rims sam yang na dgu rims sogs ma nor bar bsgom pa gnad che gsungs/ mchan/gzab nas bcos mi dgos par bya/ /gnas khang de ni yi dam gzhal yas khang /malastan seng khri pad ma zla ba'i gdan/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal rdor skyil bca'/ /sgrub pa ci tsam 'dug pa'i dam bca' bzung / /dam bca' ring na bdud kyi bar chad 'jug /dam bca' thung bcug don la ring du bsring / /mtshams bsdam na sa ni yun ring ma song skabs/ /nye du yon bdag da pon rigs la sogs la/ /glo bur nad dang gdon gyis nye bar 'tshe/ /da res 'byon dgo4128

galate ma byon na/ /kha gtam med dam bsdig rgyu yong skad zer//nan che lus che tshig rting mna' yis mthud//de ni bdud kyis nyam sa tshad glags lta yin//re ba che'am btsan po yin kyang rung //de yi ngo bzlog mi 'gro gal che ste//de dus song na bar chad kyis 'khyer bas//nam yang sgrub pa lam du 'gro mi srid/ /nye du brtse ba shi chad byung na yang / /bsngo smon rgyas 'debs ma gtogs 'gro mi rung //rang nyid glo bur nad kyis btab na yang / /mtshams khang nang nas rtsa ston rung mod kyi/ /ci ltar thu yang mtshams ni mi klod de/ /shi yang mal stan steng der shi nus bya/ /de yis bar chad g.yul las rgyal ba ste/ /shi bar mi 'gyur bdud kyang kha skyengs 'bros/ /ro snyoms lugs dang gcod lugs ma yin pas/ /lha rjer mi ston sman ni mi za sogs/ /mi rung phung bor brnyas byed rtsa ltung yin/ /de nas ci ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /chos kyi dbang phyug zhal nas thos pa'i don/ /dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang nyams len dang / /dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang nyams len gnyis//chos kyi rjes 'brang paṇḍi ta yi lugs//byung na de nyid mchog tu gyur mod kyi/ /dad pa'i rjes 'brang ku sa li yi lugs/ /deng sang phal cher de nyid yin no gsungs/ /de lo'ang tha ma 'bring dang rab gsum ste/ /da bang lung thob kyang go ba shes rab dman/ tshed rim thob pas sems ngo srung shes tsam/ /dad ldan 'chi ba dran pas nyams len 'dod// tha na yi ge tsam yang mi shes pa//de 'dras dbang bo tha ma ri khrod 'grims shing mtshams sdoms na//tho rangs gnyid ni sad lothag pa'i dus//bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor dran//dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no zhes/ /gdangs dbyangs mi shes 'bod pa cher byed pa/ /gsol ba khyi skad ma ru 'debs zhes bya/ /de yis gnyid dkrogarig ba dang sa pa 129

dang / /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sems can bde ldan sogs/ /kun gyis shes3'ode la tshar gsum brjod//rang lus thugs rje chen por wal gyis bsgom//spyi boca bla ma 'od dpag med pa bsgom//ma nam bzhi skor de la tshar gsum 'don//yigodrug skad ni che chung ran par bzlas/ /sa phyogs de nyid bde ba can du mos/ /srog chags thams cad spyan ras gzigs su bsgom/ /de la sems gan4dmigs pa ma gsal bar/ /yig drug bzlas pa gzugs kyi bzlas pa'am/ /snangs ba sku yi khyer so zhes bya yin //'gro kun spyan ras gzugs su gyur pa des/ /ra tswagi ram bu bkyag bsam yig drug bzlas/ /de ni sga yi bzlas pa zhes bya'am/ kagrags pa gsung gi khyer so zhes bya ste/ /yig drug sgra la rig pa gtad pa yin//de yis bskyed rim don rtsa 'dus pa'o//de nas rang gi snying ga'i dkyil du ni//thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig bsgom/ /de la rig pa gnas su ci thub bya/ /ha cang mi 'phro de la sems gnas na/ /sems 'dzin zhi gnas don rtsa snol 'dus/ khe nas yid la ci yang mi bsam par/ /sems kyis sems la hrig ceding bltas 'khobazhag /gzugs dang kha dog dngos po ma mthong yang / /rnam rtog 'gyu ba thol thol skyes pa'i tshe//byung sa 'gro sa gnas sa rtsad gcod bya//ma rnyed de yi ngang go mnyam paragazhag /de yis lhag mthong donabo 'dus pa yin/ /de nas rgyunarwa rtsad gcod mi dgos te/ /nam dran dus su rang ngo cer gyis lta/ /ma mthong ngang la klod de shig ger gzhag /rnam rtog skyes na༄ dang rlabs bzhin du/ /sem4 las byung zhing sems kyi klong du thim/ /yig drug shub bur bzlas shing de nyid skyong / /nyi ma shar tsha brgya phyag 'ga' zung 'tshal/ /thug pa la sogs zas kyi spyod lamatso/ /de nas nam mkha' mthong zhing snang g.yel sar/ /sems ngo skyong zhing 130

yig drug bzlas pa bya/ /mos gus skye zhing nyams kyi 'char sgo dus/ /gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod lan gsum tsam re bya/ /dgongs bcad yin nam gdan gcig srung ba na//rang gi snying gar spyan ras gzigs bsgom nas//de la mchod pa'imos pas gung tshigs bya/ /slar yang skyabs sems la sogs da nangs bzhin//nyi nub bar du thun gcig byas la bsgoms//lus la bad gan la sogs nad yod na//ka ba'i ngos la dpe'am sku 'dra bzhag/bskor thag thung na mgo yu 'khor nas 'gyel/ /cung zad rgyang nas bskor ba nyi shu tsam/ /mun rug nas ni srod kyi mtshams de la//badzra gu ru badzra phaṭa la sogs//lha bsgom mi dgos sems ngo'i ngang la bzla/ /de nas slar yang da nangs ci bzhin du/ /rgyang 'bod nas bzung rim bzhin thun gcig bsgom/ /de nas shes na ku sa li yi ni/ /tshogs gsog ngag tu mi dgos yid kyis bsgom/ /rkang dung gsum bus phaṭa sgra 'ga' zung rgyab/ /gal te lus sbyin dmigs pa mi shes na/ /phaṭa sgra rkang dung la sogs mi bya'o/ /thun mjug de la bsngo smon gang shes bya/ /snying gar bla ma yi dam ngo bo ni/ /thig le dkar po shel gyi kha dog can/ /'od kyis khong pa'i nang kun gsal ba la/ /rig pa gtad la yig drug shub bur bzlas/ /rtseg bu'am seng ge'i nyal stabs gang bde bya//ma gnyid bar du nyams len skyong byas pas//des ni rmi lam 'od gsal zinalar sla/ /lo zla la sogs ring thung ci 'dug kyang / /nyin gcig bzhin du nyams len byed lugs gcig/de ni rmongs pa tha mal pa yi mtshams//de bas shes rab cung zad drag pa na/ /gtor bsngos pa yi gtor ma gang 'dzom bca'/ /tho rangs gnyid ni sad pa'i de ma thag/sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor rgyas bsdus gang rung 'don/ /sgrol dkar la sogs tshe sgrub gang shes de/ /dbang po 'bring gi 131

nyams tshul/ mchan/ phreng skor gnyis gsum yan chad ci nus bzlas/ /rgyal ba tshomatsho la sogs gsar ma yi/ /yi dam gtso bo gang yin mngon rtogs sam/ /'od 'bar la sogs rnying ma'i las byang zhig/bton la nyi shar bar du bsnyen par bya/ /denas ja'am thug par me 'bud cing / /brgya las mi nyung phyag 'tshal ltung bshags sogs//nyes ltung gang yod dran cing bshags pa bya//shes na gtor ma cha bcu dzam gtor btang //de nas ja thug gang yod la spyod cing //skabs der grub thob gong ma'i gsung 'bum mam/ /sems la phan pa'i dpe cha gang yang rung / /mang po ma yin ldeb ma gsum bzhi blta/ /slar yang da nangs bzhin duthun bzung ste/ /dgong ku'i bar du de yi bsnyen pa bya/ /de nas ja sogs gang yin me btang la//chos spyod gang shes brjed dogs 'don res dang //mdo sgrub seng gdong bdud bzlog chagasamed bya/ /nyi nub mi rnams khyim du song skabs der/ /rang gi chu len dgos na rku thabs blangs/ /de nas phug gtor gsos dzeebran byas te/ /rnying ma yin na las byang slar la wig('don) /gsar ma yin namadun bskyed tshang bar 'don//chos skyong las byang shes na de la sbyar//mi shes na yang gtor bsngos gang shes bya/ /gcig pur chom rkun gcan gzan gnod dogs na/ /gtor bsngos tshe der rnga brdung rgyun du bya/ /de yi gcan zan mi 'ong rkun pos rtsi/ /dogs pa med na rnga brdung mi bya ste/ /sngags nag mig ltos yin pas legs rgyu med//de nas rgyas par lus sbyin shes pa'am//mi shes ku sa li yingatshogs gsog bya//de dag rnams kyi bar skabs thams cad du//yi dam bsnyen pa chu bo'i gzhung ltar bzlas/ /bskyed rim dang ni sems ngo res mos bya/ /de la goms nas zung 'jug e 'ong blta/ /nyal kha bdag bskyed bsdu ba'i dmigs132

rim de/ /bsgom nas sems ngo'i steng du bzhag nyal bas/ /'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gdams pa de nyid yin/ /de las lhag tsam shes rab yod pa'i rigs/ /gnyid ni sad ma thag tu nam mkha' nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros ḍā ma ru 'khrol bas/ /gnyid ni sad pa yin pa'i mos pa bya/ /kha ma bshal bar sngags mi bzla gsungs pas//gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i bum chu'i sngags chab blangs//de nas bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin sogs/ /ngag gis byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba'am/ /dbyangs gsal lan gsum brjod pas chog pa ste/ /de nyin bzlas tshad dung phyur 'gyur du gsungs/ /dmigs pa lce ni ral gri rab rno ba/ /yu ba pad ma dkar bo hiḥ sa mtshan pa//bsgoms pas ngag mnan la sogs nyes skyon sel//de nas sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor byed pa'am//skyabs 'gro sems bskyed snang ba 'gyur nges bya//de nas gtum mo la sogs dmigs rim gyis//rlung ro bus shing bum can thun gcig bsgom/ /de yis khams dngas nad sel tshe yang ring / /de nas sgrol dkar tshe dpag la sogs pa//tshe sgrub gang shes bsnyen pa rab zhig bya//mang nyung rang la dgayogs yod med bstun//de nas rtsa ba'i yi dam gang yin gyi/ /gsar ma yin na bdag bskyed tshar gcig dang / /rnying ma yin na bdag mdun zung 'jug gi /las byang tshar gcig dzabya dgongs yan chad 'don/ /de nas nyi shar bar du bsnyen pa bya/ /de yang gsar ma yin na bdag bskyed bsdu/ /zung 'jug skur ldang thun mtshams spyod pa ste/ /ja thug bskol sogs bya ba gang dgos bya/ /nub tu kha bltas bde chen zhing khams ni/ /'od dpag med pa gtso 'khor mngon sum ltar/ /yid kyis gsal btab brgya phyag 'tshal ba 'am ha cang mi mang 'ga' zung 'tshal ba na//dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na 133

mo mji shrī ye/ na mo su shrī ye/ /na mo u tta ma shrī ye swā hā/ /gcig brjod phyargo gcig 'bum gter 'gyur ba yin/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs 4 dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 4 'tshal lo/ /de ni zhing der skye ba'i rgyu yin la/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhig gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa 'i sangs rgyas kun nas 'og kyi rgyal po me 'od rab tu gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la phyag 'tshal dkor sgrib byang ba yin/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po kun tu gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig pa'i rgyal po mchog lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de gsum re rer phyag re 'tshal na yang / /gaṅgā'i klung ni drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas mtshan brjod cing / phyag 'tshal ba dang bsod nams mnyam mo zhes/ /'jam dpal zhing bkod mdo dang pad dkar mdo//phyag rdor dbang bskur rgyud las gsungs pa yin//dka' tshegs med par bsod nams rgya chen po/ /thob thabs shes na mi de mkhas pa yin/ /mdun gyi ka bar dpe cha'am sku gzugs bcings//āo na mo bha ga wa te raṇḍa ke turā dzā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/a rtate/saṃ myagla gudha ya/ta rya thā/māṃ ra ra ma hā ra ratna bi dza ye sru hā/da nangs lan gcig brjod par byas nas༄smra'i / chab gsil la sogs langs 'dug byed pa'i tshe ka ba de la bskor ba 'ong bar(yong bar ) bya/ /bskor ba gcig gis bskor ba 'bum ther 'gyur/ /de bzhin chab gsil gtang bar bya ba'i tshe/ /rang lus gser gyi bum pa chen po nas/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs yi 134

dwags dri chu la/ /dga' ba thams cad ngoms shing tshim bsam la//māṃ āḥ mu tra ā ha re bhyaḥ swā hā/ /yi dwags dri chu 4 longs spyod pa rnams tshim par gyur cig /ces brjod de bzhin dri chen 'dor ba'i tshe/ /dri ma zas tshogs phun sum tshogs par bsams/ /māṃ āḥ biṣṭha ā ha re bhyaḥ swā hā/ sarba pre ta rna kha kha khā hi/ yi dwags dri chen la longs spyod pa rnams tshim par gyur cig /ces brjod dri chen dri chu'ang tshogs su 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar dros de la dzam gtor sogs/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa'am ni rgyas par gtong / /klu thebs yod na klu gtor gang 'grub btang / /klu ni ldog dus phan las gnod pa che/ /de nas snga dro'i bza' btung tshar ba dang / /slob gnyer bris dang dpe ltas cung zhig bya/ /bskyed rim brtan na cho ga wig ('don)mi dgos/ /bskyed rim dmigs pas gsal 'debs kho nas chog /mi gsal na ni bdag bskyed slar la yig('don) /de nas bsnyen pa ci 'grub cung zad bya/ /gdan gcig dgongs bcad la sogs yin pa na/ /mdo ltar phud mchod chang bu la sogs bzhag /sngags ltar yi dam lus dkyil gsal btab nas/ /lte 'og gtum mo ye shes me yin la//kha ni thab khung lce ni mame lce yin//lag pa dgang gzar blugs gzar rang byung ste/ /de ltar bsgom rgyu ma— yin shes pas chog /zas rnams sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam/ /lus kyi lha la sbyin sreg 'bul bar dmigs/ /yi dam sngags kyang yid kyis bzlas shing bza'/ /de ni nang gi sbyin sreg ces bya ste/ /sbyin sreg go yang chod par gsungagapa yin/ /oṃ a spi te hūṃ phaṭaḥ bzlas pa'i chu yis chab kyang blangs rung zhing / /bgegs kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i mchog tu gsungs/ /de min sgrub tshe chu yis kha mi bshal/ /mtshon rtse kha ru mi bcug lce mi za/ /me la phu mi bya bar sbud pa tshags/ /skra dang 185

sen mo'i rtse yang mi bregs gsungs//gzungs chu min pa'i chu yis lus mi bkru/—/byin brlabs tshogs 'khor la sogs ma byas pa'i//sha chang sgog pa la phug mi gsungs/ /de tsho ngag nus che ba'i dam tshig lags/ /ngag nus 'dod pa med na 'gal ba chung / /sha chang sgog pa la phug la sogs pa/ /tshogs 'khor byas nas zos na nyes pa med/ /de rnams rgya gar ku sa li yi lugs/ /bod yul sgom chen rnams kyi mtshams kyi lugs/ /dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang zhes bya'o/ /denas dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang ni/ /mkhas pa paṇḍi ta yi nyams len te/ /dbang lung mang thob de rnams phyag len shes/ /thob dang shes pa tsam du mi bzhag par/ /gsar rnying rgyud sde kun la nyams len byed//nyams su blangs tsapo ma yin rtags thon byed/ /rgyun du nyams len gcig tu ma nges te/ /sgrubs gagang yin phyag len theb nges byed/ /de yang rab 'bring tha ma gsum yin te/ /rab ni shes rab 'byor pa gnyis ka 'dzom/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas dang sgrub g.yog thabs mi chag /rnying ma yin na sgrub chen rgyas pa ni/ /sngags rgyun ma gtog4 tham sa cad gzhung ltaraco/ /dus gibazhi 'am gsum mam nyin mtshan gnyis/ / gzhung bsrang de man dzaza kyi bsnyen pa bya/ /ha cang mi bsring zla ba gcig tsam ste/ /phyi yi rgyal tho sgo byang mi bsdu bzhag /nang gi dkyil 'khor bsdu chog gzhudza3 bzhin bya/ /gsar ma yin na dkyil 'khor sa thig sogs/ /dkyil 'khor la4 rim sgrub mchod bzhin du bya//zla gcig tsam la bdag mdun bsnyen sgrub bya//go nasamajug tu bdag 'jug blang bar bya/ /de nas rjes chog dkyil 'khor bsdu chog bya/ /gsar ma rnyingaca' bsgrub pa gang yin kyang / /mjug der las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rgyas par bya/ /de yis lhag chad kha bskong dngos grub 'byung / /de naso'i136

zhag bdun tsam la spros med bya/ /lus dkyil bsgom la rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor sbyangs/ /de nas zhag bdun tsam la ngal bso tshul//shin tu spros med sems ngo kho na skyong / /de yis rnying lugs yo ga rnam gsum dang / /gsar ma'i lugs kyi spros bcas spros med dang / /shin tu spros med bskyed rdzogs nyams len tshang / /skabs der bsngo ba smon lam rgya cher bya/ /de nas yang ni dkyil 'khor gzhan zhig la/ /snga ma bzhin du thams cad rdzogs par bya/ /de bzhin yi dam chos skyong mtho thog la/ /bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa nyams len lag tu len/ /rgyud sde chen po kun gyi bsnyen sgrub them/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i khrid kun zhar la rdzogs/ /shi yang 'gyod med skal ba bzang po yin/ /ma shi ma 'ongs slob ma byung na yang / /sgrub pa phyag len byin rlabs brgyud par ldan/ /sgrub pa'i bstan la phan pa chen po yin/ /'bring ni sgrub chen rdzas dang yo byad dkon/ /ras bris tshom bu bum pa gtor ma sogs/ /sgrub phran so so'i gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar/ /sgrub chen gyi ni kha gsab mi byed par/ /las byang sgrub gzhung gnyis po rkyang par byed/ /gsar ma yin na bdag bskyed kha rkyang la/ /thun bzung bsnyen pa bya ba ma gtogs pa/ /yi dam rigs la dkyil 'khor mi dgos so/ sgrub pa rdzogs nas spros med la sogs kyi/ /nyams len bya tshul gong dang mtshungs pa yin/ /tha ma dbang lung man ngag kun thob kyang / /blo sna mi mang gcig la dril 'dod pas/ /sna mang mi bsgrub sgrub pa gcig la 'bad/ /lha gcig sngags gcig sgrub thabs gcig gyur kyang / /sgrub pa gcig la zla gcig phan mi bsring / /de nyid rdzogs bcug sbyin sreg bsngo smon bya/ /slar yang spros med byed tshul gong dang 'dra/ /de nas spros bcas spros med bsgrub pa rga /lan grangs du mar wig('don) ni bsgrub pa ste/ /ci ltar skal ba med pa'i mi 137

yin kyang / /lan bdun lan dgu la sogs wig('don) gyur na/ /mi 'grub mi srid gsungs pa'i gnad yin te/ /de la spogs pa'i cho ga zhes bya'o/ /sgrub pa gcig la yun ring bsring gyur na/ /lus ngag yid gsum je lhod btang snyoms 'gyur/ /rtags kyang mi gsal bgegs kyang 'jug nyan che/ /bsnyen sgrub dal drag yun thung byas pa yi/ /sun par mi 'gyur spro ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /spros bca4 spros med res mos byas pa yi/ /gcig bogs gcig gis thon te nyams rtogs 'phel/ /de rnams chos kyi rjes 'brangs mkhas pa'i lugs/ /de ltar mtshams ni byed pa'i dus dag tu/ /sgrub chen yin na rgyal tho phan chad dang / /sgrub phran yin na dril bu'i skad thos phan/ /song na bar chad 'ong bas shi na tu 'dzem/ /sgrub chen sgrub phran song ba'i bar skabs sam/ /rdzogs rim spros med sgom pa'i dus dag gam/ /sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor la sogs med pa yi/ /bdag bskyed kho na bsnyen pa'i dus skabs su/ /pha ma mched grogs yon bdag la sogs pa/ /na'am shi'am ma 'gro ka med na/ /mun rug 'gro nas tho rangs tshur 'khor ba/ /de 'dra byed pa'i phyag grokhi sngar nas gda'/ /de tshe phyi rgyab mi la mi gtugs shing / /ngag mtshams yin na kho rang de ma gtogs/ /gzhan yang ngag ni bsre bar mi bya ste/ /'gro kha rang gi nyal sa mal gos nang / /dpe cha sku 'dra rang gi phreng ba bzhag /sgrub khang bdag bskyed gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ /gos dang mal sa bdag bskyed gtso bor bsgom/ /de nyid mi bsdu rtag tu bzhugs par dmigs/ /de yang rang nyid yin ba'i nga rgyal bskyed/ /de yi thugs las sprul pa'i gtso rkyang gcig / yin par bsgom nas rang nyid 'gro ba yin/ khabang dang byin rlabs 'pho 'debs gang dgos rung / /tshur la 'khor nas sgrub khang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgo 138

nas zhugs te nyal sar 'dug pa'i dus/ /bdag bskyed gtso bo'i thugs gar bdag zhugs nas//dbyer med gyur dmigs yi dam lha sngags bsham//yig brgya sbyar la de nub cung zad bzla/ /phyir nang bskang ba rgyas pa zhig 'don no/ /lar ni bsnyen sgrub byed pa'i mtshams la ni/ /tshur la mi yis mthong na bug pa zer/ /phar la mthong na ral ba zhes bya'o/ /phar la mthong ba thu ba yin no zer/ /ngag mtshams dam na rdul byang ma gtogs pa/ /ngag gtam kyang ni mi bya mchog tu shes//mtshams g.yog yi ge mi shes ngag gtam bya//kha nas rlangs pa shor bar ma gyur na//tshig 'bru gsal yang ngag mtshams go chod gsungs//mtshams g.yog de yis ngag gtam mi go na//phyed ngag zhes bya so ni bsgrigs nas gtam//des kyang ngag bcad phyogs gtogs go chod rtsi/ /spyir ni bsnyen sgrub gtso bor ston pa na//mi tshig bar ma chod par bzla' gsungs pas/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad ngag bcad bsnyen pa yin/ /ngag mchod na de yi sum 'gyur dgos/ /de phyir rnying lugs ngag ni 'khor yug gcod/ /gsar mar thun mtshams ngag ni btang bya ste/ /chags megathugs dam rim pa gzhan rnams dang / /zhal bsgos la sogs gang dgos byed srol snang / /rdzogs rim rtsa rlung sems ngo skyong sogs kyi/ /mtshams ni dam yang ngag gcod dgos pa min//de nas mtshams kyi dam bca' rdzogs pa dang / 'dzoms na sbyin sreg las bzhi rgyas par blugs//rgyal tho sgo byang dam yig yod na bsdu/ /bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas par bya/ /mi rnams ngo gtugs rab ni zhag bdun dang / /'bring la zhag lnga tha ma gsum mam gcig /thag ring mi 'gro gnas srung tshul du 'dug /de nas rang gzhan don du gar dgos 'gro/ /de yis mtshams kyi zhal gdams hrag bsdus tshang / /zhib par gol 139

sa gcod dang gegs sel dang / /bogs 'don rtags yig spyi ltar rim gyingasabashad/ /de skad shing sbrul glang zla'i yar tshe la/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho4bskul ba'i phyir/ /rā ga a phyes thun mtshams gsum la smras//yi ge pa'ang bī sau sā ga ra/ /blo chung 'ga' la phan thogs rgya cher shog/le'u bcu drug pa'o/ /margo/ lam̐//lus sbyin bdag 'dzin bcod pa'i sta re/tsho3ljiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ nyal kha ku sa li yi tshogs gsog bdag 'dzin gcod pa'i sta re bzhugs so//na mo pradzha pa ra mi ta ye//mtsho rgyal sprul pa rtog tshogs gtad med gcod/ /lab kyi sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas//lus sbyin ku sa li yi tshogs gsog bri//gnas gsum ḍā ki'i bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs/ /snyi rje'i dbang gis sa thob sems dpa' rnams/ /snying rje4dbang gis rang lus dngos su btang //dper na stag mor lus sbyin lta bu yin/ /sa thob min na dngos su btang mi nus/ /nus kyang mi rung gegs su 'gro bar gsungs//dge sdig gang yang bsam pa gtso che bas//yid kyis sbyin par bsgom pas bsod nams 'thob/ /sbyin pa'i nang nas lus sbyin mchog yin te/ /lus srog gnyis las 'phangs pa'i nor gzhan med/ /gcod lugs kho na nyams su len na ni//bdag 'dzin blos btang gcod dmigs kho nas 'thus//de ni gtso cher mdo yi dgongs pa ste/ /rang lus mi gtsang sha khrag phung po yin/ /'di ni 140

gtso cher lha sgom sngags bzlas shing //nub mo nyal kha gcod dmigs bsgom pa'i tshe//rang lus phung khams lha yi dkyil 'khor du//yin par ngo sprod gsal btab yeshes bstim/ /de nyid gtubs nas sbyin pa mi 'gal gnad/ /tha mal lus dbus dbu ma'i rtsa yi nang / /rang gi rnam shes thig le dkar po de/ /lus lha dbang lha tshe dang bsod nams dang / bsnyen sgrub byas pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu rnams/ /gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor byas te dmigs/ /dbu ma'i lam nas spyi bor rgyangs te 'phos/ /de nyid rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur te/ /gri gug tshad pas thod pa sgar gyis 'phar/ /bhan dha'i snod chen stong gsum mnyam par gyur/ /de nang gri gug rtse yis bem ro 'phangs/ /de la gri gug tshad tsam byas pa yis/ /sha khrag dmar ltem bhan rnya ltems se gang /oṃ doḥ& gsum brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dkar la dmar mdangs chags/ /ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan par bsams//mgron bsdus dbang sdud dmigs pa mi bya bar//mgron rigs thams cad dran rdzogs dmigs byas te//rang las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med kyis//bhan rnya'i skyogs kyis bdud rtsi de las bcugs/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod//de 'og yi dam de 'og mkha' 'gro mchod//de 'og chos skyong de 'og 'jig rten skyong / /sa steng sa 'og gnod byed gdon gyi tshogs//rigs drug sems can rang rang gar yod sar//sprul pa'i mkha' 'gros so sor tshims par mchod/ de ni ku sa li yi tshogs gsog ste/ /rang lus tshogs mchod 'bul ba sngags kyi lugs/ /khra 'gyed ces bya lus tshogs bsdus pa'ang yin//chos skyong drag po bsgrubs pas ma non tshe//mgron gyi gtso bor chos skyong de dmigs nas/ /de ltar bsgom pas chos skyong gnad la phebs//'khu ldog zhi bar 141

gu ru padma yi/ /ma ning bsgrub pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa yin/ /gong gi dmigs pa'i rjes su rnam shes ni/ /spar khrig('don) byas na legs shing ma byas kyang / /gong gi bdud rtsi'i lhag ma de nyid ni/ /sha ri khrag mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod bsams/ /de yang spre snum rlangs pa ma yal bar/ /phyi sha gzugs brgyad nang cha bu dgu rnams/ /re re la'ang brgya stong grangs med 'phro/ /gang la gang 'dod lha 'dres zos khyer bsgom/ /lhag ma nyal nyil dbang chung rnams kyi thob/ /de ni dmar 'gyed zhes bya mdo yi lugs//rnam shes spar ram de yi lhag ma la//dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i 'jig rten gang / /dmar la mi dgyes lha 'dre thams cad tshims/ /phud kyis sangs rgyas byang sems bya spyod lha/ /lhag mas gdon bgegs rigs drug bar do tshims/ /de ni dkar 'gyed rtsa ba mdor bsdus yin/ /'di la phaṭaḥ sgra ma gtogs 'don mi dgos/ /rnam shes spar ba gong dang mthun pa la/ /gnod byed lus gdon nad bdag phung bor bstim/ /rang gi thugs las spros pa'i ḍā ki ni/ /bya rgod khyung dang khra ta 'ug pa'i gdong / /phag khyi lce spyang stag gi gdong can tshogs/ /bhan dha'i skyogs kyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bcus/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su rgya bod grub thob mchod/ /de 'og 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mchod/ /de 'og dpal ldan mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /sku lnga mgon bo 55sga yum 'khor gyi tshogs/ /nag po stong tshogs sha za 'bum sde dang / /ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri yi tshogs/ /khrab chen bye ba dung phyur thams cad mchod/ /de nas lan chags gdon bgegs rigs drug mchod/ /'di ni mgon po'i ba—rten gtor bcas pa'i dus/ /zla shas rgyun bsnyen byas pa'i rmi lam du/ /'di ltar lasgom pas 'chi nges nad pa yang / /lo ni bcu gnyis tshe bsring nus 142

zhes 'byung / /'khrul pa'i rmi lam bden pa ma mchis kyang / /drung chen mkha' spyod pa yi mdzad pa yi/ /mgon po'i tshogs skabs nad par bstab pa yi/ /dmigs rim yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud zhig /rang gi pha myes rgyud la yod dang mthun/ /bsgoms pas gzhan la phan thogs myong bas grub/ /'dir ni don bsdus nyung ngu tshig gis bkod/ /de min gong gi dmigs rim tshan gsum po/ /gar phyin gar 'gro rnams su bsgom byas pas/ /gnyan thog brgya rtsa don gyi chod 'gyur cing / /dang po dbang sdud dmigs pa ma byas pas/ /tshar tshad slong tshad sgug nas sdod mi dgos/ /rjes gcod dmigs pa mi dgos 'gro bas chog /de skad gcod mkhan slob dpon rnams kyis gsungs/ /de yi ming la gnas 'brel zhes su grags/ /nges pa med par tshar slong rim gyis 'byung / /bar chad sel zhing nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i mchog /rang nyid glo bur nad kyis btab gyur ste/ /cho ga chos spyod 'don par mi nus skabs/ /dmigs pa de dag yid kyis brgya tshar bsgom/ /'don pa mi dgos gre khung pha ṭa brjod tsam/ /zhag re tsam nas 'phral du bde ba ni/ /lan grangs du mar myong bas grub pa yin//nad pa gzhan la dmigs pa byed pa'i tshe/ /bdag lus gzhan lus bsre nas rnam shes sbar/ /de ni phan thogs che ste rang la gnod/ /rang nyid lus po mi bde myong pas grub/ /so sor sbar nas rnam shes gnyis bsre 'bring / /so sor sbar zhing so sor mchod sbyin gyis/ /rang la gnod pa med pa myong bas grub/ /rang la snyems rtog yod med de dang bstun/ /glo bur dag tu ser bas brab byung na/ /sa rdo ri brag phag mo dmar mor bsgom/ /sku las me 'bar ser ba ser sprin bsregs//snang srid thams cad me ru 'bar bar bsgom/ /ma thub gnam sa gnyis po steng 'og brje/ /sa gzhi gdugs phub ri 143

rnams rtse thur bstan/ /nyi zla skar gsum 'og nas yar 'char bsam/ /dmigo pa gsal na mi thub srid mi 'gyur/ /thog bsrung rang gi spyi bo'i nam mkha' la/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa yi/ /lte bar shāka thub rtsibs stong sangaso rgyas stong / /de ni steng thog bsrung ba'i dmigs pa zab/ /rang gi rkang 'og g.yu yi drod pa zhig /nem me mnan par dmigs pas 'og thog srungs/ /phyogs mtshams rdo ra khro bo me ri'i gur/ /bsgom pas bar thog bsrung bar 'gyur pa yin/ /ni na ga dza mun ti ā/ /o rgyan rje dang rang byung rdo rje'i lugs/ /dran chog thog sngags lan bdun brjod pas thub/ /shog sngon gser gyis bris la sngagaso des sngags/ /sbra gur khang pa mi sogs btags pas thub/ /sgar sogs rnam g.yeng mi khom pa yi skabs/ /ha cang gal chen min pa'i char zhus byung / /klu sman sngags pa mtsho dang chu mig bskur/ /dkar gtong bsngos shing dkon mchog bden stobs brjod/ /klu dang yul lhar char 'bebs phrin las bcol/ /dngos gzhi gong ltar lus sbyin dmigs pa'i rjes/ /rang gi pags pas 'dzam gling khyab pa'i steng / /klu dang gzhi bdag char la dbang ba kun//khrom tshogs bzhin du phag mo'i 'od kyis bsdus/ /de la dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed lan mang byas/ /phag mos zil mnan char pa'i las la bskul//klu dang gzhi bdag lha 'dre thams cad kyi/ /bu ga dgu nas char zhod na bun 'gyur/ /'jig rten thams cad chu yi rang bzhin bsam/ /zhag gsum mi 'gor myur du 'babs par bshad/ /de 'dra lan mang myong bas grub pa yin/ /char dmigs mang yang 'di nyid kho na zab/ /tshar bkag dmigs pa'itsa ba de nyid la/ /phag mos zilasanan char bkag las la bskul/ /snang srid lha 'dre gzhi —bdag thams cad kyi// bu ga dgu nas me dpung 'u 144

ru ru/ /gnam sa me 'bar sprin dang char bsreg bsam/ /gong gi lus sbyin dmigs rim gsum gyi rjes//mgron rigs thams cad sems kyis byas pa bas//bkug kyang ma bkug 'ong ba med pa'i phyir/ /gshegs gsol mi dgos mi dmigs ngang la bzhag /nad pa yin na rang dang nad pa gdon/ /gsum ka gcig bsres nam mkha' gcig tu bsres/ /nam mkhas gar khyab sems kyis khyab pa dang / /sems kyis gar khyab chos skus khyab pa yi/ /lta ba'i gdengs byas nyams len ngang la gzhag /de ni bka' brgyud lugs kyi bsre ba ste/ /bsre ba zhu zhes zer mkhan mang srol yod//rang gi 'og ta grwa khal god dogs na//dud 'gro sha med keng rus skam po la/ /bu ga dgu nas me stag 'phro bar dmigs/ /de la lha 'dres mi 'tshe srung pa'i mchog /nad pa la sogs byin brlabs byed pa'i tshe/ /rang nyid skad cig dam pa rgya gar gsal/ /sku dang phyag las ye shes me mched pas/ /nad pa'i lus dang nad dang gdon kun bsregs/ /stong par gyur rjes kho la rig pa gtad/ /nyams len skyong ba gcod kyi byin rlabs yin/ /de ltar ku sa li yi tshogs gsog 'di/ /bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i thabs zab cing / /ri khrod gsar pa gnyan sa la sogs su/ /'di nyid med na lha 'dres sdod mi bcug /teng 'dzin drod nyul nyams tshad cho 'phrul ston/ /'di yod sa non lha 'dres sdong grogs byed/ /nad gdon cho 'phrul byung yang grogs su 'gro/ /ri khrod 'grim la 'di nyid med thabs med/ /de phyir ri chos 'di yi rgyab chos su/ /ku sa li yi rnal 'byor a rā gas/ /rta lo tha skar zla ba'i tshe bzhi yi/ /gung gi thun la ji ltar smras pa rnams/ /gcig pur sdod 'dod che ba'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /mi skabs sems rtsa brel yang 'bad nas bris/ /phyi rabs ri khrod 'grim pa'i nyam 145
