chur 'gar/ /snying gi nor mchog 'di 'dra bzhag yod do/ /ku su lu zhes bya ba ma dag ste/ /rgya gar skad du ku sa li zhes bya/ /bod kyi skad du 'du shes gsum pa zer/ /bza' btung 'du shes chu gcin 'dor ba dang / /gnyid pa gsum po snonyid ma gtogs pa//bya ba thams cad spangs nas ting 'dzin bsgom/ /de la deb sang ku su lu par grags//rgya gar ku sa li pa che chung gnyis//bod du 'das log ku su lu pa ste/ /don la bya btang ri khrod bzung tshad yin/ /ku su lu zhes bya ba'i sgra don no//le'u bcu bdun pa'o maṅga lam̐//tshe dpal bskyed byed tshe g.yang kha sprod/11〉〉ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ rang dang bla ma sbyin bdag sogs kyi tshe dpal bskyed pa'i gdams ngag tshe g.yang kha sprod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ārya tā re ye/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos zhus pa'i len//rang dang bla ma mched grogs sbyin bdag sogag/gal chen rnams kyi sku tshe bsrings pa dang //bar chad sel thabs rnam pa mang na'ang / /ye shes ngang ni 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /tshe 'phel lha mo gnyis kyi gdams pa zab/ /rgyas par spro na sgrol dkar cho ga 'don/ /'bring du mngon rtogs bsdus par dmigs bzlas sbyar/ /gtor ma 'bul zhing 'dod gsol bstod pa bya/ /bsdus par dmigs pa bsgoms shing sngags bzlas te/ /mjug tu bstod pa 'dod gsol tshad gcig brjod/ /dmig pa rang nyidasgol 146

dkar thugs ka ru//'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud bcas//de ni 'khor rgyu med de gdan thabs yin/ /yig 'bru thams cad langs te khrig ger gnas/ /thugs kur thugs srog ṭwāṃ yig dkar po'i mthar/ /gu ru badzra dha rmā dha tu dzha na ganta mam 'dir sgrub pa po gang yin ming bkod/ /ā yuḥ dzha na bu shka ku ru/ /sku tshe bsring pa'i don du de ltar ste/ /sarba pā pi sharnyi ku ru sogs/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi phyir de sbyar ba'i//ṭwāṃ yig mtha' ru 'dod gsolade yis bskor//de rgyab tt+waṃ gi g.yas i g.yon du hā//rtsibs brgyad steng du sngags kyi yig 'bru brgyad//tā re tutta re tu re swā/ /brgyad po mdun nas g.yas su skor de nas//de rgyab mu khyud rim pa lnga yod de/ /nang mar dbyangs yig bcu drug g.yon du bkod/ /de rgyab gsal byed yig 'bru g.yas su bkod/ /des kyang rten 'brel snying po g.yas su bkod/ /de rgyab rdo rje dkar po nas 'bru tsam/ /nyal ba'i phreng bas khrig ger bskor ba'o//de rgyab me ri dkar po sor gcig tshad//thams cad mu tig rdog po bsgrigs pa ltar/ /rang nyid sku lus me 'gyings drang por bsgom/ /de ni tshul khrims gtsang ba'i gdams pa zab/ /ye shes bskyed bstimarabang bskur la sogs pa//gzhung na gsal phyir 'dir smos ma dgos so//rang gisku yi 'od zer las grub pa'i/ /'khor lo dkar po yangs shing— rgya che ba/ /rtsibs bcu phyogs mtshams steng 'og rtsibs rtse bstan/ /rtsibs rnams ral gri so gnyis rtse ba zhin rno/ /de rgyab rdo rje dkar pa'i gur dang ni//me ri dkar bo bar med 'bar bar bsams/ /'khor lo'i nang ni stong ba rgya che ba/ /dper na spubs chol kha sbyor lta bu yi/ /dbus su rang nyid sgrol ma bsgom pa de'i//spyi bo'i thad du bsrung bya bla ma rnams/ /g.ya sa g.yon ma dun rgyab bsrung bya thams cad bsam/4 /'khor lo de yi 147

rtsibs brgyad stong pa'i nang / /steng 'og oṃ hā rtsibs brgyad yig 'bru brgyad/ /shin tu che ba me dpung 'bar ba'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs rtser gnod byed thul thul gcod/ /snga dro g.yas 'khor dgongs mo g.yon 'khor bsam/ /de ni srung dang bzlog pa'i khyad par yin/ /srod dang tho rangs dmigs pa thun re bsgom/ /de ni bdud dang 'phrad kyang mi pham gsungs/ /thugs ma'i 'khor lo 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ /nad gdon bar chad mun la zla shar bzhin/ /'od des sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/ /tshe yi dngos grub 'byung ba'i bcud kun bsdus/ /bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la thim par bsgom/ /oṃ tā re tutta re tu re gang byed mtshan sngags dang / ma ma ā yuḥ purnyetswa na puṣṭi ku ru swā hā/ /ces bablas thuno mjug dmigs med ngang la bzhag /ā li kā/li dbyangs dang rten 'brel bcas/ 4 /gsum mam bdun sogs rab gnas tshul du brjod/ /dpal ldan blo'ima'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / /zhes sogs brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad gang 'os brjod/ /yang ni skabs 'gar gong ltar skad cig bsgom/ /rang gi thugs las 'odasderari bar spros/ /dkar ser dmar sngo ljang dang mchin kha drug /'khor lo'i phyi rol guragasang drug tu 'gyur/ /sra shing brtan la rlung yang mi thar pa'i /bar rnams thams cad utpal sngon pos gang / /de rgyab rdo ra me ri sngar ltar bsgom/ /mthing ga sngon bo smug zhud can yin no//mchan/ rjes ma 'di la sngags bzlas mi dgos so/ /rang dang bla ma srung bya gang la yang / /bsgom du rung ba'i srung 'khor zab mo 'di/ /rgyud dang rgya gzhung man ngag du ma'i bcud/ /ke tshang lugs kyi gdams ngag zab khyad yin/ /'di yi 'jigs pa thams cad skyobs pu'i tshul/ /rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyuganas gsungs pa dang / /sgrol dkar rgya gzhung brgyad po 148

zhalamathun no/ /de phyir blo gtad thub pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /khyad par nad dang dgra dang dmag gis 'jigs/ /mdor na mi mthun gnod pa gang yang rung / /'jigs pa thams cad sel ba'i gdams ngag ni/ /sngon du bshad pa'i 'khor lo'i gur khang de//yangs shing rgya che gnam sa tsam du bsgoms//de nang sa gzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /bsrung bya thams cad mngon sum lta bur dmigs//rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ni/ /sgrol dkar skur gyur nam mkhar spyan drangs pa//kun gyi phyag g.yas bum pa dkar po thogs//bsrung bya rnams la bdud rtsi'i khrus gsol bas/ /nad gdon kun dag shel sgong lta bur gyur/ /slar yang rang thugs 'khor lo'i 'od zer ni/ /dkar po zla ba shar ba ltar 'phros pas/ /dgra dang 'jigs pa nad gdon gang yin kun/ /mun pa la ni zla ba shar ba'am/ /ba mor nyi zer phog ltar zhi bar bsgom/ /oṃ tā re tuṅgā re tu re nad gdogadagra yi 'jigs pa'am//'jigs pa che ge sharnyi ku ru swā hā//dmigs pa de nyad thun rer bsgom pa'am//gal chen zhag bdun mtshams byas de bsgom zhing //thun mtshams gtor ma bsngo zhing 'dod don gsol//'khor ba la sa sgrol ma yi bstod pa bya//rmi lam bar chad zhi ba'i rmis ltas dang //lung bstan la sogs nges pa can 'byung ste/ /de byung skyon med khag khur chog pa ni/ /kho bos lan grangs drug bdun myong bas grub//chu dang g.yang sa chom rkun la sogs pa//lam dgra yong sar 'gro ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /de thad nam mkhar sgrol dkar sku chen po/ /skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'i zhabs der 'gro bar bsgom/ /chu dang g.yang sa la sogs yin na ni/ /'og nas yar la skyor ba'i tshul du bsam/ /oṃ tā re tudhā re tu re chu dang g.yang sa chom 149

rkun gyi 'jigs pa shin ku ru swā hā/ /de byas lam dgras mi tshugs bde bar thar/ /dogs pa che bus lan mang myong bas grub/ /bal gtsang srung skud ring po zhig byas te/ /bzo mkhan bu mo mgo gtsang yod na mchog /a mṛ tra dang swa bhās bsangs shing sbyangs//mdud pa nyer gcig sgrol dkar nyer gcig bsgom//i tā re tu dhā re tu re 'di 'chang ba la chom rkun dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa las srungs shig rakṣa ku ru ye swā hā//de ltar brgya stong la sogs ci nus sngags/ /lha bstims rten 'brel snying bos rab gnas byas/ /mi dang rta phyug nor sogs mgul du btags//mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs//'di yang myong bas grub pa lan grangs mang / /ye shes lha mo tshe 'phel gos dkar mo/ /rang gzhan tshe bsrings gdams ngag zab bo rgya//rang nyid dran rdzogs rdo rje phag mor bsgom/ /rang lus stong gsal sku yi gnas lnga na/ /seng ge rma bya glang chen rta mchog dang / /shang shang btegs pa'i rin chen khri lnga'i steng / /tshe dpag dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu lnga//rang gi spyi bor pad ma zla ba'i steng //rtsa ba'i bla ma yab sras dbyer med pa//rje btsun mi la sngon po ras gos can//phyag g.yas snyan brten zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs/ /phyag g.yon ba man rwa ro bdud rtsi'i bkang / /de yi dbu gtsug sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /mkham gzhag steng du lhung bzed bdud rtsi'i bkang / /mdun du tshe ring mched lnga gzhung bzhin bsam/ /rang dang mdun bskyed bar der bla ma sogs/ /bsrung bya thams cad khrom tshogs bzhin du bsam/ /bdag mdun lha rnams yid kyis spyan drangs bstim/ /i badzra a yu ṣe sar ha/ /zhes sogs sngags kyis gsol ba gdab pa'i tshe/ /spyi bo'i 'od dpag med las 'od zer 'phros/ /snang srid 'khor 'das tshe 150

dang bsod nams kun/ /'od kyis bsdus nas lhung bzed nang du thim/ /mdun gyi tshe ring mched lnga'i 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten tshe yi dngos grub 'byung ba'i bcud/ /bsdus te 'od dpag med kyi lhung bzed thim/ /lhung bzed nang nas tshe yi bdud rtsi phyur/ /mi la'i tshangs bug nas zhugs sku lus gang / /zhabs g.yas mthe bong rtse nas bdud rtsi babs/ /rang gi tshangs bu gnas zhugs rang lus gang / /rang gi gnas lnga'i tshe dpag rigs lnga las/ /rang mdog 'od 'phros rigs lnga'i rigs gyur pa'i//tshe yi dngos grub thams cad bsdus thim dmigs//sngags ni a ma ra ṇi tshe gzungs bzlas/ /oṃ ardzi dhā ri pañtsa ḍā ki ni badzra a yudzñā na sidhi hūṃ swā hā/ /da ni rang gi tshe bsring dmigs pa ste/ /de nas spyi gtsug 'od pag med pa las//'od zer nyi ma'i zer bzhin dpag med 'phros/ /'od re'i rtse mor 'od dpag med re re/ /bsrung bya re re'i spyi bor re re bzhugs/ /de nas gong bzhin sngags gsum bzlas pa yis/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /snod bcud tshe bsod dpal g.yang kun bsdus te/ /so so'i spyi bo'i 'od dpag lhung bzed thim/ /bdud rtsi phyur ba tshangs pa'i lam nas zhugs/ /lus gang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ /'di ltar thun re rgyun du dmigs pa'am//ma 'grub tshes brgyad bco lnga sogs su bsgom//rgyas par tshe ring ma yi cho ga'am//'bring du gtor 'bul bsdu na gtor bsngos bshams/ /bsrung bya'i tshe bsring dpal bskyed bcol gtams bya/ /'di ni tshe ring ma yi sgrub pa'i thabs ras chung ba dang ngan rdzong zhi ba 'od//mi la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig/gtsang smyon pa yis mdzad sogs mang po zhig /'byung ba'i don bsdus go bde gnad zab yin//yab sras la sogs sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku/ /skye 'chi rang dbang thob 151

pa yin nges pas/ /thugs sun skyo ba skyes par ma gyur na/ /mi 'chi bzhugs par rang dbang yod pa dang / /sku dngos de yi gdul bya ma rdzogs na/ /dug mtshon ngan sngags byas kyang mi 'da' bzhugs//gdul bya rdzogs nas srung ba brgya byas kyang / /sku dngos mi bzhugs gshegs pa'i tshul ston ste/ /dang po'i sa thob yan chad gang zag la//bdud dmag bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyis kyang //ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang gcod mi nus//mthong ba don ldan sku na phra mo'i dus//sku rtse ma yengs sku rim mdzod zhus pas/ /nga yi sku rim rang res byed mi dgos/ /rnga yab gling nas padma 'byung gnas dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas byams pas mdzad do gsungs//de phyir sku rim gtso bor brtan bzhugs kyi//gsol 'debs brtson pa chos lugs 'di yi srol/ /rang dbang che phyir gsol ba btab na bzhugs/ /ma bzhugs na'ang rang gi tshe 'phel ba'i/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa yin/ /de ni mdo lugs dgongs pa yin mod kyi/ /'on kyang sngags lugs dgongs pa de min te/ /phyag bzhi ba sogs mgon po'i rgyud rnams las/ /drag sngags zhe sdang drag pos bsgrub pa na/ /sa bcu non pa'i srog kyang g.yo 'gyur zhing / /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyang 'jigs nus la/ /tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan yang 'chi bar gsungs/ /mu stegs pa yi drag sngags phur pa yis/ /mgon po'i lder sku'i spyi bor btab pa des/ /phyag bzhi pa yi nus pa nyams pa dang / /ra los 'jigasabyed grub pa'i nus mthu yis/ /sa thob sems dpa' sum cu so gnyis bsgral/ /sa lugs rdo rje gdan pa mched grogs gnyis//mthu kha tshad pas gnyis ka 'das pa dang / /ra lo gnyan lo phar thub tshur thub byas/ /sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje bsnyung ba'i tshe/ /rang rer ngan sngags mthu gtad byed mkhan 'dug /152

bsrung bzlog gyis gsungs zhwa dmar grags seng pas//gshin rje kha thun sgo nas bzlog pa mdzad/ /mthu byed mkhan gyi grong la dmar bshal 'byams/ /phug pa rdibs nas mthu sgrub mkhan dgu shi/rang byung rgyal pa'i bsnyung gzhi dngas par gyur//de phyir sa lam mthon po'i bla ma la'ang //slob bu mched grogs brtse gdung can yod na//srung bzlog dmigs rim gzab na phyag phyi che//de yang drag sngags sgo nas ma yin par/ /ye shes lha mo sgrol dkar tshe 'phel ma/ /de yi sprul pa bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /ye shes lha mo thugs rje byin rlabs che//'jig rten lha mo rno myur nus par ldan/ /'di gnyis sgo nas bla ma mched grogs dang / /rang dang bu slob sbyin bdag la sogs pa'i//tshe bsring dpal bskyed gdams ngag zab mo 'dis//gzhan la mi gnod rang la nyes sgrib med/ /dmigs yul bsrung bya kun la phan thogs che//rang bzo ma yin rgyud gzhung phugs che zhing //bshad tshod ma yin lag tu len par bde//yi ge mthong tsam ma yin nyams myong yod//bdag gis rgyun gyi nyams len zab mo 'di/ /snying gi bu mchog brtson 'grus khyod la gdams/ /ma sbas ma bskung 'gro don gang che mdzod/ /de skad rnal 'byor rā ga asu yi/ /rta lo khrums kyi zla ba'i nyi shu brgyad/ /bla ma'i dus mchod skabs kyi snga dro'i thun/ /ji ltar smras bzhin zhu ba po des bris/ /sba 'os gsal bkod 'jig rten ḍā kir bshags/ /dge bas bstan pa'i bdag dang bstan 'dzin gyi/ /skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi zhabs brtan cing //bar chad kun zhi phrin las mtha' rgyas shog/le'u bco brgyad pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /153

bya spyod nyams len tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs/1shāsnyiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ mdo sngags kyi khyad par dang bya spyod kyi nyams len tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru badzra pā ṇi ye/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho gsan mdzod dang / /ri khrod 'grim zhing nyams su len pa la/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi khyad par shes dgos gda'/ /mdo las sngags ni khyad par gsum gyis 'phags/ /mdo yi lugs la nyon mongs dug gsum po/ /spang bar ma byas 'bras bu thob thabs med/ /sngags kyi lugs la nyon mongs spang ba dang / /nyon mongs sbyang dang nyon mongs bsgyur ba dang / /nyon mongs lam du khyer dang rang bzhin shes//thabs ni du mas byang chub sgrub thabs yod/ /mdo lugs bskal ba grangs med gsum gyi bar/ /sbyin pa'i mchog gyur rang gi mgo bo yang / /stong phrag tshal bar sbyin pa btang dgos pas/ /bu dang chung ma longs spyod smos ci dgos/ /dgra bos yan lag nying lag thams cad kyi/ /sha ni srang la 'jal zhing bcad na yang / /khong khro med pa'i bzod pa bsgom pa dang / /lo ni khri phrag bcu yi bar tsam du/ /ting 'dzin gcig la g.yo ba med pa sogs/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog dgos/ /de ma byas par sangs rgyas thob thabs med/ /sngags la de tsam dka' spyad mi dgos par/ /bde ba'i ngang nas yun thung sangs rgyas 'grub/ /mdo lugs dbang po rtul po'i dbang byas pas/ /bskal ba grangs med gcig gi bar dag tu/ /bsod nams 154

tshogs gsog sgrib sbyangs ma byas par/ /stong nyid don de mngon gsum rtogs mi nus/ /sngags la rtse gcig gam ni lo bcu gnyis//lo gsum phyogs gsum mam ni khrid phog gcig /dbang po rnon po rnon po'i dbang byas stong nyid rtogs/ /de ltarakhyad par gsum gyis khyad par 'phags//sngags la rgyud sde bye ba bsam yas kyang / /gsar ma'i lugs la rgyud sde bzhi ru grags/ /rnying ma'i lugs la rgyud sde drug tu bzhed/ /blta dang rgod dang lag bcangs gnyis gnyis 'khyud/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags bzhi po 'joms pa dang / /bram ze rje'u rigs rgyal rigs gdol pa'i rigs/ /mi rigs bzhi po 'dul phyir rgyud sde bzhi/ /rdzogs ldan gnyis ldan sum ldan rtsod ldan dus/ /dus bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir du'ang rgyud sde bzhi/ /bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor bla med do/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor gsang sngags spyi yi rgyud/ /ye shes lha ni phyi rol zhing khams bzhugs//phyi nas spyan drangs mchod cing dngos grub zhu/ /de phyir gsang sngags phyi yi rgyud ces bya//bla med pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med rgyud/ /rnying ma'i ma hā a nu a ti ste/ /gsar rnying rgyud gsum don la khyad med ces/ /bdag gi 'dren mchog dhame shwa ras gsungs//ye shes lha ni phyi na yod min te/ /nang gi sems nyid yi dam lha ru bzhed/ /de phyir gsang sngags nang pa'i rgyud ces bya/ /bya ba'i rgyud la rgyud sde stong phrag bzhi/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rgyud sde stong phrag drug /rnal 'byor rgyud la rgyud sde stong phrag brgyad/ /bla med rgyud la rgyud sde grangs med gsungs//de ltar rgyud sde de dag thams cad ni//rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces bya ste/ /mdo lugs 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa rnams//de yi lam stegs yin phyir 'khor du bzhed//da lta shāka thub bstan pa ma gtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas stong rtsa gzhan gyis bstan pa la/ /gsang sngags chos ni 155

mi 'byung gsungs pa'i don/ /gtan nas mi 'byung ba ni ma yin te/ /skal ldan rnams la snyan brgyud tshul du gnang / /da lta bzhin du mi rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang sngags zhes bya'i ming yang mi thos so/ /mdo lugs sde snod gsum gyi stog pa ni/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa nyid yin te/ /bstan pa lo grangs lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas/ /rim pa bzhin du dgra bcom 'bras gnas dang / /dgra bcom rgyun zhugs phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas/ /phyir mi 'ong zhugs phyir 'ong 'bras gnas dang / /phyir 'ong rgyun zhugs rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /lnga brgya phrag rer de dag— thob pa mang / /de dag 'bras bu'i dus dang sgrub pa'i dus/ /de rjes lung ṣka bstan pa lnga brgya phrag /gsum la rim bzhin mngon pa mdo sde dang / /'dul ba rnams kyi bshad pa rgya cher dar/ /bshad pa tsam las 'bras bu thob pa nyung / /de phyir lung gi bstan pa zheso bya'o/ /de rjes lnga brgya phrag gcig rtags tsam 'dzin//btsun pa'i rtags dang cha lugs 'dzin tsam las/ /bshad sgrub gnyis ka tshad ldan 'dzin pa nyung / /lnga brgya tha ma rtags tsam 'dzin pa zer/ /mchod rten sku gzugs glegs bam la sogs ni/ /yar 'phel tshe lo drug brgya'i bar du gnas/ /de ni mdo lugs bstan pa'i gnas tshad de//bstan rtsis bzhed pa mi mthun mang na yang / /pad 'byung srong btsan sgam po lugs la sogs/ /mang po go bstun rigs pas legs dpyad na/ /deng sang lnga brgya dgu pa'i dkyil tsam sems/ /mdo lugs 'bras bu sgrub pa'i bstan pa yol//nyams su blang yang 'bras bu thob pa dkon/ /sngags lugs gri gug brtsegs pa'i rgyud kyi don/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bstan pa lnga brgya gsum/ /yon tan bzhi dang lnga brgya phrag dgu ste/ /de rjes chos skyong mgon po'i phrin las bzhi//re re la yang lnga brgya phrag re gnas/ /dus 'khor 156

lugasal stong phrag mang po ste//khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa ni/ /tshe lo drugacu'i sa nas bcu yi bar//kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi bstan pa gnas//de phyir rdzogs chen bsgom na grol sla gsungs//khyad par o rgyan gter gyi bstan pa ni//re re nub kyang re re dar ba ste//thub pa'i bstan pa ming med gyur na yang //sa cha khol bu khol bur gter phran brdol//byams mgon ma byung bar du rgyun mi 'chad/ /bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud gsum ni/ /longs sku rnam snang chen po'i bstan pa yin/ /ma hā a nu a ti'i rgyud gsum ni/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po'i bstan pa yin//bstan pa so so gnas tshad so sor bzhed//de dag phal gyis snyan du mi 'gro yang //gsar rnying rgyud gzhung rgya cher gzigs dang gsal//mdo sngags khyad par 'byed pa'i dbyangs chung 'di//rā ga a sus 'phral du gang dran smras//na mo gu ru ārya pa lo ye//lus kyi bya ba phyag dang bskor ba dang //gtsang sbra bsnyung gnas la sogs gtso che bas/ /bya ba'i rgyud ces bya ba de yin no/ /bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de//khyim pa'am ni rab byung yin yang rung //chu dang cod pan dar dpyang dbang bskur zhus/ /yi dam de yi rig gtad sgrub lung zhu/ /rang gis bri'am gal te mi shes na/ /lha bzo bsnyen gnas bsrung la bri bcug ste//tshon dang ras gzhir ko spyin ma 'dres pa//gro khu'am ni zar khus sbyin byas la/ /yi dam gang yin de yi sku gzugs bri//spyan 'byed byas ma thag tu rab gnas bya/ /sku gzugs 'dzoms na dkyil 'khor med kyang chog /dkyil 'khor pad ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud can//med na 'bras kyi tshom bu bkod kyang chog/de mdun sha chang sgog sogs ma 'dres pa'i//mchod pa rnam lnga dkar gsum gtor ma bshams//sgrub g.yog gus ldan gtsang sbra che ba dang //gos gsar mchod rdzas 157

spos dang me tog tshogs//de nas rang nyid dkar phyogs bsrung byas te//nabago re bzhin du yan lag lnga khrus bya/ /gos gsar gyon te dkyil 'khor drung sa'ong / /phyag 'tshal ku sha gdan dkar steng du bdug /skyil krung mi bca' tsogapur thal mo sbyar/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas pa'i rjes/ /sa phyogs thams cad sangs rgyas zhing khams dang //mchod rdzas mchod sprin bsam mi khyab par dmigs/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dkyil 'khor yod pa'i rigs la gzhal yas bskyed//med pa'i rigs la pad ma'i sdong bo ni/ /yal ga lo 'dab bar snang khams khyab pa/ /de dbus rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i//pad ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyes pa'i dbus//ge sar rin chen sna tshogs ze'u 'bru'i steng //nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gdan du bting //gos tshags bzabs te lag tu spos thur thogs/ /lha de bzhugs pa'i phyogs su kha bltas la//ma lus sems can mgon sogs spyan 'dren bya//mkhyen pas gzigs te skad cig de nyid la/ /glog ltar myur bar byon nas gdan bzhugs bsam/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod maṇḍal la sogs pa/ /cho ga'i 'gros ni sman bla'am gnas chog dang // sa gzhi byin brlabs ltar du byas pa'i rjes//mdun bskyed lha yi thugs kur lha yi thugs/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas bsgom pa'i steng / /sa bon mtha' ru sngags sam gzungs de nyid/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /yig mgo phyi na bstan te lam mer gsal/ /sngags la so so'i rang sgra grags pa la//sngags phreng 'khor ba sogs ni ma yin no//de nas dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba//rin po che'am shing las byas kyang rung //sor bzhi tshon skud sna lngas dkris pa zhig/lag pa g.yas pas rang gi snying gar bzung //phreng lung ko bas mi 158

bongatong skud kyis/ /brgyus pa'i phreng ba lag pa g.yon pas bzung / /phreng ba sha rjenamireg gos gseb bgrang / /dbugs ni phyir la 'gro ba'i dus nyid du/ /mdunagyi thugs ma'i sngags la rig pa gtad//dbugs ni nang du rngub pa'i dus nyid du/ /mdun bskyed thugs las zla ba sngags bcas pa/ /'phros nas rang gi snying gar thim par bsgom/ /sngags sgra mi che mi chung sil bur bgrang / /thun mtshams ma gtogs ja yang btung mi nyan/ /gdan gcig nyin par gro dkar gdan gcig ste/ /ngag bcad nyin par zas spang chu yang spang / /tho rangs ngag bkrol thug pa sla'u ni//kha ngo dod pa phor pa gang btung ba//khog pa'i 'bu srin bkres pa sel phyir yin//de nyin phyag dang bskor ba mi bya zhing //cho ga ngag tu mi brjod yid 'don bya/ /gdan gcig nyin par phyag bskor cho ga 'don//sbrid pa 'og rlung gad mo shor ba na//phreng ba sa la bzhag nas chab blangs te//cho ga slar yang bskyar nas 'don dgos so//thun mtshams ma gtogs chab gsil mi rung zhing //tshar nas slar yang khrus dang chab blang ngo//'di skabs nyon mongs dug lnga 'dul tshul ni//srong btsan sgam po lta bu mngon shes la//thogs pa med pa'i rgyal po btsan po'am/ /bla ma chen po mngon shes thogs med pa'i/ /drung du yud tsam phal pa'i mis mjal tshe/ /sems la rnam rtog ngan pa 'gyu mi phod/ /'gyus na bla mas mkhyen nas thugs khrel lam/ /rgyal pos mkhyen nas bka' bkyon 'byung phyir ro//de bzhin chu bur mig gis ma mthong yang //ye shes lha de mdun du nges par bzhugs//de phyir nyon mongs rtog pa 'phreng mi phod//de la goms nas nyon mongs shugs kyis 'gag /khyad par dkar phyogs bsnyung gnas byed pa des/ /gnyid dang 'dod chags zhe sdang shugs kyis chung / /gcin rtug 'og rlung nyung 159

phyir gtsang sbra sla/ /de phyir dkar phyogs dgos pa'i don de yin/ /de nas thursha mtshams 'jog pa'i mtshams de ru/ /phreng ba bskyil la phu btab gnas gsum reg/sngags kyi byin rlabs rang la thim par bsam/ /rin chen snod ni 'bru yio/bkang steng bzhag / /dkyil 'khor drung ngam gtsang ba'i sar bzhag ste/ /phyas 'tshal langs la zas kyi bya ba sogs/ /dkyil 'khor drung du mi bya gzhan du bya/ / nub mo nyal kha thun ni 'jog pa'i tshe/ /ras bris yod na mdun bskyed de 4 bstim/ /med na gshegs shing bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ /de nas gos tshags bshig la nyal bar bya//phyir nang skya rengs shar nas gos tshags bsdams//yan lag lnga khrus byas la sngar bzhin te/ /zhag ni gsum mam bdun nam tha na yang //lnga tsam mtshams nas gos gsar brje zhing gyon/ /gos rnying rlung sing bya zhing spos khar 'don/ /mchod rdzas rnams ni bza' bar mi rung ste/ /lha la phul ba'i dkor de sgrib pa che/ /zos na lha zhal mi mthong bsgrib par 'gyur//khyi dang ba glang bong bu la sogs pa/ /dud 'gro dman pa rnams la sbyin mi rung / /gtsang zhing mtho ba'i gnas su bskyal bar bya/ /bya yi rigs kyis zos kyang skyon med de/ /nam mkhar 'gro ba mkha' 'gro'i rigs su gtogs/ /mjug tu bsnyen pa'i kha bskang sbyin sreg kyang / /sbyin sreg spyi dang mthun pa ma yin te//'jig rten me lha dam tshig lha la sogs//bskyed pa mi dgos me dpung de yi dkyil//mdun gyi lha de spyan drangs mchod pas 'thus/ /slar yang ras gzhi 'am ni dkyil 'khor gzhug /thun mtshams bdag 'jug la sogs len pa yang //mdun bskyed dpral ba mgrin pa thugs ka nas//'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdag la bstim//sgrub pa'i mjug tu dngos grub len pa'i thabs/ /lhung bzed nang du dkar gsum mngar 160

gsum dang / /bsres pa'i zho zan dag gis bkang byas te/ /steng du dar tshon sna lngasadagab par bya//de steng dam tshig rdo rje bzhag byas te//mdun gyi thugs ma'i 'od zer kha dog lnga//dngos grub rang bzhin zas la thim bsgom zhing //nyin zhag phrugs gcig zas dang gnyid spangs nas//lhung bzed lag mthil g.yon bzhag g.yas pas bkab//nam langs bar du lha yi snying po bzlas//'od dang du brnga sgra spos dri 'thul/ /drod skye rlangs pa 'thul na dngos grub 'thob/ /rtags ma byung kyang de nyid zos pa yis/ /tshe ring nad nyung rgas pa sra ba yin/ /sgrub che nyi zla 'char sogs rmi lam ltas/ /rtags yig gzhan dang mtshungs pa du ma 'byung / /ras bris dam tshig rdo rje rten du bcang / /yi dam dngos su mos la dad 'dun bskyed/ /dus bzang dus su bshams la mchod pa 'bul/ /de mdun sbyin sreg phul zhing gsol btab na//ci ltar bsams pa thams cad 'grub pa yin//dam tshig rdo rje mi ston sbas la 'chang / /ras bris slob ma'am ni dad ldan la/ /zhal bstan phyag dang mchod pa phul bcug pas/ /sgrib pa dpag med 'byongs par gsungs pa yin//de ltar bya rgyud nyams su blangs pa na//yi dam lha des rjes su bzung ba'i mthus//mi nas mir skyes skye ba drug cu la//de ltar bya rgyud nyams su len 'gyur zhing / /de nas tshe 'phos mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /yi dam lha de nyid dang mnyam 'gyur zhing / /po ṭa la sogs lha de'i zhing khams su//lha dang lha mo'i gzugs can rig 'dzin ni/ /rtag tu lha de'i zhabs 'brang byed par 'gyur//ming ni grub pa'i rig 'dzin zhes bya ste//spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma la sogs pa'i/ /'khor la bye ba dung phyur yod par gsungs/ /dgongs pa ngo bo rigs gsum mgon dang mnyam//skabs su sprul ba 'am ni skye rgyud ni//phal cher 161

bram ze'i rigs su skye 'gyur te/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyis bstan pa 'dzin par byed/ /dper na bram ze skye ba bdun pa bzhin//mthong thos dran reg thams cad 'dreganus so/ /bya rgyud nyams su len tshul dbyangs chung 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i btsu gcig dgong thun mtshams/ /sbyin sreg tshar mtshams byung rgyal smra pa po/ /snyig4dus drang srong rā ga a pya'o//yi ge pa yang bī ra ya sā ga ra/ /na mo gu ru badzra pā ṇi ye//lus kyi spyod pa bya rgyud dang 'dra zhing //sems miting nge 'dzin dang gnyis ka spyod/ /de phyir spyod pa'i rgyud ces bya ba yin//lus kyi spyod pa bya rgyud dang mtshungs shing / /ting 'dzin rnal 'byor rgyud dang phyog4'dra tsam/ /de phyir gnyis ma'i rgyud ces la las bzhed/ /chu dang cod pan dar dpyang dbang gi steng / /rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang zhus shing / /sngags kyi rje4/gnang rig gtad bsgrub lung zhu/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bris sku mchod rdza4 sogs//bya ba'i rgyud dang khyad par med pa yin//spyod pa ngag bcad sgyung gan4mi dgos te/ /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa nyin bzhin las/ /gdan gcig mi dgos dkar gro dgongs bcad chog /de don ma hā ma ya'i 'grel chen las/ /sgyung bar phyi dro'i kha zas spang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs khyim pa skye bo'i bsnyen gnas dang //'di yi gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa gnyis//bsrung tshul 'dra yang don lo mi 'dra ste/ /'dul ba las gsungs bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad/ /slob dpon la ni nges par zhu dgos te//rten gyi drung du rang gis len mi chog/'di yi gso sbyong slob dpon yod na rab//med na nyin re bzhin du rten drung blangs//'dul ba nas gsungs bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad/ /khyim pa rnams kyi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir//rab byung rnams kyis srung bar mi rung ste//bsrung na rab byung sdom la 162

gnodaces bshad//'di yi gso sbyong yun lag brgyad pa ni//nyin zhag gcig gi sdomapa yin na yang / /theg chen bya spyod rgyud kyi sdom pa ste/ /tshangs spyod dge bsnyen brdos de bsrung na/ /dge bsnyen nyes byas phra zhib thams cad dag/don la dge bsnyen gso sbyong yin pa'i phyir//gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa zhes grags so/ /gso sbyong go don dge ba gso ba dang / /sdig pa sbyong phyir gso sbyong zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin dge tshul dang ni dge slong gi /ngag bcad smyung gnas dkar phyogs byas pa na/ /sdom pa'i nyes ltung thams cad sor chud nas/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag 'gyur rgyud las gsungs//de phyir khyim pas bsnyen gnas srung ba dang //btsun pas gso sbyong yan lag brgyad srung pa//bsrung tshul 'dra yang don la mi 'dra ba//mdo sngags so so yin pa mkhyen par mdzod//de nas dkyil 'khor mdun du rang nyid ni/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod pa byin rlabs sogs/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang 'dra bar byas pa'i rjes/ /swa bhā wa yi sngags kyis sbyangs byas te//stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'am pad zla'i steng //rang sems sa bon yig 'bru 'od zer 'phros/ /don gnyis byas te 'od zer tshur 'dus pas/ /sa bon phyag mtshan yig 'brus mtshan par bsam/ /lha de'i phyag rgya bcings shing sngags brjod pas//phyag mtshan 'od zhu rang nyid yi dam bsgom//rgyan dang cha lugs so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin/ /gnas gsum oṃ āḥ hūṃ gi yi ge gsum/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas gdab med/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas zhing khams dbus/ /rin chen khang bzang gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs/ /phyi rol pad ra rdo rje'i ra ba dang / /'od kyi phreng ba lcags ri'i tshul du bskor/ /rdo rje'i gur sogs 'di la yod pa min/ / 163

dkyil 'khor med na pad sdong 'dab stong steng //zhi khro'i khyad kyi zla nyi gang tsam bsgom//spos bltams dril bu gsil zhing lag g.yas kyis//bzhugs pa'i phyog nas rdo rjes g.yab tshul gyis/ /spyan 'dren tshig gis byon nas mdun bzhug bsam/ /byon skyems chu gnyis 'bul zhing phyag 'tshal te/ /de rjes mchod pa rdzayis mchod cing bstod//dkyil 'khor drung du gdan ni gtsang ma'i steng //skyil krung phyed pas 'dug cing sems rtse gcig/bdag mdun gnyis ku'i thugs maligazhi de na//zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya ni rgyas pa'i steng //sa bon 'greng ste gnas mthar sngags sam gzungs/ /sngags phreng yig 'go phyir bstan 'khod par bsgom//mdun gyi zla ba sngags phreng sgrar bcas la//rtse gcig yid gtad ci nusabazlas pa'i mjug /mdun bskyed thugs las sngags phreng zla ba bcas/ /'phros nas rang gi sngags phreng zla bar thim/ /de la rtse gcig rig pa gtad la bzlas/ /dbugs kyi dbyung rngub dang ni sprad na legs/ /ma thub na'ang ma gsas bar du bsgom/ /thun mtshams mdun bskyed dkar gsum gtor ma bsngo/ /bzhugs gsol byas nas rang nyid dam tshig pa//stong par bsdus nas tha mal lus kyi ni/ /thun mtshams spyod pa byed cing 'di la ni/ /thun dus ja sogs btung bar rung ba ste/ /chab len lham phud la sogs bya rgyud mtshungs/ /'di yi lugs kyis dug gsum 'dul ba'i thabs/ /ye shes sems dpa' rgyal po lta bu'i mdun/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' blon po'i tshul//rgyal blon tshul du dngos grub bsgrub pa ste//dper na 'khor los bsgyur rgyal mngon shes can//shin tu bka' khrims btsan pa'i mdun de na/ /yud tsam blon pos rang don zhu 'bul tshe/ /rgyal po 'i zhal blta gsung nyan dgongs pa len//zhe ni yengs pa'i long med sgrim pa ltar// 164

yeshes lha de mngon sum mdun du dmigs/ /gzungs sngags sgra la rig pa rtse gcig gtad/ /lag g.yas lha de'i dam tshig phyag rgya ni/ /snying gar 'ching zhing g.yon pas phreng ba bgrang / /rtse gcig ma yengs khab mig skud 'dzud bzhin/ /de tshe nyon mongs skye ba'i go skabs med/ /nyal kha ras bris yod na de la bstim/ /med na ye shes gshegs shing shis pa brjod/ /sngon ltar phyir nangs langs la gso sbyong blang / /dgongs bcad rgyun du bya zhing bsnyen pa bya/ /de ltar zla drug zla gsum zla gcig sogs/ /rtags ni rtags yig spyi dang mthun pa yin/ /de ni bsnyen pa yin cing dus de'am/ /dus gzhan du yang rung ste sgrub pa dang / /dngos grub len pa'i cho ga bya ba ni/ /ras bris dkyil 'khor gang 'dzom de yi drung / /dkar gsum mchod pa gzab cing sbyin sreg 'bul/ /tshes gcig nas ni bcu bzhi'i bar dag tu/ /bsnyen pa byed tshul sngon dang 'dra ba ste/ /bco lnga'i nyin nub gnyis la sngags rgyun ni/ /bza' btung tshe yang yid 'don ma chad bya/ /gzas 'dzin 'grigs na zin tu bzang ba yin/ /nyi ma nub nas nam ni ma langs bar//lus po bsrang la gnyid rmug ma shor bar/ /lag gnyis lha de'i phyag rgya thugs kur bca'/ /phreng ba mi bgrang sngags ni sil bur bzla/ /tho rangs dus su lag pa'i phyag rgya la/ /me 'bar 'od 'phro me stag 'tshub pa'am/ /yi dam thang sku bzhad sogs rtags 'byung ste/ /'grub po yin pas gang 'dod las tshogs 'grub//gal te rtags mtshan ci yang ma byung yang / /dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg la sogs pa/ /spyod rgyud slob dpon bya ba thams cad rung / /skye ba drug cur 'bras bu thob tshul sogs/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang khyad༄ra med par bshad/ /bod 'dir spyod rgyud mang du ma 'gyur te/ /'byung 'dul rgyud 'di spyod rgyud nyid du nges/ / 165

gzhan 'ga' zhal ma 'chams pas 'dir ma brjod/ /bya spyod rgyud gnyis nyams su len dka' yang //shes rab yod cing bla ma bsten pa'i drin/ /zla shas tsam re'abrel ba bzhag pa na/ /mi lus don ldan skal ba bzang po yin/ /de phyir yid la—zungs shig birya pa//spyod rgyud lugs kyi cho ga'i 'gros de ni//'brug lugs yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs lags//de min mang po bdag gis ma mthong ngo //spyod rgyud nyams su len pa'i dbyangs chung 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i bcu gnyis dgong thun la/ /rā ga asus 'phral du gang dran smras/ /yi ge pa yang bīr ya sā ga ra/ /le'u bcu dgu pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /rnal 'byor rgyud bsgrub ngan song sgo bcod/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nyams len ngan song sgo gcod ces bya ba bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru bai ro tsa na ye/ /bīrya sā ga ra khyed snyan gson dang / /ngo mtshar gtam snyan 'ga' zhig 'di na yod//lus kyi bya spyod gtsang sbra gtso mi che/ /nang gi rnal 'byor ting 'dzin gtso che bas/ /de phyir rnal 'byor rgyud ces bya ba yin//sha chang la sogs mi gtsang zas rnams ni//spang bar gsungs kyi gal te ma spang yang / /bya spyod bzhin du gtan nas mi rung min/ /ci ltar bde bar dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de phyir sngon tshe chos rgyal khri srong gis//rgyud sde bzhi drug dpag med bsgyur ba'i nang //rnal 'byor rgyud la shin tu thugs mnyes nas/ /bsam yas dbu rtse'i bar khang steng khang du/ /rdor dbyings 166

lhagrangs bzhengs pa de ltar lags//gsang sngags gsar ma'i chos kyi chu phugs ni/ /mnga' rir byon pa'i ma hā paṇḍi ta/ /sde snod rgyud sde rig gnas kun la mkhas/ /'jam dbyangs sprul ba lo chen rin bzang gi /rnal 'byor rgyud dang khyad par spyod rgyud 'di/ /bod yul 'di na rgya cher dar bar mdzad/ /mkhas pa chen po jo bo a ti shas//bod 'di gtsang sbra chung zhing spyod pa rtsing //bya spyod rgyud gnyis 'grub pa'i re ba med/ /bod 'di the tshom che zhing rnam rtog hrag /bla med rgyud ni rtog pas mi chun te//rnal 'byor rgyud 'di bod la phan 'dug gsungs//rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs thams cad ni//ye shes pa yi lha ru don mnyam pas//lha la theg pa mtho dman yod min te/ /gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par rgyud sde gsungs/ /dang po sngon la bya rgyud gsungs pa'i phyir/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi rtsa ba bya rgyud yin/ /de phyir bya rgyud rang lugs nyams len dang / /bya rgyud spyod rgyud ltar du nyams len yod/ /rgya gar mkhas pa dgra las rnal rgyal pas/ /bya rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud ltar nyams len gsungs//dper na tshe dpag lha dgu lta bu yin//de bzhin jo bo rjes kyang de ltar mdzad/ /me brtsegs ljang gu mi 'khrugs cho ga bzhin/ /de bzhin paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pas kyang / /bya rgyud bla med rgyud ltar nyams len mdzad/ /dper na bi ma'i rnam 'joms dkar po bzhin/ /de bzhin rdo rje gdan pa che chung gis//sgrub thabs rgya mtsho brgya rtsa gnyis po dang //dbang phyug rdo rje'i gcig shes kun khrol gyi/ /bdag mdun bum gsum dbang gi sgrub lugs ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang dgongs pa mthun pa yin//sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul ni//gong gi rgya gzhung de dag kun dang mthun//rgyas par yon tan phrin las dbang bskur ni/ /zhicas khro chas phyag mtshan la sogs dang / /167

gtor dbang la sogs rnying ma'i don bsdus te//dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud ni chen po dang / /chos skyong mgon po'i gtor rgyud sogs dang mthun/ /don༄ gsar rnying kun gyi dgongs pa bsdus/ /kun mthun kun las lhag pa yin mod kyi/ /'di la zug rngu ldan pa 'ga' zhig gis/'di yi rgyud ni gang la brten dziyin/ /zer nas co 'dri byed pa bdag gis thos/ /rdor phreng sgrub thabs rgya mtshobargya rtsa sogs//rgyud sde gcig las de ltar gsungs pa med//'on kyang paṇa chen mkhas pas gcig tu bsdus/ /de bzhin gsar rnying rgyud sde mtha' yas dang / /bka' gter man ngag kun midon bsdus yin/ /de phyir 'du che zab la rgya che ba//grub mtha' gzhan la sngon chad ma byung bas//the tshom spongs la snying la chong4shig kye/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la mos pa'i dbyangs chung 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i bcu gnyis dgong thun mtshams/ /grong chog rgan po rā ga asu yis/ /zos tshod dran nas rgyud la bstod pa byas//bī rya sā ga ra yang dgod cing bris//na mo gu ru sarba bi da ye//ri khrod 'grim shid nyams su len pa'i mis//rnal 'byor rgyud la 'brel ba 'jog bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud ni de nyid 'dus pa yin/ /de la rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs//bshad pa'i rgyud ni rdo rje rtse mo yin/ /de la khams gsum rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /de gnyis rdor phreng sogs la 'byung mod kyi/ /cho ga'i khog ni kun rigs sogs dang mthun//'on kyang dar srol chung phyir spros pa bskyungs//'phros pa'i rgyud ni ngan song sbyong rgyud dang //gtsug dgu'i rgyud ni gnyis ka yin na yang / /gtsug dgu'i rgyud la la las the tshom byed/ /spyod rgyud rtsod med nyi zla lta bu yin/ /de la rgya gzhung 'grel chen bzhi yod de/ /de dag bcud bsdus rnam grol sgo chen yin/ /'a grel chen de dag rnams dang mi mthun 168

pa'i//gzhan phan mtha' yas gzhan phan 'od zer gnyis jo bo'i slob ma go ma'i sgom chen gyi/ /zin bris mdzad pa'i rjes 'brang yin par bzhed/ /zin bris de yangajo bo'i gsung rgyun te/ /jo bo lo chen gnyis po zhal 'dzoms tshe/ /lo chen rin bzang cung tsam ma mgu nas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la nga rang mkhas 'dug gsungs/ /de phyir rnam grol sgo chen khungs btsun no/ /rang re btsun pa ri khrod 'grim pa rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub par sems bskyed kyang / /sdom gsum nyes ltung phra zhib char ltar 'babs//mdo sngags bslab sbyangs rgya cher ma byas pa'i//nyes ltung phal cher srung rgyu'ang ngo mi shes//nyes byas bdun brtsegs ltung ba gcig tu 'gyur//ltung ba gcig la'ang bshags pa ma thon na//ngan song gnas su lan gcig skye dgos te/ /rang don ngan song sbyong thabs gal chen yin/ /byang bu phyir ldog bsngo zhus la sogs pa/ /zas nor dngos po legs par phul ba yang / /ngan song sdug bsngal e skyob re ba bcas//gsar rnying mdo rgyud ma lus thams cad nas/ /spyod rgyud las lhag ngan song sbyong thabs med//gzhan gyi don la'ang spyod rgyud 'di gal che//cho ga'i 'gros ni gzhung la gsal ba ltar//da nangs sngon 'gro re re btang bas chog /de nas thun bzhi'am ni thun gsum du/ /bdag bskyed de nyid kho na cig('don) nas 'don/ /bdag nyid gtso bo'i thugs kur zla ba'i steng / /rdo rje rtse lnga hūṃ gis mtshan pa'am/ /yang na hūṃ yig dkar po bsgom pas chog /de mthar rtsa rig yig 'bru 'greng thabs bkod/ /'khor rnams thugs mar zla steng sa bon mthar//rang rang sngags rnams mos pa tsam gyis chog /gtso bo nas bzung khro bo brgyad yan gyi/ /lha tshogs thams cad bdag nyid yin par dmigs/ /kun gyi zhal nas sngags sgra sgrog par bsgom/ /169

sngags phreng 'od zer g.yas 'khor bsgom yang rung / /yum rnams thugs kur sngags rnams g.yon skor bkod//yig 'bru 'khor ba'i gsal kha ma gsungs so/ / thugs ma'i sngags las 'od zer kha dog lnga//dpral ba'i mdzod spu'i sgo nas phyir thon te/ /'od de dper na nyi ma shar ba bzhin /khams gsum spyi dang khyad par bar do dang / /ngan song gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad gsal/ /ngan song skye ba'i rgyu yi sdig sgrib dang //'bras bu ngan song sdug bsngal thams cad ni//ba mor nyi zer bzhin du sangs se dag /'od zer tshur 'dus rang gi thugs kur thim/ /yang ni sngar ltar 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun la mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /'od zer de yi zer ma re res kyang / /shāka thub bzhin du mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan/ /'od zer tshur 'dus rang gi thugs kur thim/ /de ltarabasgom zhing bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya//thun mtshams bdag bskyed gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /rang nyid tha mal lus su phyir thon nas/ /gang dgos bya ba gzhan la 'jug bya ste/ /slar yang nye reg chab dang khrus byas nas/ /thugs mar zhugs te badzra dhā ra sogs/ /sngags brjod rang dang dbyer med nga rgyal bzung / /bskyed rim 'phral du gsal ni 'debs pa'i phyir//bdag bskyed slar yang khrig('don) par bya ba yin//nyal kha ye shes lha rnams gshegs dgos ste//rgyas 'debs byas na phyag rgya bkrol gal che//ma gshegs ma bkrol brtson bzung nyes par bshad//sku gzugs ras bris bstim la 'gal ba med/ /bsngo ba smon lam byas la gnyid log ste//phyir nangs yang ni sngar nyin lta bur bya//dus ni rab ni zla drug 'bring ni gsum/ /tha ma zla gcig gis kyang rung ba yin/ /rab ni rtsa rig 'bum phrag bzhi dang ni/ /'khor sngags so sor khri phrag bzhi re dang / /sbyin sreg khri phrag 170

bzhi'am yang na gcig /de ni kun rig bsnyen pa rgyas pa yin/ /'bring la phreng skor re re'i 'go la ni//rtsa rig tshang ma re re sbyar bya zhing //oṃ sho rnya ne man chad grangs su bzhag /de la bzhi 'bum rigs bzhi khri phrag re/ /yum bzhir stong re gzhan rnams brgya re tsam/ /kha bskong sgrib sbyong sbyin sreg rgyas pa gcig /de ni kun rig bsnyen pa 'bring po'o/ /lha tshogs thams cad bdag nyid yin bsgom zhing //rtsa rig la ni lha tshogs kun 'dus phyir//rtsa rig kho na rab tu 'bum phrag bzhi//'bring du gsum dang tha ma gcig yan chad//ci 'grub bzla zhing sbyin sreg grub na legs/ /mi shes na ni phyir ldog skabs nyid nas/ /gsungs ltar til la rang gi sdig pa bstem//brgya'am stong sogs ci 'grub bsreg pas 'thus//rtags ni rtags yig spyi dang mthun pa ste//sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags mtshan sna tshogs pa//'byung tshul spyod rgyud nyid nas gsungs ltar ro//spyod rgyud 'di la bdag bskyed bsnyen pa las//sgrub pa zer ba'i gsal kha med na yang //dkyil 'khor las rim sgrub mchod bsgrub par mtshungs/ /de la bdag mdun bum gsum thun gsum mam/ /thun bzhi la sogs tshar grangs spyi ltar ste/ /thun mtshams mdun bum la dmigs bsnyen par 'bad/ /mdun bum rnams kyang sngags sgra sgrog pa dang / /thugs ma'i 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra/ /de ltar zhag ni gsum lnga bdun la sogs//'bad pa sgrub mchod ces ni bya ba ste//rang don yin na mjug tu bdag 'jug blangs/ /gzhan don yin na gzhan la dbang bskur ram/ /byang bu phyir ldog la sogs gzhan don dang //ma 'grub bum chu kun la bkye bar bya//bsnyen pa'am ni 'di ltar sgrub mchod dus//bye ma mang por sngags nas tshags bya ste/ /ro dang mi dang dud 'gro'i rus pa la/ /'debs sam 'debs rgyu bskur na 171

'gro don che//sbyong rgyud bsnyen pa bya tshul dbyangs chung 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i bcu gsum dgongs thun la/ /rā ga a sus 'phral du gang dran smras/ /bī rya sā ga ra yis yi ger bris/ /na mo gu ru sarba bi da ye/ /gson dang bla ma bī rya sā ga ra/ /rnam grol sgo chen dbang dang bdag 'jug dus/ /dmigs rim gzhung na mi gsal ngag khrid ni/ /bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /tha mal lus su thon la shar sgo'i drung / /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te gnas par bsam/ /mdun bskyed gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis/ /dbyer med drung du sdom pa dam tshig dang / /dbang rnams zhu bar dmigs la dbang tshig rnams/ /mdun gyi gtso bos gsungobasgom rang gis 'don/ /bdag 'jug rdzogs nas rang nyid rdor sems de/ /bdag bskyed thugs kur zhugs la dbyer med bsams/ /badzra dhā ra la sogs sngags brjod la/ /slob ma la ni dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe/ /bdag bskyed thugs las rang nyid gtso rkyang ngam/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par phyir thon te/ /shar sgo'i 'gram du seng ge'i khri la 'dug /rang mdun 'jig rten 'khor yug rnams kyi nang / /bar khyams stong bar slob ma thams cad bsgom/ /mdun gyi lha la rang gi zhu sna dang / /ngo chen tshul du byas nas dbang bskur te/ /bskur tshul thams cad gzhung du gsal na yang / /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi khyad chos ngo mtshar can/ /zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed ces bya ba/ /snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems de ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya ni rgyas pa'i steng / /don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ni/ /rdo rje sngon po'am dkar po rtse lnga ba/ /bsgom zhing sarba yo ga'i sngags bzlas pa/ /ting 'dzin de bsgoms sngags de brjod ma thag /shāka thub mngon par rdzogs 172

par sangs rgyas so/ /de phyir bsnyen pa'i thun skabs rnams su yang / /de nyid bsgom na zhi lhag ting 'dzin skye//rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin//de man dbang gzhung nyid du gsal mod kyi//bdag 'jug gam ni slob ma yin kyang rung / /mdun bskyed lha tshogs so so'i thugs ka nas/ /so so'i sngags phreng yig 'bru gser gyi mdog /'phros nas spyi bo nas zhugs lus gang ba/ /sngags dbang de ni kun gyis shes ltar ro/ /bdag gi yid kyis mdun bskyed gtso bo la/ /yid kyis gsol ba btab pas gtso bo yis/ /'khor lha rnams la dgongs pa gtad tsam gyi//gtso bo rigs lngas dbang bskur dgongs pa gtad//yum bzhi'i thugs las sprul pa'i yum bzhi yis//shar sgo'i rnam rgyal bum pa nam mkhar btegs//slob ma rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ /sgrib pa kun dag lus nang bdud rtsis gang / /de tshe sems dpa' bcu drug bkra shis brjod//sgeg sogs brgyad kyis glu dang rol mo byed/ /khro bo brgyad kyis bar chad bgegs rnams bsrung / /de ltar bsgom zhing bum pas dbang bskur ro/ /de ni mi bskyod ngo bo chu yi dbang / /mi bskyod sbyong ba'i rgyal po don gcig go/de nas rin 'byung rgyal mchog rin chen gyi/ /ngo bo rin po che yi dbu rgyan zhig /yum bzhi'i sprul pas slob ma'i mgor bcing bsam//de bzhin me tog kha dog sna lnga yi//phreng ba dang ni de bzhin dar dpyang yang / /mgo bo'i gnas lnga dang ni g.yas g.yon rgyab/ /yum bzhi'i sprul pas dngos su btags par bsgom/ /de rjes rgyal ba rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas/ /phyag rgya lnga spros slob ma'i lag pa yi/ /phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga la bkod par bsams/ /de nas slob dpon rang gi rdor dril thogs//mdun gyi gtso bos ming de gdags par bsam/ /deyan thob nas kun rig bsgom bzlas rung / /ma smin 173

smin byed slob ma'i dbang zhes bya/ /smin cing grol nas 'gro don nus pa la/ /gzhan gyi slob dpon bya phyir slob dpon dbang / /slob ma rdor sems bskyed sogs gzhung du gsal//de nas rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid kyis//phrin las bzhi mtshon sna tshogs rdo rje de/ /lag g.yas gtad pas phrin las bzhi 'grub bsam//gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa zhig/rkang pa'i bar ram lag pa g.yon du bzhag /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dbang thob bsam/ /de nas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas/ /rang rang rigs kyi sems dpa' lnga 'phros te/ /slob ma la thim rnal 'byorargyud rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bdag por gyur par bsam//de nas yum bzhi'i thugs kur phyag mtshan dang //gtso bo'i yum ni sbas pa'i tshul yin pas//sku gzhogs g.yon nas chos 'byung gzugs la sogs//phyag rgya 'phros nas slob ma la thim pas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gsang pa'i man ngag rnams//rang gis rtogs shing gzhan la ston rung gyur//de bzhin rigs lnga'i sku las so so yi//phyag mtshan 'phros nas slob ma la thim pas//sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dbang thob ste//ye shes lnga ni myur du rtogs par bsam//de nas rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid kyis/ /slob ma'i lag tu rdo rje dril bu bzhag /slob mas thabs dang shes rab don rtogs bsam/ /slob mas rdor dril thugs kur bsnol bcug ste/ /thabs shes ya bral byang chub thob thabs med/ /thabs shes zung 'jug don de rtogs par bsgom/ /de yan dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs pa ste/ /mtha' rten rgyal srid sna bdun dbang bskur ni//shis brjod yin te don la bkra shis yin//bya spyod rgyud la sangs rgyas rnam thar dang //rjes mthun bkra shis rdza4 brgyad 'thob pa yin//rnal 'byor rgyud la yo ga rgyal po dang //chos lugs mthun 174

phyir rgyal srid sna bdun 'thob/ /bla med rgyud la sangs rgyas mtshan dpedang / /rjes su mthun par bkra shis rtags brgyad 'thob/ /bla med rgyas par 'dod na gsum ka sbyar//'di ru rgyal srid sna bdun bya ba yang //tha mal bud med rta dang glang po min/ /ngo bo 'phags pa'i nor bdun yin pa la/ /rnam pa rgyal srid sna bdun dngos lta bu/ /gtso bo'i thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul te/ /dper na slob mar bsko 'ja' gnang ba'i tshul/ /'khor lo nor bu gnyis po lag tu bzhag /btsun mo sku gzhogs g.yon dang blon po g.yas//dmag dpon rgyab dang rta glang gnyis po mdun/ /gnang sbyin tshul du byin par bsgom pa ste/ /deng sang stabs bde'i phyir du mgor 'grim kyang / /bsgom pa'i dus su de ni mi rung ste/ /dmag dpon mgo mnan glang chen steng nas brdzis/ /dmigs pa gsal na gnod cing rten 'brel ngan//de nas dam tshig khas len sbyin pa yang //gsang sngags 'di la sangs rgyas bka' las kyang / /bla ma'i bka' ni gnyan cing nus pa che/ /de phyir dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung dgos zhes/ /mi brjed mi nag la sogs phal cher gyi/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig ga la thub/ /de phyir da lta ci tsam nus ltar bsrung / /de nas rim bzhin rtogs pa na 'phar tshe/ /rim bzhin rgyud nas gsungs ltar bsrung snyam pa'i//mos pa mdzod ces gtso bos ci ltar brjod//de ltar rnal 'byor rgyud 'di nyams blangs pas//mi nas mir skye skye ba bcu drug tu//rnal 'byor rgyud 'di nyams su len 'gyur zhing / /de nas tshe 'phos rnam snang zhing khams sogs/ /rigs lnga gang du mos pa'i zhing khams su/ /dgongs pa rigs lnga dngos dang mnyam 'gyur zhing //don la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin na yang //cha lugs byang chub sems pa'i tshul bzung ste//rtag tu rigs bdag de la 175

chos nyan zhing / /sprul pa du mas 'gro ba 'dren par bshad/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang dang lam 'bras bu/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i bcu gsum dgongs thun la/ /'og a sus mgur gyi tshul du smras/ /deng sang bla ma che phra thams cad kun/ /spyod rgyud sgo nas gdul bya bsdu dgos pas/ /kun rig bsnyen pa them pa gal chen gda'/ /bsnyen pa ma them dbang dang byang bu dang //ro bsreg la sogs nyes pa che ba ste/ /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas zhes bya ba/ /yan lag ltung ba brgyad kyi ya gyal ba/ /ltung ba sbom po zhes ni bya ba'o/ /bsnyen pa tham nas sgrib sbyong sgo bdun dang / /rgyal ba rigs lnga la brten las tshogs lnga/ /sems dpa' bcu drug las tshogs bcu drug dang //de bzhin khro bo brgyad kyi las tshogs brgyad//sbyong rgyud spyi yi ras bris cho ga sogs/ /las tshogs rnams kyang bsgrub rung 'grub par gsungs//dad brtson ldan pa'i bī rya sā ga ras//dka' ba dang blangs zhun mar ngogs la bris/ /bdag 'dra'i phyi rabs rmongs pa mang po la/ /long bar mig byin bzhin du phan cher shog/le'u nyi shu them pa mang ga lam//lho sgo'i dmigs rim thar pa'i lam ston/tshokṣiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /kun rig rnam grol sgo chen gyi lho sgo'i cho ga'i dmigs rim thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bi da ye/ /sbyong rgyud gtsug dgu'i rgyud rgyal lha yi rnga/ /yo ga mkhas pa gsum gyis brdungs pa'i sgra/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar kun gyis rna bar snyan/ /176

de phyir rnam grol sgo chen phyag len ni/ /kun gyis shes shing dmigs rim gzhung tshigs gsal/ /'on kyang lho sgo'i cho ga bsdus drag pas/ /dmigs rim cung zhig slob dpon zhal las shes/ /blo gsal rnams la phan phyir 'dir brjod na/ /bdag mdun gnyis las mdun bskyed gtso che zhing / /tshe 'das lho phyogs gshin rje'i yul song ba/ /dkyil 'khor lho yi sgo nas 'gug dgos pas/ /bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /las lha rdor sems 'am ni gtso rkyang sku//rang nyid byas te dkyil 'khor lho sgo'i 'grum/ /seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa'i nga rgyal bzung / /byang bu bskyed tshar 'gug gzhug byed pa'i skabs/ /rang gi thugs ma'i 'od kyis gtso bo bskul/ /gtso bo'i 'od kyis sgo ba bzhi po bskul/ /sgo ba bzhi las rang 'dra grangs med spros//byams pa'i lcags kyus tshe 'das snying nas bzung / /snying rje'i zhags pas tshe 'das mgul nas bcings/ /rang dbang med par bkug nas byang bur bstim/ /lcags sgrogs ma yis dga' ba'i lcags sgrogs bsdam/ /ma tshar bar du gzhan du mi 'khyar byas/ /dril bu ma yis btang snyoms dril bu yi/ /shin tu dga' zhing yid sems bde ba bskyed/ /thugs rjes 'dzin byed lcags kyu'i dmigs pa'o/ /de nas ltung ba slong ba'i dmigs pa ni/ /gal te ngan song gsum du lhung tshar na//mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs ku'i 'od zer ni/ /lcags kyu'i dbyibs can rtse gsum 'og tu 'phros/ /ngan song gsum nas tshe 'das yar 'then te//rang dbang med par byang bur thim par bsgom/ /ltung ba slong ba'i sngags dang— phyag rgya bya/ /gal te sdig pas phyir 'then mi 'drong na/ /mdun bskyed thugs ma'i 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /sdig dang tshe 'das so sor phye4nas kyang / /drangs bsgom sdig pa grol ba'i sngags rgya byas/ /de yan tshe 177

'das bkug pa'i rim pa'o/ /spyir ni sbyor ba byed lugs ngos bzung ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas man nas srin bu yan/ /srog gcod gshed ma las kyi gshin rjer gsungs//'gro ba kun gyi dbugs ni len pa po//dpal ldan lha mo yin par rgyud las gsungs//gzhan yang dri za kun tu khyab byed dang //gnod sbyin rtogs 'dod 'byung po ba ra hi//de sogs nag phyogs bdud rigs mang po yis 'chi khar dbugs len phung po bdag tu 'dzin/ /tshe 'das gzugs bzung gson po rnams la gnod/ /tshe 'das la bsngos zas skom bar nas 'joms/ /tshe 'das yin par brdzus nas cha phrin bskur//de 'dra dpag tu med par yod pa'i tshul//tshe 'pho ji ltar 'gyur ba'i mdo las gsungs/ /de dag rnams dang phye bar ma byas na//gson po rnams la gnod pas gson bdud zer//gshin po yar 'gro mi bcug bcags pa'i phyir/ /de la gson bdud gshin lcags zhes bya'o//de la rigs ni dpag tu med na yang / /pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon gsum du bzung //klu gdon zhi ba pho gdon drag po dang //mo gdon zhi drag phyed mas sbyang bar gsungs//cog dog zlum po zhi ba'i gtor ma gsum//a kā ro yi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ /bhyo bi shwa lan gsum g.yas bskor tshe/ /dga' mgu bu lon lan chags byang bar bsam/ /changs rjes zur lnga 'dod yon lnga po mtshon//sor mo'i rjes drug rigs drug lan chags byang / /'bur chung bcu gnyis lo bdud bcu gnyis tshim//ting lo mar me'i gzugs yin lam sgron dang //chang bu sbyin pa zhi bar lan chags sbyangs//sum bha ni ni khro bo gnod mdzes sngags//lan gsum brjod cing g.yon du bskor ba'i tshe/ /chang bus tshim zhing khro bo'i sngags kyis skrag /gling bar mun pa'i nang du song bar bsam/ /de ni zhi drag phyed mar sbyang 178

ba'o//de nas bden stobs brjod pas dkar phyogs 'gro//nags phyogs gdug pa can rnams mi 'gro bas/ /bdag gis mdun bskyed gtso bo yid kyis bskul//gtso bo'i dgongs pa sgo srung brgyad la gtad/ /'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra'i bstod pa brjod tsam gyis//khro bo brgyad las rang 'dra dpag med 'phros//dper na bya spu rlung gis gtor ba bzhin/ /bgegs rnams bskrad nas khro bo rang rang bstim/ /de ni drag po'i sgo nas sbyang pa'o//dper na byi'u khra yis btang ba bzhin//gshed dang phral nas tshe 'das lus sems bde/ /bag phebs bshad pa'i chos rnams nyan par bsam/ /de nas rdzas gcig bsten pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ /tshe 'das snying mar yi ge kai nag po/ /de la lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa thim/ /kai yig sna bug g.yas thon til la thim/ /me nyid zhi ba'i thab khung me dpung dbus/ /khro bo hūṃ mdzad mthing nag rdor dril 'dzin/ /zhal ni me yi rang bzhin gdangs pa'i nang //sdig pa bsregs nas khro bo mi dmigs bsam//hūṃ mdzad bsgom pa bya spyod kun la 'thad/ /khro bo ma bsgom na yang mi 'gal te/ /phyag na rdo rjes 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs bsreg/ /ro rnams rgya mtshor 'dor ba'i tshul yin te/ /me de chu ru 'dor bas 'thus par gsungs//la las za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed//de ni bla med rgyud yin mi 'thad do/ /bye ma gtsang ma mi yis ma brdzis pa/ /sdig sgrib bsreg par bya ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ /sla ngar brngos la grang rjes yungs kur bsre//kun rig bsnyen dus sngags nas tshags na mchog/med kyang cho ga'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i skabs/ /phu 'grim byed pa shin tu gal che ste//ma sngags bye ma btab pas ci zhig phan/ /rang gi thugs kya'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskul/ /lha tshogs thugs kur zla steng sa bon mthar/ /rang sngags pho g.yas mo g.yon drag tu 179

'khor/ /de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros/ /rang rang mdzod spu'i sgo nas phyir thon nas/ /bye ma dang ni 'od zer dbyer med pa/ /tshe 'das la thim dug lnga'ildig sgrib rnams/ /ba mor nyi zer phog pa lta bur— bsgom/ /rgyas par dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha sngags dang / /brab sngags 'don cing 'bring bo rtsa rig dang //brab sngags gnyis bzlas bsdu na rtsa rig chog/tshan cher sngags pa'i bye ma yod gyur na//mi dang dud 'gro'i ro dang rus pa la//phyir ldog min kyang 'debs rgyu bskur na phan//de nas khrus kyi go ba len pa ni//thub rnams sdig sgrib chu yis mi bkru zhing //'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel te//'on kyang gdams ngag bstan nas sel gsungs pa//sngags dang ting 'dzin med pa'i chu gtsang gig/pha ma'i rus pa bkrus na phan no zhes//phyi rol pa rnams smra ba dgag phyir yin/ /sngags can chu yi rang ba zhin khrus byas na/ /lus can sdig pa 'dag zhes rgyud las gsungs/ /lha la dri ma med kyang khrus gsol bas/ /rang gzhan sgrib pa dag/ pa'i rten 'brel yin//mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor shar gyi khyams de na//khrus kyi khang ba rin chen ka bas btegs//logs gsum had por yod pa bsil g.yab 'dra/ /de nang mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsam//me long de dang de gnyis dbyer med yin/ /de la khrus gsol sku phyi na bza' gsol/ /rnam rgyal bum pa lha zhu'i bdud rtsi des/ lha tshogs sku lus bkrus pa'i byin rlabs can/ /khrus chab bum pa gzhan nam las bum blugs/ /de yis byang bu la ni khrus bya ste/ /rnam pa bdud rtsi ngo bo dkyil 'khor lha'i/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin chus/ /khrus byas nyon mongs drug po dag par bsgom//de nas dug bcom byed pa'i dmigs pa yang // 180

kusharma bya'i sgro bcas lag tu thogs/ /rma bya dug rnams 'joms pa'i mchog yinacing / /kha dog lnga ni ye shes lnga po mtshon/ /de dbus zla dkyil steng du hūṃ dkarapo//de mthar rtsa rig sngags kyis bskor ba las//'od zer kha dog rnam lnga 'phros pa yis/ /tshe 'das rgyud kyi dug lnga'i dug rnams kun/ /rtsig gseb du ba rlung gis ded ba ltar/ /phyi ru byung dmigs sgro yis byab tshul bya//ngag tu gzhung gi bden tshig de rnams brjod//de nas gzungs brjod chu yis khrus gcig bya//de nas sa chu me gsum mdun du bzhag /yod na rlung g.yab med na me long bzhag /tshigs bcad brjod cing bskor la dor ba'i tshe/ /gang ba'i nang du dug song zer ba'i don/ /tshe 'das rgyud kyi 'byung bzhi so so'i dug /'byung bzhi so so'i rdzas la thim par bsgom//rgyas par rtsa rig bsdu na tshigs bcad kyis//byang bu la ni bskor zhing phyir la dor/ /mjug tu gzungs bcas khrus gcig byed pa yin//gang ser ma ni shis brjod yin pa ste//bdag dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'das la ni me tog char 'bebs shing / /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis shis pa brjod par bsam//de nas dkyil 'khor lha la phyag btsal ba//tshe 'das lus ni grangs med sprul byas nas//rang gi ram bu bkyag cing phyag 'tshal bsam/ /gang gi drin gyi bla mar phyag 'tshal dang / /smra bsam brjod med chos skur phyag 'tshal te/ /rgyas par chos dbyings ye shes sho lo lnga//bsdu na chos sku nam mkha' sho lo gcig /de ni longs sku'i lha la phyag btsal yin/ /de nas thabs mkhas thugs rjes ston pa la/ /de nas grags chen shes rab sangs rgyas stong //sku yi dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rdo rje la//mkhyen rab thugs rjes mchog gi sprul sku la/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /de bzhin 181

sprul sku dang ni spyi la'o/ /de nas tshe 'das lus kun gcig tu bsdus/ /dkyi 'khor lha la skyabs tshol smre sngags ni/ /rang gi ngo chen tshul du zhu rogs dang //ོ'das lus rnying dor dang lus gsar len//da lta bar do'i yid lus dang bcopa/ /ci mdzad khyed shes tshul du 'bul bsam zhing / /gtso rgyal ma ni dbyangs bcas gyer ba yin/ /de yan lho sgo'i cho ga zhes bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid gtso rkyang nga rgyal gyis/ /tshe 'das khrid nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor la/ /bskor ba lan gsum byas nas shar sgo yi/ /g.yas 'gram rnam rgyal bum pa bzhugs pa ste/ /g.yon 'gram seng ge'i khri la rang nyid bzhugs//rang mdun 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad steng / /pad ma dkar po 'dab brgyad lte ba la/ /tshe 'das phus btsugs thal sbyar me tog thogs/ /ras dkar dri med gyon nas thal sbyo bsam/ /tshe 'das nyid kyis rjes zlos byed bsgom la/ /rgyud las/ ming la yang dbang bskur bar gyis shig gzugs brnyan la yang dbang bskur bar gyis shig gsungs phyir dbang bskur spyi dang mthun par bya/ /slob ma'i dbang bskur rdzo nas chog mod kyi/ /tshe 'das de nyid skye ba gzhan rnams su/ /rdo rje slob dpon go'aphang 'thob bya'i phyir//dbang gi dmigs rim zhal khrid rnal 'byor rgyud sgrub ngan songasgo gcod la blta bar bya'o//mchan/rdo rje slob dpon dbang yang rung ba yin/ /skye nga gzhan du 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sogs/ /'byor ba thob phyir rgyal srid dbadzobaskur rung //de nas 'dod yon zas bsngo'i dogs gcod la//pha ma sngar dus shi la lo dus bzhin/ /zas bsngo bya tshul mdo zhig mdo mang bzhugs/ /sngon tshe bod 'dir rgyal rabs nyer lnga la//dam chos ma dar bon lugs dar che bas//rgyal rgo rnams la bang so'i mchod pa zer//phal ba rnams la lo dus shi ba'i tshod//gtad 182

yarazhes pa mchod pa rgya cher dar/ /byang bu la ni rta yi srab mda' gtad//byang bu rta gong bskyon la bya ru zer/ /de bzhin khal ma'i sna thag go khrab sogs/ /zas dngachas ka byang bu la bsngos nas/ /de rnams slob dpon nyid kyis 'khyer srol byung / /bande'i lugs la de rnams med pa'i phyir/ /bod rnams ma mgu ban la ma dad pas/ /o rgyan la sogs paṇḍi ta rnams kyis//bon la dpe blangs zas gtad cho ga ni/ /dkar chog ces bya tsakli gtad rgyud mdzad/ /de nyid deng sang hor sogs phyi 'phrog la/ /kun rig zhi khro sogs la'ang sbyar ro skad/ /de yi lugs la shayang gtad rgyud yod/ /de min kun rig mi 'khrugs rang rkang la/ /tshe 'das rgyud sde 'og ma'i lhar bskyed pas/ /'dod yon sha chang bshams pa mi 'thad do//bsngos pa ma gtogs bshams pas mi 'thob pas/ /'dod yon lnga po phyag len bzhin du bsngo//bar do'i yid lus dri yis tshim pa'i phyir//gsur ni byed pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /sbyong rgyud 'grel bar khyi snying phru ba la//chags bzhin 'dod yon ma bsngos mi 'gro gsungs//dper na gal chen 'gron po thag ring du/ /'gro kha bza' btung gzab nas gtod dang 'dra//bar do'i skabs su bkres skom zhi ba dang //skye ba gzhan du 'byor ba'i rten 'brel 'gyur//'brog pa rnams kyis tshe 'das rnam shes kyis/ /rtsog lta byed 'dug bsam nas sdug dogs zer/ /'dod yon gson po rnams kyis za srol snang //zos kyang mi rung ba ni med na yang //bya khyi sprang po sogs la byin na legs/ /de nas byang bu bzhu ba'i phyag len ni/ /de yan rang nyid dkyil 'khor shar sgo'i drung / /gtso rkyang ngam ni rdor sems skur bzhugs pa/ /bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs mar zhugs//rang nyid bdag bskyed gtso bo'i nga rgyal bya/ /de nas bdag mdun rigs lnga yum bzhi 183

dang / /lha tshogs kun gyi sku las 'od zer ni/ /kha dog sna lnga me yi rang bzhin 'phros//slob ma rdor sems sku ru bskyed mod kyang //da dung bag chags yid lus dbang che bas//ma dag cha yi phung po lnga po de//rigs lnga'i sku las ye shes rnam lnga yi/ /me 'phros bsregs pas rigs lnga'i ngo bor bsgyur/ /yum bzhi'i sku las 'phros pa'i me dpung gis//sha khrag drod dbugs khams kyi bag chags bsregs//sems dpa' rnams las 'phros pa'i me dpung gis/ /mig sogs dbang po drug gi bag chags bsregs/ /sgeg sogs lha mo las 'phros me dpung gis/ /gzugs sgra dri sogs yul lnga'i bag chags bsregs/ /lha tshogs kun gyi dpral mgrin thugs ka nas/ /'od zer me dpung dkar dmar mthing 'phros pas/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgrib gsum bag chags bsregs/ /tshe 'das lus kyi rnam pa bsregs te sbyangs/ /sems ni a yig dkar po dri med gyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs kyi rtogs pa dang //dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs kyi ye shes dang //rnal 'byor rang gi nyams len rtogs pa dang //tshe 'das sems rgyud dbyer med gcig tu bsre//'brel pa thogs chog kurma pa mkhyen sogs/ /nyams len lta ba'i ngang nas rgyang 'bod bya/ /sher snying nang gi gzugs med sgra med ni/ /chos med bar gyi tshigs sdum de brjod nas//rka ka ni dang rtsa rig bzlas shing sreg/de nas dkon mchog rin chen sogs brjod tshe/ /shar sgo'i 'gram gyi rnam shes a yig de/ /yar yar bkyag nas bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar/ /bar snang khams su zla ba'i gdan la bzhag/de nas lam bstan mtshams 'dir dogs gcod ni/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnam snang yin pa'i phyir//rnam snang zhing khams stug po bkod pa ru//lam ston 'os kyang mi byed pa yi don/ /de ru sa brgyad ma thob skye mi srid/ /las lha rdo rje 184

sems dpa' yin pa dang / /tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mngon dga'i zhing du lam ston 'os na yang / /sa thob sems dpa' ma gtogs der mi skye/ /spyod rgyud gleng gzhir lta bu dri med de/ /mnar med gnas nas lha yul drangs pa'i phyir//dga' ldan gnas su lam bstan nges na yang //de ru skyes kyang phyir la lhung ba srid/ /mtshams med byas dang dam chos spangs ma gtogs//smon lam btab na skye bar nus pa dang //de ru skyes nas phyir mi ldog pa ni//'od dpag med kyi smon lam stobs yin par/ /'od mdo zhing bkod mdo sde gnyis las gsungs//dkyil 'khor 'di dang zhing de 'brel ba'i don//bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad chen po 'di/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin par gsungs/ /don la spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor yin//spyan ras gzigs la 'brel ba cher bzhag rnams/ /bde ba can du khrid nas 'ong ngo zhes/ /'od dpag med kyi drung du dam bca' mdzad/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba grangs med kyang / /dngos nyid bde ba can du rtag tu bzhugs/ /de don mdo sde rnams las rgya cher gsungs/ /bsdus don bka' chems bka' 'bum rnams na gsal/ /dkyil 'khor 'di dang 'brel phyir der lam ston//de yang rnga sgra'i rgyal po'i gzungs kyi tshig /'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /'od dpag med kyi zhing khams yod/ /su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa//zhing mchog de ru skye bar gsungs//tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyang //'od dpag med pa'i mtshan bzung nas//zhing mchog de ru 'gro bar gyis/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis lam ston te/ /nam mkha'i zla steng a yig de/ /tshe 'das rnam par shes pa dngos/ /dbang bskur ye shes sems dpa' dang / /dbyer med gcig tu gyur par gamigs/ /rang nyid kun rig bdag bskyed ni/ / 185

sku che ri rab tsam bsam la//shangs nas rlung zhig bus pa ni//shugs drag bskalaba'i 'thor rlung bzhin/ /zla ba a yig bcas par phog /sprin med dwangs pa'i skar mda' bzhin/ /bde ba can du ta ler song / /'od dpag med pa'i mdug drung du/ /me tog padma'i sbubs su bstims/ /padma 'dam sogs ngag gis gyer/ /sngags de rdzogs tshe yud tsam zhig /mi dmigs lta ba'i ngang la bzhag /de ma thag tu rdzus skyes su/ /gser mdog mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus/ /dge slong cha lugs can du gyur/ /sngon gnas rjes dran mngon shes kyi/ /slob dpon bka' drin rjes su dran/ /skad cig glog 'gyu ji bzhin du/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ongs nas kyang //e ma ho sogs ched du brjod//gtang rag mchod pa byas nas kyang //slar yang bde chen zhing gshegs bsam/ /de dag yid la bsgom bzhin du/ /gzhung tshig gatstshantu'i bar brjod/ /de nas bsngo bas rgyas 'debs bya/ /byang thal rtsa rig brjod bzhin du/ /sā tstsha 'debs sam gdab du bcug /chus mi 'jig pa'i gnas su bskyal/ /rjes chog man chad gzhung ltar ro/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis/ /bskul nas yi ge ba byas te/ /shing sbrul smin drug gnam gang dang / /mgo zla'i tshes gcig dgongs thun mtshams / /rā ga asus smras pa yin/ /lung 'dren mang po ma mchis kyang / /slob dpon rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang / /gzhung tshig mtshungs phyir the tshom med//phyi rabs dge bshes gsar bu rnams/ /'di la brten nas 'gro ba'i don/ /rgya che rgyun mi 'chad par shog /le'u nyer gcig pa'o maṅga lam̐/ / 186

bar do ngo sprod thos grol bsdus pa/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ bar do'i ngo sprod thos grol bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ye/ /'gro ba 'dren mdzad spyan ras gzigs la 'dud/ /thugs dam ma zin 'pho ba ma thebs sam/ /thebs shing zin kyang brling cha lta bu yi/ /byang bu phyir ldog zhor la ngo sprod ni//gang zag tha mal pa yi dbang byas te/ /kye ma kyi hud skal ldan che ge mo/ /khyod ni mi rtag pha rol dus las 'das/ /shi'am ma shi khyod rang yid mi ches/ /gdos bcas sha khrag lus med yid kyi lus/ /lo brgyad na tshod gar skye rigs drug mdog /nyi zla med kyang rang lus 'od kyis gsal/ /yid la dran tshe rdzu 'phrul ston par nus/ /gnas la nges med ri rtse rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /grogs la nges med shi gson su dang 'grogs/ /zas la nges med dri dang gsur gyis tshim/ /ma bsngos bar du zos kyang thob pa med/ /res 'ga' zag bcas mngon shes gsal ba na/ /skye ba snga phyi bar gsum dran na yang / /de ma thag tu brjed de 'khrul nas 'gro/ /stong gsum 'jig rten skad cig yud la 'khor/ /chu dang me long gzugs med grib ma med/ /bye ma sa 'bol nang du rjes mi dod/ /de tshe khyod rang bar dor 'khyams rtags yin//rang nyid shi bar shes te sems sdug che/ /ci drag gang drag snying ni gas la thug /da res dam chos ma 'grub 'gyod pa che/ /sdig ltung gang byas dran pas yid mi bde//gshin rje'i pho nyas sleb dogs skrag pa che/ /nye du rnams la yus che re mkhad che/ /tshur smras go 187

zhing phar smras mi go sdug/ma ngu nga ni 'di na yod ces 'bod/ /drung du song nas 'khyud cing kha gtugs kyang //ma mthong ngus pas rang nyid shi bar shes//re sa'i skyabs gnas bla mchod drung du 'gro/dam tshig mi gtsang cho ga ma dag dang //ting 'dzin mi gsal nyon mongs gang skyes mthong / /'di tshos nga bslus snyam du zhe sdang skye/ /myur du lus gcig e thob kun tu tshol/ /de 'dra'i snang ba khyod la 'char ba de//su yang ma len khyod rang 'khrul snang yin//zhag bzhi phan chad khyod kyi snang ba la/ /phyogs mtshams steng 'og 'ja' 'od thig les gang / /zhi ba'i lha tshogs mang pos nam mkha' gang / /gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od tso'abar//de dag thugs las ye shes lnga yi lam//'od zer bkrag la 'tsher ba snying gar zug/ /de dang mnyam du rigs drug 'khor ba'i lam/ /bkrag mdangs med pa drug kyang gshibs nas 'char//de tshe rigs drug lam du ma 'gro bar//ye shes lnga yi 'od lam rgyud du song //rigs lnga'i lha la gus pas gsol ba thob//de rjes yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams//dur khrod chas brgyad gar gyi nyams dgur ldan/ /rol mo'i sgra dang hūṃ phaṭa 'brug stong ldir/ /'jig rten khams kun shig shig yom yom 'gul/ /khyod nyid bar do'i lam nas bsu phyir 'byon/ /ma 'jigs ma skrag yi dam ngos bzung gyis/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khridapar 'gyur/ /de rjes khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams/ /khyod nyid bar do'i lam nas bsu phyir 'byon//'jigs su rung zhing blta bar mi bzod pa//hūṃ phaṭa thug chom 'brug stong dus gcig sgra/ /gnas sa bar snang thams cad khro bos gang / /sod sod rgyob rgyob 'od zer mtshon cha'i char//dper na nyes chen btson du bzung ba bzhin/ /bros pas mi thar gar song de 'dras gang / /de dag gzhan 188

nasa'ong ba ma yin te//khyed rang lus lha zhi khro'i lha tshogs yin//dper na dgra 'jigs che ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bsu mi'i dmag dang dgra bo nor ba bzhin/ /ma skragam sngangs ma 'bros dad gus gyis//bdun gnyis phan chad re zhig 'jigs skrag yal//bdun phrag re re'i bar na 'jigs skrag re//kha char mun nag dmag gis ded pa dang / /khro bo gshin rje gcan gzan tshogs kyis ded/ /mdun du g.yang sa dkar dmar nag pos chod//ri bo stong nyil rgya mtsho stong 'khrugs sgra//nags chen me mched sgra dang rlung chen sgra/ /'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi ya nga'i 'phrang brgyad 'char//de tsho khyod rang sems kyi 'khrul snang yin //khyod la 'dus byas sha khrag lus med pas/ /mtshon cha g.yang sa me chus 'chi rgyu med/ /de don yid la zungs la 'jigs skrag spang / /kun rig sgo nas 'gro don byed mkhan rnams/ /sangs rgyas sprul ba yin par thub pas gsungs/ /bla mchod ma dag mi gtsang bsam pa rnams//khyod rang snang ba ma dag 'khrul ba yin//dad gus bskyed dang mi bslu khyod la phan//khyod kyi mi lus thob 'dod lus 'tshol ba//khyod rang 'khor bar 'khyams 'dod blo nor yin/ /skye rga na 'chi grangs med mi 'tsher ram mi lus lha lus len 'dod bsam pa spangs//khyed la phan phyir sangs rgyas phrin las kyi//shing rta 'dren mdzad nged cag rnams yin pas//dad gus skyed la ma yengs tshig don nyon/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i phyir ldog dbang bskur gyis/ /sgrib pa sbyangs rjes ma chags ma zhen par//gtan du bde zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas//nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du song //sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i zhal blta zhing //dam chos nyan pa'i bsam pa ma brjed cig/ces brjod de nas phyir ldog dbang bskur dang / /chags zhen spang phyir zas bsngos lam bstan nas/ / 189

rnam shes spar zhing bsngo smon rgya yis gdab/ /bla ma bīrya sā ga ras bskul nag / rta lo tha skar zla ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin/ /dkor sgye rā ga a sus smras pa de/ /dkor 'dod brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bris//le'u nyer gnyis pa'o/ /maṅga lam̐/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing gi bsil grib/0ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ dgra jag chom rkun bcing ba'i gdams pa mya ngan med pa'i shing gi bsil grib ces bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru dhā ki mā rī rtsu//gcig pur sgrub pa byed 'dod che ba yi//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho zhes bya bas//nyam chung gcig pur dam chos sgrub pa la//dgra dang chom rkun gnod pa 'byung dogs pas/ /de nyid srung bzlog gdams pa dgos zhes zhus/ /bla ma khyed nyid yon tan sna mang bas/ /grwa ba med pa'i gcig 'dug mi dgos te//chibs rta grwa khal nor phyugs brang nga sogs//ha cang mang na dgra bo'i g.yab mo yin/ /snyigs dus log spyod sdig rgyal stobs ldan mang / /phra mar dga' bas nyes med srog dang phral/ /de dag bsrung ba'i gdams pa mang mchis kyang / /gsar rnying mdo rgyud gter kha thams cad nas//'od zer can las lhag pa med par gsungs/ /de la zhal phyag mang po 'khor mang sogs/ /rdor phreng sogs nas dkyil 'khor cher bshad kyang / /phyag gnyis ma 'di rtog pa'i rgyud dang mthun//sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dgongs gter gnyis nas gsungs//ngo bo dpal ldan lha mo rang byung ma/ /chom rkun bzlog byed bcu bzhi mā rī rtsu/ /de yi man ngag zab mo 190

'dilta ste/ /dbang lung thob dgos nyams su len pa ni/ /skad cig dran rdzogs 05 blo ba'i steng //rang nyid 'od zer can ma gser mdog mdzes//zhal gcig zhi'adzum thor tshugs dbu rgyan can/ /stod g.yogs sngon po ang rag sham thabs dkar/ /bcu drug na tshod dar dang rin chen brgyan/ /phyag gnyis g.yas g.yon khab dang skud pa 'dzin/ /phyed skyil phag rgod ser po'i steng na bzhugs//rang gi g.yas g.yon bsrung bya thams cad gsal/ /de rgyab nyi zla'i ga'u rim pa gsum/ /nang ma nyi ma 'og dang zla ba steng / /bar ma nyi ma g.yon dang zla ba g.yas/ /phyi ma nyi ma steng dang zla ba 'og /nyi zla'i 'od zer shin tu bkrag che bas/ /sus kyang blta bar mi bzod mig tshig go /de rgyab phag rgod ser po'i ra ba ni/ /sum rim shin tu che zhing 'jigs su rung / /kun kyang phyi ru kha gyu ngur sgra sgrogs/ /rang gi thugs kur zla steng saṃ yig mthar//sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor las 'od 'phros pas/ /rgya gar mya ngan med pa'i shing drung nas/ /rang 'dra dpag med spyan drangs dbyer med thim/ /ye shes dbang thob rnam snang dbu brgyan gyur/ /dmigs pa bsgom zhing ci nus bsnyen pa bya/ /o mā rī spyo swā hā/ /snga dro la sogs srung ba'i sngags ni 'di/ /oṃ mā 'itse 'od zer can bdag cag mi nor thams cad la skyobs shig swā hā/ /phyi dro dgra chings rkun chings sngags dmigs 'di/ /rang gi thugs las sprul ba'i lha mo dang / /rang bzhin gnas nas byon pa'i lha mo ni/ /rang 'dra phag ser zhon pas 'jig rten khyab/ /glog ltar 'khyug cing rlung ltar phyogs bcur rgyug /rang la gnod pa'i dgra jag chom rkun dang / /ngan smras phra ma byed pa thams cad kyi/ /kha dang mig rnams lha mos drub par bsgom/ /oṃ mā rī rnye badra ta li/bdā li/ba rā li/ba ra ha mu khi/sarba duṭī/pra duṭī nee/gnod byed dgra 191

jag chom rkun thams cad tsakṣurmu khaṃ brnya bharnya swa hā/ /de dag mang nyung gang dang༈bstun te bzlas//de ni rgyun khyer bsrung ba yin pa ste/ /mtshams bsdams gong gi dmigs pa 'bru drug po/ /drug 'bum bzla ba bsnyen pa'i tshad du bshad/ /'ani rang gud du bsnyen pa ma grub kyang / /sgrol dkar ku ru kulle lo ma can/ /rang byubargyal mo rnams ni rgyud gcig gsungs/ /gzhan gyi bsnyen pa thon na don gyi4 gcig /gal te gong du bsnyen sgrub ma thon yang / /rgyun du bsnyen pa thun re bya 4 'am/ /yang na gal chen dus du tshan cher bzla/ /dgra jag chom rkun rgyal po'i 'jigs pa la//'di las zab pa'i gdams ngag yod ma yin//rta drel la sog4 gal chen srung ba la/ /bu mo gtsang mas bkal na rab yin gyi/ /bal gtsang srungaḥskud phra sbom gang yang rung //ring thung mda' tshad 'am ni 'dom —tshad tsam//dang4 po lha bsgom bsnyen pa cung tsam bya/ /de nas mig btsum kha bsdams dbugs yi btang //srung skud re la mdud pa nyer gcig re//yid bzlas sngags tshar re dang mdud pa sprad/ /srung skud gcig tshar mtshams su dbugs gtong rung / /mdud’ pa re re lha mo re rer bsgoms//sngags ring brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas la sngags//ye shes lha mo grangs med bkug la bstim/ /lha mo 'od zhu mdud par thim par bsgom//rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas pa de//mi dang rta drel nor phyugs gang btags de/ /dgra jag chom rkun gcan gzan srung ba'i mchog /las tshogs de ni rgyud dang gdams ngag mthun//rang gi yi dam gtso bo gcig yin te//sgrub ripa mang song bka' srung skud dkar po yin gsungs/ rgya dam na yang / /snying gi slob bu brtson 'grus khyed la gdams/ /gsar rnying bka' gter gnam chos la3 sogs kyi/ /gdams ngag bye ba ring bsrel gcig tu bsdus/ /tshig nyung don che 192

nyams su myong bas grub/ /sba 'os gsal bkod nyes pa lha la bshags//dge bas snyigs dus dam chos spyod pa kun//dgra dang chom rkun 'tshe ba bral bar shog/kha smras gleng gzhi gshe skur med par shog /de skad gnam lo shugs 'chang rā ga'i mdog /chom rkun srung byed khyi yi zla ba yi/ /nyer brgyad dgra 'joms gshin rje rgyu ba'i nyin//kun gyi mig 'gribs mun pa smag pa'i dus//sngags nag rā ga a sus smras pa de/ /ru pa brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod//rtags ni sbrul dang byi la bong bu dang //rta dang glang chen ma he dred dang khyi//phan rjen 'thab dang rang nyid skrag pa rmis//sngags ni da rung (da dung /)gnyis 'gyur la sogs bzlas//rgya mtsho brgal dang ri bo la gnas dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems la sogs mjal ba dang / /bud med gzhon nu mdzes ma rgyan ldan dang //'od zer can ma mjal dang lung ston dang //dri bzang 'thul dang mar me 'dzin pa sogs//'grub pa'i rtags de mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'o/ /zla drug gsum mam nyer gcig la sogs dus/ /'bum phrag nyer bzhi yang na bye chung gcig/tha ma drug 'bum bzlas kyang 'grub pa ste/ /'bru drug kho na yin yang gsum ka brtsi/ /ces pa 'di yi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mchod phreng rin po ches mdzad pa nas khol du phyungs te/ blo dman rnams la phan phyir sgrub thabs 'di yi mchan bur bris pa'o/ /oṃ mā rī tsi swā hā/ /tse ye zhes pa'i ye de mgyogs dgos gsungs so/ /le'u nyer gsum pa'o maṅga lam̐//193

gson byang bzhu thabs 'brel tshad don ldan/kṣa'iri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ spros med spros bcas kyi gson byang bzhu thabs mtha' gcod dang bcas pa 'brel tshad don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo buddha bornyi sa twa ya/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i lha lam na/ /gdams ngag 'od stong ldan pa 'di shar bas/ /'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis mun pa mthar byed cing / /bshes gnyen gsar bu'i blo yi pad mo 'byed/ /kye ma thob dka'i dal 'byor lus thob nas/ /tshe gang sdig la spyod 'bras zas dang nor/ /cha shas tsam zhig bshes gnyen rnams la phul//gson shog dgos zhes phyi ma'i bde skyid re/ /de bas snying rje ba ni ci zhig yod/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho la sogs rang nyid kyi//yi dam gang yin skad cig dran rdzogs gsal//rlung zhig tshur rngub kho yi sdig sgrib rnams/ /rang la bstim pas gzi brjid 'od du 'bar/ /rlung zhig phar bus rang gi bsod nams tshogs/ /kho la bstims pas bde ba'i rgyu 'bras thob/ /kho yi snying dbus paṃ yig nag po la/ /thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib thams cad thim/ /rkang mthil gnyis las yi las rlung g.yos pas/ /lte ba'i ram̐ las me 'bar me lce des/ /baṃ yig gyen ded sna sgo g.yas pa nas/ /sdig pa rwa can gzugs su thon pa de/ /mdun du rang byung me yi dkyil 'khor dbus/ /dran rdzogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing / /khro mo'i chas rdzogs rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /me yi rang bzhin zhal ni rab gdangs pa'i/ /nang du sdig sgrib song bas dngos med 194

bsreg/ /khro mo me dkyil mi dmigs 'ja' ltar yal/ /sbyin bdag lte 'og gtum mo'ime 'bar bas/ /ma dag phung khams skye mched sdig sgrib bsreg/ /dag pa ye shes yi dam lha skur bsgyur/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /phyogs bcu'isangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ni/ /rdor sems la sogs sku mdog dkar po yi/ /rnam par spyan drangs kho yi lus la bstim/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa nad gdon zhi/ /rin 'byung la sogs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /'dzam ser la sog sku mdog ser po yi/ /rnam par spyan drangs kho la sib sib bstim/ /tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par byas/ /tshe dpag la sogs dbang gi lha tshogs rnams/ /mtsho la char babs bzhin du de la bstim/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang du 'dus par gyur/ /bde mchog phyag rdor la sogs drag po'i lha/ /bu yug 'tshubs ltar spyan drangs de la bstim/ /bdud bgegs thar pa'i bar chad tshar bcad bsam/ /de nyid zla gdan steng du me dpung dbus/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pas srung bar bsam/ /de ni phyi yi gson shog dmigs pa ste/ /bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyi don//chos kyi dbang phyug gsung rgyun las byung ngo/ /de nas sbyin bdag lus dang rang gi lus/ /gcig tu bsres la rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'am/ /phag mo la sogs bla med lha ru bsgom/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yang gsal btab ste/ /lte 'og a thung gtum mo'i me 'bar bas/ /sdig sgrib ma dag phung khams skye mched bsreg/ /bum chen bzung ngam ma lcog bar rlung bzung / /phyogs bcu'i yi dam dpal bo mkha' 'gro yi/ /sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar spyan drangs te/ /spyi bo'i haṃ la thim pas byang sems babs/ /rtsa 'khor bzhi gang dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes/ /bde stong 'dres pas bde drod me dpung 'bar/ / 195
