bdud bgegs bar chad dpag tshad mi gnas bsam/ /de ni nang ltar gsod byang bzhu thabs ste//pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gzhung dang //gtum mori khrid rim rnams kyi zur nas 'byung //rtsa brgyud bla ma yid dam lha tshogs dang //sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi sku gsungs thugs/ /rang dang sbyin bdag lus ngag yid gsum rnams//dbyer med bsres la nyams len dad pa gzhag/dang pobasre ba'i dmigs pa byas mod kyi//de nas dbyer med 'dres pa'i nyams rtog5 'char//ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba dang //rnam pa 'gag med 'char bar khyad par med/ /stong nyid me yis dngos 'dzin sgrib gnyis bsregs//de ni phyag rdzogs khrid rim kun nas gsal/ /gsang ba de kho na yi gson shog yin/ /de la byang bu bri sogs spros bcas med//yon bdag sgrib sbyong rang gi dkor sbyong la//nam dran yang yang bsgom pa man ngag yin//de ni spros med dmigs pa'i gson byang ngo/ /de nas spros bcas gzugs dang ming byang bris/ /kun rig zhi khro mi 'khrugs pa la sogs/ /cho ga cha tshang skabs la babs pa'i tshe/ /'di ru khug dang mchis par gyur mi brjod//skad cig nyid la 'di dang dbyer med gsal//sbyin bdag de dang byang bu dbyer med bsgom/ /gal te sbyin bdag sa thag ring na yang //bdag bskyed ri rab tsam bsgoms drung du 'ong //tshe 'das zer sa rnams su tshe ldan 'dzud/ /zas bsngo lam bstan gnas spar gsum po sgyur/ /de min gshin po'i dus dang 'dra ba la/ /gtum mo'i me sbar las bzhi'i lha tshogakhangabastim//dmigs pa gong du bshad pa de nyid sbyar//bsod nams ri bo la sogs bkra shis brjod//de ni spros bcas gson shog phyag len yin//de ni rang lugs rang gi nyams myong dang //rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang lam 'bras dang //dkyil 196

chog kun gyi slob ma sta gon skabs/ /za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed byas nas/ /tilanag kho na sbyin sreg gcig pu des/ /gson shog go chod ming yig bsreg pa'ilugs/ /rgyal tshabs grags pa mchog dbyangs kyis mdzad dang / /'bri gung zhabs drung mdzad pa'i yig cha la//brten nas deng sang bla ma kun gyis mdzad//nad pa yun ring na'am kug che na/ /yig bsgyur dkyil 'khor zhal bsgyur byed pa'i thabs/ /gto gcig yod pa sgom pa rnams kyis byed/ /bla mas byed rgyu'i dkyil 'khor zhal bsgyur ni//dgug gzhug zas bsngo gnas spar ma gtogs pa//phyir ldog gzhung ltar byas nas tshe dbang bskur//de yis zhag chen 'chi ba bzlog par bshad//de ni slob dpon 'ga' yi gsung las byung //khrus dang dug bcom dbang bskur la sogs pa/ /nad gdon 'jom pa'i mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /sbyong rgyud gra lnga sogs las gsal ltar yin/ /snye mo la sogs gtsang phyogs yul gru 'gar//gson dge byed zer zhag 'ga' cho ga gsog//mjug tu sbyin bdag de la phyir ldog ni/ /dgug gzhug zas bsngo gnas spar ma gtogs byed/ /theg dman mdo sde bden bzhi'i chos 'khor las//rang gi byas pa'i las 'bras chud mi za/ /ma byas pa yi las dang 'phrad mi srid//gzhan gyis byas pa gzhan la smin pa med/ /gsungs phyir tshe 'das rjes nas chos byas kyang / /dmigs med bsngo ba'i rgya yis ma thebs na/ /gshin pos mi 'thob gson po nyid la smin//de phyir rje btsun mi la ras chen gyis//mdang sum nor bu bor ba la//rkun ma'i rgyab tu rdo 'phangs 'dra/ /gsungs phyir gson che'i dge ba yod nges zer/ /de yang legs par dpyad na mi 'thad med/ /de tshe dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing sogs/ /lam sbyang bton la 'gal ba med pa ste/ /so so'i skye bo tshogs lam nas 197

bzung ste//sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro ba'i lam ston yin//da lta khrid rnams zhu ba'ang de yin mod//de bzhin pad ma 'dams sogs lam ston yang //'don du rung ste myur du mi 'gro yang //lo zla 'ga' zhig song nas 'gro dgos pa'i/ /sa rgyus med pa'i lam de bslab dang 'dra/ /de nas rnam shes spar chog mi bya bar/ /lo brgya thub sogs tshe 'phel bkra shis bya/ /de dag bshes gnyen 'ga' yi gsung las byung / /sngon tshe chos kyi dbang phyug zhal bzhugs skabs/ /gson shog rgyud sde rnams nas gsungs pa med//rung dang mi rung rtsod gzhi mang po byung //gang nas bshad ces rje yi drung du zhus/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las bshad ces gsungs/ /de ru dmigs rim don gyis gsal mod kyi/ /ming dang gzugs bri bsreg pa mi gsal yang / /ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa ni/ /ming la yang ni dbang bskur bar gyis shig /zhes gsungs pa yi don la 'thus pa ste/ /spyir ru rgyud tshig sho lo ka rer yang / /dngos bstan don dang shugs las bstan pa'i don/ /'bru don tshig don rnam pa bzhi re 'byung / /shi byang dngos su bstan pa'i zhar nyid la//gson byang yang ni shugs la bstan pa yin//srong btsan sgam pos rang ro rang gis skyel/ /rang gi phung po rang gis sreg thabs gsung / /de yang don gyis gson byang nyid du nges/ /de bzhin gtum mo'i khrid rim thams cad dang //phyag rdzogs bsre ba ro snyoms dmigs rim kun / /bdag gzhan kun gyi sgrib gnyis sreg thabs lags/ /de phyir gson shog ma gsungs smra mi rung / /sngon dus mchog gi sprul skus gson shog mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos sku tshe la gnod gsungs/ /de phyir ma mdzad zer ba mi bden te/ /bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud de las/ /de ltar bsgom na ting nge 'dzin/ /nyams par mi 'gyur 198

'phel bar 'gyur/ /gsungs phyir sku tsher gnod don ma mchis so/ /gson shog mang po bzhus na sbyin bdag de//tshe thung zer ba mi bden ser sna'i gtam//nus ldan mang pos dgug gzhug gnas spar rnams/ /yang yang byas na tshe la gnod mod kyi/ /de dag byed srol med pas ga la gnod/ /rin 'byung tshe dpag dzam bha lha la sogs/ /bstim pas tshe bsod slar la 'phel ba yin/ /glud gtor khrus dang dug bcom la sogs kyi//rkyen bzlog rim gro zhar la 'ong ba yin//shi gson byang bu byed lugs phal cher 'dra/ /dur ngo yod kyang dur los 'ong ba yin/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i/ /bskul ba po des yi ge pa byas te/ /shing sbrul smin drug zla ba'i nyer dgu'i nub/ /dgu gtor tshar skabs rā ga asus smus/ /lung 'dren tshig rnams yid la ma nges pas/ /them tshom yod na lung khungs rgyud rnams gzigs/ /don rtsa bsgom bya yid la gsal ba rnams/ /gab sbas med par gzhan la phan phyir bkod/ /'gro don 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog / /le'u nyer bzhi pa'o maṅga lam̐//tshe 'das gnas 'dren thugs rje'i lcags kyu/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ tshe 'das gnas 'dren kyi dmigs rim thugs rje'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo budha boddhi sa twa'i lha lam khyon yangs par/ /thugs rje smon lam stobs kyis chu 'dzin rngam mthug de/ /gdams ngag dbyar rnga'i chem 'ur drag po 'dis bskul bas//'gro ba mi rnams 199

'khor ba'i tsha gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs shog /rdo rje gdan pa chen po yi/ /rgyud sde bzhi po bla med ltar/ /skad cig dran rdzogs bsgom gsungs pas/ /gdams ngag 'di la the tshom spangs/ /thob dka'i mi lus rin po che/ /mdang sum rmi lam bzhin du bor/ /sngangs skrag bar do'i 'phrang la 'grim/ /ngan song gsum po g.yang sa che/ /tshe 'das de dag snying re rje/ /rlung zhig phar la bus pa yis//rang gi bde skyid dge rtsa rnams//tshe 'das rnams la sib se thim//lus sems bde bas khyab par bsgom//rlung zhig tshur la rngub pa yis/ /tshe 'das sdig sgrib sdug bsngal kun/ /lhag med bsdus nas rang la bstim/ /de ni mdo yi dgongs pa yin/ /de nas skad cig dran rdzogs la/ /rang nyid bcom ldan kun rig ni/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs par bsgom/ /dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med la/ /spyan 'dren dbang bskur mi dgos so/ /thugs kur zla steng hūṃ dkar gyis/ /mtha' la rtsa rig g.yas su 'khor/ /de las 'od zer kha dog lnga/ /mdzod spu'i sgo nas phyir thon te/ /tshe 'das de yis gtso byas pa'i/ /khams gsum sems can kun la phog /ngan song 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /dug lnga'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag /rtsa rig ci nus brjod par bya/ /'od zer tshur 'dus thugs kur thim/ /rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa'i/ /kun rig mngon rtogs don mthun yin/ /de nas skad cig gnas 'gyur te/ /rang nyid rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa//longs sku'am sprul sku gang yang rung //glang po'i khri la bzhugs par bsgom/ /thugs kur zla steng hūṃ mthing mthar/ /gzungs kyis g.yas su bskor ba las/ /'od zer mthing ga rab 'phros pas/ /tshe 'das thog drangs 'gro kun gyi/ /las kyi sgri pa thams cad ni/ /ba mor nyi zer phog ltar 200

bsgom/ /kai ka ni yi gzungs bzlas so/ /spyan snga chos grags la sogs pas/ /mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs don bsdus yin / /de nas skad cig gnas 'gyur te/ /rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /thugs por zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis/ /mgrin par dag pa rig 'dzin lha/ /glad par khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad/ /me long gzugs brnyan bzhin du bsgom/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i sa bon te/ /yig brgya kho na bzlas par bya/ /thugs mar zhi ba'i lha tshogs las/ /'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros//dmigs yul tshe 'das rnams la phog/sdig sgrib thams cad sangs se dag /rang gi thugs ku'i 'od zer gyis/ /tshe 'das de nyid gtums byas te//skar mda' chad pa bzhin du ni//bde ba can du 'phangs par bsgom//oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ tabyathā/ha ne ha ne a no li mi ta ye/gu ru ye/ badzra sa twa hūṃ swā hā/de ni gnam chos gdams pa'o//de nas rang gi thugs ka nas/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ /shar lho'i dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal/ /tsardon shing gi sdong po'i rtser/ /phyag drug mgon po bzhugs pa ste/ /spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs par bsgom/ /mgon po'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa //dbang rtags rang chas bzhugs pa de'i//sku las 'od zer sngon po 'phros//tshe 'das sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsgom/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /tshe 'das gus pas skyabs su mchi//'brel thogs tshe 'das thams cad kyi//rigs drug skye sgo bcad du gsol//bde ba can du lam sna drongs/ /de ltar ngag gam yid kyis ni/ /gsol ba btab pas mgon po yi/ /phyag drug rigs drug skye sgo bcad//rang 'dra'i sprul ba dpag med kyis/ /hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ru'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /thar pa 'thob tu mi 'jug pa'i/ /gshed dang lan chags za 'dre rnams//gling bar mun pa'i nang du bros/ /'brel 201

thogs tshe 'das thams cad ni/ /phyag g.yon zhags pas rke nas btags/ /rang dbang med par khrid nas kyang / /mgon po'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /'brel thogs tshe 'das thams cad khyer/ /bya khyu 'grogs nas 'phur ba ltar/ /bde ba can du gshegs par bsgom/ /oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣi kṣe ṭa bisnan bi na 4ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ / 'brel thogs tshe 'das thams cad/ oṃ pad me pad me padma sam bha we ma hā su ṣa wati gatstshantu swā hā/ mgon po'i las tshogs las byung ba/ /cung zhig gsal bar byas pa yin/ /de rnams gsang sngags phyis 'gyur lugs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho gsang 'dus dang / /bde mchog rta mgrin gur drag sogs/ /bla med lugs rnams mtshungs pa ste/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang sbyar na/ /rang nyid lha dgu'i ting 'dzin gsal/ /thugs las lha mo lcags kyu ma/ /grangs med 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi//lcags kyus sa bon dṛ nas bzung //lha mo byams pa'i ngo bo yin//snying rje'i lha mo zhags pa ma/ /dpag med spros pas mgul nas bcings/ /rang dbang med par mdun du bkug /dga' ba'i lha mo lcags sgrog mas/ /lcags bcuga'abros mi shes par byas/ /btang snyoms lha mos dril bu'i sgras/ /shin tu dga' zhing mgu bar byas/ /rang gi sna g.yas rlung bus pas/ /'od zer dkar po kho la phog /tshe 'das 'od du ltem gyis zhu//rlung zhig nang du rngub pa yis//tshe 'das sna bug g.yon nas drangs/ /rang nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ /spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo na/ /sku yi spyan ras gzigs dang mjal/ /dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ /denas dbu ma'i rgyud nas babs/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ /gsung gispyan ras gzigs dang mjal/ /mchog dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na/ /thugs kyi spyan ras gzugs dang mjal/ /dga' bral ye shes 202

rgyudal skyes/ /lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo na/ /yon tan spyan ras gzigs dang mjal/ /lhan skyes dga' ba rgyud la skyes/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo na/ /phrin las spyan ras gzigs dang mjal//bde stong rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/ /rnam shes byang sems ngo bo ste/ /phag mo yum gyi bha gar babs/ /hriḥ yig dmar po gcig tu gyur/ /de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros//sems can kun gyi sgrib pa byang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs bsdus/ /tshur 'dus hriḥ la thim pa yis/ /pad ma hri ཿ yis mtshan par gyur/ /de nyid kyang ni 'od du zhu/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs/ /sku chung yan lag dod par gyur/ /slar yang yab yum snyoms 'jug sgra//ha ha si si kun tu ru//badzra bhrig ces sgra bsgrags pas//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams//rang dbang med par spyan drangs te//rang nyid yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ /byang sems thig le'i ngo bor zhu/ /yab kyi rdo rje'i sbubs nas babs/ /bha ga'i sras la dbang bskur te/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis sdig sgrib dang / /sku gang dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob/ /dbang rtags rigs bdag mtshan par gyur/ /yum gyi rtsibs bar g.yon pa nas/ /thon te mdun gyi nam mkha' ru/ /zla ba'i gdan la 'khod pa la/ /rang gi shangs bug g.yas pa nas/ /shin tu shugs drag rlung zhig 'phros//zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la phog pas//rtsal po che yi mda' 'phangs ltar/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du song / /'od dpag med kyi thugs skar thim/ /'od dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs/ /bdag dang tshe 'das lus ngag yid/ /dbyer med spros bral phyag rgya che'i/ /lta ba'i ngang la yun ring gzhag /'di ni bla med rgyud sde dang / /rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa yi/ /gzhung nas o rgyan chen pos gsungs/ /de don go bder bkod pa'o/ /bla med lugs 203

'di bsgom pa la/ /bskyed rdzogs nges shes thob pa dgos//phal gyis bsgom par mi rung ngo / /'phral du tshe 'das ming gzugs can/ /med kyang 'brel thogs tshe 'das mang / /'brel thogs kun la phan pa'i thabs/ /rang nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho'am/ /gsang 'dus sku ru gsal ba yi/ /thugs ma'i hrīḥ las 'od 'phros pas/ /'brel thogs gshin po gson po yi/ /gtsor byas sems can thams cadakyis//spyi bor spyan ras gzigs dmar po//rgyan med bzhengs nas bzhugs par sgom/ /phyag g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon bum pa/ /bum nang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babasaṇapas/ /sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib bkrus/ /thugs ga'i hriḥ las trīḥ zhig 'phros/ /spyi bo nas zhugs thugs kur song / /de yi 'od kyis sems can kun/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi skur gyur te//kun gyis rang gi ram bu bkyag/yig bdun sgra yis 'jig rten gang / /yig bdun mjug tu sngags 'di sbyar//a ra pa tsa mi tatrīḥ dā ya swā hā//'di ni 'gro don char rgyun na//sangs gling gter khar o rgyan gsungs//'khor ba dong sprugs dmigs rim ni//rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs la/ /phyag stong spyan stong ri rab tsam/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya na//rang 'dra bye ba phrag brgya ste//thams cad rang nyid yin par bsgom/ /bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring ngam/ /yi ge drug pa gang 'dod bzlas//rang gi sngags sgra bsgrags pa yis//sems can kun gyis ram bu bkyag/nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams kun/ /sngags sgras 'ur chom 'jig rten g.yos/ /'brel thogs shi gson gtsor byas pa'i/ /sems can kun gyi sgrib pa dag /kun kyang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro 'dul sku ni kho nar gyur/ /bskyed rim de ni mi bsdu ste//nyams len stong nyid ngang la gzhag/de ltar bskyed 204

rim gsal ba yis/ /yig drug brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas kyang / /thugs rje chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dam ste/ /gter kha gsar rnying 'ga' nas 'byung / /'khor ba dong sprugs ting 'dzin yin//sems can kun gyi don dmigs nas/ /unḍi ṣa ni lan gsum brjod/ /de yi dge bas 'brel thogs kun/ /bde chen zhing skye'i bsngo smon bya/ /gsar rnying mdo rgyud kun gyi don//dge slong rā ga a su yi/ /yid la sngar nas gsal ba la/ /ma pham drag lu tshe 'das pa'i/ /rkyen byas rgyun khyer nyams len skabs/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis/ /bskul nas yi ge pa byas te/ /shing sbrul smin drug zla ba yi/ /dmar po'i tshes gcig dgongs thun 'tshams/ /bris la 'gal 'khrul mchis na bshags/ /dge bas 'gro don rgya che cher shog/le'u nyer lnga pa'o maṅga lam̐//yi dam phyi sgrub sngags kyi 'drug sgra/tshosari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las//bla med gsang sngags gsar rnying yi dam mkha' 'gro spyi yi phyi sgrub sngags kyi 'brug sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru dre wa ḍā ki ni sarba si rnyirgyu/ /gsar rnying bla med rgyud sde thams cad kyi/ /sgrub pa'i gnad dang dmigs rim shes gal che//dbang thob sgrub thabs shes pa'i ri khrod pas//thog ma nyid du phyi sgrub nyams su len//phug gtor nang mchod mchod pa rnam lnga dang / /ḍā dril sngon 'gro gtor ma tsam zhig las/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs sgrub rdzas gzhan mi dgos//nyin re sngon 'gro gtor ma re res chog/thun 205

zhes bya ba cho ga'i mgo brtsams nas/ /bsnyen pa byas ste bdag bskyed ma bsdu par//de bar ngag ni btang bar mi bya zhing //thun 'tshams ngag btang gsar pa yi lugs/ /sgrub pa ma rdzogs bar du ngag gcod pa/ /de ni rnying ma pa yi lug yin no/ /thun gyi mtshams 'dir gtor bsngos byed pa yin//gtor mgron rnam kyang rten gsum rnams la bstim/ /med na rang la bstim pa'i lugs kyang yod//de nas snod bcud 'od zhu gzhal yas khang //gzhal yas 'khor lha med cing lha gtsorkyang yin na snod bcud 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim zhes gsungs/ 'od zhu raja la thim par bsam mo/ /mchan/ 'od zhu 'khor lha rnams la thim/ /'khor lha 'od zhu bdag la thim par bsgom/ /bdag kyang 'od zhu thugs ga'i sa bon la/ /sa bon gyen du yal nas na dā ni/ /skra yi rtse mo brgyar gshag cha shas tsam/ /de la yun ring bar du sems bzung ba/ /zhi gnas sgom lugs mchog tu zab pa yin/ /de nas de yang yal nas stong pa nyid//stong pa yin snyam 'dzin pas ma bcing pa sems la bzo bcos med par klod de gzhag /de ni lhag mthong sgom thabs mchog tu zab/ /gang zag las ni dang po pa rnams kyi/ /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug tu mi thub pas/ /gong du bskyed rim ji tsam bsgom pa'i yun/ /mjug tu zhi lhag de gnyis bsgom dgos zhes/ /nā ro paṇḍi ta yi bzhed pa yin/ /de nas mkha' yo 'ja' tshon shar pa'am/ /dngas pa'i chu la nya ni lding ba ltar//rang nyid gtso rkyang rgyan med zhig bsgom ste//thun mtshams bya ba gang dgos byed pa yin/ /slar yang thun ni bzung lugs sngar ltar te/ /gsar bu rnams kyis bskyed rim mi gsal phyir/ /thun grangs mang ba bskyed rim gsal 'debs yin/ /zhogs pa snga dro nyinagung dgongs ka bzhi/ /srod dang tho rangs thun drug bya ba ste/ /de ni bde dgyes 206

la sogs 'grel chen gsal/ /de la goms nas thun ni lnga byas te//nyin thun bzhi stematshan thun gcig yin na/ /de la goms nas nyin gsum mtshan dang bzhi/ /de la goms nas nyin gnyis mtshan dang gsum/ /shin tu goms na nyin thun mtshams thun gnyis/ /sgrub pa'i thun la de las nyung thabs med/ /spyir ni yi dam sgrub pa gang dang gang / /gsar ma'i lugs la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /bsnyen dang nye bsnyen sgrub dang sgrub chen po//rnying ma'i lugs la bsnyen sgrub las gsum po/ /don la 'dra ste kun la tshang dgos so/ /rang gi thugs kur tshe dpag med dam spyan ras gzigs pad 'byung lta bu lha zhi ba'i rigs yin na thugs mar padma dang zla ba'i steng du so so'i sa bon bsgom/ mchan/ zhi khro'i khyad par gyi/ /pad steng nyi zla gang rung dkyil 'khor steng rta mgrin gur drag phag khros seng gsum sogs lha khro bo khro mo bsgrub pa yin na thugs gar padma dang de'i steng du nyi ma de'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon g.yo 'gul med pa stan la khab btsugs pa ltar sgom pa zhal shes 'di'ang / mchan/ / /sa bon gang yin 'phreng thabs gnas pa ste//yig 'go blta sa mdun yin mdun du lta/ /de ni rnying ma'i lugs yin 'chug pa med/ /gsar ma la ni mig gis mthong sa 'di//yi ge'i mdun yin zer kyang dag pa min//mtshan nyid rigs pa smra ba'i dge bshes rnams/ /yi ge'i gzugs 'di yi ge ma yin te/ /yi ge sgra yin rna ba'i spyod yul yin/ /yi ge mig gis mthong ba mi srid zer/ /de sogs tha snyad rigs pa 'dir mi 'thad/ /gsang sngags rnam pa lam du byed pa ste/ /dper na stong nyid chos sku yum chen mo/ /phag mo'i gzugs su snang ba lta bu'o/ /sa bon mtha' der lha ni pho rigs la/ /mdun nas brtsams te yig ngo phyir bstan pa/ /g.yon nas bkod de mdun g.yas mjug rdzogs pa/ /dper na a long 'phral kha lta bu'o/ /mo rigs lha 207

la mdun nas g.yas bskor du/ /sngags ngo nang du bstan nas bkod pa ste/ /bkod ces bya dang bskor zhes bya ba gnyis/ /gnad chen yod kyang bris pas yi ge nor/ /sgrub thabs phal cher log par song ba mang / /rang gi thugs kur sa/bon sngags phreng bkod/ /ma yengs de la rigs pa rtse gcig gtad//sngags zeng yig 'bru yid la gsal bzhin du/ /de nyid cung zad klog pa'i tshul du bzlas/ /yig 'bru rnams las rang sgra grags par bsam/ /de ni bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas sngags phreng de ni mi 'khor bar/ /sngags las byung ba'i 'od zer kha dog lnga//phreng ba mi 'khor phreng lung 'khor ba bzhin//pho g.yas mo g.yon drag tu 'khor bar bsam/ /de nas sngags phreng dang por dal bus 'khor/ /denas je mgyogs shin tu drag tu 'khorazhal sbyor gyi lha yin na'ang yab kyi thugs kur sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yum gyi thugs kur yum gyi sngags g.yon du 'khor bar bsgom/ /mchan/ /de las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mchod/ /sems cad kun gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'gro ba'i tshe bsod kun/ /'od zer des bsduorang la thim par bsgom//de ni nye bar bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ste//gsang sngags rnying ma pa yi lugs la ni//zla skar phreng ba lta bu'i dzabya dgongs zer//de ni spyi 4lugs yin khyad par du//grub chen pagru'i khyad chos man ngag ni//'od zer bar 'phros grub chen brgyad cu sogs/ /rgya bod rig 'dzin thams cad 'od des mchod/ /thugs dgyes thams cad yi dam sku ru gyur/ /char bzhin babs nas rang la thim par bsam//de bzhin 'od zer phar la 'phros pa yis//gsar rnying rgyud sde'i lha tshogs thams cad mchod//thams cad rang gi yi dam lha der gyurayi 208

dmazer ba'i rang gi lha gang yin pa de'i skur gyur par bsgom pa'o//mchan//char bzhin babasanas rang la thim par bsam/ /de bzhin 'od zer phar la 'phros pa yis//phag khros seng sogs ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ma mgon la sogs ye shes chosaskyong mchod/ /thams cad rang gi yi dam skur gyur ste/ /char bzhin babs nasarang la thim par bsgom/ /'di dus sngags ni yid bzlas byed pa dang yab yumazhal sbyor yod ba'i lha yin na lha de yi sku grangs med pa char babs ltar byon nas bdag bskyed yab yum la thim par bsgom/ /rmongs pa la phan pa'i zhal khrid / /mchan/ /spro bsdu rlung dang bsres na shin tu legs/ /ma lcog sngags dang dmigs pas chog pa yin/ /'di don rgyas par spro na mtha' yas te/ /bsre ba gsum gyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus yin/ /lha dang dkyil 'khor la sogs gang 'dod la/ /shes rab ldan pas rigs 'gres shes par gyis/ /lhag gcig bsgrubs pas thams cad 'grub pa'i thabs/ /kurma bakṣu thugs kyi nying khu'o/ /rang gi thugs na'i sngags phreng 'od zer gyis/ /snod kyi 'jig rten rang gi yi dam de'i//zhing khams gzhal yas khang dang bcas par gyur//bcud kyi sems can gzugs can gzugs med kun//thams cad yi dam lha yi skur gyur te/ /kun gyis rang gi ram bu bkyag byas te/ /'ur 'ur dir dir sngags sgra sgrog par bsgom/ /de ni sgrub pa'i dmig pa yin pa ste/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gsungs ltar na/ /snang ba sku yi khyer so zhes bya dang / /grags pa gsung gi khyer so zhes bya yin/ /dmigs pa gsal na skad cig re rer yang //dung phyur mang po 'gro zhes bka' brgyud gsungs//de don bod kyi grub thob tshem bu pas/ /sngags re bzlas shing phreng rdog re re skyur/ /de 'dras 'grub pa'i dus ni mi 'ong bas/ /gong ltar bsgom la phreng ba hab chod bya/ / 209

gsungs phyir chad lhag kha bskang nges par 'ong / /gsang sngags rnying ma pa 4lugs la ni//bung ba tshang zhig lta bu'i dzapra dgongs zer//sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dngos gzhi yin pa'o/ /rang gi thugs kya'i sngags kyi phreng ba las/ /'od zer mthing ga dmyal ba'i yul du 'phros/ /zhe sdang sdig sgrib tsha grang sdug bsngal sbyangs//dmyal khams mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du bsgyur/ /dmyal ba'i sems can rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rdo rje rigs kyi yi dam lha ru bsgyur/ /kun kyang sngags sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog par bsam/ /yang ni rang gi thugs ma'i sngags phreng las/ /'od zer dmar po glog 'od lta bu 'phros/ /yi dwags 'dod chags bkres skom tham cad sbyangs/ /yi dwags 'jig rten bde chen zhing du bsgyur//'gro bde dag snang ba mtha' yas sam/ /pad ma'i rigs kyi yi dam lha skur bsgyur/ /kun kyang sngags sgra 'ur dir sgrog par bsam//yang ni rang gi thugs ku'i sngags phreng las/ /'od zer dkar bo dud 'gro'i gnas su 'phros/ /gti mug sgrib pa glen lkugs sdug bsngal sbyangs/ /dud 'gro'i 'jig rten mthug po bkod par bsgyur//dud 'gro thams cad rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /buddhā rigs kyi yi dam sku ru bsgyur/ /kun kyang sngags sgra dir dir sgrog par bsam/ /yang ni rang gi thugs kya'i sngags phreng las/ /'od zer ser po lha dang mi la 'phros/ /nga rgyal dang ni ser sna'i sgrib pa dag /pham ltung skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal sbyangs/ /lha mi'i 'jig rten dpal ldan zhing du bsgyur/ /lha mi thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan nam//rin chen rigs kyi yi dam lha skur bsgyur//kun kyang sngags kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog par bsam//yang ni rang gi thugs ma'i sngags phreng las//'od zer ljang gu lha min gnas su 'phros/ /phrag dog sdig sgrib 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyangs/ /lha 210

min 'jig rten las rab zhing du bsgyur/ /lha min thams cad don yod grub pa'am/ /kurma'i rigs kyi yi dam lha skur bsgyur/ /kun kyang sngags sgra 'ur chem sgrog par bsam/ /de ni sgrub pa chen po'i dmigs pa ste/ /rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprugs ting 'dzin no//gsang sngags snying ma pa yi lugs la ni/ /rgyal pa'i pho nya lta bu'i dzapra dgongs zer/ /de ltar bsnyen dang nye bar bsnyen pa dang / /sgrub dang sgrub pa chen po'i dmigs rim bzhi/ /shes rab che na thun rer tshad par bya//'bring ni nyin rer re re tshang ba ste/ /blo rmongs dmigs pa shin tu zin dka' na/ /re re la yang zhag po gsum lnga bdun/ /sgrub pa tshar la khad tshun rdzogs pas chog /de dag rnams ni bsnyen dang sgrub pa ste/ /de nas las la sbyar ba'i dmigs pa ni/ /tho rangs nas bzung nyi ma dros chen bar/ /shar du kha gyus rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ /rang gi thugs kya'i sngags kyi phreng ba ni/ /mu tig phreng ba lta bur 'khor ba las/ /'od zer dkar bo zla ba'i 'od ltar 'phros/ /bdag dang bsrung bya kun gyi nad gdon dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas/ /ba mo la ni nyi zer phog pa'am/ /mun par zla ba shar bzhin dag par bsam nyi dros nas ni nyi ma phyed kyi bar/ /lho ru kha bltas rgyal po rol stabs 'dug /rang gi thugs ma'i sngags phreng ser po ni/ /gser gyi phreng ba lta bur 'khor ba las/ /'od zer gser mdog nyi ma'i 'od bzhin 'phros/ /bdag dang bsrung bya'i tshe bsod mnga' thang dang / /'gro ba kun gyi yon tan ye shes ni/ /'od des reg pa tsam gyis 'phel rgyas bsam//nyin phyed yol nas nyi ma nub kya'i bar//nub tu kha bltas skyil krung byed pas 'dug /rang gi thugs kya'i sngags phreng dmar po ni/ /byu ru'i phreng ba lta bu 'khor ba las/ /'od zer dmar po glog zhags lta bu 211

'phros/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje byin rlabs dang / /'gro ba'i tshe bsod 'byung ba'i bcud rnams kun/ /khab len rdo yis lcags phye bsdus pa ltar/ /dbang du bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam//nyi ma nub nas srod ni ma yol bar//byang du kha bltas mgar ba'i 'dug stangs bya//rang gi thugs mar sngags phreng mjing nag ni//baiḍūrya yi phreng blta bu las//'od zer mthing nag tsha la rtsub pa 'phros//rang dang bsrung bya la gnod dgra dang bgegs//'gro ba kun gyi bdud bzhi nyon mongs tshogs/ /thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs bzhin bsam//de dag bsgom tshe sngags kyi sham bu ni//rang gi yi dam lha yi sngags mjug tu//snga dro sarba pā ba sharto ku ru ye swā hā/nyin phyed ā yuḥ pusbyi puṣṭi ku ru oṃ/dgongs mo sarba sirnyi wa ka shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gnod byed nyi nub mār ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ de skad sbyar zhing bzlas pa man ngag ste/ /de don rgyud dang rgya gzhung du mar 'byung / /mang nyung tshad ni gong du bsnyen sgrub ni//ji tsam song ba'i dus sam grangs nyid kyis//dum bu bcu ru byas pa'i cha gcig tsam/ /de bas mang na bsnyen sgrub nyams 'gyur zhing //de bas nyung na phrin las mi 'grub po//de ni las sbyor dmigs pa zhes bya ste//rnying ma'i lugs kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshang //dper na bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig gong du song na las sbyor sham bu khri tsho gcig yin te nges rigs 'gres zhes —gsungs/ /mchan/ de tsam phyi bsgrub ji tsam bya ba'i yun/ /zla drug zla gsum zla gcig zhag nyer gcig/zhag bdun yan chad rang gi gang lcog bya//grangs ni bye ba sa ya bdun 'bum dang / /sum 'bum bzhi 'bum cig 'bum yan chad do/ /grangs la ma nges rtags la gtso che'i phyir/ /rtags yig bzhin du rtags thon ma212

ba gces//bsod nams ldan pas sngags grangs khri phrag gis//'grub par sangs rgyasathod pa'i rgyud nas gsungs//deng sang dung phyur bzlas kyang mi 'grub pa/ /ting 'dzin ma gsal sems gzhan yengs pa'i skyon/ /sems gzhan yengs pas bzlas brjod la sogs pa/ /bskal par byas kyang 'bras bu med pa ni/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyur slob dpon dbyig gnyen gsungs/ /gzhung nas bsnyen tshad gsungs pa thams cad kyang //ma yeng sa rtse gcig bsgom pa'i dbang du yin/ /ma yengs bsgom na yun ring mi dgos te/ /zhag gcig bsgrubs pas rtags rnams rdzogs na yang //bsnyen pa rdzogs shing las sbyor rung ba ni//gsang sngags ston pa pad ma 'byung gnas kyis//rdo rje phur ba'i gzhung las gsungs pa yin//de ltar bsnyen sgrub rdzogs nas de yi rjes/ /sbyin sreg grub na chad lhag kha bskang dang / /sgrub pa mi nyams mtha' ni btsan pa dang //dngos grub myur du smin pa'i gnad yod ces/ /gsar rnying rgyud sde kun nas mgrin gcig gsungs/ /de phyir sbyin sreg khri phrag dgos gsungs pa/ /sbyin sreg gcig la sngags grangs khri yis chog/de ni rab yin 'bring du las bzhi blugs//tha ma phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin sreg bya//yang na rdzas gcig bstan pa'i sbyin sreg blugs//gal te sbyin sreg rang gis mi shes na/ /til nyid bsreg pa'i sbyin sreg kho nas rung / /sbyin sreg mkhas kyang yo byad ma 'dzom na//rdzas dang thab kha dgang blugs mi dgos pa//ngag gis sbyin sreg 'don cing yid kyis bsgom/ /de yis chog par rgya gzhung rnams nas 'byung / /de ltar bsgrub pa'i dge ba bsngo ba dang / /smon lam bkra shis la sogs rgyas par bya//bla med lugs kyi gsar rnying thams cad kyi//yi dam spyi yi phyi sgrub bya tshul 'di/ /rta lo rgyal zla'i bcu bzhi'i dgong thun la/ /smra bar brtsams shing 213

cung zad smras pa'i tshe/ /gsang sngags bla med gnyan pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /sgyu lus bro 'tshal zhag 'ga' lus pa la//bcu dgu'i nub mor smras na legs pa yi//rmi ltas mthong phyir nyi shu'i dgongs thun nub/ /rāg a sus ci ltar smras pa rnams/ /bīrya sā ga ra yis yi ger bris/ /'khrul pa'i rmi lam gtad ra med na yang / /dpe 'di phal cher 'ga' yis tshad mar 'dzin/ /ma 'ongs rim bzhin phan nus 'gro don ni//rgya chen 'byung ngam snyam pa kho bos sems//le'u nyer drug pa'o maṅga lam̐//yi dam nang sgrub dpa' bo'i rngam skad/spu'iri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ bla med gsang snying yi dam ḍā ki spyi'i nang sgrub dpa' bo dpal chen 'bar ba'i rngam skad ces bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka ye/ /gar gyi dbang phyug pad ma he ru ka /khrag 'thung dharma shwa ras bdag la srungs/ /gson dang gu ru bīrya sā ga ra/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i skal ldan skyes bu yis/ /yi dam lha yi nang sgrub byed 'dod na/ /rgyas par sa dang thig chog gzhung ltar las/ /sa stegs steng du rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri/ /'bring du sgo khri la sogs stegs kyi khar//ras bris dkyil 'khor gding bar bya ba yin//tha ma gnas dang 'tshams pa'i stegs kyi khar/ /'bru yi tshom bu lha grangs bkod pas 'thus/ /de ltar rgyas bsdus dkyil 'khor gang lcog dbus/ /madzdzal lam ni snod gtsang 'brus bkang steng / /bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan gzungs thag 214

bcas/ /de nang rab ni dngos grub ril bus bkang / /'bru sna sman sna rin chen sna tshogs dang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum me tog sna tshogs la/ /gzhi blangs byin rlabs rten ni rnyed tshad dang / /bdud rtsi ril bu dam rdzas phab btab ste/ /sran ma dkar nag gang rung tshad tsam la/ /snum shas chung na legs par skam bya zhing / /snum gyis sbrus na skam yang mi dgos te//dmar pos mdog bsgyur bum pa bkang bar bya//ma 'dzom 'o ma chu gtsang bum rdzas btab//sgrub yun thung na chang gis rung ba yin//de steng rkang gsum mam ni khri 'u'i khar//thod pa mtshan bzang ril bu de 'dras bkang / /med na chang la bdud rtsi btab pas 'thus/ /de steng thur ma rgya gram bcings la bzhag /de steng dar ras dmar pos kha bkab bo/ /me long chang byugs de steng sintus byugs/ /pad ma 'dab bzhi chos 'byung bcas pa bri/ /dbus su yi dam gang yin sa bon dang / /'dab bzhi'i shar du ha ra'i yig 'bru gnyis/ /lho ru ri tsa nub tu ni trīḥ dang / /byang du sa ya de rgyab mu khyud la//yi dam gang yin bsnyen sngags tshang bar bri/ /de rnams yig 'go phyi la bstan pa'o//de ni dar dmar dgab pa'i steng der bzhag/de steng shel lam rdo rje rtse lnga bzhag /de steng khri'u 'am ni rkang ring steng //sgrub gtor rin chen 'bar ba rgyan bzang ba/ /yi dam tsakli dar gdugs bcas pa bshams/ /gal te de ltar brtsegs par mi shong na/ /bum pa'i mdun der bshams kyang 'gal ba med/ /rnying ma yin na bum pa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis/ /masmyul gnyis steng bhandha gnyis kyi nang / /g.yas su bdud rtsi g.yon du rakta bshams//gsar ma yin na de gnyis mi dgos so/ /gsar rnying gang la'ang rgyas par lha grangs kyi/ /gtor ma phyag len bzhin du bca' ba ste/ /'khor rnams phyogs mtshams so so'i gnas kyi thad/ /215

gtso bo bum pa'i g.yas g.yon gang bder bshams/ /bsdu na ka to ra 'am sder chen nang / /lha grangs gtor tshom bshams pa 'bring yin la/ /bsdu na rin chen 'bar ba la sogs pa'i/ /dbang gtor 'dra ba rgyan gzab che ba gcig /de ni gtor bsngos rgyun du gso rgyu yin//sngon ma sgrub gtor lha bskyed yin pa'i phyir//dang po bran nas rgyun du gso mi dgos/ /lha de'i bka' srung gel pa yod na ni/ /de yi gtor ma dkyil 'khor zur du bzhag /dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma ni/ /shar du blum po mar rgyan blum po can/ /lho ru stod zur bzhi pa gru bzhi'i dbyibs/ /mar rgyan kyang ni gru bzhi'i dbyibs kyis brgyan//nub du zur gnyis zla gam dbyibs can ste//mar rgyan tshes brgyad zla ba yu ba can//byang du drag po'i gtor ma zur gsum ni//mar rgyan kyang ni zur gsum dbyibs can te/ /zlum po mar khu byugs pas dkar po ste/ /ser bo yung ba mar bsres byugs pas ser//zur gnyis 'bri mog zur gsum drag snum byugs//dkyil 'khor shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhir bkod/ /phrin las rnams bzhi 'grub pa'i gtor ma ste/ /gsar ma la ni ma bshad med kyang chog /de rgyab dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams brgyad po ru//shar du mchod yon shar lhor zhabs bsil dang //lho ru me tog lho nub bdug spos dang //nub tu mar me nub byang dri chab dang //byang du lha bshos byang shar rol mo'i sar/ /ting shag la sogs rol cha gang bzang bzhag /med na nas bzhag mtshams 'dzin me tog zer/ /de dag rnams ni nges par dgos pa ste/ /de rgyab dkyil 'khor zur bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi//mda' bzhi gri bzhi tshon skud drwa ba dang / /me long bzhi dang dar gyi 'phan bzhi dang / /stag gi sgab skor phur chung bcu gnyis dang / /shel sogs rin chen drwa ba drwa phyed dang / /216

steng du dar gyi bla bre la sogs pa//rnying ma'i sgrub chen chas ni yin mod kyi//sman bla rdog dkyil bdun sogs gsar ma la'ang / /de ltar bya ba gzhung nas bshad 'dug go /nang sgrub 'di ni ma hā yo ga'i lugs/ /spros pa ci ltar rgyas bzhin bsod nams che/ /de phyir des chog mi bya 'bad pas bsgrub/ /ma rnyed pa la sgrub pa bshol mi dgos/ /gang 'dzom brda' tsam bsags la sgrub kyang rung //gzhan yang sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor mchod gtor gyis/ /yo byad 'dzom zhing sgrub g.yog 'dzom na legs/ /sta gon 'di ni nang sgrub gsang sgrub gnyis/ /khyad par med cing gsar rnying spyi 'gro yin//mchod rdzas zhi drag khyad par rigs pas dpyad//'u thug ngag khrid tug gu phreng 'dra 'di/ /mkhas pas gzigs na bzhad gad gnas yin kyang //rmongs pa rnams la slob dpon dpe chas chog/de phyir rā ga a sus gang smras pa/ /bī ryarsā ga ra yis yi ger bkod/ /rmongs phyir ma yin gzhan la phan phyir bris//na mo gu ru sarba dre wa ye/ /de nas yi dam nang sgrub nyams len tshul/ /thun bzhir bdag mdun gnyis ka tshar re 'don/ /thun mtshams rang gzhung gtor bsngos tshar re bya//nyi ma'i gung la sbyin sreg re re ste/ /zhi rgyas dbang gsum res mos gang 'dod bya/ /ma 'byor rdzas gcig sbyin sreg byas kyang chog /nub mo tshogs 'khor rgyas pa re re 'am//ci 'byor blo stobs bskyed pa'i tshogs re bya//de ltar zla gcig nyer gcig bcu bzhi'am/ /tha na zhag bdun bsgrub kyang chog pa yin/ /cho ga bzhin du bdag mdun gsal ba yi/ /thugs mar sa bon sngags 'khor 'khor bzhin pa/ /de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga po/ /lha yi kha dog gang yin shas che ba//rang gi zhal nas thon cing mchod pa'i tshul//mdun bskyed zhal 217

du zhugs shing thugs kur thim/ /sngags 'khor drag 'khor thugs bskyed smon lam bskul/ /slar yang 'od zer gsang pa'i sbubs nas thon/ /zhal sbyor yod na yab yum sbyor mtshams nas/ /yum gyi 'og nas tshur byung rang nyid kyi/ /sbyor mtshams gsang pa'i sbubs nas thugs kur thim/ /de ltar bar mtshams med par 'khor dmigs bzlas//de ni mdun bskyed bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim yin/ /de nas 'od zer de nyid sngags phreng gyur/ /dang bo dal bu de nas je mgyogs su/ /de nas drag tu 'khor ba nye bsnyen yin/ /bar du 'khor tshe sngags phreng de dag las/ /'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcu khyab par 'phros/ /rab 'byams zhing khams kun na bzhugs pa yi//rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs//kun la mchod sprin rgya mtshos mnyes par byas/ /de dag kun gyi sku gsung thugs rnams las/ /rang gi yi dam sku dang sngags phreng dang / /phyag mtshan sa bon yig 'brus mtshan pa rnams/ /char bzhin babs nas bdag mdun gnyis mar thim//sngags kyi 'od zer sems can kun la khyab/ /sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas sangs rgyas sar bzhag ste/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'od zer rnam par bsdus/ /bdag mdun thugs ma'i sngags phreng la thim bsam/ /de ni sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dngos yin te//gsang sngags rnying ma pa yi lugs la ni//'gal me klad la bskor 'dra'i dzabya dgongs zer/ /de lan mtshams la ji tsam 'dug pa yi/ /ru gnyis tsam la bya ba bsnyen sgrub yin//de nas bdag mdun bar gyi sngags phreng de//mu tig phreng ba lta bur dkar por bsgom//rang gi zhal nas phar la 'phro ba'i dus//zhi ba'i mchod pa phul ba'i mos pa bya/ /mdun gyi zhal zhugs sku lus brgyud pa'i tshe/ /zhi ba'i las la dgongs pa gtad par bsam//sngags phreng tshur la 'phros nas byung ba'i 218

dus/ /zhi ba'i dngos grub bdag la stsol bar bsam/ /rang gi lus brgyud thugs mar thim pa'i tshe/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib nyon mongs zhi bar bsam/ /de bzhin nyin gung sngags phreng ser po la//'od zer kha dog sna lngas brgyan pa can//dper na rma bya'i sgro yi chun po'i dbyibs//mchod pa phul dang thugs dgongs gtad pa dang / /dngos grub gnang sogs tshe bsod rgyas par dmigs/ /de bzhin dgong mo nas bzung sngags phreng dmar/ /'khyog cing gug pa lcags sgrog dbyibs can de/ /mchod dang dgongs gtad dngos grub gnang ba dang //rang gi thugs ma'i sngags phreng la thim pas/ /rlung sems snang srid dbang du 'dus par bsam de nas srod nas bzung ste sngags phreng mthing / /thags 'khyug rnam par 'khor bar gyur pa ni/ /drag po'i mchod pa dgongs gtad dngos grub gnang //thugs kur thim pas bdud bzhi tshar gcod bsam//de ni sgrub pa chen po'i dmigs pa ste//rnying ma'i lugs la las sbyor zhes bya'o//phyi sgrub bzhin du sngags sham so sor sbyor/ /de nas rab tu las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya/ /'bring du phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin sreg gcig /tha na rdzas gcig sbyin sreg man ngag ltar/ /sgrub pa thon nas dngos grub len chog ni/ /gsar ma yin na bdag 'jug tshar gcig blangs/ /rnying ma yin na dngos grub len chog bya//de yang gang yin gsal kha mi shes na//mdun bskyed dpral mgrin thugs ka lte ba nas/ /oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing hrīḥ ljang gu/ /'od dang ldan pa rim bzhin 'phros nas kyang / /rang gi dpral mgrin thugs ka lte bar thim/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la sham bu 'di btags te/ /kā ya sidhi oṃ/ wākka sirnyi āḥ tsitta sidhi hūṃ/ sarba sirnyi hrīḥ / sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi thob pa dang / /sku bzhi mngon du byed pa'i skal ldan bsam/ /rdor dril dang 219

bcas lag g.yas sgrub bum dang //g.yon pas sgrub gtor bzung ste lag gnyis bsnol//mos gus bskyed cing rang gi gnas bzhir gtugs//dngos grub thams cad thob par nges shes bskyed/ /bum chu btung dang khrus bya ril bu bza'/ /de nas rjes chog cho ga'i gzhung ltar ste//mdun bskyed gshegs sam yang na rten la bstim/ /bdag bskyed stong par bsdu ba ma gtogs pa//byang chub ma thob bar du mi gshegs te/ /phyag rgya sgo bcad bsgrug pa zhes bya'o/ /ril bu dam rdzas rten du bcangs pa ste//gtor ma phyi rgyab mi 'khyar dngos grub rol/ /de ni yi dam ḍā ki spyi khyab bo/ /rang bzo ma yin gsar rnying sgrub gzhung ni/ /rgya mtsho kun la shin tu 'gris pa'i mthus/ /lag tu blangs bde snying dmar lag tu bzhag /kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams//zhim po mi la byin na skyugs pa'i dpe//skal med rnams kyis cir yang mi brtsi ste//skal ldan las can bsgrub la brtson pa rnams//'di mthong lag pa'i mthil nas gter rnyed ltar/ /dga' spro 'phel zhing dngos grub gnyis kyis phyug /de phyir sngags rgan rā ga a su ngas/ /tshigs su bcad de smras rnams yid la zungs/ /de skad smras tshe bīrya swa ga ras/ /shin tu mgyogs pa rdzu 'phrul lta bu yis/ /rab tu gsal ba zhun mar ngogs la bris/ /sba 'os gsal bkod nyes pa mchis pa rnams/ /chos bdag ḍā ki srung ma'i tshogs la bshags/ /'di phyir sgrib par mi 'gyur dngos grub stsol/ /dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog /de skad rta lo rgyal zla'i nyer gcig nub/ /rang gis gsang sngags nyams su blangs tshul dang / /bstun nas sgrub thabs nyams mgur tshul du smras/ /le'u nyer bdun pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /220

yi dam gsang sgrub mkha' 'gro'i gdung glu/lari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ bla med gsang sngags gsar rnying yi dam ḍā ki spyi yi gsang sgrub ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gdung glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ḍāki ni sirnyi hūṃ/ /gsang sngags kun gyi bdag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /lhan skyes ḍā kis bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /gson dang bla ma bīrya sā ga ra/ /gsar rnying yi dam mkha' 'gro gang yang rung //gsang sngags snying po gsang ba'i sgrub pa ni/ /nang sgrub tshar rjes nyid du byed na ni/ /mchod gtor mi bsdu kha gso tsam gyis chog /dus gzhan yin na nang sgrub bzhin du bca'/ /thun bzhi byed lugs nang sgrub khyad med kyang //nyin gung sbyin sreg 'di la mi dgos so//bdag mdun tshang ma dus bzhir btang bya zhing / /bdag mdun gtso bo gnyis kyi sku lus nang / /stong zhing gsal ba phru ma phus btab bzhin/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga po mos tsam bsgom//ha cang gsal po ma zin na yang rung //bdag mdun gnyis ku'i dpral ba mgrin pa dang / /thugs ka lte ba gsang gnas lnga yi dbus/ /rang gi yi dam gang yin de nyid ni/ /dkar po dmar po mthing ga ser po dang / /ljang gu lnga po mngon rtogs bzhin du bsgom/ /zhal sbyor la sogs yod med mngon rtogs bstun/ /'khor du rtsa 'dab dang mnyam mkha' 'gro ma/ /spyi bor dkar mo sum cu rtsa gnyis ste/ /mgrin par dmar mo bcu drug bsgom par bya/ /snying gar sngon mo brgyad dang lte bar ni/ /ser mo drug cu rtsa bzhi bsgom par bya/ /gsang 221

bar ljang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad ste/ /rang rtags kyis mtshan gri thod kha ṭaṃ bsnams/ /gtso bo rnams la pad ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /'khor rnams zla ba'am ro yi gdan can no/ /gtso bo lnga yi thugs kur pad zla'i gdan/ /rang mdog sa bon rang mdog sngags phreng 'khor/ /pho la g.yas dang mo la g.yon du 'khor/ /rang gi thugs ku'i sngags phreng 'khor bzhin las/ /'od zer sna lnga stong skud sgrim 'dra zhig /thugs ku'i yi dam mthing ma'i zhal nas thon/ /mgrin pa'i yi dam dmar po'i gsang gnas zhugs//thugs mar phog pas sngags phreng drag tu 'khor//'od zer zhal nas thon te gyen du song / /spyi bo'i yi dam dkar po'i gsang bar zhugs/ /thugs kur phog pas sngags phreng drag tu 'khor/ /'od zer zhal nas thon te thur du song //rang nyid bdag bskyed zhal nas phar song ste//mchod pa'i tshul du mdun bskyed zhal du zhugs/ /gyen du song nas spyi bo'i lha dkar po'i/ /zhal du zhugs shing thugs kur phog pa yis/ /sngags phreng drag 'khor 'od zer gsang gnas thon/ /thur du byon nas mgrin pa'i lha zhal zhugs/ /thugs gar thim pas sngags phreng drag tu 'khor/ /gsang ba nas thon thugs ma'i lha zhal zhugs/ /sngags phreng drag 'khor 'od zer gsang bar thon/ /lte ba'i lha zhal du zhugs sngags phreng myur/ /gsang sbubs nas thon gsang ba'i lha zhal zhugs/ /sngags phreng drag 'khor gsang ba'i sbubs nas thon//mdun bskyed gsang spubs sam ni sbyor mtshams thon/ /bdag bskyed gsang spubs sam ni sbyor mtshams zhugs/ /gyen brgyud thugs kur thim pas dngos grub thob/ /phar la mchod pa tshur la dngos grub tshul//sngags phreng drag tu 'khor bas thugs dam bskul//de ltar 'od zer rgyun du 'khor bar bsgom//de ni gsang sgrub bsnyen pa'i dmigs 222

pa'o/ /gsang sngags rnying ma pa yi lugs la ni/ /ba dag/ khrid pa lta bu'i dzabya dgongs zer//de nas 'od zer de nyid sngags phreng bsgyur//'khor lugs thams cad gong ltar 'khor bar bsgom//de ni gsang sgrub nye bar bsnyen pa'o//de nas sngags phreng de ltar 'khor bzhin las/ /'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' khyab par spros/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /dpa' bo ḍā ki chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun la zag med bde ba'i mchod sprin phul/ /de dag rnams kyi dpral mgrin thugs ka nas/ /rang gi yi dam de yi sku gzugs ni/ /dkar ser dmar ljang che ba ri rab tsam//chung ba yungs 'bru tsam la grangs med pa//gsung ni dbyangs dang gsal byed rten 'brel snying / /yi dam sngags phreng dkar ser dmar ljang tshogs/ /thugs ni rdo rje rin chen pad ma dang / /rgya gram 'khor lo yi dam sa bon mtshan/ /bu yug bzhin du phyogs rnams kun nas byon/ /bdag mdun gnas lnga'i lha tshogs so sor thim/ /rigs lnga'i rigs kyi dngos grub kun thob bsam/ /'od zer 'gro drug sems can kun la phog /rigs lnga'i yi dam go 'phang la bzhag nas/ /kun gyis tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'od lnga yi/ /rnam par bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim bsam/ /de ni gsang sgrub bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /de yan gsang bsgrub ci tsam byed pa yi//ru gnyis tsam la bsnyen dang sgrub pa bya/ /de nas las sbyor sgrub pa chen po ni/ /snga dro'i dus su sngags phreng dkar por bsgyur/ /'od zer dkar po sa bdag dang 'gro kun gyi/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi/ /nyin gung dus su sngags phreng ser por bsgyur/ /'od zer ser pos bdag dang 'gro kun gyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams yon tan ye shes rgyas/ /dgong mo'i dus su sngags phreng dmar por bsgyur/ /'od zer dmar 223

pos bdag dang 'gro kun gyi/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang 'dus rang dbang thob//srod kyi dus su sngags phreng mthing kur bsgyur//'od zer mthing ga tsha zhing bsreg pa yis//bdud bzhi log 'dren thams cad bsregs par byas//mjug tu las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'grub na legs/ /gsar ma yin na bdag 'jug blang ba'am/ /rnying ma yin na dngos grub len chog dang / /rjes chog bya tshul nang sgrub dag dang mtshungs/ /sgrub yun zhag bdun bcu bzhi nyer gcig gam/ /zla gcig la sogs rang gi khams dang bstun//yi dam mkha' 'gro spyi yi gsang sgrub 'di//rta lo rgyal zla'i nyer gsum dgong thun la/ /rā ga a sus rang gi myong ba dang / /bstun nas gsar snying kun gyi bcud bsdus te//gu ru bīrya sā ga ra la gdams//des kyang brjed par phangs te yi ger bkod//sba 'os gsal bkod nyes pa gang mchis rnams/ /chos bdag ḍā ki srung ma'i tshogs la bshags/ /'di phyir sgrib par mi 'gyur dngos grub stsokheka /'dir 'bad dge bas 'di la 'brel thogs rnams//mchog thun dngos grub dpal la longs spyod shog/le'u nyer brgyad pa'o maṅga lam̐//sbyin sreg nor bu sna tshogs 'dog can/liri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ spros med las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ri khrod pa la phan pa nor bu sna tshogs mdog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pra wa kā ra ye/ /las bzhi'i sbyin sreg man ngag cung zad bri/ /o rgyan chen pos 224

bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs//las bzhi rgyas pa gzhan du gsal ba ltar/ /sdus pa la yang spros bcas spros med gnyis/ /spros bcas mdun me 'bud par thab brtsegs sam/ /yang na rdul tshon steng du sa yis g.yogs/ /bud shing las bzhi so so'i dbyibs ltar brtsegs//kha khyer ku sha bkod kun la dgos//yam shing mar khu kun la dgos pa yin/ /bdun nam nyer gcig tsam re 'bul bas chog /dngos gzhi rdzas gcig bsten pa'i sbyin sreg zhes/ /lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags gsum po de/ /sbrel ba brgya rtsa tshang pas grangs tshang ste/ /lha sngags oṃ dang rdzas sngags oṃ gnyis gcig /de bzhin swā hā yod na gcig tu bsdu/ /sdig pa zhi 'dod til nag kho na ste//bgegs zhi yungs kur nad zhi gro nyid 'bul//zhi ba'i sbyin sreg de gsum gtso bo yin/ /tshe rgyas dur wa bsod nams rgyas pa 'bras /stobs rgyas sran ma nor 'bru rgyas so ba/ /bde skyid dngos grub dbang sdud zas mchog ste/ /yang na me tog dmar po sreg rdzas gtso/ /me tog med na 'bru la tshon gyis bsgyur/ /drag por sha khrag ling ga kho nas chog /'jig rten me lha de nang ye shes pa/ /gnyis ka las bzhi so so'i mdog ltar bsgom/ /mngon rtogs bsgyur ram ma lcog yid kyis bsgyur//me lha'i thugs kur yi dam dkyil 'khor bsgom//de yi sreg rdzas mchod bstod rdzogs pa'i rjes/ /dkyil 'khor phyi khyams rdo ra'i nang de ru/ /gtor mgron bzhin du lha tshogs gang 'dod kun/ /mngon rtogs bsgom mam skad cig spyan drangs la/ /sreg rdzas mchod bstod cha re gang 'grub 'bul/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor med pa'i gtso rkyang la'ang //me lha'i thugs kur gtso bo'i mtha' skor du/ /rim bzhin spyan drangs mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ /sbyin sreg gcig nang sbyin sreg mang po shong / /sreg rdzas 'bul bas lha tshogs 225

rab tu mnyes//zhi ba'i dus su 'od zer mu tig mdog/bde ba'i reg bya ldan pa dpag med 'phros/ /'gro ba kun dang bdag dang bsrung bya yi/ /tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang nad gdon sdig /ba mor nyi zer phog ltar dag gyur ste/ /bde stong nyams skyes dri med shel ltar bsgom/ /rgyas pa'i dus su 'od zer gser gyi mdog /bdag dang bsrung bya la phog tshe bsod 'phel/ /zer gyi gseb nas rin chen char 'bebs bsam//dbang gi dus su 'od zer rā ga'i mdog/lcags kyu'i dbyibs 'phros 'jig rten spyi dang ni/ /bye brag gang dmigs me lha'i mdun du bkug/gus 'dud ldan pa chags pa'i me yis zhu/ /'od dmar zhu nas bdag la thim par bsam//drag po'i dus su lha de zhal gdangs pa'i//nang du sha khrag ling ga phul ba de//dgra bgegs dngos nyid rkang rting skya lhag lhag/mgo mjug log ste zhal du song bar bsam//de nas me zhags la sogs brgyangs pa na//me dpung thogs pa'i khro bo dpag med kyis//me rlung zhun ma'i rta la zhon nas rgyug/gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsgom/ /de ltar rdzas gcig sbyin sreg 'don 'grig ni/ /rang nyid yi dam bdag bskyed sngon song nas//sreg rdzas byin brlabs thab bskyed ku sha bkram/ /me lha bskyed bsnyim a rghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ /yam shing mar khu gsum bdun gang 'grub 'bul/ /me lhar bstod cing de yi lto ba'i nang / /rgyas par yi dam mngon rtogs bzhin du bskyed/ /bsdu na skad cig spyan drangs bzhugs kyang chog /de la rnam lnga'i mchod pa bsdus tsam 'bul/ /dngos bshams med na'ang sngags dang tshig gis chog /gang yin sreg rdzas gcig po brgya rtsa 'bul/ /gtor ma bsngos phul 'dod don gsol ba gdab//bstod pas bstod nas rjes chog sngags mchod bstod//rjes chog lha bran 226

so sor mi dgos pas/ /gang yin gtso bo'i rjes chog de gas chog /ye shes gshegs shing dam tshig 'dag la bstim//'jig rten me lhar drin lan gtor ma 'bul//'dod don gsol shing arnya sogs kyis mchod//bstod pas bstod cing ye shes drang srong de/ /shar lho'i phyogs gshegs dam tshig mi dmigs bsam/ /'di ni rdzas gcig brten pa'i sbyin sreg zhes/ /spros med lugs kyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa yin/ /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa sogs la 'di bya ste/ /cho ga bsdus pa'i gsung ram khyog pa yi/ /btsun pa du yod grangs su brtsi ba yin/ /sbyin sreg re rer sngags grangs brgya rtsa re/ /de nyid 'grub pa dka' bar gyur pa na/ /cho ga tshang ma'i ram bu mi khyog kyang //sngags de'i rjes zlos ram bu khyog tshad brtsi//'di ni rang gzhan kun la phan stobs che/ / shin tu spros med las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ni//ri khrod yin na thab kyi me la rung //bla ma slob dpon yin na mdun me bus//'di na shin tu spros med yin pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten me lha 'di la bskyed mi dgos/ /mngon rtogs dran rdzogs yid kyis bsgom pa ste/ /dam ye dbyer med spyan 'dren bya mi dgos/ /bdag dang tshe 'das la sogs 'gro kun gyis/ /sdig sgrib sna bug nas thon til la bstim//til med ldum til yungs nag yungs gzhi sogs/ /bcir bas snum 'byung til nag tshab du 'ong / /me dbus zhi ba'i thab khung yongs rdzogs dbus//yi dam gtso rkyang mdog dkar zhal gdangs bsam//de nang phul dmigs sngags re til 'bru re//yi dam rtsa sngags gang yin sham bu ru/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sarba pā paṃ da ha na sharnyikyi ru swā hā/ dgu las mi nyung brgya las mi mang ba/ /phreng ba mi bgrang grangs su mi bzhag par//tshod kyis gang 'grub tsam zhig phul ba'i rjes//227

arghaṃ sogs mchod bstod pa shwa los bstod/ /lha de rten la thim mam rang thim dmigs//'di ni sgrib sbyong zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub//'bru sna rin chen sna tshogs phye ma dang //zas sna dar ras dum bu gang 'dzom rnams//zangs sam gang 'byor snod du mang bar bsags//bran zhing a kā ro yis bdud rtsir bsam//mdun gyi me dkyil rgyas pa'i thab khung dbus//yi dam 'am ni nor lha gang 'dod bsgom//sreg rdzas phul bas longs spyod char 'bebs bsam//rtsa sngags sham bur sngags 'di sbyar la 'bul//dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ ratna sirnyi hūṃ//brgya rtsa phul zhing arnya sogs kyis mchod/ /bstod pa nyung ngu'i bstod cing rang la bsnyim/ /de yis dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub//sreg rdzas me tog dmar po rnyed na rab//med na 'bru la tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur/ /chang gi glum dang 'bri mog sin cu ra/ /rgya skyegs shing thog dmar po la sogs pa/ /phyogs gcig bsdu sa la bran te byin gyis brlab/ /me dkyil dbang gi thab khung gsal ba'i dbus/ /yi dam gtso rkyang sku mdog dmar po 'am/ /dzam dmar ku ru kulle gang rung bskyed//rtsa sngags mjug tu 'di sbyar brgya rtsa 'bul//lo ka sarba wa shaṃ ku ruṣkaḥ /'od zer dmar pos snang srid dbang bsdus bsam//arnya sogs mchod bstod nas rang labastim//de yis snang srid dbang sdud phrin las 'grub//thong ting ngam ni thangs lcags theb rtse'i nang //yungs kur blugs la dgug gzhug ci mang bya//me nang drag po'i thab khung yongs rdzogs dbus/ /rta mgrin phyag rdor gur drag seng gdong ma/ /gshin rje'i gshed dang ma mgon la sogs pa/ /gtso rkyang 'jigs rung zhal ni gnam du gdangs/ /zhal dang sku lus me yi rang bzhin can/ /yungs 'bru re re dgra bgegs dngos bsam ste//rkang mthil skya dang lhag lhag zhal du song //lus ngag 228

yid gsum bya sgro mes bsreg bzhin/ /sems ni dngos med chos skur thim par bsam//'bru re sngags re sprad la brgya rtsa 'bul//rtsa sngags sham du 'di nyid sbyar bar bya//gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa//arnya sogs mchod bstod pa shwa los bstod/ /lha de 'od zhu thugs ska'i sa bon bstim/ /sa bon rang thim nyams len ngang la gzhag /'di ni shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa ste//seng gdong ma yi gdams ngag snyan brgyud yin/ /de ltar spros med las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'di/ /gsar rnying rgyud gzhung man ngag du ma'i bcud/ /gzhan la spel phangs brtson 'grus khyod la gdams//de skad rā ga a sus smras pa de//yi ge pa yang bīrya sā ga ra/ /dge bas las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par shog /le'u nyer dgu pa'o maṅga stu'i/ /yang gsang sgrub pa bde chen rab 'bar/kṣ-i'iri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ bla med gsar rnying yi dam ḍāki spyi'i yang gsang bla na med pa'i sgrub pa bde chen rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ /gsar rnying bla med yi dam gang rung la/ /sbyar du rung ba'i yang gsang sgrub pa ni/ /grub chen pakṣu'i dgongs pa bzhin bshad na/ /bde dgyes gsang gsum phag mo seng gdong ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho la sogs gang yang rung / /sgrub rdzas gtor bsngos rten gyi mchod gtor tsam/ /yod na legs shing med na 'dir mi dgos//yang gsang rtsa rlung thig le'i sgrub pa yin//229

mtshams bsdam bde ba'i gdan la lus gnad bsrangs/ /rang lus yi dam gtso gang yin pa/ mchan/rkyang gsal bar bsgom/ /sku nang stong ba phru ma phus btab bzhin//gsang gnas nas bzung tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar//a wa sgru tī khang stong ka ba bzhin/ /mda' smyug tsam pa kha dog sngon po ste/ /g.yas pa ro ma dmar po de las phra/ /g.yon pa rkyang ma dkar po de tsam ste/ /yar sne spyi bo nas ni thur du gug /sne so sna bug gnyis su yod par bsam//dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug steng nyid du/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan zhing bkag par bsgom/ /lte 'og man chad rtsa gsum gcig tu gyur/ /mar sne gsang ba'i gnas su zug pa yang / /gsang rdor nyid dang cung zad ma 'brel bsgom/ /de ni tshul khrims mi 'chal gnad zab yin/ /'brel na chags pa che zhing 'chal dogs gsungs/ /rtsa gsum sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo mtshon/ /rtsa 'dab sgom lugs bzhed pa mang na yang / /thang shing yal ga 'am ni gdugs rtsibs bzhin/ /spyi bo'i rtsa 'dabs sum cu so gnyis dkar/ /cung zad thur du gug tshul waṃ yig mtshon/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug kha dog dmar/ /rtse mo yar la gug pa e yig mtshon/ /snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad po kha dog mthing / /cung zad thur du sbubs tshul waṃ yig mtshon/ /lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi ni//mdog ser gyen du kha phyogs tsheyig mtshon//gsang gnas rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ /ljang gu 'phred du thad skar yod pa'o/ /rtsa 'khor lnga po rigs lnga'i pho brang dngos//phyi rol zhing khams lnga dang ngo bo gcig/'di dag yon tan bskyed pa rtsa yi mchog/de min rtsa 'dab grangs las 'das pa rnams/ /skyon dang yon tan rnam grangs mang po bskyed/ /de phyir yid la mi dmigs pa nyid legs/ /de nas rlung ni dgu phrugs bus byas te/ /'jam rlung 230

cung zad dal bus bzung byas te/ /'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyong bya ba ni/ /de ni rigs ldan gyi ni gzhi bzung ba//dpag bsam gyi ni shing 'dzugs ces bya ste//lus dang rtsa yi stong ra bsgom pa yin//de nas rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ /sna bug g.yon dang mnyam du rgyu dus bzung / /g.yas nas rgyu dus bzung na gegs skyon 'phel/ /sna rtse sor ni bcu drug tshad tsam nas/ /rlung ni kha dog lnga ldan stong skud bzhin//sna sgo nas zhugs ro rkyang nas brgyud de//nang du zhugs pa dmigs shing dal bus rngub/ /'og sgo bsdam shing gsus pa theb gyis dgang / /'og sgo'i zhabs su gos sne hril po bzhag/de yis 'og rlung shugs gyis zin pa'i gnad//steng rlung mgrin pa man chad bkang ba ni//bum can yin te stod 'tshang la sogs sel/ /snying ga man chad bkang ba legs pa yin/ /drag tu jub cing dgang na nag thom 'gro/ /dal bus 'jam la ring bar rngub byas te/ /gsus pa ther gyis dgang la ci nus bzung / /dmigs pa ro rkyang nas zhugs rlung de ni/ /dbu ma'i nang nas snying gar thim par bsgom//ma thub gu mo g.yas g.yon mchan brdab bya/ /dmigs pa lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /rlung ni sngo dang sib sib phyir thon bsam//de yi rlung khug cung zad ring bar nus//de nas bzung bar ma nus gtong dgos tshe/ /sna bug gnyis nas lhag ma med par bus/ /gegs skyon sdig sgrib dang bcas phyir thon nas/ /rtsa dang lus nang stong pa song nge bsgom/ /zin rtags sngar las rlung khug ring 'gyur zhing / /yun ring bzung yang mi bde med pa 'byung / /rang nyid lus gnad bcas shing rlung bzung tshe/ /mdun du mched grogs grwa pa zhig bzhag ste/ /skyil krung bcas te lag g.yon phreng ba bzung / /mgyogs par lag g.yas pus mo g.yas dang g.yon/ /dpral bar reg cing se 231

gol gcig brdab ste/ /de nas phreng ba gcig ni bcad bya ba/ /de 'dra brgya dang brgyad kyi yun gyi bar/ /rlung ni gtong mi dgos par bzung thub na/ /rlung ni 'byangs pa'i tshad du bzhag pa yin/ /de 'byangs 'pho ba bsgom yang nus pa thon/ /gtum mo bsgom yang drod sogs skye ba yin/ /de la bum can ming du btags pa'ang yod//de nyid bum can min gsungs bkag pa'ang mdzad//'on kyang sdom 'byung rgyud las de gsal phyir/ /rlung gi rtags thon tshad de nges pa yin/ /de nas thig le'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ /thun mong ma yin pakṣu'i zab gnad ni/ /rtsa 'khor lnga yi dbus ma dbu ma'i nang / /spyi bor gti mug ngo bo oṃ dkar po//mgrin par 'dod chags ngo bo āḥ dmar po//snying gar zhe sdang ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag /lte bar nga rgyal ngo bo tt+waṃ ser po/ /gsang bar phrag dog ngo bo a ljang gu /dug lnga ye shes lnga dang rigs lnga rnams/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul du gcig phyir bsgom/ /dbu ma'i mar sne gsang gnas 'khor lo'i 'og /thig le dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa zhig/a thung gtum mo'i ngo bor bsgom par bya//de ni pakṣu'i gdams ngag lugs yin gyi//gtum mo'i rang gnas lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad//de ru bsgom na rgyud dang mthun pa yin//a thung thig le ram̐ yig gang yang rung / /a yig ring cha med pa lcags sreg mdog/thig le bsgom pa'i rtse mor me lce ni/ /sum 'khyog dmar po gcan gzan spu tsam pa/ /sum 'khyog dmar po a yig 'phred bstan dbyibs//ram̐ yig bsgom pa'i rtse mo de dang 'dra//a thung phag mo'i ngo bo zhes bya ba//ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po ni//phag mo dngos yin de nyid bsgom pa'i rten/ /lus kyi drod rnams thams cad des bskyed phyir/ /tha mal pa yis pho ba'i me drod zer//rlung bzung ro rkyang nas zhugs de la phog/sol 232

ba'i me la spud pa brgyab bzhin 'bar/ /gsang gnas 'og tu bsgom na yar 'bar ste/ /lte 'og bsgom na re zhig phyir la 'bar/ /dmar dang khyug khyug cung zad 'bar bar bsam/ /skad cig mi sdod 'khyug 'khyug g.yo bar bsam/ /dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs pa'i bu ga ru/ /thig le dkar bo dngul chu'i rdog po bzhin/ /haṃ yig dkar po 'go bo thur bstan mtshan/ /pha las thob pa'i byang sems kun gyis bcud/ /bkrag mdangs lus stobs thams cad skyed pa'i gzhi//bde mchog la sogs he ru ka dngos nyid//de ltar thig le dkar dmar gsal btab nas//rlung gcig tshur la rngub pa dang bstun nas//dug lnga'i sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang / /lam rgyud lnga ru skye ba'i sdig sgrib kun/ /'od zer lnga yi tshul du tshur bsdus te/ /gnas lnga'i yig 'bru lnga la thim par bsgom/ /de nas rlung bzung gtum mo sbar ngan song gsum dang lha dang lha min gcig tu brtsi ba yin kyang 'dir lha mi gnyis gcig la brtsi mchan/ ba yis/ /phrag dog sgrib pa lha min skye ba'i rgyu/ /a yig ljang gu ye shes me yis bsregs/ /de nyid yi dam gang yin ljang gur gyur/ /rtsa 'dabs re la ḍā ki ljang mo re//sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri thod dang //kha ṭwāṃ mchan bcug gar stabs bzhugs par dmigs/ /de nas gtum mo yar la sbar ba yis//nga rgyal sgrib pa lha ru skye ba'i rgyu//ṭwāṃ yig bsregs nas yi dam ser por bsgyur//rtsa 'dab grangs kyi ḍā ki ser mo rnams//rin chen mtshan pa'i gri thod kha ṭwāṃ ga /de nas gtum mo yar 'bar snying ga gang / /zhe sdang sdig sgrib dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /hūṃ bsregs yi dam mthing ga'i sku ru gyur/ /rtsa 'dab ḍā ki rdo rje gri thod ran/ /gtum mo yar 'bar mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab gang //'dod chags sgrib pa yi dwags skye ba'i rgyu/ /aḥ yig bsregs nas yi dam dmar por bsgyur/ /rtsa 233

'dab grangs kyi ḍā ki dmar mo ni/ /pad mas mtshan pa'i gri thod kha ṭwāṃ ga /de nas yar 'bar spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab gang / /gti mug sgrib pa dud 'gror skye ba'i rgyu//oṃ yig bsregs nas yi dam dkar por bsgyur//rtsa 'dabs grangs kyi ḍā ki dkar mo ni/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i gri thod kha ṭwāṃ ga/'khor rnams thams cad gtso bor zhal gzigs bsgom/ /de ltar rtsa gnas lha tshogs gsal thebs nas/ /rtsa 'dab lnga yi gtso bo'i thugs ka ru/ /zhi bar zla ba khro bor nyi ma'i gdan/ /de dbus sa bon rang rang sngags kyis bskor/ /pho rigs g.yas 'khor mo rigs g.yon du 'khor//sa bon sngags kyi kha dog sku mdog gcig/'khor rnams thugs kur yig 'bru re re ste/ /dkar mo'i thugs kur trīḥ yig dkar bo dang / /oṃ baṃ gsum po gang rung bsgom yang rung / /sngon mo'i thugs kur ha yig sngon po dang / /ser mo'i thugs kur ram̐ yig ser po dang / /dmar mo'i thugs shar ni yig dmar po re//ljang mo'i thugs kur sa yig ljang gu'o//de ltar gsal btab sngags ni yid bzlas bya//rlung zhig phar la bus pa dang bstun nas//rang mdog 'od zer kha dog rnam pa lnga / /nam mkha' khyab par 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems yi dam ḍā ki thams cad mchod/ /thams cad bsgom 'dra'i rigs lnga'i lhar gyur nas/ /rlung zhig tshur la rngub pa dang bstun nas/ /gnas lnga'i lha la rang rang so sor thim/ /ye shes gzhug dang dbang bskur byin rlabs thob/ /dbang rtags rigs lnga so so'i dbu brgyan pa/ /dpral ba'i gtso bo rnam snang dbu rgyan dang / /'khor rnams phyag mtshan 'khor lo dkar pos brgyan//de bzhin mgrin par snang mtha' pad ma dang / /snying gar rdor sems rdo rje rtse lnga pa//lte bar rin 'byung rin chen zur brgyad pa//gsang bar don grub sna tshogs 234

rdo rjes brgyan/ /de ltar gnas lngar sgrib pa sbyong tshul dang / /lha bsgom ye shes bstim dang dbang bskur ba/ /khrid ltar byed na rtsa gnas re re la/ /zhag bdun lnga'am gsum sogs rtse gcig sbyor/ /thon chos sngon ltar dus gcig bsgom pa ste/ /yang gsang sgrub pa'i dus sam rgyun khyer dus/ /'di ltar dus gcig bsgom pa phyag len lags/ /'di skabs 'khrul 'khor nā ro drug skor te/ /gsang gnas dmigs tshe rkang lag brkyang bskum yin/ /lte ba'i skabs su sked pa bskor ba dang //snying ga'i dus su ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu//mgrin pa'i dus su mgrin pa g.yon nas bskor/ /spyi bo'i skabs su mgo bo dgye rgya'o/ /'di skabs bsnyen pa gtso ni mi che ste/ /rlung dang sngags dang ngag gsum don gcig phyir/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor kho na gal chen yin//gal te rgas sam nad bu can la sogs//rlung dang 'khrul 'khor mi lcog mi chun na/ /sngags bzla dmigs pa kho nas chog pa yin/ /de yis drod dang bde ba mi skye yang / /yang gsang sgrub par the(gtogs) zhing byin rlabs 'byung / /de nas rlung bzung gtum mo drag tu sbar/ /gsang gnas nas bzung rtsa 'khor lnga po yi/ /lha tshogs thams cad gtum mo'i me yis zhu/ /sku mdog dang mtshungs thig le re rer gyur/ /spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems dkar po yi/ /thig pa char zim lta bur babs pa yis/ /rtsa gnas thig le rnams la des bran pas/ /lha rnams sngar dang mthun par skad cig gsal/ /bkrag mdangs gzi brjid sngar las bdun 'gyur che/ /slar yang rlung bzung gtum mo'i me sbar bas/ /spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems rgyun babs pas/ /rtsa gnas lha tshogs kun gyi zhal du zhugs/ /sku lus bde ba rgyas shing bkrag mdangs 'phel/ /gtso bo lnga po yab yum sbyor ba mdzod/ /sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar 235

babs pa'i rgyun//rtsa 'dab lnga gang lhag mas lus kun gang //bdag lus bde ba tshad med skyes par bsgom /'di skabs lus sbyong so bdun 'khrul 'khor bya/ /gal te lus la bde ba dngos skye tshe/ /bde ba'i ngo bo bltas la bde stong bsre/ /'di la bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tha snyad med/ /rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi rnal 'byor yin/ /thig le bsgom par chu zla'i gar bsgyur zer/ /'di la sgrub pa'i tshad dang zhag grangs med/ /rtags thon byed na rtse gcig sgom pa dang / /rgyun khyer byed na thun re bsgom yang rung //bdag kyang snga sor rtse gcig bsgoms pa dang / /phyis ni rgyun khyer chags med thun re ste//rlung dang 'khrul 'khor lcog dang mi lcog de//rang gi dal khom bstun te gang 'dod rung / /dmigs pa thun re 'khrul 'khor ma chags na/ /khams bde nad rigs kun la phan par mthong / /rang gi nyams myong dang bstun go bde bar/ /shin tu bsdus pa sa bon tsam yin gyi/ /rgyas pa grub chen rkarma pakṣu yi//gdams ngag rgya mtsho mtha' yas gzhung chen dang //zab chos rgya mtsho mtha' yas gnyis po yi//gzhung dang cha lag yig cha dpag med pa//bka' 'bum nang nas 'byung ba gzigs pas gsal/ /bla med rgyud sde kun gyi bcud yin te/ /grub chen pakṣu rgya nag hor gyi mtshams/ /grub rtags mang po bstan pa rdzas dang ni/ /gdams ngag yin snyam phyag dpe thams cad dang / /sku chas thams cad bcom nas gcig pur bzhag/de tshe phyag dpe ci yang med pa'i dus/ /rgya gar grub chen thams cad zhal gzigs te/ /thams cad a tsa ra yi cha lugs kyi/ /mi res gdams ngag sna re bri bar gzigs/ /de don thugs su chud pa'i snying po ste/ /rlung dang dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ma gtogs pa/ /rdzas dang 'khor lo sngags sogs mi dgos par/ /mchog thun phrin las rnam bzhi kun 236

'grub pa'i/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag rtsa ba 'di yin te//'a di yi cha lag bye brag dpag tu med/ /pakṣus gsungs pa'i zab chos phal cher rnams/ /rtsa ba 'di las 'phros pa'i yan lag yin//gsar rnying bla med rgyud sde kun la sbyar//khyad par bla med bde dgyes gsang gsum dang / /nag rgyal phag gsum rnams kyi khyad chos yin/ /'di ni zab mo'i bskyed rim zhes kyang bya/ /rtsa rlung yin pas rdzogs rim phyogs su'ang gtogs/ /yang gsang bla na med pa'i sgrub thabs yin/ /zhag re'i nang du gtor bsngos re byas te//gtor mgron ye shes skad cig spyan drangs la//gtor ma bsngo zhing mchod bstod phrin las bcol/ /ye shes rang bstems 'jig rten gshegs par dmigs//de min mdun bskyed la sogs 'di la med//gsang ba rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor la//brten nas bsgrub pa a nu yo ga'i lugs//gsar ma'i lugs la lus dkyil zhes kyang bya/ /pakṣu'i dgongs pa gsar rnying zung 'jug dang / /phyag rdzogs zung 'jug dgongs pa'i mthar thug yin/ /de skad rta lo khrums zla'i nyer gsum la/ /snga dro'i thun skabs rā ga a sus smras/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bris/ /'gal 'khrul nyes pa srung ma rnams la bshags/ /dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog /le'u sum bcu tham pa maṅga lam̐/ /237

de bzhin nyid sgrub dag pa rab 'byams/tshokhriri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/bla med yi dam spyi'i de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa snang srid dag pa rab 'byams zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā gu ru ḍā ki ni ye//bla ma mchog dang yi dam ḍā ki la//phyag 'tshal gus btud bka' yi gnang ba zhu/ /rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i lugs/ /de kho na nyid sems kyi dkyil 'khor du//snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams lha//gsar ma'i chos lugs skad cig dran rdzogs zer/ /swa bhā wa sogs sngags kyis sbyong mi dgos/ /stong nyid lta ba'i ngang la gnas bzhin du/ /ngag tu mngon rtogs cho ga 'don mi dgos//dngas pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin/ /rang nyid yi dam lha yi skur bsgoms te//snod kyi 'jig rten 'di ni gzhal yas khang //bcud kyi sems can bdag bskyed lha yi 'khor/ /gdod nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med de//rang lus gdod nas dam tshig sems dpa' nyid/ /rang gi sems nyid ye shes sems dpa' ste/ /yin la yin shes gsal gdab dbang bskur nyid/ /stong nyid rtsi dang ma bral lta ba'i ngang //yi dam lha sku gsal stong zung du 'jug/'di nyid bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom pa'i mchog/gsang sngags bstan pa'i dngos gzhi de yin te//de skad rdo rje 'chang gis bka' stsal pa//bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang //rdzogs pa yi ni rim pa ste//rim gnyis mnyam par gang gnas pa//'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /ces gsungs so/ /lce rkan phreng ba bral ba'i 238

bzlas pa ste/ /rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas gsum dang sprad nas/ /yig 'bru'i gzugs ni bsgom pa ma yin te/ /rlung ni nang du 'jug pa ye ge oṃ/ /khong du gnas pa yi ge āḥ yin te/ /phyi ru 'byung ba yi ge hūṃ du shes/ /de ltar ma yengs yid kyis dbugs grangs brtsi//dbugs ni shugs 'byung brtsi ba ma gtogs pa//nang du bzung ba la sogs ma yin no/ /de ltar nangs snga brgya 'am nyer gcig bgrang //de nas nyin gung de ltar yin shes pas//nyal kha bdun nam nyer gcig de ltar bgrang / /de nas gnyid tshe'ang de ltar yin par bsam/ /de yis zhag gcig 'byung gnas dbyung dang gsum/ /gcig tu brtsi ba'i sngags kyi grangs ka ni/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gro ba'i phyir/ /'bad rtsol med par lha 'grub bzlas pa them//'di ni 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste//gsar rnying rgyud sde kun nas rgya cher gsungs//rgyud sde la lar rngub pa hūṃ dang ni//gnas pa āḥ sogs go rim mi mtshungs yang / /'on kyang gong gi de dag kun dang mthun/ /zhi gnas skye ba'i mchog kyang de yin te/ /nyon mongs thams cad shugs kyis 'gag par gsungs/ /de nas 'di yi sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni//nang du 'jug pa yi ge oṃ du bsam//khong du cung zad rlung ni bzung ba des//gang yin sngags de dngos gzhi yin par bsam/ /phyi ru dbyung tshe hūṃ dang swā hā sogs/ /sngags mjug yi ge gang yin de ru bsam/ /dper na nang du 'jug pa yi ge oṃ/ /khong du gnas pa ma ṇi pad me ste/ /phyi ru dbyung pa hūṃ du shes par bya/ /de ni yid kyi bzlas pa yin pa'i phyir/ /ngag tu mi brjod phreng ba bgrang mi bya/ /sngags grangs 'gro tshul phan yon gong dang mtshungs//'di yi gtor mchod la sogs bya tshul ni//phor pa la sogs zas kyi snod de ni/ /rin chen las grub bhanta dum gcig dbyibs//bza' btung 239

sreg rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga//yig 'bru gsum po brjod pas byin gyis brlabs//lte 'og gtum mo ye shes me yin te/ /kha ni thabs khung lce ni me lce yin/ /lag pa dgang gzar blugs gzar shes par bya//de yi gzugs su bsgom pa ma yin no//yang gsang bsgrub pa'i lus dkyil gsal btab ste/ /de dag rnams la sreg blugs mchod pa 'bul/ /mdun bskyed logs su dgos pa ma yin te/ /rdo rje rigs kyi yi dam yin na ni/ /shar du kha bltas mngon dga'i zhing khams dang / /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba mdun bskyed rten du bsgom/ /de bzhin tshe dpag rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs/ /pad ma rigs kyi yi dam yin na ni/ /nub du kha bltas bde chen zhing khams kyi//snang ba mtha' yas mdun bskyed gtso bo ste//cha lugs rang gi yi dam gang yin bsgom/ /de la phyag dang mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe bdag bskyed skyil krung stong gsum khyab//sku yang srid pa'i rtse mo yar brgal ba//bsgoms pas thag ring zhing khams lha de yang //rang dang zhal sprod mdun bskyed nye bar yong / /thugs las spros pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ni/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen bdun/ /gdod nas grub pa lha mi'i longs spyod tshogs/ /blo yis blangs te yang yang mchod par bya/ /mdun bskyed rten dang mchod rdzas gzhan mi dgos/ /rdzogs rim bsdu dang rjes chog gshegs gsol med/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i lugs//de kho na nyid sems kyi dkyil 'khor la//brten nas bsgrub pa'i man ngag zab mo ste//'di'i don pad sdong brtsegs pa'i rgyud 'grel dang //mthar thug bla med rgyud sde rnams nas gsungs/ /dag pa rab 'byam 'char thabs ngo mtshar che/ /dper na gu ru zhi drag sgrub pa'i tshe/ /rnga yab gling phran 240

mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor yin//thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa gang byed kyang //lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin mdun bskyed bya//sgrol ma'i rigs la'ang de dang mtshungs pa yin/ /bde mchog phag mo la sogs sgrub pa'i tshe/ /nub phyogs o rgyan yul de mdun bskyed bya//de bzhin yi dam chos skyong gang sgrub kyang //so so gar bzhugs gnas de mdun bskyed gtso//so so gang bzhugs phyogs der kha gyu nas//gnas de tshun chad bdag bskyed kyis khyab pa'i//chen po bsgom pa de ni gnad yin te//'di dag mi 'thad blo bzo yin dgongs na/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po'i chos kyi rnam grangs ste/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs mdo la/ /legs par bltas na the tshom chod pa 'ong //de bzhin rtsa brgyud pad sdong brtsegs pa yi/ /'grel pa o rgyan nyid kyis mdzad pa las/ /dbang po rab kyis bskyed rim 'di ltar gsungs//mdun du dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing spyan 'dren pa//blo chung dbang po tha ma'i gang zag go/de kho na nyid sgrub thabs zab mo 'di/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse a ti yo ga'i lugs/ /bdag kyang da ni na so song ba dang / /spros bcas mang po lcog par dka' ba'i phyir//sgrub thabs 'di nyid nyams su len pa yin/ /gnam chos dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med/ /mngon rtogs nyung bsdus tsam dang snying bo las/ /gzhan med sdum sdum 'dra ba 'byung pa rnams/ /sgrub thabs 'di ltar nyams su len phyir lags//mkhas shing chen por rlom pa 'ga' zhig gis//ma tshang mi 'dug smra ba thos mod kyis/ /thegs dgu so sor sgrub lugs mi gcig pa/ /de dag ma shes pa yi rang mtshang lags/ /de skad rta lo khrums kyi zla ba yi/ /dmar po'i tshes brgyad nyin gung thun mtshams la/ /sngags 'chang rā ga a sus smras pa rnams/ /bu chen bīrya sā ga ra yis bris/ /'di la sba 'os gsal bkod 241

nyes mchis na//chos bdag ḍā ki srung ma'i tshogs la bshags//dge bas rtogs ldan 'ga' la phan thogs shog/le'u so gcig pa'o maṅga lam̐//spros med dril sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/smrosari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ bla med gsar rnying yi dam ḍā ki spyi'i dril sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sirnyi pha la hūṃ/ /yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de dag spyi dril sgrub pa 'dir 'god bya/ /bka' yis gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs//dkyil 'khor mchod gtor la sogs sta gon rnams//nang sgrub nyid dang khyad par med pa la/ /gsar ma yin na snga dro bdag bskyed dang / /nyin phyed mdun bskyed dgongs mo tshogs gtor bsngo//rnying ma yin cing las byang nyung na ni/ /nyin par dus gsum mtshan dang thun bzhi 'don/ /cho ga mang na las byang rgyas pa de/ /snga dro 'don cing phyi dro tshogs gtor 'bul/ /mtshan thun mngon rtogs nyung bsdus tsam zhig bya/ /dmigs pa'i sgom tshul snga dro'i dus kyi tshe/ /phyi sgrub nang ltar bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa bya//nyin gung nang sgrub nang gi dmigs pa bya//dgongs mo gsang sgrub dmigs pa ci lcog bya//srod la yang gsang sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang / /'khrul 'khor tshar gcig kyang ni brgyab par bya/ /nyal kha de bzhin nyid kyi sgrub pa ni/ /dmigs pa gsal gdab nyams len ngang la gzhag /bdun dang bcu bzhi nyer gcig zhag gi tshad/ /chig 'bum bzhi 'bum bdun 242

'bum grangs kyi tshad/ /rtags yig bzhin du byung na rtags kyi tshad/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang / /de bzhin nyid kyi sgrub pa gcig tu dril/ /de phyir dril sgrub zhes ni bya ba ste/ /'di ni yi dam mchog gi dril sgrub yin/ /chos skyong dril sgrub nyid dang don mi gcig /sgrub pa sna mang spros pa mi lcog cing //phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub par 'brel 'jog 'dod/ /sgrub rdzas mchod gtor yang yang mi 'dzom na/ /'di nyid bsgrubs pas sgrub pa thams cad tshang / /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dmigs rim tshogs/ /'phro 'du mang po'i dmigs pa zin dka' na/ /rtsa ba'i dmigs pa re re res mos chog /yi dam ḍā ki kun gyi spyi sgrub 'di/ /dngos grub kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /bla med gsar rnying rgyud sde du ma dang / /rgya gzhung sgrub thabs zab mo du ma'i bcud/ /mkhas mchog slob dpon mang po'i zhal khrid dang / /rang gis yang yang nyams blangs myong bas sbyar/ /phyi rabs sngags 'chang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag yin kyang gsal bar bkod/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis kun bslangs pas/ /chos bdag ḍā kyis ko long mi mdzad zhu/ /de skad rta lo khrums kyi zla ba yi/ /dmar po'i tshes dgu lha mo rgyu ba'i nyin/ /snga dro'i cha la rā ga a sus smras/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis/ /myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul mig 'phrul 'dra bar bris/ /phyi rabs sngags 'chang sgrub pa 'dod rnams la/ /bzhag pa chen po yin no maṅga lam̐//le'u so gnyis pa'o// 243

'khrul 'khor rtsa tshig dzi bu'i chu gser/(snyori chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ 'khrul 'khor gyi rtsa tshig slad med 'dzam bu chu gser zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru dzñā na ḍā ki ye//bla med spyi yi yang gsang sgrub pa dang //gtum mo'i khrid rim kun la sbyar rung ba'i//gsol 'debs nyung du 'khrul 'khor rtsa tshig ni//rdo rje'i gsung yin byin rlabs che ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi skyabs gnas rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /rnyarma shwa ri'i gsungs nyid slad med ni/ /rje skyabs gsum gyi ngo bo bla ma rje/ /pha rtogs ldan gyi rgyal po dgongs su gsol//tsaṇḍi bde stong du 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs//sgyu lus lha sku ru 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyid 'od gsal du thim par byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam sgyu lus su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'da' ka sku gsum du 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs//bar do chos nyid du grol bar byin gyis rlobs//zhes pa 'di nyid du 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs su'o/ /rtsa khrus yan lag lnga sbyong ni/ /skyil krung rdor stabs dpung steng sbub/ /rlung bzung lag gnyis brla steng nas/ /nu steng rgyud bshad mdun du brkyang / /nu steng gnyis su lan gsum brdab / /g.yas g.yon lag pa lan gsum bshad/ /thal mo gsum phur mgo bo dang / /ro rgyab rgyab mdun ro smad 'phur//mchan brdab byas la rkang g.yas g.yon//brkyang pa lan gsum mnye bar bya/ /zhes pa 'ang bka' rtsal to/ /rked pa g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gyis/ /lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin//ro stod g.yas g.yon gcud 244

pa yis/ /snying ga'i rtsa mdud grol ba yin/ /mgrin pa bskor zhing dgye dgu yis/ /spyi bo mgrin ba'i rtsa mdud grol//rkang lag brkyang bskum byas pa yis//tshigs kyi rtsa mdud grol ba yin//lus sbrug 'phur srub byas pa yis/ /rtsa rnams thams cad 'dul ba yi/ /so bdun ma ni/ /sa non byas la pho ba ni/ /g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor bas drug /pus mo g.yas par 'jus nas ni/ /de bzhin drug dang g.yon la'ang drug /mthe bong srin rtsa mnan nas kyang / /g.yas g.yon khu tshur zhags 'phen drug /g.yas g.yon mda' 'gengs byed pa drug /g.yas g.yon lag pa'i nang shad drug /lus kun sprug dang so bdun no/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ /bla med spyi yi rdzogs rim du/ /nā ro chos drug mdzad pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'di yis tshang / /rjes nas ti phu pa la sogs/ /slob ma rnams kyis mang bsnan kyang //rtsa ba 'di yis chog pa'i phyir//bdag gi 'dren mchog rgyal ba yis/ /mdzad pa'i chos drug rgyas bsdus la'ang / /'di las gzhan pa'i 'khrul 'khor med/ /gsar rnying bla med spyi dang ni/ /khyad par nag rgyal phag gsum dang / /gnam chos la sogs gtum mo la'ang / /'khrul 'khor 'di nas chog pa yin/ /khyad chos sku gsum ngo sprod dang / /rlung sems gnyis med la yang chog /'di yis 'bud pa dgu sprug dang / /lag pa'i 'khyer lugs stangs stabs rnams/ /zhib par mthong ba brgyud par ltos/ /'bebs ni che chung gang rigs sbyor/ /de yang stod 'tshang la sogs pa'i/ /rlung ni thur du dbab phyir yin//don gzhan med phyir gal yang chung //rab tu 'khrul 'khor tshan gsum po//ma rdzogs bar du rlung mi gtang / /'bring du tshan gsum mtshams su gtong / /dang po sbyong dus mi thub pas/ /ma thub so bar btang zhing bzung / /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor 245

dmigs pa gsum/ /dar drag bar med brtson byas pas/ /yun ring mi thogs ras kyang thub/ /thun re thun gnyis yud res kyang / /phan yon che ste drod mi skye/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor ma brtson na/ /sgom bzlas phan yon yod mod kyi//drod ni skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gsar bu rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rā ga a sus bsgrigs bcug pa/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ge byas/ /'di nyid bsgrigs la nyes 'gal med/ /dge bas na gzhon chos 'dod pa'i/ /rtogs ldan 'ga' la phan thogs shog/le'u so gsum pa'o maṅga lam̐//'grub rtag tshod 'dzin 'phrul gyi me long /tsho'iri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ rtags yig 'khrul gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sirnyi hūṃ/ /rten 'brel dngul dkar las grub me long du//so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab bzhin ras kyis//legs par bltas pas mchog thun dngos grub sogs/ /legs nyes dngos su bkra 'di e ma ho/ /deng sang mchog tu rlom pa'i rmongs pa 'gas/ /nyams dang rmi lam rtags dang mtshan mo sogs//kun rdzobs 'khrul pa yin pas 'bras med cing //de 'dra brtag pa'ang 'khrul zhes bzhad gad byed/ /mthar thug nges pa'i don la shāka thub kyis/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa'ang mi bden ste/ /mthong pa po rnams 'khrul pa'i dag snang tsam//rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal mi bden ste//so so'i kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i snang ba tsam//da lta rang lus skye rga na 'chi dang //skyid sdug 246
