kun kyang mi bden 'khrul pa nyid/ /'on kyang mthar thug nges don chos kyi sku/ /mngon du ma gyur bar du thams cad bden/ /rtags dang rten 'brel kun kyang shin tu bden/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ma lags pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yong pa ma yin klu sgrub gsungs//dang po'i sa nas bcu pa'i sa yi bar sa thob pa yi rtags rnams rmi lam du/ /'byung bar rmi lam bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /gsar rnying sgrub gzhung kun las 'grub pa'i rtags/ /rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma rmi lam gsungs//mar mi dwags sogs sngar byon grub thob rnams//rmi lam la brten lung bstan mgur sogs gsungs/ /de phyir mtshams sgrub byed pa'i gang zag la/ /rab ni mngon sum lha yi zhal mthong dang / /dbang bskur chos gsungs lung du ston pa 'byung //de ni skal ldan skyes bu las can te/ /dper na gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha bzhin/ /de la'ang bslu ba yod med brtag dgos te/ /khro bo'i skur bsgom drag sngags rdzas rgod bdug /de byas yal zhing med na gdon kyi rtags/ /ma yal je gsal song na lha yi rtags/ /gsungs shing lung du bstan pa'i tshig de kun/ /mdo rgyud don dang mi 'ga' lha yi rtags/ /'gal zhing log par song na bdud yin no/ /deng sang de 'dra 'ong ba res 'ga' tsam/ /dngos su bag dro byin 'thibs rig pa dngas/ /sems dga' ba dang dag snang nges shes 'phel//gsol ba btab pas dbang med mchi ma 'khrugs//dgun sgang yon chab la la rdo ltar khengs/ /la la mi khengs yon chab 'dzin pa zer//gtor ma la la rdo ltar khengs pa na/ /la la khengs pa'i zhad med gtor ma 'dzin//sgrub pa'i dus sam dus bzang gsol 'debs du//phyogs der med pa'i spos dri chil gyis 'byung / /rnga dang rnga lcag phreng ba lus gos la/ /me 'bar sir sgra dang bcas 247

tsha tsha 'phro/ /nang mchod khol zhing phyur dang rlangs pa 'byung / /dam rdzas ril bu khol dang 'phel ba dang //sgrub khang nye log 'ja' tshon yang yang zug//sgrub khang nang du sprin 'ja'am 'ja' gur phub/ /rol mo'i sgra dang sngags sgra yang yang thos/ /sngar dus yod pa'i sro shig thams cad med/ /lce ru za ma myong ba'i ro mchog myong //rgas par se'u skye dang so la ni//ring bsrel 'phel sogs dngos su 'byung ba dang / /gtor ma zhu dang bdud rtsi 'bab pa dang / /gtor ma bdud rtsir zhu ba 'grub pa'i rtags/ /'on kyang gtor ma zhu dang bdud rtsi babs/ de gnyis bar chad dngos grub brtag dka' snang //byin rlabs rten med tha mal skye bo'i khyim//mar me yang yang 'dzin na gdon che'i rtags//bsnyen sgrub ma byas tha mar skye bo yi/ /so la ring bsrel byung na na'am 'chi/ /de dag mngon sum 'byung ba'i rtags rnams yin//khyad par bskyed rdzogs nyams len brtson pa de'i//lus ni sus mthong dad gus skye ba dang //dag nas ci smras chos su song ba dang //yid ni gar gtad nad gdon zhi nus pa/ /de ni mchog gi rtags su gsungs na yang / /bdud kyis byin brlabs la yang de 'byung bas/ /rang dang de la ltos pa thams cad ni//rim bzhin dge la sbyor na lha yi rtags//thabs kyis sdig la sbyor na bdud yin no//lha rtags bdud rtags gang byung khyad med ste//rlom sems nga rgyal khengs pa rang che skyes//de ni lha rtags yin kyang bdud du 'gyur//dman sa 'dzin cing bskyed rdzogs dge sbyor brtson/ /rtags mtshan bzang la nga rgyal rlom sems med/ /de ni bdud rtags yin kyang dngos grub 'thob/ /'o na brtag ni dgos rgyu med snyam na//lha rtags yin na dngos grub len chog bya/ /bla ma lha dang gdams par dad gus bskyed/ /gdon rtags yin na gzir mnan bgegs 248

rnams bskrad/ /dbang po 'bring la nyams la rtags 'byung ste/ /nyams la mthong nyams shes nyams rnam pa gnyis/ /mthong nyams zhes pa mngon sum ma yin zhing //gnyid dang cha 'dres sad rgyu zhig kyang yod//gnyid pa ma yin mngon sum yin 'dra ba//de 'dra skabs su mthong ba mthong nyams zer//de ni ma gcig lab sgron gyis kyang bzhed/ /gnyid pa min yang mig ni btsum pa la/ /yid la dran pa 'dra yang dran pa min/ /mngon sum nyid du mthong ba lta bur gsal/ /de dus lha sogs zhal gzigs gang byung ba/ /gal gzigs go chod garma pakṣus bzhed/ /de dang 'dra 'am snyam yang mi 'dra ste/ /sngar shi'i mi dang phyan myong yul gru sogs/ /mngon sum lta bur yid la dran pa ni/ /rtog dor zhes bya snying bo med pa yin//de skad slob dpon mtshan nyid pa rnams gsungs/ /de min mthong nyams/ dang ni shes nyams la//yi dam lha yi zhal mthong gsung thos tshe//yengs pa ltar song drag sngags bzla ba dang / /bskyed rim la sogs bsgom rgyu mi rnyed kyang / /lha rtags yin nam bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /sku gzugs bzang ngan sogs kyis mi 'byed pas/ /gla rtsi'i dri ma sogs ni ma yin pa'i//dri bzang bro na lha yi rtags su nges/ /bse dri rul dri sgog skya'i dri ma sogs/ /dri ngan zhad tsam snang ba 'dre yi rtags/ /nyams de yal rjes rang gi sems la brtag/ /snying dga' lhag ger 'dug na lha yin nges/ /nyams snang sku gzugs sogs ni ma mthong bar/ /legs nyes smra dang gegs sel bogs 'don tshig/yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yin pa na//thog tu 'gro zhing rang yang nyams rtogs skye//sa bla 'byung po the'u rang rtags yin na//'phral du thig kyang rang gi dge sbyor 'grib/ /zang zing 'du yang rim gyis mi dger spyod/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gros nyams tshad byed pa'i rtags/ /lung bstan 249

mang zhing gang zer thig pa la/ /nga rgyal skyes na de nas mi thig ste/ /rang yang lha dang mkha' 'gror log lta skye/ /dam tshigs sel zhugs log pa'i lam du 'gro/ /lung bstan byung zhing thig na nga rgyal spang / /ma thig bslus na'ang log lta the tshom spang / /lta ba'i klong du ro snyoms nus pa na/ /lung bstan mkhan de bzang ngan su yin yang / /gegs su mi 'gro byang chub lam du 'gro/ /de bzhin nam mkhar yi ge shar ba dang / /bka' shog 'dra ba'i yi ge lag tu phyin/ /rang gzhan don gnyis gsal zhing thig na yang / /nga rgyal rlom sems mi bya gnad du che/ /de bzhin nyams snang ri brag mi sgrib par/ /gzugs mthong skad thos mngon shes 'dra na yang / /mngon shes yin snyam nga rgyal spang ba gces//de bzhin nyams snang pha rol mi gzhan gyis//kho rang gang bsams kha nas zer snang 'byung //de la brten nas ci bsams shes 'dra yang / /nyams kyi 'char sgo yin pas nga rgyal spang / /gang zag tha mal dngos nyams rtags mtshan dkon/ /rtags rnams rmi lam btags dgos lab sgron gsungs/ /khrus byed gos dkar gyon dang gangs rir 'dzegs/ /nam langs shel rnying mchod rten bskor ba byed//de dag sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags su gsungs//nyi zla shar dang rta zhon gyen la rgyug /dar phyar dung 'bud khrom 'du khri la 'dug /de dag bsod nams rgyas pa'i rtags yin no/ /go gyon mtshon thogs btsan pa'i gnas su 'dug /mkhar brtsegs rdzong 'dug bsrung ba 'grub pa'i rtags/ /dmag dang ser ba bzlog dang phur pa bcag /gcan gzan kha bcing bzlog pa 'grub pa'i rtags/ /g.yul 'gyed btson bzung bsod gcod drag po'i rtags/ /mun rug gos ngan gyon zhing thur du song / /lam ngan 'grim rmis tshe bsod zad pa'i rtags/ /rang nyid btson bzung rbab dang ser bas 250

ded//mda' 'tshub byung rmis byad kha zug pa'i rtags/ /tshe tshad smra dang sā tstsha mang po rmis/ /bdud rtsi sil thog srus zos tshe 'phel rtags/ /skra dang kha spu ring skyes gter rnyed dang / /rtsa sngo rin chen rnyed pa nor 'phel rtags/ /bzang ngan phal cher rig pas dpag ste shes/ /'on kyang bzang bzang 'dra la ngan pa'i rtags/ /bud med rgyan can mang po glu gar bcas/ /rang la bkur sti gus zhabs chen po ni/ /mkha' 'gro'i sun mas rang nyid tshe 'pho'i rtags/ /de la sun bzlog byed pa gnad du che/ /lha mo sgrub dus yin na skyon cher med/ /me tog dmar po'i thang la phyin pa dang / /lus la me tog dmar pos brgyan pa na/ /dbang gi phrin las sgrub na 'grub rtags te/ /dus min byung na rang nyid 'chi ba'i rtags/ /mkhar khang btsan por 'dug pa bzang lags kyi/ /mkhar ni dmar po ring po'i rtser 'dug cing / /mtha' mar 'obs dang lcags ri mang pos bskor/ /de ni 'chi ba'i rtags su gsungs pa yin/ /nya dang dug sbrul chen pos rang nyid ded/ /rang nyid / byur mid byas te mgo'am mjug /cung zad khar ma shong ba phyir lus pa/ /rlang bzung skabs yin dbu mar tshud rtags bzang / /dus min rmis na 'chi'am gtad mnan rtags/ /gser ni mang po rnyed pa rmis pa na/ /nyams len brtson skabs yin na rtogs pa skye/ /nor sgrub byed skabs yin na dngos grub 'byung / /bya ba sgrub kha yin na phyi dal che/ /dus min rmis na 'chi ba'i rtags yin no/ /dngul ni mang po rnyed pa rmis pa na/ /rtsa rlung sgom skabs thig le 'phel ba'i rtags/ /zhi ba'i las dang nor sgrub 'grub pa'i rtags//dus min rmis na rgyal bo'i bar chad yin//gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun sde chen po//dri zhim dang ba 'gro rmis sgrib dag rtags/ /sgog hral dang ba mi 'gro rgyal 'gong rtags/ /de sogs bzang 251

rtags ngan par ston pa rnams/ /rmi lam bzang yang sad tshe snying mi dga'/ /de nas ngan rtags bzang bar ston pa ni//lus la rnag khrag skyugs 'grim mi gtsang thon/ /rang lus mes bsregs thal ba rlung la bskur/ /de dag sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /rang snying rang zos rang khrag rang gis 'thung / /rang lus rang gis gtor nas rjes med byas//lus po bsgyur nas glo snying rgyab tu gyon//de dag nyams rtogs bzang po skye ba'i rtags/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gang sgrub pa'i/ /sku dngos mthong ngam bris sku lder sku dang / /rang byon nam ni gser sku legs por mjal/ /de dag sku ni 'grub pa'i rtags su gsungs/ /lha de'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs glegs bam dang //bris legs spos dri can gyi dpe cha rnyed//shog ser gter bton gsung ni 'grub pa'i rtags/ /ḍā dril phur pa kha tt+waṃ la sogs pa/ /phyag mtshan legs po rnyed rmis thugs 'grub rtags/ /de sogs phal cher rigs pas brtag pas shes//snum zhing bkrag che dang ba 'gro na lha//thal mdog sgog hral 'gong bo'i ltas yin no/ /nam srod mi lam bag chags nges pa med/ /nam phyed lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul nges pa med/ /tho rangs rmi lam 'bras bu yod pa ste//de yang tsog pu'am seng ge'i nyal stabs dgos//gzhogs g.yon sar bstan rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa'i phyir//rtsub po rmis kyang nges pa yod pa min//rmi lam mang yang sang tshe brjed gyur na/ /bzang ngan ci ltar rmis kyang nges pa med/ /rmi lam skrag sngangs byung ba la brten nas//bskyed rim zin pa rtsub zin zhes bya'o//de tshe gdon sogs drag pos btul ba ni//nus pa cung zad thon pa'i rtags yin no//'jam zin lan 'gar zin na bar dor zin/ /rmi lam dang po yi dam lha bsgoms pas//de nyid rang nyid dngos su gyur pa dang //lha dang mkha' 'gro mang 252

pos phyag 'tshal dang / /rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / /rang nyid dbyer med gcig tu mthong ba dang //de dag rnams kyis chos gsungs dbang bskur dang / /brda yi tshul gyis dam chos ston pa dang / /rgya bod rig 'dzin yi dam chos skyong tshogs//rang dang 'brel ba yod med sna tshogs pa/ /yang yang zhal mjal gdams pa bstan pa sogs/ /rang gi yi dam gang sgrub de'i rtags te//rgyal ba thams cad ye shes gcig phyir ro//rang gi skyur nas gzhan de 'don mi dgos/ /de dag bskyed rim 'byongs pa'i rtags yin no/ /de nas thar lam sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lus ni rdung gtag btad bzhin chad cing hral//skyur snying 'dod pa gtum mo sdug bsngal dus/ /de yi rtags su shes byas snying rus bskyed/ /zhu sla 'grangs dka' drod ni cung zad 'bar/ /pho nad la sogs gcong nad phal cher byang //rlung dang gtum mo gnad du 'gro ba'i rtags//phyi yi lus po 'khyags par gyur na yang //sems ni dro ba'i snang bas 'khyags ma tshor//drod ni phyi nas skyed dang nang nas skye/ /khol bur skye sogs rtsa rigs khyad yin te/ /gos ni spu can gyon par mi bya ste/ /gyon na drod ni e skye mi tshor gsungs/ /drod ni skyes rim gos ni je srab bya/ /gos ni srab par goms 'jug gnad yin gsung / /lo gsum bar du ras rkyang byas pa na/ /rtogs ldan rab kyi gral du brtsi srol gda'/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa ma byas na/ /lus po rdo ltar 'khyags shing byas ma thag /drod 'ur 'phralarwa drod ni 'bar ba na/ /gtum mo nyams len sbyong pa'i skabs rang yin/ /dmigs pa byas kyang lhag tu mi dro la/ /nyams len sems ngo'i steng du bzhag pa na/ /dgun sgang ras rkyang byas kyang mi 'khyags pa/ /mthar phyin mchog gi gtum mo yin nam snyam/ /de ni gtum mo'i 253

drod kyi dus yin la/ /drod kyi stobs kyis thig le 'phel ba'i rtags/ /bza' ba zhan kyang lus nyams bzang ba dang / /lus kyi bkrag mdangs rgyas shing 'dod chags 'bar/ /de dang rtogs pa bsres pas bde stong 'dres/ /rtogs pas ma non sdom pa 'chor ba'i skabs//rtogs pas non cing nyams len skyong nus na/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags/ /lha 'dre mi gsum mi nor zas gsum 'du/ /mchog gi dngo sa grub myur du 'thob par gsungs/ /rgyun du rlung ni chags med bzung ba na//rang gzhan don kun rlung gi rtags kyis shes/ /legs nyes dgongs pa zhu mi byung ma thag/yang na rang gi bya ba 'grub mi 'grub//legs nyes bya ba brtag par dran ma thag /rlung ni g.yas nas rgyu na dar ba ste/ /g.yon nas rgyu na shin tu bzang ba yin//mnyam du rgyu na 'bring ste thag mi chod//nang du rngub dang thug na shin tu bzang / /phyi ru rgyu dang thug na shin tu ngan/ /khong du gnas dang thug 'bring thag chod med//g.yas nas rgyu dang phyir 'bud ngan thag chod//g.yon du rgyu dang nang jub bzang thag chod//mnyam du rgyu dang nang gnas thag mi chod//g.yas rgyu nang rngub bzang ngan 'dres ma ste//g.yon rgyu phyir 'bud de bzhin bzang ngan 'dres/ /bzang ngan 'dres ma rim gros bcos pa tsam/ /thag mi chod pa rnams la rim gros bslus/ /de ltar rtogs ldan bzang po rnams la ni//rlung ltas brtag pa zhu ba dbus gtsang lugs//rgyun du bzung mkhan min pas mi thig gsungs/ /rang nyid phyogs su 'gro ba la sogs tshe/ /gom pa dang po bor ba'i dus de ru/ /rlung ltas ngan na mi 'gro bshol ba dang / /bzang na mgo thon bar chad med rtags yin/ /de nas rdzogs rim khrid ni bsgoms pa'i rtags/ /mi rtag 'chi ba tung tung yang yang dran/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba gal chen gang 254

bas kyang / /nyams len sgrub pa gal che'i don go na/ /'chi ba mi rtag bsgoms pa'i rtags yin no/ /khas blangs sdom pa dam tshig legs par bsrung / /thos bsam sgom la dus rnams thams cad du/ /bya rgyu chos las med pa zhig byung na/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa'i rtags yin no/ /btsan pos mi byed ka med bsdig pa'am/ /phyug pos rngan pa chen po ster ba'am/ /mi bya ka med rang la gal thug kyang / /rtsa ba bzhi po gtong bar mi byed na/ /rgyu 'bras khrid rim bsgoms pa'i rtags yin no/ /rang gis ci byas lam du ma song zhing / /rang gis blo sems chos la gtad bzhin du//mi dge mi rung nad gdon dgras mnar yang / /dkon mchog lha la log lta mi skye zhing / /ci mdzad khyed shes da dung blo gtad na//skyabs 'gro'i khrid rim bsgoms pa'i rtags yin no//rang gis nyes pa rdul tsam ma byas par/ /mi kha rngan chen srog la bsngo sham yang / /nam zhig de yang sangs rgyas sar bzhag la/ /skye ba tshe rabs gtan nas brlag bsams pa'i/ /su la'ang bsam ngan de ltar mi 'chang ba/ /byang chub sems bskyed bsgoms pa'i rtags yin no/ /dngos su sems dga' khams dngas dbang bo gsal/ /rmi lam khrus byas lus las mi gtsang thon/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma 'thung dang nam mkhar 'phur//rdor sems bsgoms bzlas byas pa'i rtags yin te//nyams len dge sbyor gang yang ma byas par/ /'phur ba rmis na chas ka je bsrab 'gro/ /dngos su zas ma zos kyang mi ltogs shing / /lus nyams bzab zhing yid dga' bde nyams skye/ /rmi lam lo legs rin chen gter kha rnyed/ /gos bzang gyon rmis maṇḍal rtags yin no/ /dngos su mos gus gdung shugs dbang med 'bar/ /bla ma'i mtshan nas 'bod cing rgyang 'bod 'chor//gsol ba 'debs dus dbang med mchi ma 'khrugs//rmi 255

lam bla ma mjal zhing dbang lung gnang //gegs sel bogs 'don legs nyes lung ston mdzad/ /rang nyid bla ma de nyid dngos gyur dang / /ngo bo dbyer med 'dug par shes pa rmis/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i rtags yin no/ /dbang po tshogs brgyad mi gsal gnyid pa bzhin/ /dran pa med par yun ring thom mer lus//zhi gnas 'thom po skye ba'i rtags yin no/ /'gyu ba bsgags nas ci yang mi dran par//thob mer 'dug pa sgom du rlom pa ni//rgya nag ha shang lta ba skyes rtags so//rang sems rang dbang thob pa lta bu yi//dmigs pa gar yang mi 'phro yun ring gnas/ /thun mong zhi gnas skyes pa'i rtags yin no//rang sems ma bcos lhug par gzhag pa'i tshe/ /ha cang mi 'phro yun ring gnas pa na/ /tshad ldan zhi gnas skyes pa'i rtags yin no/ /gnas pa de yi ngo bor bltas pa'i tshe/ /stong par mthong ba'i ngang la yun ring gnas/ /zhi lhag zung 'jug rtogs pa'i rtags yin no/ /sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum kha dog dbyibs/ /so sor dpyad pas gcig kyang ma rnyed pa/ /thun mong lhag mthong shar ba'i rtags yin no/ /rtogs pa gang skyes ngo bor gcer gcer bltas/ /rang zhi chu dang chu rlabs ltar mthong na//'gyur ba lhag mthong shar ba'i rtags yin no//khab mig skud pa sprad ltar ma yengs par//gnas dang 'gyu ba'i ngo bo gang shar blta/ /gnas 'gyu rkyang ded shes pa'i rtags yin no//de nas de ltar dka' gnad mi dgos par/ /dran pa tsam nas thog tu khrig khrig sleb/ /nyams len skyong bde yod pa'i rtags yin no/ /lto gos gtam sogs 'dod pa chung du song / /chos phyogs yon tan sna mang bslab mi 'dod/ /nyams len mos gus gnyis po snying por go /'jig rten bya ba kun kyang dgos med rtogs/ /sgom chen gsar bas gser mi 'dod pa'i 256

dus/ /bde nyams brod ka rnyed pa'i rtags yin no/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa yin par rtogs//stong skad mtho zhing las 'bras mi 'dzem pa//stong lta had po skyes pa'i rtags yin no//rang gi nyams len nges shes the tshom med//su la'ang mi mgu zhe yis zhabs na gnon/ /gsal nyams brtan po skyes pa'i rtags yin no/ /yun ring bsgoms kyang shes rgyud sngar las rtsub/ /ko long ser sna phrag dog sngar las che/ /mi gzhan sgom chen zer zhing mtshang nas 'bru//sgom chen rnying bas lham krad bsdu ba'i dus/ /rtsub nyams chen po skye ba'i rtags yin no/ /me chen 'bar ba'i sngon du du ba bzhin/ /de dbang ma shor ngo bo skyong nus na/ /bogs chen myur du skye ba'i rtags yin no/ /sngon gyi nyams myong thams cad shun par bud//sems kyi nyams myong ngag gis brjod mi shes//nges shes nga rgyal thams cad 'ja' ltar yal/ /rang sems ngo bo rtogs pa'i rtags yin no//nyams dang rmi lam dag snang gcig kyang med/ /nges 'byung skyo shas mos gus je cher 'bar/ /bar chad med cing mi tshe sgrub la skyel/ /rtag med rtags kyi rgyal po zhes bya ste/ /bka' brgyud rnams kyis de la thugs rtsis che/ /rang sems rtogs pa'i gdeng la 'pho 'gyur med/ /ma rtogs 'gro la shugs 'byung snying rje skye//zas nor snyan grags 'dod pa spu tsam med/ /khrid rim gdams ngag lo zla sbrel na yang / /blo 'dzin ma byas dpe la ma bltas kyang / /sems la gang phan bshad rgyu zad mtha' med/ /gzhan phan 'gro don ran pa'i rtags yin no/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i rtags yig mdor bsdus 'di/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bskul byas nas/ /shing sbrul mgo yi zla ba'i yar tshes la/ /dge slong rā ga a su zhes bya bas//dgong mo'i thun mtshams 'ga' zhig la smras pa/ /bskul ba po yis brjed tho yi ger btab/ /blo dman 'ga' la 257

phan thogs rgya cher shog/le'u so bzhi pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /gol sa bcod pa ma nor lam ston/0ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ gol sa gcod pa ma nor lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu sto ṣa ye/ /shes rab stong pa nyid kyi ral gri la/ /thabs mchog snying rje chen po'i ngar btags nas/ /gol sa'i myu gu gcod pa'i ral gri 'di/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas gnang ba'i pha nor lags/ /dbang lung gdams pa thob nas kyang / /bskyed rdzogs ha go(don go) yod pa yis/ /mtshams dang sgrub pa byed na yang / /gol sa legs par ma chod na/ /dka' spyad sgrub pa byas gyur kyang / /'bras bu chen po mi thob ste/ /dper na tshong dpon ha log(tshong nyes) bzhin/ /gsang sngags ltung ba'i sgo dgu sogs/ /gol sa che phra mtha' yas kyang / /bsdu na chags sdang rmongs gsum yin/ /gcod pa'i gdams pa mtha' yas kyang / /bsdu na stong nyid snying rje yin/ /tshe 'di'i longs spyod snyan grags la/ /chags pa'i dbang gis 'dod pa skyes/ /dbang dang rgyas pa'i lha zhig la/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa byed pa ste/ /tsandan sol ba byas dang mtshungs/ /gal te de 'grub dngos grub thob//'chi ba rjes su ma dran pas/ /zang zing 'dod yon sred pas bcings/ /nyon mongs 'dod pa me ltar 'bar/ /da ni bdag gis lha 'di 'grub/ /ci ltar byas kyang bdag gis dpal/ /nyams par mi 'gyur zhe gding bcas/ /sha chang zas kyis pha ba brgyangs/ /rtsa rlung nyams len bdag la yod/ /258

bdag la mi sgrib khyod kyang 'dren/ /phrer zhing btsun ma mang po phab/ /nal phrug lkog gsod phug na 'dug /sgrub pa ye shes lha bsgrub kyang / /sems bskyed dbang gis log par song / /'grub pa lha bu'i bdud de 'grub/ /de 'drar dgong nas mkha' spyod pas/ /lo brgyar sgrub pa byas kyang don ma rig /de 'dra'i mi de the'u rang slob rgyud yin/ /gsungs pa'ang de 'drar dgongs pa yin/ /de yi gol sa gcod pa ni/ /tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor lta ci smos/ /phyi ma lha mi'i bde skyid dang / /tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur/ /thob kyang dga' ba spu tsam med/ /bla med byang chub la dmigs nas//dbang dang rgyas pa'i ye shes lha//bsgrubs pas bsod nams ye shes rgyas/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang du 'dus/ /dper na lo legs skya rgyal na/ /sog phub zhor la 'byung ba ltar//tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor snyan grags kyang / /ma dmigs na yang zhor la 'byung / /sgrub lugs khyad par med na yang / /sems bskyed bsams pa'i khyad par yin/ /de las kyang ni cher ngan pa/ /'jig rten drag rtsal can bsgrubs nas/ /ye shes lha bas 'di lhag ste/ /rno myur 'phral du che bsam nas/ /ci mdzad khyed shes blo rtse gtad//des ni skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa'ang 'chor/ /de phyir bka' gdams glegs bam nas/ /lha ngan phal cher 'dre bas gtsog/gsungs pa de 'drar dgongs pa yin//dper na sngon 'das bla chen zhig/pe har bsgrubs shing phyag rtags blangs//rgya nag yul du byon pa las//rgya nag rgyal po'i dbu blar gyur//ja dang gser dngul dpag med rnyed//de nas bod du yar byon te/ /smar shod phyogs kyi sa char 'das/ /rgyal po gdug rtsub che ba des/ /kho rang de yi 'khor du skyes/ /ja dar gser dngul longs spyod la/ /gnas bcas cho 'phrul dpag med bstan/ /grwa 'khor rnams kyis khyer ma phod/ /259

phug stong chen po'i phug tu brtsigs//da lta'ang gar yod kun gyis shes//blta ba tsam yang mi phod skad/ /de yang bsten lugs ma shes stabs/ /lha ma bsnyen par 'dre ma sgrub//o rgyan gsungs kyang de 'drar dgongs//dang po yi dam lha bsnyen nas/ /bskyed rdzogs gsal snang thon tsam dang / /rang rgyud byin gyis rlobs nges bya/ /de nas rno myur 'dod pa na/ /'jig rten dregs pa gang yin bsgrub/ /skyabs su 'dzin pa ma yin te/ /rab kyis bran dang g.yog po'i tshul/ /'bring gis spun dang shag rog tshul//tha mas pha khu tsam du dmigs/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /'gal rkyen sel ba'i sdong grogs bcol/ /gsol mchod de yi rngan pa tsam/ /bskyed rdzogs dgongs pa gsal ba na/ /sa lam bgrod la mi sgrib par/ /dngos grub ye shes lha dang mtshungs/ /rtogs pa shin tu mtho ba na/ /bka' srung 'jig rten dregs pa rnams//rang gi rig pa'i rang rtsal las//gzhan du grub pa ma dmigs gsungs/ /de gnyis chags pa'i gol sa yin/ /gol sa legs par ma chod na/ /phyi rol mu stegs pa rnams kyis/ /dbang phyug bsgrub dang khyad par med/ /de nas sdang ba'i gol sa ni/ /dus ngan snyigs mar dgra rkun mang / /nyam chung mi la rngam chen mang //gshin rje la sogs drag po'i lha//bdag gis bsgrubs nas 'grub byas te/ /klu bdud gdug pa can bzhin du//'gras tshad thams cad rtsad nas brlag//zas nor ka cha rta phyugs rnams//btsan dug sdong po ci bzhin du/ /sus zos mi la rtags myur ba/ /de 'dra 'dod nas sgrub pa byed/ /tshe 'dir gzhan 'phung phyi ma ni/ /rang nyid phung ba'i rtsa ba yin/ /de 'dra'i sgrub pa la dgongs nas//mi bskyod zhabs kyis zhal nas kyang //sgom chen mthu mkhan dang /sgo mchen 'chal ba la yud tsam 'phrad kyang mi rung gsungs so//de don 'jam 260

dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /rgyal bo'i blon po bram ze zhig /rgyal khrims ma non ngo log mang / /bram zes gshin rje gshed po bsgrubs/ /khrims dang su 'gal thams cad bsad/ /lo ni du mar blon po byas/ /bram ze de nyid tshe 'phos nas/ /yul 'dre gdug pa can du skyes/ /yun ring 'gro ba'i srog dbugs bsdus/ /tshe 'phos mnar med dmyal bar song / /lo grangs bye ba 'bum phrag tu/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal brjod mi langs/ /sgrib pa zad nas mi lus thob//yi dam gshin rje gshed po yis/ /rjes bzung rang rgyal 'bras bu thob/ /la las ye shes lha yis ni/ /las sbyor sgo nas bsgral na yang / /skyon med lha des 'dren 'gyur bas/ /rang gis 'dren ma thub kyang bzod//zer ba mi bden gong du gsal//de bas kyang ni cher long ba/ /'jig rten dregs pa bsgrubs nas bsgral/ /gtad dang ser nag rlung 'khor sogs/ /ngan sngags sbyor bas bsad pa ni/ /'dul ba'i lugs la sdom pa 'chor/ /'dul ba'i las tshog las/ mi'am mir chags pa bsad dam/ /mtshon thogs pas gnyer tam/ 'chir bcug gam/ 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod kyang rung ste dge slong de ni pham par 'gyur ba yin te/ gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod dang / /'gro ba kun gyis bdud bzhi nyon mongs tshogs/ /tshar gcod bla med byang chub sar 'god dang / /bstan pa spyi dang rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /sku tshe phrin las bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' srung tshogs/ /bsten cing bsgrub pa mkhas grub kun gyi lugs/ /bsten lugs 'dra yang sems bskyed khyad par yin/ /dper na chos rje rang byung rdo rje la/ /sngags pa dgu yis gshin rje bsgrubs nas brub//de tshe bsnyung gzhi bzlog pa 261

dgos 'dug gsungs/ /grags pa seng ges gshin rje kha thun gyis/ /bzlog pa mdzad pas sngags pa'i phug pa rdib/ /sngags pa dgu shi sngags grong nad ngan 'phyur/ /chos rje sku khams seng zhing bstan 'gror phan/ /de 'dra'i nus pa rang rer med na yang //sems bskyed bzang na byang chub lam du 'gro//de rnams sdang ba'i gol sa bkag pa yin//yi dam khro po a 'thas ther zug tu/ /lder sku bzhin du dngos por bsgoms pa na/ /gshin rje dang ni srin por gol ba yin/ /rta phag yab yum la sogs mgo brnyan can//dud 'gro de 'dra'i mgo can yin snyam na//sha za phra man mgo brnyan can du gol/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams ther zug lder sku bzhin/ /bsgoms na gzugs khams lha ru gol ba yin/ /de 'dra'i ther zug bskyed rim brtan po ni//shi dus thugs dam brtan zhing bar do na/ /sku gzugs lha de 'dra ba'i 'byung po'i rigs//rig 'dzin zhes bya rlung lha'i 'khor du skye//de bzhin thugs ma'i sa bon hūṃ yig yang / /dngos por bsgoms pas sbrul du skye bar gsungs//de bzhin dam pa rigs brgya'i lha grangs brgya//ther zug bsgoms pas gol sa brgya ru bshad/ /gol sa de dag gcod pa'i gdams pa ni/ /go bas gcod dang sgom pas gcod pa dang / /lta bas gcod dang rnam pa gsum du 'dus//dang po sangs rgyas rnams ni chos skur gcig/sku mdog phyag mtshan nges pa yod pa min/ /dper na shel gong shin tu dngas pa de/ /gdan ni gang bzhag de yi mdog tu 'gyur//de bzhin yi dam lha yi cha lugs kyang //zhi dang khro dang zhi ma khro la sogs/ /dbu phyag mang nyung sna tshogs cir yang 'char/ /de ltar 'char ba'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ /longs sku dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad na/ /gtso bo'i zhal nas chos gsungs mi dgos te/ /gtso bo'i sku mdog phyag mtshan tsam 262

mthong bas/ /'khor rnams kun gyis de don chos kun rtogs/ /zhal gsum sku gsum phyag drug phar phyin drug /gshog pa gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab ste/ /zhabs bzhi tshad med bzhi yi brda don yin/ /de bzhin yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyi/ /cha lugs brda yi sgo nas chos ston yin/ /rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig: /chos nyid don la cha lugs mi mnga' yang: /thabs mkhas gang 'dul so so'i skur ston pa: /o rgyan chen pos gsungs pa de yi don/ /rta ni mgyogs shing sa chod che ba ltar//sangs rgyas sa lam myur du bgrod pa'i rtags //rta mgrin dbu la rta zhal byung ba yin/ /phag la gtsang btsog rnam rtog med pa ltar//phag zhal rtog med chos sku mtshon pa yin//mi la sha tshugs legs nyes yod pa ltar/ /lha yi cha lugs de bzhin nges pa med/ /de ni go bas gol sa gcod pa yin//de nas sgom pas gol sa gcod pa ni//bskyed rim rnam pa gsal dang rnam dag dran/ /rnam pa gsal ba me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rnam dag dran pa bar snang 'ja' tshon bzhin//nga rgyal rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal te//lta ba'i sgo nas gol sa gcod pa ni/ /lta ba stong nyid rtsi dang ma bral ba/ /nam mkha'i 'jal bzhin zung 'jug thub na rab/ /ma thub bskyed rdzogs res mos bya bar gsungs/ /de nas gol sa phran tshegs 'ga' zhig ni/ /'byor pa yod kyang ser snas 'byor tshogs chung / /mchod pa dmigs tshul rgyun ni ma chad tsam/ /de ni yi dwags gnas su gol bar gsungs/ /med na ma gtogs mchod pa blo stobs bskyed/ /bya spyod rgyud la mchod ro bza' mi rung / /rnal 'byor rgyud la mchod ro 'gong (spyod/)mi rung //bla med rgyud 'dir mchod ro dngos grub rol//de bzhin sha thud mar sogs tshogs la bsngo/ /rgyu ni mi dgos bsod nams tshogs chen 263

rdzogs/ /sha chang la sogs tshogs kyi dam rdzas rnams/ /tha mal zas kyi sred pas mang zos na/ /yi dwags mchu bcings gnas su gol bar gsungs/ /tshogs rdzas tha mal zas kyi'adu shes kyis/ /'dul khrims bsrung phyir de la 'dzem byas na/ /dmyal ba chu bur can du gol bar gsungs/ /gol ba zhes bya'i don de gang zhe na/ /lam nor cung zad byung na 'gor ba ltar/ /re zhig de ru skye ba len pa'i don/ /de rnams bskyed rim gol sa gcod pa yin/ /de nas thabs lam rtsa rlung sgom pa'i dus/ /drod skyes ras gos thub na mi sngon mdzes/ /rtsa rlung nus rtags thon na bag med du/ /mi gtsang spyod kyang gzhan gyis 'phya rgyu med/ /de ltar min yang bdag lus bde nyams kyis/ /'dod chags tshor bde de nyid don gnyer nas/ /rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor dag la sbyong pa ni/ /'dod chags chos su smra ba'i mu stegs pas/ /rtsa rlung sbyong pa de dang 'dra ba yin/ /de la dgongs nas mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /brkam chags can gyi rtsa rlung nyon mongs rgyu/ /gsungs pa de yang de la dgongs pa yin/ /tshor bde'i chags pa don du gnyer ba min/ /'gro ba'i don du rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid//rab kyis zla gsum 'bring gis zla ba drug/tha mas kyang ni lo gsum phyogs gsum na/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub par bya phyir du//rtsa rlung nyams su len pa'i sems bskyed des//gol sa de nyid chod par 'gyur ba yin//de nas rdzogs rim sems ngo'i gol sa ni//bde nyams yus bde sems bde zhu la khad/ /de la chags na 'dod khams lha ru gol/ /gsal nyams stong rjen nam mkha' dngas pa bzhin//gzhan gyis sems rgyud kyang ni shes snyam byed/ /de la chags na gzugs khams lha ru gol//stong nyams thams cad stong pa had de ba/ /rang gi lus kyang med dam snyam pa 'byung / /de la chags na gzugs 264

med khams su gol//chags pa zhes bya de la mchog tu 'dzin//nges shes skyes shing sems la 'chang ba yin/ /gang shar de yi ngang la ce re blta/ /chags zhen med na byang chub lam du 'gro/ /dge slong dge tshul ri khrod 'grim pa'i dus/ /chos gos snam sbyar sham thabs la sogs pa//tshad ldan med kyang skyon du mi 'gyur ste//sham thabs khru gang yod kyang chog pa dang / /skra dang kha spu ring yang skyon med la/ /'dul ba'i gling gzhi rnams na gsal bar yod/ /zas rkyeng nang gi sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor sogs/ /byed na dgongs la'ang nyes pa med mod kyi//chang ni dam rdzas tsam las btung mi bya/ /lar ni gdan gcig dgongs bcad byas na bzang / /de yi spyod pa log par gol mi 'gyur/ /dper na gsar 'gyu/ ra rdzas ni khyad par can/ /lcags rigs gang la byugs kyang gser du 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems bskyed brtan pa ni//mi dge phal cher dge bar 'gyur ba dang //dge ba thams cad byang chub lam du 'gro/ /de phyir gol sa thams cad gcod pa'i mchog /byang chub sems bskyed yin pas snying la chongs/ /dper na ral gri bsam gcod 'bar ba des/ /gang la tshad pa thams cad dum bur gcod/ /de bzhin shes rab stong nyid ral gri des//dngos 'dzin mtshan ma'i gol sa thams cad gcod/ /de bzhin stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel na/ /gol sa mang yang gol ba'i dogs pa med/ /de skad shing sbrul bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lo/ /rgyu skar mgo yi zla ba'i yar tshes drug /phyir nub dang bcas dgong mo'i thun skabs gnyis/ /rā ga a gyes 'phral du gang dran smras/ /de tshe bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis sor mo rlung gi rta la zhon nas bris/ /dge bas blo dman ri khrod 'dzin rnams la/ /'gro don rgya mtsho lta bu 'byung bar shog/le'u so lnga pa'o//maṅga lam̐// 265

gegs sel gdams pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun/'ari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ gegs sel bdud rtsi'i char rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo badzra pā ṇi ye/ /stong nyid gzhom gzhig bral ba'i rdo rje phyar/ /tshad med snying rje'i sdigs mdzub 'gro la gtad//sdom gsum rnam par dag pa'i gos sngon can/ /bla ma gsang ba'i bdag pos bdag la srungs/ /nyams len sgrub pa rtse gcig brtson pa'i mis/ /gegs sel gdams pa zab mo ma shes na/ /sgrub pa'i lo 'bras sad kyis 'khyer nyan gda'//gegs sel rnam pa dpag tu med na yang / /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi gegs sel gsum/ /sngon 'gro'i gegs sel mtshams ni ma bsdam gang //nyams su len rgyu'i dbang lung gdams ngag de/ /brgyud pa ring drag thag rul bred hrul mthud/ /sangs rgyas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa dkon//bla rab gong 'og thugs nang mthun ma mthun//gang zag tshig gis brgyud pa ma chad kyang / /sgrub pa nyams len brgyud pa chad ma chad/ /rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa chad ma chad/ /rtogs par ldan yang phyag len 'chug ma 'chug /de 'dra'i gnad kyis byin rlabs rgyud ring ste/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub kyang rtags mtshan dus la med//rang gis dbang lung thob nas sgrub kha'i bar//bla ma'i thugs la ma 'phrod cung zad log /rang gis log lta gshe bkur zar zur shor/ /dam sel de dag rkyen gyis bar chad mang / /bsgrub kyang 'grub par dka' ba'i gegs yin pas/ /tshes bcu la sogs dus tshod bzang ba'i dus/ / 266

dbang chas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par bshams/ /bdag mdun dbang sgrub cho ga gzhung ltar bya/ /gsar ma yin na bdag 'jug gzhung ltar blangs/ /de yang mdun bskyed bla ma dbyer med dmigs/ /rnying ma bdag 'jug yod pa'i rigs la ni/ /bdag 'jug blangs shing med na ting 'dzin gyi/ /dbang bzhi dmigs pa shin tu gsal bas blangs//de nas tshogs byas tshogs phud phul ba dang //bskang pa byas la bskang thung brgya rtsa 'don/ /bla ma yi dam dbyer med gcig pa yi/ /gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing bsgom/ /de mthar yig brgya dkar dmar mthing gsum 'khor/ /de las yig brgya dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ /rang gi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtha' ru 'khor/ /de las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum babs/ /bdag lus gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyis//dam tshig chags nyams thams cad sangs kyis dag/rang lus shel sgong lta bur gyur bsam zhing / /oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥ sa ma ya/ /hūṃ sa ma ya/ gu ru rshagha na tsa kra sa tu sa ma ya/ zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa bzla bya te//bdun yan brgya man mang nyung skabs dang sbyar/ /de nas bzung ste bla ma de nyid dang / /yi dam de nyid dbyer med nges shes bya/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po mi bskyod rdo rje yis/ /so skye'i bla mas dbang bskur khrid ston tshe/ //phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis/ /slob ma dad ldan rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /bla ma de yi rgyud la zhugs nas kyang / /slob ma rnams la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ /dbang bskur khrid ston tshar nas mi gnas ste//rtsi dmar ba yi sku khog 'dra'o gsungs//de ltar bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi/ /rang gi nges shes brtan po thob pa na//brgyud pa nye 267

ring dag la mi ltos te/ /grub thob gling rje ras pa'i zhal snga nas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas su 'dug pa mi ru mthong / /brgyud pa nye ring du bgrangs pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsungs pa de yang de ltar dgongs pa yin/ /de nas tshogs 'khor la sogs tshar ba'i rjes/ /mdun bskyed bla ma dkyil 'khor rang la bstims/ /bla ma rang sems dbyer med 'dres par bsgom/ /don la bla ma yi dam rang sems gsum/ /ngo bo tha dad med par gcig pa ste/ /ngo bo stong pa nyid du khyad par med/ /rang bzhin gsal stong rjen par khyad par med/ /thugs rje cir yang 'char bar khyad par med/ /de dag ji bzhin nges par rtogs pa na//thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa de la zer/ /bla ma chos sku'i mos gus de rang yin/ /skabs 'dir de ltar rtogs par ma gyur na'ang / /bsre ba'i dmigs pa byas la go ba blangs/ /dam tshig sil gyis chod pa'i gegs sel zab/ /de nas bsnyen sgrub byed rgyu yin na ni/ /sngon la rgab 'dre med pa'i lha zhig sgrub/ /spyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin sgrol ma'i rigs/ /pad 'byung zhi ba'i rigs la rgab 'dre med/ /rgab 'dre med kyang sgrub chen yin na ni/ /spyi yi dam sri sgrub chen gzhung ltar mnan/ /gshin rje'i rigs dang lha mo rnams sras rigs/ /zhing skyong dam can rnams ni rgab 'dre rtsub//phyag bzhi pa dang ma ning dzam dmar sogs//rgab 'dre yod kyang ha cang rtsub pa min//sngon du rta mgrin la sogs yi dam gzhan//bsnyen sgrub them pas rgab 'dre gzhung bzhin mnan/ /de ni rgab 'dre'i bar chad gegs sel lo/ /sgrub chen yin na bsgrub la zhugs pa nas/ /nyul le bskrad tshul sgrub chen gzhung bzhin bya/ /sgrub chen min yang nyams rmis rtsub pa'i dus/ /kun thub rgyal mo skabs su bskul na legs//de ni snying ma'i lugs kyi gegs sel yin//gsar ma 268

la yang de dang cha 'dra ba'i/ /ming mi gcig kyang don la gcig pa yi/ /sgrub pa byed tshad kun la 'tshe ba'i gegs//mang po rig pa mchog gi rgyud las gsungs//de dag so sor 'dul thabs mang bshad kyang //mdor bsdus lag tu blang bder bshad pa ni//bsgrub la zhugs nas nyi ma rtse shar dus//nyi mar kha bltas thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /bdag gis rig sngags che ge zhig sgrub kyi//bgegs khyed rnams ni yid dga' bar gyis shig /deb skad brjod pas bgegs rnams der 'du'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dran byas te/ /oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭaḥ /bdun tsam brjod nas khros pa'i tshul bstan te/ /rdog ldeb byed cing 'di nyid brjod par bya/ /khyed rnams 'dug na 'dug cig ma 'gul cig /ces brjod chu gtsang khyor gang lan bdun bsngags//shar du gtor zhing de 'dra skabs rer bya//sgrub pa ma grol bar du bgegs bcings 'gyur//bsgrub pa grol nas yid kyis bkrol dgos gsungs/ /me tog bdug spos mar me gsum po la//bgegs re yod pas phul yang lha mi mnyes//me tog phul dus sngags de brjod cing phul//spos chags la sogs spos ni gang yod pa//rdza phor 'am ni ma rnyed gyo tshal du//me blugs lag pa g.yon par mar bsngags nas//gsur byas kha la spos de phyung bas thub//mar me kong chung gcig dang gnyis byas la//gcig bltams steng du chung ba mgo thur bltams/ /lag g.yas nyungs gar sngags nas de la brab/ /mar me chung ba 'go thur bstan la 'phangs/ /de yi mar me'i gegs ni sel ba yin/ /de dag ga rgyun du dgos pa ma yin te/ /sgrub pa'i dbu la lan re byas pas chog /rgyun du phud mchod bzhag zhor phud mchod gcig /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bsngo bar bya/ /seng ldeng rab yin ma rnyed drag po'i shing //phur pa sor bzhi'i mgul du nyungs 269

gar btags//sa'am bye mar nyungs kur cung zad bsre/ /phur pa bye ma mnyam du sngags la bzhag /nub mo la sogs dngos nyams rmi lam du/ /mi sdug gzugs ston dri ngan mi snyan sgra/ /gar byung sogs su phur pas gzir ba dang / /bye ma sngags pa gtor bas bgegs de sel/ /mal sar bsdad nas thun bzung sngags bzlas ste/ /de nas langs te gom pa spo ba'i tshe/ /'og 'dren sa yi gtsug phud zhes bya ba/ /sa las langs te lus la reg par byed/ /bskal par bsags pa'i bsod nams dge tshogs dang / /rig sngags bzlas tshad nus pa med par byed/ /spra rtsi'i snyigs dang spos dkar mar dkar gsum//sngags la skabs su gos dang lus la bdug /de yi log 'dren de yi gegs sel lo/ /de dag kun gyi sngags ni gong ltar ro/ /de rnams bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub gegs sel lo/ /de nas mtshams sgrub spyi yi gegs sel ni//phyi rgyab mi yis ngo ni phar mthong ngam//tshur la lus ni gzhan bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yin gsungs/ mchan gyis mthong byung na/ /sme brtsegs bzlas pa'i gzungs chus ngo bkru ste/ /de yis gdong grib phog pa'i gegs phran sel//mtshams khung byin brlabs bka' bsgo dgos byung na//gu gul spos sogs sme brtsegs kyis bsngags pas/ /rang sngags phreng ba la sogs spos khar 'don/ /de yis reg grib gegs rnams sel bar byed/ /zas kyis grib dang sdig can 'bul ba sogs/ /grib la brten te bying rmug 'thibs pa na/ /bum par rdor sems bskyed bzlas bum chu yis/ /yan lag lnga khrus bya zhing khong du btung / /de nas thabs lam sgom pa'i gegs sel ni//'tsho ba zhan cing 'khrul 'khor brtson drag pas//lus po dub chad lus nyams zhan drag na//lag pa g.yon pas rang gi spyi bor bkab//de nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba//de dbus baṃ yig dkar 270

po mgo thur bstan//de las bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bu babs//tshangs bug nas zhugs lus nang ltem ltem gang //dmigs pa gsal bas bum chen cung zad bzung //de 'dra skabs skabs byas pas lus stobs rgyas//nad sel tshe sgrub kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /de ni lus stobs zhan pa'i gegs sel lo/ /lus nyams bzang zhing thig le rgyas drag na/ /rang dbang med par thig le zag 'gyur pas//gsang gnas rtse nas thig le thams cad ni//skar mda' bzhin du spyi bo'i haṃ la bstims//hūṃ ring dang bcas rlung ni gyen du drongs/ /lto ba sgal sbyar lce ni ya rkan sbyar/ /mig gnyis nam mkha' gtad la trīḥ ring bgrang / /gsang spubs hūṃ dmar bdun gyis bkag par bsam//drod skyes bde ba rgyas pas 'dod chags 'bar//'dod chags ngo bo bltas pas bde stong 'dres//des ni thig le'i gegs ni sel ba'o//rlung ni stod du 'tshang bas snying mi dga'/ /bshul na hu shu 'don cing srog rlung 'dra/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /yi ge dbu can ha yig ljang gu bsgom//rang gi khog nas ha yig ljang gu rnams//rim par thon nas nam mkha'i ha la bstems/ /ha zhes nyer gcig brgya sogs ci nus pa/ /drag por brjod pas stod kyi gegs de sel/ /stan mi non bar 'gro 'dod dzab dzab na/ /snying dkyil thig le nag po ril ma tsam//ba thag lta bus thag pas 'brel ba zhig/'og sgo nas thon nas 'og rim dgur song //shin tu ljid pa'i rnam par rig pa gtad/ /'bebs chen 'bebs chung ya zung ci nus brgyab/ /smad nad smad du sel ba'i gegs sel yin/ /zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes gcig nas/ /nam mkha' sal gyis langs pa nas bzung ste/ /nyi ma shar dros bar du yin na yang //nyin mtshan ring thung la yang dpyad bya zhing //tshes gcig tshes gnyis tshes gsum 271

g.yon nas rgyu/ /tshes bzhi tshes lnga tshes drug g.yas nas rgyu/ /de bzhin rtag tu gsum re res mos ste/ /rgyun du ma 'chug rgyu ba bar chad med/ /zhag 'ga' go ldog rgyu na kha smras 'ong / /zhag po brgyad dgu go log nye du 'chi/ /zhag bcu phan chad go log rang 'chi rtags/ /de yi gegs sel gang nas rgyu phyogs kyi/ /mchan khung rtsa nas lag mthil dam du mnan/ /lag pa'i srin lag sna bug de nyid bkag/mthe bong gis ni rke rtsis dam du mnan//rgyu sa'i phyogs de 'og tu bstan nas ni/ /ljid phab sngas med hrang nyal rgyang tsam bya/ /de ma thag tu rlung ni 'dod bzhin rgyu/ /rang lus rlung gis gegs de bsal tshar nas/ /phyi yi gegs rnams sel ste 'byung mi 'gyur/ /snga dro'i thun gyi brtag pa kho na las/ /rgyun du de nyid brtag rgyu med na yang //g.yas rgyu mang na bar chad rgod pa yin//g.yon rgyu mang na bde skyid 'byung ba yin/ /mnyam du rgyu mang rtogs pa skye ba yin/ /g.yas nas rgyu dang sems la dug lnga skyes//de dus rlung bzung mi rung phyir la 'bud//g.yon du rgyu dang mnyam nas rgyu ba dang / /dad pa dag snang dge phyogs dran pa'i dus/ /phyi ru mi 'bud nang du bzung ba gces/ /des ni bar chad gegs sel dngos grub thob/ /jub dus dal bus rngub pa man ngag ste/ /drag tu rngub nas bzung na nag thom 'gro/ /de la snying rus bskyed cing bzung ba na/ /rtsa log rlung log 'gro ste 'chi rkyen byed//phar la 'bud dus shed skyed lhag med 'bud//lhag ma lus na nad du 'gyur ba yin/ /gsang gnas yan nas mgrin pa man bkang ba/ /bum can zer yang srog rlung 'ong nyan che//gsang gnas yan dang bya mo lhen 'dabs man//bkang ba bum chung yin te gegs skyon med//cung zad rngub nas bkang ba ma yin pa/ /gsus pa ther ther byed pa bar rlung yin/ /de la gegs skyon ci yang 272

med pa yin/ /dgra jag kha smras bar chad 'byung dogs tshe/ /mya ngan rtsa ni mthe bong nang yod bcir/ /sor mo g.yas g.yon mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang //dpa' bo sde bzhir sgom la mthe bong ni/ /gnod byed der bsgom dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis//gnod byed bcings bsam sor mos mthe bong bcangs//rlung ni rgyang tsam bzung bas kha smras sel/ /thig le rgyas sam yang na grang gzhi'i nad//cis kyang ma phan thig le 'dzag pa na//ldum bu ba kha g.yu lo ston gyi dus//rtsa ba lo mar bcas pa grib skam bya/ /zhib btags pa yi 'o mar btab bkol nas//yang yang btung na de las zab pa med//thig le 'bab dka' bab kyang mi phebs na//rdor sems sgom bzlas tshogs 'khor ci mang bya/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i grib phog gegs de sel/ /thig le phab nas bzung bzlog mi thub par/ /dbang med 'chor na de yi gegs sel ni//sre mong rgyus pas srin lag gnyis po bcings//yang na chu srin gre 'gag 'khrul 'khor bya/ /'og rlung bzung ba 'og sgo bsdam pa yin/ /srin zhal zhes pa'ang 'og sgo'i ming yin no/ /rlung bzung dus su de nyid yar bsdam la/ /steng nas rngub pas pho ba ther gyis dgang / /phar la mi btang dgang nas 'dug pa'i yun/ /rang ngam mdun du nad med gzhan zhig gis/ /skyil krung bcas te lag pa ci mgyogs kyis/ /phus mo g.yas reg g.yon reg dpral bar reg /se gol gcig brdab de rnams gcig tu brtsi//lag pa g.yon pas phreng ba bgrang la bzhag /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bzung thub na//bum chen tshad du 'khor ba yin no zhes/ /bde mchog sdom 'byung rgyud las shin tu gsal/ /dang po nyer gcig tsam las mi thub ste/ /de nas byang nas rim gyis ring du thub/ /bum chen bzung bas rims dang tshad pa dang / /dug nad sel ba'i mchog yin rgyud las 273

gsungs/ /de dag thabs lam gegs sel tho tsam yin/ /de nas nad kyi gegs rnams sel ba ni//mtshams sgrub dus sam dus ni nam yang rung //rang gzhan su la bsgom yang phan pa ste/ /mgo bo na dang mgo 'khor 'thom pa sogs/ /mgo bo je srab je srab leb mor song / /'ja' ltar yal nas rke yan med par bsgom/ /mig mi gsal dang mig tsha mig nad rigs//mig gnyis med cing ltag khung har ba bug /bug pa ha re yod la dmigs pa gtad//so na so nang gzab kyi baṃ yig ni/ /dkar po gnyis brtsegs gcig la dmigs pa gtad/ /yang na so dkyil bla ma sman gyi bla/ /gsal bar bsgom la dmigs pa gtad pas sel/ /lce na rang gi phor bar chu gtsang blugs/ /lce nad thams cad nag dang nyi li li/ /chu nang song dmigs lce ni chu nang sbang / /bshul na bshul du bug pa nor bu'i dbyibs/ /de nang nad kun dud pa ltar thon bsam/ /tshigs sogs lus kyi khol bu gar na sar/ /bug pa lcags drwa bzhin du yod pa nas/ /nad rnams rlangs pa'i tshul du thon par bsam/ /rma ni gsar ba byung na rma yi nang / /thig le dkar dmar 'thab la dmigs pa gtad/ /bshal ba mi chod rang dbang med pa na/ /bshang lam nang du gser gyi rdo rjes bkag /gshang lam phyi nas rgyus pa 'dra ba yi/ /rgyu ma'i thag pas dam du dkris par bsam//tshad pa'i nad la snying dkyil baṃ dkar po/ /chab bram 'dra ba de las ga bur gyi/ /rang bzhin chu ni shin tu grang mo yis/ /khog pa'i nad kun bshal zhing 'grim par bsam/ /tshad pa'i nad ni thams cad dag par sgom//grang pa'i nad dang spangs gzhi dmu chu la//lte 'og sum mdor ram̐ yig dmar po las//me 'bar lus kyi nang kun gang bar bsgom//rlung gi nad la mdun du bhan rnya ni/ /chen po 'bri mar mar khus ser ltem gang / /rkang pa'i mthe 274

bong gnyis po sbu gu ltar/ /mar khu yar drangs lus kun ltem gyis gang / /ba spu'i bug nas phrum phrum thon par bsam/ /smug po la sogs bad kun spyi khyad la/ /a yig dkar pos lus kun gang par bsgom//rlung sogs mi dgos dmigs pa kho nas chog /de kun zhi byed rnying ma'i thugs sgrub sogs/ /kun las gsungs shing myong bas cung zad 'grub/ /snying mi dga' dang snying gzer srog rlung la/ /snying dkyil baṃ yig dkar por bdud rtsi babs/ /bdud rtsi dkar pos snying ni gang bar bsgom/ /dug dang tshad pa la sogs ma yin par/ /zas ma zhu zhing pho ba gzer ba na//lag mthil gnyis su a yig dkar po bsam//gan rkyal nyal la pho ba mnye bar bya/ /dus 'khor rgyud dang rnying ma nas kyang gsungs/ /rmi lam bud med rmis pa la brten nas/ /thig le shor na nyal khar gsang rdor ni/ /lcags bsregs phur pa tsha tsha 'phro bar bsgom//bsen mos cho la rku ba'i gegs de sel//thabs lam bsgom dus 'chi rtags sogs byung na/ /nam langs lus kyi ba spu mthong tsam dus/ /nam mkha' rgya cher mthong sar lus gnad bcas//kha ni cung zad tsam zhig gdangs byas nas/ /nam mkha' thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zhu/ /dkar po'am ni sngon po'i rnam pa ru/ /kha ru sib sib byung nas lus gang bsam/ /rlung rngub lus dgang ci thub drag tu mnan/ /de 'dra lan grangs 'ga' rer byas pa yis//sgreg pa byung na zhag gcig 'chi ba zlog/de rjes mtheb mdzub rke rtsis lan gsum mnan/ /rgyun du byas na tshe sgrub mchog tu 'gyur/ /thugs rje gsang 'dus gsar ma'i lam 'bras sogs/ /rgyud gzhung khams chen kun nas gsungs pa yin/ /rang la grang ba'i nad gzhi byung ba na/ /rlung dang gtum mo kho na mchog yin te/ /pho skor byas pas ma zhu 'phral du sel/ /rims 275

dang tshad pa'i nad ni byung ba na/ /gangs gseng shin tu 'khyags par yod par bsgom//so bsgrigs bar nas sir sgra dang bcas pa'i//rlung ni drag tu rngub nas bzung ba ni/ /chu rlung bzung ba zhes bya tshad sman mchog /nad rigs kun dang 'dus pa'i nad rnams la//rang gzhan spyi bor bla ma sman gyi bla//phyag g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi kha dog lnga//tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang nad dag bsam//de nas gdon gyi gegs sel bya ba ni/ /snga dro'i cha la rang nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro 'dul phyag bzhi lung pa gang par bsgom/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar//gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad yod par bsgom//de dag kun la ma gcig bu bzhin du//byams dang snying rje ci ltar skye skye bya//sku yi nang du bsrung bya thams cad tshud/ /rlung zhig phar btang rang gi bde skyid rnams//'gro ba spyi dang gnod byed rnams la thim//bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa thob par bsam/ /rlung zhig tshur rngub kho rnams sdulag bsngal sdig /rang la thim pas bkrag mdangs 'bar bar bsam/ /thugs sgrub la sogs gsar rnying du ma'i bcud/ /byams pa'i go cha snying rje'i ya lad ste/ /srung 'khor rmad byung byang chub go cha zhes//dam chos dgongs gcig nas gsungs snying po yin/ /mun rug skad cig dran rdzogs bdag nyid ni//rta mgrin dmar po dbyug to sdigs mdzub can/ /sku che khro chas yongs rdzogs 'jigs rung bsgom/ /rta skad gcig bsgrags gnod byed thams cad kun/ /sbur ma rlung gis bsdus bzhin dbang du bsdus/ /gnyis bsgrags dam la btags nas srog snying phul/ /gsum bsgrags bya spu rlung gis gtor ba ltar/ /dbang med rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad par bsam//sku las me dpung mtshon cha'i bu yug 'phros//rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri rgya gram dang //phur 276

la me ri'i gur khang rim pa drug/bar mtshams khro bo sna tshogs rlung ltar 'tshub//srung 'khor drug po srub med sgo nga bzhin/ /de nang bsrung bya thams cad tshud par bsam//de ni drag po'i sgo nas srung ba'o//skyabs 'gro srung 'khor bzlog pa la sogs pa/ /ji ltar 'bad bzhin slar yang je rtsub cing / /ji ltar byas kyang glan ka brko ba na//de nas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs bya gsungs don//nub mo dge sbyor tshar nas nyal kha'i dus/ /ku sa li yi tshogs gsog bya ba ste/ /de yang chos skyong la sogs ma non nam//pha rol stobs chen byad ka ches drag na//nam mkha'i dbyings su bla ma'i lha tshogs dang //de 'og yi dam de 'og mkha' 'gro dang //de 'og chos skyong bka' srung dam can tshogs / /nam mkha' khyab par sprin bzhin gsal bar dmigs//rang gi snying gar rang gi rlung sems dang //bla tshe srog dang byin rlabs nus pa dang //phung khams skye mched lha ru bsgoms pa rnams//gcig bsdus thig le dkar po 'od 'bar ba/ /dbu ma'i lam nas sbyi por rgyangs se spar/ /de nyid gnas 'gyur phag mo'i sku ru bsgom/ /de ltar thig ler lus lha bstims pa 'di/ /gnad zab yin gyi 'di nyid ma shes na//bdag bskyed bsgom dang gcod dmigs rgyab 'gal 'ong / /lus lha spar ba'i tha mal bem po de/ /che tsho bkrag bzang 'dzam gling gang bar bsgom/ /rang nyid phag mos gri gug tshad tsam gyis//thod pa yar nas bharnya mtshan ldan pa//stong gsum 'jig rten tsam gyi rgya khyon bsgom/ /gri gug rtse yis bem po de nang 'phangs/ /gri gug tshad tsam sha khrag dmar ltem gang / /oṃ ཿ hūṃ brjod ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan ro bcud phun tshogs gyur/ /rang gi thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /rang 'dra bye ba dung phyur grangs med spros/ /phyag g.yas rin chen las 277

grub bhanta'i—skyogs//thogs pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de las bcus/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs//kun la mchod pas thams cad mnyes shing tshims//khyad par rang la 'khu ldog byed pa yi/ /bka' srung chos skyong 'khor bcas yang yang mchod/ /shin tu mnyes shing tshim pa bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin 'jig rten skyong dang gdon bgegs tshogs//lha 'dre gzhi bdag 'gro ba rigs drug rnams//so so rang rang gnas su mkha' 'gros mchod//so sos ci 'dod longs spyod thob par bsam/ /rang nyid na nas thugs dam mi nus tshe/ /gre khung phaṭa brjod 'di nyid brgya rtsa bsgom//de yis nad gdon 'phral du sel ba ni//myong bas yang yang grub pas nges shes yod/ /nad gdon gegs sel rnams kyi mchog yin no/ /gzhan la yang ni de ltar bsgom bya ste//bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum gcig bsres nas/ /de ltar byas na pha rol phan che yang / /rang la nad gdon grib kyis gos par snang / /rtogs pa'i gdeng chen med na de mi bya/ /so so'i rnam shes so sor spar byas nas//rnam shes gcig bsres bem po so sor mchod//de ni rtogs pa 'bring gi bya ba yin/ /so sor spar zhing so sor mchod sbyin bya/ /rang la mi gnod rtogs pa dman na bya/ /de nas de dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa ni/ /rang gzhan lus po gang du na ba'i sar//'gro ba kun gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bstim//rul ba ltar gyur khrag gi rgyun chen bab//gnod byed gdon bgegs kun gyis de 'thung ste//dga' mgu yi rangs lhag ma med par bsam/ /rkang lag bzhi po gang rung na ba yi/ /mthil du ram̐ yig dmar po me 'bar bar/ /rkang lag gang yin spos thur bzhin du sregs/ /rtsa ba'i bar tshig de nas mi dmigs bsam/ /dam pa'i nad gcod dmigs pa ltar bsreg yin/ /ma zhu'i nad kyis pho ba na ba la/ /278

pho bar khung bug pho snabs nad rnams ni/ /wa chu bzhin du bab pa nad bdag 'thung / /pho nad zas mi len pa'i rigs rnams la/ /pho ba lcags kyi sha sbrang gis gang bas/ /pho ba thams cad phug cing zos par bsam/ /mid 'chus byung na mi nag sbrul mgo yis/ /lcags sreg tho lum kha nas mid par bcug /mid pa mid thag pho ba thams cad tshig /stong par gyur nas lcags sreg 'og sgor thon/ /mgo bo na zhing klad pa gzer ba la/ /mgo bo me tog pad ma stong ldan gas/ /klad pa phyungs nas sa phyogs thams cad gang //bya khyung mang pos lhag ma med par zos//mig ni na'am tsha na mi nag gis/ /lcags khem mig brus phar la 'phangs ma thag/yos gtor bzhin du sa phyogs mig gis gang / /bya nag mang pos btus te lhag med zos//so na mi nag gzugs thung skam pa thogs//so phud chu rdo'i bar brdung rlung la bskur/ /skabs su mi nag seng zhon mgo mang gis/ /so kun phud nas so phreng do shal byas/ /gling bzhi ri rab bskor ba byed cing rgyug /lce na mi nag mgo bcu stag mgo can//lce la shar mo bcu dras mgo bcus 'jib//rkang lag bzhi po gang du na yang 'dra/ /sbrul nag 'dom dgu ze ba can gnyis kyis/ /yar dkris mar dkris phur pa ltar dkris pa/ /mi nag dgra sta kha che thogs pa zhig /g.yos tshil gtubs bzhin dum bur bcad cing 'phangs/ /lha 'dre kun gyis hab thob zos par bsam//glo ba na na mi dmar mdung rtsam gyis//zangs lcags sbu gus glo ba'i rnag khrag 'jib//mkhris pa na na khyi nag 'bum phrag gis//bem po'i kha phyes mkhris khu lhag med btung / /rgyu ma na na rtsi shing nags tshal la/ /rgyu ma thams cad rgya ltar bres par bsam/ /spyir ni phyi sha nang grol gang na ba/ /de nyid gtor ba'i thang mas sa gzhir brdal/ /lha 'dre rnams kyis yos ltar 'gam par(zos pa) 279

bsam/ /de dag nang gcod na sar gcod pa'o/ /de rnams kun la sngon du snying rjer bsgom/ /rjes ni stong nyid ngang la mnyam par gzhag /de nas ting 'dzin sems kyis gegs sel ni//mang yang bying rgod gnyis su 'dus pa ste//bying rmug 'thib cing rig pa mi gsal na/ /snang yer mtho zhing bser bu yod sa ru/ /chos bdun lus gnad grim gyis bsgrims la bca'/ /mig gnyis pha ri'i ri rtser nam mkhar gtad/ /rang gi sems la rjen ne theg ger lta/ /rnam rtog 'phro rgod rlung ltar 'tshubs pa na//lus gnad bag lhod sog phon zhig ltar bzhag/mig gnyis skyil krung gdan gyi mtshams su lta//'gyu ba gar 'gror btang bas rgyang srung bya//stong nyid skyes na thams cad stong par mthong / /rgyu 'bras dge sdig phan gnod med snyam tshe/ /lus la tsher ma bcugs sam me stag blan/ /stong bar go bas phan ba e 'dug lta/ /rten 'brel bslu ba med la nges shes skyed/ /de yis gegs sel rim pa tho tsam song / /zhes pa shing sbrul bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lo/ /stobs chen glang gi zla ba'i tshes brgyad nas/ /tshes bcu'i bar gyi dgongs mo'i 'tsham re rer/ /rā ga a sus nyams myong dang bstun nas/ /lhug par gdams pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis/ /rang gi brjed thor 'phral du ye ger btab/ /rgyud gzhung lung 'dren mang po ma mchis pas/ /blo gros ldan rnams mnyes par mi 'gyur zhing / /dpyod ldan rnams ni yid gnyis skye na yang / /blun bo'i rang dran rang bzo yin nam min/ /gsar rnying rgyud gzhung rgya mtshor gzigs na gsal/ /yig cha mthong bas bris pa yin nam min//slob dpon gsung rgyun rang gi nyams myong rnams/ /bstun pa'i gdams pa zab mo yin nam min/ /gus pas yid kyis nyams su blangs na gsal/ /blo dman rang 'dra bsgrub ba'i gang zag tshogs/ /280

mang bo 'ga' la phan thogs rgya cher shog/le'u so drug pa'o maṅga lam̐//bog 'don gdams pa yid bzhin nor bu/0ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /bogs 'don yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//chos dbyings chu gter che las legs byung zhing //sems nyid rin chen beḍūr mthon ka che/ /smin byed gdams pa byin rlabs rgyun gyis brlan//sngon 'gro'i gdams pas sgrib gsum legs phyis nas//nyams rtogs du ma brtsegs pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /'phyar 'di dngos grub rnam gnyis char 'bebs yin/ /nyams len bsgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bogs 'don gdams pa legs par ma shes na/ /nyams rtegs bogs bskyed thon par mi 'gyur te//dper na chu lud med pa'i lo tog bzhin//bogs 'don kun gyi rtsa ba brtson 'grus te//tshe la nges med nam 'chi cha med 'di//nyin re lan gsum snying nas dran pa gces//de yis dge sbyor kun gyi bogs skyed 'byung //de nas bskyed rim bogs su 'don pa na/ /yi dam thang sku thig tshad bris legs pa//nyi ma shar dus rang gi mdun du bshams/ /dbu nas gdan gyi bar du yang yang blta/ /gdan nas dbu yi bar du yang yang blta//de nas sku lus spyi la yun ring blta/ /de 'dra zhag po 'ga' zung byas ba'i rjes/ /mun nag nang du mig btsum zhal thang de/ /yid la bkod bsam mngon sum lta bur 'char//de nas bdag mdun de nyid bzhin du bsgom//de ni bskyed rim gsal ba'i bogs 'don ste//rgyud sde 281

rnams las/ sngags pa las ni dang po pas/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ /bris sku dag gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa'i don yang de la dgongs pa yin/ /khyad par bris sku phyag gi g.yas g.yonasags/ /phyag mtshan 'gying thabs go log yod par bri//de nyid nyi ma shar dus bshams byas la/ /me long mtho skor dngas pa gcig bstan pas/ /me long nang du sku gzugs gsal por 'char de la sngar bzhin yang yang blta byas nas/ /de ltar gsal la ngos bzung med par bsgom/ /bar snang 'ja' tshon gsal po shar ba'i tshe/ /gsal stong zung 'jug dpe yang de la bya/ /sgrub pa bsnyen sgrub kun gyi bogs 'don ni/ /dus bzang skabs su tshogs dang gtor ma dang / /bskang ba sbyin sreg bstod bskul bya ba gces//rdzogs rim thabs lam bsgom pa'i bogs 'don ni//tshogs kyi dam rdzas sha chang spyod pa dang / /thig le 'phel ba'i zas kyis bcud len gsungs/ /rang lus gser gyi bum pa zhig tu bsgom/ /de nang rang sems rdo rje rnam 'joms bsgom/ /thugs kur nyi steng hūṃ la gzungs kyis bskor/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs yid kyis bstims//sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs lus gang bsam//gzungs ni gsum mam bdun sogs ci 'grub bzlas//dri chu'i thog ma cung zad 'dor bya zhing //snyigs ma'ang dor zhing bar maldod du bsags//dri chu mi bskyod pa yi ngo bo ste//nad gdon grib sogs dag byed mchog yin phyir//ye shes bdud rtsi yin pa'i nges shes kyis/ /phud ni sor rtses bla ma yi dam mchod/ /de nas hub gsum bdud rtsir bsams la mid//de rjes lus kun shin tu dag par bkru//rtsa rnams chad dang zhar dang 'khum pa sos//de steng shu dag nag po zhib btul ba//mar rnying sbyar ba byugs pas drod skye sla/ /rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 282

'don mchog/sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma dbyer med pa//rdo rje 'chang gi sku ru spyi por bsgom/ /mos gus gdung shugs rang dbang med pa yi/ /rgyang 'bod lan 'ga' byas nas rang la bstim//de ni rtogs pa'i bogs ni thon pa yin//gsar bur cis kyang gnas nyams ma skyes na/ /mal mi gso bar brgya phyag gcig tsam 'tshal/ /de ma thag tu rnam snang chos bdun bca'/ /rlung ni dbu mar tshud pa'i gnas nyams skye/ /ji ltar byas kyang rmug 'thibs mi gsal na/ /snga dro dgong mo nam mkha' g.ya' dag dus/ /nyi mar rgyab ston lus gnad legs par bca'/ /mig gnyis nam mkha' sngo sangs dkyil du gtad/ /sems kyang der gtad yun ring bar du blta//de yis gsal stong rjen pa'i bogs 'byung ngo //rgyun du bogs med gnas 'gyu rkyang ded na//nyin re tsam la phyag dang bskor ba sogs//lus po mi dal brel bzhin ngo bo skyong / /ngag kyang mi dal gsol 'debs chos spyod sogs/ /shin tu brel ba'i ngang nas i 'dres tshad/ /nyin re tsam la shin tu dal ba ste//'der so bzhin du g.yo 'gul med pa ru//sngags kyang mi bzla lus gnad krig ger bca'/ /res 'ga' gnyid pa ltar du ro nyal byed/ /res 'ga' gser sku bzhag 'drar lus gnad bsrang / /de ltar res mos byas pas bogs shig 'byung / /de nas nad la brten nas bogs 'don la/ /nad kyi rgyu ni sngon gyi sdig sgrib ste//sdig sgrib sbyong thabs stong nyid bsgom pa zab/ /dper na mun par sgron me bltams pa bzhin/ /nad kyi rkyen ni gdon bgegs 'byung po ste/ /dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin mang po lha 'dres shi sa//dmigs med stong nyid lha 'dres sgom mi shes/ /de phyir gdon 'dul mchog kyang stong nyid de/ /stong ba nyid la sus kyang glag mi rnyed/ /nad kyi 'bras bu na snyam rnam rtog ste/ /rnam rtog de la gcer gyis 283

bltas pa na//na dang mi na'i rnam rtogs khyad par med//nga na bsam mkhan rnam rtog de nyid la/ /bcas bcos med par mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe/ /gzer de 'phral du zhi bar ma gyur kyang //na ba'i sdug bsngal phyag rgya chen por 'char//de la cung zhig rgyun bsring sgom pa na/ /gzer chen rkang chags lus po sbrid chil 'gro/ /de la yun ring bsring nas bsgom nus na/ /sgrib pa dag pas nad gdon rang sar zhi/ /de ni rgyal ba rgod tshang pas mdzad pa'i/ /ro snyoms dgongs dril don gyi rtsa tho yin/ /de bzhin gnyen 'dun shi sogs sdug bsngal dang / /gdon bgegs lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul 'jigs skrag dang / /ma nyes kha yog skur 'debs tshig ngan sogs/ /snying la mi bzod rnam rtogs gang skyes la/ /ngo bor bltas la gzhi med yal bcug na//dekun bogs 'don mchog tu 'gyur ba ste//bde dal sgom sgrub brgya las lhag pa yin//re zhig zhi yang phyi nas dug ro ltar//ldang bar gyur na sngar bzhin ngo bo blta/ /bdag dang bdag gi rjes 'jug 'brel thogs dang / /ma 'ongs bdag 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing der yang / /de 'dra'i ngan rtog zhi zhing med par shog/ces sogs rjes nas bsngo smon rgya yis gdab//de nas bde ba'i sgo nas bogs 'don pa//bde stong zung 'jug rtogs pa ma skyes na//stong pa nyid kyi ting 'dzin brtan na yang //bla med rgyud kyi phyag chen min gsungs pas//gtum mo'i dmigs pa rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor sbyangs//drod skye drod la brten nas bde ba skye/ /bde ba'i ngo bo bltas pas bde stong 'dres/ /bde stong zung 'jug bogs chen de nas 'byung / /de nas gsal ba'i ngang nas bogs 'don pa/ /rdzogs chen thod rgal nyams len skyong ba na//'ja' 'od thig le theg phran lha sku 'char//de dang sems nyid bsres la bo ngo blta//gsal stong zung 'jug bogs 284

chen de nas 'byung //de nas mi rtogs ngang nas bogs 'don pa//seng ge'i nyal stabs byas la nyal ba'i tshe//bdag bskyed bsdu rim dmigs pa byas pa'i rjes//gnyid la ma song bar du ngo bo skyong / /shi ba'i dus dang gnyid dus cha mthun pas/ /thim rim dkar lam dmar lam nag lam sogs/ /gsal po min par zhad tsam 'ong bar(yong bar) bshad/ /gnyid du thibs se song tshe tshogs brgyad kyi/ /rnam shes mi gsal snying ga dbu ma'i nang / /gzhi yi 'od gsal cung tsam 'char bar bshad//de dag so sor ngos zin dka' na yang //sgom mtha' gnyid kyi bsu bar byas pa yis//gnyid ma thag tu rmi lam mi rmis bar sems ngo ngos zin lhang nger gnas pa na/ /de ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa yin/ /de 'dra lan bdun zin par gyur pa na/ /'chi dus thugs dam bskul ma med na yang / /rang gi thugs dam zin par o rgyan gsungs/ /ma gnyid bar du sems ngo ma yengs shing //gnyid ni ma sad bar du gnyid 'thug pas//zin dang ma zin rang gis mi shes shing / /rmi lam za zi tsam yang mi rmis bar/ /sad ma thag tu sems ngo'i stong nyid du/ /lhang nger 'dug cing khams dngas dbang bo gsal/ /de ni 'thug po'i 'od gsal zin pa yin/ /de skad mnyam med dwags po lha rjes gsungs/ /gnyid ma thag tu sems ngo zin pa la/ /sems ngo'i ngang nas 'gyu ba cung zad 'byung //gnyid pa'ang shes shing khyim gyi nang kun mthong //sems ngo ma yengs ngang nas zhal gzigs sogs/ /mthong snang thos snang rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /de ni srab mo'i 'od gsal zin pa'o/ /gnyid ma thag tu sems ngo ma zin kyang //mig nas 'od zer rag dung 'dra ba 'byung //yang na zla thig nyi zer 'dra ba mthong / /de yi rkyen gyis sems ngo gsal por zin/ /de yi ngang na 'od des 285

rkyen byas nas//khang khyim ri brag rnams kyis ma sgrib par//thag ring yul dang mi yi ci byed mthong //ci zer thos sogs res 'ga' 'byung ba na//de ni nyams kyi 'od gsal bya ba yin/ /de ltar gnyid la bsten nas nyams len pa/ /de ni mi rtag pa yi bogs 'don che/ /de ltar 'od gsal zin par ma gyur na/ /snying gar kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'thum pa de//las kyi rlung gis khrid nas rtsa rgyud 'grim//de la brten nas rmi lam sna tshogs 'byung / rmi lam i yin(yin min) ma shes ngang nyid la/ /nyin gyi bag chags bskyed rdzogs zin pa na/ /de ni rmi lam 'od gsal zhes bya'o/ /dang po rmi lam yin par ngos zin nas/ /de nas bskyed rdzogs sgom pas nyin las gsal/ /yang na bya sogs lus kyi sprul sgyur gyis/ /zhing khams bgrod dang zhal mjal chos zhu sogs/ /de ltar gnyid la brten nas bogs 'don te//kye rdo rje las/ gnyid ni spang ba mi bya zhing //dbang po rnams kyang mi dgag go/ /gsungs pa'i don yang de la dgongs pa yin/ /de yang gsar bu nyams len skyong ba'i tshe/ /nyin mo mi snyan wa dang khā ta'i skad/ /lug khyu ma bu 'dres dang ku co'i sgra/ /mtshan mo khyi skad chu sgra che ba rnams/ /ting nge 'dzin la shin tu gnod pa'i tshe/ /gnod pa'i sgra gcig la ni sems gtad de/ /sgra dang sems de bsres la ngo bo blta/ /sgra de rna bar thos kyang ngo bo stong / /de 'dra lan 'ga' byas la nan gyis bsgom//de nas thos tshad sgom gyi ngo bor 'char sems ngo ma yengs hrig ger skyong ba'i tshe/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs gang yang rung //gsal bar mthong yang 'di yin 'di min gyi//'dzin pa mi 'jug sems ngo'i ngang du gnas//dper na bu chung lha khang mjal ba bzhin//sems nyid spros bral stong pa'i ngang la gnas/ /de ni spros bral ngo bo skyong lugs te/ /'dzin pa'i 286

sems de stong par rtogs na yang //gzung ba'i ngo bo stong par ma gtogs pas//rdor dril la sogs gzugs shig mdun du gzhag/de dang sems ngo bsres nas sgom pa yis/ /gzugs de med ni song ba ma yin par/ /gzugs dang sems 'dres ngo bo stong par rtogs//de bzhin mdun gyi brag sogs la yang bya//de nas mthong tshad gzugs kun dus gcig bsre/ /de nas gling bzhi'i ri rab stong gsum khams/ /yid la bkod nas bsres pas dbyer med 'dres/ /de nas bsre ba la sogs mi dgos par/ /phyi nang snod bcud gzugs rnams thams cad kun//rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar ci bzhin du//rnam pa gsal yang ngo bo stong nyid du/ /sgom yang mi dgos rang bzhin shugs kyis 'char/ /de bzhin nam mkha' nyid dang sems bsres la/ /ngo bo skyong bas sems dang nam mkha' 'dres/ /de bzhin nam mkhas gar khyab yid bkod la/ /sems dang bsres pas dbyer med gcig 'dres nas//'di phan nam mkha' 'di tshun sems yin zhes//phye rgyu med par nyams len gcig gis ngang / /dang po yi dam la sogs sangs rgyas gcig /thugs yid dbyer med bsres la ngo bo blta/ /de nas de bzhin sangs rgyas kun dang bsre//de bzhin sems can gcig dang kun la bsre//rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dang 'gro kun sems/ /rang sems dbyer med rtogs pa'i bogs chen 'byung / /dmigs pa bsgoms dang go ba ma yin par/ /nges par gting nas rtogs na lta ba yin/ /da rung (da dung /)yengs skabs brjed skabs mang du 'byung / /de bzhin 'chi ba4 mi rtag brjed gyur pas/ /brtson 'grus thang lhod shor ba'i rkyen byed pas//rang gi sgrub khang nang gi phyogs bzhi ru//sa dkar snag tsha btsag gsum gang bde yi//'chi ba zer ba'i yig 'bru chen po dang //ma 287

yengs zer ba'i yig 'bru chen po bri/ /phyogs bzhi gang du bltas kyang de mthong bya//dbus gtsang de 'dra'i phyag srol mig gis mthong //de bzhin 'chi ba mi rtag dran pa dang //'chi ba dran nas sems ngo lta dran bya//bde nyams 'thug po skyes pa'i dus nyid du/ /yengs med 'khor yug 'dra ba 'byung na yang / /ring yang lo zla tsam las rtag mi thub//rtogs pa dngos gzhi yengs skabs shin tu mang //dran tshe yengs song snyam du 'gyod pa shor/ /nam tsam yengs song snyam nas rjes ra byed/ /de nas blo sems mi bde skyong mi 'dod/ /de yi bogs 'don dran pa'i skabs de nas/ /de snga yengs tshad rnam rtog du song kun/ /yid la bkod la phyi bltas byed pa ltar/ /ngo bo bltas pas stong par sangs kyis 'gro/ /de yis blo kha tshim shing go chod gsungs//de don mnyam med dwags po lha rje yis//ngo bo rtogs na cung zad yengs skabs kyi/ /rnam rtog de yis sgrib par mi nus gsungs/ /gtan nas yengs skabs med pa de 'dra ni//sgom med ma rtogs bar du mi 'ong par/ /mar pa'i rlung sems gnyis med khrid yig gsal/ /deng sang yengs med yod zer phal cher ni//bde nyams skabs kyi yengs med yin par snang //de ltar yengs med dngos de mi 'byung don/ /thugs ni mnyam par ma gzhag mi mnga' bar//sangs rgyas ma 'dres chos su gsungs phyir ro//yengs dang ma yengs dran dang ma dran dang / /gnyid dang ma gnyid don la khyad med de/ /ngo bo stong nyid chos sku rjen pa nyid//ma dran yengs pas ngan du mi 'gro la//dran zhing sgom yang bzang du mi 'gro bar//'gyur med sa le sbram gyi gser bzhin du//rtogs pa 'di ni ngo bo rtogs pa ste//de yi go ba tsam la gdeng bcas nas//dge sbyor spangs na bdud kyi las su 'gyur//yengs dang ma yengs khyad med gdeng rnyed kyang //yang 288

yang dran pas gsal 'debs zab par gsungs//'di don dwags pos mi la ma mjal bar/ /ma dgongs sgom la 'o brgyal byung zhes gsungs/ /'di don phag grus zhus len skabs su gsal/ /khrid yig rnams dang bla ma rnams kyis gsungs/ /rang gi nyams myong bstun pas blo bde rnyed/ /mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i bogs chen de dus 'byung / /'ga' zhig bde nyams lus sems bde bas rgyas/ /nyin mo skad cig tsam yang yengs pa med/ /sems la nges shes dga' ba chen po yod/ /de bzhin sems ni gsal stong rjen par bud/ /lhang nge rjen ne nges shes gdeng dang ldan/ /gnyid dus phal cher de yi ngang du 'gro/ /rtogs pa 'di 'dra gzhan la med snyam nas//rang rtsis che zhing rtogs ldan mchog tu rlom//de gnyis nyams yin bshigs nas ma bsgom na/ /gser du rlom nas ra gan 'chang dang mtshungs/ /de gnyis bshig rgya bshig lugs gang yin na//nges shes brtan po de nyid bshig dgos so/ /nges shes de ni rnam par rtog pa yin/ /rnam par rtog pa ma rig 'khor pa'i rgyu/ /phyag rgya chen po mi rtog ye shes yin/ /de phyir bka' rgyud gong ma'i gsung rnams la/ /sgom 'debs shes pa mangs te bshig shes dkon/ /zhes gsungs don yang de la dgongs pa yin/ /'o na sgom de ji ltar yin zhe na/ /tshe rabs sngon gyi las 'phros sad pa'am/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs byas pa'i 'bras bu 'am/ /mos gus stobs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'am/ /yi dam bsnyen sgrub them pa'i dngos grub las/ /ci yin cha med rang yang rgod bro ba/ /sngon gyi nyams rtogs bzang dgu shun par bud/ /nges shes yod pa thams cad gting nas gtor//bsgom bya sgom byed 'dzin pa ci yang med//tha mal chos ma thos dus sems nyid de //phyag rgya chen por lhan gyis rtogs gyur pas//a a 'di nyid yin 289

par 'dug pa la/ /bla mas ma gsungs pa la mgo bskor btang / /rang gis ma rtogs ha re long du song //da ni bsgom rgyu ci yang mi 'dug bas//kha rog bsdad la 'di mas chog par 'dug /snyam nas semaso nyid ngal sos lta bu 'gyur/ /tha mal shes pa rjen pa zhes bya dang / /chen po gsum gyis blo yis ma reg dang / /smra bsam brjod med spros dang bral ba rnams//thams cad de yi ming gi rnam grangs te/ /ma yengs dran rdzi'i yang yang gsal 'debs las/ /bya rgyu ci yang med pa nyams len yin/ /thos pa chung na de yis yid mi tshim/ /gsal stong rjen pa bde nyams yod pa 'dod/ /sngon bzhin e 'ong chod kyang ma byung pas/ /nyams len zhan du song snyams sems mi dga'//de ni rtogs pa nyams la shor ba yin/ /de yi bogs 'don de nyid skyong ba las/ /nyams rtogs bzang po'i 'dod pa spang bar bya/ /de nas gol sa shor sa yol ba yin/ /gsal dngas thon dang ma thon tsam zhig las//ngo bo de la 'gyur pa med pa yin//zhes pa shing sbrul mgo yi zla ba yi/ /bcu gcig dang ni bcu gnyis dgong thun mtshams//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bskul byas nas/ /rā ga a sus bsam blo ma btang bar/ /'phral du gang dran smras phyir go rim 'chol/ /de yi nongs pa mkhyen ldan rnams la bshags/ /'di ru go rim 'chol bar gyur na yang //khrid yig rnams su go rimagasal mod kyi//de ni rim gyis pa yi dbang du mdzad//thod rgal ba la go rim ma nges bya//go rim 'chol yang ha cang 'gal ba med/ /'di nyid bshad pa'i chos ni ma yin phyir/ /sa bcad go rim lung 'dren spros pa bskyungs/ /'di nyid snyan dngags bstan bcos ma yin phyir//tshig gi mdzes rgyan sdeb spyor spros pa bskyungs//'di nyid gzhung gi bshad mi ma yin phyir/ /rang lugs gzhan lugs dgag bzhag 290

spros pa bskyungs/ /'di nyid mkhas 'dod bstan bcos ma yin phyir/ /yig cha mang po bsdu ba'i bri bshu bskyungs//'di nyid gzhan zer rjes zlos ma yin phyir//grub chen gong ma'i gsung gi lung 'dren bskyungs//blun po'i rang bzo blun tshig ma yin pas/ /mdo rgyud gong ma'i gsung dang 'gal ba med//rang gi nyams myong lhug par smras pa'i phyir//rang 'dra'i dman pa 'ga' la phan nam snyam//de phyir bla ma bi rya sā ga ras/ /'khyags bsgur byas te sgron me'i ngogs la bris/ /dge bas mthong tshad nyams rtogs mthar phyin shog/le'u so bdun pa'o maṅga lam̐//rgyab chos dug 'jom rma bya chen mo/liri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ rgyab chos dug lnga spang ba dang 'dul ba dang bsgyur ba dang rang bzhin shes pa dang lam du khyer thabs dug 'joms rma bya chen mo bzhugs so/ /na mo shākya mu ne ye/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden par gsungs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma kurma brtson 'grus rgya mtsho bas/ /kye ma ci ltar byas kyang dug lnga 'di/ /stong nyid ngang du grol bar ma nus pas//dug lnga 'di yis dbang du mi 'chor ba'i//gdams pa zab mo gnang bar thugs rjes zungs//de skad zer ba'i len du smras pa ni//dug lnga spang dang gnyen pos 'dul ba dang / /rang bzhin shes par bya dang lam khyer bzhi/ /dang po bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo'i don/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med don la yid ches pas//nyes dmigs dran nas spang bar byed pa yin//skye ba 'di dang skye 291

pa gzhan dag tu/ /mi 'dod 'ong dogs che ba sdug bsngal yin/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu ni mi dge ba/ /dug lngas bslang ba'i nyes pa gang bsgrubs pa/ /de dag mi dge yin phyir spang bar bya//mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung nges pas//sdug bsngal de ni bden grub lus kyis myong / /de ni sdug bsngal bden pa zhes bya'o/ /dug lnga las ni mi dge kun 'byung ba/ /de ni kun 'byung bden pa zhes bya'o//dug lnga bkag na thar pa'i sa lam 'thob//de ni 'gog pa'i bden pa zhes bya'o/ /sa lam bgrod pas 'bras bu dgra bcom 'thob/ /de ni lam gyi bden pa zhes bya'o/ /wā rā ṇa sīr chos 'khor bskor ba yi/ /don gyi rtsa ba de la 'dus pa yin/ /'dod chags 'bras bus yi dwags skye bar gsungs/ /zhe sdang dmyal ba gti mug dud 'gro'i rgyu/ /phrag dog lha min nga rgyal lha dang mi/ /ngan song gsum na sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /mtho ris gnas su gnas skabs bde na yang / /mi rtag myur du sdug bsngal rgyu ru 'gyur/ /skye rga na 'chi grangs med thar dus med/ /de yi rtsa ba dug lnga yin phyir spang / /da lta dug lnga'i rnam rtog bsran kyang tshugs/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /de phyir dug lnga skyes kyang bsran cing bsgyur/ /rgyal po btsan po'i bka' khrims dam po bzhin/ /chos kyi rgyal bo sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis/ /khrims su bcas pa'i 'dul khrims las 'das na/ /skye ba 'bum phrag brgya yi bar dag du/ /ngan song sdug bsngal myong ba'i chad pa yong //'jig rten 'di na shi ba thu mod kyi//de bas tshul khrims 'chal ba 'bum 'gyur sdug//tshul khrims ldan pa shi yang shi ba min//de ma thag tu lus bzang len pas chog/gzugs mdzes la chags sdom pa gtong ba ni/ /mar me'i gzugs la phye lteb chags gyur nas/ /phye lheb mchongs pa dag 292

dang mtshungs pa yin/ /nyon mongs 'khrig pa'i bde la chags pa ni/ /me mdag chen po'i steng du rtswa skya bting //mal sa bde snyam gnyid kyis log dang mtshungs//sha chang dgong sogs zas kyi tshul khrims 'chal/ /spu gri'i rtse yi sbrang rtsi bldag dang mtshungs//'jig rten dgra bo ji ltar rtsog na(ngan na) yang //tshe 'di'i srog gcod longs spyod 'phrog pa las/ /skye ba mang bo'i bde skyid 'phrog mi thu ba/ /bskal pa brgya ru bsod nams gang bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams dge tshogs khong khro gcig gis 'joms/ /de phyir dgra 'di spang ba shin tu gces/ /sbrang ma sbrang rtsi la ni chags pa yi/ /sbrang rtsir 'byar nas kho rang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dod pa la/ /chags pas 'khor bar 'byar na thar dus med/ /de phyir 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes bya/ /gti mug gnyid 'di dge ba'i chom po ste/ /lo brgya thub kyang lnga bcur ro ltar nyal//gnyid la nyes pa nyi shu yod par bshad/ /de phyir gnyid srab dge sbyor brtson par bya//rang nyid mi shes gti mug dbang btsan pas//chos ma yin la chos su smra ba dang //chos la chos ma yin zhes skur 'debs pa//za rgyu med par zhal lce gcod pa zhes//don med sdig pa chen po'i las 'di spang / /rgyu 'bras phan yon nyes dmigs la sogs pa/ /de ltar mi bden bshad tshod yin sems pa/ /log lta 'di ni gti mug chen po ste/ /bshags thabs med pa'i las ngan 'di nyid spang / /rang nyid mtho 'dod gzhan la phrag dog pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la skur ba btab/ /khams gsum sems can bsad las sdig che gsungs/ /phrag dog las gyur las ngan 'di nyid spang / /nga ni sdom ldan tshul khrims gtsang ma can/ /ser chags phal pa rnams dang mi 'dra snyam/ /de yis rang gi tshul khrims mi gtsang 'gyur/ /de don 293

dbu ma 'jug pa'i gzhung las gsungs/ /ser gos gyon tshad dge 'dun dkon mchog te/ /phyi yi spyod lam mi btsun rtsing na yang / /nang der yon tan ci yod rtogs dka' bas/ /gzhan la snying nas dag snang sbyong ba dang / /rang nyid kun las dman par lta ba gces/ /de dag dug lnga spang pa'i lam zhes pa/ /nyan thos lugs kyi bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin/ /skyes pa bud med mdzes shing mdog legs pa//de mthong rang nyid chags pa skyes pa'i tshe//dper na gser bum gcin rtug bkang ba bzhin/ /phyi ni legs kyang nang ni mi gtsang rdzas/ /khog stod khrag rnag khog smad gcin rtug gang / /snabs dang lud pa klad pa mkhris pa sogs/ /mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu so gnyis kyis/ /gang ba'i rkyal pa de la ci zhig dga'/ /lus la srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong gnas/ /grol ma'i 'bu dang srin bu'i bshang gci sogs/ /grog tshang bzhin du 'bu srin gyis gang ba'i/ /de la dga' zhing 'dod pa 'khrul bar bsam/ /de ni mi gtsang sgom pa'i ting 'dzin yin/ /mi ro rgod kyis zos pa'i keng rus la/ /ci ltar yod pa'i 'jigs rung btsog pa de/ /rang gzhan kun gyi lus po'i nang 'dir yod/ /de don shes pas chags pa skye mi 'gyur//rang gi mdun du ro rul 'bus g.yeng ba//de bzhin bam dang rul dang dri ma mnam/ /keng rus sha med mig rjes dmar ha re/ /de 'dra gcig bsgom de nas sa phyogs de/ /de 'dra kho nas gang ba gsal bar bsgom/ /yang ni rang dang rang gis chags pa'i yul//thod pa nas gas lpags pa thams cad bshus//lus kun keng rus skam por gyur par bsam/ /yang ni rang gi lus 'di phyi nang bsgyur//glo snying thams cad rgyab tu phra ler bsgom//de dag mi sdug sgom pa'i ting 'dzin yin//'dod chags 'joms pa'i thabs su gsungs pa yin/ /'dul ba'i 294

sde snod bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin//sems can thams cad skye ba dpag med kyi//pha dang ma ru ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /lan gcig ma yin lan grangs dpag med byas/ /khong tsho 'khrul pa'i gdon gyis zin nas spyo/ /nga la bu ru ma shes gnod 'tshe byas//ngas ni shes bzhin pha ma smyo ba la//ci phan ma gtogs lan byed ga la rung / /snyam du dgra la byams pa tshad med bsgom/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin yongs su rdzogs dgos pas/ /gnod byed med na bzod pa su la bsgom/ /de phyir dgra 'di bdag gis dge ba'i grogs/ /ma nyes kha yog skur pa 'debs pa la/ /bzod pa bsgom na sdig sgrib dpag med byang / /skur 'debs mkhan sogs nga yi sgrib sbyong grogs/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal can dag ma mthong na/ /snying rje sgom pa'i yul dang sbyin yul med//snying rje med na byang chub thob thabs med//dbul phongs med na sbyin pa su la gtong / /ngan pa 'di tsho byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /sangs rgyas bas kyang sems can drin che ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa'i phar phyin gsum/ /sems can rnams kyi drin la brten nas 'byung / /drin can rnams la khong khro bya mi 'os/ /lha sbyin drin la brten nas shāka thub kyang / /byams pa'i sngon la rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes gsungs/ /de ltar shes kyang khong khro ma zhi na//dgra de tshe 'di'i ma de yin par bsgom/ /bsgoms ltar tshe rabs du ma'i ma yin nges//de la gnod 'tshe rung ngam mi rung brtag//rang nyid dgrar bsgom dgra de rang nyid bsgom/ /'dun pa bsgyur bas zhe sdang zhi bar gsungs/ /byams pa'i ting 'dzin zhe sdang 'dul thabs so/ /mdo sde'i sde snod bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin//thub pa lha las babs dang lhums su zhugs//mdzad pa 295

bcu gnyis yid la rtsi bgrang bya/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa/ /de las 'du byed las byung skye ba'i bar//skye dang rga dang 'chi ba la sogs pa//rga shi zhes bya rgas dang shi ba'i ming / /de las mya ngan sdug bsngal yid mi bde/ /'khor bar 'khyams phyir srid pa'i 'khor po ste/ /thams cad 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar 'gro bas/ /'gro drug gshin rje 'char kha'i lto bar gnas/ /de don dge 'dun rnams kyis go ba'i phyir/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgo g.yon bri srol yod/ /ma rig 'gag pas 'du byed 'gags pa ni//skye ba 'gags nas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar/ /rten 'brel lugs ldog thar pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po mtshon pa'i phyir//'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad ldan pa zhig/gtsug lag khang gi sgo g.yas bri srol yod//rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog yid la bgrangs/ /de yang ma rig pa de gang zhe na/ /rang sems rang gis ma rig pa de yin/ /de la brten nas srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rang sems rang gis rig pas ma rig 'gag /de la goms pas 'phags pa'i lam thob 'gyur/ /srod dang tho rangs gnyid ni bsrabs pa'i phyir//khyim du 'chag par bya ba gsungs na yang / /lag len bde bar ka bar rten gsum bcings/ /de la bskor ba bya zhing bzlas brjod 'bad/ /yang na nub mo rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug /mar me gsal ba gcig bsgoms rig pa gtad/ /de yis gnyid bsrabs gti mug sel bar gsungs//dam chos mngon pa'i bsgom bya'i rtsa ba ste//gti mug gnyen por rten 'brel sgom thabs so/ /kye ma grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas/ /bdag ni mtha' med 'khor ba 'di tsam 'khyams/ /da rung (da dung /)sun snang med pa'i snying sran can//sngon byon sangs rgyas bye ba grangs med kyi//bstan pa'i yun la ma 296
