grol las ngan po/ /dbang lung khrid dang man ngag ci thob rkyang / /rang rgyud grol bar ma nus chos sdug po/ /bstan la zhugs nas sdom pa gsum zhus kyang / /nyes ltung char pa bab pa'i khrims 'chal po/ /yi dam bsnyen sgrub dpag med byas na yang / /lha zhal zur tsam ma mthong sgrib 'thug po/ /chung nas ma shi'i bar du dkor zos kyang / /da rung (da dung /)tshim pa med pa'i dkor dred po/ /nang du nyon mongs dug lngas gang bzhin du//phyi ru chos gos gzab pa'i zo brdzu mkhan//gzhung gcig tsam yang 'chad rtsod mi shes par//da rung (da dung /)mkhas 'dod che ba'i ham pa can/ /dug lnga'i mgo bo cung zad mi non pa'i/ /bzang po yin skad smra pa'i mgo g.yog mkhan//rang nyid gar 'gro'i gtad so med bzhin du//tshe 'das mang po 'dren pa'i snying khams can/ /rang nyid nam 'chi nges pa med bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi bar chad sel pa'i byin rlabs can/ /legs par bsams na rang la yi re mug /bsam zhing rang gi brang la tug tug bya/ /de yi nga rgyal khengs pa 'joms par 'gyur/ /kye ma bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed zhus/ /de dus sangs rgyas kun gyis mkhyen cing dgongs/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sar bkod dam bca' byas//dge sbyor byas tshad 'gro ba'i don yin cing //'gro kun bde dang bde ba'i rgyur ldan pa'i//smon lam 'di yang rgyun du brjod bzhin du//mi gzhan mtho zhing skyid na ma dga' ba'i/ /phrag dog sems 'di gang nas dran na yang / /'gro kun bde zhing skyid na dga' ba'i sems/ /de nyid kho nas tshangs pa'i lus thob gsungs/ /gzhan la phrag dog mtho na mi dga'i sems/ /bsdus 'joms dmyal ba lha min sa bon lags/ /de 'dra bsam pas phrag dog zhi bar 'gyur/ /de dag dug lnga gnyen pos 'dul ba ste/ /theg pa che chung thun mong mdo 297

yi lugs/ /sems la dug lnga'i rtog pa gang shar tshe//swa bhā wa yi sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ /zhe sdang rdor sems nga rgyal rin chen 'byung / /'dod chags snang mtha' phrag dog don yod grub//gti mug rnam snang sku ru gsal bar bsgom//de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i dug lnga sbyong / /lam rgyud lnga ru skye ba'i skye sgo gcod/ /tshur 'dus 'od zhu mi dmigs stong par bsgom//skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du//bdag nyid mthong thos dran pa'i 'gro kun gyi//dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing dag nus shog /nam zhig bdag nyid mngon par byang chub tshe/ /zhing der dug lnga gtan nas med par shog /de skad yid kyis bsgom mam ngag gis brjod/ /don la phyi snod gdod nas gzhal yang khang / /nang bcud sems can thams cad yi dam lha/ /gdod nas yin bzhin gsal btab gti mug zhi/ /tha mal 'dod chags yi dam lhar mi skye/ /yi dam lha la khro 'am tshig ngan med/ /thams cad lha mnyam su mtho su zhig dma'/ /yi dam lha la mtho dog phrag dog gam//de ltar shes pas dug lnga shugs kyis 'gag/de ni bskyed rim pa yi nyams len te/ /dug lnga bsgyur ba'i lam zhes bya ba yin/ /gsang sngags mi spang pa yi dam tshig lnga/ /'dod chags zhe ldang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog lnga po spang bar mi bya ste/ /dug lnga spang ba'i ye shes logs shig med/ /dug lnga spang na theg dman nyan thos lam/ /dug lnga'i rjes su 'brang nas tha mal pa/ /dug lnga 'byol nyog spyod na bdud kyi las//dug lnga rang ngo bltas na ye shes lnga//zhe sdang me long ye shes rdo rje sems//nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'byung //'dod chags sor rtogs ye shes snang mtha' yas/ /phrag dog bya grub ye shes don yod grub/ /gti mug chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang mdzad/ /dug lnga ma spangs rang rang ngo 1 98

bo lta/ /ma spangs gnas su dag na ye shes lnga/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgongs par lhun gyis grub/ /de ni phyag rdzogs lugs kyi nyams len yin/ /nad brgya sman gcig ngo lta gcig pus chog /rab la skyes ma thag nas 'bur 'joms bya/ /dper na rtswa gseb me stag bsad pa bzhin/ /'bring ni dngos gzhi skye dus cer gyis lta/ /rang zhi rang grol chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ /tha ma dran pa rjes slebs rjes mi 'brang / /dper na smyon pas dran pa rnyed pa bzhin/ /nyams len phan che stabs bde 'di ka yin/ /rang yang cung zad nyams len byas snyam bgyid/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos nyams len de la mdzod/ /de nas dug lnga mi spangs lam khyer ni/ /thub dang mi thub rang gi nyams tshod dpag gang zag phal gyis nyams su len bya min//'di la nus ldan rtogs pa mthon po dgos//gti mug nyid kyis gti mug/tha mal snod min log lta can la gsang //'joms pa'i thabs//gtsang zhing dben par dkor zas grib la 'dzem/ /khrus byas spos bdug mi dang ngo mi gtugs/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing yig brgya bzlas//nyin la yud tsam mi gnyid gnyid bsrung bya//phyag dang bskor bas lus po thang chad bcug/bde ba'i mal du seng ge'i nyal stabs nyal/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka ru/ /padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su oṃ dkar po/ /shar du a sngon lho ru nu ser po/ /nub tu ta dmar byang du ra ljang bsgom/ /de nas gnyid ni rab gcig hur ba('thib pa) dang / /yi ge bzhi por rim bzhin dmigs pa gtad//gnyid ka dbus kyi oṃ la sems gtad nas/ /ma yengs sems ro'i rtsi dang ma bral gnyid/ /gnyid tshe tshogs brgyad mi gsal gcig tu bsdus/ /yud tsam dbu mar zhugs tshe 'od gsal 'char/ /de nyid ngos zin ngang la mnyam par gzhag /'od gsal zin pa 299

phyir nang gsal bar dran/ /de ni srab mo'i 'od gsal zin pa yin/ /ma gnyid bar du nyams len ngang du gnas/ /gnyid nas ma dran rmi lam cung zad med/ /sad ma thag tu sems ngo'i thog tu gnas/ /sems dga' khams bde lus kyi sha mdog dkar / /'od gsal zin nam ma zin ma shes kyang / /'thug po'i 'od gsal yin par dwags pos gsungs/ /de ni gti mug lam khyer gdams ngag yin//'dod chags lam khyer phyag rgya rnam bzhi ste//las kyi phyag rgya rig ma mtshan ldan ni//sa thob rdzu 'phrul ston nus ma yin pa'i//'dul khrims zhus pas brten na ngan song rgyu//'dul khrims ma zhus rtsa rlung las rung pas//'dod chags skye ba gtum mo 'dod chags dus//de dus stong pas rgyas gdab bde stong bsre//thig le ma nyams srog ltar bsrung bar bya//dwags po bka' brgyud rnams kyi phyag srol lags//yid rig ye shes phyag rgya zhes bya ba//yi dam yab yum zhal sbyor sgom pa yin/ /rang gi sems nyid stong nyid phyag rgya che/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'phags pa bzhi ka de la skyes pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum zhes brjod pa yin//de nyid nyams len phyag rgya chen po'i yum//rtsa rlung mi chun rgan po rnams kyis brten//de rnams 'dod chags lam khyer gdams pa yin//bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba ma gtogs pa'i//dgra bo byung yang bzod pa bsgom dgos so/ /zhing bcu tshang zhing rang gi dgrang gyur kyang / /de la drag po'i las sbyor rung mi rung / /yi dam lha la gsol btab rmi lam brtag /rung ba'i gnang ba byung na las bya bar/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i rgyud gzhung rnams nas gsungs/ /rang dgra min yang thub bstan spyi bshig pa/ /rang gis bsgral ba'i nus pa ldan bzhin du/ /btang snyoms bzhag na de nyid nyes pa che/ /de nyid mi 300

min sprul ba yin shes dang //rang las lhag pa'i bstan 'dzin gzhan yod dam//rang la nus pa med na nyes pa med//zhe sdang ma yin kho la snying rje yis//sdig 'phro gcod cing bde bar 'dren pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub rgyas pa'i phyir//drag sngags nus pas de nyid tshar bcad de//sha khrag phung pos lha dang srung ma mchod//rnam shes dag pa'i zhing ngam mtho ris su//spar nas thugs rjes nam yang mi gtang bar/ /rang gis rim gyis sangs rgyas sar 'god pa'i/ /sems bskyed smon lam dang bcas bsgral ba ste//dper na mu stegs sprang po nyi ma des//lo grangs bcu gnyis mig btsum nyi ma bsgrubs/ /rdo rje gdan du 'ong nas mig bltas pas/ /mig nas me 'bar rdo rje gdan gyi ni/ /gtsug lag khang dang dam chos thams cad bsregs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rū ṭar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /chos skyong mang po rbad kyang rtags ma byung / /de nas rnam sras rta sngon can rbad pas/ /kho yi tsitta dngos su khyer nas byung / /chos skyong yongs kyi gtso bor mnga' gsol mdzad/ /sdig can mu stegs sprang po nyi ma de/ /klu sgrub kyis bsgral thugs rjes ma btang phyir/ /bod du mkhon rigs klu yi dbang por skyes//mkhas grub chen po bstan pa'i bdag por gyur//de ltar bsgral nas thugs rjes 'dzin pa de//zhe sdang lam khyer gdams ngag yin mod kyi//de ltar kho nyid 'dren par mi nus na//'dul pa'i lung nas gsod dam 'chir bcug ces//srog bcad pham pa 'byung ba mtshungs 'dra bas//mthu dga' mi che mthu bsdig mi byed par/ /dam tshig gtsang zhing bsnyen sgrub them pa dang / /gtor bsngos dgu gtor bskang gsol brtson byas na/ /ched du las sbyor dmigs dan ma byas kyang / /dgra la rtags dang cho 'phrul mang du 'byung / /ma 301

bskul par yang gnod pa'i dgra bsgral zhes/ /dam tshig gtsang zhing lha srung 'khor rtags yin/ /de 'dra byung yang rang la sgrib pa med/ /'di yang myong bas lan mang grub pa yin/ /'di yi gnad la kho bos 'di 'dra mthong / /dngos su drag sngags las sbyor ma byas kyang / /sems la zhe sdang khong khro yod na ni/ /de la bka' chad dag ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /pha rol po der mi 'os gnod byas kyang / /sems la khong khro zhe sdang ma skyes na/ /gnod pa che chung gang byas tshod de dang / /'tshams pa'i bka' chad mi dge sna tshogs pas//lo zla mi 'gyang myur du 'ong ba ni/ /lan gcig ma yin lan mang myong bas grub/ /gu ru chos dbang la yang de 'dra byung //mthu bzhes gtor gsum byas kyang rtags med pa//byams dang snying rje bsgoms pas gtan nas brlag/de don ci lags o rgyan la zhus pas//dgra la zhe sdang gnyen la gdung sems ni/ /rang sems snang ba'i dbang du phar shor bas/ /bsams bzhin mi 'grub log par 'gro ba yin/ /dgra la mi sdang byams dang snying rje skyes/ /snang ba rang sems dbang du tshur 'dus pas/ /rang gi ci bsam 'grub pa yin no gsungs/ /bka' brgyud bzhed pa'ang de dang mthun par snang //mngon shes med pas mngon spyod mi rung ste//tshe stod bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bo yang //tshe smad bstan la phan pa che srid gsungs//mdo lugs dkon mchog gsum la gnod mi mnga'/ /dkon mchog gsum po yid la dran pas kyang / /gnod pa thams cad skyob par gsungs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod par byed pa'i dgra / /theg dman lugs la bdud dang bstan dgra ste/ /theg chen lugs la che ba 'don pa'i phyir//sangs rgyas nyid kyis sprul pa yin pa ste/ /dper na bdud rgyal lhas byin lta bu'o/ /bka' gdams lugs la bdud 302

rgyal glang dar yang / /sangs rgyas bstan la bka' drin chen po ste/ /sngags la kha g.yar chos log dar ba rnams//kho yis tshar bcad sa phyogs gtsang bar byas /de nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa a ti sha/ /byon pas dam chos slad med 'di dar zhes/ /rngog lo chen po sogs kyis gsungs pa yod/ /de phyir bstan dgra yin yin 'dra na yang / /las sbyor byed thag chod pa ma yin no/ /de dag zhe sdang lam khyer gnad 'gag yin/ /mdo lugs rang sems mi gtsang sha khrag lus/ /byang chub sems bskyed phar phyin drug spyod kyang / /bskal pa grangs med gsum par 'tshang mi rgya//sngags lugs tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgya ba//rang lus lha ru shes pa'i zab khyad yin/ /phung po lnga ni rgyal ba rigs lnga ste/ /khams lnga yum lnga tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad/ /yin la yin par shes pa'i nges shes kyis/ /rang nyid yi dam lha yi nga rgyal bskyed//srid gsum 'di na 'gran zla med par bsgom//nga rgyal nges shes brtan na byin rlabs 'byung / /de ni nga rgyal lam du khyer ba yin/ /rang lus lha yi thugs kya'i 'od zer gyis/ /srid pa gsum gyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rnams/ /thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim par bsgom/ /srung bzlog byed pa'i dmigs rim skabs rnams su/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bgegs dang dgra yi tshogs/ /gtub cing bsgral te sha khrag srung mas zos/ /gtor gzhong gling bzhi ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og/mnan par bsgom sogs phrag dog lam khyer yin//de ltar dug lnga spang dang 'dul ba dang //bsgyur dang rang bzhin shes dang lam khyer ba'i//gdams ngag tshan lnga 'phral du gang dran rnams//rta lo tha skar zla ba'i tshes gnyis nyin/ /snga dro'i thun la rā ga a sus smras//bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod/ /rgyud gzhung rnams dang 'gal ba'i cha mchis na/ /mang 303

thos sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la bshags/ /dge bas rab byung gsar bu mang po la//sems rgyud chos dang mthun pa 'ong bar(yong bar) shog/le'u so brgyad pa'o maṅga lam̐//spyod pa'i gdams pa rgyal sras lag len/tshoskeri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/spyod pa rgyal sras lag len bzhugs so/ /na mo badzra dhā ra ye/ /bogs 'don rtsa ba spyod pa ste/ /so so'i skye bo gang zag gis/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa mi bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yi gang zag gis/ /grub thob spyod pa mi bya'o/ /grub pa thob pa rnams kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas spyod pa mi rung gsungs/ /'og mas gong ma'i spyod pa byas/ /seng ge'i rjes su wa mchongs dpe/ /gong mas 'og ma'i spyod pa byas/ /mi rgan rtsed mo rtses dang 'dra/ /rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa dang //phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa dang //khyi phag lta bu'i spyod pa dang / /smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang / /seng ge lta bu'i spyod pa rnams/ /grub thob rnams kyis spyod pa ste/ /rang la myong ba med phyir dang / /mkho dgos med phyir spros pa bskyungs/ /sha btson lta bu'i spyod pa ni/ /nyes chen sha rtsas btson bzung na/ /ma thar na ni mtha' rgyu gcig /e thar (thar ba'i)thabs la 'bad pa ltar/ /dang po chos sgor zhugs pa'i dus/ /khyim pa'i dgra nas ci thar bya/ /de nas ser gzugs chos med kyi//gral nas rang nyid ci thar bya//de nas rigs drug 'khor ba yi/ /gnas nas thar te bde chen zhing //phyir mi ldog par 'gro rtsis bya//bung 304

ba lta bu'i spyod pa ni//dbang lung gdams ngag zhu ba'i dus//dper na bung bas me tog kun/ /bcud 'jib mi chags mi sdang bar/ /sbrang rtsi 'jib nas 'gro ba ltar/ /dam sel ngan pas ma chod pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la/ /dbang lung gdams pa ci thob bya/ /de la chags nas mi 'dug cing / /dam tshig chags par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig mi gtsang dam sel can/ /de 'drar dbang lung thob gyur kyang //lung yig gra ru mi 'bri zhing //nyams len mi bya spel mi bya gter ston yin/mchan//de skad bdud 'dul rdo rjes gsungs//bya rgyud don yod zhags pa sogs/ /dbang bskur thob par ma gyur kyang / /gso sbyong len zhing dkar phyogs bsrung / /gzungs bzla rung zhes sa paṇa gsungs/ /de min gsang sngags sgrub thabs kun/ /dbang ma thob na mi rung ste/ /dbang chu'am dbang gi chu bo zhes/ /dbang rgyun ma chad pa zhig dgos/ /dbang rgyun chad na bdag 'jug sogs//blangs kyang mi phan gnod pa che//dbang rdzogs lung rdzogs rab yin te//dbang rdzogs 'don cha'i lung tsam 'bring / /tha ma lung ni ma thob kyang / /mngon rtogs dang ni sngags gnyis po/ /dbang gi zhar la thob pas 'thus/ /de yi rgyud dang rgya bzhung dang //sgrub thabs las tshogs dpag med dang //mdo sngags khrid rim gdams pa'i tshogs/ /rang nyid shin tu de la mos/ /lung rgyun thob pa'i khungs med pa/ /dpe cha bltas tsam de don shes/ /don med lag tu 'khyar byung tshe/ /maṇḍal 'bul zhing spyi bor bzhag /chos bdag mkha' 'gros gtad par mos/ /o rgyan la sogs smon lam las/ /las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog /gsungs phyir las can skyes bu la/ /mkha' 'gros chos de gtad pa yi/ /dngos bstan gter ston rnams yin kyang //shugs bstan de dang cha 'dra tsam//rang gi 305

yi dam sgrub skor sogs//med thabs med pa rnyed med ni//lag tu phyin cing phan thogs pa/ /mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa ru/ /brtsi bar dri med kun dgas gsungs//'on kyang gzhan la spel thabs med//bka' rgyud chos skor yin na ni//yab sras la sogs zhabs rjes bkram//yang na thub pa'i zhabs rjes ni//par ma rnyed na mchog yin te/ /phyag zhabs rjes bkram mchod pa bshams/ /chos de'i mnga' bdag bla ma de/ /zhabs rjes de nyid yin par bsgom//spyan 'dren mchod bstod maṇḍal 'bul/ /mngon sum bzhugs pa'i nges shes skyed/ /lung de gnang bar gsol pa gdab//de nas lung de gnang bar bsgom//bdag gis nyan pa'i mos pa yis/ /rang gis tshar gcig 'don par bya/ /bla ma'i zhal nas yig 'bru rnams/ /byon nas rang la thim par bsgom/ /glegs bam rang gi spyi bor bzhag /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang //tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ces dang //rten 'brel snyir po tshar gsum brjod/ /zhabs rjes gsang spyod ma zhes pa/ /mnyam med dwags pos mdzad pa dang //mi bskyod zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i don//rang gi nyams len kun la ni/ /de yis chog par gnyis gas gsungs/ /dwags pos gzhan la spel chog gsungs//mi bskyod zhabs kyis zhabs rjes de//bla mar dngos su byon na chog/de min spel du mi btub gsungs/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i/ /bya rog chen po'i rgyud las ni//bla mar thob dang khyad med gsungs//o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa yi//dgongs 'dus po ti'i lung dbang ni//rang gis blang ba'i cho ga'i don//306

gsar rnying mdo rgyud gang 'dod kyi//glegs bam khri steng g.yas su bzhag/g.yon du 'bru yi 'dab brgyad steng / /'dzom na thub dbang gser sku bshams/ /dge 'dun bzhi sde 'dzom na rab/ /med na yid kyis bsgom gsungs pas/ /don la gnas chog rgyas pa'am/ /sa gzhi byin rlabs rgyas par 'don/ /thub par lung gnang gsol ba gdab/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni snyan pa yis/ /lung de yongs rdzogs gnang bar bsam//tshar gcig 'don sogs mi dgos so//glegs bam spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzung / /rten 'brel snying po tshar gsum brjod/ /de tshe thub pa'i zhal nas ni/ /glegs bam de yi yig 'bru rnams/ /dkar po sil sil char ltar bab/ /tshangs bug nas zhugs rang thim bsgom/ /maṇḍal bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ /de nas dmigs med ngang la bzhag /rjes ni bsngo ba smon lam dang / /sprang por sbyin gtong la sogs pa/ /ci 'byor bsod nams tshogs gsog bya//de yi mdo rgyud sgrub thabs sogs/ /thub pa nyid las thob dang mnyam/ /rang la nyams myong legs skyes nas//gzhan la'ang lung rgyun spel chog gsungs//rtsom pa la sogs byed dus su/ /ban bon mdo rgyud gsar rnying sogs/ /kun gyi lung 'dren 'dri dgos pas//brtsams de'i lung rgyun spel dus su//sngon la 'di ltar bya ba gces/ /brgyud pa mi gtsang dam sel can/ /phal gyi lung rgyun do zla min/ /thub pa'i bka' dang o rgyan gsungs//de la the tshom ga la yod//bung ba lta bu'i spyod pa 'di//rngog lo blo ldan shes rab dang //mkhas pa mang po'i rnam thar yin//jo bo dpal ldan a ti shas/ /nyid kyi yon tan brgya stong gi /cha shas tsam yang med pa yi//bla ma mang po bsten zhes gsungs//grub thob thang stong rgyal po yis//yugs sa ya po yan chad kyi//bla ma lnga brgya bco lnga bsten//de bzhi na rang gi chos 307

'brel gyi/ /bla ma che phra thams cad la/ /skyon la mi lta yon tan len/ /bung bas sbrang rtsi 'jib pa ltar/ /rang nyid dbang lung gdams pas phyug/bung bas sbrang rtsi bsags pa 'dra/ /brgyud pa'i gang zag zhan na yang / /chos la sgrib par mi 'gyur te//chu ni zhing la theb pa na//yur ba gtsang btsog bzang ngan med//de ni bod kyi paṇḍi ta/ /blo ldan shes rab bzhed pa yin/ /'brom dang rgya ras mi bskyod zhabs/ /de dag la sogs bzhed pa la/ /'jig rten ka cha nyo na yang / /brtag gzhig legs par byed dgos na/ /skye ba gtan gyi 'dun ma ste/ /chos brgyud bla ma'i bzang ngan sogs//legs par ma brtag zhu mi rung //kun la chos 'brel zhu ba de//dam tshig nyams pa rin gyis nyos//brgyud pa thag rul bring rul mthud//gdams ngag sprang po'i rtsam pa 'dra//pha mang bu ltar rigs 'tshol ba'i//brgyud pa gang gi'ang rkang mi zin//bla ma 'chug med gcig btsal nas//de yi gdams pa nyams blangs pas//bka' rgyud rgyal sa zin nas kyang //bstan la phan pa yin no gsungs/ /de dag gnyis ga'i don bsdus pa/ /rgyal ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis//rgya gar lugs dang rgya nag lugs//paṇa chen lugs dang grub thob lugs//mang po shes ni dgos rgyur 'dug /nyams su len bya de tsho la/ /bya byed mang po byas pa na/ /chos dang bla ma gzhan gyis bsgyur/ /sgar dang chos sde nges med du/ /rlung 'tshub mang po'i dpal 'byor can/ /'byung bar dogs pa kho bos sems/ /gsungs phyir mang po thob na yang / /nyams su len bya'i snying po de/ /brgyud pa gtsang ba'i chos shig dgos/ /bla ma slob dpon mang bsten yang / /gsol ba 'debs yul bla ma de/ /mos blos yar gzhal mi dgos pa'i//sangs rgyas dngos su thag chod pa/ /rgyal ba yab sras lta bur bya/ /ma mjal chos 'brel ma thob 308

kyang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma bzung byas nas/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa na/ /byin rlabs nyams rtogs skye ba yi//zhal bzhes dwags po lha rje dang //dus mkhyen rgod tshang pa rnams kyis//zhal chems bzhag pa yin par bzhed//gnad de go ba gal che'o/ /khyim pa lta bu'i spyod pa ni/ /bsam blo 'phrod nas ma shi'i bar/ /zas nor bsag phyir 'bad pa yin//de bzhin chos sgor zhugs phyin nas//ma shi bar gyi bya ba rnams/ /tshogs gnyis bsag phyir 'bad pa yin/ /de bzhin 'jig rten khyim pa yis/ /dom btang rgya 'gro dbus skor sogs/ /khe ni gang che byed pa yin/ /de bzhin chos sgor bzhugs pa rnams/ /dge ba 'gyur ni gang che byed/ /gang zag 'gyur dang gnas kyi 'gyur/ /dus kyi 'gyur dang rnam gsum las/ /dus 'gyur bde phyir kun gyis byed/ /mdo sde 'jig rten bstan bzhag las//yar ngo'i tshes brgyad mar ngo'i brgyad/ /nyer gsum/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi'i g.yog rnams kyis/ /'dzam gling thams cad khyab par nyul/ /dge sdig gang byas yi ger bris/ /brgya byin lha yi dbang por gtad//dge ba mang na lha rnams dga'//sdig byed mang na lha rnams sdug /yi ge gshin rje'i yul du bskur/ /gshin rje'i yig chung de yin gsungs/ /de bzhin yar mar bcu bzhi la/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi'i bu rnams nyul/ /de bzhin yar mar bco lnga la//rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang //lha dbang brgya byin bcas pas nyul/ /dus tshod de dag rnams la ni/ /dge sdig gang byas 'bum 'gyur yin/ /de bzhin tshes brgyad sman bla 'byon/ /sgrol dkar dang ni tshe ring ma/ /ku ru kulle zhing skyong dus/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ /pad 'byung phag khros bde mchog dang / /ma ning dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun/ /khyad par nyi shar o rgyan 'byon/ /bco lnga 'od dpag med pa'i dus//dgu gsum lha 'dre thams cad 309

rgyu/ /bcu dgur mkha' spyod dbang po gshegs/ /yar yar gyi tshes dgu dang bcu gcig mar gyi nyer drug dang nyer bzhi'o//mar dgu dang bcu gcig dus//dpal ldan lha mo dpon g.yog rgyu/ /nyi shu brgyad la mi bskyod zhabs/ /dbang phyug rdo rje chos dbang phyug /gshegs phyir nyi shu brgyad mchod zer/ /de nyin gshin rje'i rigs kun rgyu/ /bla ma'i dus mchod bzung ba ni/ /bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /mgon po'i rgyud sogs mang por bshad/ /gnam gang bcom ldan shākya thub/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong bcas 'byon/ /de ltar nya mtshams brgyad gsum la/ /ston pa rnam gsum 'byon pa'i tshe/ /dge ba 'bum 'gyur yod pa'i tshul/ /jo bo rje dang srong btsan gsungs//nyi shu dgu dang gnam gang la//mgon po'i rigs kun rgyu ba ste/ /lo gcig sgrub pa byas pa bas/ /rgyu dus mchod pa gcig dga' bar//grub chen mtsho skyes rdo rje dang //o rgyan la sogs gsungs pa yin//de ni zla ba'i dus yin la//mchu yi zla ba'i tshes gcig nas//bco lnga'i bar du shāka thub kyi//mu stegs btul zhing cho 'phrul bstan//sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga la//lhums zhugs rab byung mngon sangs rgyas//rnam gsum 'dzom pa'i dus zhes bya//chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus//tha skar zla ba'i bco lnga la//lha babs zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus//nyer gnyis lha babs dngos kyi dus/ /de gnyis gcig tu brtsi ba yin/ /ston pa'i dus chen bzhi zhes grags/ /dge ba bye ba brgya 'gyur du//mdo sde mang po zhal mthun no//'di dag zla ba ngos 'dzin la/ /rgya bod kun tu mi mthun mang / /o rgyan dgongs 'dus skar mdzod las/ /zhal ni gang 'cham bstun gsungs ltar/ /kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī/ /mdo rgyud mang po gung bstun nas//zla ba ngos 'dzin bstan bcos mdzad//de phyin rgya 310

bod thams cad kyi/ /zla ba 'di bzhi thag chod yin/ /gtor ma tshar gcig btang na yang / /gtor ma bye ba brgya ru nges/ /de 'dra ci yi phyir zhe na/ /ston pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /khyad par sngags kyi bzlas brjod la/ /nyi zla gza' yis bzung nas kyang / /sos yag ma red bar de la/ /zla ba bye ba brgya 'gyur te/ /nyi ma bye ba 'bum 'gyur yin/ /de ni mdo rgyud mang po mthun/ /de phyir dbang ni thob tshad kyi/ /lha ni skad cig dran rdzogs bsgom/ /sngags ni phreng skor re bzlas pas/ /de dag kun gyi bsnyen pa them/ /dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs/ /so so'i las tshogs bya rung ba/ /mkhas pa thams cad zhal mthun phyir/ /dge bshes gsar pa kun gyis mdzad/ /de dag bsod nams zhing sa bzang / /dge ba'i sa bon thob cig ces/ /bka' gdams pa kun zhal gdams yin/ /de nas zhag gi dus tshod la//tho rangs mngon par sangs rgyas dus/ /rlung bzung tshe sgrub bya bar bzang / /nams langs nas ni nyi dros bar/ /zhi ba'i bzlas pa gang byas 'grub/ /nyi dros nas ni nyin phyed par/ /rgyas pa'i bzlas pa gang byas 'grub/ /phyed yol nas ni nyi nub bar/ /dbang gi bzlas pa gang byas 'grub//nyi ma mdung gang tsam nas bzung / /nyi ma nub yag ma red bar/ /gza' dang bzlog pa thams cad 'grub/ /mun rug nas ni nam phyed bar/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun 'du bas/ /gtor bsngos tshogs 'khor la sogs bzang / /drag po'i sngags kyang gang bzlas 'grub/ /khyad par srod kyi dus de nyid/ /thub pas bdud btul dus yin pas/ /bdud kyi bar chad rtsom dus yin/ /yi dam khro bo'i bzlas pa bya/ /nam phyed nas bzung tho rangs phyed/ /gnyid kyi 'od gsal bzung dus yin/ /dus tshod de dang de rnams su/ /so so'i bzlas pa byed pa mchog /ri dwags smas ma'i spyod pa ni/ /ri 311

dwags grwa ru mi sdod par/ /dben par gab nas 'dug pa ltar/ /mtshams dang sgrub pa byed pa'i dus/ /rang nyid gcig pur 'dug pa'am/ /mtshams g.yog la sogs yod gyur kyang //mi gtugs lus ni sbas te 'dug/spyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa yang //cha mthun zhar la 'byung ba ste//nye du la sogs ngo chen gyis//'bod mi la sogs byung na yang / /ngo mi bsrung bar smyon pa bzhin/ /khyi phag lta bu'i spyod pa yang / /cha mthun tsam zhig zhar la 'byung / /dri chu thig le la sogs pa/ /btsog pa'i 'du shes mi byed par/ /khrus dang btung sogs dgos dus bya/ /the bya tshang zhugs spyod pa yang / /de yi zhar la 'byung ba ste/ /dbang lung gdams ngag khrid rim sogs/ /sngar nas legs par rtsad bcad pas/ /de dus the tshom som nyi med/ /nyams len nyid la 'jug pa yin/ /spyir ni spyod pa 'di dag la/ /ming gcig don ni mi gcig pa'i/ /bshad tshul rnam grangs mang na yang / /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / /tshangs spyod ces bya don gcig ste/ /dwags po bka' brgyud phal cher gyis//spyod pa de nyid kho na yis//sa lam thams cad bgrod par byed/ /de yi spyod pa gang zhe na/ /lus kyi cha lugs spyod pa rnams/ /'dul khrims bzhin du dngas tshugs bzung / /de yang dam klod ran byas te/ /chos kyi dbang phyug zhal snga nas/ /dper na stag mos bu khur ba/ /dam na mche bas bu 'chi la/ /klod na bu ni sa la 'brul/ /dam klod ran par khur ba ltar/ /gung tshigs cung tsam phyi ba dang / /chab len rung chu brjed sogs la/ /srog chad tsam du skrag pa ni//dam drag rnam par rtog pas bcings//dgong za chang ni bag med btung //chab ril chu dang lo mang bral/ /yod kyang chos gos lhung bzed bskyur/ /dge bsnyen dang ni dge slong gnyis dge tshul sogs mchan/ rgyus yod min par 'byed 312

dka' bas//de 'dra ha cang lhod pa'i skyon/ /rgyun du gdan gcig byung na rab//na 'am yang na tshogs 'khor nyid/ /min par dgong ni bza' mi bya/ /tshogs sha min pa'i sha mi bza'//bsngos sha gtan nas spang bar bya//chang ni dug ltar spang bar bya/ /tshogs chang dam tshig mi 'gal phyir/ /thur 'gyed dam ni sor rtses blangs//mang yang bha rnya 'bring tshad gang //de bas mang ba mi rung ba//bde mchog sdom 'byung rgyud na gsal//tshogs shartsa rlung 'khrul 'khor sbyong dus sogs la lus gso ba'i phyir mchan/ bza' bar rung ba ste//khams dang thig le rgyas phyir ro//de yang bsngos sha yin na spang / /bsngos sha yin kyang tshogs sha la/ /bsngos na dud 'gro der phan pa/ /'ja' tshon snying bo'i gsungs las gsal/ /'dul khrims phra zhib thams cad kyang / /ci ltar nus pa bsrung bya ste/ /ma thub bam ni ma shes pas/ /ltung ba nyes byas mang sogs pa/ /zla ba phyed phyed gso sbyong dus/ /dge 'dun sde ni med pa'i phyir//gso sbyong dngos ni mi 'ong yang //gso sbyong byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ /yang na zhi gnas gso sbyong bya/ /med na ma gtogs gung tshigs kyang / /lhung bzed nang du bza' bya ste//phud mchog chang bu la sogs kyang //gzhung ltar rgyun du ma brjed bya/ /bag yod dran shes skye ba'i phyir/ /chos gos rnam gsum chu tshags bcangs/ /dus bzang skabs su byang sdom len/ /las dang bya ba gang byed kyang / /sems bskyed bzang po'i kun slong gzab//'gro ba sems can kun don du//bla med byang chub bsgrub pa las//don gyi gtso bo gzhan med bya//nyams len bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ste//gtso bor ngo bo skyong bar bya//rgyal ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis/ /phyi ltar so thar dge slong //nang ltar byang chub sems dpa'//gsang ba sngags kyi rnam 'byor/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa/ /bsam zhing dga'o skyid do/ / 313

gsungs pa'ang de yi don la dgongs/ /spyod pa de ni mtshams sgrub dang / /grong dang dgon pa gar 'dug kyang / /thang lhod med par mthar phyin bya/ /de ni ha cang dka' ba'ang min/ /dka' zhing mthar mi thon pa yi/ /dam bca' brtsams pa'ang nyams pa'i rgyu/ /de ka tsam yang mi thub snyam/ /zer nas gnas pa'ang nyams pa'i rgyud/ /de las gzhan pa'i spyod pa rnams/ /skabs su babs na bogs che ste/ /khrigs su ma 'phrod gegs su che//spyod pa gzhan rnams ma byas kyang //kun bzang spyod pa gcig pu des/ /sa lam thams cad bgrod par gsungs/ /dwags rgyud rnams kyi gshegs shul lam/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan pa dang / /rang nyid chos mgo mthar thon cing / /rang la yon tan gang yod kyi/ /'gro don rgya chen 'byung ba dang / /sbyin bdag rnams kyang dang ba 'dren/ /rgyun du spyod pa de rang bya/ /nya tshes bco lnga mtshams gnam gang brgyad tshes brgyad gsum nyi shu gsum 'dir mar ngo'i tshes brgyad yin gsungs//tshes bcu dang nyer dgu dgu gnyis nyi shu brgyad//de dag rnams su dus mchod gzab/ /gtor ma chags med gtong thon rab/ /mi 'grub nya tshes bco lnga mtshams gnam gang brgyad gsum tshes brgyad gtong / /de ni dzam lha'i dam tshig yin/ /su rū ba yi gtor ma dang / /brgya rtsa shin tu bsdus pa gnyis/ /nang snga rtsa stong chags med bya/ /nub mo gsur gyi mchod pa dang / /lus sbyin rgyas pa'am ma lcog na/ /ku sa li yi tshogs gsog bya/ /rtsa ba'i yi dam bdag bskyed dang / /bsnyen pa gtor bsngos ma chags pas/ /gsar ma'i bskyed rim nyams len dang / /rnying ma'i ma hā yo ga yi/ /nyams len don rtsa 'dus pa yin/ /'grub sbyor la sogs bzang po'i dus//chos skyong bskang gsol rgyas pa dang / /zhi rgyas dbang gi sbyin sreg bya/ /des ni bskyed rim bogs 'don 'ong / /rgyun du yi 314

dam lus dkyil bsgom/ /bza' btung nang gi sbyin sreg bya/ /dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug gnas dang gsum//'thu gsum rdo rje'i bzlas par dmigs/ /khom na rlung bzung 'khrul 'khor bya/ /ma khom lus kyi 'gul spyod kun/ /'khrul 'khor gar dang phyag rgyar dmigs/ /de yis gsar ma'i lus dkyil dang //rnying ma'i a nu yo ga tshang / /rab kyi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gam/ /med kyang ngo bo skyong bar brtson/ /dran rdzis yang yang gsal 'debs bya//phyag chen khrigs chod nyams len tshang / /zer gnyis thod rgal bltas pa yis/ /a ti theg dgu'i yang rtse tshang /de nyin dge sbyor gang byas rnams/ /do dgong bsngo smon rgya yis gdab/ /de yis dge ba mi nyams 'phel/ /de ltar spyod pa'i rnam dbye 'di/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bskul byas nas/ /gzhung gi bshad pa ma byas par/ /rang gi nyams su blangs tshod tsam/ /rang 'dra dman pa gzhan la yang / /phan par 'gyur ram bsams pa des/ /shing sbrul mgo zla'i bco brgyad dang / /bcu dgu'i dgong mo thun skabs gnyis/ /rā ga a sus smras pa rnams/ /gu ru bī ryas yi ger bris/ /lta spyod mthon po'i gang zag gis/ /gzigs na snying rje'i gnas su mdzod/ /tha snyad mkhas pa'i gang zag gis/ /gzigs na bzhad gad gnas su mdzod/ /bdag 'dra blo dman gang zag gis/ /gzigs na nyams su blangs par mdzod/ /shin tu dman pa'i gang zag ni/ /mang po 'ga' la phan par shog /le'u so dgu pa'o maṅga lam̐// 315

'gro don gdams pa phrin las rgya mtsho/slo'iri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las//'gro don phrin las rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra ye/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ 'gro don 'di la lugs gnyis yod/ /shāka thub bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis/ /lung gi bstan pa bshad pas 'dzin//shes rab brtson 'grus ldan pa'i mis//dge bshes mkhas pa mang po bsten/ /rig gnas kun la ma rmongs shing / /sgra dang tshad ma mngon pa dang / /dbu phar 'dul ba'i gzhung rnams la/ /bgro gleng rtsod pa'i rigs pa byang / /'bru sbyor 'phros len bshad pa mkhas/ /nyams dang rtogs pa med na yang / /dang po chos sgor zhugs pa nas/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas bar/ /sa lam bshad pa zhib rgyas shes/ /bka' bcu rab 'byams mkhas ming thogs/ /slob ma la yang de ltar bslab//slob ma dge bshes mang po thon//grwa sa chen po'i chos lugs yin/ /de don mi la ras chen gyis/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams na//chos sgom pa mi brin bshad pa brin//gsung ltar de 'drar rtsis che'o/ /tshe 'dir nyams rtogs 'dod pa med/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma bsrung ba'i 'bras/ /skye ba kun tu mi lus thob/ /bag chags bzang bas mkhas pa 'byung / /de 'dra'i skye ba grangs med gsum/ /de nas stong nyid rtogs par 'dod/ /de dang cha mthun dbang lung rnams/ /rgya chen 'thob cing de don shes/ /nyams dang rtogs pa ma skyes kyang / /dbang rgyun lung rgyun gzhan la spel//dper 316

na 'on pas dung bus bzhin/ /de don rang gis ma rtogs kyang / /las 'phro can la phan pa srid//de tsho lung gi bstan pa ste//deng sang shāka thub bstan pa mang //rtogs pa'i bstan pa yol nas ni/ /lung gi bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /de phyir bshad rgyun lung rgyun tsam/ /spel thub lung gi bstan 'dzin yin/ /slob mar nyams rtogs mi skye yang / /shes rab ldan na lung rgyun 'phel/ /rmongs pas thos pa'i bsod nams thob/ /dus la dpag pa'i 'gro don yin/ /rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pas 'dzin/ /dwags brgyud pa dang rnying ma gnyis/ /gtso cher sgrub rgyud bstan pa yin//sgrub rgyud 'gro don lugs la ni//rtse gcig mtho dman rtogs pa des/ /gzhan la khrid sogs 'chad pa na/ /gzhan la mi phan rang la gnod/ /de phyir sgrub la brten dus yin/ /spros bral mtho dman nyams rtogs kyis/ /zhib rgyas nan gyis bshad na phan/ /'on kyang rang la cung zhig gnod/ /ro gcig rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor des/ /'gro don dus la babs pa'i phyir/ /ma 'bad longs spyod char ltar 'bebs/ /ci smras gzhan gyis gus shing nyan/ /gzhan rgyud byin gyis brlab nus phyir//nyams dang rtogs pa bskyed par nus//rang gis de ltar ma rtogs na/ /skol phor ri mo swā tstsha'i dpe/ /khrid kyang lung rgyun tsam du 'gyur/ /sgom med rtogs pa'i gang zag gis/ /ha cang bshad kyang mi dgos te/ /zhal mjal phyag dbang thob tsam mam/ /ma mjal dad pas gsol btab kyang //nyams dang rtogs pa bskyed nus par/ /bka' rgyud rnams kyis bzhed pa yin/ /de dag gnyis kur gal che ba/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs de ni/ /rgyas pa'am ni bsdus pa'ang rung //ma nor ba zhig bshad shes dgos//mi shes bzhin du bshad pa ni/ /khams gsum sems can bsad pa pas/ /gti mug can gyi chos bshad 317

pa/ /nyes pa che bar thub pas gsungs/ /shes shing zang zing 'dod phyir min/ /gzhan la snying rjes chos sbyin pa/ /stong gsum rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /bkang nas sangs rgyas mchod pa bas//dam chos tshigs bcad gcig bshad pa//bsod nams che bar thub pas gsungs//zang zing 'dod pa med bzhin du/ /slob mas dad pas phul pa ni//tshig gcig bshad pa'i yon la ni//gser ni rang lus tsam phul yang / /de yis drin lan mi 'khor phyir/ /rang la dkor sgrib 'byung dogs med//slob ma'ang bsod nams tshogs rdzogs te/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun mchod pas/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod lhag /skye ba der yang longs spyod ldan/ /mthar ni sangs rgyas rgyu ru 'gyur/ /zas nor longs spyod don gnyer nas/ /dbang lung gdams ngag spel ba ni/ /dam chos btsongs nas zos pa'i phyir/ /bshas khe tshwa khe byas las long / /de gnyis byed lugs 'dra na yang / /bsam pa'i khyad kyis dbye ba yin//bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi//byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /'gro don byed pa'i sgo bzhi yin/ /de don rgyal ba 'brom ston gyis/ /jo bo rje la bstod pa las/ /mkho ba sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /'jig rten don mthun gdul bya'i don spyod pa/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi dpal 'byor gyis/ /gzhan don lhur mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs don de zhib bshad na/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su yang / /chos dang 'jig rten rgyab 'gal yang / /'gro don byed pa'i dus su ni/ /bsam pa'i khyad par ma gtogs pa/ /chos dang 'jig rten zung 'jug yin/ /yon bdag grwa ris su la yang / /zas nor chung ngu byin byas nas/ /de len chen po 'dod pa ni/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /'grim 'grul bkres shing skom pa la/ /'phral du gang 'byor zas skom 318

sbyin/ /thag ring nas 'ong 'grim 'grul la/ /lam chas 'khyol bar bskur ba dang / /gnang sbyin 'os pa'i yon bdag la/ /gnang sbyin phyag mdud la sogs pa/ /chos dang gdams ngag 'dod drags par/ /snag smyug shog gu sbyin pa dang / /chos rgyags chad nas chos shol phyir/ /rgyags mthud chos de tshang thabs dang / /slob ma gzhan don nus pa la/ /gang 'os dpe dang mchod cha sbyin/ /de la bzang lan bkur sti sogs/ /chen po i 'ong (yong ngam)re ba spangs//de ni mkho ba sbyin pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /byed lugs gong dang khyad med kyang / /bsam pa'i khyad kyis dge sdig gnyis/ /phyogs nas 'ong la phyags phebs dang / /'gro kha thugs dam gong 'phel sogs/ /mya ngan can la sems gso dang //grub mtha' log chos spyod pa la'ang / /gshe skur mi bya yon tan brjod/ /mi nyan dgos pa'i kha ta la/ /tshig ngan mi brjod dal bus smra/ /thabs kyis legs pa'i phyogs su khrid/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /snyan par smra ba'i 'gro don sgo/ /za sdug khog skyid zer ba'i dpe/ /log par spyod la bstod ra dang / /khas bstod zhe yis khrel ba dang / /kha 'jam khog rtsub so dkar ston/ /blo ngan de 'dra ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /de gnyis byed lugs mtshungs na yang / /don la mi mtshungs bsam pa'i khyad/ /rang la rtsi zhing khas nyan na/ /'thab rtsod 'khrugs pa bzlums pa dang / /yon bdag rnams kyi rkyen sel thabs/ /re ba gang bcas bskang ba dang / /chos kyi phyogs su khrid thub na/ /rus dbon snag dbon sogs kyang bskor/ /nye du yon bdag la sogs kyang / /sems la chags zhen med na yang / /'jig rten pa dang mthun par skyongs/ /de ni 'jig rten don mthun zhes/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'gro don sgo/ /rus dbon snag dbon nye du sogs/ /chos la 319

sbyor bar mi nus kyang / /chags zhen dbang gi dkor gyis gso/ /phyi ma rnga mo'i lus len par//srong btsan sgam pos gsungs pa yin//gnyen dang gra ris skyong ba dang / /chags zhen pho rus bsams pa yis/ /bskyangs na ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru nges//rim gyis chos phyogs dkri ba'i phyir//yin na de 'ang 'gro don nyid//yon dang lha rten 'dod pa'i phyir / /bzlog pa sbyin sreg dbang bskur dang / /cho ga phyir ldog byang bu dang //dbang lung khrid sogs gang byas pa//tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyis sgrib//byang chub thob pa'i gegs su che//'gro kun pha mar shes byas te//lhag par rang la re bcas pa/ /yon bdag tshe 'di'i rkyen sel dang / /yon tan mkhan la yon tan slob/ /de ni tshe 'dir phan pa ste/ /yon bdag dbang bskur byang bu dang / /yon tan mkhas la bsnyen sgrub slob/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i ngo sprod sogs/ /de ni phyi mar bde thob thabs/ /'gro ba phan bde la 'god pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don rtsa yin//de gnyis byed tshul khyad med kyang //bsam pa'i khyad kyis tha dad pa//byang chub sems dpa'i 'gro don sgo//gdul bya'i don spyod ces bya dang / /lto phyir gnam sdib grong chog gnyis/ /'dra 'dra 'dra ste nor dogs che/ /ma nor rang gi sems kyis shes/ /grwa ba gzugs mdzes gos bzang ba//'don pa 'grig pa mang bo zhig/'dzom na bla chen shugs kyis 'ong / /gang du phyin yang gdul bya 'du//bsams nas mi gzhon mang po bskor/ /'don pa'i kha khral chos yin bsam/ /sems rgyud dul zhing nyams rtogs can/ /nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du dkon//bsgom bya'i gtso bo khe dang tshong //chags sdang 'dod chags me ltar 'bar/ /gson po'i rim gro gshin po'i chos/ /khar ma de yis chog par sems//dkor la rngam che chog shes med//sdom pa dam tshig thams cad ni//bla ma 320

chos khrims pa sogs kyis/ /ma thos na ni des chog sems/ /pho khrom khrom 'dus 'tshogs pa yin//'tshogs pa bzang ngan 'bring gsum yang //dge 'dun dngos kyi dag snang gi /ngur smrig chos gos sham thabs sogs/ /skye ba stong phrag mang po la/ /lan re tsam yang gyon par dka'/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i tshe na yang / /ngur smrig gos rnams thams cad kun/ /lha yis khyer nas lha yul du//mchod rten byas nas mchod par gsungs/ /thams cad gra mnyam dka' na yang / /grwa mang nang nas 'ga' zung tsam/ /bstan la phan pa'i dge bshes dang / /nyams rtogs yod pa'i rtogs ldan dang //bsnyen sgrub them pa'i sngags 'chang dang / /sdom pa mthar phyin dge slong ni/ /re re byung yang rin thang che/ /sngon gyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams/ dkor rdzas dngos po gang byung ba/ /grwa mang zhal du thong mdzod dang / /dge 'dun sde 'phel bstan la phan/ /zhes pa 'das khar zhal chems bzhag /dkor phud byed lugs mang na yang //chos mthun grwa ris skor ba na//bstan dang sems can gnyis por phan/ /'brug pa ngag dbang bzang po dang //kurma bstan 'phel rgya ra ba/ /de sogs bla ma mang po 'gas/ /lha bri rten bzhengs la sogs pa'i/ /dkor phud ci yang ma mdzad kyang / /dkor gyis grwa ris skyong pa des/ /bstan pas mdo khams shar phyogs khyab/ /dwags po phag gru la sogs pa'i/ /bka' rgyud pha rgan de rnams kyang //de ltar mdzad pas bstan pa 'phel//de don mdo sde pad dkar las/ /dge slong 'tsho mdzad lung bstan skabs/ /dag pa'i slob ma lnga brgya dang / /ma dag slob ma lnga brgya sogs/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad la/ /dge 'dun dngos kyi 'du shes kyis/ /bsnyen bkur zhabs tog phun tshogs shing / /bla med byang chub phyir bsngos pas/ /sku de mya ngan 'das ma 321

thag /bde ba can du skye 'gyur zhing / /bla med byang chub lung yang bstan/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyi phyag len yang / /'di la go rgyu chen po yod/ /zhe 'dod chos brgyad 'khor sdud dang / /bstan don dge 'dun sde btsugs gnyis/ /'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs yod/ /ma nor bsam pa'i khyer so gzobs/ /de bzhin rta drel nor phyugs sogs/ /chags zhen dbang gis brang nga yang / /dgra 'dre'i g.yab mo ngan song rgyu/ /'brog pa rnams dang khyad par med/ /sgrub mchod dus mchod dgu gtor dang / /nyams len sgrub pa'i mtshams rgyags dang / /grwa tshogs dge 'dun sde skyong phyir//ci ltar mang yang skyon med de//grub chen kurma pakṣu de//rgya nag yul du 'byon kha dus/ /mtshur phu'i brang nga thams cad ni/ /gcig kyang med par gtong dgongs tshe//rang byung rgyal mo dngos su byon//da rung (da dung /)khyod kyi tshe 'di la/ /bya ba mang po byed dgos yod/ /brang nga gcig kyang ma gtong gsungs/ /nor kun she btang bzhag ces bshad/ /phyis dus mtshur phu'i lha chen dang / /rigs lnga spyan ras gzigs sogs bzhengs/ /de bzhin dkon mchog mchod pa dang //dge 'dun skyong phyir brang nga dang / /ser snas sdug btsir byed pa gnyis/ /byed lugs 'dra yang bsam pa'i khyad/ /de don 'dul ba'i gzhung las kyang / /dge tshul dang ni dge slong gi//gser dngul len pa mi rung ste//gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun don/ /gser dngul srang chen brgya stong yang / /nya ra rung(nyal tshag) bar gsungs pa'o//de bzhin 'bul ba gdul bya sogs//dpag tu med pa byung na yang / /rang gi phus sris mnog don du/ /bsams nas blangs na dkor grib che/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun skyong / /spyi yi don du dmigs bya yi/ /rang gis sger nor bcangs bzung du/ /lus gang gos dang phor pa tsam de 322

las ci yang med pa gces/ /de ni 'dul ba'i don dang mthun/ /dkor sgrib shin tu chung ba yin/ /byang chub sems bskyed ldan rnams kyi/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yi 'gro don ni/ /nyams myong lag tu lon tshod tsam/ /glu yi sa rga dang po'o/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rang nyid sgrub pa byed pa'i skabs/ /bskyed rdzogs nges pa cud zang rnyed/ /snying nas dam chos 'dod pa'i mis/ /rang la snying nas re bcas pa/ /de yi re ba ma bskang na/ /sems can blos spangs ltung bar 'gyur/ /ha cang yangs na sgrub bar la/ /rang gi sgrub pa'i bar chad 'ong / /nga rgyal rang mthong dad gus med/ /gdams dag rku thabs brgyud pa gsang //zhus bar thos na ngo mtshar sems//rig pa rno yang dad 'dun med/ /yon tan mi mthong skyon la blta/ /rjes nas gshe skur kun tu sgrog/la la chos 'dod dad ldan yang / /bshad kyang mi go bong bu 'dra/ /la la cal sgrogs rjes su rgyug /'di bsam med par chos zhur 'ong / /tshang bar mi nyan phyir la rgyug de 'dra brgya stong 'tshogs pa bas/ /dad can shes rab brtson 'grus ldan/ /rang la gus shis gang zer nyan/ /rang nyid bla mar 'dzin pa yi/ /slob ma 'ga' zung bsten na yang / /'gro don 'bras bu de che'i phyir/ /bka' rgyud gong ma'i gsungs la ni/ /ra khrid lug khrid ces kyang bya/ /khrom chen bsdu ba ma yin phyir/ /phug sgo chos bshad ces kyang bya/ /maḥ thog rnying ma'i lugs la ni/ /gcig khrid ces bya zab par brtsi/ /de la byed lugs rigs mang ste//shes rab phyurge sum tshogs pa la/ /'phral du sgrub pa byed rgyu yi/ /dbang lung nyi ma gnyis tsam bya/ /dbang zhor ngo sprod btsan thabs gdab/ /sgrub rgyags khang pa sogs 'dzom na/ /nye logs de ru mtshams bsdam nas//lo gsum phyogs gsum dam bca' blangs//323

zhag po drug bdun tsam gyi sor/ /dmigs thun bsgom bya rngul byang bskur/ /lo gsum phyogs gsum mthar thon tshe/ /bsnyen sgrub them dang nyams rtog skyes/ /bla ma 'ong ba dus mnyam 'byung //nye log mtshams bsdam ma 'grig na//nyams len dbang lung nyer mkho sbyin/ /ngo sprod gdams ngag nan gyis btab/ /nyams su len tshul zin bris bskur//rgyun du gegs sel dmigs pa dang / /byin 'bebs dmigs pas byin gyis brlabs//des kyang sgrub them nyams rtogs skye//ma mjal sa thag ring bo nas/ /dad ldan 'bul ba bskur sogs la/ /gsol 'debs ngo sprod yi ge bskur//'gro mgon sangs rgyas dpon po yis//yi ge bskur bas grol ba yi/ /slob ma brgya rtsa yod do skad/ /de tsam rang res 'ong dka' yang / /blo sems chos la 'gyur ba dang / /sems ngo 'phrod dang bogs thon sogs/ /'byung ba myong bas grub pa yin/ /de bzhin bka' bsgo dmigs thun dang / /phyir ldog byang bu bsngo smon sogs/ /mtshams kyi khong nas byed pa rnams/ /rang gzhan gnyis don bsgrub pa yin//rang gi sgrub la mi gnod par//gzhan phan ci nus ma bsgrub na/ /theg pa dman par gol ba yin/ /sems bskyed bsam pa bzang ba na/ /de ka tsam gyi 'gro don yang / /chung rgyu med pas chen por nges/ /thub dbang bya ni shing rta ru/ /bsam zhing skye ba bzhes pa'i dus/ /seng ge'i gre phug rus so zug//zug gzer chen po ldan pa de//snying rje'i dbang gis 'don rogs mdzad//de las 'gro don gzhan med kyang //ngo mtshar skyes rabs grar brtsis na//'ga' zung nad gdon zhi ba dang //'ga' zung bsnyen bsgrub thon pa dang //'ga' zung nyams rtogs skye thub na/ /'gro don legs pa ma lags sam/ /rang gzhan gnyis don bsgrub pa yi/ /glu yi sa rga gnyis pa'o//gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba// 324

gzhan don gtso bor byed pa la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rten 'brel brtag /phyi ltar lo legs yul 'khrugs med/ /nang ltar sgar chas sgrub rdzas 'dzom/ /gsang ba bskyed rdzogs gdeng dang ldan//kun slong byang chub sem sa bskyed nas//phyogs rnams kun tu 'gro ba'i tshe/ /rang nyid rgyal ba rgya mtshor bsgom/ /spyi bor bya khyung rgyal po lding //sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis mnan//chib pa'i gong du 'dug pa'i tshe//chib pa pad zla'i gdan du bsgom//rkang lag mkha' 'gro sde bzhis btegs//'gro ba'i don du 'byon pa'i tshe/ /steng du bka' rgyud bla ma rnams/ /sprin dpung bzhin bzhugs byin gyis brlabs//rgyab tu yi dam lha tshogs rnams//rgyab brten tshul du rjes rjes 'byon//g.yas nas seng chen g.yu ral bsig/g.yon nas stag mo 'dzum drug rgyas//mdun gyi sgar snar glang po che//smyon pa brtul zhugs ldan pa yi/ /sna la mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor/ /sgar gyi sna nas mig mthong sar/ /rdo rje legs pa seng ger chibs/ /steng du khra dang bya nag lding / /stag spyang 'phar ba rol du khrid/ /btsan dmag stong gi 'khor tshogs bcas/ /kun kyang dar mdung dmar po phyar/ /bswo sgra cha sgra sgrog cing song / /lam sgra'i bar chad sel ba dang / /mthun rkyen dgos 'dod sgrub par bsams//rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang gi//spyan gyis gzigs pa'i srog chags kun//sdig sgrib ma lus byang bar bsgom//de nas sgar ni brgyab pa'i tshe//sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje ni//sra shing brtan pa'i lte ba la/ /padma'i sdong bo chen po skyes/ /'dab mas sa phyogs de kun khyab/ /de steng pad ma zla ba'i steng / /rang nyid thugs rje chen po yi/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas ma thag /sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /'ja' gur me tog char pa 'bab/ /phyogs de'i mi dang lha 'dre kun/ /'dus nas phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed/ /gtong len 325

dmigs pa thun gcig bsgom/ /bdag gi 'od zer phog pa las/ /thams cad spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ /yig drug dir dir 'don par bsgom/ /phyag dbang zhu mi byung ba'i tshe/ /sor mo rgyal ba rigs lnga las/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyi/ /'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas/ /dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag par bsgom/ /bza' btung rung ba'i 'bul ba kun/ /oṃ āḥ rgyu gis byin brlabs pas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dmigs/ /mgron rigs bzhi po thams cad ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dang dzam lha dkar/ /lo ma gyon ma'i skur gyur nas/ /bdud rtsi gsol bas mnyes par bsgom/ /so so'i sngags la khā hi btags/ /dkon mchog mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam bskang gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /lan chags bu lon byang gyur cig /rnam bzhi mgron gyi tshogs rnams la//tshad med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas//bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ /longs spyod ldan zhing tshogs rdzogs nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces brjod dmigs med ngang la bzhag/de bzhin 'bru dang rin chen sogs/ /skam chas maṇḍal dmigs la 'bul/ /rta phyugs go mtshon la sogs pa/ /gtor bsngos zhor gyi bskang thung zhor/ /bskang ba'i rdzas su dmigs te 'bul/ /bar chad sel zhing longs spyod 'du/ /dkor sgrib chung ba'i gdams ngag yin/ /de bzhin shi shog gson shog kyang / /bsngo pa'i skabs su dmigs pas bzhu/ /rjes nas rgyas par cho gas bzhu/ /shi gson 'brel pa thogs tshad ces/ /rgyun du'ang bsngo smon ma brjed bya/ /lha dang bla mas bka' rgya yis/ /rab tu bsdams pa'i dbang lung dang / /drag sngags rigs dang ngan sngags rigs/ /rkun nor bzhin du sba bar bya/ /'dod cing dri ba byung ba na/ /mi shes ma thob dpe cha med/ /zer 326

ba'i lan de kho na gdabs/ /'di phyir phan pa'i dbang lung dang / /khrid dang gdams ngag zab mo'i rigs/ /sba sri med pa ston mor 'gyed/ /snod dang ldan nam mi ldan pa/ /brtag dgos mi dgos rtogs pas shes/ /'khor 'das dbyer med don rtogs na/ /snod min dbang bskur chos bshad kyang //de la nyes pa med par gsungs/ /rtogs pa de tsam med na ni/ /snod ma yin dang dam nyams la/ /dbang dang gdams pa zab spel na/ /gsang ba thugs kyi dam tshig nyams/ /tshe 'dir mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad kyi/ /smyo 'bog la sogs mi dge 'byung / /phyi ma dmyal bar ltung bar bshad/ /de phyir sdig can dam nyams sogs/ /phyag rten bzang ba'i ngo byas nas/ /shin tu zab gnyan dbang bzhi dang / /gsang sngags zab gnad bstan mi bya/ /kun la phan zhing spel rung ba/ /skyabs sdom bsnyen gnas sdom pa dang / /smyung gnas ngag bcad sdom pa dang / /zab mo lta ba'i rgyud pa'i lugs/ /byang chub sems bskyed sdom pa dang / /sman bla kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ /tshe dpag lha dgu 'byung 'dul dang / /zhi khro thugs rje chen po sogs/ /bka' rgya yangs shing 'gro don la//gzhung nas bsngags pa'i dbang rnams bskur//cung zhig bka' rgya dogs pa rnams/ /su yin mi btsud nyung dbang bya/ /dbang bskur kun gyi thog mar ni//khrom rnams 'du ba'i rten 'brel du//'gro ba dge la bskul ba'i lha//skul byed ma yi dbang bskur bya//khrom 'tshogs chos khrir 'dug ma thag/bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms pa'i gzungs/ /thar rgyan nang nas 'byung ba ltar/ /skad gsang mthon pos tshar gcig brjod/ /khrom la rims nad mi 'byung phyir/ /de nas lo ma gyon ma bskur / /nyin bzhin sngags thung 'ur 'don bcug /khrom par nad yams mi 'byung ba'i/ /gdams ngag mchog tu gyur ba yin/ /de 327

nas sgrub chen tshugs na rab/ /khrom pa 'tshogs dang 'tshogs rgyu kun/ /rgyal tho srung 'khor nang tshud dmigs/ /yig bdun bo rnyitsitta sogs/ /khrom gyi das 'ur 'don thun rer byas//de yis thun pa'i go chod yin//gzhung bsrang tshar re byed du bcug /rang gi dmigs pas gsal yang btab/ /phyag len mthong ba brgyud pas shes/ /gal te sgrub chen ma tshugs na/ /khrom dbang zhar la spyi chos bshad/ /khrid zhu rnams la nyung chos bshad/ /grol kha tshe dbang bskur ba dang / /bsngo ba bkra shis rgyas par bya/ /de dag rnams kyi bar skabs su/ /'dod chos dbang lung gdams ngag spel/ /tshong dpon lta bu'i 'gro don yin/ /dper na tshong dpon chen po yi/ /mkho dgu'i longs spyod sna tshogs khyer/ /gang la gang dgos yo byad tshang / /rang la ci 'dod longs spyod 'byung / /de bzhin dbang lung phun tshogs pas/ /gang la gang dgos dbang lung spel/ /rang la chos dang longs spyod kyi/ /dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung ba ni/ /tshong dpon lta bu'i 'gro don zhes/ /dgongs 'dus gzhung las gsungs pa yin//tshong dpon lta bu'i 'gro don gyi//glu yi sa rga gsum pa'o/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /mnyan pa lta bu'i 'gro don ni/ /sa 'gag chu bo chen po'i 'gram/ /gnas bcas gru dang skya ba 'tshags/ /'grim 'grul phar kur 'gro 'dod kun/ /gru yis sgrol nas gtong ba ltar//rgas sam lus po mi sra'am/ /sgar bcas grwa slob khal rta med/ /gru dang skya ba 'dra ba yi//dbang lung gdams ngag zab dgu yod//dgon pa'am ni ri khrod kyi//gnas mal zhig tu rtag tu 'dug/'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /thar 'dod dad gus brtson 'grus can//dbang zhu chos zhu su byung la//so so'i 'dod pa bskangs te gtong / /mnyan pa lta bu'i 'gro don du/ /o rgyan chen pos gsungs pa yin/ /328

rgyal bo lta bu'i 'gro don ni/ /'bri stag sa dkar la sogs kyi/ /chen po rnams kyi spyod yul te/ /rang re rnams kyis ga la 'ong / /'on kyang de yi cha mthun tsam/ /rang la chos dang 'jig rten gyi/ /kha thabs ci tsam yod pa'i tshod/ /rang la re zhig ltos pa yi//skya ser skyes pa bud med sogs//tshe 'dir nad gdon zhi thabs dang / /phyi ma ngan song spong ba'i thabs/ /rang gi ji ltar nus pa ltar/ /g.yo sgyu med par byas pas 'thus//rang gi 'byor pa dang dpag nas//bla ma dgon pa la sogs la//dkor phud 'bul ba mang ja dang //klog 'don sā tstsha chu gtor dang //lo dus bskang gso mdos sogs bca'//dbul phongs rnams la ci 'byor sbyin//khyad par cho 'phrul yar ngo la/ /bya byi'u rnams la yos sbyin btang / /chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la/ /rgya grog phung bo mang po gso/ /sangs rgyas stong sku la sogs dang / /yi dam chos skyong sku rnams bzhengs/ /rang gi yi dam chos skyong gi/ /rgyud gzhung gzhung pod ci nus bzhengs/ /grwa pa rab 'bring tha ma rnams/ /ka tshar yan nas dbang bskur man/ /blo tshod dpag pa'i yon tan bslab/ /ja mar sha thud gang byung rnams/ /bum sgrub la sogs bsnyen sgrub 'bad/ /zhag bdun la sogs sngags rgyun bya/ /chu 'khor rlung 'khor jo dar dang / /dung 'khor la sogs dge ba'i tshogs//kun la 'brel pa 'jog pa yin//rgyal bo lta bu'i 'gro don 'di//gu ru'i thugs sgrub gzhung nas gsungs/ /de rnams rlabs chen 'gro don te/ /san de ni bzhi po'o/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /rlabs chen 'gro don ma byung yang / /bskyed rdzogs nyams len yod pa'i mis/ /grong chog byas kyang 'gro don dang / /rtogs pa'i bogs 'don gnyis ka 'ong / /rgyud sde rnams nas gsungs pa yi//spyod pa'i rnam grangs mang po yang //zhar la shugs kyis 'grub pa 329

yin//bogs 'don gcod kyi khrid ces pa//ri gnyan mtsho gnyan la sogs pa'i//gnyan thog zhar la gcod pas chog /snyigs dus rgyun du char chu dkon/ /ljang bu skam zhing mi rnams skrag /bla ma kun kyang char 'bod 'tsher/ /nam mkha' baiḍūrya ltar dwangs/ /than pa dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar/ /mi kun sdug cing gnam la blta/ /gnas chen pa kun khog rgod 'chor/ /dbul bo rnams ni snying rtsa 'dar/ /sprang po rnams kyang yi mug skye/ /'chi nad mu ge yin no bsam/ /'bu srin rnams kyis tsha dmyal myong / /bsam yod kun gyis smre sngags 'don/ /de dus gdams ngag zab pa yi/ /gzhan dang mi 'dra khyad chos gcig/rtags thon bsam pa dran ma rung //'gro ba 'di dag snying rje bas//'bu srin rnams la skyabs kyi sbyin//'gro ba spyi la byams pa'i sbyin/ /dbul phongs rnams la zang zing sbyin/ /klu dang lha 'drer chos kyi sbyin/ /char ba legs po gcig khug na/ /sbyin pa rnams bzhi dus gcig tshang //klu yi dug lnga lha 'dre'i zer//rang nyid shi yang chos phyir yin//nam yang lus 'di skyur dgos na/ /chos phyir shi na don dang ldan/ /de ltar blo thag bcad la 'gro/ /yi dwags lha 'dre phran bu dang / /chu mig tsag rtsig chu pa med/ /nus med lha 'dre brdung na bros/ /chu mig phal cher than pas skam/ /ri gnyan chu mig mang ba'am/ /mtsho gnyan klu bdud gnas sar 'gro/ /sngags lugs char 'bod byed na yang / /thun mtshams gcod dmigs lus sbyin gtong / /sprin tshogs yod pa 'ja' bzhin yal/ /nyi ma sngar las tsha ba 'dra/ /dngos nyams rmi lam cho 'phrul che/ /'ong dran bsam pa'i 'gyod pa 'chor/ /de tshe de yi ngo bor blta//bogs 'don mgo bo de nas btsugs//shing gnyan bcad dang brag gnyan bshig /mtsho dkrug chu mig slog la sogs/ /rbab gtong la sogs rtsings spyod 330

dang / /dmigs pas drag tu gzir ba'i tshe/ /sprin nag g.yag khyu 'grogs pa 'dra/ /sa 'brug ldir zhing sa gzhi khol/ /rkang pa 'phongs rnams sbrid chil chil/ /'brug sgra klad pa 'gem pa 'dra/ /glog zhags sil sgra rwa gzhob 'tshub/ /skrag cing snying 'dar ba spu gzengs/ /'bros sa med de gnam gyi zhabs/ /steng nas thog mda' 'ong la khad/ /'og nas 'khyug kyang 'ong la nye/ /char pa mi khug pha rol nas/ /yul khams ser bas 'joms la khad/ /de dus ma skrag ma 'bros la/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams len skyong / /de dus zin na bar dor zin/ /bar do chung chung de na yod/ /bogs gcig thon na de dus thon/ /nyams len steng du 'dug nus na/ /dngos nyams rmi lam yad yud skabs/ /lha 'dres phyag 'tshal dngos grub ster/ /thog dang ser ba 'ja' ltar yal/ /char bas 'gro ba thams cad tshim/ /tshar slong gnyis ka dus gcig rdzogs/ /mi rnams dpa' zhing legs so brjod/ /dkar gsum khyer ba'i bkur snyi mang / /rang yang yid dga' nga rgyal skye/ /byin rlabs nus pa nga che snyam/ /char 'bod gzhan tshos ma khug pas/ /rang gis khug pa'i zur za smra/ /dga' brod bdud po de ru slebs//de dus dga' ba'i ngo bo lta/ /rang gis yin nam nga rgyal spangs/ /nga yi byin rlabs ma yin te/ /dge 'dun mang drin yin zhes brjod/ /bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab/ /gzhi bdag lha 'dre thams cad la/ /'khon sems dogs pa mi bzung bar/ /yon bdag 'dris chen lta bur bsams/ /gal te 'gro ba'i bsod nams sam/ /bskal pa'i khug zur lo nyes 'dod/ /gnas de'i sa bdag klu gnyan la/ /nad kyis zin nam char ba med/ /rang gis char ba ma khug cing / /char g.yog grwa khal la sogs la/ /nad kyis theb bam god tshogs 'byung / /dngos nyams rmi lam ltas ngan mang / /331

yid pham skrag 'jigs skyes pa dang / /ngo tsha snyam pa'i ngo gnong che/ /lha la pham ltung byung ba 'dra/ /sems sdug ngo tsha'i ngo bor lta/ /lha dang gdams ngag log lta spang / /si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs/ /skyes chen dam pa mang pos kyang / /sa tshig chen po byung ba'i dus//char ma khug pa'i lo rgyus bsam//gnas gcig yun ring mi sdod par//ri gnyan mtsho gnyan chu mig sogs//mang po 'grim zhing lus sbyin dang / /byams dang snying rje stong nyid bsgoms/ /sngags lugs char 'bod gang bde rnams/ /skabs su gang babs bya ba dang / /don la babs rung ma bab rung / /bogs 'don gnyan khrod 'grims pa yin/ /char pa bab la dga' ba dang //ma babs sdug pa'i ro snyoms bya//gnyan thog ri 'grims de mas 'thus/ /ri 'grim sarga lnga pa'o/ /yang gcig gson dang brtson 'grus pa/ /bogs 'don nā ro gsang spyod lugs/ /dur khrod grong mtha' la sogs pa/ /mtshan mo 'gro ba skur 'deb rgyu/ /de 'dra byung ba mthong thos mang / /dur khrod zhar la gcod pas chog/btsan thabs shi dang gri khar shi//gnya' ba bcings sogs gzhon shi'i ro/ /za 'dre rgod pas 'jigs skrag che/ /mi gzhon rnams kyang sgyid rtsa 'dar/ /bud med rnams dang byis pa tsho//mun 'go rub nas chab gsil dka'//grong chog bla ma de 'drar phyin/ /sbra dang khyim ni shin tu dogs/ /ro dang bla ma mnyam du bsgrigs//nye drag shi shig rnams kyang 'gos//mdze nad byung ltar sor mo 'dzad//dbyar kha yin na rul dri 'tshubs//rlung kha gyu dus skyug la khad/ /ro la grib gzhi bsnan pa'am/ /spyod ma 'grim pa'i sman nad kyis/ /ro 'phag skrangs te g.yag ro tsam/ /kha nas gre sogs bca' 'dra ba'i/ /sgra skad dang bcas khrag rgyun 'bab/ /nub mo nyal kha'i dus tsam nas//mi kun thabs kyis phyir la byer/ /ro dang bla ma 332

mnyam du lus/ /mar me la yang grib phog nas/ /tshag tshag zer zhing je je nag /bskal ba yar dar ma gtogs pa//ro langs dngos ni mi 'byung yang //mig gis lta dang bshud pa byed//gzhogs rje tshig ngan brjod pa sogs//dus phyis de 'dra mthong thos mang / /ro yis de ltar ma byas kyang / /skrag drag rnam rtog dgrar langs pas/ /lta snang 'gul yo byed snang dang / /spyod ma 'grim pa'i sman gyi mthus/ /kha nas har rtse byed 'dra 'byung / /'bros na ngo tsha bros thabs med/ /bsdad na gnyid med nam mi chod//sa stong dur rnying mang bo bas//'jigs pa'i dur khrod de na yod//de dus skrag snang btsog snang sgyur//bdag gi lus kyang 'di dang 'dra//snyam du mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom//'di la skrag dang btsog pa na//rang gi lus la'ang skrag cing btsog /mi ro rang ro gcig tu bsre/ /tshe 'das de yi rnam shes kyang //rang gi sems dang dbyer med bsre//nyams len phyag rgya chen po la/ /sa le seng nge mnyam par gzhag/da rung (da dung /)skrag snang btsog snang skyes//de yi ngo bor gcer gyis bltas/ /phyag rgya chen por wal gyis 'char//'jigs skrag btsog snang 'ja' ltar yal/ /bag phebs gro lhub gnyid du 'gro/ /gsang spyod dur 'grim de gas 'thus/ /gsang spyod dur gcod bogs 'don gyi/ /glu yi sarga drug pa'o/ /yang gcig gson dang brtson 'grus pa/ /rtogs pa'i bogs 'don byed pa'i tshe/ /stan thog lo gcig bsgom pa bas/ /lha 'dre drag po gnas pa yi//gnyan sar zhag gcig bogs che gsungs/ /gnyan sa ched du 'tshol mi dgos/ /bsod nams chung ngam phog thug shor/ /ban bon nus can 'gras pa'am/ /ri dwags bsad dam shing gnyan bcad/ /de 'dra'i phog thug shor ba'am/ /tshe sngon bsod 333

nams ma bsags pa'i/ /rgyal 'gong dam sri gza' klu sogs/ /sde brgyad dregs pa dgra ru langs/ /shi 'phro mi chad shi chad mang / /na 'phro mi chad nad pa mang / /ltas ngan cho 'phrul rgyun mi chad/ /bsod chung 'grim pa phyin na yang / /de la nad gag rkyen kha langs/ /khyim der 'dre yis tshang bcas nas/ /'grim pa phyin kyang gnyid mi zin/ /nad bu can phyin dbang bo 'chor/ /chang bzi phyin na smyo rgod 'byung //de 'dra'i gdon can khyim de ru/ /grong chog bla ma gdan 'dren 'byung / /mdos bzlog bskang gsol gcod tshogs sogs//bar chad rkyen sel bla mar re//gdon bying che zhing tsha ngad ldan/ /gzi brjid cho 'phrul 'jigs skrag skye/ /ba spu gyen langs tsha 'ub be/ /dgye dgye mi phod sgur snying 'dod//ltag pa'i bdud sgo'i phyogs nas skrag /sdig can mi ngan 'di tshang na/ /mi 'ong ka med nan gyis bos/ /mi ngan gar 'dug ngu ba'i lam//nga yang bsod chung 'di na phyin//phan thogs ma byung ngo yang tsha/ /drag las dmigs pas gzir drags na/ /rang gi srog la ya nga za/ /gnyan sa chung chung de na yod/ /de dus 'gyod pa mi skyed la/ /rtogs pa'i bogs 'don dran par bya/ /gdon dang yon bdag gnyis ka la/ /byams dang snying rjes gtong len bsgom/ /'jigs skrag rnam rtog gang skyes kyang / /ngo bo bltas la mnyam par gzhag /'drer 'dzin rnam rtog de chod na/ /bogs 'don mchog tu de 'gyur ro/ /gdon zhi nad phan lha ngo 'byung / /de tshe gdon des yon bdag gis/ /sems bsgul rang la le lan gyis/ /legs so bkur sti mi byed par/ /cung zad mi dga'i tshul zhig ston/ /khyod kyi bka' drin ma yin te/ /ga shad gzhan nas su zhig gis/ /ci zhig byas pas phan skad smra/ /de tshe sems la zhe sdang skyes/ /'dre yi kha nas dngos su blangs/ /yon dang 'bul ba mi gzab steng / /kha 334

bzang tsam yang mi byed par//da phyin kho la dgos byung na//phan thogs byed re'i rtog pa 'chang / /byang chub sems bskyed de ru shor/ /de tshe slongs su ngos bzung ste/ /kye ma kho la rang dbang med/ /dam sri rgyal 'gong sems ngan pas/ /yon bdag sems rgyud bsgul nas kyang / /bdag la zhe lan len pa yin//gdon dang yon bdag gnyis ka ni/ /tshe rabs mang po'i pha ma yin//bzang lan 'dod pa'i phan btags ni//tha mal skye bo'i bya ba yin//lan dang re ba mi 'dod pa'i//phan gdags byang chub sems dpa'i srol/ /gdon dang yon bdag thog drangs pa'i/ /khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas sa la skyel bar shog /bsam par byas la gtong len bsgom/ /de yis gdon de'i bsam ngan zhi/ /yon bdag de yang je gus 'gyur/ /gnyan thog zhar la gcod pa yi/ /glu yi sa rga bdun pa'o/ /gson dang kurma brtson 'grus pa/ /nā ro paṇa chen thugs kyi bcud/ /spyod pa ro snyoms skor drug de/ /rtogs pas ro ni snyoms nus na/ /ro snyoms zhar la 'ong zhing gda'/ /dma' na mi dga' mtho na dga'/ /'jig rten chos brgyad rnam gnyis te/ /gdan dang khri la mi dum rtsod/ /rgyal ba rigs lngar khri rkang lnga/ /dug lnga rnam par dag rtags lags/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du/ /rgyal bu don grub sangs rgyas tshe//sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis kyi//gdan khri sa la rang byung skyes/ /'khor 'jigs gser thub 'od srung gis/ /khri la phyag dang bskor ba mdzad/ /shwaka thub khri la bzhugs ma thag /khri gzhan nub te mi snang gyur/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi bar/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyongs mdzad pa yi/ /bsod nams las grub gdan khri lags/ /shāka thub mya ngan 'das rjes su/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya'i snam sbyar brtsegs/ /de steng nyan thos 'od srung dang / /nye bar 'khor 335

dang kun dga' bo/ /rim bzhin bzhugs nas sde snod gsum/ /thugs nas tshar re gsungs tshar nas/ /khri la ma bzhugs sa la babs/ /mi brjed gzungs thob gdan khri lags/ /de tsho phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i zhing / /de min lung dang las ka dang / /gdan sa'i 'thob dang khri la sogs//'jig rten chos brgyad phyogs dang mthun//ci phyir las ka khri la sogs//lugs ni rgya nag rgyal po yin//'dzam gling phyed la dbang bsgyur nas//lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ni/ /rgya nag rgyal po yin par 'dod//khong gis bla mar bskos pa na//kun gyis bla mar bkur dgos pa'i/ /rtags la thil dmar gdan dmar dang //khri dang rgya gling rgya dar sogs//rgya 'jang rgyal po'i lag rtags yin/ /'jig rten ngos nas khur dgos kyi//chos nas brtsis na lhag rgyu med//mar mi dwags po dus mkhyen dang / /skyob pa thang pa sogs la'ang / /ngo bo sangs rgyas yin mod kyi/ /las ka the'u dmar gdan khri med/ /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa yi/ /las ma'i 'thob cha gdan yig la/ /kurma pakṣur kur rtsag dang //kom stan zhig las med do skad//'on kyang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes rnams//kurma pakṣu ma do pas//rgya nag rgyal po'i zhal nas kyang //bla ma bla ma ste/ bla mchan rgya 'bar ba de/ /gsungs pa'i kha dpe kun la 'jag /'gro mgon phag mo gru pa yi/ /slob ma dbu la gdugs bskor ba/ /lnga stong brgyad brgya 'tshogs pa la'ang / /dbang lung gdams ngag gnang ba'i tshe/ /kom stan gcig las gdan med skad/ /de phyir rang la nyams rtogs dang / /yon tan legs po yod pa na//gdan khri dma' yang skyon med do//mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen po de//gdung rus che zhing yon tan mkhas//de phyir rgya nag rgyal po yis//gser khri rgyab yol bcas pa bskur//mkhas shing nga rgyal chen po yis//zhwa dmar pa la zur 336

za che//mtshur phu'i dge 'dun stong phrag gis//khang tshan mgo yang ma non pas/ /gza' bsgrubs gtad mnan mtshur phu nyams//khong rang chos kyi brgyud pa chad//bkra shis dpal 'byor zhes bya ba//zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i chibs kha khrid//dkor la 'dzem nas phogs ma gsol//ja lo gsol bas sngon por song //ming yang gnyan la sngo 'khyog zer//gdan khri med pa'i bya bral de//mi bskyod rdo rje'i rigs bdag gyur/ /kai tshang bstan pa gnas kyi bar/ /khong gi brgyud pa ma chad do/ /de dag rnams la dpyad pa na//gdan khri rtsod pa 'khrul ba rang //gral gyi mtho dman de dang 'dra//ras chung rdo rje grags pa yang //zhal skyems mang ja e rag gi//bka' gdams pa yi gral mjug bsdad/ /na bza' ngur smrig med pa des/ /ra dkar lug gi gral mi tshud/ /zer nas phyag nas bzung ste phud/ /'byon long ma byung sgo 'dan pas/ /zhabs ya sgo yi bar du bcir//zug gzer che bas mgur dbyangs 'then/ /chos rje bya yul pa yis gsan/ /dad pa'i dbang gis spyan chab shor/ /lkog tu rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten/ /des na don la khri dang ni/ /gral gyi mtho dman khyad par med/ /sngar dus rgyal ba yab sras rnams/ /jo bo mjal du brdzus te phebs/ /drung 'khor rnams kyis gral mjug tu/ /yab sras bzhugs kyang sus ma shes/ /bud med ḍāki'i rigs can gyis/ /shes nas sngon du ja drangs skad/ /yab sras mjug tu bzhugs pa des/ /chung du song skad mi 'dug go /'dul ba'i lugs la bslab gral te/ /sdom pa zhus rim snga rim mtho/ /'on kyang nges pa med pa ste/ /bslab pa rgan dang ye shes rgan/ /bslab pa zhu ni gang snga ste/ /rtogs pa yon tan med pa na/ /lo brgya lon yang byis pa nyid//yon tan che 'am rtogs pa mtho/ /de ni ye shes rgan pa ste/ /sdom pa zhu ni phyi na yang / /de nyid gong du bzhag 337

par gsungs//'on kyang gral rim ma bsgrigs par//mgyogs gral byas pas dge 'dun sde/ /'tshogs pa che pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /de phyir ngam ring la sogs pa'i//dgon chen phal cher mgyogs gral yin//gtsang gi sa skya'i dgon chen na//gral la rtsod pa che ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pa gtsang nag ras pa de/ /gral gyi mjug las ma tshud pas/ /gtsang nag ras pas nangs snga dus/ /nam langs ma langs tshogs 'tshogs skabs/ /bong bu zhig la sham thabs dang / /chos gos rnam pa gsum bkal nas/ /gral gyi stod la khrid do skad/ /nam langs ci yin smras pa na//'di ni skad bzang na bza' bzang / /gral 'go 'di na 'jog 'os gsungs/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa gtsang nag pa'i//gsung de go rgyu chen po gda'//go rgyu de nyid ci yin na//yon tan ldan nam rtogs pa mtho/ /gral mjug bsdad kyang gral mgo yin/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan med/ /tshul khrims rnam par ma dag na/ /gral mgor bsdad kyang gral mjug tu/ /sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzhi bdag sogs/ /mngon shes ldan pa kun gyis mthong / /lung rtogs yon tan ldan pa dang / /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yi/ /gong du 'dug pa nyes pa che//mkhas pa'i god lci zhes gsungs so//phyag kyang de dang 'dra ba ste/ /lung rtogs yon tan ldan pa'i phyag /rang las theg pa mtho gyur na/ /rang gi bsod nams zad 'gyur zhing / /srung skyobs 'jig rten lha kun 'bros/ /lha dbye 'byung ste mthu bas thu/ /khri dang gral gyi mtho dman gyi/ /glu yi sarga brgyad pa'o/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /'dra 'dra'i bla ma mang 'tshogs tshe/ /'jig rten chos brgyad mtho dman gnyis/ /ro snyoms nyams len de na yod/ /mtho bar 'dod pa'i bla ma kun/ /gus zhabs bcas te yar la bzhag /rang nyid 338

dma' ba'i sdug snang gis/ /rnam rtog de la hrig ger lta/ /gzhi med nyams len klong du bskyur/ /mtho 'dod khong rnams dga' ba dang / /dge 'dun bkur ba'i bsod nams 'thob/ /de tshe don la nga bzang ste/ /rgyal kha kho la 'bul lo bsam//zhe nas brnyas pa'i rnam rtog 'byung / /de phyir ro snyoms lam mi 'gro//khong rnams lung dang rtogs pa yi/ /yon tan dngos su mi snang ba/ /nga rang bsam pa ma dag cing / /mngon shes spyan dang mi ldan pas/ /gang zag tshod 'dzin ga la nus/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yis//khra 'brug mchod rten rtsa ba ru//dge slong chos gos rul pa can/ /shig mang shig rnams spar ras 'chu/ /me yi nang du 'debs pa gzigs/ /khyed nyid dge slong chos gos can/ /shig rnams bsregs pa mi legs gsungs/ /dge slong sdigs mdzub rtse mo ru/ /khra 'brug mchod rten bzhag nas bskor/ /rgyal po zhal skyengs la thod phud/ /'od dpag med kyi dbu bstan pas/ /dge slong gri gug bton nas kyang / /dge slong nyid kyi brang gshag nas/ /dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu bstan/ /rgyal pos rtag tu bla mchod byas/ /de bzhin bla ma 'di rnams kyang / /phal cher so skye yin nges med//byang chub sems dpa' rkun ma gnyis//gar yod mi shes zer ba'i dpe/ /phal cher byang chub sems dpa' nyid//sngon dus bskal pa bzang ba'i dus/ /dgra bcom nam mkhar 'phur ba bas/ /deng sang chos gos gyon tsam yang / /phan yon che bar gsungs pa dang / /sngon dus grub rtags thogs med las//deng sang sems ngo skyong shes tsam/ /phan yon che bar gsungs pa rnams/ /yid la bsam zhing dag snang sbyongs/ /bdag nyid kun las dman par lta/ /de don glang ri thang ba yis/ /gang du su dang 'grogs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid kun las dman lta zhing / /gzhan la bsam pa thag pa nas/ / 339

mchog tu gus par 'dzin par shog/gsungs pa'i nyams len de lags so//mtho dang dma' ba'i rnam rtog gnyis/ /ro snyoms lam du khyer ba yi/ /glu yi sarga darku pa'o//yang gcig gson dang brtson 'grus pa//rtogs par ldan pa'i rtogs ldan gyis/ /sgo ba ka bla rkang dung khyer//'grang ltogs dro 'khyags ro snyoms phyir//rgyal khams phyogs med bskor ba ni//na med rlung khyer chos par brtsi//'dul khrims zhus pa'i btsun pa yang / /dbus gtsang dwags kong 'khyams pa na/ /btung ba chang las gzhan ma mchis/ /chang tshug mang bas chang gis bzi/ /sde dgon grong nag srang mdor nyal//sde yi chos lad dmigs srol ngan//chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ste//bod kyi sdom gcig 'chor nyan gda'//de 'dra byung ba mthong thos mang /nyams len rtogs pa yod pa na/ /rnyed na dga' dang ma rnyed sdug /'jig rten chos brgyad rnam gnyis yin/ /mtshams dang sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen brgyags/ /dbyar ston ldom bu byed pa'i tshe/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed ro snyoms na/ /sbyong ba mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /ming yang ro snyoms ldom bu zer/ /ched du khyi 'gram gcog mi dgos/ /'gris che lha drin yod pa yi/ /yon bdag zhig la gtad nas 'gro/ /gdul bya longs spyod 'ong snyam tsa//bu chung thal mdog sgo nas byung //de ring a pha ga shed song / /a mas ja med ci byed zer/ /grong pa rnams kyang mu ge che/ /gtsang langs dgos sam ma dgos tsam/ /grwa pa rnams kyang ngo 'dzum nag /yon bdag de la gnad tshig brjod/ /bla ma gung tshigs ma theb nas/ /dpon slob thams cad ltogs yus lugs(ltog drag nas)/ /dpon slob kun gyi ngo dang sems/ /cha lugs mthun par nag thug ge /de dus bogs 'don dus gcig yin//ma rnyed snyam pa'i yi mug de//'jig rten chos brgyad sna gcig yin//de yi 340

ngo la hrig ger blta/ /lta ba'i ngang la phyam mer gzhag /bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis//dkor gyi nyes pa gsungs pa'i tshe//dge slong mang pos sdom pa phul//de la ston pas yi rang mdzad/ /de phyir gdul bya ma rnyed pas/ /dkor sgrib chung ba'i dga' ba bsgom/ /yon bdag de dang ru ba der/ /mi dga'i bsam pa rtsad nas spang //byams dang snying rjes gtong len bsgom//de nas yang cig byon pa dang //rgyus med ngo shes med pa yi/ /grong ngam ru bar 'gro bsam pas/ /grwa pa dmus nas mi 'gro zer/ /mi la ras pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /che ba'i sbra la ma rngam par /chung ba'i sbra'u mi skyur dpe/ /lam zhor red pas 'gro gsungs 'byon/ /rgyus med mi tshad brel tshub be//gdan bting du ba nag phyur re//byin rlabs zhu dang bka' bsgo zhu/ /dbang bskur zhu dang zhal phu zhu/ /byang bu zhu dang bsngo ba zhu/ /ru ba'i sdom bu chi ler 'dus/ /bza' btung 'tsho bas mdun rnams bkang //rgyus med 'dris med 'os med par/ /'di tshang bkur sti 'di tsam gzab//ci yin bsam zhing dpon slob kun/ /thugs dgongs dgyes shing zhal ras 'dzum/ /ja snyigs phos pa thams cad kyang / /mig la byugs dang rke la byugs//dad pa che 'os med par che//de tshe rnyed pa rnyed pa'i mi//dga' tshor sems dbang mtho ba de//'jig rten chos brgyad sna gcig lags/ /dga' ba'i bsam pa gzhi med du/ /lta ba'i klong du yal bcug ste//rnyed dang ma rnyed bsam pa gnyis//khyad med nges par ro snyoms na/ /ro snyoms chung chung de na yod/ /bogs gcig thon na de dus thon/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed ro snyoms gyi/ /glu yi sarga bcu pa'o/ /gson dang brtson 'grus rgya mtsho ba/ /dkar ldom thag ring bgrod pa'i tshe//la thur che bas brla rkang log/tshug thag ring bas lto ba bkres/ /char drag ser bas nag nu re/ /jag rkun khyi 341

smyon spyang kir skrag/ /mi rnyed sdug dang mi khyag sdug /mgo thon dka' ba'i sdug dang gsum/ /sdug bsngal 'jig rten khyim thabs spangs/ /nga la sdug bsngal 'ong don med/ /nged rang dpon slob 'di rnams kyis/ /kha rgyab tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /mi sos rgyu yang gzhan med par/ /'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal ci yin ang / tshe sprang dus 'khyams ngo yang tsha/ /yon bdag rnams kyang e mi sun/ /chos sgor zhugs pa bzang lags te/ /mi tsher sprang dgos sdug por gda'/ /sprang mi dgos pa'i longs spyod gcig /yod na ci ma rung snyam nas/ /phyug po'i mi la yid smon 'chor/ /dbul pos btsal bas mi rnyed sdug /phyug pos 'tsho skyong mi thub sdug /de gnyis mi rnams kun la yod/ /chos sgor zhugs pas lan pa min/ /mi lus blangs pas lan pa yin/ /rnam rtog de yi ngo bor blta/ /dka' las che ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /ngo bo bsres pas bogs gcig 'byung / /rtogs ldan rgyal khams bskor ba rnams/ /dka' las de nyid 'tshol phyir byon/ /dka' las 'tshol du ma song yang //shugs kyis 'byung la bsre thub bya/ /chags zhen med pa'i ldom bu ni/ /thub pas gnang ba'i pha 'bab lags/ /de la dkor sgrib yod pa min/ /yang gcig byon pa'i lam ka na/ /'byor ldan ru chen mang po'i gseb/ /sha thud mar sogs khur zhing dpung / /ri dang sa phyogs thams cad kun/ /rta lug nor gyis khra ltem me//nyi ma dro zhing 'ja' sprin 'khrigs//spang ljongs g.yu yi kha dog la//me tog sna tshogs tshal chen rgyas/ /bung ba khu byug gsung snyan sgrog /'bab chu tung tung snyan pa'i sgra/ /sems kyang dga' spro snang ba skyid/ /spang ljongs de ru 'dug snying spro/ /gsol 'debs mgur dbyangs byed snying 'dod/ /de tshe me tog thams cad ni/ /yid kyis yi dam lha la 'bul/ /de min me tog sngon po la/ /'gong nags gsang 342

bdag dam tshig nyams/ /me tog tshal gyi dkyil de ru/ /gding ba gding zhing lus gnad bsrang / /snang ba dga' dang ya le ba'i/ /rnam rtog de la hrig ger blta/ /dga' dang yi mug bsam pa gnyis/ /lta ba'i ngang du ro snyoms na/ /ro snyom chung chung de na yod//bogs 'don chung chung de yis 'ong //de bzhin lus bde sems sdug med/ /nyi ma dro zhing bza' btung 'dzom/ /chos kyi gnad 'gag nga rang shes/ /su la zhu dgos 'dri dgos med/ /shi yang ngan song 'gro dogs med//mi tshe chos la bskyal ba yin/ /bsam pas yid dga' blo bde dang / /na tsha sdug bsngal du mas mnar/ /nga la 'di 'dra ci la 'ong / /blo phug dkon mchog gsum la gtad//sku rim rkyen bzlog gsol mchod gzab//bdud dang dam sri'i bar chad dam/ /pha rol gtad mnan ngan sngags sam//sngon gyi las ngan smin pa'am//snang srid lha 'dre'i g.yos chen 'di/ /cis drag cis phan blo sna mang / /de ltar skyid sdug bsam pa gnyis/ /lta ba'i ngang du ro mnyam na/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs/ /skyid sdug lam khyer gdams pa yin/ /skyid sdug lam du khyer ba yi/ /glu yi sarga bcu gcig go/ /yang gcig gson dang brtson 'grus pa/ /snyan grags dga' dang mi snyan sdug /'jig rten chos brgyad sna gnyis yin/ /rang la lung dang rtogs pa yi/ /bstod 'os yon tan mi che yang / /yon bdag la sogs glen dad can/ /mang pos dus gsum sangs rgyas zer/ /la las grub thob yin no zer/ /rang nyid nam 'chi mi shes kyang / /gzhan gyi mngon shes yod zer bstod/ /gos dum skra sen chab gsil yang //dad can mang pos 'khyer dang btung //sde dpon shog dpon yul dpon dang / /sku skye dge bshes dpon rigs sogs/ /'thob thang che zhing nga rgyal can/ /mang pos phyag 'tshal dbang chos zhu//rgyus med phyogs 343

phyogs sde rnams kyang //gzhan zer cal sgrog rjes rgyug gis//de ba bzang po red ces gleng / /de tshe rang mthong nga rgyal skye/ /kun gyis bkur sti che ba des/ /rang yang bzang po yin snyam byed//snyan grag lha yi bu yi bdud//nga rgyal skyes na thar lam bkag /snyan grags brag cha 'dra ba de/ /grags stong lta ba'i klong du bskyur/ /mthon po'i khri la 'dug pa dang / /mi chen bla chen phyag 'tshal tshe/ /chos dang dbang gi che ba yin/ /bdag ni mthon po'i khrir 'dug dang / /gzhan gyis phyag 'tshal ga la 'os/ /dbang lung la sogs byed pa yang / /chos kyi maṇḍal tshul du 'bul/ /bla 'dod bla ma yin snyam spang / /snyan grags lam du khyer ba yin/ /de bzhin rang la nyes med par//don med gshe skur 'debs pa dang //rdzun ma zob po yin zer dang / /su zhig bu dang ma de'i bu/ /zer zhing rus kyi mtshang nas brjod/ /pho mgo skor zhing mo mgo g.yog /so zho mig tshil yan chad kyi/ /sde yi bcud tsho 'dis bsdus zer/ /rang nor phrogs pa tsam du 'bar/ /dbang lung gdams ngag spel ba na//kho la phug med rdzun yin zer//gdams ngag zin bris zab bstan na//rang bzo rdzun gyi mgo bskor zer//nad zhi gdon zhi phan thogs na/ /'dre yi za kha phyes so zer/ /legs nyes gang smras thog babs na/ /the'u rang ltag rdzos yin no zer/ /cho sar 'gro don che ba na/ /dbang sdud ngan sngags yod do zer//de sogs mi snyan sgra thos tshe//nyes med nga la ci phyir 'bar/ /rdzun ni nga yis smra ma myong //gnod pa'i bya ba ngas ma byas/ /dad ldan gdul bya byung ba la//khong rnams ser sna che don ci//snyam du sems rtsub mi dga' tshe//ngo bo bltas la klod nyal btang //byams dang snying rje gtong len bsgom//rang gis nyes pa byas pa na/ /rang gis ma pher sdug pa yin/ /rang gis nyes pa ma byas par 'bar sha 344

gtam ngan mang po de/ /sdig sgrib phyags mas 'debs pa yin/ /nga yi sdig sgrib sbyong rogs de//don med khong tshos byed pa la//mi dga' ci yod 'or che bsgom//de ltar snyan dang mi snyan gnyis//rtogs pa'i ngang du ro snyoms na//ro snyoms chen po de na yod/ /bogs 'don de yis chen po 'ong / /snyan dang mi snyan 'jig rten chos/ /ro snyoms glu yi sarga ste/ /le'u bcu gnyis pa yin no/ /gson dang /rma brtson 'grus pa/ /rang 'dod khog tu bcug pa yis/ /don mthun 'gro don 'ong ba med/ /snying nas rang 'dod med pa yis/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar 'god pa'i//sems bskyed bzang po'i rtsis zin na//gser 'gyur rtsi yis zin pa yis//lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba bzhin//ci byas byang chub lam du 'gro//mi dge phal cher dge bar 'gyur//lo tog shin tu legs pa na//sog phub zhar la 'byung ba ltar/ /rang don ma bsam lhun grub yin/ /thub pas rtag tu gzhan don mdzad/ /rang don mngon par sangs rgyas 'thob/ /tha mal skye bos rang don bsgrubs/ /rang don ma 'grub ngan song lhung / /'di gnyis khyad par ltos shig ces/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lha yis gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i sems bskyed ma shes na/ /gsang sngags bla med nyams blangs kyang / /byang chub lam du 'gro bar dka'/ /'di don dwags po lha rje yis/ /chos ni chos su 'gro ba'i thabs/ /gdams ngag zab par gsungs pa yin/ /'gro don rtsa ba sems bskyed kyi/ /glu yi sarga bcu gsum pa/ /glu chung sarga bcu gsum 'di/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bskul byas nas/ /shing sbrul mgo zla'i dmar po'i phyogs/ /drug bdun brgyad kyi dgong thun mtshams/ /rang gi myong ba dang bstun nas/ /rā ga a sus smras pa de/ /bla ma bīrya sā ga ras/ /sor mo glog gi rta la zhon/ /mgo rgyal zla ba'i tsha ngar la/ /bzod pa 345
