chen po'i go cha bgos/ /phyi rabs gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /myur mgyogs brtson pa'i cang shes bcibs/ /dung mdog shog bu'i ngos nyid la/ /baiḍūr mdog 'dra snag tshas bris/ /bdag 'dra'i bya bral nyam chung 'ga'/ /spyod pa lam du bslangs nas kyang / /dngos mtshan chen po med pa'i ngos/ /sa lam rim pa mang bgrod nas//rdzogs sangs sa la 'god par shog/le'u bzhi bcu pa'o maṅga lam̐//'chi lugs gdams pa dpag bsam shing 'bras/tshusari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ chos byed pa'i gang zag rnams 'chi lugs rab 'bring tha ma yang mtha' rnams gsal ba dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badzra dhā ra ye/ /gsar rnying mdo rgyud man ngag du ma nas//'bras bu 'thob pa'i tshul dang shi ba'i tshul//rgya cher bshad kyang go bder 'dir brjod pa/ /nyams myong med kyang gsar rnying rgyud sde'i don/ /thos pa'i shes rab la brten 'dir brjod bya/ /'chi ba med dang 'da' tshul 'chi ba gsum//'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa//gu ru padma 'byung gnas lta bu la/ /nam mkha' ji srid 'chi ba med par gsungs//phyag rdzogs zung 'jug bar skal re re tsam/ /mchi ba med de 'ja' lus 'grub pa ni/ /'pho ba chen po'i sku ni 'grub pa zhes/ /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra lta bu ste/ /de yang mthar ni mi snang 'od du yal/ /yi dam lha yi byin gyis brlabs gyur pas/ /lo ni stong phrag du mar 'chi med pa/ /dper na grub chen mi tra dzwa ki bzhin/ /de ni tshe la dbang 346

ba'i rig 'dzin yin/ /mthar ni phung po mi bzhag mya ngan 'da'/ /zag bcas lus 'di zag med lus su gyur/ /lo ni stong phrag khri phrag tsam gyi bar/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad na yang / /gang zag phal gyis de yi sku mi mthong / /dper na sa ra ha dang tai lo bzhin/ /de ni mkha' spyod gshegs zhes ming 'dogs te//mkha' spyod chung ngu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral yin//'ga' zhig yi dam dngos su 'grub 'gyur te/ /ngo bo yi dam lha dang dbyer med cing / /rnam pa grub chen sku yi cha lugs 'dzin//'gro la phan phyir mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs//gsol pa btab na dngos grub sbyin mdzad kyang //sku de tha mal pa yis mi mthong ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su rin chen gzhal yas su/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshogs dpon mdzad nas bzhugs/ /dper na grub chen klu yi byang chub bzhin / /de don dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang / /sa skya paṇa chen rnam thar nang nas gsal/ /ye shes lha yi rigs sngags nus pa yis/ /tshe lo dpag med thub par gsungs pa ltar/ /rma bya chen po'i rigs sngags grub pa'i mthus//slob dpon klu sgrub dgung lo drug brgyar bzhugs/ /de bzhin arya de was bzhi brgya dang / /slob dpon thogs med gnyis brgya bzhugs zhes grags/ /de bzhin tshe sgrub byas pa'i nus pa yis/ /jo mo mtsho rgyal nyis brgya bzhugs pa dang / /dam pa rgya gar lnga brgya bco lnga bzhugs/ sangs rgyas ye shes brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs//de dag mchog gi tshe yi rig 'dzin lags/ /phyi rol mu stegs pa yi drang srong zhig /dbang phyug bsgrub pas tshe lo stong thub rgyu/ /dngos grub 'khong bas lnga brgya 'grib ces grags/ /bya ri ka pas dngul chu'i bcud len gyis/ /byams pa ma byon bar du mi 'chi skad/ /paṇḍi ta pa bai ro tsa na yis/ /dngul chu'i bcud len nus pas sum 347

brgya tsam/ /thub steng bod kyi yul du 'das par snang / /de dag thun mong tshe 4rig 'dzin lags/ /de dag 'chi ba med pa'i khong du gtogs/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas sa thob nas/ /sku gdung ma bzhag nam mkhar 'ja' ltar yal/ /dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun mnyam dbyer med pa//rgya gar yul du dga' rab shri sing dang //bod du a ro yon tan 'byung gnasacog ro sgom chung bzhin//de la lhag med mngon par sangs rgyas zer//de don rdzogs chen lo rgyus rnams su gsal//ma dag 'byung lnga'i khams lnga 'od du zhu/ /dag pa ye shes 'od lnga'i rang bzhin gyur/ /de kun lte ba'i thad du thim pa dang / /lte ba'i rtsa 'dab phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyur/ /de nyid dbus kyi hrīḥ 'am baṃ la thim/ /de nas dngos med stong pa nyid du gyur/ /zhing khams gzhan du'ang gshegs pa ma yin te/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gar bzhugs nges pa med//las can rnams la nam mkhar 'ja' shar bzhin/ /sku dngos ston cing dam chos ston par byed/ /ma rgyud lugs kyi 'ja' lus mkha' spyod yin//de don ma gcig lab sgron gsung las gsal//yi dam lha bsgrubs phyag rdzogs bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /zag bcas sha khrag rus pa'i phung po 'di//zag med 'ja' lus sgrib pa med par gyur//lus kyi rdzu 'phrul ci yang ston nus te/ /ma 'das sngar dus sku lus 'dra bar yod/ /bde ba can sogs zhing khams byon nas bzhugs//ras chung pa dang rje btsun rtse mo dang //ngom pa mkha' spyod nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bzhin/ /pha rgyud lugs kyi 'ja' lus mkha' spyod lags//rtsa rlung sgyu lus rtogs pa mthar phyin nas//brtul zhugs spyod pas dur khrod gnas chen 'grim/ /de tshe dag snang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral phyin/ /tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi de nyid zos ma thag /gdos bcas sha khrag lus de gnas 'gyur 348

nas/ /dngos med 'ja' lus 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /dngos su byon kyang tha mal pas mi mthong / /dper na rgya gar grub chen phal cher dang / /bod du thang stong rgyal po lta bu yin//de dag 'ja' lus mkha' spyod grangs su 'gro//spyod par gshegs zhes bya ba'ang de lags so/ /de dag 'chi ba med pa'i sde tshan no/ /'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston pa ni/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob tshar bas/ /rang gi snang ngor 'chi ba med na yang //ma dag pa yis 'das shing gdung bzhus mthong / /de tshe nyid na'ang las 'phro dag pa rnams/ /dngos su byon nas chos bshad dbang bskur mthong //la las seng ge rta mchog sogs chibs nas/ /mkha' 'gros gdan drangs zhing khams gshegs par mthong / /don la 'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul bstan/ /dag dang ma dag mthong tshul so sor snang / /de don nā ro mi la'i rnam thar dang //grub chen pakṣu'i gsung sogs rnam thar gsal//tshe 'di nyid las sangs rgyas thob tshar te//thugs ni sangs rgyas kun dang dgongs pa mnyam/ /sgom med chen mo'i rtogs pa mngon gyur ba/ /de 'dra thugs dam bzhugs pa ma yin te/ /thugs dam bzung rgyu sgrib pa sbyang rgyu dang / /bsgom bya sgom byed sgom pa ci yang med/ /dper na yab sras thugs dam mi bzhugs bzhin/ /'gro ba'i don phyir sku gdung ring bsrel bzhag /phung po lhag bcas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa zer//tshe 'dir sgom med chen po ma rtogs shing //sgom med 'bring min ro gcig chen po yan//rtogs pa nyin mtshan 'khor yug yod pa de//bco lnga nub par mun pa med pa bzhin/ /dbugs nyid ma song bar du nyams len dang / /dbugs chad nag lam yal nas 'od gsal dang //zhag gsum yan chad thugs dam bzhugs pa des/ /rtogs pa'i na 'phar sgom med chen por 349

phyin/ /'chi ba chos skur rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes bya/ /de la bar do 'char bar mi 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med ro gcig 'gyur/ /rdzogs chen bsgoms pas rig pa tshad phebs nas//nyin mtshan med par rtag tu 'ja' 'ong dang / /thig le lha sku khra chem mthong ba'i mi/ /phyi dbugs chad par gyur pa de yi tshe//'og min gnas nas rdor sems thugs ka nas//'od kyi sbu gu mig gi dkyil du zug /de yi rgyud la rnam shes yar drangs nas/ /rdor sems thugs kur thim pas dbyer med 'dres/ /de la bar do yod pa ma yin te/ /rtags mtshan 'ja' 'od dpag med 'byung bar bshad/ /gal te rnal 'byor rtogs par ldan pa yis//'chi rtags tshang nas 'pho ba drag tu sbyangs//bum chen rlung la nus pa thon pa des//shi nad ma phog gang du 'pho byas na/ /bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing du skye/ /de la bar do yod pa ma yin no//rtags ni 'ja' 'od sku gzugs 'byung bar bshad/ /ro gcig 'bring dang chung ngu'i gang zag rnams/ /bdun gcig bdun gnyis thugs dam bzhugs pa la/ /rtogs pa na 'phar sgom med chung 'bring 'gyur/ /bar do 'char ste lha sku mi 'char zhing / /rang nyid gang 'dod skye pa len pas chog /spros bral 'bring dang chung ngu'i gang zag rnams/ /thugs dam 'dug dang mi 'dug rang dbang che/ /'on kyang rig pa gsal rig dwangs drag pas//thugs dam 'grogs par yang ni sla ba yin//de yan thugs dam bskul ma mi dgos te/ /goms cha che bas shugs kyis zin par 'gyur/ /bdun gsum yan chad dgung zhag nam chad par/ /bzhugs na rtogs pa ro gcig chung 'bring 'phar/ /'di dag bdag gi 'dren mchog bla ma rje/ /tsher lung kun dga' rnam rgyal de yis bzhed/ /spros bral chung 'bring chen po'i rnal 'byor ba/ /mtshams 350

sbyor ma zhan gtsed chung ba na/ /ci byed rang dbang che ba 'dra zhig 'byung / /shi nas gzhi yi 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe//bdun phrag gcig tu de yi ngang la gnas//de ni 'chi ba chos skur sbyong ba yin/ /de tshe tshangs pa'i lam nas 'pho bya bas/ /de nas lus sems bral bar gyur ma thag /bar do ngo shes yi dam bskyed rim bsgom/ /'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba sogs/ /da lta sgrub dus dmigs pa thams cad bsgom/ /bar do'i yid lus de nyid gnas 'gyur nas/ /yi dam lha yi sku ru dngos su 'gyur/ /de ni lha sku phyag rgya chen po ste/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob pa yin//thugs rje byin rlabs yi dam dngos dang mnyam/ /zhag bdun bar du de ltar bsgom pa ni//bar do longs skur sbyangs pa zhes bya'o//de nas rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i/ /yab yum zhal sbyor thugs ga'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byin rlabs bsdus nas yab yum zhal du zhugs/ /byang sems ngo bor zhu nas rdo rje'i lam/ /yum gyi padmar phab pa zhes pa de/ /oṃ yig dkar bo'i rnam par gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyas byang sems sku yi nus pa bstems/ /de dus rang la mngon shes spyan ldan pas/ /sku yis gdul pa'i gdul bya gang yod par/ /rigs ldan zhig gis mngal du oṃ yig 'phangs/ /de la sku yi sprul pa'i sprul sku byon/ /sku lus mdzes shing yid 'od dang ba 'dren/ /de nyid mthong thos reg tshad 'dren par nus/ /de bzhin gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus pa yi/ /āḥ spros 'phangs pas gsung gi sprul pa 'byon/ /gsung bzang dbyangs snyan sde snod bshad la mkhas/ /de yis thos bsam bshad grwa'i bstan la phan/ /de bzhin hūṃ yig spros 'phangs thugs sprul 'byung / /thugs gtum nyams dang 351

rtogs pa shin tu mtho/ /nyams len sgrub pa'i bstan la phan par 'gyur/ /de bzhin yon tan kun bsdus swā yig spros/ /yon tan sprul sku rig gnas kun la mkhas/ /gdul bya longs spyod kyang ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /phrin las byin rlabs bsdus la ha ljang spros/ /phrin las sprul sku mthu rtsal nus pa che/ /'gro don phrin las rlabs chen 'grub par 'gyur//sprul gzhi dngos ni yi dam lhar thim nas//gud du med de dbyer med ro gcig gam/ /rigs 'dus sprul sku dag pa'i zhing du 'byon/ /de ltar zhag bdun bsgom zhing sprul sku spro//shin tu rgyas pa sprul pa lnga po las//yang sprul lnga re sum sprul dpag med 'gyed//de ni sa thob sems dpa'i spyod yul lags/ /sa thob min na sprul ba 'gyed mi nus/ /de nas yi dam bskyed rim bsdus byas la/ /re zhig stong pa nyid du yud tsam gnas/ /de nas sa bon nam ni phyag mtshan nam//yi dam gtso rkyang sku ru sprul byas te//dag pa'i zhing du skar mda' 'phangs bzhin 'gro//zhing der pad ma'i sbubs las brdzus te skyes//sa thob slar yang sprul pas 'gro don byed/ /zhing khams mi bgrod skye ba len pa ni/ /gang yin mi skye mngal ni gdam bya ste/ /rigs rgyud gdung rgyud bzang bor bsams bzhin 'khrungs/ /las can skyes bu de 'dra ma gtogs pa/ /bla ma gong ma'i thugs bskyed smon lam dang //bka' srung chos skyong rnams la gnyer gtad pas//phal pa gdud rgyud bzang por nye mi nus//gal te skyes kyang bka' srung de yis bsgral//gdung rgyud ngo mtshar che don de ltar lags//snying rje che zhing sems dpa' mthun rkyen rnams/ /pha ma sdig can nam ni dbul phongs la/ /snying rje'i dbang gis skyob phyir skye ba len/ /rgyal ba mchog sogs sprang por skye don de/ /pha ma ma rungs las ngan bdud 'dre'i rigs/ /de 'dra'i kha non phyir du 'khrungs 352

pa'ang yod/ /pha ma sbas tshul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rigs/ /rigs mthun phyir na de 'drar skye ba'ang yod//pha ma sngags 'chang rtsa rlung dbang thob pas//skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad phyir skye/ /bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes pa de lags so/ /bar do'i skabs su pha ma de mthong tshe/ /'gro don rgya chen bskyed pa'i sems bskyed kyi/ /pha ma gnyis po yi dam yab yum bsgom/ /ma yi mngal de rin chen gzhal yas dbus//byang sems dkar dmar nyi ma zla ba'i gdan//gsang dbang zhu ba'i 'dun las mngal du zhugs//rang gi rnam shes yi dam sa bon bsgom//de las 'od 'phros rgyal kun byin rlabs bsdus/ /tshur 'dus bdag thim rdo rje rtse lngar gyur//de las rang nyid lha yi skur bsgom ste//bstan pa'i bdag po 'dod na shākya thub/ /dge bshes mkhas pa 'dod na 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'gro don rgya chen 'dod na spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu dang stobs shugs che 'dod gsang ba'i bdag /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul che 'dod pad ma 'byung / /de ltar bsgom pa'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum/ /byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum srung bar bsam/ /gzhal yas sgo bcad rta mgrin gcig gis srung / /dang po de ltar bsgoms par byas mod kyi//de nas nyams len ngang la bzhag byas pas//lus ni ma rdzogs bar du mi dran no//lus rdzogs sems dpa' chen po 'ga' res dran//gsung bsgrags yig drug la sogs 'don pa lags/ /'khrungs tshe nyid nas dran par ma gsungs te/ /'khrungs nas langs gog bsre dus bar du dran/ /de nas brdab log re phogs brjed ces grags/ /stobs chen yin na mi brjed smra ba yin/ /de yang sa lam mtho bas dran pa dang / /smon lam stobs kyis dran pa gnyis su yod/ /phal cher chung tshe dran cing smra ba la/ /che nas mi dran grib kyis 353

phog pa'o/ /chung tshe rtag med ci yang mi dran pa/ /phyis nas mtshams bsgrubs byas pas mang du dran/ /de ni mngal gyi dri ma sangs pa yin/ /tshe sngon mkhas grub bzang po yin na yang //pha ma'i khu khrag mi gtsang rdzas des sgrib//re zhig nyams rtogs yon tan kun med kyang //phyis nas brda' ston tsam kyis chog pa lags//deng sang sku skye zhes byar yongs su grags/ /rtse gcig 'bring dang chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'chi rkyen bzang zhing gnad gcod chung ba dang / /thugs dam bskul mi yod na zin mod kyi//de la gol sa mang po yod ba'i tshul//sbyor drug lugs kyi ngo sprod 'ga' nas gsal/ /rtse gcig nyams yin rtogs pa ma thob phyir/ /bde gsal nyams la chags zhen che na ni/ /thugs dam gsal zhing shin tu brtan na yang / /'dod khams gzugs khams gnas su skye bar nges/ /stong nyams 'dzin pa zhugs pa'i thugs dam des/ /gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir skye 'gyur te//mi khom gnas te tshe ring lha yin no//de la thos grol dbu nas bshad pa ltar//rna bar kha gtad ngo sprod yang yang bya//de yis nyams kyi zhen pa de dag nas//spros bral rtogs pa'i ngo bo mthong bar 'gyur/ /rtse gcig chu'i thugs dam mi zin gsungs//'on kyang bskyed rim lha yi nga rgyal ni//brtan po yod na zin cing yun ring brtan/ /gsal stong min pa'i ther zug bskyed rim la/ /gol sa brgya phrag yod par rgyud las gsungs/ /zhi ba bsgoms pas 'dod khams gzugs khams lha//khro bo bsgoms pas bdud dang srin por skye//mgo brnyan bsgoms pas sha za phra men ma/ /hūṃ yig dngos por grub la sems gtad pas/ /de ni sbrul gyi lus su skye bar gsungs/ /dam tshig nyams shing khro bo'i skur gsal bas/ /lha de'i gzugs can 'dre yi lus su skye/ /de 'dra byung tshul lo rgyus dpag tu med/ /de 354

'dra thugs dam brtan pa'i rigs byung na/ /kho rang yi dam gang yin mngon rtogs bklags/ /de yang gdos bcas ther zug mi sgom shing / /snang stong chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar sgom zhes/ /yang yang gsal gang bgegs de sel ba yin/ /zhi gnas 'thom pa 'thug po skyes pa yang / /thugs dam grangs su 'gro ba ma yin te/ /zhag bdun phung por gnas pa yod par gsungs/ /de la gnas pa'i ngo bo ltos shig dang / /stong gsal ci yang med pa yin no zhes//ngo sprod gdab na cung zhig phan nam snyam/ /de dag chos sgor zhugs pa rnams yin te/ /tha mal pa la ngo sprod gdab rgyu med//sangs rgyas mtshan bsgrags 'pho ba'i dmigs pa zab//sngas 'gor 'pho 'debs lan gcig yin mod kyang / /rke rtses chad nas zhag bdun zhag gsum bar//thun bzhir dmigs pas lan grangs brgya tsam spar//tshe 'das skyid sdug de la re ba'i phyir/ /sngas mgo'i gyer dbyangs tsam gyis chog mi 'dzin/ /zhag skor 'pho ba'i sgrub pa 'dra ba bya/ /cho ga chos spyod gzhan las de gal che/ /dmigs pa ma gtogs gsol 'debs mi dgos so/ /de nas lus sems bral bar gyur pa nas/ /phyir ldog la sogs sgrib sbyong gang 'grub dang / /dgung zhag bar du thos grol ngos sprod bya//khyad par bdun phrag gsum pa bzhi pa'i skabs//phal cher skye ba len pa'i dus yin pas/ /dag pa'i zhing du lam ston yang yang bya/ /chags zhen spang phyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad/ /ting 'dzin gsal bas rnam shes zhing der 'phangs/ /'phen tshul dmigs pa gud du gsal ba ltar/ /de skor zhag bar thun bzhir rtse gcig bsgom/ /'dod pa'i dbang gis bsgoms kyang mi phan pas/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang //byams dang snying rje drag po'i ngang nas bsgom//ha cang sdig stobs chen po 355

ma yin na/ /de yis tshe 'das nges par drangs par 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir mtshams med byas pa'i sdig can ni/ /phyi dbugs chad skabs 'pho ba theb na drongs/ /de yang dag pa'i zhing du mi skye ste//lha lus mi lus gtsang ma zhig tu skye//gal te 'pho ba theb par ma gyur na/ /bshad ba'i lam nas rnam shes thon ma thag /chu nang rdo 'phangs bzhin du dmyal bar 'gro//de la bar do yod pa ma yin te/ /de ni mar gyi zang thal zhes su grags/ /de dag ma gtogs thams cad bar do bgrod/ /ngo sprod so sor byas pas grol ba mang / /grol na gshin rje'i khrims ra 'grim mi dgos//ma grol gshin rjes dge sdig gshag ral byas//gar skye lung ston de yi tshe tshad kyang / /gshin rje'i khro yig bri nas gtong ba yin/ /dge sdig ci yang ma byas gtang snyoms pa//gar yang mi skye lus ni mi len par//rnam shes 'khyam po grangs med bsam las 'das//gzugs med khams su skyes pa'i sems can rnams//de dang 'dra la khad kyang mi 'dra ste/ /dran pa med par rnam shes rgyun tsam zhig /bskal ba brgyad khri'i bar du lus mi len/ /de nas lus blangs slar yang 'khor bar 'khyams/ /de dag thams cad 'khor ba'i sems can yin/ /thar pa mya ngan 'das pa zhes bya ba/ /nyan thos dgra bcom rang rgyal dgra bcom gnyis/ /tshe 'dir nyon mongs thams cad rtsad nas bcom//gtan nas skye rgyu med pas dgra bcom zer/ /de nyid sku tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags nas sku lus las//me dang chu yi rgyun babs rdzu 'phrul ston//thugs las me 'bar sku lus phung bo bsregs//ring bsrel char babs lhung bzed chos gos ltung //sems ni stong nyid ngang la bzhugs pa las//bskal ba brgyad khri'i bar du lus mi len/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'od zer phog pa yis/ /dran pa rnyed nas byang 356

chub sems bskyed nas/ /rim gyis bla med byang chub bsgrub par gsungs/ /thar ba zhes bya dgra bcom zhes bya yin//sangs rgyas thams cad chos sku gcig pa ste//gzugs dang kha dog dngos po med na yang / /'gro ba'i tshogs bsag don du gzugs sprul ba/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang yum chen mo//sangs rgyas thams cad longs sku lnga yin te/ /phung lha rnam dag rgyal ba rigs lnga'o/ /rang re sems can rgyud kyi ye shes ni/ /bum pa'i nang gi nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /nam mkha' chung ngu gcig las yod pa min/ /bum pa chag tshe phyi yi nam mkha' dang / /dbyer med 'dres nas so sor phye rgyu med//de bzhin sems can sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus//sangs rgyas kun dang chos sku gcig tu gyur//dus skabs so sor 'ja' tshon shar na yang //kha dog lnga yi ngo bo gcig pa ltar/ /longs sku thams cad rigs lnga'i ngo bor gcig /dper na mtshan mo lha khang chen po'i nang / /mar me brgya stong dus gcig sbar ba na/ /mar me so sor yod pa sprul sku'i dpe/ /'od rnams gcig tu 'dres pa longs sku'i dpe/ /de rnams lha khang nang gi nam mkha' ni/ /gcig gi khong du chud pa chos sku'i dpe/ /de ni sems can mang po gsar du ni/ /yar la sangs rgyas thob dus dbyer med dam//yab sras la sogs spar nas sangs rgyas pa//sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya 'byon pa'i dpe//mtshan mo sprin med nam mkha' chos sku'i dpe/ /de la nya rgyas zla shar longs sku'i dpe/ /sa gzhir mtsho chung dwangs pa du yod pa/ /de ni gdul bya 'gro ba rnams kyi dpe/ /de nang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba de/ /sprul sku bye ba phrag brgya'i dpe yin te/ /chu rnyog phyir na zla gzugs mi snang ba/ /sprul sku mya ngan 'das pa'i dpe yin te/ /'das dang bltams dang bzhugs pa la sogs pa/ /don la ma grub gdul bya'i mthong tshul 357

lags/ /bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyang ni de dang 'dra/ /skye dgu rnams kyi bsod nams che chung khyad/ /de dag myong bas grub pa ma mchis kyang / /mdo rgyud bka' gter gsar rnying du ma nas//dgongs pa mthun dang 'dra min du ma'i tshogs//rgya cher bshad pa thos pa'i shes rab kyi/ /de don cung zad yid la yod pa rnams/ /go rim med par gang dran smras pa yin/ /lung 'dren bris na yi ges 'jigs pas bzhag /bshad phyogs re re tsam re ma mthun yang / /'gal bar mi sems bshad lugs mang po'i don/ /mdo rgyud gsar rnying kun la gzigs pas gsal/ /de don nyams su lon par dka' na yang / /so so'i dbye ba shes par bya ba'i phyir/ /rta lo khrums zla'i dmar po'i tshes bcu gcig /bcu gnyis snga dro'i thun mtshams gnyis kyi tshe/ /dge slong ra ga a sus smras pa rnams/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis//blo dman gsar bu rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /tshegs la ma brtsis mang yang yi ger bkod/ /'di ni ha cang zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /skyes chen chos kyi spyan ldan ma gtogs pa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis ji bzhin rtogs dka' bas//dper na yang dgon pa yi ri chos las//rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad gsungs pa yang / /nyid kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul rnams/ /mngon sum gzigs nas gsungs pa yin mod kyang / /de ni phyogs re tsam las ma gtogs zhes/ /rang byung rgyal bas nang don ṭī kur bkag /de bzhin 'dir yang mahogs log rtog dang / /phyogs rtogs 'khrul ba'i cha ni gang mchis pa /mkhas grub chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la bshags/ /'di ni bstan bcos brtsams pa'ang ma yin pas//dpe la ma bltas bsam blo ma btang bar//byung rgyal nyams mgur tshul du smras pa la/ /go rim mang po 'chol bar gyur ba rnams//dge bshes 358

mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling dar rgyas shog/le'u zhe gcig pa'o maṅga lam̐//zhing khams gdam pa dad dpon nor len/lta|ljiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ zhing khams 'dam pa ded dpon nor len zhes bya ba bzhugs so//e ma ho//bu rig pa can gyi brtson 'grus pas//tshe ci ltar gal te ring na yang / /lo brgya las mi thub 'chi dus kyi/ /don gnad 'gag chen po'i dri ba byas/ /'di chos pa kun la do gal che/ /tshe 'di la tshogs bsag sgrib sbyong ba/ /rta bzang po sga srab byas pa 'dra/ /de bsngo smon srab kyis kha bsgyur nas/ /rang gar 'dod zhing khams bgrod par chog/spyir sangs rgyas kun gyi gzigs snang dang / /ma 'gro drug kun gyi 'khrul snang las/ /zhing dag dang ma dag grangs med yod/ /gnas 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams de/ /spyir nam mkhas khyab tshad zhing khams yin/ /las dag pa rnams kyi snang ngo la/ /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / /nang bcud kyi sems can yi dam lha/ /der 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ming yang med/ /spyir nam mkhas gar khyab 'khor 'das kun/ /de rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs gyis khyab//de sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yin//de gsang ba bstan pa'i mdo las bshad/ /rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed grangs/ /der dag pa'i zhing khams brjod mi langs//der rgyal ba sras bcas chos 'khor bskor/ /de gcig gis gcig la mi gnod de/ /dpe stong gsum yungs dkar 359

nang du tshud//de stong gsum chung du ma song zhing / /phyi yungs dkar che ru ma song ba//de sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul te//zhing nam mkhas gar khyab thams cad kun/ /dpe til gyi gong bu kha phyes ltar/ /der rgyal ba sras bcas rtag tu bzhugs/ /de sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzigs tshul lags//mar sems can rnams kyi snang ngo la/ /gnas rigs drug sdug bsngal so sor snang / /dpe dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams/ /de rmi lam lta bu ma yin te/ /dus da lta rang re mi rnams bzhin/ /rang so so'i snang ngor gdos bcas grub/ /dus da lta'i stong gsum 'jig rten 'di/ /mi rnams la brkel pa mar 'grib snang / /khong sems can la la'i snang ba la/ /'di bskal pa zhig nas stong par mthong / /khong la las bskal pa chags par mthong //sa nam mkha' mthong ba'i sems can mang //khong la las nam mkha' sa ru mthong //khong la las 'og phyogs steng du mthong //khong la las steng phyogs 'og tu mthong / /de la sogs snang ba bsam mi khyab/ /rang so so'i ngo bo bden par grub/ /de rgyas par dkon brtsegs mdo las gsal/ /de sems can snang ba tha dad yin//de stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten khams//mi thams cad las mthun mthong tshul mthun/ /de 'khor 'das gnyis kyi zhing khams so/ /e ma ho/ /gnas 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na/ /shar mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams yod/ /gnas de na mi 'khrugs rgyal ba bzhugs/ /lha rdor sems mi 'khrugs mi bskyod gcig /shar baiḍūrya snang zhing khams na/ /lha bcom ldan sman pa'i rgyal po bzhugs/ /de bzhin du sman bla mched bdun ni/ /zhing so sor bde gshegs so sor bzhugs/ /gnas 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpal longs spyod ldan pa'i zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na rin chen 'byung ldan bzhugs/ / 360

mtshan rin chen tog ces grags pa yin/ /sa 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na/ /dpal las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na don yod grub pa bzhugs/ /mtshan me tog cher rgyas zhes su grags/ /zhing de dag dag pa'i zhing khams te//de longs sku chung ngu'i zhing du 'dod//don sprul sku'i zhing khams chen por rtsi/ /sa dang bo yan chad ma thob pa'i/ /zhing de dag rnams su skye mi srid/ /de ma gcig lab kyi sgron mas gsungs/ /don mi 'khrugs bkod pa'i mdo dang mthun//gnas 'og min 'thug po bkod pa de//rgya che chung bsam las 'das pa yin/ /rgyan bkod pa longs spyod 'thug drags pas/ /der 'thug po bkod ces ming du grags/ /zhing de dbus rin chen gzhal yas khang / /tshad bsam las 'das pa gcig gi dbus//gdan seng khri pad ma nyi zla'i steng //spyir sangs rgyas kun gyi sku 'dus shing / /lha spyan ras gzigs dbang longs sku'i cha/ /de nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas nges pa 'og min 'thug po bkod//dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs/ /'khor nges pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems/ /chos nges pa theg chen bla med de/ /de zhal nas mi gsungs brda' yis ston//lha de yi ba spu re re'i nang / /der sprul sku'i zhing khams dpag med chags/ /der gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro don mdzad/ /de longs sku'i zhing khams chen po yin/ /de rnam snang mngon byang rgyud las gsungs//lha de yi phyag mthil lhung bzed nang //der me tog pad sdong dpag med skyes/ /de re re'i steng du zhing khams mang / /de'i dbus mar me tog pad sdong gcig/de me tog nyer lnga brtsegs mar skyes//de re re'i steng du zhing khams mngaka/der me tog bcu gsum pa yi steng //de ze'u 'bru phrum phrum re re'i nang / /der 'jig rten khams ni dpag med yod/ /de'i 361

ze'u 'bru dbus ma gcig gi nang / /zhing 'di yi stong gsum 'jig rten chags//'dir ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang //gling bzhi po bye ba phrag brgya yod//de sprul sku gcig gi gdul zhing ste//lha shāka thub bye ba phrag brgya dang //rje pad 'byung bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /chos mdo dang sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /zhing 'di ru mchog dman su yang skye/ /don de tsho sdong po bkod pa'i mdo/ /rje srong btsan o rgyan sogs kyis gsungs//gnas 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams der//sa brgyad pa man chad skye mi srid/ /de ye shes ḍā ki lab sgron gsungs/ /don sa lam bshad pa kun dang mthun//bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde nas/ /gnas dur khrod me ri 'bar ba zer/ /rgyud mgon po khrag mtsho khol chen nas/ /dpal rnam par snang mdzad dur khrod zer/ /lha rnam par snang mdzad chen po de'i / /mdun bar snang khams su zhing khams yod/ /sa thams cad dug tsher gdug pa skyes/ /nyin rlung 'tshub mtshan mo me ru 'bar/ /ri thams cad keng rus rus pa'i ri/ /de rtsi shing nags tshal mtshon char skyes/ /chu thams cad khrag rnag rba klong 'khrugs/ /der gcan gzan gdug pa lang lang 'khrugs/ /zhing de dbus thod pa'i gzhal yas khang / /de khro bo'i dkyil 'khor mngon rtogs bzhin/ /lha gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan zhes/ /don che mchog khrag 'thung rigs drug la/ /lha yi dam khro bo ḍākki'i tshogs//der bla med gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor//zhing de yang 'gyur med rtag tu gnas/ /de rig 'dzin sa thob ma gtogs pa/ /zhing de ru skye bar mi srid cing //gzhan sems can phal pa lta ci smos//sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor phyin na yang / /der skrag cing bsngangs nas brgyal nas 'bros/ /dus deng sang rig 'dzin sa thob cing / /las drag po'i phrin las kho na yis/ /ma sems can 362

'dren par byed pa rnams/ /zhing de ru skyes nas gsang sngags spyod/ /de rig 'dzin chen po'i zhing khams lags/ /der ye shes dang ni las grub pa'i/ /chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad bzhugs/ /zhing de yi 'od zer phog pa tsam//gnas bsil ba'i tshal dang dur khrod brgyad/ /rgyan bkod pa brda' tsam yod par gsungs/ /der sprul pa'i chos skyong thams cad bzhugs/ /dus deng sang gsang sngags tshul bzhin spyod/ /da 'on kyang dam tshig cher chags na/ /gnas dur khrod brgyad dang bsil tshal gyi/ /lha ma mgon chos skyong 'khor du skye/ /dus deng sang chos skyong phrin las kyis//mi sdig can bsgral ba thams cad kyang //des dag pa'i zhing khams mi 'thob kyang //mar ngan song gnas su mi gtong bar//lha chos skyong so so'i 'khor du skye/ /de lung bstan bka' rgya ma sogs gsal/ /da stong gsum 'di yi dbang byas na/ /steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang na/ /rje rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po bzhugs/ /dus deng sang sdom pa'i tshul khrims gtsang / /chos thos bsam kho nar 'bad pa'i mi/ /zhing de ru smon lam btab pa na/ /dus nam zhig phyi dbugs chad ma thag /lha byams pa'i dpral ba'i mdzod spu na/ /'od dkar po phu dung sang brkyang 'dra/ /mi de yi spyi bor 'ja' ltar zug /sems rig pa 'od des gtums nas drangs/ /gnas dga' ldan lha yi pho brang na/ /gdan me tog pad cha/'i steng rtsaskye//'khor lha mo bdun res rtag tu mchod//rje byams pa mgon pos chos gsungs kyang / /der skyid dga' glu gar rtsed mor 'byams/ /dus ma 'ong sa byams pa 'dir byon tshe/ /de thams cad tshe 'phos mir skyes nas/ /slar rab tu byung zhing dam chos nyan/ /rje byams pa'i bstan pa ma rdzogs par/ /de mi nas mir skye bstan pa 'dzin/ /de bzhin du bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong / /de 363

thams cad mjal zhing dam chos nyan/ /des sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa'i yun/ /dus rtag du mir skye bstan pa 'dzin/ /de bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rdzogs nas//dus ma 'ongs kurma bkram sa yi//ming yod pa'i bskal pa yongs su chags//zhing de ru sangs rgyas brgyad khri 'byon//de thams cad zhal mthong chos thos shing / /de kun gyi bstan pa 'dzin byas nas/ /dus de nas rim gyis sangs rgyas 'thob/ /de byams pa'i lung bstan mdo nas bshad/ /dus deng sang dga' ldan skye ba yi//gnad bsngo pa smon lam mdzad mkhan mang //don 'gro don dpag med 'grub pa dang / /rje rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong phyir/ /lus skye 'chi dung phyur mi 'chor na/ /gnas dga' ldan gnas su smon lam thob//chos byams smon thugs dam chags med mdzod/ /mi bdag kyang lo bdun de ltar byas/ /ngas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di mthong bas/ /da skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal rab tu 'tsher/ /chos byams smon bzhag nas bde smon bton/ /gnas dga' ldan lha yi pho brang ni//de sprul sku'i zhing khams chung ngu yin/ /gnas 'di nas nyi ma lho nub mtshams//lho 'dzam bu'i gling phran srin po'i yul//gnas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtse/ /dpal pad ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na/ /rje o rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /'khor rig 'dzin ḍāki 'bum gyis bskor/ /chos rnying ma byas pa'i gang zag kun//zhing de ru smon lam 'debs mkhan mang //dpal o rgyan rje la mos drags pas/ /mi bdag gi slob dpon gnas der bzhugs/ /mi bdag kyang gzhon tshe de ru smon/ /skye sla bas mi skye dogs pa med/ /da 'on kyang legs par bsam byas pas//zhing de ru skye lugs bzang ngan gnyis/ /rab rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍā ki'i rigs/ /sku rus pa'i rgyan drug dur khrod chas/ /lus 'dod 364

dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul can//dpal o rgyan chen po'i 'khor dang g.yog/mi phal gyis mi mthong gdos bcas min/ /der skyes na gsang sngags nyams su len/ /'phral skyid cing phug tu mngon sangs rgyas/ /don de 'drar gyur na legs mod de/ /lus mi sdug sha za srin po'i bu/ /de srin po yin phyir dug lnga che/ /rje o rgyan zhal mthong gsungs thos kyang / /de rgyal po yin snyam dad gus chung / /des gsungs bzhin mi bsgrub log spyod na/ /khrims gcod pas dad pa logs kyang srid/ /lar skyid sdug tshe yi ring thung sogs/ /de gling g.yog yin phyir 'di dang 'dra/ /las skal ba cung zhig ldan srid na/ /rje o rgyan byin brlabs dbang bskur nas/ /khyod 'di ru ma 'dug bod du song / /chos spyod cing 'gro don 'byung ngo zhes/ /'dug 'dod kyang 'dug dbang med pa srid/ /mi nga ni skye 'chi 'di la 'tsher//khyed skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal mi 'tsher zhing / /dpal pad 'byung rje la dad drags pas/ /don ci gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrub nus na/ /gnas rnga yab gling der smon lam thob//de sprul sku'i zhing khams chung ngu yin//der skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kun/ /dus bskal ba bzang po'i yun tsam la/ /gnas ma nges gar yang skye srid de/ /mthar bde ba can du skye rgyu yin/ /don de tsho gsang ba'i rnam thar dang / /rje lang gro lo tsā'i zhus lan gsal/ /dus deng sang yig drug 'don mkhan kun/ /gnas po ṭa la ru smon lam 'debs/ /lha sgrub thabs 'ga' nas de ltar bshad//rgya dkar bo'i skad du po ṭa la/ /bod skad du ri bo gru 'dzin yin//de zhing khams ma yin gnas ri yin//las dag pa rnams kyi snang ngo la//ri rtse mor rin chen gzhal yas khang / /gdan padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng / /lha byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ /'khor rig 'dzin ḍā ki lha klus 365

bskor//ri'i sked par rin chen gzhal yas su/ /lha khro gnyer can dang rta mgrin sogs/ /ri rtsa bar rin chen gzhal yas su/ /lha sgrol ma dkar sngon la sogs bzhugs/ /de ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ngo la/ /ri bye ri chen po'i tsandan nags/ /rtser rang byung rdo yi lha khang nang //lha kha sar pa ṇi rang byon gyi/ /sku lo brgyad bu chung na tshod can/ /rgyab baiḍūrya ya yi brag ri la/ /dngul zhun ma'i rang byon yig drug yod//de dngos su phyin yang mjal bas chog/de dge bsnyen lcags kyi rkang pa can/ /rje rin chen gling pa'i rnam thar gsal/ /lha bde mchog phag mo yi dam mkhan/ /nub o rgyan yul du skye bar smon/ /de zhing khams ma yin gnas ri ste/ /las dag pas dur khrod gzhal yas dbus/ /lha bde mchog yab yum dngos su bzhugs/ /'khor dpa' po ḍā ki bye ba 'bum/ /las ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ngo la/ /gnas rang byung rdo yi lha khang nang / /bka' rgyud sde thams cad gter du bzhugs/ /mi gcig kyang med pa'i bud med gling / /de thams cad mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin skad//der skye lugs rnga yab gling dang 'dra/ /shar rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga dang / /lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri na/ /nub gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti se rnams/ /las dag pa'i snang ngor gzhal yas khang / /lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag med bzhugs//rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lus blangs nas//yun ring na skal pa rdzogs pa'i bar//yun thung na sangs rgyas re re'i ring //rang 'ja' lus dpa' bo mkha' 'gror skyes/ /de mkha' spyod chung ngu'i zhing khams yin/ /lam gsang sngags nyams su len pa yi/ /khong grub thob phal cher de ltar bzhugs/ /las ma dag sems can der phyin yang / /lha mi mthong nags tshal gangs kyi ri/ /rab phyin yang phal cher mi mthong dogs/ /don de phyir bdag kyang 'dod pa 366

med//khyod brtson 'grus rgya mtshos ci 'drar dgongs//byang sham bha la zhes bya ba de/ /don rgya gar dang 'dra mi yi yul/der sprul pa'i rgyal bo rgyun mi chad/ /chos dus kyi 'khor lo dar mod kyang / /tshe ring thung skyid sdug 'di dang 'dra/ /bon rnams kyis smon lam 'debs tshul ni//gnas zhang zhung yul du skye bar smon//de ti se'i rgyab phyogs bod yul yin/ /bon dar kyang skyid sdug 'di dang 'dra//don de phyir zhing khams 'dam ma nor/ /sa 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /grangs gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed/ /de 'das pa'i 'jig rten pha mtha' na/ /zhing 'di bas steng du 'phags pa'i sa/ /nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod/ /der bde skyid ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs/ /las mi dge sdug bsngal ming yang med/ /sngon 'od dpag med kyi smon lam mthus/ /zhing de ru smon lam btab pa na/ /sdig mtshams med lnga dang chos spangs pa//de ma gtogs su yang skye bar gsungs//rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /lam dge bcu bsod nams rgya chen bsags/ /de thams cad zhing der skye phyir bsngo/ /sems ma yengs rtse gcig dad gus kyis/ /zhing de ru skye ba'i bsngo smon ni/ /lan bcu tsam byas pas skye bar gsungs/ /de mi bden snyam du the tshom na/ /zhing de ru skye bar gyur kyang ni/ /lo lnga brgyar me tog kha mi bye/ /der bde skyid longs spyod ldan pa dang / /'od dpag med kyi gsungs thos kyang / /lo lnga brgyar zhal mthong 'phyi skyon 'gyur/ /don de phyir the tshom spang mdzod la//khyed zhing khams de ru smon lam thob//khyod 'chi dus rig pa de ru gtod/ /khyed de la the tshom skyes pa na/ /chos dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i le'u ste/ /chos 'od mdo bde chen zhing bkod mdo/ /chos padma dkar po'i mdo sde dang / /chos da lta'i sangs rgyas bzhugs mdo dang / /dpal 'chi med rnga 367

sgra'i gzungs la sogs//dpe de rnams glegs bam legs par gzigs//dus da ltar rang dbang che skabs 'dir/ /dus da lta zhing khams legs par gdam/ /der 'gro ba'i rgyags phye grabs su tshud//der 'gro la thogs pa med par mdzod//e ma ho/ /he he/ /bu dge slong brtson 'grus rgya mtsho bas/ /zhing de yi yon tan gang yin zer/ /dpal sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig ni/ /phrag brgyad cu rtsa gcig zhing khams kyi/ /rgyan bkod pa yon tan gcig tu bsdoms/ /ma 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa//de thams cad rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur nas//yun bskal ba las kyang lhag gi bar/ /zhing de yi yon tan gsungs gyung kyang / /de yongs rdzogs brjod par mi nus gsungs//de bdag gis brjod par ga la nus//nub bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams//de chags pa yod de 'jig pa med//sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med byon//dus da lta 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /dus nam yang 'pho 'gyur dar gud med/ /rgya bsam gyis mi khyab rtsis las 'das//der mi khom gnas brgyad thos ma myong / /der sdug bsngal zhes bya mi srid cing / /dus rtag tu bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /don de phyir bde ba can zhes bya/ /gdan me tog padma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /yun skad cig tsam gyis lus grub ste/ /de byis pa ma yin dar ma'i dus/ /dbu gtsug tor zhabs la 'khor lo sogs/ /mtshan so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cur ldan//der skyes tshad thams cad mtshungs pa ste/ /sku gser mdog dge slong cha lugs tshul/ /sems mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan//sems nyon mongs dug lnga gcig kyang med/ /der rgas dang na ba'i sdug bsngal med/ /tshe grangs med bskal pa mtha' yas te/ /der dus min 'chi ba srid pa min//dus nam zhig de nas tshe 'phos nas//der skye ba gzhan gyis bar mi chod// 368

der rdzogs sangs mi rgya srid ma yin/ /de da lta smon lam las 'bras kyi/ /rang bsam zhing 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /de byon na ma gtogs 'khor ba ru/ /phyir mi ltung skye ba len mi srid/ /gnas gzhal yas khang dang bza' btung sogs/ /de yid la bsam tsam lhun gyis grub//der rtsol sgrub so nam dgos pa min//de zos pas tshim zhing bkrag mdangs rgyas/ /snyigs mi gtsang bshang lci yong ba min/ /der tha mal bud med med na yang / /rang mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med kyis / /dus rtag tu rang la bsnyen bkur byed//dus rtag tu sangs rgyas mi 'bral zhing //des bsnyen bkur mchod sprin dpag med pa/ /rang lag pa'i mthil nas gang 'dod 'byung / /zhing de yi gtso bo 'od dpag med/ /des rtag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /gnas rnga yab bye ba phrag brgya na/ /rje o rgyan bye ba phrag brgya dang / /bod 'od mtshan cod pan nyi shu gcig /de bye ba phrag brgya 'byon pa rnams/ /de 'od dpag sprul pa'i cha shas re//don o rgyan dngos ni 'od dpag med//gnas po ṭa la ni spyan ras gzigs//bod srong btsan sgam dang marma ka /don de bzhin bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong //de thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyis sprul/ /de spru la gzhi spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos/ /de 'od dpag med kyi nye gnas tshul/ /dus rtag tu sku gzhogs g.yas su bzhugs//gnas lcang lo can du gsang ba'i bdag /des yang sprul grags pa'i mtshan can sogs/ /de bye ba phrag brgya sprul na yang / /de sprul gzhi sems pa mthu chen thob/ /de sku gzhogs g.yon du rtag tu bzhugs//gnas 'dzam gling 'di nas der byon pa'i//dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub dwags po rje//rje khyung po rnal 'byor bsod nams rtse//gdong mkha' spyod nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / /rje ngong pa rdo rje 'chang la sogs/ /spyir byang chub 369

sems dpa' bye ba ni//phrag khrag khrig bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni//zhing 'di nas der skye thub pas gsungs/ /rje mthong ba don ldan sku rgyab ma'i/ /sku bkod pa gcig kyang der bzhugs gsungs/ /'khor dge slong 'bum phrag yod par bshad/ /bu brtson 'grus nam zhig tshe 'phos tshe//zhing de ru 'byon pa'i thugs thag chod/ /da bsam blo legs par thong mdzod dang / /mar ngan song sdug bsngal bsam mi tshugs//yar lha mi'i bde skyid rmi lam tsam//dus snyigs ma bstan pa mar 'grib skabs/ /rang mi nas mi ru skye chog kyang / /rkyen dus min 'chi sogs bar chad mang / /chung lo bcu phan chad bsam pa med/ /dus rtag tu lto gos g.yeng bas khyer/ /tshe phyed kyi mtshan mo gnyid kyis gcod/ /da tshe tshad bzhi bcu kha ral skabs/ /chos byed long med pa ma mthong ngam/ /mi thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga hrag /phan btags pa'i lan la gnod pa skyel/ /rje mkhas grub kun la skur ba 'debs/ /las mi dge bcu la hab thob spyod/ /rje sangs rgyas dngos su byon rnams kyang //dus deng sang 'gro don dka' 'dug na//rang 'gro don mi 'grub sdug bsngal rgyu/ /gnyen nye du grwa slob mthun grogs kun/ /rang shi ba'i rgyab nas yun mi ring / /rang skyes kyang mi 'phrad yid la zhog /rje 'od dpag med kyi sku tshe'i tshad//de bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig 'bum//de sus kyang grangs la mi theb ste//dus nam zhig mya ngan 'das tshul ston//de'i bstan pa bskal pa gang gā'i klung //grangs bye ma snyed ni gnyis par gnas//dus de tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /des rgyal tshab mdzad cing bstan pa skyong / /yun de tshe rang yang dam chos spyod/ /der skyes tshad rdzu 'phrul thogs med pas//shar mngon par dga' dang sman bla'i zhing / /lho dpal ldan byang phyogs las rab rdzogs/ /lho po ṭa la dang rnga yab 370

gling / /nub o rgyan yul sogs zhing kun du/ /rang rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis thogs med bgrod/ /der mchod 'bul dbang dang gdams ngag zhu/ /yun mi 'gor myur du bde chen sleb/ /don de phyir zhing der skyes pa na/ /zhing kun tu skyes dang khyad par med/ /'dir ltad mo lta 'dod 'ong yang chog /zhing 'di ru byams pa seng ge sogs/ /rje sangs rgyas stong rnams nam byon tshe/ /rang 'ong zhing mchod de dam chos zhu/ /zhag mi 'gor bde ba can du slebs/ /dus bskal pa bye snyed gnyis 'das skabs/ /rje 'od dpag dam chos srod la nub/ /dus tho rangs spyan ras gzigs dbang de/ /khong mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /mtshan 'od zer dpal brtsegs rgyal bor gyur/ /de sku tshe bskal ba bye ba ni/ /phrag khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu drug /yun de tshe de yi zhabs 'bring byed/ /de 'das nas de yi dam pa'i chos/ /yun bskal pa dung phyur phrag drug dang / /phrag bye4 4ba 'bum phrag gsum du gnas/ /dus de srid sems dpa' mthu chen thob/ /rje rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bstan pa 'dzin/ /dus de tshe rang yang ting 'dzin bsgom/ /las sgrib gnyis bag chags de nas byang //nam de yi bstan pa rdzogs ma thag/rje mthu chen thob pa sangs rgyas te/ /mtshan yon tan nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal/ /des sku che'i tshad dadza bstan pa'i tshad//rje spyan ras gzigs dang mnyam par gsungs//dus de srid rang yang dam chos spyod/ /rang tshogs gnyis bre kha de nas gang —/ /zhing de 'am zhing khams gang 'dod ru/ /tshe 'phos ma thag tu rdzogs sangs rgyas//don de phyir zhing du skyes tshad rnams/ /lus skye ba gcig des thogs pa yi/ /de sems dpa' sha stag yin no gsungs//bu phan yon de rnams yid la zungs/ /chos bde smon kho na thugs dam mdzad/ /lha 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ /de kho 371

na bsgrub pa dang du longs/ /don de skad rta lo khrums kyi zla/ /dus dmar porṣa tshes brgyad tshes dgu yi//dus dgong thun snga dro'i thun skabs las//bdag dge slong rā ga a sus smras//de brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod//le'u zhe gnyirsā pa'o maṅga lam̐//dag pa'i zhing bgrod rta mchog ba la ha/11spyiljiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las//bskyed rdzogs shes shing nyams len cung zad yod kyang brtan pa ma thob bar 'chi ba glo bur du byung na zhing khams bgrod pa'i gdams ngag rta mchog ba la ha'i bzhon pa zhes bya ba bzhugs po//na mo a mi tabha ya/ /bdag ban rgan rā ga a su la/ /bu brtson 'grus rgya mtshos 'di skad zer//lo brgya las mi thub 'chi dus kyi//skabs de dus bskyed rdzogs ci ltar byed/ /don 'pho ba'i gdams pa ci ltar byed/ /sems rig pa zhing khams gang la gtad/ /lus bem rig bral ba'i sdug bsngal dus/ /skabs de dus sdug bsngal ci ltar bzlog/don 'di la gdams pa thugs rjes zungs//bu gson dang bīrya sā ga ra//dus deng sang bzhi bcu kha ral dus//lo brgya tsam thub pa e srid na/ /dus da lta yod pa'i mi phal cher/ /sang de tsho sa yi steng na med/ /lar skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba ste//de mi myong thabs shig ngas mi shes//de 'chi kha nad gcod sdug bsngal yin/ /don 'chi ba skad cig btang snyoms pa/ /'chi tshar nas bar do'i 'jigs skrag yod/ /de mi myong thabs 'ga' gsungs mod kyang / /mi phal 372

cher chos sgor zhugs pa rnams/ /na gzhon tshe slob gnyer byed la yengs/ /don dbang lung gdams ngag mang thob kyang / /de go yul dpe cha'i steng du lus/ /sems bskyed rdzogs gdams ngag shes na yang / /de brtan pa ma thob rkyen mi khyag /dus nam zhig 'chi nad drag pos theb/ /srung bzlog pa rim gros phyir la thu//phan re ba'i sman pas wa bros byed//sems brtse ba'i grwa slob mchi ma 'don//rang dpon slob dkor zas mang bo zos/ /khyed cis kyang thugs dam bzhugs dgos zer/ /rang bskyed rdzogs brtan pa ma thob pas//rang thugs dam e zin cha med phyir/ /da ro rul chags nas ci zhig byed/ /nga mi 'dug 'pho ba byed do zhes/ /dus 'chi kha rang la'ang jo brdzu byed/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud 'grel las//nad ma phog gang du 'pho dgos kyi//nad phog nas rang nyid 'pho mi nus/ /de gsungs phyir 'pho bsam 'khrul par sems/ /don de dus phan pa'i gdams ngag 'di/ /rje dwags po lha rjes gsungs pa yin/ /nga tshe 'dir de sngon 'chi ma myong / /don de phyir myong ba med na yang / /bdag rang dang 'dra ba'i mched grogs 'ga'//khong 'das tshe gdams ngag 'di bslabs pas//des phan thogs che ba'i lag blangs yod/ /don de phyir 'di nyid snying la 'chang / /go bde phyir lung 'dren mang po bzhag/tshig bshad pa'i na yam phar la skyur//don hril gyis dril na 'di rang yin/ /rang nges par 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /lus yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku//lus nang stong khru ma phu btab bzhin/ /rtsa dbu ma khong stong ka ba ltar/ /de mar sne lte 'og phug sdug gtad/ /dpe smyug ma'i tshigs pa 'gag pa bzhin/ /rtsa phyi dkar nang dmar stong sang nge //rtsa yar sne spyi bor had po lte//dpe skar khung bzhin du gsal ha re/ /gnas spyi gtsug khru gang nam mkha' la/ /373

gdan pad ma stong ldan zla ba'i steng / /rje yab sras la sogs bla ma dang / /don dbyer med skyabs gsum kun 'dus pa/ /rje rgyal ba mgon po 'od dpag med//sku rā ga'i mdog can mtshan dpe rdzogs/ /sku chos gos rnam gsum skyil krung bzhugs//phyag mnyam bzhag lhung bzed bdud rtsi bsnams//nub bde ba can du bzhugs pa dang / /don dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu bsgom/ /de ngag gi nus sam ma nus na/ /sems yid kyis skyabs 'gro lan gsum dang / /ma 'gro drug sems can kun gyi phyir//dus da res 'chi ba chos skur sbyangs//sang bar do longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs/ /dus de nas skye ba sprul pa'i sku/ /nub bde ba can du rdzus skyes nas/ /rje 'od dpag med pa mchod byed cing / /dus nam zhig sa bcu thob pa'i tshe/ /ngas sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed/ /ma 'gro drug sems can 'dren pa la/ /lha spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med shog /de snying nas lan gsum sems bskyed bya//lus longs spyod dge rtsa ci yod dang //rang sems la chags zhen gang yod kyi/ /nor longs spyod mchod cha dpe cha dang / /yul yon bdag grwa slob nye 'brel sogs/ /de thams cad maṇḍal gcig tu bsdus/ /rje 'od dpag med la yid kyis phul//ngag maṇḍal tshigs bcad lan gsum brjod//dpe 'bul ba tshar ba'i yon bdag bzhin/ /de phyin chad de phyogs sems mi 'phreng / /da sus khyer khyer la ci byed kyis/ /mi ngas ni lha la phul tshar snyam/ /sems chags zhen cung zad cis kyang gnod/ /don de phyir chags 'dzin rtsad nas spang / /rang thugs kor thugs dbus dbu ma'i nang / /hrīḥ dmar po tshegs drag bcas pa las/ /hrīḥ de 'dra rim bzhin 'phros pa yi//mar ngan song 'gro ba'i sgo gsum po//'og bshang lam chu lam thig le'i lam/ /yar kha yi lam dang bzhi bo bkag /bar mi 374

dang lha min 'dod lha'i lam/ /gnas lte ba sna g.yon sna g.yas bkag /mi 'khor los sgyur rgyal grul bum dang / /yar gzugs khams lam du skye ba'i lam/ /mig g.yas g.yon rna ba g.yas g.yon bkag /'dir 'dod bzhed mang ste the tshom skyur/ /gnas gzugs khams gzugs med skye ba'i sgo/ /gnas smin mtshams tshangs sme sdud sgo bkag /de thams cad hrīḥ yig dmar po re/ /'od sra mkhregs ldan pas khrig ger bkag /dpe them bu them kyis dgag pa bzhin/ /lus chags 'jig gnyis ka byed pa'i gnas/ /rang lte 'og dbu ma'i nang de ru/ /gdan pad ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi/ /de'i steng du zla dkyil chung ngu'i steng / /rang rnam shes rlung sems kun 'dus pa/ /dbyibs thig le dkar zlum sran ma tsam/ /mdog dkar dmar mdangs ldan 'phar la khad/ /dpe skar khung nang nas mda' 'phangs bzhin/ /yar dbu mar brgyud de rgyangs se thon/ /rje 'od dpag med pa'i thugs mar bstims/ /de yang nas yang du bsgom wig('don) bya/ /dpe skar mda' yang yang chad pa bzhin//lan nyer gcig las ni mi nyung bya//dus de nas rang lus spyan ras gzigs/ /lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i nga rgyal bskyed/ /rang gdams ngag zab mo 'di 'dra bsgom//mi mi 'chi 'dug sa gcig med de//mi nga las skyid pa med snyam pa'i/ /sems zhum pa spang la nga rgyal skyed/ /'di shin tu gal chen yin par gsungs/ /rang snying dbus pad ma zla steng du/ — /thugs hrīḥ yig yi ge drug pas bskor/ /hrīḥ 'od zer nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /lus nang kun shin tu gsal bar bsgom/ /rang sems ngo gtan nas ma rtogs kyang / /'di kho nas thugs dam shin tu brtan/ /sems gnas 'gyu tsam yang mi shes pa'i/ /khong dge bshes mang po'i dgung zhag la/ /sbur bkrag mdangs mi yal thugs 375

dam brtan/ /de thugs ma'i yi dam sa bon la/ /sems rig pa gtad pa ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan bsgom rgyu med pa thag gis chod/ /rang de nas ci yang mi bsgom par/ /sems gang shar ngo bor lta bar bya/ /lus phyi nang 'byung ba'i thigarim dang / /dus de rjes dkar lam dmar lam dang / /de 'char lugs dpag med bshad na yang //yun ring po ma yin se gol tsam//de so sor ngos bzung bya mi dgos/ /sems kho rang ma gtogs 'char rgyu med/ /gang shar lang de yi ngo bo blta//de'i ngang la phyi dbugs chad ma thag/phyi lus la tshor ba ci yang med//nang sems nyid dran med nag thom 'gro/ /dus de tshe gdung bcas gzob cig smra/ /yun 'di 'dug tshod zin med na yang / /lar 'chi kha'i sems de stobs ldan pas/ /de gang bsam thog tu 'gro ba'i phyir/ /mi chos pa rnam dag 'ga' zhig kyang / /'phral 'chi rkyen mtshams sbyor ngan pa'i mthus/ /dbugs 'gro khar zhe sdang smon lam gyis//bdud lha srin drag por skyes la ltos//ston rgan rgon 'chi kha lo tog la/ /srus ma rag bsam pa'i sems kyi mthus//ston 'bras drug 'joms pa de la ltos//sang mi 'gro ka med gal chen dus//sang tho rangs skar rgyan shar tsam na/ /'gro bsam pa'i gnyid kha'i dam bca' des//gnyid de dus sad dang mtshungs par gsungs//rang zhag bdun la sogs nam 'dod par//rang thugs dam 'dug pa'i dam bca' bzung / /de thog tu 'gro ba myong bas grub/ /lus gdung bcas gzab pa tshar dus tsam/ /khyed thugs dam ma yengs brjod du bcug/dus de dus tshogs brgyad mi gsal kyang //ming gzhi yi 'od gsal zhes su grags/ /don ngo bo rjen par nang nas 'char/ /don de yi ngang la gnas par bya//phyi 'brug sgra 'ur chom la sogs la//der rnam rtog rags pa ma skyes na//nang 376

de ru rnam rtog phra'u 'ga'/ /de skyes kyang thugs dam mi grol te/ /don bar do thos grol ngo sprod las/ /phyir rnam shes 'pho rtags ma byung bar/ /mchu rna bar ma reg tsam byas nas/ /tshig ngo sprod yang yang bya bar gsungs/ /de sbyor drug skor nas bshad dang mtshungs/ /don 'di yang nyams len myong bas grub/ /grwa 'khor slob gdung bcas gzab mkhas na/ /de thugs dam grol yang mi yo zhing / /de ma mkhas ma grol na yang yo/ /don 'di yang myong bas lan mang grub//de thugs dam grol dang ma grol rtags/ /'di brtag gzhig shin tu zhib pa gces/ /lus ma skam yi ga ma chad cing / /de 'chi kha skom rtsi sbyong sman mang / /de thugs dam grol ba ma yin kyang / /kha sna dang bu gar rlan sogs 'bab/ /lus skam sgog yi ga yun ring chad/ de thugs dam grol bar gyur kyang ni/ /de grol rtags sna sgor chu ser med//de gnyis po ma yin spyi mtshams la/ /de grol rtags sna nas chu ser 'bab/ /khong sa lam mthon po yin na ni/ /de chu ser thig pa ring bsrel 'gyur/ /rab 'ga' rer spyi bor chu ser 'phrum/ /yang 'chi khar chu gcin 'gags pa 'ga'/ /de thugs dam grol rtags chab gsil 'byung //don 'di yang myong bas lan 'ga' 'gab/ /bka' gsar rnying gter kha gang nas kyang / /mi 'chi dus 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags//lus tshugs thub tsog pur 'dug pa gsungs//phyi rtags mtshan nam mkha' g.ya' dag la/ /de ston ka yin kyang sad mi 'byung / /nang rtags mtshan sha bkrag yun ring gnas/ /don gsang ba'i rtags mtshan ā yig dang / /hūṃ ring bsrel la sogs 'byung bar gsungs/ /don de phyir lus tshugs gdung bcas shes/ /don blta sa sha bkrag kho na yin/ /sku bgres drag sha bkrag med pa la/ /de 'das tsa gsar du gang nas 'byung / /de 'on kyang gson dus sku mdog 377

las/ /de bag tsam dkar mdangs snum bag chags/ /khong gzhon nu yin kyang gson dus las/ /mdog bag tsam dkar zhing snum 'od chags/ /spyan zim bu zhal yang 'dzum pa 'dra//shangs ma rdib rna ba ma 'byar par/ /bzhin dpral ba'i rtsa rnams tshur la langs/ /tshur skyi mo 'then na phar la rang / /dbyar yin yang sbrang bu mi 'khor ro/ /dgun yin yang khengs par mi 'gyur te/ /mdun de ru nyams len yod pa'i mi/ /de phyin cing bsdad na nyams rtogs gsal/ /de thugs dam yin pa'i rtags su nges//spos rol mo gyer dbyangs 'dzem srol gda'/ /de 'dzem srol zhag bdun tshun la che//dpe me stag chung ngu 'da' sla bzhin//da phan chad 'od gsal cher mched pas/ /de 'dzem pa mi dgos gsungs srol gda'/ /don de yang bden par myor bas grub/ /da 'on kyang bla ma khong nyid dang / /'khon dam tshig tshabs chen chags pa'i mi/ /des mjal na thugs dam grol rkyen byed/ /de min pa'i sus mjal gnod pa med/ /don de la nor sa gcig yod pas//mi sdig can sems ngo mi shes pa//de 'chi dus lus tshugs rang tsho thub//ngo nad med dus bzhin snum rtsig ge/ /de thugs dam zin pa ma yin te/ /gdon dri za phung por zhugs pa yin//tshabs ches na ro langs byed nyan yod//de chos drug rgyas pa'i nang nas gsal//don 'di yang lan mang myong bas grub//ros tshig smra bshud pa byed ces thos//lus skam pa'i thugs dam grol rtags ni/ /khrag chu ser gcin sogs ma byung yang //mdog nyams shing sna zhom mig 'bras rdib/ /dbyar yin na sbrang bu 'khor ba dang / /dgun yin na lus po khengs 'dug na/ /de thugs dam grol ba'i rtags su nges/ /sbur bzhu kha thugs dam gshegs gsol zhing / /des lus lha dbang lha bsnyims pa rnams/ /de mchod bstod bya zhing 378

gshegs gsol bya/ /lha rnam snang dam tshig gtso rkyang zhig /slar bskyed nas ye shes mi bstim par/ /dus de nas gnas yig sogs sbyar te/ /de ma byas phung bo bsreg pa na/ /der lus lha dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /de bshig pas sdig pa che zhes gsungs//de byas na rten shugs chung ba 'byung //don lha dang khong gnyis dbyer med du/ /de bsgom nas sreg blugs phul ba la/ /sdig mi 'byung yon tan rten shugs che/ /des gdung sgo thil sogs mi dgos par/ /'phral nyid nas byon pa'i rten zhal rung //yang gal te gshegs gsol byas na ni//slar gdung sgo zhag gsum thil byas te/ /der khong gi yi dam dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /der zhag gsum spyan 'dren mchod gtor 'bul/ /de mi gshegs rus bu rnams la bstims/ /rnga rol mo dang bcas byin 'bebs bya/ /sngags rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas/ /slar bkra shis brjod nas rten zhal bstan/ /der me long ngos nas khrus gsol 'bul//rten 'byon lugs btags grol gzhung mthun 'byung //tshe sngon gyi las 'bras khyad par gyis/ /tshe 'di la thugs dam rtse gcig pa'i/ /lha sku dang sngags sogs mi 'byung zhing / /don med pa'i lha sngags 'byon srid kyang / /lha thams cad ngo bo gcig ba'i phyir/ /der the tshom bskyed par mi bya'o/ /tshe 'di la thugs dam dpag med cing / /sngags bsnyen sgrub mang du them pa la/ /gzhung rnams nas bshad ltar rten 'byon te//don stong nyid kho na bsgom pa la//phyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag ma gtogs pa/ /rten ci yang 'byon par ma gsungs pas/ /rten ci yang byon par ma gyur na/ /khong sbyin bdag dad pa mi log phyir/ /rten bzo thabs mang bo gsungs na yang / /de jo brdzu rdzun tshig che ba'i phyir/ /rang 'dul khrims sdom pa nyams dogs mchis/ /don de phyir rten bzo spang bar bya/ /379

rten ring bsrel byon nges yin na yang / /don de la rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ /rab sa thob yan gyi 'phags pa'i gdung / /de sra mkhregs gzhom gzhig bral ba ste//de yin min lcags gtun nang du bzhag /de gtun mdel lcags kyis drag bsnun na/ /de mi chag lcags la rjes gtod pa/ /de rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom pa'i ring bsrel yin pa'i rtags/ /mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga//ming sha ri ram dang chu ri ram/ /gdung me rir ma dang nya ri ram//de pañtsa ram dang rnam pa lnga//de gdung lnga mthong reg don dang ldan//yang ring bsrel nag po dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /mdog dmar nag kham nag dud kha'i mdog /de bdud dang srin por skye gsungs kyang / /de spyir btang yin gyi nges tig med/ /sngon jo bo rje la'ang nag po mang / /de man la sku gdung ming mi 'thob/ /mdog rigs lnga phra zhib snum la 'dril/ /de brdung na chag pas rdung mi btub/ /snod theb rtse gtsang mar nyi ma'i nang / /rten li mtshad pas thag gis len/ /de byin rlabs ldan pa'i ring bsrel rtags/ /yang bzo ma rdo yi ring bsrel sogs/ /rten li mas len pa ma yin no/ /don log pa'i sdig pa ring srel ni/ /mi mtshams med sdig stobs can la 'byung //de min pa'i las ngan bdud sprul gyi/ /ro sreg tshe pe har rgyal bo des//khos bar chad sro ma spar gang btab//de mi 'os ring bsrel tshan cher 'byung //de dad 'os byas tshad ngan 'gror ltung //de mtshan ma rdzas kyi ring bsrel yin/ /phag ring bsrel can gyi sha zos na/ /de dmyal bar 'gro zhes kun la grags/ /mi dal 'byor chos ldan skye ba bdun//de brtsegs mar blangs la ring bsrel 'byung / /sha rus pa skye bdun ru ci'i rdzas/ /lar rten bzo la sogs min nges na/ /sku yig 'bru byon la 'khrul pa med/ /dbu bum ril dung 380

dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs//de byon na mchog ste nor 'khrul med//thugs ljags dang spyan gnyis grags che yang //de byon pa dang ni ma byon gnyis//don bsregs tshod zin dang ma zin khyad/ /dbyibs gdung g.yog lag pa'i 'du byed tsam/ /dus deng sang thugs ljags spyan 'bras zer/ /'di nor sa mtshar bo gda'o ang / /'dir gdung g.yog rig pa rno ba gces/ /rten byon la khrus gsol rab gnas bya/ /de ma byas sku dang yig 'bru rnams/ /de dang bo gsal yang mi gsal 'gro/ /rten ring bsrel phra zhib mi snang yal/ /mi dad ldan dam tshig gtsang ba'i mgul/ /ci ma byon rus dum btags pa de/ /sku yig 'bru ring bsrel 'byon pa snang //de bzhin du gdung thal thum bu'i nang //sngar med pa'i ring bsrel 'byung ba'ang snang / /mi dam nyams log lta che ba'i mgul/ /sngar byon pa phyis nas med pa'ang 'byung / /don de tsho ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /don de tsho phal cher myong bas grub/ /e ma ho/ /gal te thugs dam brtan po ma zin nas/ /zhag gsum nyi ma'i dros bzhi dus 'phos na/ /bar do'i yid lus ma blangs skabs de la//'od gsal phyag chen ngo bo rjen par 'char/ /de tshe de nyid ngos bzung de ngang bzhag /de yi ngang la yun ring gnas pa na/ /'od gsal gnyis pa zhes bya zin pa yin/ /de nyid ma zin zin yang yun thung na//bar do yid kyi lus su krong gis skye/ /de dus gdos bcas sha khrag lus med kyang / /rmi lam dus ltar lus gcig yod snang 'byung / /shi 'am ma shi rang gis ngo mi shes/ /sngar bzhin khyim dang nye skor de ru 'khor/ /de nas rnam snang la sogs zhi khro'i lha/ /rim pa bzhin du 'char bar bshad na yang / /sngon du 'od gsal brtan po zin na ni/ /de nas lha rnams gcig kyang mi 'char srid/ /bar do gnyis pa cung zad zin nas ni/ /zhag brgyad 381

dus su snang ba mtha' yas 'char/ /'od gsal ma zin zhag bdun nyin par 'char/ /thos grol snang ba mtha' yas 'char gsungs dang / /mdo las bde ba can du skye rgyu rnams/ /mdun du 'od dpag med pa 'byon gsungs pa/ /don gcig zhag brgyad nyin par 'char bar nges/ /de phyir zhag bdun thugs dam 'dug pa dang / /thugs dam grol dang 'od dpag 'char ba gnyis/ /dus mnyam 'ong rgyu byas pas legs pa ste/ /da lta blo rtse gtad phyogs smon lam mthus/ nges par 'char zhing de yang ngos zin te//zin rtags mkha' la 'ja' tshon ngo mtshar ba/ /dmar ser shas che kha dog lnga ldan 'byung / /'di yang lag len myong bas grub pa yin/ /des ni nges par bde chen zhing du skye/ /de ni gang zag tha ma'i 'bring du brtsi/ /de ltar thugs dam bzung lugs de byas pas/ /dang po skyabs 'gro byas pas rgyab brten bzang / /de nas sems bskyed bsam pa'i bzo rgya legs/ /'bul ba tshar ba'i ka cha gar song yang / /yon bdag de la chags zhen mi skye ltar/ /maṇḍal phul bas chags zhen 'khri ba chod/ /sgo dgu bkag pas log pa'i lam mi 'gro/ /dang po 'pho ba'i dmigs pa bsgoms pa des/ /thugs dam ma zin pa'am 'grogs shor yang / /tshangs bug ma gtogs sgo gzhan der mi 'gro/ /rang lus lhar bsgom hrīḥ la sems gtad pas/ /thugs dam brtan po zin cing 'grogs par dka'//thugs dam brtan cing gsal po zin pa des//sbyin bdag dad cing grwa slob ngo so mtho/ /phyi rab chos pa kun gyis bstan la phan/ /zhag bdun bzhugs nas zhag brgyad nyin 'phos pas//'od dpag 'byon dang 'phrad pas rang nyid 'tshengs/ /grwa slob rnams la stabs bde ring thung 'tshams/ /'di ltar 'pho ba thugs dam zung 'jug la/ /thos rgya chung ba'i rmongs pa 'ga' zhig 382

gis/ /'pho ba thugs dam 'gal zhes 'phya thos kyang / /chos sku'i 'pho ba thugs dam don gcig ste/ /'pho bya 'pho byed med pa'i bya btang gis/ /lus gnas ye shes brjod med phyag rgya che/ /de las gud na sangs rgyas gzhan med pas/ /rang grol dwags po bka' rgyud 'grub par shog /gsungs pa'i don yang de la dgongs pa yin/ /longs sku'i 'pho ba lha sku bsgom pa dang / /chos sku'i 'pho ba dmigs med 'jog pa gnyis/ /'gal lo snyam du the tshom skyes pa na/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams len med pa'i rtags//'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum ka la/ /nyams len gcig gis sa lam gcod dgos pas/ /spyi bor 'od dpag rang lus spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs kur hrīḥ la sems gtad ngo bo skyong / /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug de yi ngang du 'chi/ /'pho ba thugs dam zung 'jug gdams ngag zab//gal te nyams len ldan pa'i gang zag kyang //skam po'i lag stabs chu nang mi 'ong dpe/ /mtshams sbyor ngan pas shi'am nad gcod che/ /'chi khar smyo'am dbang po mi gsal 'thibs/ /de 'dra'i rkyen gyis bskyed rdzogs ma zin na/ /gang zag dbang po rab 'bring nyer gcig gis/ /tha ma'i yang mtha' grol ba'i gdams ngag ste/ /'chi kha'am bar do grol ba ma thob na/ /phyi ma sprul sku'i drung du dbugs dbyung thabs/ /'chi khar 'pho ba thebs sam ma theb rung / /'chi dus 'od gsal zin nam ma zin rung / /zhi khro'i lha ngos zin nam ma zin rung / /shi nas bdun phrag phyed gsum tsam gyi dus/ /rang nyid shi ba yin par thag chod cing / /zag bcas mngon par shes pa shin tu gsal/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs med gar 'gro rang dbang che//shi bas sems sdug gnyen la re 'khang che//sdig pa gang byas dran cing 'gyod pa che/ /gshin rje'i pho nya 'ong dogs skrag pa che/ /da res dam 383

chos ma 'grub zhe 'gyod che/ /sa phyogs yul ris nor la chags sems che/ /nye du mthun grogs rnams la gdung sems che/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'gro dbang yod na yang / /thag ring 'gro shes mi nus phyogs der chags/ /nye skor 'di ru mi lus gcig lon na//de nas dam chos gsha' ma byed do snyam/ /de yang mgyogs dgos yun ring sgug longs med/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas khrid nas gshin rje'i mdun/ /dge sdig gshag ral zhib tu byed dgos na/ /dge sdig gang mang mi shes skyon re che//de bas myur du lus len bsam nas tshol//sa rdo'i bar du'ang lus po brdzong la thug /de tshe gdams ngag 'di nyid dran par gyis/ /kye ma kyi hud bskal pa grangs med na/ /'khor ba 'di nas ma thar gnyug re bud(yi thang chad)/ /sngon byon sangs rgyas grangs med bstan pa la//bdag ni de dum grol las re ngan//skye 'chi grangs med de tsam myong ba la/ /da dung 'tsher snang med la snying re rul/ /ngan song gnas su ltung na ya re nga //mtho ris bde ba mi rtag rmi lam tsam//deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma bstan pa'i mjug /mi lus blangs na sdug bsngal rin gyis nyos/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro don 'grub dka' na/ /'gro don phar skyur ngan song ltung nyan che//da ni 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'dug re kun//sdug bsngal kun bral gtan bde 'grub pa'i gnas//bde ba can gyi zhing der mi 'gro re/ /blo gtad bcas pa'i bla ma yi dam lha//bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs//bdag ni bar dor 'khyams pa gzigs lags sam//thugs rje thugs dam phrin las dus la bab//bde ba can gyi zhing der lam sna drongs//zhes sogs lha dang bla mar 'bod pa bya/ /sman bla thugs dam byas pa'i mi yin na/ /byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad der byon nas/ /bde ba can du 'gro ba'i 384

lam ston par/ /sman bla mched bdun mdo las gsungs pa yin/ /phyag bzhi pa dang zhing skyong la sogs pa//bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i gang zag yin na ni//der 'byon bde ba can du khrid pa ni/ /phyag bzhi pa yi gri gug brtsegs rgyud dang / /zhing skyong srog rgyud nang nas gsal bar gsungs/ /gal te dam tshig chags nyams kyis sgrib na//lam ston byed mkhan lha yang ma mthong zhir//bar dor nyi ma zla ba mi snang bas/ /nub kyi phyogs de gar yin ma shes na/ /bde ba can gyi zhing dang 'od dpag med/ /yid la dung dung bsgom zhing song bas na/ /zhing khams de ru nges par phyin pa ni/ /dgongs 'dus thugs rje chen po la sogs pa/ /o rgyan gyis mdzad byang bu'i lam bstan gsal/ /'jig rten khams ni gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /'das pa'i pha rol sa thag ring na yang / /mi phyin pa yi dogs pa med pa ste/ /mgyogs bul da lta'i 'gyu ba 'di nyid yin/ /de phyir ma chags ma zhen the tshom spangs/ /bya rgyal rgod po rnyi las thar ba bzhin/ /nub kyi phyogs su kha gtad nam mkha'i dbyings//bya rgyal rgod pos gnam 'phangs gcod bzhin song //'di nas 'gro dang zhing de'i bar lam du/ /khyod kyi pha ma nye du mthun grogs rnams/ /nga yin ma 'gro ma skyur 'dir shog zer/ /ming nas 'bod cing smre sngags 'don pa na/ /bdud bgegs log 'dren thar ba'i bar chad yin//phyi mig ma blta skad lan ma sbyin cig/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa ma gtogs pa//yid la ci yang bsgom par ma byed cig /bde ba can gyi bde skyid ma gtogs pa/ /ci dang gang la'ang 'dod sems ma skyed cig /de byas bde ba can du phyin par nges/ /zhing der de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med/ /pad ma rā ga'i ri 'dra 'od zer 'bar/ /zhal mjal sku yi 'od zer phog ma thag /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa 385

phal cher dag /sku rgyas gtad pa'i byang chub shing chen de/ /mthong bas yon tan dpag med rgyud la skyes//de nas me tog pad ma kha zum pa/ /gcig la nga yi yin snyam chags sems skye/ /de ma thag tu de nang brdzus te skye/ /skyes ma thag tu lus rdzogs mtshan dpes brgyan/ /da lta mi skye dogs par the tshom na/ /lo grangs lnga brgyar me tog kha mi phye//bde skyid ldan yang sangs rgyas zhal mthong 'phyi//the tshom med na de ma thag nas phye/ /sangs rgyas mchod cing dam chos thos pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi lung bstan thob par 'gyur/ /der skyes phyir la ltung ba mi srid pas/ /'brel thogs la sogs 'dren dgos mang na yang / /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis dmyal ba bar do sogs/ /bgrod cing de dag 'dren pas chog pa yin/ /chos spangs mtshams med byas pa ma gtogs pa//bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing //zhing khams de ru smon lam btab pa dang //sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la rtse gcig dad/ /dge sdig gnyis las dge ba stobs che na/ /zhing der skye ba 'od dpag smon lam stobs/ /khyad par man ngag 'di yod the tshom med/ /sems bskyed mi ldan smon lam ma btab dang / /sdig shas che ba rnams ni der ma gtogs/ /chos sgor ma zhugs rnams ni ga la gtogs/ /'on kyang dbang bskur mtshan thos phan yon dang / /rjes nas bsngo ba smon lam mthu shugs kyis/ /dus mthar skye ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur ba ste/ /de don 'brel ba thogs chog nang du gsal/ /de phyir dbang thob tsam dang mtshan thos tsam//yab sras zhal mthong tsam gyis skye gsungs pa/ /rdzun du mi 'gyur de la dgongs pa yin/ /de phyir dge rtsa cung zad tsam res kyang / /zhing der skye gsungs don de shes par gyis/ /de don brtson 'grus rgya mtshos zhus pa'i len/ /shākya'i dge slong rā ga a su yis/ /rta lo khrums 386

zla'i dmar bo'i bcu gcig nyin/ /mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi bcud bsdus pa/ /dpe la ma bltas 'phral du ngag nas smras/ /dge bshes brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yi ge pa/ /nongs pa med pas bshags bya cang ma mchis//dge bas 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg kun//skye ba gzhan gyis bar 'tshams mi chod par//bde ba can gyi zhing der brdzus skyes nas/ /'od dpag med mgon mchod pas mnyes byed shog/le'u zhe gsum pa'o maṅga lam̐//thugs dam gsal 'debs rgyal po'i bka' 'phrin/6miri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ thugs dam gsal 'debs rgyal po'i bka' phrin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ye/ /'gro drug 'dren mdzad mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen brtson 'grus rgya mtsho bas/ /'chi dus thugs dam gsal 'debs dgos zhes zer//de la so so'i thugs dam gang yin pa'i/ /de dang mthun pa'i gsal 'debs dgos mod kyang / /'dir ni mdor bsdus spyi mtshams nyung 'dus brjod//'chi kha'i gsal 'debs 'chi dus gsal 'debs dang / /bar do'i gsal 'debs dang ni gsum du 'dus/ /shi bar thag bcad kha chem bzhag pa'i rjes/ /rab tu bla ma 'bring du mched grogs dang / /tha na yi ge shes pa gcig gis brjod/ /kye ma bdag la 'chi kha bar do 'char dus 'dir//kun la chags sems zhen 'dzin spangs byas nas//gdams 387

ngag gsal ba'i ngang la ma yengs 'jug /rang rig skye med nam mkha'i dbyings su 'pho/ /'dus byas sha khrag lus dang bral la khad/ /mi rtag sgyu ma yin pa shes par bya/ /de skad bar do rtsa ba'i tshig las gsungs/ /khyed rang yi dam thugs rje chen por sgoms/ /ma dag 'khor bar 'gro ba'i sgo brgyad po/ /hrīḥ yig tshegs drag ldan pa re res bkab//sku lus stong pa khru ma phus btab bzhin//lus dbus dbu ma khong stong ka ba ltar/ /mar sne lte 'og phug rdug lte ba'i thad/ /pad ma dmar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /rang gi rlung sems rnam shes ngo bo de/ /thig le dkar po 'phur la khad du sgoms/ /dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug thar ba'i sgo/ /skar khung phyes 'dra'i steng gi khru gang sor/ /pad ma stong ldan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i sku ru bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar po mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /chos gos gsum gsol rdo rje'i skyil mo krung //mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /sku yi 'od zer nyi ma 'bum bzhin 'bar/ /bde chen zhing gi bkod pa sku la rdzogs/ /ye shes dam tshig dbyer med gcig tu sgoms/ /de la yid kyis skyabs su 'gro bar gyis//'gro ba sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir//da res 'chi ba chos skur sbyangs byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sems bskyed sgoms/ /lus dang longs spyod nye du nor rdzas sogs/ /chags dang zhin pa'i 'khri ba gtan nas chod/ /chags kyang chags nas 'dug pa'i dbang ni med//mi rtag sgyur ma rmi lam yin par soms//rang sems thig le dbu ma'i lam nas 'phangs//'od dpag med kyi thugs gar tshe 'das tha mal pa la 'di yan bsgom pa gtso che gsungs/ /yang yang bstims/ /de rjes rang gi snying dbus pad zla'i 388

steng / /thugs srog hrīḥ yig gsal stong shel sgong bzhin/ /de la /yud tsam rig pa gtad pa'i rjes/ /de nas ci yang yid la mi bsgom par/ /sems la gang shar de yi ngo bor ltos/ /gson dus bde dus lo zlar bsgoms pa bas/ /da lta skad cig bsgom pas phan stobs che/ /da lta nyams len snying rus ma byas na/ /chos sgor zhugs la don go med pa yin/ /de phyir rig pa sgrims la snying rus gyis/ /lus tshugs ma thub pa la skyon med pas//thub ba'i dbang bo mya ngan 'das pa bzhin//seng ge'i nyal stabs gyis la ngo bo skyongs/ /gzer na gzer mkhan ngo bo de la ltos/ /'gro ba kun gyi na go chod par sgoms/ /lpags bzhi sar lhung sa ni chur thim rtags//yid kyi yul du ser po'i snang ba 'char//de la bltas pas ser po'i ngo bo stong / /yum chen sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku thob 'gyur//kha dang sna skam lce ni gre khung 'gro//chu ni mer thim yid yul dkar po 'char//de la bltas pas dkar po'i ngo bo stong / /yum chen mā ma ki yi sku thob 'gyur/ /me ni rlung thim lus drod mtha' nas sdud/ /yid yul dmar po 'char ba'i ngo bor ltos/ /yum chen gos dkar mo yi sku thob 'gyur/ /rlung ni rnam shes la thim dbugs phyir 'pho/ /yid yul ljang gu 'char ba'i ngo bor ltos//yum chen dam tshig sgro ma'i sku thob 'gyur//spyi bo'i byang sems thig le thur du lhung / /phyi rtags zla ba shar ba'i dkar lam shar/ /nang rtags du ba smig rgyu lta bu 'char/ /zhe sdang las gyur rtog pa so gsum 'gag /dga' ba'i ye shes skad cig gcig la skye//de dus ma yengs de yi ngo bor ltos/ /zhe sdang rnam dag bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /sku yi rdo rje 'grub pa'i nges pa yin/ /lte 'og ma las thob pa'i thig le ni/ /a thung phag mo'i ngo bo gyen du 'phar/ /phyi rtags nyi ma 'char 'dra'i dmar lam 'char//nang rtags me khyer lta 389

bur dmar phrom phrom/ /'dod chags las gyur rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag /mchog dga'i ye shes skad cig gnyis la skye/ /de nyid ngos bzung de yi ngo bor ltos/ /'dod chags rnam dag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas//gsung gi rdo rje 'grub pa'i nges pa yin/ /de dus rtsa rlung sgom mkhan grol bar gsungs/ /rlung ni rnam par shes la thim pa dang //phyi dbugs chad dang nag lam dus mnyam ste//phyi yi rnam shes tshogs brgyad thams cad 'gag/se ru song zer nad g.yog mchi ma 'byin//gzugs mi mthong zhing sgra mi thos pa dang / /lus tshugs mi thub mnyel zhing ma mkhal brul/ /phyi rtags nyi shu dgu yi smag nag 'dra/ /nang rtags rnam shes bum nang mar me bzhin//gti mug las gyur rtog pa bdun po 'gag /thig le dkar dmar snying gar 'phrad pa'i bar/ /rnam par shes pa 'thum ste gnas pa yi/ /dga' bral ye shes skad cig gsum la skye/ /ma yengs de yi ngo bor ltos mdzod dang / /ngos zin na ni yun ring gnas pa yin/ /gnas na gti mug rnam dag rnam snang mdzad/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /thig le dkar dmar phrad pa mthong pa de/ /ma dag pa yis phyi ma'i pha mar mthong / /phyi ma gar skye'i lus kyang yud tsam 'char/ /dag pa rnams kyis yi dam yab yum mthong / /'di skabs zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag med cig/'char bar jo bo rje dang lab sgron bzhed/ /bskyed rim pa rnams grol ba'i dus yin pas/ /khyed rang yi dam lha yi bskyed rim sgoms//thugs srog sa bon ye ger rig pa gtod//de tshe lus la tshor ba med pa'i phyir//gdung g.yog pa yis gdung bcas gzab pa yin//ma zin na ni skad cig gsum yin yang / /zin na yun ni rgyang tsam gnas pa yin/ /'pho ba'i dus gnad mchog ni 'di yin te/ /thig le dkar dmar sems su dbyer 390

med 'dres/ /tshangs pa'i lam du rgyangs se 'pho ba yin/ /ma zin na ni thig le'i gnas 'chug te//dkar po thur ltung dmar po gyen du yal/ /sna bug g.yon nas khrag dang chu ser 'byung / /de ltar thig le'i gnas ni ma 'chug gong / /nag lam yal rjes gzhi yi 'od gsal 'char/ /phyi rtags skya rengs 'char 'dra cung zad gsal/ /sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ /tshur la 'char zhing rnam rtog 'dzin pa med//lhan gcig skyes dga'i ye shes phyag rgya che//skad cig bzhi yi yun bar kun la 'char/ /de nyid ngos zin yun ring gnas pa na/ /'chi ba chos skur sangs chung rgya ba ste//sku gsum lhun grub ye shes rdo rje yi/ /go 'phang mchog ni de dus 'thob par gsungs//de dus ngas kyang khyed la gsal 'debs byed/ /de dus ngos bzung de yi ngang la bzhugs/ /de yan 'chi kha dbang po gsal dus brjod/ /dus gcig ma yin dal bus lan gsum gdab/ /de nas phyi dbugs chad par gyur ma thag //rke rtsis gnyis po lag pas myang byas te//rke rtsis ma chad bar du mi mnan zhing / /rke rtsis chad nas yud tsam drag tu mnan/ /de yis ro rkyang rlung gnyis nang du log /de nyid dbu mar thim pas thugs dam zin/ /mi zin mi srid pa yi gnad zab mo//bar do thos grol gzhung nas gsungs pa yin//sa paṇa lugs la rke rtsa chad ma thag /mgrin pa dar gyis dam du bcings par gsungs/ /bum pa min yang mgul chings dgos zhes bshad/ /de gnyis gnad 'gag gcig tu bab pa yin/ /phyi dbugs chad nas yun ni mi bsring bar/ /gdung bcas rnams kyang mgyogs shing legs par byas/ /de nas ngo sprod gdab pa'i dus su yang //dang po nyid nas ming nas mi 'bod ste//bos na rna ba'i rgyud du 'pho nyan yod/ /nag lam yal rjes tshur la gsal nas kyang / /che chung ran 391

par bos na go bar bshad/ /de phyir rna ba'i drung nas 'bod byas te/ /gzhi yi 'od gsal khyed la shar nas yod/ /nyams len steng du 'jog par zhu zhes pa/ /lan gsum brjod rjes ming nas lan gsum 'bod//kye ma khyod ni tshe 'di'i snang ba nub/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i snang ba ma shar te/ /'chi ba chos skur sbyong ba'i dus la babs/ /rang gi shes rig ngo bo stong sang nge/ /dngos po kha dog cir yang ma grub pa//'di ka sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum yin//khyod rang shes rig ngo bo stong pa la/ /stong ba phyal chad ci yang med pa min/ /sa le sing nge wa le gsal ba 'di/ /rang gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po yin/ /ngo bo stong pa cir yang ma grub pa/ /rnam pa 'gag med gsal dang wa le ba/ /dbyer med 'di ka chos sku'i sangs rgyas yin//rang rig gsal stong 'od kyi phung po 'di//dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba yin//rang gi sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas la//rang gis bltas la de yi steng du zhog / de la yun ni ring du gnas nus na/ /'chi ba chos kyi sku ru sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de nyid lan gcig gam ni lan gsum brjod/ /shi nas zhag po du song mi shes pas/ /khyod la gzhi yi 'od gsal shar nas yod/ /thugs dam ma yengs brjod rjes ming nas bos/ /khyod nyid shi nas zhag po che ge song / /da rung (da dung /)thugs dam ngang du 'di ltar bzhugs/ /zhes brjod nyin re bzhin du gsal 'debs bya//de ni spyi mtshams thugs dam gsal 'debs yin//nyams len rtogs pa ha cang mi mtho zhing / /mos gus drag po yod la gsal 'debs ni/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis mgur gyi tshul du brjod/ /kye ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu//snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na//tsitta rin chen snying gi dbus//pad ma nyi zla rtsegs pa'i steng / /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs 392

rdzogs/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan dang ldan/ /'od dang 'od zer 'bar zhing gda'/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /bla ma chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /khyed kyi sems nyid chos sku dang / /dbyer med gcig tu 'dres nas gda'/ /sems gyis sems la tshur ltos dang / /ngo bo stong bar 'dug pa de/ /bla ma chos sku yin par gda'/ /rang bzhin gsal bar 'dug pa de/ /bla ma longs sku yin par gda'/ /sna tshogs 'gag med 'char ba de/ /bla ma sprul sku yin par gda'/ /de gsum dbyer med don gcig pa/ /sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid//bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/ /khyod dang dbyer med gcig ni gda'/ /mos gus bsgoms pa'i don go de/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas gda'/ /sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /gzhi yi 'od gsal shar nas gda'/ /ma yengs de yi ngang la zhog /sangs rgyas zer ba'i g.yer bo che/ /da ni thob la khad du gda'/ /skal ldan khyod las skyid pa med/ /ces brjod gsal 'debs de yis chog /nyams rtogs med pa'i bskyed rim mkhan/ /de la gsal 'debs 'di ltar brjod/ /kye/ gson dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /dgra 'chi bdag gshin rje dbang che bas/ /khyod mi rtag tshe las 'das nas song / /dus da dung bem rig ma bral skabs/ /lha yi dam bsgom pa'i dus la babs/ /rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs//dpe me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin//de gsal la spu ris dod par sgoms/ /sku a 'thas ther zug ma yin par/ /dpe gsal stong nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin sgoms/ /de mos pa yid byed ma yin par/ /rang yi dam dngos kyi nga rgyal bskyed/ /lus tsitta snying gi gzhal yas nas/ /gdan pad ma nyi ma zla ba'i steng / /sems thugs srog sa bon yi ge de/ /dpe rlung med 393

mar me bzhin du gsal//de rnam pa gsal yang ngo bo stong //dpe chu nang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /khyong rig pa rtse gcig de la gtod/ /khyod nam zhig lus sems bral ba'i tshe/ /khyod bar do'i yid lus mi 'char bar/ /lus yi dam lha yi skur gyur nas//lha de dang dbyer med sangs rgyas te//don phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob//don de phyir thugs dam yun ring zungs//tshig de skad lan gsum dbyangs bcas brjod//des thugs dam brtan po 'ong bar (yong bar)nges//de nyin bzhin brjod pas gol sa chod/ /yang rtse gcig man gyi rnal 'byor ba/ /de dang po thugs dam gsal 'debs dang / /rjes gol sa gcod pa mnyam du bya/ /khyod thugs dam ma yengs brjod pa'i rjes/ /kye gson dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /bu khyod ni tshe las 'das pa yin//da thugs dam bzung ba'i dus la babs /khyod sems kyis sems la tshur ltos dang / /sems stong ba gzugs dang kha dog med/ /de med pa ma yin rang mdangs gsal/ /de til gyi mar me rlung med bzhin/ /sems rtse gcig de yi ngang la zhog /sems bde ba chen po'i nyams rtogs la//khyod ma chags ma zhen ngo bo ltos//don bde stong phyag rgya chen po yin//sems gsal rig stong rjen lhang nge ba/ /de mchog tu ma 'dzin ngo bo ltos/ /don gsal stong phyag rgya chen po yin//don ci yang ma grub stong pa nyid/ /de stong par 'dzin pa'i 'khri ba chod//sems gang shar ma bcos so mar zhog/khyod yun ring thugs dam zungs mdzod dang / /khyed stong nyid rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ /sang lus sems so sor bral tsam na/ /rang gar skye rang dbang 'thob pa yin/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas gol sa chod//sgom spros bral yan chad rtogs pa la//der ngo sprod gsal 'debs dgos rgyu med/ /khyed thugs dam ma yengs brjod pas 394

'thus/ /thugs dam ma zin tha mal pa rnams la//sangs rgyas mtshan brjod 'pho ba 'debs pa yin/ /thugs dam yun ring gdung g.yog ma 'khyol na//spos dang rol mo sogs kyis bskrog pa ni//ting 'dzin bar chad nyes pa dpag tu med//de bas 'pho ba btab par byas na ni/ /rta bzang sga srab byas pa bskyon 'dra zer/phan yon ma gtogs nyes pa ci yang med/ /de phyir thugs dam yun ring grol 'dod dam/ /thugs dam grol dang ma grol mi 'byed dam//thugs dam zin dang ma zin the tshom na/ /'pho ba 'debs pa 'di ni shin tu legs/ /de skad rta lo tha skar tshes gnyis kyi/ /dgong thun rā ga a sus smras pa ste//sgom chen kurma bīryas yi ger bris//le'u zhe bzhi pa'o maṅga lam̐//chos skyong spyi sgrub phrin las rlabs phring /tshomiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi chos skyong spyi'i sgrub thabs phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ma hā kā la rnyarma pā la ye/ /sngags chung gsar bu thos rgya chung ba la//phan phyir chos skyong spyi sgrub gdams pa bri//dam can rgya mtsho'i bka' gnong byin gyis rlobs/ /ma mgon la sogs ye shes chos skyong dang / /ma gza' dam gsum la sogs 'jig rten pa//de bzhin nor lha gter srung la sogs pa//gang yang 'dra ste spyi mthun sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dkyil 'khor rten rdzas bla rdo la sogs pa/ /rgyas par so so'i gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/ /bsdu na sa stegs sam ni mchod gzhi'i 395
