steng / /'bru yi tshom bu lha grangs bkod pa'am/ /gtso rkyang yin na pad ma 'dab brgyad bri/ /de steng khri'am mardzil bzhag pa'i steng / /zangs lcags thod pa la sogs gang 'os snod/ /de nang so so'i gtor ma rgyan ldan bshams/ /'khor rnams gtor chung lha grangs 'byor na bca'/ /'khor rnams med kyang rung ste gtso bo chog /rtse la so so'i tsakli btsugs par bya/ /yod na thang sku rgyab nas tshur la bshams/ /yang na gtor ma'i thad der brkyang la bshams/ /sku gzugs sku dang gtor ma gsung gi rten/ /tshom bu thugs rten yin par rgya 'grel gsal/ /gtor ma de nyid lha bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ /dang po bran nas mi bsgrub gso mi dgos/ /de mdun de las chung tsam gtor ma gcig /rgyun du nam 'don gso bran bya ba ste/ /de ni rtag gtor rgyun gtor don gcig go/ /drag po yin na g.yas g.yon sman rag bshams/ /nor lha'i rigs la zas sna gang 'dzoms bshams/ /klu rigs yin na 'o mar klu sman btab/ /btsan dang 'jig rten gzhi bdag rigs yin na/ /than gyi g.yag lug bya ri'i gzugs bshams so/ /drag po'i rigs la gtor ma sha khrag brgyan/ /mkha' rir ra sha dam can mdzo sha spang / /gza' dang dam can btsan rigs ra sha legs/ /klu yi rigs la sha chang spang bar bya/ /mtha' skor mchod pa sna bdun bskor bshams byed/ /yon chab khrag dang 'o ma zhi drag khyad/ /thun mtshams 'bul rgyu'i gtor chung mang du bsags/ /bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad la sogs spyi dang mthun//de nas rang gi yi dam bdag bskyed bya/ /de yi bsnyen pa cung tsam byas pa'i rjes/ /lha de'i gong non gnyen po'i lhar bsgyur te/ /dper na phyag bzhi pa la bde mchog bzhin//ye shes pa yi chos skyong yin na ni//sprul gzhi'i lha de bsgoms pas 'grub 396

par sla/ /'jig rten pa la gang 'dul gnyen po'i lha/ /gza' la phyag rdor klu la rta mgrin dang / /pho rgyud 'dul ba'i lha ni gshin rje gshed/ /mo rgyud 'dul ba'i lha ni he ru ka/ /thams cad kun la gur drag gro lod sogs/ /bsgom pa gnyen po ye shes lha zhes bya/ /bskyed rim gsal na bran gyis rje mthong 'dra/ /snang srin 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems/ /chos skyong bka' srung dregs pa thams cad kyang / /sems kyi cho 'phrul las gzhan med par rtogs//de ni lta ba gyad kyi lha zhes bya/ /de yod rtsub chag 'khu ldog 'byung mi srid/ /bla ma rigs bdag dam chos snying gi nor/ /dam tshig gtsang zhing snying nas byang chub sgrub//bstan dang bla ma'i don la sems khur che/ /ye shes chos skyong pha khu ma sring tshul/ /'jig rten chos skyong spun dang snying gi grogs/ /kha tsam min pa snying nas de yod na/ /bla rdo srog 'khor brten rdzas de la tshang //bgegs dang bar chad rang gi rnam rtog ste//rnam rtog ye nas chos sku rjen pa nyid/ /de ltar rtogs pas dam sri mnan pa tshang / /kun rdzob rten 'brel bgegs gtor byin la bskrad/ /mtshams bcad gu gul bdug la srung 'khor bsgom/ /rang nyid gong non gnyen po'i lhar gsal bas/ /mngon rtogs bzhin du mdun bskyed gtor ma de/ /chos skyong gang yin bsgom zhing spyan 'dren bya//ye shes chos skyong gu gul sha chen bsreg//'jig rten lha la spos dkar dud pa gtang / /gnyan dang dam can btsan rigs ra tshil gsur/ /spos dkar nā gi sbyar ba klu yi spos/ /de dag med na dri bzang gang 'byor btang / /gla rtsi 'dres pa'i spos ni klu la spang / /ci yang med na shug dud tsam gyis 'ong / /dang po yin gyi rgyun du dgos pa min/ /ye shes pa la so so'i gtor chog nas/ /nyin par thun gsum mtshan dang thun bzhi byed/ /ma mgon la 397

sogs gtor chog rgyas pa'i rigs/ /snga dro mngon rtogs nas bzung bstod pa yan/ /nyin gung gsol kha dgong mo bskang gso dang / /mtshan mo mtshal ma'i bstod pa yan chad bya/ /'jig rten chos skyong mchod bstod gal che'i phyir//nyin gsum mtshan gsum thun drug las byang bton/ /las byang nam 'don rgyun gtor gso bran bya/ /las byang tshar nas thun gyi bsnyen pa bya/ /thun mjug mtshams der gtor chung re re la//byin brlabs rtsa ba'i sngags kyis khā hi sbyar//so so'i bstod bskul rgyas bsdus gad rigs shig/dbyangs dang rol mor bcas pas bton byas la/ /dkyil 'khor 'gram der yar la phul ba'am/ /yang na bsgrigs te bzhag kyang rung ba yin//de nas bsnyen tshe dmigs pa'i rim pa ni//rang nyid yi dam sku che nam mkha' khyab/ /mdun du chos skyong rang las cung zad dma'/ /dbu ni rang gi snying thad sleb pa tsam/ /gtso 'khor rgyan dang cha lugs mngon rnyogs bzhin/ /thugs mar zhi ba yin na zla ba dang / /drag po yin na nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng / /rang srog sa bon mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /kho yi thugs ma'i sa bon sngags la phog /dper na rlung 'khor la ni rlung phog bzhin/ /pho rigs g.yas 'khor mo rigs g.yon du 'khor/ /de las 'od zer rang mdog lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /rang rang gnas pa'i pho brang der 'phros pas/ /rang rang lha de'i thugs ma'i sa bon la/ /'od zer lcags kyu'i rtse mo de yis 'khyud/ /dper na zhags pas theb pa'i dud 'gro bzhin/ /'od des 'then pas 'khor bcas myur du byon/ /mdun bskyed sku la dbyer med thim par bsam/ /de nas rang gi zhal nas gang yin sngags/ /brjod pas sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshig dran/ /dpa' bo chen pos ci gsungs 398

bka' bsgrub ces/ /rab tu dgyes shing rang la gus 'dud bsam/ /dmigs pa de nyid kho na cig('don) bya zhing //zhag gsum las ni mi nyung tsam zhig bzlas//de ni bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim yin pa'o/ /de tshe skyes pa bud med chas bzang dang / /slob dpon btsun pa khrims ldan dpon rigs dang / /dmag dang khrom tshogs ngo mi shes pa yi/ /'du 'tshogs zang zing bla rtags srog chags rmis/ /sgo brdung khang ba 'tshags dang thugs chom dang / /rlung thog ser phran char drag 'brug sgra 'byung / /dngos nyams sems 'khrugs 'jigs skrag blo mi bde/ /de yi bsnyen pa'i drod tshad gtan la pheb/ /de nas thun dang 'don lugs gong dang mtshungs/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros/ /mdun bskyed la phog sngags de drag tu 'khor/ /de las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros/ /chos skyong srung ma 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /lha srin dregs pa stobs ldan bdud rigs kyi/ /mthu dang nus pa stobs dang gzi brjid dang //'jig rten khams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / /'od zer kha dog sna tshogs rnam par bsdus/ /chos skyong la thim gzi brjid bdun 'gyur 'phel/ /de nyid dngos grub 'bul ba'i tshul nyid du/ /'od zer rnam par tshur byung bdag la thim/ /dmigs pa de nyid bsgoms shing zhag gsum bsnyen/ /de tshe sngar rmis skyes pa bud med tshogs/ /de 'dras gus 'dud phyag bskor byed pa dang / /dkar gsum zas gos 'bru dang rin chen tshogs/ /dngos su bag dro byin chags rig pa dang / /de tshe sgrub pa'i drod tshad gtan du pheb/ /de nas zhag gcig las sbyor bya ba ni/ /lha de zhi drag gang yin de dang bstun/ /rang nyid thugs las 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros/ /mdun bskyed la phog mdun bskyed thugs ka nas//'od zer dkar bo zla ba shar 399

bzhin du/ /bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya thams cad kyi/ /nad gdon dgra dang bar chad thams cad kun//mun pa la ni zla ba shar ba 'am//ba mor nyi zer phog bzhin zhi bar byas/ /'jig rten khams kyi zhi ba'i dngos grub kun/ /'od zer dkar por bsdus nas bdag la thim//zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub pa'i dngos grub thob/ /dkar gsum brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzang po 'bul/ /rang la gnod pa'i 'jigs pa gang yod pa//zhi ba'i bcol gtam bka' bsgo drag tu bya//rmis ltas nam langs nyi ma shar ba dang / /nad gdon zhi ba'i brda'am lung bstan 'byung / /rgyas par rang gi 'od zer mdun bskyed phog /mdun las 'od zer gser mdog phyogs bcur 'phros/ /rang dang dmigs yul 'khor slob rigs rgyud sogs/ /pad ma chu yis bran ltar bkrag mdangs rgyas/ /'jig rten khams kyi tshe bsod snyan dang grags//'od zer ser por bsdus nas bdag la thim//tshe bsod rgyas shing rgyas pa'i dngos grub thob//khyad par nor lha'i rigs ni yin na ni/ /chos skyong sku lus ba spu'i bu ga dang / /thugs ma'i 'od zer nyi zer 'dra ba las/ /rin chen zas gos longs spyod sna tshogs pa/ /char bzhin babs pas dgos 'dod lhun grub bsam//rmi lam rin chen char pa 'bebs pa dang //khri la 'dug dang dar phyar lo legs rmis/ /dngos su zas ma zos kyang 'grang snyam 'byung / /sems mtho nga rgyal khengs pa'i snang ba 'char/ /gtor ma rin po che yi dbyibs 'dra la/ /'bru sna zas sna shing tog blugs pa 'bul/ /stobs dang 'byor ba rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol bya/ /dbang la rang las 'od zer gong ltar 'phros/ /mdun bskyed bskul bas mdun bskyed thugs ka nas/ /'od zer dmar po glog zhags lta bu ni//phyogs bcur 'phro'am gang dmigs phyogs su 'phros//rgyal blon 400

yul khams longs spyod snyan grags bcas/ /'od zer dmar por bsdus nas rang nyid kyi/ /gdan khri'am ni sku yi smad la bstims/ /snang srid dbang sdud dngos grub thob par bsam/ /khyad par dmigs yul nges pa can yod na/ /de nyid 'od dmar zhu bcug rang la bsnyims/ /gtor ma zur gnyis 'bri mog byugs pa la/ /mngar gsum chang sogs bran nas gtor mar 'bul/ /rang gi gang dgos bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ /rmi lam dung 'bud khrom chen 'du ba dang / /phyag 'tshal bud med rgyan ldan 'du ba 'byung / /dngos su bde nyams 'dod chags 'dres ma skye/ /yang na zhen med dgos med rtogs pa 'char/ /drag po yin na dmar gtor ling gar bcas/ /dgra bgegs dgug gzhug drag tu bya ba 'am/ /rgyas par spron phur gdab ling ga bsgral/ /ling ro dmar gtor nang du 'bul bar bya/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ /mdun bskyed lha yi thugs mar phog pa yi/ /mtshang chen gnad la phog pa ci bzhin 'phros/ /thugs las 'od zer mthing ga tsha zhing rtsub//'khor la phog pas rang dbang med par rgyug /rang 'dra sprul pa'i khro bos 'jig rten bkang / /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren kun/ /la las bzung zhing la las gsod par byed/ /la las sha zos la las khrag la 'thung / /la las glo snying nang khrol phyogs kun khyer/ /la las lpags gyon la las rus pa mur/ /bya gcan thed la rub pa lta bur dmigs/ /thun gtor bran la so so'i bskul ba 'don/ /theb sdog brtsis la phyi rol zor du 'phangs/ /dngos nyams zhe sdang rngam rngams rtsig rtsig skye/ /nyams dang rmi lam sha khrag don snying ster//srog chags bsad sogs drag po'i rmis ltas 'byung / /rang la dgra sogs dmigs yul med na yang / /bstan pa'i spyi dgra 401

bgegs sogs la dmigs nas/ /drag las brda mtshon 'di tsam ma byas na/ /mgon po'i rigs sogs bka' srung drag po'i rigs/ bsgrub na rang gi tshe la gnod pa ste/ /dper na dgra ya med par dmag bsdus bzhin/ /de don mgon po'i rgyud sde rnams su gsal//bsgral zhing ma tshad chos pa'am don med mi//de la dmigs na chos skyong thugs kyis khrel/ /'khu ldog 'byung zhing phyi ma'ang ngan 'gro'i rgyu//bstan pa spyi yi don la dmigs byas na//chos skyong dang ni rang gnyis bsam pa gcig/zhar la rang gi don yang 'grub pa yin//rang 'dod kho nar lha des las mi byed//de ltar bsnyen pa zhag gsum bsgrub pa gsum//las sbyor zhag gcig kun 'dus zhag bdun tshad/ /de ni rnal 'byor rab kyi lugs yin te/ /'bring gi nyis 'gyur tha ma sum 'gyur dang / /yang mtha' bzhi 'gyur byas na mi 'grub med/ /de nas lha de ye shes pa yin na/ /ber chen la sogs mjug nas 'byung ba ltar/ /dngos grub len chog bton la brten gtor des/ /rang gis rang la bdag 'jug gtor dbang bya/ /rang rang so so'i rtsa sngags gang yin mjug /kā ya sidhim/ wākka sidhi āḥ tsitta sidhi hūṃ/ sarba siddhi trī: zhes brjod dpral mgrin snying ga lte bar gtugs/ /'jig rten pa la gtor dbang mi bya'o//de nas ye shes 'jig rten gang yin kyang / /gtor ma lhar bskyed nam mkhar btegs byas la/ /de nas gtor ma de nyid gso bran bya/ /mchod pa rnams kyi kha yang legs par gso/ /rang rang las byang gtor chog 'don la bsngo/ /skabs der dga' ston tshogs 'khor 'byor na rab/ /tshogs gzhung rang gi yi dam bzhin du bya/ /chos skyong gang yin rtsa sngags sham bu ru/ /ghan tsakra khā hi sbyar bas 'thus/ /lha de zhi ba'i sgrub pa yin na ni/ /gtor ma rang dang bsrung bya kun gyis 402

bza'//gtor bdug byin yang phan pa che ba yin/ /rgyas pa yin na rang gis cung zad bza'/ /rang gi khyim phug mdzod phug gang bder sba/ /'brog pa yin na gtor rtse rkang rtser bcug /lhag ma nang skor mi dang chibs par sbyin/ /ba glang bong bu bya khyir sbyin mi rung //dbang gi sgrub pa yin na gtor ma de//rang gi zos 'phro thab kyi me la bsregs/ /lha de klu rigs yin na bsreg mi rung / /mtsho'am chu chen nang du phul bar bya/ /drag po'i sgrub pa gnad chen yin na ni/ /sla nga la sogs lcags snod chen po'i nang / /sgrub rten gtor ma che ba gnyis ka bzhag /mtha' ru gtor chung phul tshad rnams kyang spung / /tsakli yar shab (yar blang)sha khrag chang gis bran/ /dang po dkar gtor phul zhing gser skyems gtong / /mdun du dkar gtor de rgyab gtor chen de/ /gnod pa'i phyogs su gtong zhal phar la bsgyur/ /mar rgyan thams cad dngos grub tshul du blangs/ /de gasngags mar rtsis chen bsrung byar sbyin/ /slar yang gtor ma gso bran byas pa la/ /dgug gzhug byas shing dgra bgegs sha khrag dmigs/ /nam mkhar btegs pa'i chos skyong lha tshogs la/ /dmag lto sbyin pa'i tshul du khā his bsngos/ /lha de'i bskul ba gang yod thams cad bton/ /theb ldog brtsis la phyogs ni gtsang ba'i sar/ /dkar gtor gtor chen dar nag rim pas khyer/ /gom pa re bzhi las ni thung mi rung / /thung na rang gi 'khor la rkyen kha 'byung / /de bas ring yang nyes skyon med par gsungs/ /cung zad sa gzhi khod snyom sa ru bsdad/ /spro na gser skyems bsngo zhing dkar gtong 'bul/ /de nas bskul ba chung ngu gcig bya ste/ /de nas bzhes 'bod gang shes drag tu bya/ /de nas drag sngags brjod cing gtor chung rnams/ /rim par 'phangs rjes gtor chen gnyis kyang 'phen//dmigs pa dgra 403

la mtshon cha'i char ba ste/ /bgegs la me yi phung po chen por dmigs/ /dgra rnams sho mang ser ba brgyab 'drar gtsags/ /dar nag brdab pas nam mkha'i lha tshogs kun/ /ser sprin drag po rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /'ur sgra thug chom dang bcas dgra yul song / /de ru gnas bcas za skal gtad par bsam/ /gtor ma ma gyu lan gsum 'phen wig('don) bya/ /gtor ma bya khyil zos kyang 'gal ba med/ /gtor zan de nyid dgra la 'khyar dogs na/ /me tom sbar la de ru bsreg par bya//de yang shing de gru gsum bsgom byas la/ /me sbar me nang skad cig chos skyong dmigs/ /gtor ma dgra bgegs dmigs la zhal du bstab/ /tshig rjes gshegs gsol mi dgos mi dmigs bya/ /gtor gzhong sbubs pa ri rab chen po'i 'og/dam sri bkug mnan dmigs la rta bro brdung //grwa slob sngon btang rang nyid phyi nas 'ong / /bya khyung 'jigs pas phyir gzigs rjes bcad bsam/ /phyi mig mi blta khyung sngags bgrangs shing 'ong / /gal te mthu byas zor sogs dgos yod na/ /nam phyed sus kyang mi go gsang thabs bya/ /nang du phyin nas bkra shis brjod pa dang //ye shes pa ni gshegs sam rten la bstim//bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa rnams rang la bstim/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rgod yin na ni/ /spyan drangs pa yi lha de rang gnas gshegs//bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa de rten la bstim//de ltar ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi//chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i spyi sgrub 'di/ /rta lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dmar po yi/ /mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i snga dro'i thun mtshams la/ /rā ga asus ngag khrid tshul du smras/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos brjed thor yi ger bkod//'di la sba 'og gsal bkod nyes mchis na//bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags/ /dge bas dkon mchog dbu 'phang 404

cher mtho zhing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa yun ring rgyas par shog /le'u zhe lnga pa'o snod ldan ma gtogs 'di'ang bstan par mi bya//gsungs pas shes par byos shig /maṅga stu'i /bu yig mde'u thung phrin las kun 'grub/6tsheri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ chos skyong spyi sgrub kyi bu yig mdel thung phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā kā la kā li ye/ /ma mgon lcam dral tshogs la gus btud nas/ /chos skyong spyi sgrub bu yig gsal bkod bya/ /bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan rnams chos skyong spyi sgrub gzhung bzhin la/ /rang byung ma dang dud sol re ma ti/ /e ka tsa ti la sogs ye shes kyi/ /lha mo bsgrub tshe dmigs rim mi 'dra ste/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer kha dog lnga //stong skud lta bu rang gi zhal nas thon//lha mo'i zhal zhugs thugs kur thim pa'i mod/ /sngags phreng drag 'khor lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /lha mos bdag la bu yi 'du shes skyes/ /bdag la shin tu byams pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'od zer tshur byung rang gi snying gar zhugs/ /lha mo'i byin rlabs dngos grub bdag la thim/ /lha mor ma yi 'du shes dad gus bskyed/ /de ni ma ltar bsgrub pa'i dmigs rim yin//sngon ltar rang gi 'od zer lha mor phog /lha mos bdag la ming po'i 'du shes skyes/ /lha mo bdag la brtse zhing gdung ba yi/ /rang bzhin 'od zer lte ba nas tshur byung / /rang gi lte bar zhugs nas thugs kur 405

thim/ /lha mor sring mo'i 'du shes brtse gdung ba/ /de ni sring ltar bsgrub pa'i dmigs rim yin/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer sngar bzhin 'phros/ /lha mo'i thugs kur phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ /lha mos bdag la khyo yi 'du shes skyed//lha mo bdag la dgyes shing chags pa yis/ /'od zer thugs ka nas byung bha gar thon/ /rang gi rdo rje nas zhugs thugs kur thim/ /dngos grub thob cing bde ba rgyas par bsams//'di ni khyim pa rnams kyis mi rung ste//lha mos phrag dog byed pas chung ma 'chi/ /btsun pas byas na 'dul khrims gtsang ba yi/ /gdams ngag mchog tu zab pa yin pa ste/ /lha mo tshul khrims snying nye ma zhes bya/ /rang nyid yi dam nga rgyal brtan pa yi/ /'od zer mi spro sngags ni bka' bsgo'i tshul/ /brjod pas lha mos sngon gyi dam tshig dran/ /lha mos bdag la rje dpon 'du shes skye/thugs la gang bzhed kho mos bsgrub bo zhes/ /khas blangs zhal bzhes dam bca' yang yang mdzad/ /rang 'dra'i sprul bas 'jig rten khams kun gang / /dkar mos zhi byas ser mos tshe bsod spel/ /dmar mos dbang bsdus nag mos dgra bgegs bsgral/ /kun kyang tshur 'dus lha mo nyid la thim/ /bran ltar bsgrub 'di shin tu rno myur te//ko long phrag dog rtsub 'gyur che ba yin/ /de phyir lha mo brten dka' ma zhes bya/ /de dag bsgrub pa'i dus kyi dmigs rim ste//bsnyen dang las sbyor dmigs rim spyi sgrub ltar//khyad par lha mo ma ltar bsgrub nas ni//las sbyor zhi rgyas dbang gsum gang rung ste/ /khyad par zhi ba bsgrub na thun gyi mjug /rtsa sngags kā ya wākka tsitta dang / /sarba siddhi hūṃ zhes sbyar ba yi/ /sngags ni phreng skor tsam re bzlas pa'i tshe//ma gcig lha mo'i nu ma bdag gis nus//mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub thob par bsgom/ /sring ltar bsgrub na sring mo'i 'du shes kyi/ / 406

ngo tsha srung zhing gsang gnas sba ba gces/ /mdza' ltar brten na rang nyid yi dam gsal/ /khyad par gshin rje gshed dang rta mgrin bsgom/ /lha mo dang sbyor gsang mchod phul bar bsgom/ /bran ltar bsgrub na bya nag lug nag ni/ /dngos sam zan la bzos pa mchod par bya/ /de dag sgrub thabs spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i/ /lha mo kho na'i zab gnad ngo mtshar che/ /ye shes lha mo rnams ni ma ltar brten/ /las kyi lha mo sring dang mdza' ltar brten/ /'jig rten lha mo bran ltar brten pa ste/ /mdza' bran gnyis ka ltar brten 'khor tshabs che/ /lha mo'i rigs ni mang po 'don na ni/ /la la ma dang la la grogs dang sring / /de dag so sor brten pas shin tu legs/ /i thi/ /de nas chos skyong spyi yi sgrub pa yi/ /zab khyad rno mdel sngags kyi sham bu ni/ /bsnyen sgrub byas kyang rtags mtshan ye med na/ /rtsa sngags sham bur sngags 'di sbyar la bzlas/ /u ne u ne u ne//a a ā i i yīzhu u lca a kurma ya sa ma ya dza dzaḥ / ces bzlas rtags mtshan me long bltas ltar gsal/ /bsnyen sgrub rtags thon las la sbyar ba ni/ /rtsa sngags gang yin mjug tu sngags 'di sbyar/ /nad gdon bar chad sarba shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ /rgyas pa'i las sgrub sngags kyi sham bu ni/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor buṣṭi ku ru hūṃ swā hā/ /dbang gi las sgrub dus su sngags shams ni//lokā siddhi pā shaṃ ku ru hūṃ swā hā//drag po'i las sgrub dus su sngags sham ni//rtsa sngags mjug tu hūṃ phaṭa mi 'byar na//gnod byed sarba sha hūṃ mār ya phaṭaḥ rgyu phaṭa 'byar na hūṃ gi gong de ru/ /mā ra ya yan sngags de 'dzud pa yin//'di dag spyi mtshams chos skyong bsnyen sgrub ste/'bod rbad bsad gsum lta bu ma yin no/ /de phyir 'di dag nam yang bsgrub tu rung / /chos skyong 'bod rbad bsad gsum bsgrub pa dang //de gsum gcig dril bsgrub pa mang na 407

yang / /dgra gcig nges par gsod na ma gtogs pa/ /nam dga' rang gar bsgrub pa rung ba min/ /de phyir spyi sgrub 'di ni kun la phan/ /chos skyong spyi sgrub bu yig mdel thung 'di/ /rta lo khrums zla'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i gung / /sngags 'chang rā ga a myas smras pa de/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos brjed thor bris/ /gsang sngags sba 'os gsal bar bkod pa'i nyes//ma gcig lha mo stong rtsa'i drung du bshags/ /dge bas bu slob yang slob brgyud par bcas/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub char shog /le'u zhes drug pa'o//'di'ang snod min la shin tu gsang ba dam tshig go/maṅga lam̐//rgab 'dre mnan thabs ha la'i ri rab/〈〈rgyuljiri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /sgrub pa spyi'i dam sri rgab 'dre mnan thabs stobs chen hā la 'bar ba'i ri rab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badzra kro dha ma hā ba la ye//khro bcu'i nang nas 'og phyogs khro bo la//gus pas phyag 'tshal stobs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /lha rnams kun la rgab 'dre re re yod/ /dper na shāka thub la ni lhas byin bzhin/ /sems can kun la lhan cig skyes pa'i bdud/ /'bral ba med cing gnod pa'i smon lam can/ /de phyir 'jig rten lha la'ang rgab 'dre re/ /de bsgrub sngags pa'i tshe dang bsod nams rku/ /de dag mnan thabs so so'i sgrub thabs las/ /so sor gsungs kyang rtags thon bsgrub dgos shing //rdzas sogs phyag len dka' bas lag mi lon//de phyir bsgrub pa mi 408

dgos rdzas mi dgos/ /blo bur 'dra rigs btsan thabs mnan pa'i thabs/ /gter kha gsar rnying 'ga' nas gsungs mod kyang / /shin tu sla ba gsar ma'i lugs 'di ni/ /bram gzugs mgon po'i chos skor gnyan lo'i lugs/ /shog gu gcig la ma hā ba la'i sku//glang mgo dmar po rwa ni gdengs pa'i bar//khro zhal dmar po zhal du sbrul za ba//de steng mi mgo sngon po mig gcig pa//dbu skra dar sngon gyis bcings dar dpyangs 'phur/ /'og mi'i mgo la sbrul gyi gdengs ka bdun//lte ba zur gsum hom khung thur bstan nang //dgra bgegs sa bon dṛ tri mgo thur bstan/ /sku mdog dud kha phyag gnyis thugs kur sbyar//phyag bar phur ba dṛ tri la tshed bri/ /sku smad sbrul mjug ljang gu g.yas 'khyil lo/ /de yi rgyab tu sngags 'di thur du brtsegs/ /sngags phreng gcig la bri ba shong bar bya/ /oṃ sha ma ran pra ma shag dun hūṃ hūṃ nan dul dul nan rbad sod/ snying la ma ra ya sod/ces bri gtor ma gcig kyang bshams byas la/ ba lang spyod nas bsgom 'dra spyan drangs bstims/ /oṃ ma hā ba la hūṃ/ ces pa brgya rtsa rten 'brel rab gnas bya/ /rtsa sngags khā hi btags pas gtor ma sbyin/ arnya la sogs sngags kyis mchod byas nas//hūṃ/'jig rten lha 'dre kun gyi gshed po ste//las kyi mthu las grub pa bdud kyi bu/ /ba lang spyod kyi gling la dbang bsgyur ba/ /stobs chen ma hā ba la khyod la bstod/ /sku gzugs 'di dang dbyer med brtan bzhugs la//khyod kyi 'dul skal yin pas 'dre 'di non/ /stobs chen khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs//ces brjod sku gzugs de dang dbyer med bstims//shog gu gtsang mar ling ga spyi mtshams bri/ /yan lag 'bru bzhi phyi rol dza khro bskor/ /snying gar dzaḥ yig kha sprod gnyis kyi bar/ /dṛ tri khug gsum brtsegs mar bri bar bya/ /lto 409

ba'i nang du bsgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ /dam sri rgab 'dre shi gshed gson 'dre sogs/ /gdon rigs gang gnod ming mjug khug nan bri/ /rang ming lha ming de ru bri mi rung / /dri ma song dogs med dang rlung la g.yug /mdun du bzhag la dgug gzhug spyi ltar las/ /chos skyong 'di dang 'di zhes bsgrub pa la/ /bar du gcod pa'i rgab 'dre gang yin pa//khug gcig dzaḥ hūṃ bai ho zhes pa de//brgya 'am nyer gcig bdun sogs nan tan bya/ /rang nyid yi dam khro bo'i thugs ka yi/ /'od zer lcags kyus yang yang bkug la bstim//phyi sgo'i them 'og gru gsum dong brus la/ /de nang ling ga gan rkyal mgo phyir bstan/ /de steng ma hā ba la'i sku de sbubs/ /dbu ni phyir bstan kha sbyor byas la mnan/ /shugs chen mi yis byis pa mnan pa ltar/ /ma hā ba las nam yang mi btang bsam/ /sa khod rim gcig mnan pa'i steng du ni//jo g.yam gcig gi ngos ni gnyis po la//rdo rje rgya gram ri rab gling bzhi bri/ /dmyal yul tsam du thug par thur mnan steng //rlung ni rdo rje rgya gram 'byung rim brtsigs/ /de steng ri rab gling bzhis mnan par dmigs/ /byams pa ma byon bar du ma ldang cig /de nas longs la byang chub sems bskyed zhus//de bar ma hā ba las ma btang cig/ces brjod sa rim dgu la rgya gram re//de steng me khrol de steng chu yang blugs/ /sa yis bkab la bcag brdung mi mngon bya/ /rta bro gang shis brdung rjes dmigs med gzhag /de ni ye shes lha dang 'jig rten pa/ /kun gyis rgab 'dre mnan thabs thun mongs te/ /shi sri chung sri god 'dre'i mnan pa dang //rgyal 'gong 'dre mo mnan yang ming gi bsgyur/ /'dre mnan gcig chog zab mo i thi rgya/ /'di la rnying ma'i gur drag lugs yod kyang / /de ni sgrub pa rta gas thon dgos phyir dka'/ /gnam chos lugs la 'di 410

nyid yod na yang / /de yi bka' gtad dbang lung med mi ru nga / /'di ni las tshogs yan gar yin pa'i phyir//ma hā ba la'i bka' gtad thob mi dgos//'di ni 'jig rten lha 'dre kun gyi bdud//'jig rten lha 'dre kun ni 'joms pa yi /las la grub pa'i dregs pa can yin gyi/ /ye shes pa yi lha ni ma yin te/ /rgya gar chos lugs rgya nag rtsis gzhung lugs/ /kun las 'dre gsod shan par 'di bsngags so/ /de skad chos skyong spyi sgrub cha lag tu/ /rta lo khrums zla'i mar ngo'i bcu gnyis gung / /rā ga asus phyag khrid tshul du smras/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yis/ /phyi rabs sngags chung kun la phan phyir bkod//gab sbas gsal bar bkod pa'i nyes mchis na/ /stobs chen ma hā ba la nyid la bshags/ /dge bas sgrub la bar chad med par shog /le'u zhe bdun pa'o maṅgalam//bla rdo bca' thabs sha rul sbrang 'khor/1111ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /chos skyong spyi sgrub kyi bla rdo rten rdzas kyi yig chung sha rul spreng bu rang 'khor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badzra pā ni ye/ /chos skyong spyi yi bla rdo srog 'khor dang / /brten rdzas sgrub rdzas so so'i sgrub thabs nas/ /so so'i gzhung bzhin grub na mchog yin te/ /shes par dka' zhing shes kyang 'dzom par dka'/ /gtan nas med na 'grub par dka' ba ste/ /dper na rnga dang pi tsam la sogs bzhin/ /rdzas sna gcig ma tshang yang don mi 411

'grub/ /spyir ni lha yi bla rdo shel dkar rdo/ /mi yi bla rdo drug dmar g.yu yin te//'dre yi bla rdo pha wang long bu nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi bla rdo mu men dang / /nor lha'i bla rdo gser ni sa byung ba/ /klu yi bla rdo mu tig nya phyis yin/ /lha mo'i bla rdo mtsho rdul sngon po dang //rdo nag gru gsum mgon po'i bla rdor bshad/ /de dag so sor sa bon yi ge bri/ /so sor ma rnyed lha 'dre thams cad kyi//bla rdo gcig bsdus pha wang long bu yin/ /rab gser 'bring dngul tha ma mtshal gyis ni/ /phyogs bzhir dzaḥ rgyu baṃ ho'i yi ge bzhi/ /steng du gtso bo yab yum sa bon dang / /yum med na ni gtso bo'i sa bon nyid/ /'og tu las mkhan pho mo'i sa bon bri//des ni gang yin lha de'i bla rdo tshang //rab ni dar ram gos chen lha yi mdog/ma rnyed gro shog gtsang ma la yang rung / /rtsa sngags phreng gcig bris pas bla rdo dril/ /de nyid gos dar lha yi kha ngag gtums/ /de nyid tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram bcings/ /de nyid lhar bskyed bskyed bstims gtor ma 'bul//mi gshegs der bstims rten 'brel rab gnas bya//de nyid bsgrub tshe ga 'ur lus la bcangs//tshar nas rten sgam nang ngam mda' dar btags/ /rtag tu mi gshegs de la thim par dmigs//rdo ni bla rdo sngags ni srog 'khor tshad/ /phyi rten mgon por g.yag nag dar snas brgyan/ /lha mor lug nag spyi dkar bya mo nag /dam can ra dkar gnya' nag rnga khras brgyan/ /nor lha'i rigs la rta sngon chu ris dang / /btsan la khyi dmar rta dmar klu la ni//chu rta sngon po sbal ba sbrul gyi gzugs/ /rab ni dar ras tha na shog gur bri/ /mda' la btags pas phyi rten de yis tshang / /mda' gtsang rgod sgro me yis ma bshur ba/ /rang mdog dar btags de yi nang rten tshang / /shog gu gtsang ma'am dar ras tsakli bri/ /de yi rgyab tu thugs thad sa bog 412

bri/ /de rgyab gang yin phyag g.yas phyag mtshan bri//mtha' skor bsnyen sngags sgrub sngags g.yas bskor bri/ /ma shong sngags mjug nang du bcug par bya/ /de nyid spyan dbye rab gnas brda' tsam bya//gza' skar bzang ngam dus tshod gnyen po la/ /bri dang rab gnas nyin gcig gis rdzogs bya/ /rten rdzas kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /sgrub dus gtor ma'i mgo la btsugs pa ste/ /tshar nas mda' dar mgul btags rten sgam sba//sku ni sku rten sngags ni gsung gi rten//phyag mtshan bris pas thugs kyi rten tshang ngo//gsang rten gang du bshad pa'i bla rdo'o//bskang rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs gsungs pa rnams/ /bskang rdzas thang sku'am zan la bar btab rung / /dngos su med kyang dmigs rten brda mtshon re/ /med na lha mo'i rigs ni mi 'grub ste/ /ting 'dzin gsal yang de yis mi chog phyir/ /rdzas la dga' bas rdzas dga' ma zhes bya/ /bskang ba'i nang nas gsungs pa'i rdzas de dag /dngos su 'dzom na ma bsgrub na yang chog /dper na sha rul sbrang ma 'du mtshungs gsungs/ /de don ma mgon rgyud gzhung rnams su gsal/ /rang mdog dar ram ras la sku bris pa/ /de ni phyar dang kun la yongs su grags/ /rang mdog dar kha ma nyams gtsang ma la/ /bsnyen sngags 'bod sngags spyan 'dren sngags bris pa/ /lcags sam gang rung rdo rje'i sne la btags//spyan 'dren skabs su lag g.yug tshul du g.yab//de ni g.yab dar yin te shes mkhan dkon//skyes pa thig le ma nyams gsang rdor ni/ /'bras bu gnyis bcas mi dbang 'bras bu yin/ /ming sring sbyor ba'i byis pa nal bu ste/ /ha ta zhes pa lag pa'i ming yin la/ /mtshal gyi shing tog padma rakta yin/ /ston kha lcang ma'i lo ma rlung khyer ba//sa la ma phog bar snang khams nas bzung / /de yi stod la lha mo'i sku bris la/ /phyed 413

bcad smad la lha mo'i snying po bri//de gnyis zhal sbyar tshon skud sna lngas bcings//lha mo bskyed bstims 'bral med lus la bcangs/ /lha mo lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par gsungs/ /de ni lha mo'i rten rdzas kun las mchog/ri rgyal gnyen po grags pa can gyi rtse/ /yang na ri mgul ri zur yin kyang rung / /rdo nag zur gsum sha ril mdzub rtse tsam//gri gug gam ni gri yi rtse mos blangs//lag pas ma reg shos gu'i nang gtum la//logs gcig gser gyi hūṃ yig bri ba dang //g.yas su de yi las mkhan gang yin srog /g.yon du de yi yum de'i sa bon bri/ /gong ltar sngags kyi shog dril gyis gtums te//btag gam bcangs pa mgon po'i bla rdo mchog /de bzhin mtsho gnyan rde'u sngon po gcig /lag pas ma reg khem mam skyog gis blangs//bhyoḥ 'am ma bris sngags gtums lha mo'i rten//phuḥbris sngags gtums klu yi bla rdo yin//gal te phyi rten rta dang g.yag btsan na//dang po rnam 'joms gzungs chu gtor bas bkru/ /ra la btsag byugs rna ba dpung ba gnyis//rnga tshon sngon dmar dar sna srung skud gdags//gang yin lha yi snying po'i shog dril ni//rna ba 'am ni dpung pa'i gseb tu btags//bskang gso'i skabs su 'di la rten chos la/ /mi nor spel zhing srung ba'i phrin las bcol/ /spu mi bregs shing sha mi gcod pa dang / /lud sogs ngan pa'i khal ni bkal mi bya/ /skabs su lha yang de la bstims dmigs na/ /gcan gzan chom rkun rnams la dpa' ba yin//rigs mthun dud 'gro'i khyu yang bsrung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rnga thug btsug bar bya ba yang //kha ṭaṃ sde chen bla chen dgon pa sogs//'thob cha yod pa min pas mi khyog zer/ /mdung lcags skya ser sngags pa sus kyang rung / /thugs kyi rtse stod srog shi nga de yi nang //chos skyong rnams kyi 'bod sngags bsnyen 414

sngags bcug /rked par rbad pa'i sngags ring shog dril bcug /rtsa bar bsad sngags shog dril bcug pa ni/ /ma ning rnga thug o rgyan gyi mdzad lugs/ /rnga thug nang du phyogs gsum shog dril btags/ /yang na shing gi nang du bcug kyang rung / /de ni rnga thug yu ba ma brtan te/ /rnga thug khur dgos sgar pa byed pa'i lugs/ /lcags de gnam lcags ma la ya yi ri//rnga ma mgon sprul bya rog nag po ste/ /yu ba byang shar dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /dpal ldan lha mo'i bzhugs gnas mtshon pa yin//dgu gtor dus su rgyun du de la bstims//dgon pa lha cha brang nga la sogs pa/ /bsrung zhing skyob pa'i bcol gtam yang yang bya/ /de yis yul phyogs dgon gnas bsrung ba'i mchog /de la sa ser gnam sngon dar lce dmar/ /dar nag chos skyong sngags bris btags pa yis/ /chos skyong srung ma shugs la 'khor ba'i gnad/ /dar la 'du ba lha 'dre spyi yi lugs/ /zhes pa chos skyong spyi yi rten rdzas rnams/ /tshegs chung don che sus kyang rnyed sla ba/ /rta lo khrums zla'i mar ngo'i bcu gnyis gung / /rā ga a sus dag khrid tshul du smras/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor brtson 'grus rgya mtsho bas//sngags chung gsar bu rnams la phan phyir bris/ /sba 'os gsal bkod nyes 'gal srung mar bshags/ /dge bas sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas shog /le'u zhe brgyad pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /'o skol gyi chos skyong 'di yi mtshan ni/ lho brag gi mgon po gcig mgyogs ma zhes kyang bya/zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i sha ba rgyug 'gyel zhes kyang bya/ gnyal ba nyi ma 'bar gyi pho rog lding skyur zhes kyang bya/ gnyal ba jo sras kyi myur ba khrag skyugs zhes kyang bya/ chos skyong 'di ni mgon po spyi bsdus kyi sgrub pa yin pa la/ slob dpon arṇa pa yi mgon po spyi sgrub zhes kyang bya/mal gyo lo tsā ba'i mgon po me yi spu gri zhes 415

kyang bya/slob dpon nyi ma 'bar gyis mgon po phur byed ces kyang bya/ gnyal bo jo sras kyi mgon po bar chen zhes kyang bya/ bla ma ras chen gyi mgon po lcags par ma zhes kyang bya/ don dam par ni/ mgon po 'di yi mtshan ni/ dpal gyi mgon po ber nag can zhes bgyi ba lags so/ mgon po 'di ni shin tu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che ba ste/ rgyud me lce phreng ba las/bcom ldan 'das kyis mgon po nag po la bka' stsal ba/ skyes bu khyod kyi mthu rtsal ni/ /srid pa gsum la byol 'debs shing //khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed//'dod khams dkrug cing zil gyis gnon/ /stong gsum gzhan du 'phen par byed//'byung ba kun gyi rgyun lam gcod//rgya mtsho chen po hub kyis 'debs//ri rab lto ru za bar byed//dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod cing //khyod kyi gad mo bgad pa ni//gshe ba'i gad mos lha rnams brgyal/ /bdud dang mu stegs bsngangs bar byed//shi la thug par brgyal bar 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar gad mos dbang du sdud/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams yid kyang 'phrog /hūṃ sgras khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /phaṭaḥ kyis stong gsum dus gcig sgrol//phe dze dze gyis 'jig rten g.yo//g.yo bas thams cad dbang du sdud//bangs kyi stobs ni glog dang 'dra//stong gsum dus gcig khyab par 'gro//mngon shes lnga dang rab ldan zhing //rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab bstan nas//'gro ba log rtog sgrol bar byed/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyis gtso bo ste/ /dung khrod kun gyi bdag po ste//lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po ste//zhing skyong dpa' bo'i dmag dpon byed/ /gshin rje bdud kyi rje bo mdzad/ /gnod sbyin kun kyang bran du khol/ /de ltar dpal ldan ded dpon khyod/ /ces gsungs so/ /rin chen dpung rgyan las/gang tshe ci yis 'dul ba shes pa po/ /ci dang ci 'dul sprul ba shes pa po/ /ces 416

gsungs pa dang /srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las//mgo na po nyid kyis smras pa/ e ma ho/ bdag ni shin tu mi bsrun pas/ /srin po rnams kyang bran du khol/ /lha ma yin rnams brlag par byed//lha srin sde brgyad 'khor du bcas//lha ma yin gyi bu mo rnams/ /srin mor bcas te khas blangs nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du bcug /ces so/ /zhes pa lung 'dren 'di yang bya rga dpe nas khol du phyungs te rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyis bstsal ba ltar bdag rkarma bī rya sā ga ras mgyogs par bris pa'o//gtor ma'i yig sna lha yi nor bu/ 11spyilji ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ chos skyong spyi'i brten gtor sogs gtor ma'i yig sna lha'i nor bu ke ke ru zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gsang rgya'o/ /na mo gu ru ma hā kā la ye/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs la 'dud/ /bka' yi gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs/ /sngags la mos pa'i bla ma brtson 'grus kyi / /brten gtor la sogs gtor ma'i rnam dbye rnams/ /chos skyong spyi la phan pa'i zhal gdams zhus/ /de don gsar rnying rgyud gzhung rgya mtsho dang / /khyad par gtor ma'i las rgyud la sogs nas/ /gtor ma med na bar chad bsal bar dka'/ /gtor mar brtson na bar chad mi tshugs shing / /mchog thun dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mchog tu gsungs/ /phyi yi gtor ma chu gtor brgya rtsa sogs/ /gsang ba'i gtor ma lus sbyin ku su lu/ /gsang sngags nang gi gtor ma gtor bsngos 417

te/ /'di gsum ma chag bsod nams tshogs bsags mchog /nang gtor ma gtogs chos skyong gtor ma la/ /brten gtor rigs gnyis gta' gtor rtag gtor dang / /rgyun gtor thun gtor dus gtor rnam dbye'o/ /brten gtor 'phral du bsgrub pa'i brten gtor ni//sgrub tshe lhar bskyed tshar nas dbang len pa/ /dgon gnas la sogs gzhag rgyu'i brten gtor ni/ /ma mgon la sogs drag po'i lha yin na/ /nas nag gtsang ma snod du blugs byas la/ /swa bhā wa yi sngags kyis stod par sbyangs//nas 'bru re re hūm̐ yig sngon por bsgom//de nas mi dmigs byas la rjen 'thag bya//zhi bar nas dkar so so'i sa bon dmigs//de yang rjen 'thag bya ba gong dang 'dra/ /chu chang zan chang byas na rul bas spang / /mar khu byas na gtor gzugs bca' mi nyan//mar dkar chu btsag chang gi nying khus sbrus/ /gtsang ma'i khrag dang bdud rtsi'i ril bu bsre/ /zhi ba'i rigs la de dag mi bsre ste//nor lha'i rigs la mngar gsum shing tog rigs//klu yi rigs la klu sman phye ma dang //ba dkar ra dkar 'bri zal 'o ma bsres//drag po yin na zangs lcags snod legs te/ /zhi bar li'am shing snod shing shun rung / /rdza las grub pa'i zla gam gtor snod dbyibs/ /de ni ma mgon gtor mar mchog tu bshad/ /bse dang ra gan rdo leb snod mi rung / /gtor ma che na 'og gdan stegs bu'i steng //yang na gtor snod nang du brda' tsam bri//zlum po dkar po'i nang du gru bzhi ser/ /de nang zla gam dmar nang gru gsum mthing / /de ni las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brda' mtshon yin / /gru bzhi blum po phyi nang brjes kyang rung / /de steng gtor ma'i dbyibs ni dbang gtor bzhin/ /rang rang gtor gzugs lhun mthug zur mi rno/ /gtor ma che na stod smad rnam pa lngar/ /so sor 418

shog dril bcug par bya ba ste/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma stod rim sa thob rnams/ /so so'i mtshan sngags shog dril bri ba ste/ /sa thob min par bla brgyud mi bri bar//oṃ āḥ sarba ku ru hūṃ gis chog /de 'og chos skyong de nyid 'dul ba'i lha//yi dam gang yin de yi snying po bcug /gtor ma'i stod der bsnyen sngags 'bod sngags bcug /rked par sgrub sngags dngos grub sham bu dang / /rbad sngags sngags ring bcas pa bcug par bya/ /rtsa bar bsang sngags sngags ring bcug par bya/ /gtor ma chung na zangs lcags sbu gu'am/ /smyug tshigs nang du stod smad so sor bcug /de nyid gtor ma'i srog shing byas pas 'thus/ /'jig rten lha la bla ma'i mtshan mi bcug /gong non gnyen po'i lha yis sngags kyis chog /gtor ma'i dbus su rin chen sna tshogs pa/ /bcug na longs spyod 'phel pa'i rten 'brel zab/ /sman sna kun bcug nad nyung rten 'brel 'gyur/ /ye shes pa la bdud rtsi ril bu dang / /'jig rten pa la klu sman ril bu bcug /gser dang gser shog mang po bcug pa la/ /gser gtor zhes bya khams chen brtsi srol gda'/ /zhi drag mar rgyan so so gang 'os dang / /so so'i sa bon yig 'bru bkod par bya/ /yab sras la sogs stobs chen phyag len la/ /gos chen bzang bor gtor ma'i dbyibs drub nas/ /nang du 'bru sman rin chen shog dril bkang / /dngul gyi mar rgyan brdung nas btags pa lags//chu ma 'dres pa'i a bsno'i (mar zan)gtor ma de/ /lo stong song yang mi rul zhig mi 'gyur/ /de ni myong bas grub pa'i lo rgyus thos/ /sha rgyan 'os pa'i gtor ma yin na ni/ /sha ma 'dres pa'i tshil la dras byas te/ /de yang mar khu'i nang nas drangs la 'dzugs/ /rtse la so so'i tsaka li dar gdugs phub/ /che chung mda' gang khru gang mtho gang dang //tha na mdzub gang gis 419

kyang chog pa yin/ /che na rang mdog mda' dar btsugs par bya/ /dang bo bshams nas spos bdug chab kyis bran/ /chang rgod nang mchod bran cing bsgul mi bya/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ /ro yo khaṃ 'phros me chu rlung gsum gyis/ /bsregs gtor bkrus nas stong pa nyid du bsam/ /gtor sno phrin las bzhi yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /lcags ri rim pa phyi nang bzhi 'dra ba/ /nang ma kun la sgis skar 'dra ba'i nang / / dbus su rlung me thod skyed spyi ltar steng / /bhan dha stong gsum mnyam pa gcig bsgoms te/ /nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga / /de man gtor ma'i smad cha gtor snod bcas/ /gtor ma'i sked par chos skyong gzhal yas gsal//rtse ru bla ma yi dam sprin ltar gtibs//zhi ba'i chos skyong nor lha sogs yin na/ /rlung me thod skyed bhan dha mi bsgom par/ /rin chen sna tshogs bdud rtsis gang bar bsgom/ /gtor chog bzhin du chos skyong spyan 'dren bstems/ /bhan rnya 'am ni rin chen snod de nas/ /bdud rtsir 'phyur bas phrin las rnam bzhi yis/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bo bdud rtsis ltems se gang / /bdud rtsi'i rlangs pa mchod rdzas dpag med pa/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rin chen rnam pa bdun/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug sprin ltar gtibs/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor nang du dkar gsum dang / /rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor nang du nor bu'i rigs/ /dbang gi dkyil 'khor nang du dar zab tshogs/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor dgra bgegs sha khrag sogs//phud rlangs bskang rdzas sgrub rdzas brten pa'i rdzas//zad med dpag med 'phro zhing 'du ba las/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas de la thugs mnyes nas/ /byis pa gzhon nu rtsed mor yengs pa'am/ /'dod sred ldan pa nor la chags pa bzhin/ /rtag tu dgyes shing 'khor zhing bzhugs pa de/ /bsil ba 420

tshal sogs rang rang bzhugs gnas dang / /gtor ma de nyid dbyer med ro gcig bsam/ /rtag tu mi gshegs mi bsdu de ltar bzhag /bdun gnyis bdun gsum bar du thun re re//gtor mar sems gtad stod phrag tsam re bsnyen/ /de ni brten gtor bsnyen pa'i rim pa ste/ /rjes nas dgu gtor dus kyang de la bstims//dus bzang skar bzang dus su gso bran bya/ /rgyun du mi yis ma mthong sbas te bzhag /shog gur bris sam shing la brkos pa yi//zla phyed rdo rje gcig dang srung skud ni/ /bal lam dar ras gtsang mar mdud byas la/ /rtsa sngags shams bur bdag dang bu slob dang //rta phyugs dgon skor la sogs srungs shig dang //rakka rakṣa swā hā spel ba'i sngags/ /brgya rtsas sngags te rten gtor la btags bya/ /de ni spyi yi mi nor srung ba'i mchog /khyad par zhing skyong brten gtor gdams ngag ni//seng gdong yab yum bam ro pho mo'i sngags//de mjug sde brgyad sngags ni mi 'byar bar/ /ka cha mchod cha brang nga la sogs pa//ming bris mjug tu zhing skyong yab yum la/ /bcol lo gtad do ma bskur thub par srungs/ /nā ga ra ti nor srungs shig /ces bris shog dril gtor mar btags par bya/ /de ni dkor nor bsrung ba'i mchog tu gsungs/ /gal te khyer na rbad mi dgos par bshad/ /zhig ral byung na brje ba ma gtogs pa/ /de min brten gtor brje bar bya ba min//bstan la thug pa'i dgra bo byung srid na//zor du 'phangs na hur thum 'gro bar bshad//rang nyid yi dam nga rgyal brtan po yi//lha nyid gdan dang bcas te 'phangs bsgoms pas//pha rol rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ /nus pa chung na rang la ldog dogs che/ /bskul ba bton nas lha de nam mkhar btegs/ /ser sprin bzhin du 'ur chem bcas te song //gtor ma me dpung mtshon char dmigs 421

te 'phangs/ /de yis rang la ldog dogs yod pa min/ /brten gtor brje 'am 'phen dgos byung ba'i rjes//de nyin nyid du grub na rab yin te//ma 'grub yun ring ma 'gor sngar bzhin bca'/ /rang nyid gnas der mi 'dug 'gro dgos na/ /gtor mar dbang blangs bkra shis gshegs gsol bya/ /gtor ma'i ru rtsesngags kyi shog dril dang / /tsag li la sogs chas rnams rang gis khyer/ /gtor ma cung zad zos 'phro gtor bdug sbyin/ /de nas rtag 'dug gnas der sngar ltar bca'//de ltar bsgrub pa'i tshe yi rten gtor dang //bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi rten gtor sogs/ /rtag gtor phug gtor gong gtor don gcig te/ /lo re lan re brje ba'i phug gtor yin/ /rim gro yin na ma grol bar du'o/ /rag rim lha grangs bca' ba kun gyis shes/ /gtor ma'i rtse thad rang rang lha rnams bsgom/ /rtag par 'jog pas rtag gtor zhes bya'o/ /de 'dra bsdus pa nub re rgyun du bca'/ /de nub nyid nas bsdu ba rgyun gtor ste/ /phug gtor rgyun du bca' ba mi 'khyol phyir/ /rtag gtor rgyun du gso ba rgyun gtor yin/ /gta' gtor zhes bya gta' mar bzung ba de/ /gtor ma shin tu bzang ba gcig bshams te/ /chos skyong drag po'i las la rbad pa'i dus/ /las 'di 'grub rtags byung dus 'bul lo bya/ /las 'grub rmis ltar la sogs gsal byung tshe/ /gsol mchod rgyas par byas la de nyid 'bul/ /thun gtor zhes bya thun mtshams gtor chung nyid/ /dus gtor zhes bya dgu gtor tshes bcu'am/ /lha de rgyu dus dus mchod bzung la 'bul//gzhan du lo sgrub gcig ni byas pa bas/ /rgyu dus mchod gtor byas na mthu che gsungs//las gtor zhes bya nges med rang nyid la//bya ba bsgrub dgos byung tshe gtor ma 'bul/ /nga yi don 'di sgrubs zhes phrin las 422

bcol//de ni blo bur las bcol gtor ma zer//las de zhi rgyas dbang drag gang yin dang / /lha de zhi ba drag po gang yin dang / /dmar gtor dkar gtor ci ltar 'os pa dang / /zhi rgyas dbang gi las la gsol mchod bya/ /bzlog bsad cho 'phrul las la drag tu bskul/ /theb ldog mi 'gal dgra phyogs zor du 'phangs/ /rbad bsad sngags brjod zhwa gos dar nag brdab/ /thag ring 'gro 'am zhi rgyas dbang gi las/ /'gro ba'i phyogs su gtor ma'i rtse ston 'bul/ /'di la phyogs dang theb ldog brtsi mi dgos/ /phyogs der srung ma gshar nas song bar bsgom/ /'gro phyogs min par phul na phyi dal rgyu/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi gtor ma dngos grub bza'/ /drag po'i gtor ma tshur la blangs mi rung / /gtor ma phul nas gtor snod khyer 'ong tshe/ /kha phyir bstan nas khyer na dngos grub yol/ /kha nang bstan nas khyer na dngos grub 'du/ /de ltar gtor ma'i zhal gdams mdor bsdus 'di/ /gsar rnying gter kha kun gyi don bsdus yin/ /rta lo khrums zla'i mar ngo'i bcu gnyis kyi/ /dgong thun tshigs su bcad de smras pa rnams/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos mgyogs par yi ger bris/ /sba 'os gsal bkod nyes pa lha la bshags/ /phyi rabs sngags la mos pa'i gang zag la//phrin las kun 'grub yid bzhin nor bur shog/le'u zhe dgu pa'o maṅga lam̐/ / 423

pakṣu'i khyad chos ma mgon zhal sbyor/ḍā'iri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ /ma mgon bsgrub pa'i zin bris grub chen rkarma pakṣu'i khyad chos bzhugs so//na mo gu ru ma hā kā la ye//bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs la 'dud/ /bla ma rū pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho yi/ /chos skyong bka' srung sgrub thabs dgos zer ba//chos skyong kun gyi sprul gzhi rtsa ba'i lha//ma mgon lcam dral 'di las zab pa med/ /sta gon dkyil 'khor la sogs spyi sgrub bzhin/ /de nas 'don lugs mi 'dra sna tshogs te/ /bdag bskyed phag mo mdun bskyed mgon po bsgom//dgu gtor bskang gsol la sogs spyi 'tshams lugs/ /bdag bskyed phyag rdor mdun bskyed mgon po bsgom/ /de ni rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin//bdag bskyed gshin rje phyag gnyis yum 'khril ba//mdun bskyed lha mo rigs gsum gang rung bsgom//o rgyan gyis mdzad dus mkhyen yab chos lugs/ /phyag bzhi ma dang sku gsum lha mo dang / /gtso 'khor gsum la lha mo rigs gsum zer/ /bdag mdun gnyis ka rang byung rgyal mo bsgom/ /de ni dus gsum mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin/ /bdag bskyed legs ldan srung 'khor gzhung ltar bsgom/ /mdun bskyed yab rkyang phyogs bcu mgon pos bskor/ /de ni 'gro mgon ras chen bzhed pa yin/ /bdag mdun gnyis ka yab rkyang ber chen bsgom/ /de ni rang byung rdo rje'i bzhed pa yin/ /zhal sbyor rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba ni/ /pakṣu'i yab chos zhal gzigs gnyis ka yin/ /de la 'khor mang 424

bskor ba deng sang 'di/ /rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po'i bzhed pa yin/ /de la 'jam dbyangs chen pos dgag mdzad kyang / /ma khog mthong ba don ldan de rjes 'brang / /mgon nyob ma zhes bya ba'i chog chen mdzad/ /rgyal dbang brgyad pas bka' yis bskul mdzad pas/ /dkon mchog 'bangs kyis deng sang 'di ka btus//me lce phreng ba ber chen brtsegs pa sogs/ /ber nag can rgyud brgyad stong nyung 'gyur tsam/ /dngos grub bstan gzigs lha mo'i srog rgyud sogs/ /lha mo'i rgyud kyang brgyad stong nyung 'gyur tsam//zhib par mjal bas nges shes dad pa thob//zhal sbyor rgyud la ma gsungs zer mod kyi//rin chen dpung rgyan srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /lha rgyud gsang ba chen po gsum ka las/ /zhal sbyor 'di nyid gsal bar gsungs pa mthong //'don cha 'di dag phal cher rgyud tshig lags/ /mal gyo nas brgyud mgon po'i yig rnying dang / /zhang btsun gter kha lha mo'i yig rnying ni/ /'dra min rdzogs mtha' med pa du ma mthong / /dkon mchog 'bangs kyis bsgrigs pa'i bod gzhung dang / /rgyal dbang dgu pas bsgrigs pa'i bod gzhung mjal/ /de phyir chos 'di'i mtha' rgya bdag gis chod/ /slob dpon gcirga nas tshang ma 'ong dka' bas/ /mchog dman slob dpon bdun la dbang gdams thob//rab rib 'khrul ba gnyid kyi snang ba la/ /si tu mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha des/ /mgon po'i bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs gnang bar mdzad/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs pas gzhung mthun rtags mtshan thob/ /nyams dang rmi lam skabs su lan 'ga' mjal//nga yi snying gi chos skyong 'di yin pas//bu khyod snying gi cho sa skyong 'di la mdzod/ /grub chen karma pakṣu'i zhal snga nas/ /ma mgon yig snas 'dzam gling khyab na yang / /de la brten nas dngos grub thob pa med/ /dpe 425

rul mang pos dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /nam mkha'i lha bzung man nas khong rang yan/ /zhal gzigs grub thob brgyud pa rgyun ma chad/ /grub rtags 'dzam gling khyab pa ma thos sam//phyin chad khong gi lugs 'di gyis gsungs nas//yab yum zhal sbyor sgrub thabs 'di ga mdzad/ /cho ga'i gzhung 'di rnying ma sor bzhag yin/ /'di yi man ngag po ti'i gzhung rnams su/ /tshig re tshig gnyis so sor 'thor nas yod/ /slob dpon zhal khrid med par shes par dka'//de phyir deng sang mgon po dar che yang / /'di yi bsnyen sgrub them pa dkon par byung //man ngag snyan rgyud shin tu gsang phyir yin/ /gong du bshad pa'i lugs ni mang po dag /phar skyur pakṣu'i dgongs pa nyid bshad na/ /'di la gong non yi dam mi dgos te//bla ma yi dam ma mgon dbyer med yin//'di la bdag mdun so sor mi dgos te/ /'di ni rnying ma sor bzhag lugs yin phyir/ /cho ga gcig gis bdag mdun dus gcig bskyed/ /bdag bskyed mgon por lha mos tshur 'khyud bsgom/ /mdun bskyed gzhung ltar lha mor mgon pos 'khyud//de gnyis dmigs pas phye ba ma gtogs pa/ /mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang 'dod gzhung dang mthun//rgyas pa'am mtshal ma gnyis po gang 'dod 'don//spyan 'dren skabs su 'od zer 'phros pa des/ /ri rab rtse mor sum rtsen lha yi yul/ /de yi byang phyogs rtsub 'gyur dur khrod tshal//de dbus brag steng gru gsum mthing nag steng //ma hā kā la dngos su bzhugs pa dang / /ri rab byang shar dpag bsam yongs 'du'i shing /de la dpal ldan lha mo gnas pa la/ /'od zer phog pas sngon gyi dam tshig dran//sprin nag rlung gis bskyod bzhin byon par dmigs//dmigs pa ma gsal bar du ma mgon gyi/ /spyan 'dren sngags ring gnyis po ci nus brjod/ /mchod 426

cing bstim dang dbang bskur gzhung du gsal//de nas bstod pa ma rdzogs bar du 'don//las byang dus bzhir dgos rgyu yin na yang //de byas bsnyen pa 'ga' yang mi 'gro bas/ /snga dro bstod pa yan de thun gcig bya/ /nyin gung gsol kha btang ba thun gcig brtsi/ /dgongs mo bskang gso bya ba thun gcig brtsi/ /mtshan mo mtshal ma'i bstod pa yan chad de/ /de bzhi thun bzhi'i las byang go chod yin/ /thun mtshams dmar gtor chung ngu re 'bul ba/ /gzhung gi dgug gzhug nyung ngu de byas la/ /snga dro'i thun la byang phyogs dur khrod dang / /ye shes dbyings ma gnyis po 'don la 'bul/ /nyin gung rtags bstod gnyis po 'don par bya/ /dgong mo 'das dang ma byon yab yum gnyis//mtshan mo gang zhig bla ma la smod ma/ /yum ni ye shes mkha' 'gro bar la mad/ /thun gtor dkyil 'khor drung phul spyi dang mtshungs //gson cig ma ni bsnyen sgrub dus mi 'don//de nas bsnyen sgrub dmigs pa'i bye brag ni//rang nyid mgon po yab yum zhal sbyor gyi//spyi bor rtsa brgyud bla ma kun 'dus pa/ /grub chen pakṣu sku mdog smug nag la/ /chos gos rnam gsum zhwa nag gser mdangs can/ /spyan mig zur gsum chos dbyings nam mkhar gzigs/ /sku sha rab rgyas ag tshom zur gsum ldan/ /phyag gnyis bdud 'dul phyag rgya sa gnon gyis//snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul du bskyed/ /rang nyid mgon po'i thugs ku'i cha stod du/ /rang sems yi dam sku tshad sor bzhi tsam//ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bsgom par bya//yab kyi thugs kur zla steng hūṃ yig mthar/ /oṃ shri ma hā kā la hūṃ//zhes pa'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom//yum gyi thugs mar nyi steng bhyoḥ sngon mthar//oṃ yakṣa be ta li dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las/ /'od zer kha dog sna chogs 427

phyogs bcur 'phros/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes chos skyong tshogs/ /kun la 'od zer des mchod thugs rgyud mnyes/ /thams cad ma mgon lcam dral skur gyur nas/ /kha ba bu yug 'tshub bzhin thams cad byon/ /bdag mdun lha tshogs kun la sib sib thim/ /rgyun chad med par dmigs pa de bsgom zhing / /drag po'i lha rgyud gsang ba las gsungs pa'i/ /zhal sbyor sku gsung thugs kyi sngags gsum lang///sku yi snying po lha sku bsgom pas 'thus/ /thugs kyi snying po bskyed rdzogs don gyis 'thus/ /bzlas gal che ba gsung gi sngags yin phyir/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la yakṣa bai ta li hūṃ dzaḥ /zhag gsum bya ba bsnyen pa'i rim pa yin/ /de nas rang gi thugs kya'i sngags 'khor las/ /'od zer mthing shas che ba'i kha dog lnga//zhal nas thon cing mdun bskyed la nye tshe/ /gnyis su byas nas yab yum zhal du zhugs/ /thugs kyi rgyud bskul sku yi dbyibs brgyud nas//sbyor mtshams nas thon rang gi sbyor mtshams zhugs//rdo rje'i sbubs nas rang gi thugs mar thim/ /phar la mchod pa tshur la dngos grub tshul/ /phyis nas 'od zer de yang sngags phreng bsgyur//bdag mdun sngags 'khor bzhi dang bar gyi sngags/ /sngags phreng lnga po mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /drag tu 'khor las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /bla ma yi dam ma mgon lcam dral tshogs/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa kun la 'od des mchod/ /de dag rnams las ma mgon yab yum sku/ /che phra sna tshogs sngags phreng yi ge dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga hūṃ mthing bhyoḥ sngon sogs/ /rgyun chad med par char chen bab pa bzhin/ /lhug lhug sib sib bdag mdun rnams la thim/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig zhag gsum bsgrub pa yin/ /de nas 'od zer sngags kyi phreng ba rnams/ /snga dro dkar dang nyin phyed 428

ser ba dang / /dgongs ka dmar dang srod la mthing nag bsgyur/ /phrin las rnam bzhi so sor 'grub bsam zhing / /zhag gcig bzlas pa las sbyor rim pa'o/ /de nub zan gyi ling ga gcig byas la/ /dgug gzhug phur 'deb la sogs las 'grig bzhin//ling ro dmar gtor che ba gcig nang 'bul//las 'grig bzhin du bskul ba thams cad 'don /gser skyems grub legs ma 'dzom dkar gtor 'bul/ /rgyu ldog 'grig na bzhes 'bod zor du 'phangs/ /ma 'grig gnod pa'i phyogs su 'bul rgyu bskur//gtor snod mdun du sbub la lta bro 'don/ /phyir nang mtshal ma tshar gcig bsdus pa byas/ /dngos grub lan chog 'don cing gtor dbang blangs/ /rtags yig rjes chog la sogs spyi dang mthun / /'di yi bsnyen tshad zhag bdun nges pa te/ /bdun gnyis bdun gsum la sogs bsgrub kyang mchog /grangs bsnyen 'bru grangs 'bum phrag bcu gsum yin/ /de dag mtshams dang sgrub pa'i lugs yin te/ /spros med rgyun khyer nyams su len 'dod na/ /mngon rtogs cho ga ngag nas 'don mi dgos/ /dran rdzogs bdag nyid yab yum zhal sbyor sku/ /spyi bor pakshi'i snying gar yi dam lha/ /'khor la nag po yab yum bcu drug las//gzhan pa'i 'khor mang bsgom par mi bya zhing / /'khor med gtso rkyang bsgom yang rung ba yin/ /bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa gong dang khyad par med/ /'od zer sngags phreng rang gi zhal nas thon/ /yum gyi zhal zhugs yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ /bha ga nas thon rdo rje nas zhugs bstims/ /yab la brten nas yum nyid sgrub thabs yin//rang nyid lha mor bsgoms nas mgon por 'khyud//sngags phreng rang nyid lha mo'i zhal nas thon//mgon po'i zhal du zhugs pas thugs rgyud bskul/ /rdo rje'i lam nas rang gi bha gar zhugs/ /thugs gar zhugs pas dngos 429

grub thob bar dmigs/ /lha mo la brten mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs//bskyed rim go bldog bogs 'don mchog yin zhes/ /rgyal dbang brgyad pas 'di la bsngags pa che/ /de ltar dmigs pa bsgom zhing sngags bzlas te/ /sgrub pa'i thun mtshams rnams su gegs sel dang //rgyun bsnyen skabs sam yang na nam dgos su/ /bar chad sel ba'i dmigs rim zab mo ni//rang nyid mgon po'i phrag gong g.yas g.yon du/ /bya rog nag po cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs/ /mchu sder gnam lcags pha lam las grub pa//me stag tsha tsha 'phro ba gnyis sgom ste//de las sprul pa'i bya rog dpag med pa/ /che chung 'brong g.yag tsam pas 'jig rten gang / /'phur zhing lding dang 'dzum dang 'bab la sogs/ /gshog sgra 'ur sgra 'brug chen ldir ba bzhin/ /rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /thams cad bye'us 'bu srin thus bzhin zos/ /thams cad tshur 'dus 'od zhu thugs skar thim//shā sa na yi sngags ni tshar gcig brjod//'di ni bar chad sel thabs mchog tu zab/ /spros med bdag bskyed ting 'dzin gsal ba'i dus/ /bza' btung mchod par dmigs pas chog mod kyi/ /nub re gtor bsngos rgyas pa thon na rab//ma grub ma dag ma tsam chags med bya//mtshal ma chags med la sogs ma grub kyang / /mgon po thugs dam gtso bor byed chog pas/ /'di 'dra chos lugs 'di la gser bas phangs//gong gi sgrub pa zhag gsum mtshams dam par/ /bsgrub pa rtags mtshan rang nyid yid ches pa/ /byung ba rang dang rang gi slob ma ni/ /drug bdun tsam gyis myong bas grub pa byung / /'di 'dra'i phyag len zhal khrid kho na ste/ /gsal bo phyogs gcig yi ger bris pa med/ /po ti gzhung la sbas thabs 'thor nas yod/ /lung 'dren tshig rnams bri ba yi ger 'jigs/ / 430

zab dang mi zab nyams su longs la ltos/ /grub mtha' mi gcig brgyud pa mi 'dzin pa'i/ mi la bstan na bka' chad 'byung ngo zhes/ /grub chen pakṣu'i bka' rgya dam par 'dug /grub mtha' 'di 'dzin nyams su len rnams la/ /kun la shod cig ston cig bris shig gsungs/ /de skad me 'bar cang shes rgyal po'i lo/ /dbang phyug chen po'i theb chen khrums zla ba'i/ /ma mgon rgyu dus nyer dgu'i snga dro la/ /ma mgon rnal 'byor rā ga a sus smras//rū ba sngags 'chang brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bris/ /sba 'os gsal bkod ma mgon drung du bshags/ /dge bas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par shog/le'u lnga bcu pa'o maṅga lam̐//ras chen khyad chos mgon po'i nor sgrub/7snyori chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ 'gro mgon ras chen gyis mdzad pa'i mgon po nor lha ltar bsgrub pa rgyun khyer du bya ba'i zin bris bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ma hā kā la ye/ /ḍo mbi he ru ka yi sprul pa'i sku//'gro mgon ras pa chen pos mdzad pa yi/ /mgon po nor lha ltar du bsgrub pa 'di/ /gzhung gi dpe mod kun gyis shes mod kyang / /zhal khrid med phyir phyag len bde ba min/ /bca' tshogs gsol kha gzhung ltar rgyas par bya/ /'di yi bsgrub pa gud du ma byas kyang / /bde rim bskang gsol byed ba'i skabs rnams su/ /sngags dang dmigs pa thun re bsgoms pa yis/ /longs spyod mnga' thang shugs kyis 'dus pa yin/ /de phyir bskang gsol shes tshad rnams la phan/ /thun mtshams skad cig yi dam 431

gnas 'gyur nas/ /rang nyid ber can yab rkyang gzhung ltar la/ /don la phyogs bcu mgon po yin pa la/ /cha lugs rang 'dra ber can bcu yis bskor/ /kun kyang dbu la rin chen rtse bran lnga/ /kun kyang rin chen rgyan cha du mas bklubs/ /nor lha mched brgyad la sogs nor lhas bskor/ /rang gi thugs mar rang gi yi dam lha/ /bsnyen sgrub them pa'i yi dam gzhan med na/ /ye shes mgon po legs ldan bsgom pas chog /de gnyis gang byed thugs kur nyi ma'i steng / /hūṃ mthing tha mar bzlas sngags g.yas su 'khor/ /mdun du zhal sbyor 'khor mang gzhung ltar bsgom/ /de dag kun kyang rin chen rgyan chas bklubs/ /rang gi thugs kya'i sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang 'dra mgon po bcu la 'od zer phog /de yi 'od zer nor lha mched brgyad bskul/ /de las 'od 'phros 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor bcud bsdus bdag la bstim/ /yang ni bdag las 'od zer mdun bskyed bskul/ /mdun bskyed phyogs bcu mgon po'i grar bzhugs pa'i/ /gter bdag dzam bha la dang rnam thos sras/ /phyugs lha sha ba ri dang re manta/ /re manta ni dpal 'bar 'chang pa yin/ /nor lha bzhi po de las 'od zer 'phros/ /rta g.yang nor g.yang zas nor longs spyod g.yang / /thams cad bsdus nas bdag dang gnas khang bstims/ /res 'ga' de dag sku yi 'od zer gyis/ /dgos 'dod rin chen sna tshogs char 'bebs bsam/ /gsol ba'i mjug tu sngags 'di ci nus 'bad/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ bdag la ratnasirnyi sirnyi hphi/ /ces pa'i sngags de ci nus bzlas par bya/ /de ni nor sgrub mchog tu gyur ba ste/ /gsol kha nam byed gsham du sngags dmig sa chog /khyad par dmigs pa'i bsgyur kha cung zad ni/ /bdag bskyed 'od zer mdun bskyed 432

ma mgon bskul/ /ma mgon 'od zer rnam sras dzam lha gnyis/ /drag tu bskul bas de gnyis 'od zer gyis/ /zas nor longs spyod rin chen sna tshogs pa/ /char ltar 'bebs shing na bun ltar 'phyur dmigs/ /yang ni 'od zer dpal rab mgon po bskul/ /rta g.yang kun bsdus rta la thim par bsam/ /bdag mdun 'od zer nub byang mgon po bskul/ /nor g.yang kun bsdus nor la thim bsam pas/ /god kha chod cing sgab 'phel g.yang chags 'gyur/ /spyir ni ma mgon 'khor bcas bsgrub pa 'di/ /'jig rten mchod bstod rgyud du gtogs par gsungs/ /'jig rten mchod dang bstod pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ /brgyud pa 'dzin zhing dam tshig bsrung ba dang / /mchod bstod rgya cher 'bul zhing bstod bskul gyis/ /bsgrub mi dgos par phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /'grub par 'gyur zhes grub chen pakṣus gsungs/ /de phyir gsol kha dag la brtson bya zhing / /sngags dang dmigs pa sham bu de yod na/ /'dzam bu gling rnams dbang du sdud pa dang / /dgos 'dod sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /nor lha rnams kyi mchog kyang 'di yin te/ /'di 'dra gzhan la med ces gsungs pa yin/ /de skad cang shes pad ma rā ga'i mdog /dbang phyug chen po'i dus chen khrums zla yi/ /gnam gang mgon po lan gsum rgyu ba'i nyin/ /dge slong rā ga a sus smras pa de/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod/ /sba 'os gsal bkod nyes pa lha la bshags/ /dge bas bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel gyur cig /le'u nga gcig pa snod min la gsang rgya'o//bkra shis// 433

snyan rgyud lho brag mgon po'i gdams ngaga'ari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ ma mgon gyi rdzogs rim rtsa rlung gi gdams pa mar ba'i snyan brgyud lho brag mgon po zhes bya ba'i zin bris bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ma hā kā la ye/ /mgon po lha mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /snyan brgyud ma mgon rtsa rlung gdams pa bri/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gros bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs//grub chen ḍombi he ru ka chen por/ ma mgon lcam dral nyid kyis lung bstan nas/ /mgon po'i rgyud dgu lha mo'i rgyud dgu dang / /bco brgyad don bsdus ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi/ /sgrub thabs rdzogs rim dang bcas rtsa tshig mdzad/ /rgya gzhung nyung zhing man ngag snyan du brgyud/ /mar pa'i snyan brgyud lho brag mgon po zer/ /te lo nā ro mar mi dus mkhyen bar/ /gcig brgyud yin te gzhan gyis thos pa med/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas kyang / /chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral yin gsungs pa/ /rtsa ba de yi don la dgongs pa yin/ /khokhris mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs drag sngags skor/ /mal gyo nas brgyud 'gro mgon ras pas gsan//bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs mgon po'i skor 'di la//nga las mkhas med snyam pa'i nga rgyal yod//yab yum gtsang yin khams su byon pa'i tshe/ /kai po gnas nang dus mkhyen snyan grags che/ /chos zhu yobasam grub rtags 'gran du byon//dus mkhyen mjal bas 'gro mgon chas ja la//bhandha 'jal ba'i chu blugs thug pa bskol/ /tshwa dang rdor gyi tshab la thab gnya' nas/ / 434

bong bu'i rus pa o tho ril lu gcig /blangs nas tshwa rdor tshab la thug pa dkrug /rgyun du lan re la ni mi dkrug ste/ /de ring gal che lan gnyis dkrug dgos gsungs/ /'gro mgon ras pas 'di 'dra'i mu ge la/ /dgongs nas yi mug thugs khrel bzhag par byas/ /de nas dpon slob gnyis kyi bhandhar blugs/ /'gro mgon ras pas gsol nyan med dgongs dza//ro mchog brgyad ldan de 'dra gsol ma myong / /de nas ras chen dad pa cung tsam skyes/ /khyed dang nga gnyis rlung nus 'gran dgos zhus//nga ni rgas drags khyod kyi ya mi 'ong //pha kir song dang nga yi slob bu gcig/yod pas de dang 'gran par gyis shig gsungs//de ru song bas phug pa gcig gi nang //stag gcig nyal 'dug skrag nas myur du byon//dus mkhyen la zhus da rung (da dung /)song dang gsungs//song bas mtsho gcig sngo ltem 'khyil nas 'dug /mtsho yi nang du rdel bu 'ga' re 'phangs/ /mi ni mi 'dug tshur la log nas 'ong / /dus mkhyen la zhus da rung (da dung /)song dang gsungs/ /song bas sgom chen dbu skra se cog ge /gcig gis skyil krung bcas nas bzhugs 'dug pa'i/ /pang du da ci'i 'phangs pa'i rde'u 'dug /de la rlung nus 'gran dgos zhus pa yi/ /dgun kha lung ba chab rom gang ba de/ /stod du 'ba' tsha stag del ba de bzhugs//gnyis ka gcer bu ras rkyang chu ras mdzad//'ba' tsha stag del sku yi mda' 'ben tshun/ /'khyags zhu skyil krung gram pa la thug cing / /chu khol rlangs pa na bun ltar 'khrigs kyang / /chu de btang na 'khyags de zhu dogs nas/ /mar la ma btang yar la 'khyil zhing 'phyur/ /ras chen 'khyags zhu thub kyang chu ma dros/ /sku smad chur nub shin tu 'khyags par byung / /thor ngas dus su dus gsum mkhyen pa nyid/ /seng ger chibs nas nam 435

mkhar dngos su byon//bu 'ba' tsha stag dil ba/ khyod kyis sgom chung gsar bu de 'khyags grir ma bsad//gsungs pas sku la 'khyil ba'i chu tshan btang //lung ba de yi 'khyags rnams thams cad zhu/ /slob bu 'di la rdzu 'phrul 'di 'dra na/ /bla mar 'gran dgos smras pa nga re 'khrul/ /dgongs shing 'gro mgon ras pa'i nga rgyal chags//chos 'brel tsam zhig zhu ba ma gtogs pa//dus mkhyen slob ma byed bsam med pa la/ /khyod kyi yon tan gang shes gsungs pa la/ /nga ni mgon por mkhas zhes shes tshad smras/ /dus mkhyen zhal nas de tsho phyi sgrub skor/ /phrin las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sngags nag yin/ /stod las byang chub sgrub thabs med dam gsungs/ /ma mchis nyid la bdog na gnang zhus pas/ /mar pa'i snyan brgyud ma mgon rtsa rlung gnang / /de yis yid ches dad pa'i gdeng tshud nas/ /dus mkhyen chos brgyud 'dzin pa des byung gsungs//'di nyid snyan rgyud shin tu zab pa'i phyir/ /rgya gzhung rtsa ba sdeb ngos tsam las med/ /mkha' spyod dbang po don ldan la sogs pa'i/ /dam dum brjed tho lta bur mdzad pa mang / /khrid yig cha tshang yi ger bris pa med//phrin las bsgrub pa'i dmigs rim brgya rtsa sogs//yod par gsungs kyang de yi rtsa ba ni/ /yab yum zhal sbyor rab kyi dbang bzhi'am/ /tha na zhal sbyor gtong dbang thob par bya/ /rab tu sngon la bsnyen pa thon na mchog /ma thon na yang bsgom la nyes 'gal med/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas 'thus//rang nyid mgon po rkang thang gri thod can//ber can mngon rtogs spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ /lha mo phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud/ /phyag bzhi ma yis 'khyud pa rang byung bzhed/ /sku nang stong ba phru ma phus btab bzhin/ /'di skabs rlung ni 'bud pa dgu phrugs bya/ /dmigs pa ma 436

gsal bar du 'jam rlung bzung //de nas yum de yab la thim pa'i mthus//nang gi mkha' 'gro ma ni rtsa yin phyir/ /rtsa gsum lus dang rtsa yi stong ra thig le'i rnal 'byor sogs yang gsang bla med kyi sgrub pa bde chen rab 'bar nang du blta bar bya'o/ /mchan/ 'khor lo lnga ldan chos drug bzhin/ /pakṣu'i bzhed ltar gnas lngar yig 'bru lnga/ /dug lnga'i ngo bo gtum mo'i mes bsregs pas//mgon po rigs lngar lha mo rigs lngas 'khyud/ /'khor gyi lha mo rtsa yi grangs rnams kyang / /ba༈ med de g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bzhugs/ /gnas lnga'i lha yi thugs skar rang mdog gi/ hūṃ dang bhyoḥ yig so sor bsgom par bya/ /mgon po'i thugs kur o ma hā kā la ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ lha mo'i thugs yir oṃ traka rakṣa ma ti dun bhyo ma hā yakṣa tikṣa ṇa kā li dun bhyoḥ / zhes pa de gnyis bsgom rgyu yin na yang / /kurma pakṣu'i khyad chos zab khyad ni/ /oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hri da hūṃ phaṭaḥ /'di ni ber nag can gyi snying por bzhed//gsar rnying mgon po'i rgyud gzhung thams cad nas//'di las phan yon che ba'i sngags ma mchis/ /oṃ ru ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bhyo dza dzaḥ /de ni lha mo spyi yi sngags yin zhing / /khyad par rang byung ma yi yang snying yin/ /lha mo rgyud sde srid do 'tshal kun las/ /de las phan yon che ba'i sngags ma mchis/ /de phyir de gnyis gnas lngar g.yas g.yon 'khor/ /rlung bzung 'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyong bya//de nas sum mdo 'am lte 'og sor bzhi nas//gtum mo'i me 'bar lus kun me yis gang //me lce ba spu'i bu gar phyir thon pas//lus kun me 'bar me dpung je cher mched/ /gnas de'am ni bsrung bya gar yod khyab/ /gnod byed bsregs dmigs 'khrul 'khor drug bskor bya/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor brtson na drod skye 'gyur/ /thun mtshams me dpung tshur 'dus rang 437

la bstims/ /yang ni me sbar spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu/ /rtsa gnas kun gang bde bas lus gang bsams/ /dmigs pa gsal na bde nyams gnas nyams skye/ /de tshe ngo bo bltas la bde stong bsre/ /sngags 'khor bsgom zhing sngags rnams yid kyis bzla//gnas lnga'i mgon po lnga las 'od zer dang //rang mdog lha tshogs mang po spros pa yis/ /rigs lnga'i lhar gyur lha kun mchod byed cing / /de dag ma mgon rigs lnga'i skur gyur nas/ /tshur byon gnas lnga'i lha la bstims pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga po yi / /mchog thun dngos grub thams cad thob par bsgom/ /dpral ba'i ma mgon dkar po'i 'od zer gyis/ /rang gzhan nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang //mgrin pa'i ma mgon dmar po'i 'od zer gyis//lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa dang / /thugs ma'i ma mgon mthing ma'i 'od zer gyis//rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi ye shes bsdus//rang thim nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel/ /lte ba'i ma mgon ser bo'i 'od zer gyis/ /tshe dang bsod nams bstan pa rgyas par spel/ /gsang gnas ma mgon ljang nag 'od zer gyis/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod sogs/ /dmigs pa'i bsgyur kha brgya rtsa yod par gsungs/ /'di dag skabs su 'khrul 'khor so bdun bya/ /dmigs pa'i bsgyur kha rgyas par mang mchis kyang //rtsa ba'i dmigs rim de tsam zhig gis 'thus//rtsa rlung la brten dgra bgegs bsgral ba ni//shin tu zab gnyan grub chen pakṣu'i lugs/ /rang nyid mgon po yab rkyang gnam sa tsam sku lus stong gsal bsgom pa'i lteng 'og thad/ /me yi rang bzhin gru gsum rgya che'i dbus/ /zhal sbyor ram ni gtso rkyang gang yang rung / /zhal ni zur gsum yar la gdangs pa de/ /me yi rang bzhin me dpur 'bar bar bsgom/ /rang gi thugs 438

dbus zla steng hūṃ mthing mthar/ /shā sa na sogs mgon po'i sngags kyis bskor/ /de las 'od zer dmar nag 'phros pa de/ /shangs bug g.yas thon lcags kyu'i dbyibs lta bus/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs gang yin thams cad bkug /shangs bug g.yon zhugs lte ba'i ma mgon gyi/ /zhal du rkang rting skya lhag song bar bsams/ /lus ngag yid gsum nus pa tshe srog rnams/ /bya sgro me la bsregs bzhin rdul du brlag/rlung ni phar 'phros 'od zer phar 'phro dang / /tshur la rngub dus bkug pa'i dmigs pa dang / /nang du dgongs tshe zhal du bsreg pa dang / /kho yi sems nyid chos dbyings klong thim par//bsgom la nyams len ngang la thun gcig gzhag /de tshe shā sa na dang hu ra sogs//drag sngags yid kyis bzla bar bya ba yin/ /rtsa rlung goms shing dmigs pa gsal ba'i mis/ /dgra bsgral bgegs 'dul 'di las zab pa med/ /mchod gtor rbad bskul ci yang mi dgos gsungs/ /gong ma bsgrub pa 'di ni las sbyor yin//'di nyid snyan brgyud shin tu zab pa'i phyir/ /'tshogs med gsal bar bkod na bka' chad 'byung / /de phyir bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim mjug 'dir bri/ /rang nyid mgon po yab rkyang gong ltar gsal/ /de yi dpral mgrin thugs ka gsum po ru/ /oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing gsal bar dmigs//de las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang //sna bug nas thon 'jig rten kun khyab pas/ /'jig rten 'das pa dang ni ma 'das pa'i/ /'khor 'das kun la 'od des phog pa'i mthus/ /sa 'og gnas rnams sku yi mgon po dkar/ /sa steng gnas rnams gsung gi mgon po dmar//sa bla bar snang yan chod yin gsungs mchan/gnas rnams thugs kyi mgon po mthing //rang mdog ber gsol kun kyang sngags sgra sgrog/ /rlung zhig tshur la rngub 439

pa dang bstun nas/ /de kun oṃ dkar āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing gyur/ /sna g.yon nas zhugs gnas gsum yig 'brur thim/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ /rlung bzung mi dmigs ngang la cung zad gzhag /slar yang rlung zhig phar la gtong ba'i tshe/ /snod kyi 'jig rten chos 'byung gzhal yas khang / /bcud kyi sems can thams cad mgon po'i sku//pho rnams mgon po mo rnams dpal lha mo/ /sgra skad thams cad ma mgon sngags su bsam/ /de yang sems las gzhan du ma grub pas/ /sems nyid ngo bo stong ba dpal lha mo/ /rang bzhin gsal ba ye shes mgon po nyid/ /stong gsal dbyer med yab yum zhal sbyor ba/ /sna tshogs 'phros pa las byed dregs pa'i 'khor//ye nas lhun grub rang la gnas pa ste//ye nas chos sku rjen pa yin pa ste/ /rang ngo rang gis shes pas ye shes zer/ /de rtog sa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /skyob pa'i skyabs dang mgon ni de yin phyir//ye shes mgon po rang gi sems nyid yin//de don mgon po'i rgyud chen rnams su gsal/ /'phags bzhi skyed byed lha mo yum chen mo/ /rang gis sems las gud du med pa'i tshul/ /lha mo'i rgyud gzhung rnams la shin tu gsal / /de nyid rtogs na rtsub chags 'khu ldog med/ /ma mgon lus dang grib bzhin 'bral mi srid/ /bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim don ldan zhabs kyi lugs/ /dpal 'byor don grub nyid la gdams pa yin/ /de ltar ma mgon rlung khrid mdor bsdus 'di/ /rū ba brtson 'grus rgya mtshos nan gyis bskul/ /bka' rgya dam pas smra bar dka' na yang / /ma mgon srung ma rnams la gsol btab pas/ /'dir mos gsar bu rnams la phan snyam nas/ /lo yi rgyal bo cang shes me 'bar lo/ /dbang phyug chen po'i dus chen khrumasra zla yi/ /nyer dgu ma mgon dus chen dgu 440

gtor nyin/ /nyin gung rnal 'byor rā ga a sus smras/ /rū pa'i rigs las byung pa'i sngags 'chang ni/ /brtson 'grus mchog ldan brtson 'grus rgya mtshos bris/ /gsang sngags sba 'os gsal bar bkod pa'i nyes/ /gang mchis ma mgon srung ma'i tshogs la bshags/ /dge bas sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar rgyas shog /le'u nga gnyis pa'o maṅga lam̐/ /dbang lung ma thob pa dang nyams su mi len pa la gsang bar zhes gsungs i thi /bsngo ba'i zhal gdam nor bu rin chen/ṭhari chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams las/ sngo ba'i zhal gdams nor bu rin chen zhis bya bzhugs so/ /na mo shākya mu ne ye/ /kun mkhyen thub pa'i zhabs la phyag mtshal lo/ /bsngo ba'i zab gnad zhal gyi gdams pa ni/ /rang re sems can 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di/ /tshogs ma bsags pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ /tshogs bsags dpag tu med pa byas mod kyi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyu ru ma bsngos pas/ /'bras bu lha mi'i bde skyid mang po zhig /myong bas dge 'bras zad nas ltung ba yin/ /dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngos na ni/ /skye ba kun tu bde skyid myong na yang //bsod nams mi zad mthar thug byang chub 'thob/ /dge ba zad med gdams ngag bsngo ba yin/ /tshe 'dir dge ba mang po bsgrubs na yang / /mi dmigs bsngo bas rgyas 'debs ma shes na/ /so ma btang ba'i rdza ma gsar ba bzhin//dge ba de yang nyams par sla ba ste//sbyin dang tshul khrims dge 441

ba bskal ba brgyar//bsags pa khong khro gcig gis 'joms par gsungs//dge pa skyoms pa zhes bya rang nyid kyi//dge pa gang byas ngoms na 'dzad par bshad//zang zing dge ba rlabs chen bsgrubs pa'i rjes//ser sna'i dbang gis 'gyod pa skyes na 'dzad/ /dge ba gang 'grub bsngo bas rgyas btab na/ /khro dang skyom dang 'gyod pas nyams mi 'gyur//dge ba mi nyams thabs la bsngo ba zab/ /bsngo bas rgyas ma theb pa'i dge ba rnams/ /lo brgya song yang skyed med de ka rang / /bsngo bas rgyas theb phyin nas dge ba de/ /zhag re song zhing skyed re 'phel ba ste/ /dge ba chung ngu la yang chen por 'gyur//gling bzhi 'jig rten lo legs snye ma bzhin//dgra bcom rang rgyal bar med gang ba la/ /ji srid 'tsho bar bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ /dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo byas na/ /phan yon che sogs bsngags pa mtha' yas pa/ /stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /de ni yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /dmigs med 'khor gsum yang dag bsngo ba yin/ /'khor gsum dmigs pa can gyi bsngo ba ni/ /bsngo ba dug can zhes bya phan yon chung / /'jig rten lha mi'i bde skyid rgyur 'gyur gyis//'phags lam 'thob pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur ba min/ /'khor gsum yang dag bsngo ba'i bzhed pa ni/ /stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i 'phags pa yis/ /mdzad rgyu yin cing so skyes mi 'grub pas//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la//dgongs gsol tshig gis snyan gsan dbab byas te//dge ba 'di yang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi /bsngo bar 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol lo zhes/ /gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa dang //'das dang ma byon da lta'i sangs rgyas dang /kun du bzang po 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa'i/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngo ba mdzad pa ltar/ / 442

dge ba 'di yang de ltar gyur cig ces/ /mos pa tsam gyis bsngo ba byed pa ni/ /mdo lugs bstan pa spyi yi bsngo ba yin//de don bzang spyod ltung bshags sogs las gsal/ /bsngo ba bsngo mkhan bsngo rgyu rnam pa gsum/ /sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i blo bzhag ste/ /bsngos na 'khor gsum yang dag bsngo ba yi/ /phyogs mthun 'byung bar jo bo rje yis bzhed/ /de don bka' gdams glegs bam nang du gsal / /phyag rdzogs dgongs pa bka' brgyud bzhed pa la//spros bral rtogs pa skyes pa'i rtogs ldan des/ /nyams len ngang nas bsngo bar byed pa de/ /'khor gsum yang dag bsngo ba yin pa de/ /spros bral stong nyid mngon sum rtogs par bzhed/ /de la 'gro mgon sa skya parnyi tas/ /spros bral stong nyid mngon sum yin na ni/ /stong nyid mngon sum rtogs dang sa thob mnyam/ /dang po sa thob byang chub sems dpa' des/ /skad cig lag pa brkyang bskum yud tsam la/ sprul pa brgya yis dag pa'i zhing khams brgyar//sangs rgyas brgya mjal dam chos nyan pa dang / /sprul pa brgya yis ma dag 'jig rten brgyar/ /re res sems can brgya re'i don mdzad dang / /'jig rten khams brgya kun ni g.yo nus pa'i/ /yon tan de dag med pa ci yin gsungs/ /khyung ni sgong nga'i nang du gshog drug rgyas/ /sgo nga ma chag bar du 'phur ma nus/ /seng ge ma yi khog nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /ma skyes bar du lus rtsal ston mi nus//de bzhin stong nyid mngon sum rtogs na yang //rnam smin lus rgyas btums phyir rtags mi gsal/ /shi tshe bar dor rtags rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ /bka' brgyud pa rnams dngos su bzhugs tshe las/ /'das nas byin rlabs che ru 'gro bar bshad//de la mkhas pa sa skya parnyi tas/ /nyi ma de ring shar bar gyur ba la//'od ni de ring med de song yod pa/ /blun po tshig gis mgo skor 443

yin no gsungs/ /de la skyobs pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis//rtags yod na ni sa thob yin nges shing / /rtags de med na sa thob min nges pa'i/ /tshad ldan mdo rgyud lung zhig sus rnyed la/ /chib pa 'di la gos yug btags nas sbyin/ /gsungs kyang de dus sus kyang ma rnyed skad//de don byams pa'i lung bstan mdo sde las/ /byams pa dge slong ma pham par gyur pas/ /shākya thub pa'i drung du bzhugs pa la/ /'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas byams pa yin/ /thub pas gsungs kyang 'khor rnams yid ma ches//'di la rtags dang yon tan gcig kyang med//nyon mongs ma spangs tha mal dge slong rang / /'di 'dra sangs rgyas lnga par 'gyur srid dam/ /bsam tshe byams pas lung bstan mdo sde gsungs/ /de phyir rtags dang yon tan med na yang / /stong nyid ma rtogs min par mdo der gsal/ /de phyir phyag rdzogs gnyis kyi bzhed pa la/ /spros bral yan chad rtogs pa'i gang zag des//nyams len ma yengs bsngo ba byed pa de//'khor gsum yang dag bsngo ba yin par nges/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dang //so so'i skye bos dge ba gang mdzad la/ /bsam pa dag pas rjes su yi rang bsgom//de ltar yi rang bsgom pa'i dge ba dang / /sbyin bdag de yis rang la byin pa sogs/ /bsngo rgyu'i dge ba gang yin gcig tu bsdoms/ /sangs rgyas kun la mchod pa'i sprin du bsngo//sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas phyir bsngo//bstan 'dzin sku tshe phrin las rgyas phyir bsngo//'jig rten thams cad bde zhing skyid phyir bsngo/ /sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo/ /de ltar bsngo tshul de dag re res kyang / /dge ba chung ngu dpag med chen por 'phel/ /de don rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo pa'i mdo/ /la sogs mdo sde mang po rnams nas gsungs/ /de 444

nas de dag thams cad gcig bsdus te/ /rang ngam sbyin bdag tshe 'das sogs la bsngo/ /skye ba kun tu bde skyid ldan pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de ni tha mal shi bsngo gson bsngo yin/ /mchod bsngo la yang 'bring dang rab gnyis te/ /'bring ni dge rtsa zhing gshegs la smin nas/ /rang don chos sku mngon du mdzad pa dang / /gzugs sku dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad du/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i brda chos ston pa dang / /sprul sku ma dag 'jig rten bye ba brgyar/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'gro ba 'dren pa dang / /rjes 'jug rnams kyang bar chad rkyen zhi zhing / /rigs rgyud chos rgyud 'phel ba'i bsngo smon bya/ /rab ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma de/ /sku gsum dag pa'i zhing du bzhugs pa la/ /dge rtsa de nyid mchod pa'i sprin chen po/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen bdun/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang / /'khor ba ji srid mchod sprin rgyun mi chad/ /zag pa med pa'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs/ /gdul bya rnams la thugs rjes nyer gzigs nas/ /bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sku mchog myur du byon/ /gdul bya'i don chen mdzad phyir bsngo smon bya/ /bla phran yin na 'dus pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur bya tshul kun gyis shes/ /bla chen dgon chen yin na mthun 'gyur rnams/ /tshigs bcad sho lo ka re bskul 'don dang / /bla phran yin na de yi 'thob cha med/ /de ltar bsngo ba'i gdams pa zhal khrid 'di/ /rta lo tha skar zla ba'i yar tshes lnga/ /ri chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /dge slong rā ga a sus smras pa de/ /bla ma brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ge bkod//le'u nga gsum pa'o maṅgalam̐// 445

chig brgyud u pa chos gyi grangs ldan/(log su bzhugs pas der gzigs pa zhu/)tsho'izhabs rten zhal shes gdams pas 'jug bsdu ba/ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams gnang dus/ rje la brtan bzhugs su phul ba'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dngos dpal ldan bla ma mchog /bstan 'gro'i don la thugs rjes nyer dgongs nas/ /zhing 'dir sprul pa'i skur bzhengs gu ru rje/ /kurma rā ga a su zhabs brtan shog /nyid sku 'khrungs nas sgrub pa dpag med mdzad/ /mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /skar tshogs lta bur dpag med zhal gzigs pa'i/ /gu ru rā ga a su zhabs brtan shog /khyad par rgyud sde bzhi dang sde snod gsum/ /dam chos thugs nyams bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don/ chos kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcur bskor mdzad pa'i/ /sprul sku rā ga a su zhabs brtan shog /gzhan yang mthong thos don ldan 'gro ba rnams/ /smin grol lam la dngos su 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rā ga a su lo brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /bstan pa nyi zla lta bur gsal ba dang / rgyud 'dzin bstan pa 'dzin pa'i grwa slob rnams/ /chu bo rgyun bzhin rgyun chad med par shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems smon lam la/ /dbang ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong nor lha dam can rgya mtsho yi/ /bden pa'i stobs dang dge tshogs stobs rnams kyis/ /smon lam da lta nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ces ba 'di shugs 'chang cang shes rgyal po'i 446

lor/ /rgyal zla ba'i yar tshes la gnas mchog dpal ri'i rtser/ rje la brtan bzhugs su bla ma skarma bīrya sā ga ras phul ba'o//maṅga lam̐//bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ /ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag ri khrod 'grims shing / /mdo sngags kyi nyams len dang / /gsar rnying thams cad gcig tu dril ba'i sgrub pa gcig shes kun khrol/ /rang gzhan gyi don thams cad bsgrub par 'dod na/ /ri chos mtshams kyi zhal gdams 'di la tshang ba yin te/ /nga dang dngos su 'phrad kyang //'di las legs pa bshad rgyu med par shes par byos la//glegs bam 'di bri bar 'dod pa dag gis le'u so sor mi phye bar/ /mgul 'bum bris pa ltar phyogs gcig tu sbrags nas glegs bam bzang po gcig gyis la zhog dang / dpe cha kha ma 'thor ba sogs 'ong bas blo chung rnams la 'gro don rgya cher po zhig 'byung ngam snyam pa kho bos sems so/ /zhes dang /'og nas 'byung ba'i rtsa rlung gi gdams pa dang / chos skyong spyi sgrub kyi skor rnams dbang lung ma thob pa dang / sgrub pa mi byed sogs snod min rnams la gsang bar bya ste shes par byos shig ces pa'i zhal gdams zhal shes 'di yang kurma bīryas bris pa'o/ /maṅga lam̐// 447

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ mkhan po rdo rje/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ kurma gu ru/ sngags 'chang gu ru/mkhan 'chi med tshe dbang/mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/glegs bam drug pa/chags med ri chos/mkhas grub rā ga a sus brtsams/mkhan po rdo rjes bsgrigs/zhang kyang then mā dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/lan kru'u dmag khul dpar khang gis par/deb tshad/ 850〉〈1168 17 32 dpar shog15gsab shog 4 yig grangs khri 23nyis stong gsum lo'i zla ba bcu par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/nyis stong gsum lo'i zla ba bcu par dpar thengs dang po par/dpe rtags/ 132ma962—450—953—070 42794:rdozud sprodaspreng / sgor 1900
